entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de bīng xiāng lǐ yǒu shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's in your fridge?
entries.answer: 我的冰箱裡有很多啤酒。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de bīng xiāng lǐ yǒu hěn duō pí jiǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: There's a lot of beer in my fridge.

entries.example: 從這裡走過去大約十分鐘。
entries.examplePinyin: cóng zhè lǐ zǒu guò qù dà yuē shí fēn zhōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's about a ten-minute walk from here.
entries.question: 你每天大約幾點起床？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ měi tiān dà yuē jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng?
entries.questionEnglish: About what time do you get up every day?
entries.answer: 我大約七點起床。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dà yuē qī diǎn qǐ chuáng.
entries.answerEnglish: I get up at about seven.

entries.example: 這家店晚上十點關門。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn wǎn shàng shí diǎn guān mén.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop closes at 10 p.m.
entries.question: 你家附近的超市幾點關門？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn de chāo shì jǐ diǎn guān mén?
entries.questionEnglish: What time does the supermarket near your home close?
entries.answer: 我家附近的超市十點關門。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā fù jìn de chāo shì shí diǎn guān mén.
entries.answerEnglish: The supermarket near my home closes at ten.

entries.example: 我們可以坐捷運，或者坐公車。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men kě yǐ zuò jié yùn, huò zhě zuò gōng chē.
entries.exampleEnglish: We can take the MRT, or the bus.
entries.question: 週末你通常做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: zhōu mò nǐ tōng cháng zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you usually do on weekends?
entries.answer: 我在家休息，或者去逛街。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài jiā xiū xí, huò zhě qù guàng jiē.
entries.answerEnglish: I rest at home, or go shopping.

entries.example: 我對這間房子很滿意。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ duì zhè jiān fáng zi hěn mǎn yì.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm very satisfied with this apartment.
entries.question: 你對現在的工作滿意嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì xiàn zài de gōng zuò mǎn yì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you satisfied with your current job?
entries.answer: 很滿意，同事都很好。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn mǎn yì, tóng shì dōu hěn hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Very satisfied. My coworkers are all great.

entries.example: 晚餐做好了，快來吃！
entries.examplePinyin: wǎn cān zuò hǎo le, kuài lái chī!
entries.exampleEnglish: Dinner's ready. Come and eat!
entries.question: 你今天的工作都做好了嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jīn tiān de gōng zuò dōu zuò hǎo le ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you finished all your work today?
entries.answer: 還沒，我明天才能做好。
entries.answerPinyin: hái méi, wǒ míng tiān cái néng zuò hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Not yet. I won't finish until tomorrow.

entries.example: 我每天騎機車上班。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi tiān qí jī chē shàng bān.
entries.exampleEnglish: I ride my scooter to work every day.
entries.question: 你會騎機車嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì qí jī chē ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you ride a scooter?
entries.answer: 會，但我比較常騎腳踏車。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, dàn wǒ bǐ jiào cháng qí jiǎo tà chē.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but I ride a bike more often.

entries.example: 老闆，我要一份炒飯。
entries.examplePinyin: lǎo bǎn, wǒ yào yí fèn chǎo fàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Excuse me, I'd like one order of fried rice.
entries.question: 你在夜市一次會買幾份小吃？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài yè shì yí cì huì mǎi jǐ fèn xiǎo chī?
entries.questionEnglish: How many portions of snacks do you buy at a night market?
entries.answer: 我通常會買三份小吃。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ tōng cháng huì mǎi sān fèn xiǎo chī.
entries.answerEnglish: I usually buy three portions of snacks.

entries.example: 這裡不能停車。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè lǐ bù néng tíng chē.
entries.exampleEnglish: You can't park here.
entries.question: 你家附近好停車嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn hǎo tíng chē ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is it easy to park near your home?
entries.answer: 不好停，我家附近停車很難。
entries.answerPinyin: bù hǎo tíng, wǒ jiā fù jìn tíng chē hěn nán.
entries.answerEnglish: No, parking near my home is hard.

entries.example: 廚房裡有一隻老鼠！
entries.examplePinyin: chú fáng lǐ yǒu yì zhī lǎo shǔ!
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a rat in the kitchen!
entries.question: 你怕老鼠嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pà lǎo shǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you afraid of rats?
entries.answer: 很怕，我看到老鼠就會叫。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn pà, wǒ kàn dào lǎo shǔ jiù huì jiào.
entries.answerEnglish: Very. I scream whenever I see a rat.

entries.example: 我早餐吃了一個三明治。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zǎo cān chī le yí gè sān míng zhì.
entries.exampleEnglish: I had a sandwich for breakfast.
entries.question: 你早餐喜歡吃三明治嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zǎo cān xǐ huan chī sān míng zhì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like eating sandwiches for breakfast?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常在早餐店買三明治。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ cháng zài zǎo cān diàn mǎi sān míng zhì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often buy sandwiches at a breakfast shop.

entries.example: 公園的池塘裡有很多鴨子。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng yuán de chí táng lǐ yǒu hěn duō yā zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of ducks in the park pond.
entries.question: 你家附近有鴨子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn yǒu yā zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there ducks near your home?
entries.answer: 有，河邊常常有鴨子。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, hé biān cháng cháng yǒu yā zi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are often ducks by the river.

entries.example: 我女兒養了一隻兔子。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ nǚ ér yǎng le yì zhī tù zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: My daughter has a pet rabbit.
entries.question: 你養過兔子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǎng guò tù zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever kept a rabbit?
entries.answer: 養過，我小時候養過兩隻兔子。
entries.answerPinyin: yǎng guò, wǒ xiǎo shí hòu yǎng guò liǎng zhī tù zi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I had two rabbits when I was little.

entries.example: 我在捷運站門口等你。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài jié yùn zhàn mén kǒu děng nǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'll wait for you at the MRT station entrance.
entries.question: 你家門口有什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā mén kǒu yǒu shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What is there outside your front door?
entries.answer: 我家門口有一家便利商店。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā mén kǒu yǒu yì jiā biàn lì shāng diàn.
entries.answerEnglish: There's a convenience store right outside my door.

entries.example: 動物園的獅子在睡覺。
entries.examplePinyin: dòng wù yuán de shī zi zài shuì jiào.
entries.exampleEnglish: The lions at the zoo are sleeping.
entries.question: 你看過真的獅子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò zhēn de shī zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a real lion?
entries.answer: 看過，在台北動物園看過獅子。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, zài tái běi dòng wù yuán kàn guò shī zi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw lions at the Taipei Zoo.

entries.example: 我肚子好餓，去吃飯吧！
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ dù zi hǎo è, qù chī fàn ba!
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm starving. Let's go eat!
entries.question: 你現在肚子餓嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiàn zài dù zi è ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you hungry now?
entries.answer: 我肚子有一點餓。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dù zi yǒu yì diǎn è.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm a little hungry.

entries.example: 他在沙發上睡著了。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài shā fā shàng shuì zháo le.
entries.exampleEnglish: He fell asleep on the couch.
entries.question: 週末你喜歡在沙發上做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: zhōu mò nǐ xǐ huan zài shā fā shàng zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you like to do on the couch on weekends?
entries.answer: 我喜歡在沙發上看電影。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan zài shā fā shàng kàn diàn yǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: I like watching movies on the couch.

entries.example: 我們八點出發。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men bā diǎn chū fā.
entries.exampleEnglish: We'll set off at eight.
entries.question: 你明天幾點出發去上班？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ míng tiān jǐ diǎn chū fā qù shàng bān?
entries.questionEnglish: What time are you leaving for work tomorrow?
entries.answer: 我明天七點半出發。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ míng tiān qī diǎn bàn chū fā.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm leaving at seven thirty tomorrow.

entries.example: 我買了一本新的筆記本。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ mǎi le yì běn xīn de bǐ jì běn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a new notebook.
entries.question: 上中文課，你用筆記本還是電腦？
entries.questionPinyin: shàng zhōng wén kè, nǐ yòng bǐ jì běn hái shì diàn nǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: In Chinese class, do you use a notebook or a computer?
entries.answer: 我用筆記本寫生詞。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yòng bǐ jì běn xiě shēng cí.
entries.answerEnglish: I write new words in a notebook.

entries.example: 清境農場有很多小羊。
entries.examplePinyin: qīng jìng nóng chǎng yǒu hěn duō xiǎo yáng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Cingjing Farm has lots of lambs.
entries.question: 你餵過小羊嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ wèi guò xiǎo yáng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever fed a lamb?
entries.answer: 餵過，我在農場餵過小羊。
entries.answerPinyin: wèi guò, wǒ zài nóng chǎng wèi guò xiǎo yáng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I fed lambs on a farm.

entries.example: 壽山上有很多猴子。
entries.examplePinyin: shòu shān shàng yǒu hěn duō hóu zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of monkeys on Shoushan.
entries.question: 你在台灣看過猴子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān kàn guò hóu zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen monkeys in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 看過，我在高雄看過猴子。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài gāo xióng kàn guò hóu zi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw monkeys in Kaohsiung.

entries.example: 我小時候很愛看卡通。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xiǎo shí hòu hěn ài kàn kǎ tōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I loved watching cartoons as a kid.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪部卡通？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ bù kǎ tōng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which cartoon do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡哆啦A夢的卡通。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan duō lā A mèng de kǎ tōng.
entries.answerEnglish: I like the Doraemon cartoon best.

entries.example: 這家店很賺錢。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn hěn zhuàn qián.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop makes a lot of money.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼工作最賺錢？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me gōng zuò zuì zhuàn qián?
entries.questionEnglish: What job do you think makes the most money?
entries.answer: 我覺得當醫生最賺錢。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de dāng yī shēng zuì zhuàn qián.
entries.answerEnglish: I think being a doctor makes the most money.

entries.example: 這顆蘋果裡有蟲！
entries.examplePinyin: zhè kē píng guǒ lǐ yǒu chóng!
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a worm in this apple!
entries.question: 你怕蟲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pà chóng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you afraid of bugs?
entries.answer: 我很怕蟲，看到就跑。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ hěn pà chóng, kàn dào jiù pǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm really scared of bugs; I run when I see one.

entries.example: 我的錢包不見了！
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de qián bāo bú jiàn le!
entries.exampleEnglish: My wallet is gone!
entries.question: 你的錢包裡有多少錢？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de qián bāo lǐ yǒu duō shǎo qián?
entries.questionEnglish: How much money is in your wallet?
entries.answer: 我的錢包裡只有五百塊。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de qián bāo lǐ zhǐ yǒu wǔ bǎi kuài.
entries.answerEnglish: There's only five hundred dollars in my wallet.

entries.example: 剩下的菜可以帶回家。
entries.examplePinyin: shèng xià de cài kě yǐ dài huí jiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: You can take the leftover food home.
entries.question: 吃不完的時候，你會怎麼做？
entries.questionPinyin: chī bù wán de shí hòu, nǐ huì zěn me zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when you can't finish your food?
entries.answer: 我會把剩下的帶回家吃。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì bǎ shèng xià de dài huí jiā chī.
entries.answerEnglish: I take the rest home to eat.

entries.example: 我今天在市場買了豬肉。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ jīn tiān zài shì chǎng mǎi le zhū ròu.
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought some pork at the market today.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃豬肉嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī zhū ròu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like eating pork?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我最喜歡吃豬肉水餃。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ zuì xǐ huan chī zhū ròu shuǐ jiǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my favorite is pork dumplings.

entries.example: 他對人很有禮貌。
entries.examplePinyin: tā duì rén hěn yǒu lǐ mào.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's very polite to people.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣人有禮貌嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān rén yǒu lǐ mào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwanese people are polite?
entries.answer: 很有禮貌，常常跟我說謝謝。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn yǒu lǐ mào, cháng cháng gēn wǒ shuō xiè xiè.
entries.answerEnglish: Very polite. They often say thank you to me.

entries.example: 這串葡萄好甜。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè chuàn pú táo hǎo tián.
entries.exampleEnglish: This bunch of grapes is so sweet.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃葡萄嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī pú táo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like grapes?
entries.answer: 喜歡，夏天我常買葡萄吃。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, xià tiān wǒ cháng mǎi pú táo chī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. In summer I often buy grapes.

entries.example: 你聞聞看，這個好香！
entries.examplePinyin: nǐ wén wén kàn, zhè ge hǎo xiāng!
entries.exampleEnglish: Smell this. It smells so good!
entries.question: 你喜歡聞什麼味道？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan wén shén me wèi dào?
entries.questionEnglish: What smells do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡聞咖啡的味道。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan wén kā fēi de wèi dào.
entries.answerEnglish: I like the smell of coffee.

entries.example: 改天一起吃飯吧！
entries.examplePinyin: gǎi tiān yì qǐ chī fàn ba!
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's have a meal together sometime!
entries.question: 朋友約你，你沒空時怎麼說？
entries.questionPinyin: péng yǒu yuē nǐ, nǐ méi kòng shí zěn me shuō?
entries.questionEnglish: When a friend invites you out and you're busy, what do you say?
entries.answer: 我會說：「改天再約吧！」
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì shuō: “gǎi tiān zài yuē ba!”
entries.answerEnglish: I say, "Let's do it another day!"

entries.example: 我們下午三點吃點心。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men xià wǔ sān diǎn chī diǎn xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: We have a snack at three in the afternoon.
entries.question: 你下午喜歡吃什麼點心？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xià wǔ xǐ huan chī shén me diǎn xīn?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you like to have as an afternoon snack?
entries.answer: 我喜歡吃蛋糕當點心。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan chī dàn gāo dàng diǎn xīn.
entries.answerEnglish: I like to have cake as a snack.

entries.example: 我常在咖啡館工作。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ cháng zài kā fēi guǎn gōng zuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: I often work in cafes.
entries.question: 你常去咖啡館嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng qù kā fēi guǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often go to cafes?
entries.answer: 常去，我週末都去咖啡館看書。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng qù, wǒ zhōu mò dōu qù kā fēi guǎn kàn shū.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I go to a cafe to read every weekend.

entries.example: 這顆桃子好甜！
entries.examplePinyin: zhè kē táo zi hǎo tián!
entries.exampleEnglish: This peach is so sweet!
entries.question: 你喜歡吃桃子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī táo zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like peaches?
entries.answer: 喜歡，夏天的桃子最好吃。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, xià tiān de táo zi zuì hǎo chī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, summer peaches are the best.

entries.example: 夜市的烤香腸很好吃。
entries.examplePinyin: yè shì de kǎo xiāng cháng hěn hǎo chī.
entries.exampleEnglish: The grilled sausages at the night market are delicious.
entries.question: 你吃過台灣香腸嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chī guò tái wān xiāng cháng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had Taiwanese sausage?
entries.answer: 吃過，我很喜歡夜市的香腸。
entries.answerPinyin: chī guò, wǒ hěn xǐ huan yè shì de xiāng cháng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I really like the sausages at night markets.

entries.example: 週末我們去動物園看熊貓。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōu mò wǒ men qù dòng wù yuán kàn xióng māo.
entries.exampleEnglish: We're going to the zoo to see the pandas this weekend.
entries.question: 你去過台北的動物園嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò tái běi de dòng wù yuán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to the zoo in Taipei?
entries.answer: 去過，我很喜歡台北動物園。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, wǒ hěn xǐ huan tái běi dòng wù yuán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I really like the Taipei Zoo.

entries.example: 冬天的草莓很甜。
entries.examplePinyin: dōng tiān de cǎo méi hěn tián.
entries.exampleEnglish: Strawberries in winter are very sweet.
entries.question: 你去採過草莓嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù cǎi guò cǎo méi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever gone strawberry picking?
entries.answer: 去過，我在大湖採過草莓。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, wǒ zài dà hú cǎi guò cǎo méi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've picked strawberries in Dahu.

entries.example: 這個包包是假的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge bāo bāo shì jiǎ de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This bag is fake.
entries.question: 你買過假的東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi guò jiǎ de dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever bought something fake?
entries.answer: 買過，我在夜市買到假的手錶。
entries.answerPinyin: mǎi guò, wǒ zài yè shì mǎi dào jiǎ de shǒu biǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I bought a fake watch at a night market.

entries.example: 一開始我聽不懂台語。
entries.examplePinyin: yì kāi shǐ wǒ tīng bù dǒng tái yǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: At first I couldn't understand Taiwanese.
entries.question: 你一開始來台灣習慣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yì kāi shǐ lái tái wān xí guàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Were you used to Taiwan when you first came?
entries.answer: 一開始不太習慣，現在好多了。
entries.answerPinyin: yì kāi shǐ bú tài xí guàn, xiàn zài hǎo duō le.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really at first, but it's much better now.

entries.example: 超商的布丁很好吃。
entries.examplePinyin: chāo shāng de bù dīng hěn hǎo chī.
entries.exampleEnglish: The pudding at the convenience store is very good.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃布丁嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī bù dīng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like pudding?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我最喜歡雞蛋布丁。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ zuì xǐ huan jī dàn bù dīng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like egg pudding best.

entries.example: 這家店的牛肉麵很有名。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn de niú ròu miàn hěn yǒu míng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop's beef noodles are famous.
entries.question: 你的家鄉有什麼有名的菜？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de jiā xiāng yǒu shén me yǒu míng de cài?
entries.questionEnglish: What dishes is your hometown famous for?
entries.answer: 我家鄉的魚很有名。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā xiāng de yú hěn yǒu míng.
entries.answerEnglish: My hometown is famous for its fish.

entries.example: 颱風過後，高麗菜很貴。
entries.examplePinyin: tái fēng guò hòu, gāo lí cài hěn guì.
entries.exampleEnglish: After a typhoon, cabbage gets expensive.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃高麗菜嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī gāo lí cài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like cabbage?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常炒高麗菜。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ cháng chǎo gāo lí cài.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often stir-fry cabbage.

entries.example: 我要去日本玩兩個禮拜。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ yào qù rì běn wán liǎng gè lǐ bài.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm going to Japan for two weeks.
entries.question: 你放假最長放過多久？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ fàng jià zuì cháng fàng guò duō jiǔ?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the longest holiday you've had?
entries.answer: 我最長放過兩個禮拜。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì cháng fàng guò liǎng gè lǐ bài.
entries.answerEnglish: The longest was two weeks.

entries.example: 台灣人很習慣排隊。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān rén hěn xí guàn pái duì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwanese people are used to lining up.
entries.question: 你願意排隊買好吃的東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yuàn yì pái duì mǎi hǎo chī de dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you willing to queue for good food?
entries.answer: 願意，我常排隊買雞排。
entries.answerPinyin: yuàn yì, wǒ cháng pái duì mǎi jī pái.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often queue for fried chicken.

entries.example: 我要一杯珍珠奶茶。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ yào yì bēi zhēn zhū nǎi chá.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'd like a bubble milk tea.
entries.question: 你喝奶茶喜歡加珍珠嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ hē nǎi chá xǐ huan jiā zhēn zhū ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like tapioca pearls in your milk tea?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我都會加很多珍珠。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ dōu huì jiā hěn duō zhēn zhū.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always add lots of pearls.

entries.example: 是嗎？我不知道他結婚了。
entries.examplePinyin: shì ma? wǒ bù zhī dào tā jié hūn le.
entries.exampleEnglish: Really? I didn't know he got married.
entries.question: 朋友說了奇怪的事，你會說什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: péng yǒu shuō le qí guài de shì, nǐ huì shuō shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: When a friend says something surprising, what do you say?
entries.answer: 我會說：「是嗎？真的假的？」
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì shuō: “shì ma? zhēn de jiǎ de?”
entries.answerEnglish: I'd say, "Really? Are you serious?"

entries.example: 我們今晚叫披薩來吃吧！
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men jīn wǎn jiào pī sà lái chī ba!
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's order pizza tonight!
entries.question: 你喜歡吃什麼口味的披薩？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī shén me kǒu wèi de pī sà?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of pizza do you like?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡吃海鮮披薩。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan chī hǎi xiān pī sà.
entries.answerEnglish: I like seafood pizza best.

entries.example: 蛤？你說什麼？我沒聽到。
entries.examplePinyin: há? nǐ shuō shén me? wǒ méi tīng dào.
entries.exampleEnglish: Huh? What did you say? I didn't hear.
entries.question: 沒聽清楚別人說話時，你會說什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: méi tīng qīng chǔ bié rén shuō huà shí, nǐ huì shuō shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you say when you didn't catch what someone said?
entries.answer: 我會說：「蛤？可以再說一次嗎？」
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì shuō: “há? kě yǐ zài shuō yí cì ma?”
entries.answerEnglish: I'd say, "Huh? Can you say that again?"

entries.example: 這張照片有點不清楚。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhāng zhào piàn yǒu diǎn bù qīng chǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: This photo is a little unclear.
entries.question: 工作上有不清楚的事，你會問誰？
entries.questionPinyin: gōng zuò shàng yǒu bù qīng chǔ de shì, nǐ huì wèn shéi?
entries.questionEnglish: When something at work is unclear, who do you ask?
entries.answer: 我有不清楚的事會問同事。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yǒu bù qīng chǔ de shì huì wèn tóng shì.
entries.answerEnglish: When something's unclear, I ask my coworkers.

entries.example: 我午餐吃了一盤義大利麵。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ wǔ cān chī le yì pán yì dà lì miàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I had a plate of pasta for lunch.
entries.question: 你會自己煮義大利麵嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zì jǐ zhǔ yì dà lì miàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you cook pasta yourself?
entries.answer: 會，我常常在家煮義大利麵。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng cháng zài jiā zhǔ yì dà lì miàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often cook pasta at home.

entries.example: 我住在一間小小的套房。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zhù zài yì jiān xiǎo xiǎo de tào fáng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I live in a tiny studio apartment.
entries.question: 你的房間大不大？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de fáng jiān dà bu dà?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your room big?
entries.answer: 不大，我的房間小小的，但很舒服。
entries.answerPinyin: bú dà, wǒ de fáng jiān xiǎo xiǎo de, dàn hěn shū fú.
entries.answerEnglish: Not big. My room is tiny, but it's comfortable.

entries.example: 午餐時間，便利商店人很多。
entries.examplePinyin: wǔ cān shí jiān, biàn lì shāng diàn rén hěn duō.
entries.exampleEnglish: At lunchtime, convenience stores are crowded.
entries.question: 你的午餐時間有多久？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de wǔ cān shí jiān yǒu duō jiǔ?
entries.questionEnglish: How long is your lunch break?
entries.answer: 我的午餐時間有一個小時。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de wǔ cān shí jiān yǒu yí gè xiǎo shí.
entries.answerEnglish: My lunch break is an hour.

entries.english: throw away; chuck; get rid of
entries.example: 這些舊衣服可以丟掉了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè xiē jiù yī fu kě yǐ diū diào le.
entries.exampleEnglish: These old clothes can be thrown out.
entries.question: 你常常把舊東西丟掉嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng cháng bǎ jiù dōng xī diū diào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often throw out old things?
entries.answer: 會，我常把舊衣服丟掉。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng bǎ jiù yī fu diū diào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often throw out old clothes.

entries.example: 樹上有一隻小鳥在唱歌。
entries.examplePinyin: shù shàng yǒu yì zhī xiǎo niǎo zài chàng gē.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a little bird singing in the tree.
entries.question: 你家附近有很多小鳥嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn yǒu hěn duō xiǎo niǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there lots of birds near your home?
entries.answer: 有，每天早上都有小鳥在叫。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, měi tiān zǎo shàng dōu yǒu xiǎo niǎo zài jiào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, birds chirp every morning.

entries.example: 我明天最早九點到公司。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ míng tiān zuì zǎo jiǔ diǎn dào gōng sī.
entries.exampleEnglish: Tomorrow I'll get to the office at nine at the earliest.
entries.question: 你每天最早幾點起床？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ měi tiān zuì zǎo jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the earliest you get up each day?
entries.answer: 我最早六點起床。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì zǎo liù diǎn qǐ chuáng.
entries.answerEnglish: The earliest I get up is six.

entries.example: 你直接坐捷運去比較快。
entries.examplePinyin: nǐ zhí jiē zuò jié yùn qù bǐ jiào kuài.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's quicker if you just take the MRT straight there.
entries.question: 下班以後，你會直接回家嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: xià bān yǐ hòu, nǐ huì zhí jiē huí jiā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you go straight home after work?
entries.answer: 會，我通常直接回家。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ tōng cháng zhí jiē huí jiā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I usually go straight home.

entries.example: 小孩子都喜歡吃糖果。
entries.examplePinyin: xiǎo hái zi dōu xǐ huan chī táng guǒ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Kids all love candy.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃什麼糖果？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī shén me táng guǒ?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of candy do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡吃水果口味的糖果。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan chī shuǐ guǒ kǒu wèi de táng guǒ.
entries.answerEnglish: I like fruit-flavored candy.

entries.example: 我今天的中文作業很多。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ jīn tiān de zhōng wén zuò yè hěn duō.
entries.exampleEnglish: I have a lot of Chinese homework today.
entries.question: 你的中文老師常給作業嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de zhōng wén lǎo shī cháng gěi zuò yè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your Chinese teacher often give homework?
entries.answer: 常給，每天都有作業。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng gěi, měi tiān dōu yǒu zuò yè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's homework every day.

entries.example: 我們坐電梯上去吧。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zuò diàn tī shàng qù ba.
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's take the elevator up.
entries.question: 你住的地方有電梯嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhù de dì fāng yǒu diàn tī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there an elevator where you live?
entries.answer: 有，我們大樓有兩台電梯。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men dà lóu yǒu liǎng tái diàn tī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our building has two elevators.

entries.example: 請你大聲再說一次。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng nǐ dà shēng zài shuō yí cì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please say it again, louder.
entries.question: 你在家會大聲唱歌嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài jiā huì dà shēng chàng gē ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you sing loudly at home?
entries.answer: 會，我洗澡的時候會大聲唱歌。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ xǐ zǎo de shí hòu huì dà shēng chàng gē.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I sing loudly in the shower.

entries.example: 我的行李太重了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de xíng li tài zhòng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: My luggage is too heavy.
entries.question: 你出國的時候帶幾件行李？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chū guó de shí hòu dài jǐ jiàn xíng li?
entries.questionEnglish: How many bags do you take when you go abroad?
entries.answer: 我通常只帶一件行李。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ tōng cháng zhǐ dài yí jiàn xíng li.
entries.answerEnglish: I usually take just one bag.

entries.example: 我每天騎機車上班。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi tiān qí jī chē shàng bān.
entries.exampleEnglish: I ride my scooter to work every day.
entries.question: 你會騎機車嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì qí jī chē ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you ride a scooter?
entries.answer: 會，可是我在台北不騎機車。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, kě shì wǒ zài tái běi bù qí jī chē.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but I don't ride one in Taipei.

entries.example: 我好口渴，想喝水。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hǎo kǒu kě, xiǎng hē shuǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm so thirsty; I want some water.
entries.question: 你口渴的時候喜歡喝什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kǒu kě de shí hòu xǐ huan hē shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you like to drink when you're thirsty?
entries.answer: 我口渴的時候喜歡喝冰紅茶。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ kǒu kě de shí hòu xǐ huan hē bīng hóng chá.
entries.answerEnglish: When I'm thirsty, I like iced black tea.

entries.example: 這件事不重要，別擔心。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn shì bú zhòng yào, bié dān xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This doesn't matter; don't worry.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼東西不重要？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me dōng xī bú zhòng yào?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think doesn't matter?
entries.answer: 我覺得名牌不重要。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de míng pái bú zhòng yào.
entries.answerEnglish: I don't think brand names matter.

entries.example: 這碗湯太鹹了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè wǎn tāng tài xián le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This soup is too salty.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃鹹的還是甜的？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī xián de hái shì tián de?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer salty or sweet food?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡吃鹹的。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan chī xián de.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer salty food.

entries.example: 這個西瓜有五公斤。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge xī guā yǒu wǔ gōng jīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This watermelon weighs five kilos.
entries.question: 你的行李箱有幾公斤？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de xíng li xiāng yǒu jǐ gōng jīn?
entries.questionEnglish: How many kilos is your suitcase?
entries.answer: 我的行李箱有二十公斤。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de xíng li xiāng yǒu èr shí gōng jīn.
entries.answerEnglish: My suitcase is 20 kilos.

entries.example: 台北一零一是台灣最高的大樓。
entries.examplePinyin: tái běi yī líng yī shì tái wān zuì gāo de dà lóu.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taipei 101 is the tallest building in Taiwan.
entries.question: 你爬過最高的山是哪一座？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pá guò zuì gāo de shān shì nǎ yí zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the highest mountain you've climbed?
entries.answer: 我爬過最高的山是玉山。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ pá guò zuì gāo de shān shì yù shān.
entries.answerEnglish: The highest mountain I've climbed is Yushan.

entries.example: 哈！我找到鑰匙了！
entries.examplePinyin: hā! wǒ zhǎo dào yào shi le!
entries.exampleEnglish: Ha! I found my keys!
entries.question: 你常常說「哈哈」嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng cháng shuō “hā hā” ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often say 'haha'?
entries.answer: 常常，覺得好笑的時候我就說哈哈。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, jué de hǎo xiào de shí hòu wǒ jiù shuō hā hā.
entries.answerEnglish: Often. When something's funny, I say 'haha'.

entries.example: 我弟弟是大學生。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ dì di shì dà xué shēng.
entries.exampleEnglish: My younger brother is a college student.
entries.question: 你當大學生的時候住在哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dāng dà xué shēng de shí hòu zhù zài nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where did you live when you were in college?
entries.answer: 我當大學生的時候住在宿舍。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dāng dà xué shēng de shí hòu zhù zài sù shè.
entries.answerEnglish: I lived in a dorm when I was in college.

entries.example: 動物園裡有兩隻老虎。
entries.examplePinyin: dòng wù yuán lǐ yǒu liǎng zhī lǎo hǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are two tigers at the zoo.
entries.question: 你在動物園看過老虎嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài dòng wù yuán kàn guò lǎo hǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen tigers at the zoo?
entries.answer: 看過，那隻老虎好大。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, nà zhī lǎo hǔ hǎo dà.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, that tiger was huge.

entries.example: 你有兄弟姊妹嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: nǐ yǒu xiōng dì jiě mèi ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
entries.question: 你有幾個兄弟姊妹？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu jǐ gè xiōng dì jiě mèi?
entries.questionEnglish: How many brothers and sisters do you have?
entries.answer: 我有兩個兄弟姊妹。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yǒu liǎng gè xiōng dì jiě mèi.
entries.answerEnglish: I have two siblings.

entries.example: 夜市的烤蝦子很好吃。
entries.examplePinyin: yè shì de kǎo xiā zi hěn hǎo chī.
entries.exampleEnglish: The grilled shrimp at the night market is delicious.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃蝦子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī xiā zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like eating shrimp?
entries.answer: 喜歡，可是我不會剝蝦子。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, kě shì wǒ bú huì bāo xiā zi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but I can't peel shrimp.

entries.example: 我住在他家隔壁。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zhù zài tā jiā gé bì.
entries.exampleEnglish: I live next door to him.
entries.question: 你家隔壁住的是誰？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā gé bì zhù de shì shéi?
entries.questionEnglish: Who lives next door to you?
entries.answer: 我家隔壁住一對老夫妻。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā gé bì zhù yí duì lǎo fū qī.
entries.answerEnglish: An elderly couple lives next door to me.

entries.example: 我想喝一罐汽水。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xiǎng hē yí guàn qì shuǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'd like a can of soda.
entries.question: 你喜歡喝汽水嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan hē qì shuǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like soft drinks?
entries.answer: 不太喜歡，汽水太甜了。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài xǐ huan, qì shuǐ tài tián le.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really; soda is too sweet.

entries.example: 他晚上喝了兩杯酒。
entries.examplePinyin: tā wǎn shàng hē le liǎng bēi jiǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: He had two drinks this evening.
entries.question: 你喜歡喝酒嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan hē jiǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like to drink?
entries.answer: 還好，我只喝一點酒。
entries.answerPinyin: hái hǎo, wǒ zhǐ hē yì diǎn jiǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really; I only drink a little.

entries.example: 秋天的樹葉變黃了。
entries.examplePinyin: qiū tiān de shù yè biàn huáng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The leaves have turned yellow in autumn.
entries.question: 你喜歡看紅色的樹葉嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kàn hóng sè de shù yè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like looking at red leaves?
entries.answer: 喜歡，紅色的樹葉很漂亮。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, hóng sè de shù yè hěn piào liang.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, red leaves are beautiful.

entries.example: 晚上房間裡有好多蚊子。
entries.examplePinyin: wǎn shàng fáng jiān lǐ yǒu hǎo duō wén zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of mosquitoes in the room at night.
entries.question: 你常被蚊子咬嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng bèi wén zi yǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often get bitten by mosquitoes?
entries.answer: 常常，夏天蚊子很多。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, xià tiān wén zi hěn duō.
entries.answerEnglish: All the time; there are lots of mosquitoes in summer.

entries.example: 我每天搭捷運上班。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi tiān dā jié yùn shàng bān.
entries.exampleEnglish: I take the MRT to work every day.
entries.question: 你常搭捷運嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng dā jié yùn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often take the MRT?
entries.answer: 常搭，捷運又快又方便。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng dā, jié yùn yòu kuài yòu fāng biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the MRT is fast and convenient.

entries.example: 我在名單上排第十六。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài míng dān shàng pái dì shí liù.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm sixteenth on the list.
entries.question: 這是你在台灣的第幾個月？
entries.questionPinyin: zhè shì nǐ zài tái wān de dì jǐ gè yuè?
entries.questionEnglish: Which month in Taiwan is this for you?
entries.answer: 這是我在台灣的第十六個月。
entries.answerPinyin: zhè shì wǒ zài tái wān de dì shí liù gè yuè.
entries.answerEnglish: This is my sixteenth month in Taiwan.

entries.example: 昨天太晚睡，今天好睏。
entries.examplePinyin: zuó tiān tài wǎn shuì, jīn tiān hǎo kùn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I went to bed too late last night, so I'm really sleepy today.
entries.question: 你下午常常覺得睏嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xià wǔ cháng cháng jué de kùn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often feel sleepy in the afternoon?
entries.answer: 會，吃完午飯我就很睏。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, chī wán wǔ fàn wǒ jiù hěn kùn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, after lunch I get really sleepy.

entries.example: 我們十點有十分鐘的休息時間。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men shí diǎn yǒu shí fēn zhōng de xiū xí shí jiān.
entries.exampleEnglish: We have a ten-minute break at ten.
entries.question: 你上班的休息時間多長？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shàng bān de xiū xí shí jiān duō cháng?
entries.questionEnglish: How long is your break at work?
entries.answer: 我中午有一個小時的休息時間。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhōng wǔ yǒu yí gè xiǎo shí de xiū xí shí jiān.
entries.answerEnglish: I have an hour's break at noon.

entries.example: 我每天早上去河邊慢跑。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng qù hé biān màn pǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: I go jogging by the river every morning.
entries.question: 你常常慢跑嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng cháng màn pǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often go jogging?
entries.answer: 常常，我週末都去公園慢跑。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ zhōu mò dōu qù gōng yuán màn pǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Often; I jog in the park every weekend.

entries.example: 我的家鄉在加拿大。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de jiā xiāng zài jiā ná dà.
entries.exampleEnglish: My hometown is in Canada.
entries.question: 你的家鄉有什麼好吃的？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de jiā xiāng yǒu shén me hǎo chī de?
entries.questionEnglish: What good food is there in your hometown?
entries.answer: 我的家鄉有很好吃的起司。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de jiā xiāng yǒu hěn hǎo chī de qǐ sī.
entries.answerEnglish: My hometown has delicious cheese.

entries.example: 陽明山有很多特別的植物。
entries.examplePinyin: yáng míng shān yǒu hěn duō tè bié de zhí wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: Yangmingshan has lots of special plants.
entries.question: 你家裡有種植物嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā lǐ yǒu zhòng zhí wù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you grow plants at home?
entries.answer: 有，我在陽台種了很多植物。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ zài yáng tái zhòng le hěn duō zhí wù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I grow lots of plants on my balcony.

entries.example: 我午餐吃了一個漢堡。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ wǔ cān chī le yí gè hàn bǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: I had a burger for lunch.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃漢堡嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī hàn bǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like burgers?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常吃雞肉漢堡。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ cháng chī jī ròu hàn bǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often eat chicken burgers.

entries.example: 最近搭捷運的人增加了。
entries.examplePinyin: zuì jìn dā jié yùn de rén zēng jiā le.
entries.exampleEnglish: More people have been taking the MRT recently.
entries.question: 你最近的工作增加了嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn de gōng zuò zēng jiā le ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has your workload increased recently?
entries.answer: 增加了，我最近常常加班。
entries.answerPinyin: zēng jiā le, wǒ zuì jìn cháng cháng jiā bān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, it has; I've been working overtime a lot lately.

entries.example: 在家我都穿拖鞋。
entries.examplePinyin: zài jiā wǒ dōu chuān tuō xié.
entries.exampleEnglish: I always wear slippers at home.
entries.question: 你出門會穿拖鞋嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chū mén huì chuān tuō xié ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you wear flip-flops when you go out?
entries.answer: 會，去便利商店我都穿拖鞋。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, qù biàn lì shāng diàn wǒ dōu chuān tuō xié.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I wear flip-flops when I go to the convenience store.

entries.example: 我還在適應台灣的天氣。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hái zài shì yìng tái wān de tiān qì.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm still getting used to the weather in Taiwan.
entries.question: 你適應台灣的生活了嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shì yìng tái wān de shēng huó le ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you got used to life in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我已經適應了，很喜歡這裡。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yǐ jīng shì yìng le, hěn xǐ huan zhè lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I've got used to it. I really like it here.

entries.english: for; on behalf of; instead of
entries.example: 我替你買了一杯咖啡。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ tì nǐ mǎi le yì bēi kā fēi.
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a coffee for you.
entries.question: 你常替同事買東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng tì tóng shì mǎi dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often buy things for your coworkers?
entries.answer: 我常替同事買午餐。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cháng tì tóng shì mǎi wǔ cān.
entries.answerEnglish: I often buy lunch for my coworkers.

entries.example: 這是一本關於台灣的書。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shì yì běn guān yú tái wān de shū.
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a book about Taiwan.
entries.question: 你喜歡看關於什麼的電影？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kàn guān yú shén me de diàn yǐng?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you like movies to be about?
entries.answer: 我喜歡看關於歷史的電影。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan kàn guān yú lì shǐ de diàn yǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: I like movies about history.

entries.example: 進入捷運站不能吃東西。
entries.examplePinyin: jìn rù jié yùn zhàn bù néng chī dōng xī.
entries.exampleEnglish: You can't eat once you enter the MRT station.
entries.question: 你什麼時候進入現在的公司？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shén me shí hòu jìn rù xiàn zài de gōng sī?
entries.questionEnglish: When did you join your current company?
entries.answer: 我去年進入這家公司。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qù nián jìn rù zhè jiā gōng sī.
entries.answerEnglish: I joined this company last year.

entries.example: 過年的時候，人們都回家。
entries.examplePinyin: guò nián de shí hòu, rén men dōu huí jiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: At Chinese New Year, people all go home.
entries.question: 在你的國家，人們過年做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: zài nǐ de guó jiā, rén men guò nián zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: In your country, what do people do at New Year?
entries.answer: 在我的國家，人們會去看煙火。
entries.answerPinyin: zài wǒ de guó jiā, rén men huì qù kàn yān huǒ.
entries.answerEnglish: In my country, people go and watch fireworks.

entries.example: 這條公車路線很方便。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tiáo gōng chē lù xiàn hěn fāng biàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This bus route is very convenient.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪一條捷運路線？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ yì tiáo jié yùn lù xiàn?
entries.questionEnglish: Which MRT line do you like best?
entries.answer: 我喜歡板南線，那條路線很方便。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan bǎn nán xiàn, nà tiáo lù xiàn hěn fāng biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I like the Bannan Line. That route is very convenient.

entries.example: 有任何問題，可以問我。
entries.examplePinyin: yǒu rèn hé wèn tí, kě yǐ wèn wǒ.
entries.exampleEnglish: If you have any questions, you can ask me.
entries.question: 你有任何不吃的東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu rèn hé bù chī de dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there anything you don't eat?
entries.answer: 我沒有任何不吃的東西。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ méi yǒu rèn hé bù chī de dōng xī.
entries.answerEnglish: There's nothing I don't eat.

entries.example: 夜市有許多好吃的東西。
entries.examplePinyin: yè shì yǒu xǔ duō hǎo chī de dōng xī.
entries.exampleEnglish: The night market has lots of tasty food.
entries.question: 你在台灣有許多朋友嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān yǒu xǔ duō péng yǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have many friends in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 有，我在台灣認識了許多朋友。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ zài tái wān rèn shì le xǔ duō péng yǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've made many friends in Taiwan.

entries.example: 我坐太久了，背很痛。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zuò tài jiǔ le, bèi hěn tòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I've been sitting too long and my back hurts.
entries.question: 你工作一整天，背會痛嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gōng zuò yì zhěng tiān, bèi huì tòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your back hurt after a whole day at work?
entries.answer: 會，我的背常常很痛。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ de bèi cháng cháng hěn tòng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my back often hurts.

entries.example: 穿過這條馬路就到了。
entries.examplePinyin: chuān guò zhè tiáo mǎ lù jiù dào le.
entries.exampleEnglish: Cross this road and you're there.
entries.question: 你上班要穿過公園嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shàng bān yào chuān guò gōng yuán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you go through a park on your way to work?
entries.answer: 要，我每天穿過一個公園。
entries.answerPinyin: yào, wǒ měi tiān chuān guò yí gè gōng yuán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I go through a park every day.

entries.example: 我家在捷運站和公園之間。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ jiā zài jié yùn zhàn hé gōng yuán zhī jiān.
entries.exampleEnglish: My home is between the MRT station and the park.
entries.question: 你家和公司之間遠不遠？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā hé gōng sī zhī jiān yuǎn bu yuǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: Is it far between your home and your office?
entries.answer: 我家和公司之間很近。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā hé gōng sī zhī jiān hěn jìn.
entries.answerEnglish: My home and office are close to each other.

entries.example: 我從來不喝酒。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ cóng lái bù hē jiǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: I never drink alcohol.
entries.question: 有什麼台灣菜你從來沒吃過？
entries.questionPinyin: yǒu shén me tái wān cài nǐ cóng lái méi chī guò?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a Taiwanese dish you've never eaten?
entries.answer: 我從來沒吃過臭豆腐。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cóng lái méi chī guò chòu dòu fu.
entries.answerEnglish: I've never eaten stinky tofu.

entries.example: 大多數的人坐捷運上班。
entries.examplePinyin: dà duō shù de rén zuò jié yùn shàng bān.
entries.exampleEnglish: Most people take the MRT to work.
entries.question: 你的朋友大多數是哪國人？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de péng yǒu dà duō shù shì nǎ guó rén?
entries.questionEnglish: Where are most of your friends from?
entries.answer: 我的朋友大多數是台灣人。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de péng yǒu dà duō shù shì tái wān rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Most of my friends are Taiwanese.

entries.example: 我們穿了同樣的衣服！
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men chuān le tóng yàng de yī fu!
entries.exampleEnglish: We're wearing the same clothes!
entries.question: 你每天都吃同樣的早餐嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ měi tiān dōu chī tóng yàng de zǎo cān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you eat the same breakfast every day?
entries.answer: 對，我每天吃同樣的早餐。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ měi tiān chī tóng yàng de zǎo cān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I eat the same breakfast every day.

entries.example: 我和一群朋友去爬山。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hé yì qún péng yǒu qù pá shān.
entries.exampleEnglish: I went hiking with a group of friends.
entries.question: 你常跟一群人出去，還是一個人？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng gēn yì qún rén chū qù, hái shì yí gè rén?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you usually go out with a group or on your own?
entries.answer: 我常跟一群同事出去吃飯。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cháng gēn yì qún tóng shì chū qù chī fàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I often go out to eat with a group of coworkers.

entries.example: 我明天必須早起。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ míng tiān bì xū zǎo qǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: I have to get up early tomorrow.
entries.question: 你上班必須穿什麼衣服？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shàng bān bì xū chuān shén me yī fu?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you have to wear to work?
entries.answer: 我必須穿襯衫上班。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bì xū chuān chèn shān shàng bān.
entries.answerEnglish: I have to wear a shirt to work.

entries.example: 政府說明天放颱風假。
entries.examplePinyin: zhèng fǔ shuō míng tiān fàng tái fēng jià.
entries.exampleEnglish: The government says tomorrow is a typhoon day off.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣政府做得好嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān zhèng fǔ zuò de hǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwan's government does a good job?
entries.answer: 我覺得台灣政府做得不錯。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de tái wān zhèng fǔ zuò de bú cuò.
entries.answerEnglish: I think Taiwan's government does pretty well.

entries.english: lean against; rely on; be near
entries.example: 請不要靠在車門上。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng bú yào kào zài chē mén shàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please don't lean against the doors.
entries.question: 你坐車的時候喜歡靠窗嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò chē de shí hòu xǐ huan kào chuāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like sitting by the window when you travel?
entries.answer: 我喜歡靠窗的位子。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan kào chuāng de wèi zi.
entries.answerEnglish: I like window seats.

entries.example: 前面路口要轉彎。
entries.examplePinyin: qián miàn lù kǒu yào zhuǎn wān.
entries.exampleEnglish: We need to turn at the next intersection.
entries.question: 你騎車轉彎的時候會小心嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qí chē zhuǎn wān de shí hòu huì xiǎo xīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you careful when you turn on your scooter?
entries.answer: 會，我轉彎的時候騎很慢。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ zhuǎn wān de shí hòu qí hěn màn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I ride slowly when I turn.

entries.example: 夜市有各種小吃。
entries.examplePinyin: yè shì yǒu gè zhǒng xiǎo chī.
entries.exampleEnglish: The night market has all kinds of snacks.
entries.question: 你去過台灣各地嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò tái wān gè dì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to different parts of Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我去過台灣各地，最喜歡台東。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qù guò tái wān gè dì, zuì xǐ huan tái dōng.
entries.answerEnglish: I've been all around Taiwan. I like Taitung best.

entries.example: 這次會議的重點是什麼？
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì huì yì de zhòng diǎn shì shén me?
entries.exampleEnglish: What's the main point of this meeting?
entries.question: 你覺得學中文的重點是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de xué zhōng wén de zhòng diǎn shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is the key to learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 我覺得重點是多說。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de zhòng diǎn shì duō shuō.
entries.answerEnglish: I think the key is to speak a lot.

entries.example: 這家餐廳的服務很好。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā cān tīng de fú wù hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: The service at this restaurant is very good.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣便利商店的服務怎麼樣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān biàn lì shāng diàn de fú wù zěn me yàng?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think of the service at Taiwan's convenience stores?
entries.answer: 便利商店的服務很好，很方便。
entries.answerPinyin: biàn lì shāng diàn de fú wù hěn hǎo, hěn fāng biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: The service is great and very convenient.

entries.example: 這家咖啡店提供免費網路。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā kā fēi diàn tí gōng miǎn fèi wǎng lù.
entries.exampleEnglish: This café offers free Wi-Fi.
entries.question: 你的公司提供午餐嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng sī tí gōng wǔ cān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company provide lunch?
entries.answer: 我的公司不提供午餐。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de gōng sī bù tí gōng wǔ cān.
entries.answerEnglish: My company doesn't provide lunch.

entries.example: 這家店的生意很好。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn de shēng yì hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop does very good business.
entries.question: 你想自己做生意嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng zì jǐ zuò shēng yì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to run your own business?
entries.answer: 我想以後自己做生意。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng yǐ hòu zì jǐ zuò shēng yì.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to run my own business one day.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan cān jiā pài duì ma?

entries.answerPinyin: jīn tiān fā shēng le yí jiàn hǎo shì, wǒ jiā xīn le!
entries.answerEnglish: Something good happened today: I got a raise!

entries.examplePinyin: qǐng gēn zhe wǒ zǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please follow me.
entries.question: 你旅行喜歡跟著導遊嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ lǚ xíng xǐ huan gēn zhe dǎo yóu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you travel, do you like following a tour guide?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，我不想跟著導遊走。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xǐ huan, wǒ bù xiǎng gēn zhe dǎo yóu zǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't want to follow a guide around.

entries.example: 我在研究怎麼坐車去花蓮。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài yán jiù zěn me zuò chē qù huā lián.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chū qù wán yǐ qián huì xiān yán jiù ma?

entries.answer: 會，我會先研究要吃什麼。

entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I research what to eat first.

entries.examplePinyin: tái wān shì yí gè zì yóu de shè huì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan is a free society.

entries.questionPinyin: tái wān shè huì gēn nǐ de guó jiā yí yàng ma?

entries.answer: 不太一樣，台灣社會比較安全。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài yí yàng, tái wān shè huì bǐ jiào ān quán.
entries.answerEnglish: Not quite. Taiwanese society is safer.

entries.example: 我的母親是老師。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de mǔ qīn shì lǎo shī.

entries.answerEnglish: My mother lives in Canada.

entries.examplePinyin: bān lái tái wān yǐ hòu, wǒ gǎi biàn le hěn duō.

entries.answer: 我最大的改變是愛吃辣了。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì dà de gǎi biàn shì ài chī là le.
entries.answerEnglish: My biggest change is that I love spicy food now.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài nǎ lǐ zhǎo zū fáng zi de zī xùn?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you look for information about renting?
entries.answer: 我在網路上找租屋資訊。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài wǎng lù shang zhǎo zū wū zī xùn.
entries.answerEnglish: I look for rental information online.

entries.answer: 我幾乎每天都去健身房。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jī hū měi tiān dōu qù jiàn shēn fáng.
entries.answerEnglish: I go to the gym almost every day.

entries.examplePinyin: zhè shì yí gè hǎo xiǎng fǎ!

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì xué zhōng wén yǒu shén me xiǎng fǎ?

entries.answer: 我的想法是每天說一點。

entries.answerEnglish: My idea is to speak a little every day.

entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dōu tí zǎo liǎng gè xiǎo shí dào.
entries.answerEnglish: I always get there two hours early.

entries.answer: 我弄丟過一把雨傘。

entries.example: 我的父親今年六十歲。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de fù qīn jīn nián liù shí suì.
entries.exampleEnglish: My father is sixty this year.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de fù qīn zuò shén me gōng zuò?

entries.answer: 我的父親是醫生。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de fù qīn shì yī shēng.

entries.question: 你覺得努力一定會有好結果嗎？

entries.answer: 不一定，可是不努力就沒有好結果。
entries.answerPinyin: bù yí dìng, kě shì bù nǔ lì jiù méi yǒu hǎo jié guǒ.

entries.answerPinyin: wǒ céng jīng qù guò rì běn hé tài guó.
entries.answerEnglish: I've been to Japan and Thailand.

entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ měi gè xīng qí dōu yào xiě bào gào.

entries.answer: 我覺得三十歲左右是最好的年齡。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de sān shí suì zuǒ yòu shì zuì hǎo de nián líng.

entries.examplePinyin: tái wān měi sì nián xuǎn yí cì zǒng tǒng.

entries.answer: 很累，我不想當總統。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn lèi, wǒ bù xiǎng dāng zǒng tǒng.

entries.answer: 有，我常去看藝術展。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ cháng qù kàn yì shù zhǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often go to art exhibitions.

entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de zhǔ yào gōng zuò shì xiě chéng shì.

entries.answerPinyin: zhǔ yào shì yīn wèi wǒ zhù zài tái wān.

entries.examplePinyin: tā yǒu shí nián de gōng zuò jīng yàn.

entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men de lǚ xíng jì huà gǎi le.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ men guó jiā de jīng jì hǎo ma?

entries.answer: 最近經濟不太好，物價很高。

entries.answerEnglish: The economy isn't great lately. Prices are high.

entries.examplePinyin: wǒ tóng yì nǐ de kàn fǎ.
entries.exampleEnglish: I agree with you.
entries.question: 你同意「台灣最美的風景是人」嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tóng yì “tái wān zuì měi de fēng jǐng shì rén” ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you agree that "Taiwan's most beautiful sight is its people"?
entries.answer: 我很同意，台灣人很熱情。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ hěn tóng yì, tái wān rén hěn rè qíng.
entries.answerEnglish: I totally agree. Taiwanese people are very warm.

entries.example: 我整個週末都在睡覺。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zhěng gè zhōu mò dōu zài shuì jiào.
entries.exampleEnglish: I slept the whole weekend.
entries.question: 你可以一個人吃完整個披薩嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kě yǐ yí gè rén chī wán zhěng gè pī sà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you eat a whole pizza by yourself?
entries.answer: 可以，我一個人能吃完整個披薩。
entries.answerPinyin: kě yǐ, wǒ yí gè rén néng chī wán zhěng gè pī sà.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I can finish a whole pizza on my own.

entries.example: 我在台灣待了三年。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài tái wān dài le sān nián.
entries.exampleEnglish: I've been in Taiwan for three years.
entries.question: 你打算在台灣待多久？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dǎ suàn zài tái wān dài duō jiǔ?
entries.questionEnglish: How long are you planning to stay in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我想在台灣待五年以上。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng zài tái wān dài wǔ nián yǐ shàng.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to stay in Taiwan for over five years.

entries.example: 台北的街道很乾淨。
entries.examplePinyin: tái běi de jiē dào hěn gān jìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The streets in Taipei are very clean.
entries.question: 你家附近的街道熱鬧嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn de jiē dào rè nào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are the streets near your home busy?
entries.answer: 很熱鬧，街道兩邊都是商店。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn rè nào, jiē dào liǎng biān dōu shì shāng diàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Very. Both sides of the street are lined with shops.

entries.example: 一般的便當大概一百塊。
entries.examplePinyin: yì bān de biàn dāng dà gài yì bǎi kuài.
entries.exampleEnglish: An ordinary lunch box costs about a hundred dollars.
entries.question: 你一般幾點下班？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yì bān jǐ diǎn xià bān?
entries.questionEnglish: What time do you usually get off work?
entries.answer: 我一般六點下班。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yì bān liù diǎn xià bān.
entries.answerEnglish: I usually get off at six.

entries.example: 我在一家國際公司上班。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài yì jiā guó jì gōng sī shàng bān.
entries.exampleEnglish: I work for an international company.
entries.question: 你在台灣有很多國際朋友嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān yǒu hěn duō guó jì péng yǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have many international friends in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 有，我的國際朋友比台灣朋友多。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de guó jì péng yǒu bǐ tái wān péng yǒu duō.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have more international friends than Taiwanese ones.

entries.example: 這張床太硬了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhāng chuáng tài yìng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This bed is too hard.
entries.question: 你喜歡睡硬的床還是軟的床？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan shuì yìng de chuáng hái shì ruǎn de chuáng?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like sleeping on a hard bed or a soft one?
entries.answer: 我喜歡睡硬一點的床。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan shuì yìng yì diǎn de chuáng.
entries.answerEnglish: I like a slightly firmer bed.

entries.example: 我的手臂被蚊子咬了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de shǒu bì bèi wén zi yǎo le.
entries.exampleEnglish: I got bitten on the arm by a mosquito.
entries.question: 你運動完手臂會痠嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yùn dòng wán shǒu bì huì suān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do your arms ache after you exercise?
entries.answer: 會，我打完網球手臂很痠。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dǎ wán wǎng qiú shǒu bì hěn suān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my arms ache after tennis.

entries.example: 這個週末公園有很多活動。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge zhōu mò gōng yuán yǒu hěn duō huó dòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of events in the park this weekend.
entries.question: 你週末喜歡參加什麼活動？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhōu mò xǐ huan cān jiā shén me huó dòng?
entries.questionEnglish: What activities do you like doing at the weekend?
entries.answer: 我喜歡參加戶外活動，像是爬山。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan cān jiā hù wài huó dòng, xiàng shì pá shān.
entries.answerEnglish: I like outdoor activities, like hiking.

entries.example: 我的家人都很支持我。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de jiā rén dōu hěn zhī chí wǒ.
entries.exampleEnglish: My family really supports me.
entries.question: 你來台灣的時候，家人支持你嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ lái tái wān de shí hòu, jiā rén zhī chí nǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you came to Taiwan, did your family support you?
entries.answer: 很支持，他們覺得這是好機會。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn zhī chí, tā men jué de zhè shì hǎo jī huì.
entries.answerEnglish: Very much. They thought it was a great opportunity.

entries.example: 這家公司的產品很好用。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā gōng sī de chǎn pǐn hěn hǎo yòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This company's products are really good.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪個牌子的產品？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ gè pái zi de chǎn pǐn?
entries.questionEnglish: Which brand's products do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡蘋果的產品。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan píng guǒ de chǎn pǐn.
entries.answerEnglish: I like Apple's products best.

entries.example: 現在的情況有點複雜。
entries.examplePinyin: xiàn zài de qíng kuàng yǒu diǎn fù zá.
entries.exampleEnglish: The situation is a bit complicated right now.
entries.question: 遇到緊急情況，你會打幾號？
entries.questionPinyin: yù dào jǐn jí qíng kuàng, nǐ huì dǎ jǐ hào?
entries.questionEnglish: In an emergency, what number would you call?
entries.answer: 遇到緊急情況，我會打119。
entries.answerPinyin: yù dào jǐn jí qíng kuàng, wǒ huì dǎ 119.
entries.answerEnglish: In an emergency, I'd call 119.

entries.example: 記得把蓋子蓋好。
entries.examplePinyin: jì de bǎ gài zi gài hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Remember to put the lid back on properly.
entries.question: 你常忘記蓋上蓋子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng wàng jì gài shàng gài zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often forget to put the lid back on?
entries.answer: 常常，我常忘了把牙膏蓋子蓋好。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ cháng wàng le bǎ yá gāo gài zi gài hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I keep forgetting to put the cap back on the toothpaste.

entries.example: 工地的工人很早就開始工作。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng dì de gōng rén hěn zǎo jiù kāi shǐ gōng zuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: The workers on the building site start very early.
entries.question: 你家最近有請工人來修東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā zuì jìn yǒu qǐng gōng rén lái xiū dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you had workers come to fix anything at home recently?
entries.answer: 有，上個月請工人來修冷氣。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, shàng gè yuè qǐng gōng rén lái xiū lěng qì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, last month a worker came to fix the AC.

entries.example: 牆上有一張很大的地圖。
entries.examplePinyin: qiáng shàng yǒu yì zhāng hěn dà de dì tú.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a big map on the wall.
entries.question: 你房間的牆是什麼顏色？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ fáng jiān de qiáng shì shén me yán sè?
entries.questionEnglish: What color are the walls in your room?
entries.answer: 我房間的牆是白色的。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ fáng jiān de qiáng shì bái sè de.
entries.answerEnglish: The walls in my room are white.

entries.example: 搭捷運的規則是不能吃東西。
entries.examplePinyin: dā jié yùn de guī zé shì bù néng chī dōng xī.
entries.exampleEnglish: One of the MRT rules is no eating.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣哪個規則最特別？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān nǎ gè guī zé zuì tè bié?
entries.questionEnglish: Which rule in Taiwan do you find most unusual?
entries.answer: 捷運上不能喝水的規則很特別。
entries.answerPinyin: jié yùn shàng bù néng hē shuǐ de guī zé hěn tè bié.
entries.answerEnglish: The rule against drinking water on the MRT is pretty unusual.

entries.example: 這位球員打得很好。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè wèi qiú yuán dǎ de hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This player is really good.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪一位球員？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ yí wèi qiú yuán?
entries.questionEnglish: Which player do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡的球員是大谷翔平。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan de qiú yuán shì dà gǔ xiáng píng.
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite player is Shohei Ohtani.

entries.example: 今天的會議開了三個小時。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn tiān de huì yì kāi le sān gè xiǎo shí.
entries.exampleEnglish: Today's meeting went on for three hours.
entries.question: 你一個星期要開幾次會議？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yí gè xīng qí yào kāi jǐ cì huì yì?
entries.questionEnglish: How many meetings do you have a week?
entries.answer: 我一個星期大概有五個會議。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yí gè xīng qí dà gài yǒu wǔ gè huì yì.
entries.answerEnglish: I have about five meetings a week.

entries.example: 秋天是我最喜歡的季節。
entries.examplePinyin: qiū tiān shì wǒ zuì xǐ huan de jì jié.
entries.exampleEnglish: Autumn is my favorite season.
entries.question: 你最喜歡台灣的哪個季節？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan tái wān de nǎ gè jì jié?
entries.questionEnglish: Which season do you like best in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡秋天這個季節，不冷也不熱。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan qiū tiān zhè ge jì jié, bù lěng yě bú rè.
entries.answerEnglish: I like autumn best. It's neither cold nor hot.

entries.example: 這家店不接受信用卡。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn bù jiē shòu xìn yòng kǎ.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop doesn't take credit cards.
entries.question: 你能接受吃臭豆腐嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ néng jiē shòu chī chòu dòu fu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you handle eating stinky tofu?
entries.answer: 可以接受，我還滿喜歡的。
entries.answerPinyin: kě yǐ jiē shòu, wǒ hái mǎn xǐ huan de.
entries.answerEnglish: I can handle it. I actually quite like it.

entries.example: 我很想有機會去花蓮玩。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hěn xiǎng yǒu jī huì qù huā lián wán.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'd love a chance to go to Hualien.
entries.question: 你在台灣有機會說中文嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān yǒu jī huì shuō zhōng wén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you get chances to speak Chinese in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 有，我每天都有機會說中文。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ měi tiān dōu yǒu jī huì shuō zhōng wén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I get to speak Chinese every day.

entries.example: 我有一個好消息要告訴你！
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ yǒu yí gè hǎo xiāo xí yào gào sù nǐ!
entries.exampleEnglish: I've got some good news to tell you!
entries.question: 你最近有什麼好消息嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn yǒu shén me hǎo xiāo xí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you had any good news lately?
entries.answer: 有，我的好消息是我要結婚了！
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de hǎo xiāo xí shì wǒ yào jié hūn le!
entries.answerEnglish: Yes! My good news is that I'm getting married!

entries.example: 我未來想開一家咖啡店。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ wèi lái xiǎng kāi yì jiā kā fēi diàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: In the future I want to open a café.
entries.question: 你未來想住在哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ wèi lái xiǎng zhù zài nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you want to live in the future?
entries.answer: 我未來想住在台南。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ wèi lái xiǎng zhù zài tái nán.
entries.answerEnglish: In the future I'd like to live in Tainan.

entries.example: 小心，別被球打到！
entries.examplePinyin: xiǎo xīn, bié bèi qiú dǎ dào!
entries.exampleEnglish: Careful, don't get hit by the ball!
entries.question: 你被球打到過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bèi qiú dǎ dào guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been hit by a ball?
entries.answer: 有，我打棒球的時候被球打到過。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ dǎ bàng qiú de shí hòu bèi qiú dǎ dào guò.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I got hit by a ball playing baseball.

entries.example: 我目前住在新北。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ mù qián zhù zài xīn běi.
entries.exampleEnglish: I currently live in New Taipei.
entries.question: 你目前在做什麼工作？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mù qián zài zuò shén me gōng zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do for work at the moment?
entries.answer: 我目前在一家科技公司上班。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ mù qián zài yì jiā kē jì gōng sī shàng bān.
entries.answerEnglish: I currently work at a tech company.

entries.example: 我第一次做蛋糕就失敗了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ dì yī cì zuò dàn gāo jiù shī bài le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The first time I made a cake, it was a failure.
entries.question: 你做菜失敗過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò cài shī bài guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had a cooking disaster?
entries.answer: 常常失敗，我做的菜都太鹹了。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng shī bài, wǒ zuò de cài dōu tài xián le.
entries.answerEnglish: All the time. My dishes always come out too salty.

entries.example: 你可以再解釋一次嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: nǐ kě yǐ zài jiě shì yí cì ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: Could you explain that again?
entries.question: 你會怎麼跟朋友解釋「小確幸」？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zěn me gēn péng yǒu jiě shì “xiǎo què xìng”?
entries.questionEnglish: How would you explain "xiao que xing" to a friend?
entries.answer: 我會解釋說，就是生活裡小小的快樂。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì jiě shì shuō, jiù shì shēng huó lǐ xiǎo xiǎo de kuài lè.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd explain that it means the small joys in everyday life.

entries.example: 太陽從西方下山。
entries.examplePinyin: tài yáng cóng xī fāng xià shān.
entries.exampleEnglish: The sun sets in the west.
entries.question: 你覺得西方人和台灣人哪裡不一樣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de xī fāng rén hé tái wān rén nǎ lǐ bù yí yàng?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you think Westerners and Taiwanese people are different?
entries.answer: 我覺得西方人說話比較直接。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de xī fāng rén shuō huà bǐ jiào zhí jiē.
entries.answerEnglish: I think Westerners speak more directly.

entries.example: 我最近工作壓力很大。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zuì jìn gōng zuò yā lì hěn dà.
entries.exampleEnglish: I've been under a lot of pressure at work lately.
entries.question: 你壓力大的時候會做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yā lì dà de shí hòu huì zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when you're stressed?
entries.answer: 壓力大的時候，我會去運動。
entries.answerPinyin: yā lì dà de shí hòu, wǒ huì qù yùn dòng.
entries.answerEnglish: When I'm stressed, I go and exercise.

entries.example: 這條馬路很寬。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tiáo mǎ lù hěn kuān.
entries.exampleEnglish: This road is very wide.
entries.question: 你家前面的馬路寬不寬？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā qián miàn de mǎ lù kuān bu kuān?
entries.questionEnglish: Is the road in front of your home wide?
entries.answer: 不太寬，只能過一台車。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài kuān, zhǐ néng guò yì tái chē.
entries.answerEnglish: Not very. Only one car can get through.

entries.example: 太陽從東方升起來。
entries.examplePinyin: tài yáng cóng dōng fāng shēng qǐ lái.
entries.exampleEnglish: The sun rises in the east.
entries.question: 你覺得東方和西方的文化差很多嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de dōng fāng hé xī fāng de wén huà chà hěn duō ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Eastern and Western cultures are very different?
entries.answer: 差很多，東方人比較重視家庭。
entries.answerPinyin: chà hěn duō, dōng fāng rén bǐ jiào zhòng shì jiā tíng.
entries.answerEnglish: Very different. People in the East care more about family.

entries.example: 這家咖啡店的設計很漂亮。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā kā fēi diàn de shè jì hěn piào liang.
entries.exampleEnglish: This café is beautifully designed.
entries.question: 如果可以，你想怎麼設計你的房間？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ kě yǐ, nǐ xiǎng zěn me shè jì nǐ de fáng jiān?
entries.questionEnglish: If you could, how would you design your room?
entries.answer: 我想把房間設計得簡單一點。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng bǎ fáng jiān shè jì de jiǎn dān yì diǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd design my room to be a bit simpler.

entries.example: 我在存錢買機車。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài cún qián mǎi jī chē.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm saving up for a scooter.
entries.question: 你每個月會存錢嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ měi gè yuè huì cún qián ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you save money every month?
entries.answer: 會，我在存錢去日本玩。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ zài cún qián qù rì běn wán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm saving up for a trip to Japan.

entries.example: 過去的事就不要想了。
entries.examplePinyin: guò qù de shì jiù bú yào xiǎng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: Don't dwell on the past.
entries.question: 過去一年，你最開心的事是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: guò qù yì nián, nǐ zuì kāi xīn de shì shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What was the happiest thing for you in the past year?
entries.answer: 過去一年最開心的是我來到台灣。
entries.answerPinyin: guò qù yì nián zuì kāi xīn de shì wǒ lái dào tái wān.
entries.answerEnglish: The happiest thing this past year was coming to Taiwan.

entries.example: 這個電視節目很好笑。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge diàn shì jié mù hěn hǎo xiào.
entries.exampleEnglish: This TV show is really funny.
entries.question: 你喜歡看什麼節目？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kàn shén me jié mù?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of shows do you like to watch?
entries.answer: 我喜歡看美食節目。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan kàn měi shí jié mù.
entries.answerEnglish: I like watching food shows.

entries.example: 東京是日本的首都。
entries.examplePinyin: dōng jīng shì rì běn de shǒu dū.
entries.exampleEnglish: Tokyo is the capital of Japan.
entries.question: 你們國家的首都在哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men guó jiā de shǒu dū zài nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the capital of your country?
entries.answer: 我們國家的首都是倫敦。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men guó jiā de shǒu dū shì lún dūn.
entries.answerEnglish: Our capital is London.

entries.example: 我明天要去拜訪一個客戶。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ míng tiān yào qù bài fǎng yí gè kè hù.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm visiting a client tomorrow.
entries.question: 你來台灣以後拜訪過朋友的家嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ lái tái wān yǐ hòu bài fǎng guò péng yǒu de jiā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Since coming to Taiwan, have you visited a friend's home?
entries.answer: 拜訪過，我去過同事家吃飯。
entries.answerPinyin: bài fǎng guò, wǒ qù guò tóng shì jiā chī fàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've been to a coworker's home for dinner.

entries.example: 計程車司機常常開著收音機。
entries.examplePinyin: jì chéng chē sī jī cháng cháng kāi zhe shōu yīn jī.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taxi drivers often have the radio on.
entries.question: 你現在還聽收音機嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiàn zài hái tīng shōu yīn jī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you still listen to the radio?
entries.answer: 很少，我只有開車的時候才聽收音機。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn shǎo, wǒ zhǐ yǒu kāi chē de shí hòu cái tīng shōu yīn jī.
entries.answerEnglish: Rarely. I only listen to the radio when I'm driving.

entries.example: 我今天終於完成報告了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ jīn tiān zhōng yú wán chéng bào gào le.
entries.exampleEnglish: I finally finished the report today.
entries.question: 你今天的工作完成了嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jīn tiān de gōng zuò wán chéng le ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you finished today's work?
entries.answer: 還沒，我晚上要在家完成。
entries.answerPinyin: hái méi, wǒ wǎn shàng yào zài jiā wán chéng.
entries.answerEnglish: Not yet. I have to finish it at home tonight.

entries.example: 朋友幫我準備了一個生日驚喜。
entries.examplePinyin: péng yǒu bāng wǒ zhǔn bèi le yí gè shēng rì jīng xǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: My friends prepared a birthday surprise for me.
entries.question: 你喜歡別人給你驚喜嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan bié rén gěi nǐ jīng xǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like people surprising you?
entries.answer: 喜歡，收到驚喜讓我很開心。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, shōu dào jīng xǐ ràng wǒ hěn kāi xīn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, getting a surprise makes me very happy.

entries.example: 我昨天晚上被蚊子咬了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shàng bèi wén zi yǎo le.
entries.exampleEnglish: I got bitten by mosquitoes last night.
entries.question: 你在台灣常被蚊子咬嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān cháng bèi wén zi yǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often get bitten by mosquitoes in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 常常，夏天我每天都被咬。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, xià tiān wǒ měi tiān dōu bèi yǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: All the time. In summer I get bitten every day.

entries.example: 一杯咖啡在紐約要五塊美金。
entries.examplePinyin: yì bēi kā fēi zài niǔ yuē yào wǔ kuài měi jīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: A cup of coffee costs five US dollars in New York.
entries.question: 你出國旅行會帶美金嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chū guó lǚ xíng huì dài měi jīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you take US dollars when you travel abroad?
entries.answer: 會，我通常帶一些美金在身上。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ tōng cháng dài yì xiē měi jīn zài shēn shàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I usually carry some US dollars.

entries.example: 那位女士在找捷運站。
entries.examplePinyin: nà wèi nǚ shì zài zhǎo jié yùn zhàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: That lady is looking for the MRT station.
entries.question: 上台說話時，你會怎麼開始？
entries.questionPinyin: shàng tái shuō huà shí, nǐ huì zěn me kāi shǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: When you speak in front of an audience, how do you begin?
entries.answer: 我會說：「各位女士、先生，大家好！」
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì shuō: “gè wèi nǚ shì, xiān shēng, dà jiā hǎo!”
entries.answerEnglish: I say, 'Ladies and gentlemen, hello everyone!'

entries.example: 他買彩券中了一百萬！
entries.examplePinyin: tā mǎi cǎi quàn zhòng le yì bǎi wàn!
entries.exampleEnglish: He won a million on the lottery!
entries.question: 如果你有一百萬，你想做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ nǐ yǒu yì bǎi wàn, nǐ xiǎng zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: If you had a million, what would you do?
entries.answer: 我會用這一百萬去環遊世界。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì yòng zhè yì bǎi wàn qù huán yóu shì jiè.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd use the million to travel around the world.

entries.example: 今天下雨的機率是百分之八十。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn tiān xià yǔ de jī lǜ shì bǎi fēn zhī bā shí.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's an eighty percent chance of rain today.
entries.question: 你的薪水有百分之幾拿來付房租？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de xīn shuǐ yǒu bǎi fēn zhī jǐ ná lái fù fáng zū?
entries.questionEnglish: What percentage of your salary goes on rent?
entries.answer: 大概百分之三十。
entries.answerPinyin: dà gài bǎi fēn zhī sān shí.
entries.answerEnglish: About thirty percent.

entries.example: 我每天都使用悠遊卡坐捷運。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi tiān dōu shǐ yòng yōu yóu kǎ zuò jié yùn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I use my EasyCard to ride the MRT every day.
entries.question: 你最常使用什麼App？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì cháng shǐ yòng shén me App?
entries.questionEnglish: Which app do you use most?
entries.answer: 我最常使用LINE。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì cháng shǐ yòng LINE.
entries.answerEnglish: I use LINE the most.

entries.example: 我得到了一個新的工作機會。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ dé dào le yí gè xīn de gōng zuò jī huì.
entries.exampleEnglish: I got a new job opportunity.
entries.question: 你最近得到什麼好消息嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn dé dào shén me hǎo xiāo xí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you had any good news recently?
entries.answer: 我得到了一個面試機會。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dé dào le yí gè miàn shì jī huì.
entries.answerEnglish: I got a job interview.

entries.example: 我不喜歡恐怖類型的電影。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bù xǐ huan kǒng bù lèi xíng de diàn yǐng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I don't like horror films.
entries.question: 你喜歡什麼類型的音樂？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan shén me lèi xíng de yīn yuè?
entries.questionEnglish: What type of music do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡爵士這種類型的音樂。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan jué shì zhè zhǒng lèi xíng de yīn yuè.
entries.answerEnglish: I like music like jazz.

entries.example: 我的中文老師很有耐心。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de zhōng wén lǎo shī hěn yǒu nài xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: My Chinese teacher is very patient.
entries.question: 你排隊的時候有耐心嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pái duì de shí hòu yǒu nài xīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you patient when you wait in line?
entries.answer: 沒什麼耐心，我討厭排隊。
entries.answerPinyin: méi shén me nài xīn, wǒ tǎo yàn pái duì.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. I hate queuing.

entries.example: 我們家附近有一間教堂。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men jiā fù jìn yǒu yì jiān jiào táng.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a church near our home.
entries.question: 你星期天會去教堂嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xīng qí tiān huì qù jiào táng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you go to church on Sundays?
entries.answer: 會，我星期天早上去教堂。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ xīng qí tiān zǎo shàng qù jiào táng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I go to church on Sunday mornings.

entries.example: 我跟同事的關係很好。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ gēn tóng shì de guān xì hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: I get along really well with my coworkers.
entries.question: 你跟你的鄰居關係好嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gēn nǐ de lín jū guān xì hǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a good relationship with your neighbors?
entries.answer: 關係不錯，他們常送我水果。
entries.answerPinyin: guān xì bú cuò, tā men cháng sòng wǒ shuǐ guǒ.
entries.answerEnglish: Pretty good. They often give me fruit.

entries.example: 他是我真正的朋友。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì wǒ zhēn zhèng de péng yǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a true friend.
entries.question: 你覺得真正的台灣味是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zhēn zhèng de tái wān wèi shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think the real taste of Taiwan is?
entries.answer: 我覺得真正的台灣味是牛肉麵。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de zhēn zhèng de tái wān wèi shì niú ròu miàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I think the real taste of Taiwan is beef noodle soup.

entries.example: 我在網路上找資料。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài wǎng lù shang zhǎo zī liào.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm looking up information online.
entries.question: 你出國旅行前會先找資料嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chū guó lǚ xíng qián huì xiān zhǎo zī liào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you do some research before you travel abroad?
entries.answer: 會，我會先上網找很多資料。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì xiān shàng wǎng zhǎo hěn duō zī liào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I look up lots of information online first.

entries.example: 等了半個小時，公車終於來了。
entries.examplePinyin: děng le bàn gè xiǎo shí, gōng chē zhōng yú lái le.
entries.exampleEnglish: After waiting half an hour, the bus finally came.
entries.question: 你終於習慣台灣的天氣了嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhōng yú xí guàn tái wān de tiān qì le ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you finally got used to Taiwan's weather?
entries.answer: 我終於習慣了，但是夏天還是太熱。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhōng yú xí guàn le, dàn shì xià tiān hái shì tài rè.
entries.answerEnglish: I've finally got used to it, but summer is still too hot.

entries.example: 我不買，只是看看。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bù mǎi, zhǐ shì kàn kàn.
