entries.exampleEnglish: I'm not buying, just looking.
entries.question: 你去夜市都會買東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù yè shì dōu huì mǎi dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you always buy things at the night market?
entries.answer: 不一定，有時候只是去走走。
entries.answerPinyin: bù yí dìng, yǒu shí hòu zhǐ shì qù zǒu zǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: Not always. Sometimes I just go for a stroll.

entries.example: 這家餐廳的地點很方便。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā cān tīng de dì diǎn hěn fāng biàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant's location is very convenient.
entries.question: 你覺得台北最好的約會地點是哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái běi zuì hǎo de yuē huì dì diǎn shì nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you think is the best date spot in Taipei?
entries.answer: 我覺得最好的約會地點是淡水。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de zuì hǎo de yuē huì dì diǎn shì dàn shuǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I think the best date spot is Tamsui.

entries.example: 牆上有一張很大的圖畫。
entries.examplePinyin: qiáng shàng yǒu yì zhāng hěn dà de tú huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a big picture on the wall.
entries.question: 你家牆上有掛圖畫嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā qiáng shàng yǒu guà tú huà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any pictures on the walls at home?
entries.answer: 有，我掛了一張朋友畫的圖畫。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ guà le yì zhāng péng yǒu huà de tú huà.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I hung up a picture a friend drew.

entries.example: 我通常七點起床。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ tōng cháng qī diǎn qǐ chuáng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I usually get up at seven.
entries.question: 你週末通常做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhōu mò tōng cháng zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you usually do at weekends?
entries.answer: 我週末通常去爬山。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhōu mò tōng cháng qù pá shān.
entries.answerEnglish: I usually go hiking at weekends.

entries.example: 我丟給你，你要接住喔！
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ diū gěi nǐ, nǐ yào jiē zhù ō!
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm throwing it to you. Catch it!
entries.question: 朋友丟鑰匙給你，你接得住嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: péng yǒu diū yào shi gěi nǐ, nǐ jiē de zhù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: If a friend throws you the keys, can you catch them?
entries.answer: 沒問題，我一定能接住。
entries.answerPinyin: méi wèn tí, wǒ yí dìng néng jiē zhù.
entries.answerEnglish: No problem. I'll definitely catch them.

entries.example: 這件事你不要告訴任何人。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn shì nǐ bú yào gào sù rèn hé rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: Don't tell anyone about this.
entries.question: 你有沒有沒告訴任何人的祕密？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu méi gào sù rèn hé rén de mì mì?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a secret you haven't told anyone?
entries.answer: 有，但是我不能告訴任何人。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, dàn shì wǒ bù néng gào sù rèn hé rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but I can't tell anyone.

entries.example: 這份報告有很多錯誤。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè fèn bào gào yǒu hěn duō cuò wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: This report has a lot of mistakes.
entries.question: 你說中文常犯什麼錯誤？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shuō zhōng wén cháng fàn shén me cuò wù?
entries.questionEnglish: What mistakes do you often make when speaking Chinese?
entries.answer: 我最常犯的錯誤是聲調不對。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì cháng fàn de cuò wù shì shēng diào bú duì.
entries.answerEnglish: My most common mistake is getting the tones wrong.

entries.example: 這是學中文最好的方法。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shì xué zhōng wén zuì hǎo de fāng fǎ.
entries.exampleEnglish: This is the best way to learn Chinese.
entries.question: 你學中文最好的方法是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xué zhōng wén zuì hǎo de fāng fǎ shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your best way of learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 我的方法是每天看台灣的電視劇。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de fāng fǎ shì měi tiān kàn tái wān de diàn shì jù.
entries.answerEnglish: My method is watching Taiwanese TV dramas every day.

entries.example: 這家店的飲料選擇很多。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn de yǐn liào xuǎn zé hěn duō.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop has lots of drinks to choose from.
entries.question: 如果可以選擇，你想住在哪個城市？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ kě yǐ xuǎn zé, nǐ xiǎng zhù zài nǎ gè chéng shì?
entries.questionEnglish: If you could choose, which city would you like to live in?
entries.answer: 我會選擇住在花蓮，因為很漂亮。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì xuǎn zé zhù zài huā lián, yīn wèi hěn piào liang.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd choose to live in Hualien, because it's beautiful.

entries.example: 我們晚上去看街頭表演。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men wǎn shàng qù kàn jiē tóu biǎo yǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: We're going to see a street performance tonight.
entries.question: 你最近看過什麼表演？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn kàn guò shén me biǎo yǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: What performances have you seen recently?
entries.answer: 我上個月看了一場舞蹈表演。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ shàng gè yuè kàn le yì chǎng wǔ dǎo biǎo yǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Last month I saw a dance performance.

entries.example: 地板剛拖好，小心滑倒。
entries.examplePinyin: dì bǎn gāng tuō hǎo, xiǎo xīn huá dǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: The floor has just been mopped. Careful not to slip.
entries.question: 你在家會坐在地板上嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài jiā huì zuò zài dì bǎn shàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you sit on the floor at home?
entries.answer: 會，夏天坐在地板上很涼。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, xià tiān zuò zài dì bǎn shàng hěn liáng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the floor is nice and cool in summer.

entries.example: 她的丈夫是工程師。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de zhàng fu shì gōng chéng shī.
entries.exampleEnglish: Her husband is an engineer.
entries.question: 在你的國家，丈夫常常在家煮飯嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zài nǐ de guó jiā, zhàng fu cháng cháng zài jiā zhǔ fàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: In your country, do husbands often cook at home?
entries.answer: 很多丈夫也會煮飯，像我爸爸。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn duō zhàng fu yě huì zhǔ fàn, xiàng wǒ bà ba.
entries.answerEnglish: Lots of husbands cook too, like my dad.

entries.example: 她的中文發音很標準。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de zhōng wén fā yīn hěn biāo zhǔn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Her Chinese pronunciation is very standard.
entries.question: 你覺得你的中文發音標準嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ de zhōng wén fā yīn biāo zhǔn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your Chinese pronunciation is standard?
entries.answer: 不太標準，我常常說錯聲調。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài biāo zhǔn, wǒ cháng cháng shuō cuò shēng diào.
entries.answerEnglish: Not very. I often get the tones wrong.

entries.example: 我對台灣的廟宇文化很有興趣。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ duì tái wān de miào yǔ wén huà hěn yǒu xìng qù.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm very interested in Taiwan's temple culture.
entries.question: 你最喜歡台灣的什麼文化？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan tái wān de shén me wén huà?
entries.questionEnglish: What part of Taiwanese culture do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡台灣的夜市文化。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan tái wān de yè shì wén huà.
entries.answerEnglish: I love Taiwan's night market culture most.

entries.example: 他的咖啡店開得很成功。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de kā fēi diàn kāi de hěn chéng gōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: His café has been very successful.
entries.question: 你覺得怎樣才算成功？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zěn yàng cái suàn chéng gōng?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think counts as success?
entries.answer: 我覺得每天快樂就是成功。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de měi tiān kuài lè jiù shì chéng gōng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think being happy every day is success.

entries.example: 我們下午要開會討論新計畫。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men xià wǔ yào kāi huì tǎo lùn xīn jì huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: We're having a meeting this afternoon to discuss the new plan.
entries.question: 你常跟朋友討論什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng gēn péng yǒu tǎo lùn shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you often discuss with your friends?
entries.answer: 我們常討論去哪裡吃好吃的。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men cháng tǎo lùn qù nǎ lǐ chī hǎo chī de.
entries.answerEnglish: We often discuss where to go for good food.

entries.example: 我今年的目標是存十萬塊。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ jīn nián de mù biāo shì cún shí wàn kuài.
entries.exampleEnglish: My goal this year is to save a hundred thousand dollars.
entries.question: 你學中文的目標是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xué zhōng wén de mù biāo shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your goal in learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 我的目標是能跟同事用中文開會。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de mù biāo shì néng gēn tóng shì yòng zhōng wén kāi huì.
entries.answerEnglish: My goal is to be able to have meetings with coworkers in Chinese.

entries.example: 吃飯的時候放下手機吧。
entries.examplePinyin: chī fàn de shí hòu fàng xià shǒu jī ba.
entries.exampleEnglish: Put your phone down while you eat.
entries.question: 你下班以後能放下工作嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xià bān yǐ hòu néng fàng xià gōng zuò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you switch off from work after hours?
entries.answer: 可以，我一下班就放下工作。
entries.answerPinyin: kě yǐ, wǒ yí xià bān jiù fàng xià gōng zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. As soon as I finish work, I put it out of my mind.

entries.example: 這家咖啡店的環境很安靜。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā kā fēi diàn de huán jìng hěn ān jìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This café has a quiet atmosphere.
entries.question: 你喜歡在什麼環境工作？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zài shén me huán jìng gōng zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of environment do you like to work in?
entries.answer: 我喜歡在安靜的環境工作。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan zài ān jìng de huán jìng gōng zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: I like working somewhere quiet.

entries.example: 我的手指流血了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de shǒu zhǐ liú xiě le.
entries.exampleEnglish: My finger is bleeding.
entries.question: 你看到血會怕嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn dào xiě huì pà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you scared when you see blood?
entries.answer: 會，我一看到血就頭暈。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ yí kàn dào xiě jiù tóu yūn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I feel dizzy as soon as I see blood.

entries.example: 傍晚的淡水河邊很漂亮。
entries.examplePinyin: bāng wǎn de dàn shuǐ hé biān hěn piào liang.
entries.exampleEnglish: The Tamsui riverside is beautiful at dusk.
entries.question: 你傍晚通常在做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bāng wǎn tōng cháng zài zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you usually do in the early evening?
entries.answer: 我傍晚常常去河邊散步。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bāng wǎn cháng cháng qù hé biān sàn bù.
entries.answerEnglish: In the early evening I often go for a walk by the river.

entries.english: date; appointment; go on a date
entries.example: 我晚上有約會，不能加班。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ wǎn shàng yǒu yuē huì, bù néng jiā bān.
entries.exampleEnglish: I have a date tonight, so I can't work overtime.
entries.question: 你覺得第一次約會去哪裡最好？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de dì yī cì yuē huì qù nǎ lǐ zuì hǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you think is best for a first date?
entries.answer: 第一次約會去看電影最好。
entries.answerPinyin: dì yī cì yuē huì qù kàn diàn yǐng zuì hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: A movie is best for a first date.

entries.example: 冬天很多鳥會從北方飛來台灣。
entries.examplePinyin: dōng tiān hěn duō niǎo huì cóng běi fāng fēi lái tái wān.
entries.exampleEnglish: In winter, many birds fly to Taiwan from the north.
entries.question: 你的國家北方冷還是南方冷？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā běi fāng lěng hái shì nán fāng lěng?
entries.questionEnglish: In your country, is the north or the south colder?
entries.answer: 我們國家的北方比較冷。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men guó jiā de běi fāng bǐ jiào lěng.
entries.answerEnglish: The north of my country is colder.

entries.example: 小心，地上有破掉的玻璃。
entries.examplePinyin: xiǎo xīn, dì shàng yǒu pò diào de bō lí.
entries.exampleEnglish: Careful, there's broken glass on the floor.
entries.question: 你喜歡用玻璃杯還是塑膠杯？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan yòng bō lí bēi hái shì sù jiāo bēi?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer glass cups or plastic cups?
entries.answer: 我喜歡用玻璃杯，比較環保。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan yòng bō lí bēi, bǐ jiào huán bǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer glass cups. They're more eco-friendly.

entries.example: 我在網路上看到一篇有趣的文章。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài wǎng lù shang kàn dào yì piān yǒu qù de wén zhāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I read an interesting article online.
entries.question: 你可以看懂中文文章嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kě yǐ kàn dǒng zhōng wén wén zhāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you understand articles in Chinese?
entries.answer: 簡單的文章我看得懂。
entries.answerPinyin: jiǎn dān de wén zhāng wǒ kàn de dǒng.
entries.answerEnglish: I can understand simple articles.

entries.example: 我很喜歡看科學的影片。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hěn xǐ huan kàn kē xué de yǐng piàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I love watching science videos.
entries.question: 你覺得科學有趣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de kē xué yǒu qù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you find science interesting?
entries.answer: 很有趣，我常看科學的書。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn yǒu qù, wǒ cháng kàn kē xué de shū.
entries.answerEnglish: Very interesting. I often read science books.

entries.example: 他的語言能力很好。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de yǔ yán néng lì hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: His language ability is very good.
entries.question: 工作上，你覺得什麼能力最重要？
entries.questionPinyin: gōng zuò shàng, nǐ jué de shén me néng lì zuì zhòng yào?
entries.questionEnglish: At work, what ability do you think matters most?
entries.answer: 我覺得溝通能力最重要。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de gōu tōng néng lì zuì zhòng yào.
entries.answerEnglish: I think the ability to communicate matters most.

entries.example: 下雨會影響我們的計畫。
entries.examplePinyin: xià yǔ huì yǐng xiǎng wǒ men de jì huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: Rain will affect our plans.
entries.question: 天氣會影響你的心情嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: tiān qì huì yǐng xiǎng nǐ de xīn qíng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does the weather affect your mood?
entries.answer: 會，下雨天會影響我的心情。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, xià yǔ tiān huì yǐng xiǎng wǒ de xīn qíng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, rainy days affect my mood.

entries.example: 我很想念媽媽做的菜。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hěn xiǎng niàn mā ma zuò de cài.
entries.exampleEnglish: I really miss my mom's cooking.
entries.question: 你最想念家鄉的什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xiǎng niàn jiā xiāng de shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you miss most about your hometown?
entries.answer: 我最想念家鄉的麵包。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xiǎng niàn jiā xiāng de miàn bāo.
entries.answerEnglish: I miss the bread from back home the most.

entries.example: 回國以後，我們要保持聯絡！
entries.examplePinyin: huí guó yǐ hòu, wǒ men yào bǎo chí lián luò!
entries.exampleEnglish: After you go home, let's keep in touch!
entries.question: 你怎麼保持健康？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zěn me bǎo chí jiàn kāng?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you keep healthy?
entries.answer: 我每天走路，保持運動的習慣。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ měi tiān zǒu lù, bǎo chí yùn dòng de xí guàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I walk every day to keep up the habit of exercising.

entries.example: 這本書的作者是台灣人。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè běn shū de zuò zhě shì tái wān rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: The author of this book is Taiwanese.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪一位作者？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ yí wèi zuò zhě?
entries.questionEnglish: Which author do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡的作者是村上春樹。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan de zuò zhě shì cūn shàng chūn shù.
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite author is Haruki Murakami.

entries.example: 出門記得擦防曬，保護皮膚。
entries.examplePinyin: chū mén jì de cā fáng shài, bǎo hù pí fū.
entries.exampleEnglish: Remember to put on sunscreen before you go out to protect your skin.
entries.question: 夏天你怎麼保護皮膚？
entries.questionPinyin: xià tiān nǐ zěn me bǎo hù pí fū?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you protect your skin in summer?
entries.answer: 我出門會撐傘保護皮膚。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ chū mén huì chēng sǎn bǎo hù pí fū.
entries.answerEnglish: I carry an umbrella when I go out to protect my skin.

entries.example: 這台機器壞了，請用旁邊那台。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tái jī qì huài le, qǐng yòng páng biān nà tái.
entries.exampleEnglish: This machine is broken. Please use the one next to it.
entries.question: 你會用超商的機器買票嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì yòng chāo shāng de jī qì mǎi piào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use the machines in convenience stores to buy tickets?
entries.answer: 會，我常用超商的機器買高鐵票。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng yòng chāo shāng de jī qì mǎi gāo tiě piào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often use the convenience store machine to buy high-speed rail tickets.

entries.example: 台北101是很現代的大樓。
entries.examplePinyin: tái běi 101 shì hěn xiàn dài de dà lóu.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taipei 101 is a very modern building.
entries.question: 你喜歡現代的房子，還是老房子？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan xiàn dài de fáng zi, hái shì lǎo fáng zi?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer modern houses or old ones?
entries.answer: 我喜歡現代的房子，比較方便。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan xiàn dài de fáng zi, bǐ jiào fāng biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer modern houses. They're more convenient.

entries.example: 出門前，我會檢查有沒有帶鑰匙。
entries.examplePinyin: chū mén qián, wǒ huì jiǎn chá yǒu méi yǒu dài yào shi.
entries.exampleEnglish: Before I go out, I check that I have my keys.
entries.question: 你多久做一次健康檢查？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duō jiǔ zuò yí cì jiàn kāng jiǎn chá?
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you have a health check-up?
entries.answer: 我每年做一次健康檢查。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ měi nián zuò yí cì jiàn kāng jiǎn chá.
entries.answerEnglish: I have a check-up once a year.

entries.example: 我等一下傳訊息給你。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ děng yí xià chuán xùn xí gěi nǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'll send you a message in a bit.
entries.question: 你每天收到很多訊息嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ měi tiān shōu dào hěn duō xùn xí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you get a lot of messages every day?
entries.answer: 對，我每天收到很多工作訊息。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ měi tiān shōu dào hěn duō gōng zuò xùn xí.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I get lots of work messages every day.

entries.example: 糟糕，我走錯方向了！
entries.examplePinyin: zāo gāo, wǒ zǒu cuò fāng xiàng le!
entries.exampleEnglish: Oh no, I went the wrong way!
entries.question: 你在新的地方常常走錯方向嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài xīn de dì fāng cháng cháng zǒu cuò fāng xiàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often go the wrong way in a new place?
entries.answer: 常常，我的方向感很差。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ de fāng xiàng gǎn hěn chà.
entries.answerEnglish: All the time. I have a terrible sense of direction.

entries.example: 這家店的珍珠奶茶很受歡迎。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn de zhēn zhū nǎi chá hěn shòu huān yíng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop's bubble tea is very popular.
entries.question: 在你的國家，什麼運動最受歡迎？
entries.questionPinyin: zài nǐ de guó jiā, shén me yùn dòng zuì shòu huān yíng?
entries.questionEnglish: In your country, which sport is the most popular?
entries.answer: 在我的國家，足球最受歡迎。
entries.answerPinyin: zài wǒ de guó jiā, zú qiú zuì shòu huān yíng.
entries.answerEnglish: In my country, soccer is the most popular.

entries.example: 他剛剛提到你的名字。
entries.examplePinyin: tā gāng gāng tí dào nǐ de míng zì.
entries.exampleEnglish: He just mentioned your name.
entries.question: 你跟朋友聊天時，常提到工作嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gēn péng yǒu liáo tiān shí, cháng tí dào gōng zuò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you chat with friends, do you often bring up work?
entries.answer: 常提到，因為大家工作都很忙。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng tí dào, yīn wèi dà jiā gōng zuò dōu hěn máng.
entries.answerEnglish: Often, because everyone is busy with work.

entries.example: 我發現錢包不見了！
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ fā xiàn qián bāo bú jiàn le!
entries.exampleEnglish: I just realized my wallet is gone!
entries.question: 來台灣以後，你發現了什麼有趣的事？
entries.questionPinyin: lái tái wān yǐ hòu, nǐ fā xiàn le shén me yǒu qù de shì?
entries.questionEnglish: Since coming to Taiwan, what interesting things have you discovered?
entries.answer: 我發現台灣人很喜歡排隊。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ fā xiàn tái wān rén hěn xǐ huan pái duì.
entries.answerEnglish: I've found that Taiwanese people love lining up.

entries.example: 把外套掛在門後面吧。
entries.examplePinyin: bǎ wài tào guà zài mén hòu miàn ba.
entries.exampleEnglish: Hang your coat on the back of the door.
entries.question: 你房間的牆上掛了什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ fáng jiān de qiáng shàng guà le shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's hanging on the wall of your room?
entries.answer: 我掛了一張世界地圖。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ guà le yì zhāng shì jiè dì tú.
entries.answerEnglish: I've hung up a map of the world.

entries.example: 照顧小孩是父母的責任。
entries.examplePinyin: zhào gù xiǎo hái shì fù mǔ de zé rèn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Looking after children is the parents' responsibility.
entries.question: 你在工作上有什麼責任？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài gōng zuò shàng yǒu shén me zé rèn?
entries.questionEnglish: What are your responsibilities at work?
entries.answer: 我的責任是照顧好客人。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de zé rèn shì zhào gù hǎo kè rén.
entries.answerEnglish: My responsibility is to take good care of the customers.

entries.example: 我寫了一張生日卡片給她。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xiě le yì zhāng shēng rì kǎ piàn gěi tā.
entries.exampleEnglish: I wrote her a birthday card.
entries.question: 你上次寫卡片給誰？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shàng cì xiě kǎ piàn gěi shéi?
entries.questionEnglish: Who did you last write a card to?
entries.answer: 我上次寫卡片給我媽媽。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ shàng cì xiě kǎ piàn gěi wǒ mā ma.
entries.answerEnglish: The last time I wrote a card, it was to my mom.

entries.example: 我很喜歡逛傳統市場。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hěn xǐ huan guàng chuán tǒng shì chǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I love wandering around traditional markets.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃台灣的傳統小吃嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī tái wān de chuán tǒng xiǎo chī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like traditional Taiwanese snacks?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我最愛傳統的豆花。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ zuì ài chuán tǒng de dòu huā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love traditional tofu pudding most.

entries.example: 她對我微笑。
entries.examplePinyin: tā duì wǒ wéi xiào.
entries.exampleEnglish: She smiled at me.
entries.question: 你拍照的時候喜歡微笑嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pāi zhào de shí hòu xǐ huan wéi xiào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like to smile in photos?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我拍照都會微笑。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ pāi zhào dōu huì wéi xiào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always smile in photos.

entries.example: 週末這家店的顧客很多。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōu mò zhè jiā diàn de gù kè hěn duō.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop has lots of customers at the weekend.
entries.question: 你是哪家店的老顧客？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shì nǎ jiā diàn de lǎo gù kè?
entries.questionEnglish: Which shop are you a regular customer of?
entries.answer: 我是公司樓下咖啡店的老顧客。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ shì gōng sī lóu xià kā fēi diàn de lǎo gù kè.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm a regular at the café downstairs from my office.

entries.example: 我以為今天是星期五。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ yǐ wéi jīn tiān shì xīng qí wǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: I thought today was Friday.
entries.question: 來台灣以前，你以為台灣是什麼樣子？
entries.questionPinyin: lái tái wān yǐ qián, nǐ yǐ wéi tái wān shì shén me yàng zi?
entries.questionEnglish: Before you came to Taiwan, what did you think it was like?
entries.answer: 我以為台灣很小，其實山很多。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yǐ wéi tái wān hěn xiǎo, qí shí shān hěn duō.
entries.answerEnglish: I thought Taiwan was tiny, but actually it has lots of mountains.

entries.example: 下班後我們去酒吧喝一杯吧。
entries.examplePinyin: xià bān hòu wǒ men qù jiǔ bā hē yì bēi ba.
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's go to a bar for a drink after work.
entries.question: 你常去酒吧嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng qù jiǔ bā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often go to bars?
entries.answer: 不常，我一個月去一次酒吧。
entries.answerPinyin: bù cháng, wǒ yí gè yuè qù yí cì jiǔ bā.
entries.answerEnglish: Not often. I go to a bar about once a month.

entries.example: 檢查結果都很正常。
entries.examplePinyin: jiǎn chá jié guǒ dōu hěn zhèng cháng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The test results are all normal.
entries.question: 你覺得每天工作十個小時正常嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de měi tiān gōng zuò shí gè xiǎo shí zhèng cháng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think working ten hours a day is normal?
entries.answer: 不正常，這樣太累了。
entries.answerPinyin: bú zhèng cháng, zhè yàng tài lèi le.
entries.answerEnglish: It's not normal. That's too exhausting.

entries.example: 好久不見，你還認得我嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: hǎo jiǔ bú jiàn, nǐ hái rèn de wǒ ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: Long time no see. Do you still recognize me?
entries.question: 你現在認得多少個中文字？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiàn zài rèn de duō shǎo gè zhōng wén zì?
entries.questionEnglish: How many Chinese characters can you recognize now?
entries.answer: 我大概認得五百個中文字。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dà gài rèn de wǔ bǎi gè zhōng wén zì.
entries.answerEnglish: I can recognize about five hundred characters.

entries.example: 我們公司有五十位員工。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men gōng sī yǒu wǔ shí wèi yuán gōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Our company has fifty employees.
entries.question: 你的公司有多少員工？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng sī yǒu duō shǎo yuán gōng?
entries.questionEnglish: How many employees does your company have?
entries.answer: 我們公司大概有兩百位員工。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men gōng sī dà gài yǒu liǎng bǎi wèi yuán gōng.
entries.answerEnglish: Our company has about two hundred employees.

entries.example: 泰國人很尊敬他們的國王。
entries.examplePinyin: tài guó rén hěn zūn jìng tā men de guó wáng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Thai people have great respect for their king.
entries.question: 你的國家有國王嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā yǒu guó wáng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your country have a king?
entries.answer: 沒有，我們國家沒有國王。
entries.answerPinyin: méi yǒu, wǒ men guó jiā méi yǒu guó wáng.
entries.answerEnglish: No, my country doesn't have a king.

entries.example: 接下來我們去吃晚餐吧。
entries.examplePinyin: jiē xià lái wǒ men qù chī wǎn cān ba.
entries.exampleEnglish: Next, let's go and have dinner.
entries.question: 今天接下來你要做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: jīn tiān jiē xià lái nǐ yào zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What are you doing next today?
entries.answer: 接下來我要去健身房。
entries.answerPinyin: jiē xià lái wǒ yào qù jiàn shēn fáng.
entries.answerEnglish: Next I'm going to the gym.

entries.example: 你有注意到他剪頭髮了嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: nǐ yǒu zhù yì dào tā jiǎn tóu fǎ le ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: Did you notice he got a haircut?
entries.question: 來台灣後，你注意到什麼不一樣的地方？
entries.questionPinyin: lái tái wān hòu, nǐ zhù yì dào shén me bù yí yàng de dì fāng?
entries.questionEnglish: Since coming to Taiwan, what differences have you noticed?
entries.answer: 我注意到這裡騎機車的人很多。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhù yì dào zhè lǐ qí jī chē de rén hěn duō.
entries.answerEnglish: I've noticed that lots of people here ride scooters.

entries.example: 他在海邊撿了一顆石頭。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài hǎi biān jiǎn le yì kē shí tou.
entries.exampleEnglish: He picked up a stone on the beach.
entries.question: 你旅行時會撿石頭當紀念嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ lǚ xíng shí huì jiǎn shí tou dàng jì niàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you pick up stones as souvenirs when you travel?
entries.answer: 會，我撿過花蓮海邊的石頭。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ jiǎn guò huā lián hǎi biān de shí tou.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've picked up stones from the beach in Hualien.

entries.example: 我的肩膀好痠。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de jiān bǎng hǎo suān.
entries.exampleEnglish: My shoulders are so stiff.
entries.question: 你工作久了，肩膀會痠嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gōng zuò jiǔ le, jiān bǎng huì suān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do your shoulders get stiff after working a long time?
entries.answer: 會，我的肩膀常常很痠。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ de jiān bǎng cháng cháng hěn suān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my shoulders are often stiff.

entries.example: 日月潭的風景很美麗。
entries.examplePinyin: rì yuè tán de fēng jǐng hěn měi lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: The scenery at Sun Moon Lake is beautiful.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣哪裡的風景最美麗？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān nǎ lǐ de fēng jǐng zuì měi lì?
entries.questionEnglish: Where in Taiwan do you think has the most beautiful scenery?
entries.answer: 我覺得太魯閣的風景最美麗。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de tài lǔ gé de fēng jǐng zuì měi lì.
entries.answerEnglish: I think Taroko has the most beautiful scenery.

entries.example: 我立刻打電話給他。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ lì kè dǎ diàn huà gěi tā.
entries.exampleEnglish: I called him right away.
entries.question: 你下班回家會立刻洗澡嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xià bān huí jiā huì lì kè xǐ zǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you shower right away when you get home from work?
entries.answer: 會，我一回家就立刻洗澡。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ yì huí jiā jiù lì kè xǐ zǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I shower as soon as I get home.

entries.example: 我切菜的時候切到手指了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ qiē cài de shí hòu qiē dào shǒu zhǐ le.
entries.exampleEnglish: I cut my finger while chopping vegetables.
entries.question: 你玩手機玩太久，手指會痠嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ wán shǒu jī wán tài jiǔ, shǒu zhǐ huì suān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do your fingers get sore when you use your phone too long?
entries.answer: 會，我的手指有時候會痠。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ de shǒu zhǐ yǒu shí hòu huì suān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my fingers get sore sometimes.

entries.example: 這隻狗的主人在哪裡？
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhī gǒu de zhǔ rén zài nǎ lǐ?
entries.exampleEnglish: Where's this dog's owner?
entries.question: 你去朋友家，會帶禮物給主人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù péng yǒu jiā, huì dài lǐ wù gěi zhǔ rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you visit a friend's home, do you bring the host a gift?
entries.answer: 會，我常帶水果給主人。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng dài shuǐ guǒ gěi zhǔ rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often bring the host some fruit.

entries.example: 我哥哥是律師。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ gē ge shì lǜ shī.
entries.exampleEnglish: My older brother is a lawyer.
entries.question: 你覺得當律師好嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de dāng lǜ shī hǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think being a lawyer is a good job?
entries.answer: 我覺得當律師很累，但是薪水高。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de dāng lǜ shī hěn lèi, dàn shì xīn shuǐ gāo.
entries.answerEnglish: I think being a lawyer is tiring, but the pay is good.

entries.example: 我對這件事有不同的看法。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ duì zhè jiàn shì yǒu bù tóng de kàn fǎ.
entries.exampleEnglish: I see this differently.
entries.question: 你對台灣的交通有什麼看法？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì tái wān de jiāo tōng yǒu shén me kàn fǎ?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your view of the traffic in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我的看法是機車太多了。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de kàn fǎ shì jī chē tài duō le.
entries.answerEnglish: My view is that there are too many scooters.

entries.example: 有困難就跟我說。
entries.examplePinyin: yǒu kùn nán jiù gēn wǒ shuō.
entries.exampleEnglish: If you run into any difficulty, just tell me.
entries.question: 你在台灣生活有什麼困難？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān shēng huó yǒu shén me kùn nán?
entries.questionEnglish: What difficulties do you have living in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 最大的困難是看不懂中文字。
entries.answerPinyin: zuì dà de kùn nán shì kàn bù dǒng zhōng wén zì.
entries.answerEnglish: The biggest difficulty is not being able to read Chinese.

entries.example: 轉角有一家便利商店。
entries.examplePinyin: zhuǎn jiǎo yǒu yì jiā biàn lì shāng diàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a convenience store on the corner.
entries.question: 你家附近的轉角有什麼店？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn de zhuǎn jiǎo yǒu shén me diàn?
entries.questionEnglish: What shop is on the corner near your home?
entries.answer: 我家轉角有一家早餐店。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā zhuǎn jiǎo yǒu yì jiā zǎo cān diàn.
entries.answerEnglish: There's a breakfast shop on the corner by my place.

entries.example: 台灣夏天太陽很大，皮膚容易曬黑。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān xià tiān tài yáng hěn dà, pí fū róng yì shài hēi.
entries.exampleEnglish: The summer sun in Taiwan is strong, so your skin tans easily.
entries.question: 你的皮膚怕曬太陽嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de pí fū pà shài tài yáng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your skin sensitive to the sun?
entries.answer: 很怕，我的皮膚很容易曬傷。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn pà, wǒ de pí fū hěn róng yì shài shāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Very. My skin burns easily.

entries.example: 奶奶在院子裡種菜。
entries.examplePinyin: nǎi nai zài yuàn zi lǐ zhòng cài.
entries.exampleEnglish: Grandma grows vegetables in the yard.
entries.question: 你小時候家裡有院子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu jiā lǐ yǒu yuàn zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did your home have a yard when you were a kid?
entries.answer: 有，我家的院子很大。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiā de yuàn zi hěn dà.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our yard was very big.

entries.example: 我在便利商店買了一本雜誌。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài biàn lì shāng diàn mǎi le yì běn zá zhì.
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a magazine at the convenience store.
entries.question: 你還會買雜誌嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ hái huì mǎi zá zhì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you still buy magazines?
entries.answer: 很少，我現在都看電子雜誌。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn shǎo, wǒ xiàn zài dōu kàn diàn zǐ zá zhì.
entries.answerEnglish: Rarely. These days I read digital magazines.

entries.english: be responsible for; in charge of
entries.example: 我負責公司的網站。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ fù zé gōng sī de wǎng zhàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm in charge of the company website.
entries.question: 你在公司負責什麼工作？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài gōng sī fù zé shén me gōng zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: What are you responsible for at your company?
entries.answer: 我負責行銷的工作。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ fù zé xíng xiāo de gōng zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm responsible for marketing.

entries.example: 台灣是一座島。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān shì yí zuò dǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan is an island.
entries.question: 你去過台灣附近的哪些島？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò tái wān fù jìn de nǎ xiē dǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: Which islands around Taiwan have you been to?
entries.answer: 我去過綠島和蘭嶼。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qù guò lǜ dǎo hé lán yǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: I've been to Green Island and Orchid Island.

entries.example: 請不要碰展覽的作品。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng bú yào pèng zhǎn lǎn de zuò pǐn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please don't touch the works on display.
entries.question: 你在路上碰過老朋友嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài lù shang pèng guò lǎo péng yǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever run into an old friend on the street?
entries.answer: 碰過，我在捷運上碰到大學同學。
entries.answerPinyin: pèng guò, wǒ zài jié yùn shàng pèng dào dà xué tóng xué.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I ran into a university classmate on the MRT.

entries.example: 我的襪子破了一個洞。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de wà zi pò le yí gè dòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: My sock has a hole in it.
entries.question: 你的衣服破洞了會怎麼辦？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de yī fu pò dòng le huì zěn me bàn?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when your clothes get a hole?
entries.answer: 衣服破洞我就買新的。
entries.answerPinyin: yī fu pò dòng wǒ jiù mǎi xīn de.
entries.answerEnglish: If my clothes get a hole, I just buy new ones.

entries.example: 我姊姊是一位科學家。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ jiě jie shì yí wèi kē xué jiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: My older sister is a scientist.
entries.question: 你小時候想當科學家嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu xiǎng dāng kē xué jiā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you want to be a scientist when you were little?
entries.answer: 想啊，我小時候想當科學家。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng a, wǒ xiǎo shí hòu xiǎng dāng kē xué jiā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I wanted to be a scientist as a kid.

entries.example: 她買了一雙金色的鞋子。
entries.examplePinyin: tā mǎi le yì shuāng jīn sè de xié zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: She bought a pair of gold shoes.
entries.question: 你喜歡金色的東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan jīn sè de dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like gold-colored things?
entries.answer: 不太喜歡，金色太亮了。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài xǐ huan, jīn sè tài liàng le.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. Gold is too flashy.

entries.example: 我喜歡自己住，比較自由。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xǐ huan zì jǐ zhù, bǐ jiào zì yóu.
entries.exampleEnglish: I like living alone; I have more freedom.
entries.question: 你覺得在台灣生活自由嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zài tái wān shēng huó zì yóu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you feel free living in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 很自由，我想做什麼都可以。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn zì yóu, wǒ xiǎng zuò shén me dōu kě yǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Very free. I can do whatever I want.

entries.example: 我在收集便利商店的點數。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài shōu jí biàn lì shāng diàn de diǎn shù.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm collecting convenience store points.
entries.question: 你有收集什麼東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu shōu jí shén me dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you collect anything?
entries.answer: 我喜歡收集明信片。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan shōu jí míng xìn piàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I like collecting postcards.

entries.example: 我的華語考試分數不錯。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de huá yǔ kǎo shì fēn shù bú cuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: I got a pretty good score on my Chinese test.
entries.question: 你上次中文考試的分數怎麼樣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shàng cì zhōng wén kǎo shì de fēn shù zěn me yàng?
entries.questionEnglish: How did you score on your last Chinese test?
entries.answer: 還不錯，分數比上次高。
entries.answerPinyin: hái bú cuò, fēn shù bǐ shàng cì gāo.
entries.answerEnglish: Not bad. My score was higher than last time.

entries.example: 看到這張照片，我想起了媽媽。
entries.examplePinyin: kàn dào zhè zhāng zhào piàn, wǒ xiǎng qǐ le mā ma.
entries.exampleEnglish: Seeing this photo, I thought of my mom.
entries.question: 什麼食物會讓你想起家鄉？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shí wù huì ràng nǐ xiǎng qǐ jiā xiāng?
entries.questionEnglish: What food reminds you of home?
entries.answer: 吃起司會讓我想起家鄉。
entries.answerPinyin: chī qǐ sī huì ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ jiā xiāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Eating cheese reminds me of home.

entries.example: 我完全聽不懂台語。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ wán quán tīng bù dǒng tái yǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: I can't understand Taiwanese at all.
entries.question: 你聽得懂台語嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tīng de dǒng tái yǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you understand Taiwanese?
entries.answer: 完全聽不懂，太難了。
entries.answerPinyin: wán quán tīng bù dǒng, tài nán le.
entries.answerEnglish: Not at all. It's too hard.

entries.example: 這樣分很公平。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè yàng fēn hěn gōng píng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Splitting it this way is fair.
entries.question: 你覺得你的薪水公平嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ de xīn shuǐ gōng píng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your salary is fair?
entries.answer: 我覺得還算公平。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de hái suàn gōng píng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think it's reasonably fair.

entries.example: 高鐵的速度很快。
entries.examplePinyin: gāo tiě de sù dù hěn kuài.
entries.exampleEnglish: The high-speed rail is very fast.
entries.question: 你打中文字的速度快嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dǎ zhōng wén zì de sù dù kuài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you fast at typing Chinese?
entries.answer: 不快，我打字的速度很慢。
entries.answerPinyin: bú kuài, wǒ dǎ zì de sù dù hěn màn.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I type slowly.

entries.example: 這個假期我想去花蓮。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge jià qí wǒ xiǎng qù huā lián.
entries.exampleEnglish: I want to go to Hualien this holiday.
entries.question: 你下一個假期想去哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xià yí gè jià qí xiǎng qù nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you want to go on your next holiday?
entries.answer: 我下一個假期想去日本。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xià yí gè jià qí xiǎng qù rì běn.
entries.answerEnglish: On my next holiday I want to go to Japan.

entries.example: 到了台北再聯絡我。
entries.examplePinyin: dào le tái běi zài lián luò wǒ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Get in touch when you get to Taipei.
entries.question: 你常跟家人聯絡嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng gēn jiā rén lián luò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you keep in touch with your family often?
entries.answer: 常常，我每天都跟媽媽聯絡。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ měi tiān dōu gēn mā ma lián luò.
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I talk to my mom every day.

entries.example: 巷子裡有一家小餐館。
entries.examplePinyin: xiàng zi lǐ yǒu yì jiā xiǎo cān guǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a small restaurant in the alley.
entries.question: 你家附近有好吃的餐館嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn yǒu hǎo chī de cān guǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there any good restaurants near your home?
entries.answer: 有，有一家越南餐館很好吃。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, yǒu yì jiā yuè nán cān guǎn hěn hǎo chī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a really good Vietnamese restaurant.

entries.example: 我每天早上餵貓。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng wèi māo.
entries.exampleEnglish: I feed the cat every morning.
entries.question: 你家的寵物都是誰在餵？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de chǒng wù dōu shì shéi zài wèi?
entries.questionEnglish: Who feeds your pet?
entries.answer: 都是我在餵，一天餵兩次。
entries.answerPinyin: dōu shì wǒ zài wèi, yì tiān wèi liǎng cì.
entries.answerEnglish: I do. I feed it twice a day.

entries.example: 你的中文進步很多！
entries.examplePinyin: nǐ de zhōng wén jìn bù hěn duō!
entries.exampleEnglish: Your Chinese has improved a lot!
entries.question: 你覺得你的中文有進步嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ de zhōng wén yǒu jìn bù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your Chinese has improved?
entries.answer: 有，我的聽力進步了很多。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de tīng lì jìn bù le hěn duō.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my listening has improved a lot.

entries.example: 夏天我整天開電風扇。
entries.examplePinyin: xià tiān wǒ zhěng tiān kāi diàn fēng shàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: In summer I keep the fan on all day.
entries.question: 你家用冷氣還是電風扇？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yòng lěng qì hái shì diàn fēng shàn?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use air-conditioning or a fan at home?
entries.answer: 我比較常用電風扇，比較省錢。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào cháng yòng diàn fēng shàn, bǐ jiào shěng qián.
entries.answerEnglish: I use the fan more; it saves money.

entries.example: 他的腳受了傷。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de jiǎo shòu le shāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: He hurt his foot.
entries.question: 運動的時候，怎麼做才不會受傷？
entries.questionPinyin: yùn dòng de shí hòu, zěn me zuò cái bú huì shòu shāng?
entries.questionEnglish: How can you avoid getting hurt when you exercise?
entries.answer: 運動前先暖身，就比較不會受傷。
entries.answerPinyin: yùn dòng qián xiān nuǎn shēn, jiù bǐ jiào bú huì shòu shāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Warm up before you exercise and you're less likely to get hurt.

entries.example: 夜市很多攤位只收現金。
entries.examplePinyin: yè shì hěn duō tān wèi zhǐ shōu xiàn jīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Many night market stalls only take cash.
entries.question: 你身上常帶現金嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēn shàng cháng dài xiàn jīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you usually carry cash?
entries.answer: 常帶，去夜市要用現金。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng dài, qù yè shì yào yòng xiàn jīn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I need cash for the night market.

entries.example: 週末我們去博物館看展覽。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōu mò wǒ men qù bó wù guǎn kàn zhǎn lǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: At the weekend we went to the museum to see an exhibition.
entries.question: 你喜歡去博物館嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan qù bó wù guǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like going to museums?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常去台北的博物館。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ cháng qù tái běi de bó wù guǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often go to museums in Taipei.

entries.example: 他這個月賺了很多錢。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zhè ge yuè zhuàn le hěn duō qián.
entries.exampleEnglish: He made a lot of money this month.
entries.question: 你覺得在台灣容易賺錢嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zài tái wān róng yì zhuàn qián ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think it's easy to make money in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 不太容易，賺錢很辛苦。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài róng yì, zhuàn qián hěn xīn kǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. Earning money is hard work.

entries.example: 這個問題很複雜。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge wèn tí hěn fù zá.
entries.exampleEnglish: This problem is complicated.
entries.question: 你覺得中文的語法複雜嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zhōng wén de yǔ fǎ fù zá ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Chinese grammar is complicated?
entries.answer: 不太複雜，但是聲調很難。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài fù zá, dàn shì shēng diào hěn nán.
entries.answerEnglish: Not very complicated, but the tones are hard.

entries.example: 一天學會中文是不可能的。
entries.examplePinyin: yì tiān xué huì zhōng wén shì bù kě néng de.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's impossible to learn Chinese in one day.
entries.question: 你覺得一年學好中文可能嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de yì nián xué hǎo zhōng wén kě néng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you can master Chinese in a year?
entries.answer: 不可能，至少要三年吧。
entries.answerPinyin: bù kě néng, zhì shǎo yào sān nián ba.
entries.answerEnglish: Impossible. It takes at least three years.

entries.example: 天氣越來越熱了。
entries.examplePinyin: tiān qì yuè lái yuè rè le.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's getting hotter and hotter.
entries.question: 你的中文越來越好了嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de zhōng wén yuè lái yuè hǎo le ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your Chinese getting better and better?
entries.answer: 對，我的中文越來越好了。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ de zhōng wén yuè lái yuè hǎo le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my Chinese is getting better and better.

entries.example: 她邀請我去她家吃飯。
entries.examplePinyin: tā yāo qǐng wǒ qù tā jiā chī fàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: She invited me to dinner at her place.
entries.question: 你最近有邀請朋友來家裡嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn yǒu yāo qǐng péng yǒu lái jiā lǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you invited friends over recently?
entries.answer: 有，上週我邀請同事來吃飯。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, shàng zhōu wǒ yāo qǐng tóng shì lái chī fàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, last week I invited coworkers over for dinner.

entries.example: 我們騎腳踏車過橋。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men qí jiǎo tà chē guò qiáo.
entries.exampleEnglish: We rode our bikes across the bridge.
entries.question: 你家附近有橋嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn yǒu qiáo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a bridge near your home?
entries.answer: 有，我家旁邊有一座橋。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiā páng biān yǒu yí zuò qiáo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a bridge next to my home.

entries.example: 衣服還沒乾。
entries.examplePinyin: yī fu hái méi gān.
entries.exampleEnglish: The clothes aren't dry yet.
entries.question: 冬天你的皮膚會很乾嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: dōng tiān nǐ de pí fū huì hěn gān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your skin get dry in winter?
entries.answer: 會，冬天我的皮膚很乾。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, dōng tiān wǒ de pí fū hěn gān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my skin gets very dry in winter.

entries.example: 請提醒我明天帶雨傘。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng tí xǐng wǒ míng tiān dài yǔ sǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please remind me to bring an umbrella tomorrow.
entries.question: 你都用什麼提醒自己做事？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dōu yòng shén me tí xǐng zì jǐ zuò shì?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you use to remind yourself of things?
entries.answer: 我都用手機提醒自己。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dōu yòng shǒu jī tí xǐng zì jǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I use my phone to remind myself.

entries.example: 他今天穿西裝去面試。
entries.examplePinyin: tā jīn tiān chuān xī zhuāng qù miàn shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: He wore a suit to his interview today.
entries.question: 你上班要穿西裝嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shàng bān yào chuān xī zhuāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have to wear a suit to work?
entries.answer: 不用，我上班不穿西裝。
entries.answerPinyin: bú yòng, wǒ shàng bān bù chuān xī zhuāng.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't wear a suit to work.

entries.example: 請把瓶子丟進回收桶。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng bǎ píng zi diū jìn huí shōu tǒng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please put the bottle in the recycling bin.
entries.question: 你喝完水會回收瓶子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ hē wán shuǐ huì huí shōu píng zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you recycle bottles after you finish drinking?
entries.answer: 會，我都把瓶子拿去回收。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōu bǎ píng zi ná qù huí shōu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always recycle the bottles.

entries.example: 你的發音很正確。
entries.examplePinyin: nǐ de fā yīn hěn zhèng què.
entries.exampleEnglish: Your pronunciation is very accurate.
entries.question: 你覺得你的聲調正確嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ de shēng diào zhèng què ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your tones are correct?
entries.answer: 不太正確，我常說錯。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài zhèng què, wǒ cháng shuō cuò.
entries.answerEnglish: Not very. I often get them wrong.

entries.example: 我們的導遊很會說故事。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men de dǎo yóu hěn huì shuō gù shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Our tour guide is great at telling stories.
entries.question: 你想在台灣當導遊嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng zài tái wān dāng dǎo yóu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to be a tour guide in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 想，我想當英文導遊。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, wǒ xiǎng dāng yīng wén dǎo yóu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to be an English-speaking guide.

entries.example: 捷運站的入口在對面。
entries.examplePinyin: jié yùn zhàn de rù kǒu zài duì miàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The MRT station entrance is across the street.
entries.question: 你家大樓的入口在哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā dà lóu de rù kǒu zài nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where's the entrance to your building?
entries.answer: 入口在便利商店旁邊。
entries.answerPinyin: rù kǒu zài biàn lì shāng diàn páng biān.
entries.answerEnglish: The entrance is next to the convenience store.

entries.example: 不要浪費食物。
entries.examplePinyin: bú yào làng fèi shí wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: Don't waste food.
entries.question: 你覺得滑手機是浪費時間嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de huá shǒu jī shì làng fèi shí jiān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think scrolling on your phone is a waste of time?
entries.answer: 有時候是，我常浪費很多時間。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu shì, wǒ cháng làng fèi hěn duō shí jiān.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. I often waste a lot of time.

entries.example: 我睡前喜歡看小說。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ shuì qián xǐ huan kàn xiǎo shuō.
entries.exampleEnglish: I like reading novels before bed.
entries.question: 你最近在看什麼小說？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn zài kàn shén me xiǎo shuō?
entries.questionEnglish: What novel are you reading lately?
entries.answer: 我在看一本推理小說。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài kàn yì běn tuī lǐ xiǎo shuō.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm reading a mystery novel.

entries.example: 我平常七點起床。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ píng cháng qī diǎn qǐ chuáng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I usually get up at seven.
entries.question: 你平常週末做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ píng cháng zhōu mò zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you usually do at the weekend?
entries.answer: 我平常週末去爬山。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ píng cháng zhōu mò qù pá shān.
entries.answerEnglish: I usually go hiking at the weekend.

entries.example: 這瓶可樂沒氣了，不好喝。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè píng kě lè méi qì le, bù hǎo hē.
entries.exampleEnglish: This bottle of cola has gone flat. It doesn't taste good.
entries.question: 你的腳踏車輪胎沒氣過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de jiǎo tà chē lún tāi méi qì guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has your bike ever had a flat tyre?
entries.answer: 有，上個星期我的輪胎沒氣了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, shàng gè xīng qí wǒ de lún tāi méi qì le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my tyre went flat last week.

entries.english: a large stretch; a big patch; a vast expanse
entries.example: 山上有一大片茶園。
entries.examplePinyin: shān shàng yǒu yí dà piàn chá yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a large stretch of tea fields on the mountain.
entries.question: 你家附近有一大片草地嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn yǒu yí dà piàn cǎo dì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a big area of grass near your home?
entries.answer: 有，河邊有一大片草地。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, hé biān yǒu yí dà piàn cǎo dì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a big stretch of grass by the river.

entries.example: 糟糕，我忘了帶鑰匙！
entries.examplePinyin: zāo gāo, wǒ wàng le dài yào shi!
entries.exampleEnglish: Oh no, I forgot my keys!
entries.question: 你遇過最糟糕的天氣是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yù guò zuì zāo gāo de tiān qì shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the worst weather you've ever had?
entries.answer: 最糟糕的是颱風天，又風又雨。
entries.answerPinyin: zuì zāo gāo de shì tái fēng tiān, yòu fēng yòu yǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: The worst was a typhoon day, with wind and rain.

entries.example: 老闆要求我們準時上班。
entries.examplePinyin: lǎo bǎn yāo qiú wǒ men zhǔn shí shàng bān.
entries.exampleEnglish: The boss requires us to be on time for work.
entries.question: 你的老闆對你要求很高嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de lǎo bǎn duì nǐ yāo qiú hěn gāo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your boss expect a lot of you?
entries.answer: 還好，他對我的要求不高。
entries.answerPinyin: hái hǎo, tā duì wǒ de yāo qiú bù gāo.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. He doesn't demand too much of me.

entries.example: 我每個星期都去踢足球。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi gè xīng qí dōu qù tī zú qiú.
entries.exampleEnglish: I go and play football every week.
entries.question: 你喜歡踢足球嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan tī zú qiú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like playing football?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我週末常常去踢足球。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ zhōu mò cháng cháng qù tī zú qiú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often play football on weekends.

entries.example: 這是我們兩個的秘密。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shì wǒ men liǎng gè de mì mì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a secret between the two of us.
entries.question: 你會跟好朋友說秘密嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì gēn hǎo péng yǒu shuō mì mì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you tell secrets to your good friends?
entries.answer: 會，我什麼秘密都跟她說。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ shén me mì mì dōu gēn tā shuō.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I tell her all my secrets.

entries.example: 台北下雪？不太可能。
entries.examplePinyin: tái běi xià xuě? bú tài kě néng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Snow in Taipei? Unlikely.
entries.question: 你今年會搬去別的城市嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jīn nián huì bān qù bié de chéng shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Will you move to another city this year?
entries.answer: 不太可能，我很喜歡現在住的地方。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài kě néng, wǒ hěn xǐ huan xiàn zài zhù de dì fāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Unlikely. I really like where I live now.

entries.example: 他的感冒很嚴重。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de gǎn mào hěn yán zhòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: His cold is very bad.
entries.question: 你住的地方塞車嚴重嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhù de dì fāng sāi chē yán zhòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is traffic bad where you live?
entries.answer: 很嚴重，上下班時間都塞車。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn yán zhòng, shàng xià bān shí jiān dōu sāi chē.
entries.answerEnglish: Very bad. There are traffic jams at rush hour.

entries.example: 很多阿姨晚上在廣場跳舞。
entries.examplePinyin: hěn duō ā yí wǎn shàng zài guǎng chǎng tiào wǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Lots of older ladies dance in the square in the evening.
entries.question: 你家附近有廣場嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn yǒu guǎng chǎng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a square near your home?
entries.answer: 有，捷運站前面有一個廣場。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, jié yùn zhàn qián miàn yǒu yí gè guǎng chǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a square in front of the MRT station.

entries.example: 她是電視台的記者。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì diàn shì tái de jì zhě.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's a TV reporter.
entries.question: 你想當記者嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng dāng jì zhě ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to be a journalist?
entries.answer: 不想，記者的工作太累了。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xiǎng, jì zhě de gōng zuò tài lèi le.
entries.answerEnglish: No, a journalist's job is too tiring.

entries.example: 我要去超商列印文件。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ yào qù chāo shāng liè yìn wén jiàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm going to the convenience store to print some documents.
entries.question: 你常在便利商店列印東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng zài biàn lì shāng diàn liè yìn dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often print things at convenience stores?
entries.answer: 常常，我都去超商列印資料。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ dōu qù chāo shāng liè yìn zī liào.
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I always print documents at the convenience store.

entries.example: 吃不完可以打包嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: chī bù wán kě yǐ dǎ bāo ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: Can we take the leftovers to go?
entries.question: 你出國前什麼時候打包行李？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chū guó qián shén me shí hòu dǎ bāo xíng li?
entries.questionEnglish: When do you pack your luggage before a trip abroad?
entries.answer: 我都前一天晚上才打包。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dōu qián yì tiān wǎn shàng cái dǎ bāo.
entries.answerEnglish: I always pack the night before.

entries.example: 廚房裡都是煙，快開窗！
entries.examplePinyin: chú fáng lǐ dōu shì yān, kuài kāi chuāng!
entries.exampleEnglish: The kitchen is full of smoke. Open the window, quick!
entries.question: 你中秋節烤肉的時候怕煙嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhōng qiū jié kǎo ròu de shí hòu pà yān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you barbecue at Moon Festival, does the smoke bother you?
entries.answer: 不怕，可是煙太大我會咳嗽。
entries.answerPinyin: bú pà, kě shì yān tài dà wǒ huì ké sou.
entries.answerEnglish: No, but if there's too much smoke I cough.

entries.example: 高鐵是很快速的交通工具。
entries.examplePinyin: gāo tiě shì hěn kuài sù de jiāo tōng gōng jù.
entries.exampleEnglish: The high-speed rail is a very fast way to travel.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的網路快速嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān de wǎng lù kuài sù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think the internet in Taiwan is fast?
entries.answer: 很快速，在家看影片都不會卡。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn kuài sù, zài jiā kàn yǐng piàn dōu bú huì kǎ.
entries.answerEnglish: Very fast. Videos never lag at home.

entries.example: 前面發生車禍了。
entries.examplePinyin: qián miàn fā shēng chē huò le.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's been a car accident up ahead.
entries.question: 怎麼做可以減少車禍？
entries.questionPinyin: zěn me zuò kě yǐ jiǎn shǎo chē huò?
entries.questionEnglish: What can be done to reduce traffic accidents?
entries.answer: 大家開車慢一點，車禍就會變少。
entries.answerPinyin: dà jiā kāi chē màn yì diǎn, chē huò jiù huì biàn shǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: If everyone drives a bit more slowly, there will be fewer accidents.

entries.example: 我經常在超商買午餐。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ jīng cháng zài chāo shāng mǎi wǔ cān.
entries.exampleEnglish: I often buy lunch at the convenience store.
entries.question: 你經常運動嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jīng cháng yùn dòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you exercise often?
entries.answer: 對，我經常去公園跑步。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ jīng cháng qù gōng yuán pǎo bù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often go running in the park.

entries.example: 這是最新的手機。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shì zuì xīn de shǒu jī.
entries.exampleEnglish: This is the latest phone.
entries.question: 你用的是最新的手機嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yòng de shì zuì xīn de shǒu jī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your phone the latest model?
entries.answer: 不是，我的手機不是最新的。
entries.answerPinyin: bú shì, wǒ de shǒu jī bú shì zuì xīn de.
entries.answerEnglish: No, my phone isn't the latest one.

entries.example: 我對台灣歷史很感興趣。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ duì tái wān lì shǐ hěn gǎn xìng qù.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm very interested in Taiwanese history.
entries.question: 你對什麼最感興趣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì shén me zuì gǎn xìng qù?
entries.questionEnglish: What are you most interested in?
entries.answer: 我對台灣的美食最感興趣。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ duì tái wān de měi shí zuì gǎn xìng qù.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm most interested in Taiwanese food.

entries.example: 天好黑，看來快下雨了。
entries.examplePinyin: tiān hǎo hēi, kàn lái kuài xià yǔ le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The sky is so dark. Looks like it's going to rain.
entries.question: 這個週末的天氣看來怎麼樣？
entries.questionPinyin: zhè ge zhōu mò de tiān qì kàn lái zěn me yàng?
entries.questionEnglish: What does the weather look like this weekend?
entries.answer: 看來很好，我要去爬山。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn lái hěn hǎo, wǒ yào qù pá shān.
entries.answerEnglish: It looks good, so I'm going hiking.

entries.example: 我們隊今天贏了！
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men duì jīn tiān yíng le!
entries.exampleEnglish: Our team won today!
entries.question: 看比賽時，你支持哪一隊？
entries.questionPinyin: kàn bǐ sài shí, nǐ zhī chí nǎ yí duì?
entries.questionEnglish: When you watch a match, which team do you support?
entries.answer: 我支持台灣隊！
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhī chí tái wān duì!
entries.answerEnglish: I support Team Taiwan!

entries.example: 我每天用中文寫日記。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi tiān yòng zhōng wén xiě rì jì.
entries.exampleEnglish: I write a diary in Chinese every day.
entries.question: 你有寫日記的習慣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu xiě rì jì de xí guàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you keep a diary?
entries.answer: 有，我每天晚上都寫日記。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ měi tiān wǎn shàng dōu xiě rì jì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I write in my diary every night.

entries.example: 他說謊，他根本沒在加班。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shuō huǎng, tā gēn běn méi zài jiā bān.
entries.exampleEnglish: He lied. He wasn't working overtime at all.
entries.question: 你小時候常常說謊嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu cháng cháng shuō huǎng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you often lie when you were a child?
entries.answer: 不常，我小時候很少說謊。
entries.answerPinyin: bù cháng, wǒ xiǎo shí hòu hěn shǎo shuō huǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: Not often. I rarely lied as a child.

entries.example: 我家靠近捷運站。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ jiā kào jìn jié yùn zhàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: My home is close to an MRT station.
entries.question: 你家靠近夜市嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā kào jìn yè shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your home near a night market?
entries.answer: 很靠近，走路五分鐘就到。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn kào jìn, zǒu lù wǔ fēn zhōng jiù dào.
entries.answerEnglish: Very close. It's a five-minute walk.

entries.example: 我到月台時，捷運剛好來了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ dào yuè tái shí, jié yùn gāng hǎo lái le.
entries.exampleEnglish: Just as I got to the platform, the MRT arrived.
entries.question: 你今天出門的時候剛好下雨嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jīn tiān chū mén de shí hòu gāng hǎo xià yǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did it happen to be raining when you went out today?
entries.answer: 對，我出門的時候剛好下雨。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ chū mén de shí hòu gāng hǎo xià yǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, it was raining just when I went out.

entries.example: 我媽媽很關心我。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ mā ma hěn guān xīn wǒ.
entries.exampleEnglish: My mum really cares about me.
entries.question: 你最關心什麼新聞？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì guān xīn shén me xīn wén?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of news do you care about most?
entries.answer: 我最關心天氣的新聞。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì guān xīn tiān qì de xīn wén.
entries.answerEnglish: I care most about weather news.

entries.english: be related to; have to do with; about
entries.example: 我的工作跟電腦有關。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de gōng zuò gēn diàn nǎo yǒu guān.
entries.exampleEnglish: My job has to do with computers.
entries.question: 你的工作跟什麼有關？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng zuò gēn shén me yǒu guān?
entries.questionEnglish: What is your job related to?
entries.answer: 我的工作跟教育有關。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de gōng zuò gēn jiào yù yǒu guān.
entries.answerEnglish: My job is related to education.

entries.example: 我要去移民署申請居留證。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ yào qù yí mín shù shēn qǐng jū liú zhèng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm going to the immigration office to apply for my ARC.
entries.question: 你申請過台灣的居留證嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēn qǐng guò tái wān de jū liú zhèng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you applied for a Taiwan residence permit?
entries.answer: 申請過，申請居留證不太難。
entries.answerPinyin: shēn qǐng guò, shēn qǐng jū liú zhèng bú tài nán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, applying for an ARC isn't too hard.

entries.example: 秘書幫我訂了機票。
entries.examplePinyin: mì shū bāng wǒ dìng le jī piào.
entries.exampleEnglish: The secretary booked my plane ticket.
entries.question: 你的公司有秘書嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng sī yǒu mì shū ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company have a secretary?
entries.answer: 有，我們部門有一位秘書。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men bù mén yǒu yí wèi mì shū.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our department has a secretary.

entries.example: 阿里山上有一大片森林。
entries.examplePinyin: ā lǐ shān shàng yǒu yí dà piàn sēn lín.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a big forest on Alishan.
entries.question: 你喜歡去森林散步嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan qù sēn lín sàn bù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like walking in the forest?
entries.answer: 喜歡，森林裡的空氣很好。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, sēn lín lǐ de kōng qì hěn hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the air in the forest is great.

entries.example: 這套軟體很好用。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tào ruǎn tǐ hěn hǎo yòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This software is really easy to use.
entries.question: 你工作常用什麼軟體？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gōng zuò cháng yòng shén me ruǎn tǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: What software do you often use at work?
entries.answer: 我常用設計軟體。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cháng yòng shè jì ruǎn tǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I often use design software.

entries.example: 這條小路可以走到海邊。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tiáo xiǎo lù kě yǐ zǒu dào hǎi biān.
entries.exampleEnglish: This path takes you to the seaside.
entries.question: 你家附近有安靜的小路嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn yǒu ān jìng de xiǎo lù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a quiet lane near your home?
entries.answer: 有，我常在那條小路散步。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ cháng zài nà tiáo xiǎo lù sàn bù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often take walks along that lane.

entries.example: 他的中文程度很好。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de zhōng wén chéng dù hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: His Chinese is at a very good level.
entries.question: 你覺得你的中文程度怎麼樣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ de zhōng wén chéng dù zěn me yàng?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you rate your level of Chinese?
entries.answer: 我的程度還不錯，但還要加油。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de chéng dù hái bú cuò, dàn hái yào jiā yóu.
entries.answerEnglish: My level isn't bad, but I still need to work at it.

entries.example: 他看到帳單，表情很奇怪。
entries.examplePinyin: tā kàn dào zhàng dān, biǎo qíng hěn qí guài.
entries.exampleEnglish: When he saw the bill, he made a strange face.
entries.question: 你生氣的時候會有什麼表情？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēng qì de shí hòu huì yǒu shén me biǎo qíng?
entries.questionEnglish: What expression do you have when you're angry?
entries.answer: 我生氣的時候，表情很可怕。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ shēng qì de shí hòu, biǎo qíng hěn kě pà.
entries.answerEnglish: When I'm angry, my face looks scary.

entries.example: 這張照片的背景是101。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhāng zhào piàn de bèi jǐng shì 101.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taipei 101 is in the background of this photo.
entries.question: 你手機桌面的背景是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shǒu jī zhuō miàn de bèi jǐng shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the background on your phone's home screen?
entries.answer: 我的手機背景是我的貓。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de shǒu jī bèi jǐng shì wǒ de māo.
entries.answerEnglish: My phone background is my cat.

entries.example: 這份工作的條件是會說英文。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè fèn gōng zuò de tiáo jiàn shì huì shuō yīng wén.
entries.exampleEnglish: The requirement for this job is speaking English.
entries.question: 你找工作時最在意什麼條件？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhǎo gōng zuò shí zuì zài yì shén me tiáo jiàn?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you care about most when looking for a job?
entries.answer: 我最在意的條件是薪水。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì zài yì de tiáo jiàn shì xīn shuǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: The thing I care about most is the salary.

entries.example: 手機是很好的學習工具。
entries.examplePinyin: shǒu jī shì hěn hǎo de xué xí gōng jù.
entries.exampleEnglish: A phone is a great tool for learning.
entries.question: 你學中文用什麼工具？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xué zhōng wén yòng shén me gōng jù?
entries.questionEnglish: What tools do you use to learn Chinese?
entries.answer: 我最常用的工具是手機。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì cháng yòng de gōng jù shì shǒu jī.
entries.answerEnglish: The tool I use most is my phone.

entries.example: 她的戒指很漂亮。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de jiè zhǐ hěn piào liang.
entries.exampleEnglish: Her ring is beautiful.
entries.question: 你平常會戴戒指嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ píng cháng huì dài jiè zhǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you usually wear a ring?
entries.answer: 會，我每天戴結婚戒指。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi tiān dài jié hūn jiè zhǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I wear my wedding ring every day.

entries.example: 這家餐廳的位置很好。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā cān tīng de wèi zhì hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant is in a great location.
entries.question: 你家的位置方便嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de wèi zhì fāng biàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your home in a convenient location?
entries.answer: 很方便，位置就在捷運站旁邊。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn fāng biàn, wèi zhì jiù zài jié yùn zhàn páng biān.
entries.answerEnglish: Very convenient. It's right next to an MRT station.

entries.example: 我看手機太久，脖子好痛。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ kàn shǒu jī tài jiǔ, bó zi hǎo tòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I looked at my phone too long and now my neck hurts.
entries.question: 你常常脖子痛嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng cháng bó zi tòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often get a sore neck?
entries.answer: 常常，我用電腦太久脖子會痛。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ yòng diàn nǎo tài jiǔ bó zi huì tòng.
entries.answerEnglish: Often. My neck hurts when I use the computer too long.

entries.example: 捷運上規定不能吃東西。
entries.examplePinyin: jié yùn shàng guī dìng bù néng chī dōng xī.
entries.exampleEnglish: The rules say you can't eat on the MRT.
entries.question: 你的公司有奇怪的規定嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng sī yǒu qí guài de guī dìng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company have any strange rules?
entries.answer: 有，我們公司規定不能穿短褲。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men gōng sī guī dìng bù néng chuān duǎn kù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our company says you can't wear shorts.

entries.example: 我對這附近很熟悉。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ duì zhè fù jìn hěn shú xī.
entries.exampleEnglish: I know this neighborhood well.
entries.question: 你熟悉你家附近嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shú xī nǐ jiā fù jìn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know the area around your home well?
entries.answer: 很熟悉，我住這裡三年了。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn shú xī, wǒ zhù zhè lǐ sān nián le.
entries.answerEnglish: Very well. I've lived here for three years.

entries.example: 我忘記這裡的網路密碼了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ wàng jì zhè lǐ de wǎng lù mì mǎ le.
entries.exampleEnglish: I've forgotten the Wi-Fi password here.
entries.question: 你常忘記密碼嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng wàng jì mì mǎ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often forget passwords?
entries.answer: 常常，我常忘記網站的密碼。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ cháng wàng jì wǎng zhàn de mì mǎ.
entries.answerEnglish: All the time. I often forget website passwords.

entries.example: 我大部分的朋友都是台灣人。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ dà bù fèn de péng yǒu dōu shì tái wān rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: Most of my friends are Taiwanese.
entries.question: 你大部分的時間在哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dà bù fèn de shí jiān zài nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you spend most of your time?
entries.answer: 我大部分的時間在公司。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dà bù fèn de shí jiān zài gōng sī.
entries.answerEnglish: I spend most of my time at the office.

entries.example: 今天的溫度很高。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn tiān de wēn dù hěn gāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: The temperature is high today.
entries.question: 你家冷氣的溫度開幾度？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā lěng qì de wēn dù kāi jǐ dù?
entries.questionEnglish: What temperature do you set your air conditioner to?
entries.answer: 我冷氣的溫度都開二十六度。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ lěng qì de wēn dù dōu kāi èr shí liù dù.
entries.answerEnglish: I always set the air conditioner to 26 degrees.

entries.example: 這件外套太薄了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn wài tào tài báo le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This jacket is too thin.
entries.question: 你冬天穿厚的還是薄的外套？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dōng tiān chuān hòu de hái shì báo de wài tào?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you wear a thick or thin jacket in winter?
entries.answer: 台灣不太冷，我穿薄的。
entries.answerPinyin: tái wān bú tài lěng, wǒ chuān báo de.
entries.answerEnglish: Taiwan isn't very cold, so I wear a thin one.

entries.example: 秋天的葉子變黃了。
entries.examplePinyin: qiū tiān de yè zi biàn huáng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The leaves have turned yellow in autumn.
entries.question: 你喜歡秋天變色的葉子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan qiū tiān biàn sè de yè zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like leaves that change color in autumn?
entries.answer: 喜歡，紅色的葉子很漂亮。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, hóng sè de yè zi hěn piào liang.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, red leaves are beautiful.

entries.example: 外面空氣很差，呼吸不太舒服。
entries.examplePinyin: wài miàn kōng qì hěn chà, hū xī bú tài shū fú.
entries.exampleEnglish: The air outside is bad, so it's unpleasant to breathe.
entries.question: 你緊張時會深呼吸嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jǐn zhāng shí huì shēn hū xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you take deep breaths when you're nervous?
entries.answer: 會，我會先深呼吸。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì xiān shēn hū xī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I take a deep breath first.

entries.example: 我的手機在口袋裡。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de shǒu jī zài kǒu dài lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: My phone is in my pocket.
entries.question: 你的口袋裡有什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de kǒu dài lǐ yǒu shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's in your pocket?
entries.answer: 我的口袋裡有鑰匙和悠遊卡。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de kǒu dài lǐ yǒu yào shi hé yōu yóu kǎ.
entries.answerEnglish: I've got my keys and my EasyCard in my pocket.

entries.example: 我的臥室很小。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de wò shì hěn xiǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: My bedroom is very small.
entries.question: 你的臥室有窗戶嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de wò shì yǒu chuāng hù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your bedroom have a window?
entries.answer: 有，我的臥室有一個大窗戶。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de wò shì yǒu yí gè dà chuāng hù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my bedroom has a big window.

entries.example: 這些蝦子還是活的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè xiē xiā zi hái shì huó de.
entries.exampleEnglish: These shrimp are still alive.
entries.question: 你在市場買過活的海鮮嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài shì chǎng mǎi guò huó de hǎi xiān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever bought live seafood at a market?
entries.answer: 買過，我買過活的螃蟹。
entries.answerPinyin: mǎi guò, wǒ mǎi guò huó de páng xiè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've bought live crabs.

entries.example: 一輛卡車停在我家門口。
entries.examplePinyin: yí liàng kǎ chē tíng zài wǒ jiā mén kǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: A truck is parked in front of my house.
entries.question: 你開過卡車嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kāi guò kǎ chē ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever driven a truck?
entries.answer: 沒有，我沒開過卡車。
entries.answerPinyin: méi yǒu, wǒ méi kāi guò kǎ chē.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I've never driven a truck.

entries.example: 我奶奶住在鄉下。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ nǎi nai zhù zài xiāng xià.
entries.exampleEnglish: My grandma lives in the countryside.
entries.question: 你比較喜歡住城市還是鄉下？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bǐ jiào xǐ huan zhù chéng shì hái shì xiāng xià?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer living in the city or the countryside?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡鄉下，很安靜。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan xiāng xià, hěn ān jìng.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer the countryside. It's quiet.

entries.example: 他上班的時候很專心。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shàng bān de shí hòu hěn zhuān xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's very focused at work.
entries.question: 你在哪裡最能專心？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài nǎ lǐ zuì néng zhuān xīn?
entries.questionEnglish: Where can you concentrate best?
entries.answer: 我在咖啡店最能專心。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài kā fēi diàn zuì néng zhuān xīn.
entries.answerEnglish: I concentrate best in a coffee shop.

entries.example: 我住在一間老公寓。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zhù zài yì jiān lǎo gōng yù.
entries.exampleEnglish: I live in an old walk-up apartment.
entries.question: 你住公寓還是大樓？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhù gōng yù hái shì dà lóu?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you live in a walk-up or a high-rise?
entries.answer: 我住在五樓的公寓。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhù zài wǔ lóu de gōng yù.
entries.answerEnglish: I live in a fifth-floor walk-up apartment.

entries.pinyin: bù zhī dào wèi shén me
entries.example: 不知道為什麼，我今天很累。
entries.examplePinyin: bù zhī dào wèi shén me, wǒ jīn tiān hěn lèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: For some reason, I'm really tired today.
entries.question: 你今天心情怎麼樣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jīn tiān xīn qíng zěn me yàng?
entries.questionEnglish: How are you feeling today?
entries.answer: 不知道為什麼，我今天很開心。
entries.answerPinyin: bù zhī dào wèi shén me, wǒ jīn tiān hěn kāi xīn.
entries.answerEnglish: For some reason, I'm really happy today.

entries.example: 她是一位有名的演員。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì yí wèi yǒu míng de yǎn yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's a famous actress.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪個演員？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ gè yǎn yuán?
entries.questionEnglish: Which actor do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡的演員是成龍。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan de yǎn yuán shì chéng lóng.
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite actor is Jackie Chan.

entries.example: 我的牙齒有點痛。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de yá chǐ yǒu diǎn tòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: My tooth hurts a bit.
entries.question: 你多久檢查一次牙齒？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duō jiǔ jiǎn chá yí cì yá chǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you get your teeth checked?
entries.answer: 我半年檢查一次牙齒。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bàn nián jiǎn chá yí cì yá chǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I get my teeth checked every six months.

entries.example: 台灣很多家庭都有機車。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān hěn duō jiā tíng dōu yǒu jī chē.
entries.exampleEnglish: Many households in Taiwan have a scooter.
entries.question: 你來自大家庭還是小家庭？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ lái zì dà jiā tíng hái shì xiǎo jiā tíng?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you come from a big family or a small one?
entries.answer: 我來自小家庭，只有三個人。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ lái zì xiǎo jiā tíng, zhǐ yǒu sān gè rén.
entries.answerEnglish: I come from a small family, just three of us.

entries.example: 我這次中文考試的成績不錯。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zhè cì zhōng wén kǎo shì de chéng jī bú cuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: I did well on this Chinese test.
entries.question: 你上次中文考試成績怎麼樣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shàng cì zhōng wén kǎo shì chéng jī zěn me yàng?
entries.questionEnglish: How did you do on your last Chinese test?
entries.answer: 成績還不錯，我考了八十分。
entries.answerPinyin: chéng jī hái bú cuò, wǒ kǎo le bā shí fēn.
entries.answerEnglish: Pretty good. I got eighty.

entries.example: 我的腳踏車被偷了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de jiǎo tà chē bèi tōu le.
entries.exampleEnglish: My bike was stolen.
entries.question: 東西被偷了，應該怎麼辦？
entries.questionPinyin: dōng xī bèi tōu le, yīng gāi zěn me bàn?
entries.questionEnglish: What should you do if something is stolen?
entries.answer: 東西被偷了，應該去報警。
entries.answerPinyin: dōng xī bèi tōu le, yīng gāi qù bào jǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: If something is stolen, you should report it to the police.

entries.example: 這盆花的土太乾了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè pén huā de tǔ tài gān le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The soil in this flower pot is too dry.
entries.question: 你種花用什麼土？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhòng huā yòng shén me tǔ?
entries.questionEnglish: What soil do you use for your plants?
entries.answer: 我用花店買的土。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yòng huā diàn mǎi de tǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: I use soil from the flower shop.

entries.example: 非常感謝你的幫忙。
entries.examplePinyin: fēi cháng gǎn xiè nǐ de bāng máng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Thank you so much for your help.
entries.question: 你最想感謝誰？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xiǎng gǎn xiè shéi?
entries.questionEnglish: Who would you most like to thank?
entries.answer: 我最想感謝我的父母。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xiǎng gǎn xiè wǒ de fù mǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd most like to thank my parents.

entries.example: 夜市晚上很熱鬧。
entries.examplePinyin: yè shì wǎn shàng hěn rè nào.
entries.exampleEnglish: The night market is very lively in the evening.
entries.question: 你喜歡熱鬧的地方嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan rè nào de dì fāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like lively places?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我喜歡熱鬧的夜市。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ xǐ huan rè nào de yè shì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like busy night markets.

entries.example: 他抓了雨傘就出門了。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zhuā le yǔ sǎn jiù chū mén le.
entries.exampleEnglish: He grabbed an umbrella and went out.
entries.question: 早上快遲到時，你會抓什麼就出門？
entries.questionPinyin: zǎo shàng kuài chí dào shí, nǐ huì zhuā shén me jiù chū mén?
entries.questionEnglish: When you're about to be late in the morning, what do you grab on your way out?
entries.answer: 我會抓一個麵包就出門。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì zhuā yí gè miàn bāo jiù chū mén.
entries.answerEnglish: I grab a bread roll and head out.

entries.example: 公園裡有一個小湖。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng yuán lǐ yǒu yí gè xiǎo hú.
