entries.example: 我的房東人很好，常送我水果。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de fáng dōng rén hěn hǎo, cháng sòng wǒ shuǐ guǒ.
entries.exampleEnglish: My landlord is very nice and often gives me fruit.
entries.question: 你的房東是怎麼樣的人？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de fáng dōng shì zěn me yàng de rén?
entries.questionEnglish: What is your landlord like?
entries.answer: 我的房東是一位很親切的阿姨。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de fáng dōng shì yí wèi hěn qīn qiè de ā yí.
entries.answerEnglish: My landlord is a very friendly middle-aged lady.

entries.example: 捷運站貼了很多電影海報。
entries.examplePinyin: jié yùn zhàn tiē le hěn duō diàn yǐng hǎi bào.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of movie posters up in the MRT station.
entries.question: 你房間裡有貼海報嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ fáng jiān lǐ yǒu tiē hǎi bào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have posters up in your room?
entries.answer: 有，我貼了一張樂團的海報。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ tiē le yì zhāng yuè tuán de hǎi bào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I put up a poster of a band.

entries.example: 我中午吃了鮭魚便當。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zhōng wǔ chī le guī yú biàn dāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I had a salmon bento for lunch.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃鮭魚嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī guī yú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like salmon?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我最喜歡吃鮭魚壽司。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ zuì xǐ huan chī guī yú shòu sī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, salmon sushi is my favorite.

entries.example: 這道菜放了很多大蒜。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè dào cài fàng le hěn duō dà suàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This dish has a lot of garlic in it.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃大蒜嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī dà suàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like garlic?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我吃香腸一定要配大蒜。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ chī xiāng cháng yí dìng yào pèi dà suàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always eat Taiwanese sausage with garlic.

entries.example: 很多名人都來過這家餐廳。
entries.examplePinyin: hěn duō míng rén dōu lái guò zhè jiā cān tīng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Lots of celebrities have eaten at this restaurant.
entries.question: 你在台灣遇過名人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān yù guò míng rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever run into a celebrity in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 遇過，我在機場看過一個名人。
entries.answerPinyin: yù guò, wǒ zài jī chǎng kàn guò yí gè míng rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw a celebrity at the airport.

entries.example: 爸媽每個月給弟弟零用錢。
entries.examplePinyin: bà mā měi gè yuè gěi dì di líng yòng qián.
entries.exampleEnglish: My parents give my younger brother pocket money every month.
entries.question: 你小時候有零用錢嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu yǒu líng yòng qián ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you get pocket money as a child?
entries.answer: 有，我每個禮拜有五十塊零用錢。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ měi gè lǐ bài yǒu wǔ shí kuài líng yòng qián.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I got fifty dollars of pocket money a week.

entries.example: 他最大的優點是很有耐心。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zuì dà de yōu diǎn shì hěn yǒu nài xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: His greatest strength is his patience.
entries.question: 你最大的優點是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì dà de yōu diǎn shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your greatest strength?
entries.answer: 我最大的優點是很樂觀。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì dà de yōu diǎn shì hěn lè guān.
entries.answerEnglish: My greatest strength is that I'm optimistic.

entries.example: 搭捷運要抓住拉環。
entries.examplePinyin: dā jié yùn yào zhuā zhù lā huán.
entries.exampleEnglish: Hold on to the hand strap when you ride the MRT.
entries.question: 你會抓住每個說中文的機會嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zhuā zhù měi gè shuō zhōng wén de jī huì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you seize every chance to speak Chinese?
entries.answer: 會，我會抓住每個說中文的機會。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì zhuā zhù měi gè shuō zhōng wén de jī huì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I seize every chance to speak Chinese.

entries.example: 我報名了下個月的馬拉松。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bào míng le xià gè yuè de mǎ lā sōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I signed up for next month's marathon.
entries.question: 你最近報名了什麼課？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn bào míng le shén me kè?
entries.questionEnglish: What classes have you signed up for recently?
entries.answer: 我報名了週末的烹飪課。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bào míng le zhōu mò de pēng rèn kè.
entries.answerEnglish: I signed up for a weekend cooking class.

entries.example: 霧太大了，什麼都看不見。
entries.examplePinyin: wù tài dà le, shén me dōu kàn bú jiàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The fog is so thick that you can't see anything.
entries.question: 你不戴眼鏡看得見嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bú dài yǎn jìng kàn de jiàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you see without your glasses?
entries.answer: 看不見，我近視很深。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn bú jiàn, wǒ jìn shì hěn shēn.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I'm very nearsighted.

entries.example: 今天陽光很好，我們去散步吧！
entries.examplePinyin: jīn tiān yáng guāng hěn hǎo, wǒ men qù sàn bù ba!
entries.exampleEnglish: It's sunny today. Let's go for a walk!
entries.question: 你喜歡有陽光的房間嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan yǒu yáng guāng de fáng jiān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like rooms that get sunlight?
entries.answer: 喜歡，有陽光的房間比較舒服。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, yǒu yáng guāng de fáng jiān bǐ jiào shū fú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, sunny rooms are more comfortable.

entries.example: 歡迎給我們一些意見。
entries.examplePinyin: huān yíng gěi wǒ men yì xiē yì jiàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: We welcome your feedback.
entries.question: 你買東西前會問朋友的意見嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi dōng xī qián huì wèn péng yǒu de yì jiàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you ask friends for their opinion before you buy things?
entries.answer: 會，我買衣服前會問朋友的意見。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ mǎi yī fu qián huì wèn péng yǒu de yì jiàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I ask my friends' opinion before buying clothes.

entries.example: 週末我有一個朋友的聚會。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōu mò wǒ yǒu yí gè péng yǒu de jù huì.
entries.exampleEnglish: I have a get-together with friends this weekend.
entries.question: 你常參加聚會嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng cān jiā jù huì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often go to gatherings?
entries.answer: 常常，我每個月有兩、三個聚會。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ měi gè yuè yǒu liǎng, sān gè jù huì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have two or three get-togethers a month.

entries.example: 我認為這個方法比較好。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ rèn wéi zhè ge fāng fǎ bǐ jiào hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: I think this method is better.
entries.question: 你認為台北最好玩的地方是哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ rèn wéi tái běi zuì hǎo wán de dì fāng shì nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you think is the most fun place in Taipei?
entries.answer: 我認為士林夜市最好玩。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ rèn wéi shì lín yè shì zuì hǎo wán.
entries.answerEnglish: I think Shilin Night Market is the most fun.

entries.example: 我每天在公園跑三圈。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi tiān zài gōng yuán pǎo sān quān.
entries.exampleEnglish: I run three laps around the park every day.
entries.question: 你跑步的時候通常跑幾圈？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pǎo bù de shí hòu tōng cháng pǎo jǐ quān?
entries.questionEnglish: How many laps do you usually run?
entries.answer: 我通常在操場跑五圈。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ tōng cháng zài cāo chǎng pǎo wǔ quān.
entries.answerEnglish: I usually run five laps around the track.

entries.example: 這家店的商品都很便宜。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn de shāng pǐn dōu hěn pián yi.
entries.exampleEnglish: Everything in this shop is cheap.
entries.question: 你常在網路上買什麼商品？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng zài wǎng lù shang mǎi shén me shāng pǐn?
entries.questionEnglish: What kinds of products do you often buy online?
entries.answer: 我常在網路上買3C商品。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cháng zài wǎng lù shang mǎi 3C shāng pǐn.
entries.answerEnglish: I often buy electronics online.

entries.example: 寶貝，晚餐好了！
entries.examplePinyin: bǎo bèi, wǎn cān hǎo le!
entries.exampleEnglish: Sweetheart, dinner's ready!
entries.question: 你家裡誰是大家的寶貝？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā lǐ shéi shì dà jiā de bǎo bèi?
entries.questionEnglish: Who is everyone's darling in your family?
entries.answer: 我家的狗是大家的寶貝。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā de gǒu shì dà jiā de bǎo bèi.
entries.answerEnglish: Our dog is everyone's darling.

entries.example: 我在台北租了一間套房。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài tái běi zū le yì jiān tào fáng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I rent a studio in Taipei.
entries.question: 你現在住套房還是公寓？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiàn zài zhù tào fáng hái shì gōng yù?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you live in a studio or an apartment now?
entries.answer: 我住套房，一個人住剛好。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhù tào fáng, yí gè rén zhù gāng hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: I live in a studio; it's just right for one person.

entries.example: 她的眉毛很濃。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de méi máo hěn nóng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Her eyebrows are thick.
entries.question: 你會自己修眉毛嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zì jǐ xiū méi máo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you trim your own eyebrows?
entries.answer: 會，我每個星期修一次眉毛。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi gè xīng qí xiū yí cì méi máo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I trim my eyebrows once a week.

entries.example: 這個枕頭太高了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge zhěn tou tài gāo le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This pillow is too high.
entries.question: 你喜歡軟的還是硬的枕頭？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan ruǎn de hái shì yìng de zhěn tou?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer soft or firm pillows?
entries.answer: 我喜歡軟一點的枕頭。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan ruǎn yì diǎn de zhěn tou.
entries.answerEnglish: I like a softer pillow.

entries.example: 雲遮住了月亮。
entries.examplePinyin: yún zhē zhù le yuè liàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The clouds hid the moon.
entries.question: 拍照時，你會遮住臉嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: pāi zhào shí, nǐ huì zhē zhù liǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you cover your face when someone takes a photo?
entries.answer: 有時候會，我會用手遮住臉。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu huì, wǒ huì yòng shǒu zhē zhù liǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes; I cover my face with my hand.

entries.example: 祝福你們新婚快樂！
entries.examplePinyin: zhù fú nǐ men xīn hūn kuài lè!
entries.exampleEnglish: Wishing you a happy marriage!
entries.question: 朋友結婚時，你會說什麼祝福的話？
entries.questionPinyin: péng yǒu jié hūn shí, nǐ huì shuō shén me zhù fú de huà?
entries.questionEnglish: What good wishes do you say when a friend gets married?
entries.answer: 我會祝福他們永遠幸福。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì zhù fú tā men yǒng yuǎn xìng fú.
entries.answerEnglish: I wish them happiness forever.

entries.example: 他把行李拖上樓。
entries.examplePinyin: tā bǎ xíng li tuō shàng lóu.
entries.exampleEnglish: He dragged the luggage upstairs.
entries.question: 搬家時，你會自己拖重的東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: bān jiā shí, nǐ huì zì jǐ tuō zhòng de dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you move house, do you haul heavy things yourself?
entries.answer: 會，我會自己把箱子拖過去。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì zì jǐ bǎ xiāng zi tuō guò qù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I drag the boxes over myself.

entries.example: 他比以前成熟多了。
entries.examplePinyin: tā bǐ yǐ qián chéng shú duō le.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's much more mature than before.
entries.question: 你覺得自己成熟嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ chéng shú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're mature?
entries.answer: 我覺得我比以前成熟多了。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de wǒ bǐ yǐ qián chéng shú duō le.
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm much more mature than I used to be.

entries.example: 我把約會寫在日曆上。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bǎ yuē huì xiě zài rì lì shàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I wrote the appointment on the calendar.
entries.question: 你用手機日曆還是紙的日曆？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yòng shǒu jī rì lì hái shì zhǐ de rì lì?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use a phone calendar or a paper one?
entries.answer: 我都用手機的日曆。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dōu yòng shǒu jī de rì lì.
entries.answerEnglish: I always use the calendar on my phone.

entries.example: 水餃要沾醬油才好吃。
entries.examplePinyin: shuǐ jiǎo yào zhān jiàng yóu cái hǎo chī.
entries.exampleEnglish: Dumplings taste better dipped in soy sauce.
entries.question: 你吃水餃喜歡沾什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chī shuǐ jiǎo xǐ huan zhān shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you like to dip your dumplings in?
entries.answer: 我喜歡沾醬油和辣椒。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan zhān jiàng yóu hé là jiāo.
entries.answerEnglish: I like dipping them in soy sauce and chili.

entries.example: 她是一個很善良的人。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì yí gè hěn shàn liáng de rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's a very kind person.
entries.question: 你身邊誰最善良？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēn biān shéi zuì shàn liáng?
entries.questionEnglish: Who's the kindest person around you?
entries.answer: 我媽媽最善良，常常幫助別人。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ mā ma zuì shàn liáng, cháng cháng bāng zhù bié rén.
entries.answerEnglish: My mom is the kindest; she often helps others.

entries.example: 這個罐子打不開。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge guàn zi dǎ bù kāi.
entries.exampleEnglish: This jar won't open.
entries.question: 你家用罐子裝什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yòng guàn zi zhuāng shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you keep in jars at home?
entries.answer: 我用罐子裝餅乾和糖。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yòng guàn zi zhuāng bǐng gān hé táng.
entries.answerEnglish: I keep cookies and sugar in jars.

entries.example: 騎機車一定要戴安全帽。
entries.examplePinyin: qí jī chē yí dìng yào dài ān quán mào.
entries.exampleEnglish: You must wear a helmet when riding a scooter.
entries.question: 你的安全帽是什麼顏色？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de ān quán mào shì shén me yán sè?
entries.questionEnglish: What color is your helmet?
entries.answer: 我的安全帽是黑色的。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de ān quán mào shì hēi sè de.
entries.answerEnglish: My helmet is black.

entries.example: 我喜歡咖啡的香味。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xǐ huan kā fēi de xiāng wèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: I love the smell of coffee.
entries.question: 你最喜歡什麼香味？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan shén me xiāng wèi?
entries.questionEnglish: What scent do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡剛烤好的麵包香味。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan gāng kǎo hǎo de miàn bāo xiāng wèi.
entries.answerEnglish: I love the smell of freshly baked bread most.

entries.example: 農場裡有很多山羊。
entries.examplePinyin: nóng chǎng lǐ yǒu hěn duō shān yáng.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of goats on the farm.
entries.question: 你喝過山羊奶嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ hē guò shān yáng nǎi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had goat's milk?
entries.answer: 喝過，山羊奶的味道有點特別。
entries.answerPinyin: hē guò, shān yáng nǎi de wèi dào yǒu diǎn tè bié.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, goat's milk tastes a little unusual.

entries.example: 我很喜歡吃菇。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hěn xǐ huan chī gū.
entries.exampleEnglish: I love eating mushrooms.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃什麼菇？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī shén me gū?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of mushrooms do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡吃杏鮑菇。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan chī xìng bào gū.
entries.answerEnglish: I like king oyster mushrooms.

entries.example: 這家餐廳值得排隊。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā cān tīng zhí dé pái duì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant is worth lining up for.
entries.question: 你覺得來台灣值得嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de lái tái wān zhí dé ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think coming to Taiwan was worth it?
entries.answer: 很值得，我學到很多東西。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn zhí dé, wǒ xué dào hěn duō dōng xī.
entries.answerEnglish: Totally worth it; I've learned a lot.

entries.example: 我住在市中心，交通很方便。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zhù zài shì zhōng xīn, jiāo tōng hěn fāng biàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I live downtown, so getting around is easy.
entries.question: 你住在市中心嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhù zài shì zhōng xīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you live downtown?
entries.answer: 不是，我住在離市中心有點遠的地方。
entries.answerPinyin: bú shì, wǒ zhù zài lí shì zhōng xīn yǒu diǎn yuǎn de dì fāng.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I live a bit far from the city center.

entries.example: 今天的新娘好漂亮！
entries.examplePinyin: jīn tiān de xīn niáng hǎo piào liang!
entries.exampleEnglish: The bride looks so beautiful today!
entries.question: 你參加過台灣的婚禮嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān jiā guò tái wān de hūn lǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to a Taiwanese wedding?
entries.answer: 參加過，新娘換了三套禮服。
entries.answerPinyin: cān jiā guò, xīn niáng huàn le sān tào lǐ fú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the bride changed into three different gowns.

entries.example: 我是屬龍的。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ shì shǔ lóng de.
entries.exampleEnglish: I was born in the Year of the Dragon.
entries.question: 你看過划龍舟比賽嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò huá lóng zhōu bǐ sài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever watched a dragon boat race?
entries.answer: 看過，去年端午節我去看划龍舟。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, qù nián duān wǔ jié wǒ qù kàn huá lóng zhōu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I went to watch the dragon boat races last Dragon Boat Festival.

entries.example: 花園裡有很多蝴蝶。
entries.examplePinyin: huā yuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō hú dié.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of butterflies in the garden.
entries.question: 你在哪裡看過很多蝴蝶？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài nǎ lǐ kàn guò hěn duō hú dié?
entries.questionEnglish: Where have you seen lots of butterflies?
entries.answer: 我在陽明山看過很多蝴蝶。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài yáng míng shān kàn guò hěn duō hú dié.
entries.answerEnglish: I saw lots of butterflies on Yangmingshan.

entries.example: 小孩手上拿著一顆氣球。
entries.examplePinyin: xiǎo hái shǒu shàng ná zhe yì kē qì qiú.
entries.exampleEnglish: The child is holding a balloon.
entries.question: 你看過台東的熱氣球嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò tái dōng de rè qì qiú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen the hot-air balloons in Taitung?
entries.answer: 看過，熱氣球飛在天上很漂亮。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, rè qì qiú fēi zài tiān shàng hěn piào liang.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the hot-air balloons look beautiful in the sky.

entries.example: 台灣常常有地震。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān cháng cháng yǒu dì zhèn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan often has earthquakes.
entries.question: 你在台灣遇過地震嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān yù guò dì zhèn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been through an earthquake in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 遇過，第一次遇到地震很害怕。
entries.answerPinyin: yù guò, dì yī cì yù dào dì zhèn hěn hài pà.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the first time I was really scared.

entries.example: 不要在路上吐口香糖。
entries.examplePinyin: bú yào zài lù shang tǔ kǒu xiāng táng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Don't spit gum on the street.
entries.question: 吃魚的時候，你怎麼處理魚刺？
entries.questionPinyin: chī yú de shí hòu, nǐ zěn me chǔ lǐ yú cì?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do with the bones when you eat fish?
entries.answer: 我會把魚刺吐出來。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì bǎ yú cì tǔ chū lái.
entries.answerEnglish: I spit the bones out.

entries.example: 我的看法跟他相反。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de kàn fǎ gēn tā xiāng fǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: My view is the opposite of his.
entries.question: 你跟你的家人個性一樣還是相反？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gēn nǐ de jiā rén gè xìng yí yàng hái shì xiāng fǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your personality like your family's or the opposite?
entries.answer: 我跟我姐姐的個性完全相反。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ gēn wǒ jiě jie de gè xìng wán quán xiāng fǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: My sister and I have completely opposite personalities.

entries.example: 我家的吸塵器壞了，要買新的。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ jiā de xī chén qì huài le, yào mǎi xīn de.
entries.exampleEnglish: My vacuum cleaner broke, so I need to buy a new one.
entries.question: 你多久用一次吸塵器？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duō jiǔ yòng yí cì xī chén qì?
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you use a vacuum cleaner?
entries.answer: 我每個週末用一次吸塵器。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ měi gè zhōu mò yòng yí cì xī chén qì.
entries.answerEnglish: I vacuum once every weekend.

entries.example: 公司的休息室有咖啡機。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng sī de xiū xí shì yǒu kā fēi jī.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a coffee machine in the office break room.
entries.question: 你們公司有休息室嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men gōng sī yǒu xiū xí shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company have a break room?
entries.answer: 有，我中午常在休息室吃飯。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ zhōng wǔ cháng zài xiū xí shì chī fàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often eat lunch in the break room.

entries.english: among; in the middle of; amid
entries.example: 我們三個人當中，他最高。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men sān gè rén dāng zhōng, tā zuì gāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Of the three of us, he's the tallest.
entries.question: 你的朋友當中，誰最會做菜？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de péng yǒu dāng zhōng, shéi zuì huì zuò cài?
entries.questionEnglish: Among your friends, who's the best cook?
entries.answer: 我的朋友當中，小林最會做菜。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de péng yǒu dāng zhōng, xiǎo lín zuì huì zuò cài.
entries.answerEnglish: Among my friends, Xiaolin is the best cook.

entries.example: 外面又打雷又閃電，好可怕。
entries.examplePinyin: wài miàn yòu dǎ léi yòu shǎn diàn, hǎo kě pà.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's thunder and lightning outside. It's so scary.
entries.question: 你怕打雷閃電嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pà dǎ léi shǎn diàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you afraid of thunder and lightning?
entries.answer: 我不怕閃電，可是很怕打雷。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bú pà shǎn diàn, kě shì hěn pà dǎ léi.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm not afraid of lightning, but I'm really scared of thunder.

entries.example: 浴室的燈泡壞了。
entries.examplePinyin: yù shì de dēng pào huài le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The bathroom light bulb has burned out.
entries.question: 你會自己換燈泡嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zì jǐ huàn dēng pào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you change a light bulb yourself?
entries.answer: 會，換燈泡很簡單。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, huàn dēng pào hěn jiǎn dān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, changing a light bulb is easy.

entries.example: 我們週末常去體育館打球。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zhōu mò cháng qù tǐ yù guǎn dǎ qiú.
entries.exampleEnglish: We often go to the gym to play ball on weekends.
entries.question: 你家附近有體育館嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn yǒu tǐ yù guǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a gymnasium near your home?
entries.answer: 有，我常去那座體育館打羽毛球。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ cháng qù nà zuò tǐ yù guǎn dǎ yǔ máo qiú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often play badminton at that gym.

entries.example: 這段廣告可以跳過。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè duàn guǎng gào kě yǐ tiào guò.
entries.exampleEnglish: You can skip this ad.
entries.question: 看影片時，你會跳過廣告嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: kàn yǐng piàn shí, nǐ huì tiào guò guǎng gào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you watch videos, do you skip the ads?
entries.answer: 會，能跳過的廣告我一定跳過。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, néng tiào guò de guǎng gào wǒ yí dìng tiào guò.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. If an ad can be skipped, I always skip it.

entries.example: 他切了一大塊蛋糕給我。
entries.examplePinyin: tā qiē le yí dà kuài dàn gāo gěi wǒ.
entries.exampleEnglish: He cut me a big piece of cake.
entries.question: 吃牛排時，你喜歡切大塊還是小塊？
entries.questionPinyin: chī niú pái shí, nǐ xǐ huan qiē dà kuài hái shì xiǎo kuài?
entries.questionEnglish: When you eat steak, do you like to cut big pieces or small ones?
entries.answer: 我喜歡切大塊，吃起來比較過癮。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan qiē dà kuài, chī qǐ lái bǐ jiào guò yǐn.
entries.answerEnglish: I like big pieces. They're more satisfying.

entries.example: 台灣的地理位置很好。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān de dì lǐ wèi zhì hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan's geographical location is excellent.
entries.question: 你喜歡台灣的地理環境嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan tái wān de dì lǐ huán jìng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like Taiwan's geography?
entries.answer: 喜歡，台灣的地理環境有山也有海。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, tái wān de dì lǐ huán jìng yǒu shān yě yǒu hǎi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. Taiwan's geography has both mountains and sea.

entries.example: 我們八點要上船去綠島。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men bā diǎn yào shàng chuán qù lǜ dǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: We're boarding the boat to Green Island at eight.
entries.question: 你上船前會吃暈船藥嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shàng chuán qián huì chī yùn chuán yào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you take seasickness pills before you get on a boat?
entries.answer: 會，我上船前一定會吃暈船藥。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ shàng chuán qián yí dìng huì chī yùn chuán yào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. I always take seasickness pills before I get on a boat.

entries.example: 我的包裹放在管理員那裡。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de bāo guǒ fàng zài guǎn lǐ yuán nà lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: My package is at the building manager's desk.
entries.question: 你住的大樓有管理員嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhù de dà lóu yǒu guǎn lǐ yuán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your building have a building manager?
entries.answer: 有，管理員會幫我們收包裹。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, guǎn lǐ yuán huì bāng wǒ men shōu bāo guǒ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. The building manager takes in our packages for us.

entries.example: 我的牛排要五分熟。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de niú pái yào wǔ fēn shú.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'd like my steak medium.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃幾分熟的牛排？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī jǐ fēn shú de niú pái?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you like your steak done?
entries.answer: 我喜歡七分熟的牛排。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan qī fēn shú de niú pái.
entries.answerEnglish: I like my steak medium-well.

entries.example: 我週末常去書店看漫畫。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zhōu mò cháng qù shū diàn kàn màn huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: On weekends I often go to the bookstore to read comics.
entries.question: 你喜歡看哪一種漫畫？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kàn nǎ yì zhǒng màn huà?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of comics do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡看日本的運動漫畫。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan kàn rì běn de yùn dòng màn huà.
entries.answerEnglish: I like Japanese sports manga.

entries.example: 我的老闆脾氣很好。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de lǎo bǎn pí qì hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: My boss is very good-tempered.
entries.question: 你覺得自己脾氣好嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ pí qì hǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you have a good temper?
entries.answer: 還不錯，我很少發脾氣。
entries.answerPinyin: hái bú cuò, wǒ hěn shǎo fā pí qi.
entries.answerEnglish: Not bad. I rarely lose my temper.

entries.example: 我週末常跟好友去爬山。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zhōu mò cháng gēn hǎo yǒu qù pá shān.
entries.exampleEnglish: On weekends I often go hiking with my good friends.
entries.question: 你和好友常常一起做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ hé hǎo yǒu cháng cháng yì qǐ zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you and your close friends often do together?
entries.answer: 我和好友常一起去夜市吃東西。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ hé hǎo yǒu cháng yì qǐ qù yè shì chī dōng xī.
entries.answerEnglish: My friends and I often go eat at night markets together.

entries.example: 我在陽台曬衣服。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài yáng tái shài yī fu.
entries.exampleEnglish: I hang my laundry out on the balcony.
entries.question: 你家有陽台嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yǒu yáng tái ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your home have a balcony?
entries.answer: 有，我在陽台種了一些花。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ zài yáng tái zhòng le yì xiē huā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. I've planted some flowers on the balcony.

entries.example: 我想買一張圓形的桌子。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì zhāng yuán xíng de zhuō zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: I want to buy a round table.
entries.question: 你喜歡圓形的還是方形的桌子？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan yuán xíng de hái shì fāng xíng de zhuō zi?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer round tables or square ones?
entries.answer: 我喜歡圓形的，吃飯比較熱鬧。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan yuán xíng de, chī fàn bǐ jiào rè nào.
entries.answerEnglish: I like round ones. Meals feel livelier.

entries.example: 我晚上在當英文家教。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ wǎn shàng zài dāng yīng wén jiā jiào.
entries.exampleEnglish: I work as an English tutor in the evenings.
entries.question: 你當過家教嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dāng guò jiā jiào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever worked as a tutor?
entries.answer: 當過，我在台北當過英文家教。
entries.answerPinyin: dāng guò, wǒ zài tái běi dāng guò yīng wén jiā jiào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I was an English tutor in Taipei.

entries.example: 他一喝酒就臉紅。
entries.examplePinyin: tā yì hē jiǔ jiù liǎn hóng.
entries.exampleEnglish: His face turns red as soon as he drinks.
entries.question: 你什麼時候會臉紅？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shén me shí hòu huì liǎn hóng?
entries.questionEnglish: When do you blush?
entries.answer: 被別人稱讚的時候，我會臉紅。
entries.answerPinyin: bèi bié rén chēng zàn de shí hòu, wǒ huì liǎn hóng.
entries.answerEnglish: I blush when people praise me.

entries.example: 吃完飯，我們點了甜點。
entries.examplePinyin: chī wán fàn, wǒ men diǎn le tián diǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: After the meal, we ordered dessert.
entries.question: 你最喜歡的甜點是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan de tián diǎn shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your favorite dessert?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡的甜點是芒果冰。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan de tián diǎn shì máng guǒ bīng.
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite dessert is mango shaved ice.

entries.english: use; make use of; take advantage of
entries.example: 我利用午休時間去銀行。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ lì yòng wǔ xiū shí jiān qù yín háng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I use my lunch break to go to the bank.
entries.question: 你會利用週末學中文嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì lì yòng zhōu mò xué zhōng wén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use your weekends to study Chinese?
entries.answer: 會，我利用週末上中文課。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ lì yòng zhōu mò shàng zhōng wén kè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. I use my weekends to take Chinese classes.

entries.example: 我可以喝一小口嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ kě yǐ hē yì xiǎo kǒu ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: Can I have a sip?
entries.question: 你會讓朋友喝一小口你的飲料嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì ràng péng yǒu hē yì xiǎo kǒu nǐ de yǐn liào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you let a friend have a sip of your drink?
entries.answer: 會，我會讓好朋友喝一小口。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì ràng hǎo péng yǒu hē yì xiǎo kǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. I'd let a good friend have a sip.

entries.example: 我在上中級中文課。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài shàng zhōng jí zhōng wén kè.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm taking an intermediate Chinese class.
entries.question: 你的中文是初級還是中級？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de zhōng wén shì chū jí hái shì zhōng jí?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your Chinese beginner or intermediate?
entries.answer: 我的中文大概是中級。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de zhōng wén dà gài shì zhōng jí.
entries.answerEnglish: My Chinese is about intermediate.

entries.example: 我每天用這個馬克杯喝咖啡。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi tiān yòng zhè ge mǎ kè bēi hē kā fēi.
entries.exampleEnglish: I drink coffee from this mug every day.
entries.question: 你有最喜歡的馬克杯嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu zuì xǐ huan de mǎ kè bēi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a favorite mug?
entries.answer: 有，我最喜歡朋友送我的馬克杯。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ zuì xǐ huan péng yǒu sòng wǒ de mǎ kè bēi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my favorite is a mug a friend gave me.

entries.example: 週末我們去河邊野餐吧！
entries.examplePinyin: zhōu mò wǒ men qù hé biān yě cān ba!
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's go for a picnic by the river this weekend!
entries.question: 你喜歡去哪裡野餐？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan qù nǎ lǐ yě cān?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you like to go for picnics?
entries.answer: 我喜歡去大安森林公園野餐。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan qù dà ān sēn lín gōng yuán yě cān.
entries.answerEnglish: I like having picnics in Daan Forest Park.

entries.example: 我姪子最喜歡恐龍。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zhí zi zuì xǐ huan kǒng lóng.
entries.exampleEnglish: My nephew loves dinosaurs most of all.
entries.question: 你小時候喜歡恐龍嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu xǐ huan kǒng lóng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you like dinosaurs as a child?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我有很多恐龍玩具。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ yǒu hěn duō kǒng lóng wán jù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I had lots of dinosaur toys.

entries.example: 我早餐常吃穀片加牛奶。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zǎo cān cháng chī gǔ piàn jiā niú nǎi.
entries.exampleEnglish: I often have cereal with milk for breakfast.
entries.question: 你早餐會吃穀片嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zǎo cān huì chī gǔ piàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you eat cereal for breakfast?
entries.answer: 有時候，我喜歡穀片加優格。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu, wǒ xǐ huan gǔ piàn jiā yōu gé.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. I like cereal with yogurt.

entries.example: 這兩家便利商店互相競爭。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè liǎng jiā biàn lì shāng diàn hù xiāng jìng zhēng.
entries.exampleEnglish: These two convenience stores compete with each other.
entries.question: 你的工作競爭激烈嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng zuò jìng zhēng jī liè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a lot of competition in your job?
entries.answer: 對，我們這一行競爭很激烈。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ men zhè yì háng jìng zhēng hěn jī liè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, competition in my line of work is fierce.

entries.example: 我們搭船去一座小島。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men dā chuán qù yí zuò xiǎo dǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: We took a boat to a small island.
entries.question: 你去過台灣的哪些小島？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò tái wān de nǎ xiē xiǎo dǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: Which of Taiwan's small islands have you been to?
entries.answer: 我去過綠島，那是一座很美的小島。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qù guò lǜ dǎo, nà shì yí zuò hěn měi de xiǎo dǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: I've been to Green Island; it's a beautiful little island.

entries.example: 這盒櫻桃好貴！
entries.examplePinyin: zhè hé yīng táo hǎo guì!
entries.exampleEnglish: This box of cherries is so expensive!
entries.question: 你喜歡吃櫻桃嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī yīng táo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like cherries?
entries.answer: 喜歡，可是台灣的櫻桃很貴。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, kě shì tái wān de yīng táo hěn guì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but cherries are expensive in Taiwan.

entries.example: 我早餐吃火腿蛋餅。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zǎo cān chī huǒ tuǐ dàn bǐng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I had a ham egg crepe for breakfast.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃火腿嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī huǒ tuǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like ham?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常吃火腿三明治。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ cháng chī huǒ tuǐ sān míng zhì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often eat ham sandwiches.

entries.example: 我真是個笨蛋，又忘了帶鑰匙！
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zhēn shì gè bèn dàn, yòu wàng le dài yào shi!
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm such an idiot, I forgot my keys again!
entries.question: 你什麼時候會覺得自己是笨蛋？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shén me shí hòu huì jué de zì jǐ shì bèn dàn?
entries.questionEnglish: When do you feel like an idiot?
entries.answer: 我搭錯捷運的時候，會覺得自己是笨蛋。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dā cuò jié yùn de shí hòu, huì jué de zì jǐ shì bèn dàn.
entries.answerEnglish: When I take the wrong MRT line, I feel like an idiot.

entries.example: 加油站的服務員很親切。
entries.examplePinyin: jiā yóu zhàn de fú wù yuán hěn qīn qiè.
entries.exampleEnglish: The gas station attendant is very friendly.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的服務員親切嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān de fú wù yuán qīn qiè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think service staff in Taiwan are friendly?
entries.answer: 很親切，餐廳的服務員都很有禮貌。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn qīn qiè, cān tīng de fú wù yuán dōu hěn yǒu lǐ mào.
entries.answerEnglish: Very friendly. Restaurant staff are all very polite.

entries.example: 我早餐吃培根蛋餅。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zǎo cān chī péi gēn dàn bǐng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I had a bacon egg crepe for breakfast.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃培根嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī péi gēn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like bacon?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我最愛培根三明治。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ zuì ài péi gēn sān míng zhì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love bacon sandwiches.

entries.example: 打雷的聲音讓我嚇一跳。
entries.examplePinyin: dǎ léi de shēng yīn ràng wǒ xià yí tiào.
entries.exampleEnglish: The thunder startled me.
entries.question: 最近什麼事讓你嚇一跳？
entries.questionPinyin: zuì jìn shén me shì ràng nǐ xià yí tiào?
entries.questionEnglish: What has startled you recently?
entries.answer: 電費帳單太貴，讓我嚇一跳。
entries.answerPinyin: diàn fèi zhàng dān tài guì, ràng wǒ xià yí tiào.
entries.answerEnglish: The electricity bill was so high it gave me a fright.

entries.example: 寶特瓶要拿去回收。
entries.examplePinyin: bǎo tè píng yào ná qù huí shōu.
entries.exampleEnglish: Plastic bottles should go to recycling.
entries.question: 你在家會做資源回收嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài jiā huì zuò zī yuán huí shōu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you recycle at home?
entries.answer: 會，我每天都會做資源回收。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi tiān dōu huì zuò zī yuán huí shōu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I recycle every day.

entries.example: 便當可以用微波爐加熱。
entries.examplePinyin: biàn dāng kě yǐ yòng wéi bō lú jiā rè.
entries.exampleEnglish: You can heat up a lunch box in the microwave.
entries.question: 你常用微波爐熱東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng yòng wéi bō lú rè dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often heat food in the microwave?
entries.answer: 常用，我中午都用微波爐熱便當。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng yòng, wǒ zhōng wǔ dōu yòng wéi bō lú rè biàn dāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I heat my lunch box in the microwave every day.

entries.example: 我的簽證下個月到期。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de qiān zhèng xià gè yuè dào qí.
entries.exampleEnglish: My visa expires next month.
entries.question: 你來台灣需要辦簽證嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ lái tái wān xū yào bàn qiān zhèng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you need a visa to come to Taiwan?
entries.answer: 需要，我來台灣前辦了簽證。
entries.answerPinyin: xū yào, wǒ lái tái wān qián bàn le qiān zhèng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I got a visa before I came to Taiwan.

entries.example: 我在九份買了幾張明信片。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài jiǔ fèn mǎi le jǐ zhāng míng xìn piàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a few postcards in Jiufen.
entries.question: 你旅行時會寄明信片嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ lǚ xíng shí huì jì míng xìn piàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you send postcards when you travel?
entries.answer: 會，我常常寄明信片給家人。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng cháng jì míng xìn piàn gěi jiā rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often send postcards to my family.

entries.example: 吃餃子要加一點醋。
entries.examplePinyin: chī jiǎo zi yào jiā yì diǎn cù.
entries.exampleEnglish: Add a little vinegar when you eat dumplings.
entries.question: 你吃餃子喜歡加醋嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chī jiǎo zi xǐ huan jiā cù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like vinegar with your dumplings?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我吃餃子一定加醋。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ chī jiǎo zi yí dìng jiā cù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always add vinegar to dumplings.

entries.example: 每天塞車上班很痛苦。
entries.examplePinyin: měi tiān sāi chē shàng bān hěn tòng kǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Sitting in traffic to work every day is agony.
entries.question: 什麼事會讓你覺得很痛苦？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shì huì ràng nǐ jué de hěn tòng kǔ?
entries.questionEnglish: What feels like agony to you?
entries.answer: 早上很早起床讓我很痛苦。
entries.answerPinyin: zǎo shàng hěn zǎo qǐ chuáng ràng wǒ hěn tòng kǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: Getting up really early is agony for me.

entries.example: 雨停了，天上有一道彩虹。
entries.examplePinyin: yǔ tíng le, tiān shàng yǒu yí dào cǎi hóng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The rain stopped, and there was a rainbow in the sky.
entries.question: 你最近看過彩虹嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn kàn guò cǎi hóng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen a rainbow recently?
entries.answer: 看過，上週下完雨就有彩虹。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, shàng zhōu xià wán yǔ jiù yǒu cǎi hóng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there was a rainbow after the rain last week.

entries.example: 我的衣櫥已經滿了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de yī chú yǐ jīng mǎn le.
entries.exampleEnglish: My wardrobe is already full.
entries.question: 你的衣櫥裡衣服多嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de yī chú lǐ yī fu duō ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there a lot of clothes in your wardrobe?
entries.answer: 很多，我的衣櫥快放不下了。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn duō, wǒ de yī chú kuài fàng bú xià le.
entries.answerEnglish: Lots. My wardrobe can barely hold them.

entries.example: 這個便當很有營養。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge biàn dāng hěn yǒu yíng yǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This lunch box is very nutritious.
entries.question: 你覺得你吃得有營養嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ chī de yǒu yíng yǎng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you eat nutritiously?
entries.answer: 還好，我會多吃青菜補充營養。
entries.answerPinyin: hái hǎo, wǒ huì duō chī qīng cài bǔ chōng yíng yǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: It's OK. I eat lots of vegetables for nutrition.

entries.example: 請在表格上寫你的國籍。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng zài biǎo gé shàng xiě nǐ de guó jí.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please write your nationality on the form.
entries.question: 你有幾個國籍？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu jǐ gè guó jí?
entries.questionEnglish: How many nationalities do you have?
entries.answer: 我只有一個國籍，是美國。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhǐ yǒu yí gè guó jí, shì měi guó.
entries.answerEnglish: I only have one nationality: American.

entries.example: 在捷運上不能吃口香糖。
entries.examplePinyin: zài jié yùn shàng bù néng chī kǒu xiāng táng.
entries.exampleEnglish: You can't chew gum on the MRT.
entries.question: 你常常吃口香糖嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng cháng chī kǒu xiāng táng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often chew gum?
entries.answer: 有時候，開會前我會吃口香糖。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu, kāi huì qián wǒ huì chī kǒu xiāng táng.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. I chew gum before meetings.

entries.example: 我女兒很想騎小馬。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ nǚ ér hěn xiǎng qí xiǎo mǎ.
entries.exampleEnglish: My daughter really wants to ride a pony.
entries.question: 你小時候騎過小馬嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu qí guò xiǎo mǎ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you ride a pony when you were little?
entries.answer: 騎過，我在農場騎過小馬。
entries.answerPinyin: qí guò, wǒ zài nóng chǎng qí guò xiǎo mǎ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I rode a pony on a farm.

entries.example: 你去超商順便幫我買牛奶。
entries.examplePinyin: nǐ qù chāo shāng shùn biàn bāng wǒ mǎi niú nǎi.
entries.exampleEnglish: Since you're going to the convenience store, get me some milk.
entries.question: 你下班回家會順便買晚餐嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xià bān huí jiā huì shùn biàn mǎi wǎn cān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you pick up dinner on your way home from work?
entries.answer: 會，我常常順便買便當回家。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng cháng shùn biàn mǎi biàn dāng huí jiā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often pick up a boxed meal on the way home.

entries.example: 我買了一瓶香水送媽媽。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ mǎi le yì píng xiāng shuǐ sòng mā ma.
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a bottle of perfume for my mom.
entries.question: 你平常會噴香水嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ píng cháng huì pēn xiāng shuǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you usually wear perfume?
entries.answer: 出門的時候我會噴一點香水。
entries.answerPinyin: chū mén de shí hòu wǒ huì pēn yì diǎn xiāng shuǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I put on a little perfume when I go out.

entries.example: 昨天的地震把我嚇壞了。
entries.examplePinyin: zuó tiān de dì zhèn bǎ wǒ xià huài le.
entries.exampleEnglish: Yesterday's earthquake terrified me.
entries.question: 什麼東西會把你嚇壞？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me dōng xī huì bǎ nǐ xià huài?
entries.questionEnglish: What would scare you badly?
entries.answer: 會飛的蟑螂會把我嚇壞。
entries.answerPinyin: huì fēi de zhāng láng huì bǎ wǒ xià huài.
entries.answerEnglish: Flying cockroaches would terrify me.

entries.example: 對不起，我踩到你的腳了。
entries.examplePinyin: duì bù qǐ, wǒ cǎi dào nǐ de jiǎo le.
entries.exampleEnglish: Sorry, I stepped on your foot.
entries.question: 你在捷運上被人踩過腳嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài jié yùn shàng bèi rén cǎi guò jiǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has anyone ever stepped on your foot on the MRT?
entries.answer: 有，人多的時候常常被踩到。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, rén duō de shí hòu cháng cháng bèi cǎi dào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, it happens often when it's crowded.

entries.example: 我家後面有一片樹林。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ jiā hòu miàn yǒu yí piàn shù lín.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a grove of trees behind my home.
entries.question: 你家附近有樹林嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn yǒu shù lín ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there any woods near your home?
entries.answer: 有，我家附近有一片小樹林。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiā fù jìn yǒu yí piàn xiǎo shù lín.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a small grove near my home.

entries.example: 我女兒在學小提琴。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ nǚ ér zài xué xiǎo tí qín.
entries.exampleEnglish: My daughter is learning the violin.
entries.question: 你會拉小提琴嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì lā xiǎo tí qín ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you play the violin?
entries.answer: 不會，但我很想學拉小提琴。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, dàn wǒ hěn xiǎng xué lā xiǎo tí qín.
entries.answerEnglish: No, but I'd really like to learn the violin.

entries.example: 空服員送來了一杯熱茶。
entries.examplePinyin: kōng fú yuán sòng lái le yì bēi rè chá.
entries.exampleEnglish: The flight attendant brought a cup of hot tea.
entries.question: 你想當空服員嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng dāng kōng fú yuán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to be a flight attendant?
entries.answer: 不想，空服員的工作太累了。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xiǎng, kōng fú yuán de gōng zuò tài lèi le.
entries.answerEnglish: No, a flight attendant's job is too tiring.

entries.example: 可以把字放大一點嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: kě yǐ bǎ zì fàng dà yì diǎn ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: Could you make the text a bit bigger?
entries.question: 你看手機的時候會把字放大嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn shǒu jī de shí hòu huì bǎ zì fàng dà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you enlarge the text when using your phone?
entries.answer: 會，我都把字放大來看。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōu bǎ zì fàng dà lái kàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always enlarge the text.

entries.example: 週末我常跟朋友下西洋棋。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōu mò wǒ cháng gēn péng yǒu xià xī yáng qí.
entries.exampleEnglish: On weekends I often play chess with friends.
entries.question: 你會下西洋棋嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì xià xī yáng qí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you play chess?
entries.answer: 會，我小時候就學過西洋棋。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ xiǎo shí hòu jiù xué guò xī yáng qí.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I learned chess as a child.

entries.example: 我們交換一下座位好嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men jiāo huàn yí xià zuò wèi hǎo ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: Shall we swap seats?
entries.question: 你跟朋友交換過禮物嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gēn péng yǒu jiāo huàn guò lǐ wù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever exchanged gifts with friends?
entries.answer: 有，聖誕節我們都會交換禮物。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, shèng dàn jié wǒ men dōu huì jiāo huàn lǐ wù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we always exchange gifts at Christmas.

entries.example: 奶奶家養了三隻母雞。
entries.examplePinyin: nǎi nai jiā yǎng le sān zhī mǔ jī.
entries.exampleEnglish: Grandma keeps three hens.
entries.question: 你小時候家裡有養母雞嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu jiā lǐ yǒu yǎng mǔ jī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did your family keep hens when you were young?
entries.answer: 有，我們家的母雞每天下蛋。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men jiā de mǔ jī měi tiān xià dàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our hens laid eggs every day.

entries.example: 週末我們全家去郊遊。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōu mò wǒ men quán jiā qù jiāo yóu.
entries.exampleEnglish: Our whole family went on an outing at the weekend.
entries.question: 你週末喜歡去哪裡郊遊？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhōu mò xǐ huan qù nǎ lǐ jiāo yóu?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you like to go for an outing on weekends?
entries.answer: 我喜歡去陽明山郊遊。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan qù yáng míng shān jiāo yóu.
entries.answerEnglish: I like going on outings to Yangmingshan.

entries.example: 餅乾一拿起來就碎掉了。
entries.examplePinyin: bǐng gān yì ná qǐ lái jiù suì diào le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The cookie crumbled as soon as I picked it up.
entries.question: 你的手機螢幕碎掉過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de shǒu jī yíng mù suì diào guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has your phone screen ever cracked?
entries.answer: 碎掉過，修理花了很多錢。
entries.answerPinyin: suì diào guò, xiū lǐ huā le hěn duō qián.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, and the repair cost a lot.

entries.example: 在台灣亂丟垃圾會被罰錢。
entries.examplePinyin: zài tái wān luàn diū lè sè huì bèi fá qián.
entries.exampleEnglish: In Taiwan you get fined for littering.
entries.question: 你看過有人亂丟垃圾嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò yǒu rén luàn diū lè sè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen someone litter?
entries.answer: 看過，我覺得亂丟垃圾很沒禮貌。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ jué de luàn diū lè sè hěn méi lǐ mào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I think littering is very rude.

entries.example: 牛在草地上吃草。
entries.examplePinyin: niú zài cǎo dì shàng chī cǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: The cows are grazing in the field.
entries.question: 你看過羊吃草嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò yáng chī cǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen sheep grazing?
entries.answer: 看過，我在清境農場看過羊吃草。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài qīng jìng nóng chǎng kàn guò yáng chī cǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw sheep grazing at Cingjing Farm.

entries.example: 袋子裡的蛋糕被壓壞了。
entries.examplePinyin: dài zi lǐ de dàn gāo bèi yā huài le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The cake in the bag got squashed.
entries.question: 你買的東西被壓壞過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi de dōng xī bèi yā huài guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has something you bought ever been crushed?
entries.answer: 有，網購的盒子被壓壞了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǎng gòu de hé zi bèi yā huài le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a box I ordered online got crushed.

entries.example: 昨天晚上雷聲好大。
entries.examplePinyin: zuó tiān wǎn shàng léi shēng hǎo dà.
entries.exampleEnglish: The thunder was really loud last night.
entries.question: 你怕雷聲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pà léi shēng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you afraid of thunder?
entries.answer: 不怕，但雷聲太大會吵醒我。
entries.answerPinyin: bú pà, dàn léi shēng tài dà huì chǎo xǐng wǒ.
entries.answerEnglish: No, but loud thunder wakes me up.

entries.example: 我是新手，請多指教。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ shì xīn shǒu, qǐng duō zhǐ jiào.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm new at this, so please bear with me.
entries.question: 你做什麼事還是新手？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò shén me shì hái shì xīn shǒu?
entries.questionEnglish: What are you still a beginner at?
entries.answer: 我做菜還是新手。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuò cài hái shì xīn shǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm still a beginner at cooking.

entries.example: 這隻小狗好可憐。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhī xiǎo gǒu hǎo kě lián.
entries.exampleEnglish: This little dog is so pitiful.
entries.question: 你看到流浪狗會覺得可憐嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn dào liú làng gǒu huì jué de kě lián ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you feel sorry for stray dogs when you see them?
entries.answer: 會，我覺得牠們很可憐。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ jué de tā men hěn kě lián.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I feel they're very pitiful.

entries.example: 天氣冷，我多穿了一件背心。
entries.examplePinyin: tiān qì lěng, wǒ duō chuān le yí jiàn bèi xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's cold, so I put on an extra vest.
entries.question: 你夏天常穿背心嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xià tiān cháng chuān bèi xīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often wear tank tops in summer?
entries.answer: 常穿，夏天穿背心很涼快。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng chuān, xià tiān chuān bèi xīn hěn liáng kuai.
entries.answerEnglish: Often; tank tops are cool in summer.

entries.example: 麵包放太久變硬了。
entries.examplePinyin: miàn bāo fàng tài jiǔ biàn yìng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The bread went hard after sitting too long.
entries.question: 你怎麼處理變硬的麵包？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zěn me chǔ lǐ biàn yìng de miàn bāo?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do with bread that has gone hard?
entries.answer: 我把變硬的麵包烤一下再吃。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǎ biàn yìng de miàn bāo kǎo yí xià zài chī.
entries.answerEnglish: I toast hard bread before eating it.

entries.example: 母雞帶著小雞在散步。
entries.examplePinyin: mǔ jī dài zhe xiǎo jī zài sàn bù.
entries.exampleEnglish: The hen is out walking with her chicks.
entries.question: 你小時候養過小雞嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu yǎng guò xiǎo jī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you ever raise chicks as a child?
entries.answer: 養過，我小時候養過一隻小雞。
entries.answerPinyin: yǎng guò, wǒ xiǎo shí hòu yǎng guò yì zhī xiǎo jī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I raised a chick when I was little.

entries.example: 我種的植物終於開花了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zhòng de zhí wù zhōng yú kāi huā le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The plant I grew has finally flowered.
entries.question: 你種的植物開花過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhòng de zhí wù kāi huā guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has any plant you've grown ever flowered?
entries.answer: 有，我種的蘭花開花了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ zhòng de lán huā kāi huā le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my orchid has bloomed.

entries.example: 這裡的房租是我家鄉的三倍。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè lǐ de fáng zū shì wǒ jiā xiāng de sān bèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: Rent here is three times what it is in my hometown.
entries.question: 台北的房租比你家鄉貴幾倍？
entries.questionPinyin: tái běi de fáng zū bǐ nǐ jiā xiāng guì jǐ bèi?
entries.questionEnglish: How many times more expensive is rent in Taipei than in your hometown?
entries.answer: 台北的房租大概是我家鄉的三倍。
entries.answerPinyin: tái běi de fáng zū dà gài shì wǒ jiā xiāng de sān bèi.
entries.answerEnglish: Rent in Taipei is about three times my hometown's.

entries.example: 她的女兒很活潑。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de nǚ ér hěn huó pō.
entries.exampleEnglish: Her daughter is very lively.
entries.question: 你小時候是活潑的孩子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu shì huó pō de hái zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Were you a lively child?
entries.answer: 是，我小時候很活潑。
entries.answerPinyin: shì, wǒ xiǎo shí hòu hěn huó pō.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I was very lively as a child.

entries.example: 天上有一隻老鷹在飛。
entries.examplePinyin: tiān shàng yǒu yì zhī lǎo yīng zài fēi.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's an eagle flying in the sky.
entries.question: 你在台灣看過老鷹嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān kàn guò lǎo yīng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen an eagle in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 看過，我在山上看過老鷹。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài shān shàng kàn guò lǎo yīng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw one in the mountains.

entries.example: 我的腰有點疼。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de yāo yǒu diǎn téng.
entries.exampleEnglish: My lower back aches a bit.
entries.question: 你工作久了哪裡會疼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gōng zuò jiǔ le nǎ lǐ huì téng?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you ache after working a long time?
entries.answer: 坐太久我的背會疼。
entries.answerPinyin: zuò tài jiǔ wǒ de bèi huì téng.
entries.answerEnglish: My back aches if I sit too long.

entries.example: 我們輪流開車去花蓮。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men lún liú kāi chē qù huā lián.
entries.exampleEnglish: We took turns driving to Hualien.
entries.question: 你家的家事是大家輪流做嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de jiā shì shì dà jiā lún liú zuò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do people at home take turns doing chores?
entries.answer: 是，我們輪流洗碗。
entries.answerPinyin: shì, wǒ men lún liú xǐ wǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we take turns washing the dishes.

entries.example: 鄉下的公雞早上五點就叫了。
entries.examplePinyin: xiāng xià de gōng jī zǎo shàng wǔ diǎn jiù jiào le.
entries.exampleEnglish: In the countryside the roosters crow at five in the morning.
entries.question: 你聽過公雞叫嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tīng guò gōng jī jiào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever heard a rooster crow?
entries.answer: 聽過，我住鄉下時每天聽公雞叫。
entries.answerPinyin: tīng guò, wǒ zhù xiāng xià shí měi tiān tīng gōng jī jiào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I heard roosters every day when I lived in the countryside.

entries.english: at the same time; meanwhile; simultaneous
entries.example: 我們兩個同時到了餐廳。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men liǎng gè tóng shí dào le cān tīng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The two of us got to the restaurant at the same time.
entries.question: 你可以同時做兩件事嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kě yǐ tóng shí zuò liǎng jiàn shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you do two things at the same time?
entries.answer: 可以，我常常同時聽音樂跟工作。
entries.answerPinyin: kě yǐ, wǒ cháng cháng tóng shí tīng yīn yuè gēn gōng zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often listen to music and work at the same time.

entries.example: 我好羨慕你可以去日本玩！
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hǎo xiàn mù nǐ kě yǐ qù rì běn wán!
entries.exampleEnglish: I really envy you getting to go to Japan!
entries.question: 你最羨慕誰？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xiàn mù shéi?
entries.questionEnglish: Who do you envy most?
entries.answer: 我最羨慕我哥哥，他每年都出國玩。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xiàn mù wǒ gē ge, tā měi nián dōu chū guó wán.
entries.answerEnglish: I envy my older brother most; he travels abroad every year.

entries.example: 她今天擦了紅色的口紅。
entries.examplePinyin: tā jīn tiān cā le hóng sè de kǒu hóng.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's wearing red lipstick today.
entries.question: 你常擦口紅嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng cā kǒu hóng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often wear lipstick?
entries.answer: 上班的時候我會擦口紅。
entries.answerPinyin: shàng bān de shí hòu wǒ huì cā kǒu hóng.
entries.answerEnglish: I wear lipstick when I go to work.

entries.example: 週末的高速公路很塞。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōu mò de gāo sù gōng lù hěn sāi.
entries.exampleEnglish: The freeway is jammed on weekends.
entries.question: 你常開高速公路嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng kāi gāo sù gōng lù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often drive on the freeway?
entries.answer: 我回南部的時候會開高速公路。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huí nán bù de shí hòu huì kāi gāo sù gōng lù.
entries.answerEnglish: I take the freeway when I go back down south.

entries.example: 他很喜歡看體育新聞。
entries.examplePinyin: tā hěn xǐ huan kàn tǐ yù xīn wén.
entries.exampleEnglish: He loves watching sports news.
entries.question: 你喜歡看哪種體育節目？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kàn nǎ zhǒng tǐ yù jié mù?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of sports programs do you like to watch?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡看體育台的棒球比賽。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan kàn tǐ yù tái de bàng qiú bǐ sài.
entries.answerEnglish: I like watching baseball games on the sports channel most.

entries.example: 我坐太久，站起來有點頭暈。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zuò tài jiǔ, zhàn qǐ lái yǒu diǎn tóu yūn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I sat too long and felt a bit dizzy when I stood up.
entries.question: 你坐船會頭暈嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò chuán huì tóu yūn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you get dizzy on boats?
entries.answer: 會，我坐船一定會頭暈。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ zuò chuán yí dìng huì tóu yūn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always get dizzy on boats.

entries.example: 他們昨天又吵架了。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men zuó tiān yòu chǎo jià le.
entries.exampleEnglish: They had another argument yesterday.
entries.question: 你常跟家人吵架嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng gēn jiā rén chǎo jià ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often argue with your family?
entries.answer: 不常，我們很少吵架。
entries.answerPinyin: bù cháng, wǒ men hěn shǎo chǎo jià.
entries.answerEnglish: Not often; we rarely argue.

entries.example: 下雨天地很滑，小心！
entries.examplePinyin: xià yǔ tiān dì hěn huá, xiǎo xīn!
entries.exampleEnglish: The floor is slippery on rainy days. Be careful!
entries.question: 下雨天你騎車會怕路滑嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: xià yǔ tiān nǐ qí chē huì pà lù huá ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When it rains, are you afraid of slippery roads when you ride?
entries.answer: 會，路很滑的時候我會騎很慢。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, lù hěn huá de shí hòu wǒ huì qí hěn màn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I ride very slowly when the road is slippery.

entries.example: 這道菜放了很多辣椒。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè dào cài fàng le hěn duō là jiāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This dish has a lot of chili in it.
entries.question: 你吃得了辣椒嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chī de liǎo là jiāo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you handle chili?
entries.answer: 吃得了，我很喜歡吃辣椒。
entries.answerPinyin: chī de liǎo, wǒ hěn xǐ huan chī là jiāo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love eating chili.

entries.example: 我的中文老師常常鼓勵我多開口。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de zhōng wén lǎo shī cháng cháng gǔ lì wǒ duō kāi kǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: My Chinese teacher often encourages me to speak up more.
entries.question: 學中文時，誰最常鼓勵你？
entries.questionPinyin: xué zhōng wén shí, shéi zuì cháng gǔ lì nǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Who encourages you the most when you're learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 我的台灣朋友最常鼓勵我。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de tái wān péng yǒu zuì cháng gǔ lì wǒ.
entries.answerEnglish: My Taiwanese friends encourage me the most.

entries.example: 我十幾歲的時候住在倫敦。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ shí jǐ suì de shí hòu zhù zài lún dūn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I lived in London when I was a teenager.
entries.question: 你十幾歲的時候喜歡做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shí jǐ suì de shí hòu xǐ huan zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What did you like to do when you were a teenager?
entries.answer: 我十幾歲的時候很喜歡打電動。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ shí jǐ suì de shí hòu hěn xǐ huan dǎ diàn dòng.
entries.answerEnglish: When I was a teenager, I loved playing video games.

entries.example: 電影看到一半，我就睡著了。
entries.examplePinyin: diàn yǐng kàn dào yí bàn, wǒ jiù shuì zháo le.
entries.exampleEnglish: I fell asleep halfway through the movie.
entries.question: 你常常看電影看到一半就睡著嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng cháng kàn diàn yǐng kàn dào yí bàn jiù shuì zháo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often fall asleep halfway through a movie?
entries.answer: 常常，我在家看電影常看到一半就睡著。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ zài jiā kàn diàn yǐng cháng kàn dào yí bàn jiù shuì zháo.
entries.answerEnglish: Often. When I watch movies at home, I often fall asleep halfway.

entries.example: 我家的狗是一隻母狗。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ jiā de gǒu shì yì zhī mǔ gǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: Our dog is a female.
entries.question: 你喜歡養公狗還是母狗？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan yǎng gōng gǒu hái shì mǔ gǒu?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer male or female dogs as pets?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡養母狗，比較乖。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan yǎng mǔ gǒu, bǐ jiào guāi.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer female dogs; they're better behaved.

entries.example: 門卡住了，打不開。
entries.examplePinyin: mén kǎ zhù le, dǎ bù kāi.
entries.exampleEnglish: The door is stuck and won't open.
entries.question: 你的電腦常常卡住嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de diàn nǎo cháng cháng kǎ zhù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your computer often freeze?
entries.answer: 常常，我的舊電腦一直卡住。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ de jiù diàn nǎo yì zhí kǎ zhù.
entries.answerEnglish: All the time. My old computer keeps freezing.

entries.example: 你會累是可以理解的。
entries.examplePinyin: nǐ huì lèi shì kě yǐ lǐ jiě de.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's understandable that you're tired.
entries.question: 朋友遲到，你覺得可以理解嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: péng yǒu chí dào, nǐ jué de kě yǐ lǐ jiě ma?
entries.questionEnglish: If a friend is late, do you think it's understandable?
entries.answer: 如果是塞車，我覺得可以理解。
entries.answerPinyin: rú guǒ shì sāi chē, wǒ jué de kě yǐ lǐ jiě.
entries.answerEnglish: If it's because of traffic, I think it's understandable.

entries.example: 我不小心撞到了桌子。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bù xiǎo xīn zhuàng dào le zhuō zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: I accidentally bumped into the table.
entries.question: 你走路看手機會撞到人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zǒu lù kàn shǒu jī huì zhuàng dào rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you bump into people when you look at your phone while walking?
entries.answer: 有時候會，我上次撞到一根柱子。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu huì, wǒ shàng cì zhuàng dào yì gēn zhù zi.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. Last time I walked into a pillar.

entries.example: 我在澳洲第一次騎馬。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài ào zhōu dì yī cì qí mǎ.
entries.exampleEnglish: I rode a horse for the first time in Australia.
entries.question: 你騎過馬嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qí guò mǎ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever ridden a horse?
entries.answer: 騎過，我在蒙古騎馬騎了三天。
entries.answerPinyin: qí guò, wǒ zài měng gǔ qí mǎ qí le sān tiān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I rode horses for three days in Mongolia.

entries.example: 窗戶沒關好，一直有冷風吹進來。
entries.examplePinyin: chuāng hù méi guān hǎo, yì zhí yǒu lěng fēng chuī jìn lái.
entries.exampleEnglish: The window isn't shut properly, so cold air keeps coming in.
entries.question: 冬天你怕冷風嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: dōng tiān nǐ pà lěng fēng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you mind the cold wind in winter?
entries.answer: 很怕，我出門一定戴圍巾擋冷風。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn pà, wǒ chū mén yí dìng dài wéi jīn dǎng lěng fēng.
entries.answerEnglish: Very much. I always wear a scarf to keep out the cold wind.

entries.example: 英文有二十六個字母。
entries.examplePinyin: yīng wén yǒu èr shí liù gè zì mǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: English has twenty-six letters.
entries.question: 你的名字有幾個字母？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de míng zì yǒu jǐ gè zì mǔ?
entries.questionEnglish: How many letters are in your name?
entries.answer: 我的名字有五個字母。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de míng zì yǒu wǔ gè zì mǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: My name has five letters.

entries.example: 請幫我轉分機二三五。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng bāng wǒ zhuǎn fēn jī èr sān wǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please put me through to extension 235.
entries.question: 你公司的電話有分機嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gōng sī de diàn huà yǒu fēn jī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your office phone have an extension?
entries.answer: 有，我的分機是一零八。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de fēn jī shì yī líng bā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my extension is 108.

entries.example: 芒果是台灣夏天很常見的水果。
entries.examplePinyin: máng guǒ shì tái wān xià tiān hěn cháng jiàn de shuǐ guǒ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Mango is a very common summer fruit in Taiwan.
entries.question: 你的國家最常見的早餐是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā zuì cháng jiàn de zǎo cān shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the most common breakfast in your country?
entries.answer: 我們最常見的早餐是麵包和咖啡。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men zuì cháng jiàn de zǎo cān shì miàn bāo hé kā fēi.
entries.answerEnglish: Our most common breakfast is bread and coffee.

entries.example: 我買了一台二手機車。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ mǎi le yì tái èr shǒu jī chē.
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a used scooter.
entries.question: 你買過二手的東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi guò èr shǒu de dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever bought anything secondhand?
entries.answer: 買過，我的腳踏車是二手的。
entries.answerPinyin: mǎi guò, wǒ de jiǎo tà chē shì èr shǒu de.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my bike is secondhand.

entries.example: 他打籃球的時候傷到了腳。
entries.examplePinyin: tā dǎ lán qiú de shí hòu shāng dào le jiǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: He hurt his foot playing basketball.
entries.question: 搬重東西的時候，怎麼樣才不會傷到腰？
entries.questionPinyin: bān zhòng dōng xī de shí hòu, zěn me yàng cái bú huì shāng dào yāo?
entries.questionEnglish: How can you lift heavy things without hurting your back?
entries.answer: 要先蹲下來，才不會傷到腰。
entries.answerPinyin: yào xiān dūn xià lái, cái bú huì shāng dào yāo.
entries.answerEnglish: Squat down first so you don't hurt your back.

entries.example: 我需要硬幣才能買飲料。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xū yào yìng bì cái néng mǎi yǐn liào.
entries.exampleEnglish: I need coins to buy a drink.
entries.question: 你的皮夾裡常常有很多硬幣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de pí jiā lǐ cháng cháng yǒu hěn duō yìng bì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your wallet often full of coins?
entries.answer: 有，我的皮夾裡都是硬幣。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de pí jiā lǐ dōu shì yìng bì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my wallet is full of coins.

entries.example: 週末我們去購物中心逛逛吧。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōu mò wǒ men qù gòu wù zhōng xīn guàng guàng ba.
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's go to the mall this weekend.
entries.question: 你家附近有購物中心嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn yǒu gòu wù zhōng xīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a mall near your home?
entries.answer: 有，走路十分鐘就有一家購物中心。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, zǒu lù shí fēn zhōng jiù yǒu yì jiā gòu wù zhōng xīn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's one a ten-minute walk away.

entries.example: 便利商店的飯糰是三角形的。
entries.examplePinyin: biàn lì shāng diàn de fàn tuán shì sān jiǎo xíng de.
entries.exampleEnglish: Convenience store rice balls are triangular.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃三角形的飯糰嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī sān jiǎo xíng de fàn tuán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like triangle rice balls?
entries.answer: 喜歡，三角形的飯糰很方便。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, sān jiǎo xíng de fàn tuán hěn fāng biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, triangle rice balls are convenient.

entries.example: 我的皮夾放在包包裡。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de pí jiā fàng zài bāo bāo lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: My wallet is in my bag.
entries.question: 你的皮夾裡有什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de pí jiā lǐ yǒu shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's in your wallet?
entries.answer: 我的皮夾裡有悠遊卡和現金。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de pí jiā lǐ yǒu yōu yóu kǎ hé xiàn jīn.
entries.answerEnglish: My wallet has my EasyCard and some cash.

entries.example: 最理想的是住在公司附近。
entries.examplePinyin: zuì lǐ xiǎng de shì zhù zài gōng sī fù jìn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Ideally, you'd live near your office.
entries.question: 你理想的工作是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ lǐ xiǎng de gōng zuò shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your ideal job?
entries.answer: 我理想的工作是可以在家上班。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ lǐ xiǎng de gōng zuò shì kě yǐ zài jiā shàng bān.
entries.answerEnglish: My ideal job is one where I can work from home.

entries.example: 垃圾的味道好噁心。
entries.examplePinyin: lè sè de wèi dào hǎo ě xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The garbage smells disgusting.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼食物很噁心？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me shí wù hěn ě xīn?
entries.questionEnglish: What food do you find gross?
entries.answer: 我覺得生的蝦子有點噁心。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de shēng de xiā zi yǒu diǎn ě xīn.
entries.answerEnglish: I find raw shrimp a bit gross.

entries.example: 便利商店有賣果凍。
entries.examplePinyin: biàn lì shāng diàn yǒu mài guǒ dòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Convenience stores sell jelly.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃什麼口味的果凍？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī shén me kǒu wèi de guǒ dòng?
entries.questionEnglish: What flavor of jelly do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡吃葡萄口味的果凍。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan chī pú táo kǒu wèi de guǒ dòng.
entries.answerEnglish: I like grape jelly.

entries.example: 我太粗心，又忘了帶鑰匙。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ tài cū xīn, yòu wàng le dài yào shi.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm so careless; I forgot my keys again.
entries.question: 你是粗心的人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shì cū xīn de rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you a careless person?
entries.answer: 有一點，我常常粗心忘東西。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu yì diǎn, wǒ cháng cháng cū xīn wàng dōng xī.
entries.answerEnglish: A bit. I often forget things.

entries.example: 可以借我一把剪刀嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: kě yǐ jiè wǒ yì bǎ jiǎn dāo ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: Can I borrow a pair of scissors?
entries.question: 你家的剪刀放在哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de jiǎn dāo fàng zài nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you keep the scissors at home?
entries.answer: 我家的剪刀放在抽屜裡。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā de jiǎn dāo fàng zài chōu tì lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Our scissors are in the drawer.

entries.example: 王太太的孫女很會唱歌。
entries.examplePinyin: wáng tài tài de sūn nǚ hěn huì chàng gē.
entries.exampleEnglish: Mrs. Wang's granddaughter sings really well.
entries.question: 你的爸媽有孫女嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de bà mā yǒu sūn nǚ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do your parents have a granddaughter?
entries.answer: 有，他們有兩個孫女。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, tā men yǒu liǎng gè sūn nǚ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, they have two granddaughters.

entries.example: 我的老闆很幽默。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de lǎo bǎn hěn yōu mò.
entries.exampleEnglish: My boss is very funny.
entries.question: 你覺得自己幽默嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ yōu mò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're funny?
entries.answer: 我覺得我還滿幽默的。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de wǒ hái mǎn yōu mò de.
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm pretty funny.

entries.example: 你的中文發音很標準。
entries.examplePinyin: nǐ de zhōng wén fā yīn hěn biāo zhǔn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Your Chinese pronunciation is very accurate.
entries.question: 中文的哪個發音對你最難？
entries.questionPinyin: zhōng wén de nǎ gè fā yīn duì nǐ zuì nán?
entries.questionEnglish: Which Chinese sound is hardest for you?
entries.answer: 我覺得第三聲的發音最難。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de dì sān shēng de fā yīn zuì nán.
entries.answerEnglish: I find the third tone the hardest to pronounce.

entries.example: 我身高一百七十公分。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ shēn gāo yì bǎi qī shí gōng fēn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm 170 centimeters tall.
entries.question: 你身高多少公分？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēn gāo duō shǎo gōng fēn?
entries.questionEnglish: How tall are you in centimeters?
entries.answer: 我一百八十公分。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yì bǎi bā shí gōng fēn.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm 180 centimeters.

entries.example: 巷口有一家藥房。
entries.examplePinyin: xiàng kǒu yǒu yì jiā yào fáng.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a pharmacy at the end of the lane.
entries.question: 你家附近有藥房嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn yǒu yào fáng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a pharmacy near your home?
entries.answer: 有，走路兩分鐘就有一家藥房。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, zǒu lù liǎng fēn zhōng jiù yǒu yì jiā yào fáng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's one a two-minute walk away.

entries.example: 我的游泳教練很年輕。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de yóu yǒng jiào liàn hěn nián qīng.
entries.exampleEnglish: My swimming coach is very young.
entries.question: 你運動的時候會找教練嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yùn dòng de shí hòu huì zhǎo jiào liàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you work with a coach when you exercise?
entries.answer: 會，我每個星期跟教練上一堂課。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi gè xīng qí gēn jiào liàn shàng yì táng kè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a session with my trainer every week.

entries.example: 他送我一束紅玫瑰。
entries.examplePinyin: tā sòng wǒ yí shù hóng méi guī.
entries.exampleEnglish: He gave me a bunch of red roses.
entries.question: 你喜歡什麼顏色的玫瑰？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan shén me yán sè de méi guī?
entries.questionEnglish: What color roses do you like?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡白色的玫瑰。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan bái sè de méi guī.
entries.answerEnglish: I like white roses best.

entries.example: 這家餐廳用機器人送餐。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā cān tīng yòng jī qì rén sòng cān.
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant uses robots to bring the food.
entries.question: 你家有掃地機器人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yǒu sǎo dì jī qì rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a robot vacuum at home?
entries.answer: 有，我家有一台掃地機器人。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiā yǒu yì tái sǎo dì jī qì rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we have a robot vacuum.

entries.example: 下雨以後，外面有很多青蛙在叫。
entries.examplePinyin: xià yǔ yǐ hòu, wài miàn yǒu hěn duō qīng wā zài jiào.
entries.exampleEnglish: After the rain, lots of frogs are croaking outside.
entries.question: 你小時候抓過青蛙嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu zhuā guò qīng wā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you ever catch frogs as a kid?
entries.answer: 抓過，我小時候常在河邊抓青蛙。
entries.answerPinyin: zhuā guò, wǒ xiǎo shí hòu cháng zài hé biān zhuā qīng wā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often caught frogs by the river when I was little.

entries.example: 這個詞的用法很多。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge cí de yòng fǎ hěn duō.
entries.exampleEnglish: This word has many usages.
entries.question: 學新詞的時候，你會注意用法嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: xué xīn cí de shí hòu, nǐ huì zhù yì yòng fǎ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you learn a new word, do you pay attention to its usage?
entries.answer: 會，我會看例句學用法。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì kàn lì jù xué yòng fǎ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I learn the usage from example sentences.

entries.example: 我的房間空間不大。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de fáng jiān kōng jiān bú dà.
entries.exampleEnglish: My room doesn't have much space.
entries.question: 你的房間空間夠大嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de fáng jiān kōng jiān gòu dà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there enough space in your room?
entries.answer: 不太夠，我房間的空間很小。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài gòu, wǒ fáng jiān de kōng jiān hěn xiǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really; my room is very small.

entries.example: 這家麵攤只有幾張小凳子。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā miàn tān zhǐ yǒu jǐ zhāng xiǎo dèng zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: This noodle stall only has a few little stools.
entries.question: 你家有凳子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yǒu dèng zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any stools at home?
entries.answer: 有，廚房有兩張凳子。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, chú fáng yǒu liǎng zhāng dèng zi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are two stools in the kitchen.

entries.example: 桌上都是灰塵。
entries.examplePinyin: zhuō shàng dōu shì huī chén.
entries.exampleEnglish: The table is covered in dust.
entries.question: 你多久清一次家裡的灰塵？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duō jiǔ qīng yí cì jiā lǐ de huī chén?
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you dust at home?
entries.answer: 我每個星期清一次灰塵。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ měi gè xīng qí qīng yí cì huī chén.
entries.answerEnglish: I dust once a week.

entries.example: 廚房裡有很多螞蟻。
entries.examplePinyin: chú fáng lǐ yǒu hěn duō mǎ yǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of ants in the kitchen.
entries.question: 你家有螞蟻嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yǒu mǎ yǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there ants in your home?
entries.answer: 有，夏天廚房常有螞蟻。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, xià tiān chú fáng cháng yǒu mǎ yǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are often ants in the kitchen in summer.

entries.example: 我想找跟設計相關的工作。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xiǎng zhǎo gēn shè jì xiāng guān de gōng zuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: I want to find a job related to design.
entries.question: 你的工作跟什麼相關？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng zuò gēn shén me xiāng guān?
entries.questionEnglish: What is your work related to?
entries.answer: 我的工作跟教育相關。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de gōng zuò gēn jiào yù xiāng guān.
entries.answerEnglish: My work is related to education.

entries.example: 他看到老鼠就大叫。
entries.examplePinyin: tā kàn dào lǎo shǔ jiù dà jiào.
entries.exampleEnglish: He yelled when he saw the mouse.
entries.question: 你什麼時候會大叫？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shén me shí hòu huì dà jiào?
entries.questionEnglish: When do you yell?
entries.answer: 看到蟑螂的時候我會大叫。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn dào zhāng láng de shí hòu wǒ huì dà jiào.
entries.answerEnglish: I scream when I see a cockroach.

entries.example: 我們在草地上野餐。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zài cǎo dì shàng yě cān.
entries.exampleEnglish: We had a picnic on the grass.
entries.question: 你喜歡在草地上做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zài cǎo dì shàng zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you like to do on the grass?
entries.answer: 我喜歡在草地上躺著看書。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan zài cǎo dì shàng tǎng zhe kàn shū.
entries.answerEnglish: I like lying on the grass and reading.

entries.example: 這碗豆花有加花生。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè wǎn dòu huā yǒu jiā huā shēng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This bowl of tofu pudding has peanuts in it.
entries.question: 你吃豆花喜歡加花生嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chī dòu huā xǐ huan jiā huā shēng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like peanuts in your tofu pudding?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我每次都加花生。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ měi cì dōu jiā huā shēng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I add peanuts every time.

entries.example: 我晚上會去學校操場跑步。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ wǎn shàng huì qù xué xiào cāo chǎng pǎo bù.
entries.exampleEnglish: In the evening I go running at the school track.
entries.question: 你家附近有操場嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn yǒu cāo chǎng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a sports field near your home?
entries.answer: 有，附近的國小有一個操場。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, fù jìn de guó xiǎo yǒu yí gè cāo chǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the elementary school nearby has a sports field.

entries.example: 我們在海鮮餐廳吃螃蟹。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zài hǎi xiān cān tīng chī páng xiè.
entries.exampleEnglish: We ate crab at a seafood restaurant.
entries.question: 你會吃螃蟹嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì chī páng xiè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you eat crab?
entries.answer: 會，可是剝螃蟹很麻煩。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, kě shì bō páng xiè hěn má fán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but shelling crab is a hassle.

entries.example: 天氣冷，記得戴圍巾。
entries.examplePinyin: tiān qì lěng, jì de dài wéi jīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's cold, so remember to wear a scarf.
entries.question: 你冬天會戴圍巾嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dōng tiān huì dài wéi jīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you wear a scarf in winter?
entries.answer: 會，我有好幾條圍巾。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ yǒu hǎo jǐ tiáo wéi jīn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have several scarves.

entries.example: 「吃」是一個動詞。
entries.examplePinyin: “chī” shì yí gè dòng cí.
entries.exampleEnglish: "Chi" (eat) is a verb.
entries.question: 你覺得中文的動詞難嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zhōng wén de dòng cí nán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you find Chinese verbs difficult?
entries.answer: 不難，中文的動詞不用變化。
