entries.examplePinyin: tā zài yí gè huán bǎo zǔ zhī dāng zhì gōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: She volunteers at an environmental organization.
entries.question: 你有參加什麼組織嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu cān jiā shén me zǔ zhī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you belong to any organizations?
entries.answer: 有，我參加了一個國際志工組織。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ cān jiā le yí gè guó jì zhì gōng zǔ zhī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I joined an international volunteer organization.

entries.example: 我在冰箱上留了一張便條給室友。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài bīng xiāng shàng liú le yì zhāng biàn tiáo gěi shì yǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: I left a note on the fridge for my roommate.
entries.question: 你會用便條紙提醒自己嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì yòng biàn tiáo zhǐ tí xǐng zì jǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use sticky notes to remind yourself of things?
entries.answer: 會，我電腦上貼滿了便條紙。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ diàn nǎo shàng tiē mǎn le biàn tiáo zhǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my computer is covered in sticky notes.

entries.example: 這份合約的細節要看清楚。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè fèn hé yuē de xì jié yào kàn qīng chǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Read the details of this contract carefully.
entries.question: 你是注意細節的人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shì zhù yì xì jié de rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you a detail-oriented person?
entries.answer: 是，我工作的時候很注意細節。
entries.answerPinyin: shì, wǒ gōng zuò de shí hòu hěn zhù yì xì jié.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I pay close attention to details at work.

entries.example: 醫生說我的腰要治療一個月。
entries.examplePinyin: yī shēng shuō wǒ de yāo yào zhì liáo yí gè yuè.
entries.exampleEnglish: The doctor says my back needs a month of treatment.
entries.question: 中醫常用什麼方法治療？
entries.questionPinyin: zhōng yī cháng yòng shén me fāng fǎ zhì liáo?
entries.questionEnglish: What methods does Chinese medicine often use for treatment?
entries.answer: 中醫常用中藥和針灸治療。
entries.answerPinyin: zhōng yī cháng yòng zhōng yào hé zhēn jiǔ zhì liáo.
entries.answerEnglish: Chinese medicine often uses herbal medicine and acupuncture for treatment.

entries.example: 颱風來的時候，東部地區雨很大。
entries.examplePinyin: tái fēng lái de shí hòu, dōng bù dì qū yǔ hěn dà.
entries.exampleEnglish: When the typhoon came, it rained heavily in the eastern region.
entries.question: 你住在台北的哪個地區？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhù zài tái běi de nǎ gè dì qū?
entries.questionEnglish: Which area of Taipei do you live in?
entries.answer: 我住在大安區，那個地區很方便。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhù zài dà ān qū, nà ge dì qū hěn fāng biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I live in Da'an. That area is very convenient.

entries.example: 我們的飛機晚上八點抵達桃園。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men de fēi jī wǎn shàng bā diǎn dǐ dá táo yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: Our plane arrives in Taoyuan at 8 p.m.
entries.question: 你第一次抵達台灣是什麼時候？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dì yī cì dǐ dá tái wān shì shén me shí hòu?
entries.questionEnglish: When did you first arrive in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我是三年前的夏天抵達台灣的。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ shì sān nián qián de xià tiān dǐ dá tái wān de.
entries.answerEnglish: I arrived in Taiwan in the summer three years ago.

entries.example: 出門前我會把水壺裝滿水。
entries.examplePinyin: chū mén qián wǒ huì bǎ shuǐ hú zhuāng mǎn shuǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Before I go out, I fill up my water bottle.
entries.question: 你的冰箱現在裝滿了嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de bīng xiāng xiàn zài zhuāng mǎn le ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your fridge full right now?
entries.answer: 裝滿了，我昨天才去超市買菜。
entries.answerPinyin: zhuāng mǎn le, wǒ zuó tiān cái qù chāo shì mǎi cài.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, it's full. I only went grocery shopping yesterday.

entries.example: 他對台灣歷史的知識很豐富。
entries.examplePinyin: tā duì tái wān lì shǐ de zhī shì hěn fēng fù.
entries.exampleEnglish: He knows a great deal about Taiwanese history.
entries.question: 你覺得從哪裡得到知識最快？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de cóng nǎ lǐ dé dào zhī shì zuì kuài?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you think is the fastest place to gain knowledge?
entries.answer: 我覺得上網找知識最快。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de shàng wǎng zhǎo zhī shì zuì kuài.
entries.answerEnglish: I think looking things up online is the fastest way to gain knowledge.

entries.example: 他的中文進步得很明顯。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de zhōng wén jìn bù de hěn míng xiǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: His Chinese has improved noticeably.
entries.question: 你來台灣以後，有什麼明顯的改變？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ lái tái wān yǐ hòu, yǒu shén me míng xiǎn de gǎi biàn?
entries.questionEnglish: Since coming to Taiwan, have you changed in any obvious way?
entries.answer: 最明顯的改變是我變得很愛吃辣。
entries.answerPinyin: zuì míng xiǎn de gǎi biàn shì wǒ biàn de hěn ài chī là.
entries.answerEnglish: The most obvious change is that I've come to love spicy food.

entries.example: 租房子要提供工作證明。
entries.examplePinyin: zū fáng zi yào tí gōng gōng zuò zhèng míng.
entries.exampleEnglish: To rent a place, you need to provide proof of employment.
entries.question: 你辦居留證的時候需要什麼證明？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bàn jū liú zhèng de shí hòu xū yào shén me zhèng míng?
entries.questionEnglish: What documents did you need for your residence permit?
entries.answer: 我需要公司的在職證明。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xū yào gōng sī de zài zhí zhèng míng.
entries.answerEnglish: I needed proof of employment from my company.

entries.example: 圖書館有很多免費的學習資源。
entries.examplePinyin: tú shū guǎn yǒu hěn duō miǎn fèi de xué xí zī yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: The library has lots of free learning resources.
entries.question: 你用什麼資源學中文？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yòng shén me zī yuán xué zhōng wén?
entries.questionEnglish: What resources do you use to learn Chinese?
entries.answer: 我用App和YouTube的資源學中文。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yòng App hé YouTube de zī yuán xué zhōng wén.
entries.answerEnglish: I use apps and YouTube to learn Chinese.

entries.example: 我在台灣的這三年成長很多。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài tái wān de zhè sān nián chéng zhǎng hěn duō.
entries.exampleEnglish: I've grown a lot in my three years in Taiwan.
entries.question: 你是在哪裡成長的？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shì zài nǎ lǐ chéng zhǎng de?
entries.questionEnglish: Where did you grow up?
entries.answer: 我在加拿大的一個小鎮成長。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài jiā ná dà de yí gè xiǎo zhèn chéng zhǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: I grew up in a small town in Canada.

entries.example: 台灣的醫療又便宜又方便。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān de yī liáo yòu pián yi yòu fāng biàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Healthcare in Taiwan is cheap and convenient.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的醫療怎麼樣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān de yī liáo zěn me yàng?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think of healthcare in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 很好，台灣的醫療比我的國家便宜很多。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn hǎo, tái wān de yī liáo bǐ wǒ de guó jiā pián yi hěn duō.
entries.answerEnglish: It's great. Healthcare in Taiwan is much cheaper than in my country.

entries.example: 我的生日願望是去日本旅行。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de shēng rì yuàn wàng shì qù rì běn lǚ xíng.
entries.exampleEnglish: My birthday wish is to travel to Japan.
entries.question: 你今年的願望是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jīn nián de yuàn wàng shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your wish for this year?
entries.answer: 我的願望是家人都健康。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de yuàn wàng shì jiā rén dōu jiàn kāng.
entries.answerEnglish: My wish is for my family to stay healthy.

entries.example: 她的性格很開朗，大家都喜歡她。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de xìng gé hěn kāi lǎng, dà jiā dōu xǐ huan tā.
entries.exampleEnglish: She has a cheerful personality. Everyone likes her.
entries.question: 你覺得自己是什麼性格的人？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ shì shén me xìng gé de rén?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of personality do you think you have?
entries.answer: 我的性格比較安靜，不太愛說話。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de xìng gé bǐ jiào ān jìng, bú tài ài shuō huà.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm a fairly quiet person. I don't talk much.

entries.example: 簽合約以前要先看清楚。
entries.examplePinyin: qiān hé yuē yǐ qián yào xiān kàn qīng chǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Read a contract carefully before you sign it.
entries.question: 你的租屋合約簽了多久？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de zū wū hé yuē qiān le duō jiǔ?
entries.questionEnglish: How long is your rental contract?
entries.answer: 我的租屋合約簽了一年。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de zū wū hé yuē qiān le yì nián.
entries.answerEnglish: My lease is for one year.

entries.example: 煎蛋餅需要一點技巧。
entries.examplePinyin: jiān dàn bǐng xū yào yì diǎn jì qiǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Making an egg crepe takes a bit of technique.
entries.question: 你有什麼學中文的小技巧嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu shén me xué zhōng wén de xiǎo jì qiǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any little tricks for learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 我的技巧是每天記五個新單字。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de jì qiǎo shì měi tiān jì wǔ gè xīn dān zì.
entries.answerEnglish: My trick is to learn five new words every day.

entries.example: 她終於實現了開咖啡店的夢想。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zhōng yú shí xiàn le kāi kā fēi diàn de mèng xiǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: She finally realized her dream of opening a café.
entries.question: 你有什麼夢想想要實現？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu shén me mèng xiǎng xiǎng yào shí xiàn?
entries.questionEnglish: What dream would you like to make come true?
entries.answer: 我想實現騎腳踏車環島的夢想。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng shí xiàn qí jiǎo tà chē huán dǎo de mèng xiǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: I want to realize my dream of cycling around Taiwan.

entries.example: 我來台灣的目的是學中文。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ lái tái wān de mù dì shì xué zhōng wén.
entries.exampleEnglish: My purpose in coming to Taiwan is to learn Chinese.
entries.question: 你這次旅行的目的是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhè cì lǚ xíng de mù dì shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the purpose of your trip?
entries.answer: 這次旅行的目的是去看朋友。
entries.answerPinyin: zhè cì lǚ xíng de mù dì shì qù kàn péng yǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: The purpose of this trip is to visit friends.

entries.example: 我們在花蓮度過了一個美好的週末。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zài huā lián dù guò le yí gè měi hǎo de zhōu mò.
entries.exampleEnglish: We had a wonderful weekend in Hualien.
entries.question: 你在台灣最美好的回憶是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān zuì měi hǎo de huí yì shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your most wonderful memory of Taiwan?
entries.answer: 最美好的回憶是第一次看到太魯閣。
entries.answerPinyin: zuì měi hǎo de huí yì shì dì yī cì kàn dào tài lǔ gé.
entries.answerEnglish: My most wonderful memory is seeing Taroko Gorge for the first time.

entries.example: 這件T恤上的圖案很可愛。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn T xù shàng de tú àn hěn kě ài.
entries.exampleEnglish: The design on this T-shirt is cute.
entries.question: 你喜歡有圖案的衣服嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan yǒu tú àn de yī fu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like clothes with patterns on them?
entries.answer: 不太喜歡，我比較喜歡沒有圖案的。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài xǐ huan, wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan méi yǒu tú àn de.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. I prefer plain ones.

entries.example: 夏天要小心蚊子傳染的疾病。
entries.examplePinyin: xià tiān yào xiǎo xīn wén zǐ chuán rǎn de jí bìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: In summer, watch out for diseases spread by mosquitoes.
entries.question: 怎麼做可以預防疾病？
entries.questionPinyin: zěn me zuò kě yǐ yù fáng jí bìng?
entries.questionEnglish: What can you do to prevent disease?
entries.answer: 多運動、多洗手可以預防疾病。
entries.answerPinyin: duō yùn dòng, duō xǐ shǒu kě yǐ yù fáng jí bìng.
entries.answerEnglish: Exercising and washing your hands often can help prevent disease.

entries.example: 我把不用的程式從手機移除了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bǎ bú yòng de chéng shì cóng shǒu jī yí chú le.
entries.exampleEnglish: I removed the apps I don't use from my phone.
entries.question: 你最近從手機移除了什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn cóng shǒu jī yí chú le shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What have you removed from your phone recently?
entries.answer: 我移除了一個遊戲，太花時間了。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yí chú le yí gè yóu xì, tài huā shí jiān le.
entries.answerEnglish: I removed a game. It took up too much time.

entries.example: 我們早點出門，避開塞車。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zǎo diǎn chū mén, bì kāi sāi chē.
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's leave early to avoid the traffic.
entries.question: 你上班會避開尖峰時間嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shàng bān huì bì kāi jiān fēng shí jiān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you avoid rush hour when you go to work?
entries.answer: 會，我都提早出門，避開人潮。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōu tí zǎo chū mén, bì kāi rén cháo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always leave early to avoid the crowds.

entries.example: 這家咖啡廳的風格很特別。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā kā fēi tīng de fēng gé hěn tè bié.
entries.exampleEnglish: This café has a very distinctive style.
entries.question: 你喜歡什麼風格的衣服？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan shén me fēng gé de yī fu?
entries.questionEnglish: What style of clothes do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡簡單風格的衣服。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan jiǎn dān fēng gé de yī fu.
entries.answerEnglish: I like clothes with a simple style.

entries.example: 她是一位很有名的藝術家。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì yí wèi hěn yǒu míng de yì shù jiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's a very famous artist.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪一位藝術家？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ yí wèi yì shù jiā?
entries.questionEnglish: Which artist do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡的藝術家是草間彌生。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan de yì shù jiā shì cǎo jiān mí shēng.
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite artist is Yayoi Kusama.

entries.example: 停電的時候，房間一片黑暗。
entries.examplePinyin: tíng diàn de shí hòu, fáng jiān yí piàn hēi àn.
entries.exampleEnglish: When the power went out, the room was completely dark.
entries.question: 你一個人走黑暗的小路會怕嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yí gè rén zǒu hēi àn de xiǎo lù huì pà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you scared walking down a dark lane alone?
entries.answer: 會怕，我不喜歡走黑暗的小路。
entries.answerPinyin: huì pà, wǒ bù xǐ huan zǒu hēi àn de xiǎo lù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I don't like walking down dark lanes.

entries.example: 老闆給了我一個新任務。
entries.examplePinyin: lǎo bǎn gěi le wǒ yí gè xīn rèn wu.
entries.exampleEnglish: My boss gave me a new task.
entries.question: 你這個星期最重要的任務是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhè ge xīng qí zuì zhòng yào de rèn wu shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your most important task this week?
entries.answer: 我的任務是完成一份報告。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de rèn wu shì wán chéng yí fèn bào gào.
entries.answerEnglish: My task is to finish a report.

entries.example: 他相信上帝，每週都去教會。
entries.examplePinyin: tā xiāng xìn shàng dì, měi zhōu dōu qù jiào huì.
entries.exampleEnglish: He believes in God and goes to church every week.
entries.question: 在你的國家，很多人相信上帝嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zài nǐ de guó jiā, hěn duō rén xiāng xìn shàng dì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: In your country, do many people believe in God?
entries.answer: 對，很多人相信上帝。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, hěn duō rén xiāng xìn shàng dì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, many people believe in God.

entries.example: 這張表要填性別和年齡。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhāng biǎo yào tián xìng bié hé nián líng.
entries.exampleEnglish: You need to fill in your gender and age on this form.
entries.question: 你覺得工作能力和性別有關係嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de gōng zuò néng lì hé xìng bié yǒu guān xì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think ability at work has anything to do with gender?
entries.answer: 我覺得能力和性別沒有關係。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de néng lì hé xìng bié méi yǒu guān xì.
entries.answerEnglish: I don't think ability has anything to do with gender.

entries.example: 他的收入不高，但很穩定。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de shōu rù bù gāo, dàn hěn wěn dìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: His income isn't high, but it's steady.
entries.question: 在台北，一個月收入多少才夠用？
entries.questionPinyin: zài tái běi, yí gè yuè shōu rù duō shǎo cái gòu yòng?
entries.questionEnglish: In Taipei, how much monthly income is enough to live on?
entries.answer: 我覺得收入要五萬塊才夠用。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de shōu rù yào wǔ wàn kuài cái gòu yòng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think you need an income of fifty thousand to get by.

entries.example: 那次旅行是很美好的回憶。
entries.examplePinyin: nà cì lǚ xíng shì hěn měi hǎo de huí yì.
entries.exampleEnglish: That trip is a wonderful memory.
entries.question: 你在台灣最美好的回憶是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān zuì měi hǎo de huí yì shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your best memory of Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我最美好的回憶是第一次去墾丁。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì měi hǎo de huí yì shì dì yī cì qù kěn dīng.
entries.answerEnglish: My best memory is my first trip to Kenting.

entries.example: 他把錢拿去投資股票。
entries.examplePinyin: tā bǎ qián ná qù tóu zī gǔ piào.
entries.exampleEnglish: He put his money into stocks.
entries.question: 你有在投資嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu zài tóu zī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you invest?
entries.answer: 有，我每個月投資一點錢在基金上。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ měi gè yuè tóu zī yì diǎn qián zài jī jīn shàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I put a little money into funds every month.

entries.example: 這支手機有很多新功能。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhī shǒu jī yǒu hěn duō xīn gōng néng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This phone has lots of new features.
entries.question: 你最常用手機的什麼功能？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì cháng yòng shǒu jī de shén me gōng néng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which phone feature do you use most?
entries.answer: 我最常用拍照功能。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì cháng yòng pāi zhào gōng néng.
entries.answerEnglish: I use the camera the most.

entries.example: 搬家以後，我的睡眠改善了很多。
entries.examplePinyin: bān jiā yǐ hòu, wǒ de shuì mián gǎi shàn le hěn duō.
entries.exampleEnglish: Since I moved, my sleep has improved a lot.
entries.question: 你想改善生活中的哪一個問題？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng gǎi shàn shēng huó zhōng de nǎ yí gè wèn tí?
entries.questionEnglish: Which problem in your life would you like to improve?
entries.answer: 我想改善睡眠，不要太晚睡。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng gǎi shàn shuì mián, bú yào tài wǎn shuì.
entries.answerEnglish: I want to improve my sleep and not go to bed so late.

entries.example: 這個小村莊在山上，很安靜。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge xiǎo cūn zhuāng zài shān shàng, hěn ān jìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This little village is up in the mountains and very quiet.
entries.question: 你去過台灣的小村莊嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò tái wān de xiǎo cūn zhuāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to any small villages in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 去過，我去過花蓮的一個小村莊。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, wǒ qù guò huā lián de yí gè xiǎo cūn zhuāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've been to a small village in Hualien.

entries.example: 他承認是自己弄錯了。
entries.examplePinyin: tā chéng rèn shì zì jǐ nòng cuò le.
entries.exampleEnglish: He admitted that he had got it wrong.
entries.question: 你做錯事的時候，會馬上承認嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò cuò shì de shí hòu, huì mǎ shàng chéng rèn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you make a mistake, do you admit it right away?
entries.answer: 會，我會馬上承認錯誤。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì mǎ shàng chéng rèn cuò wù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I admit my mistakes right away.

entries.example: 下車時請帶好隨身物品。
entries.examplePinyin: xià chē shí qǐng dài hǎo suí shēn wù pǐn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please take all your belongings with you when you get off.
entries.question: 你出門一定會帶什麼物品？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chū mén yí dìng huì dài shén me wù pǐn?
entries.questionEnglish: What items do you always take when you go out?
entries.answer: 手機和錢包是我一定會帶的物品。
entries.answerPinyin: shǒu jī hé qián bāo shì wǒ yí dìng huì dài de wù pǐn.
entries.answerEnglish: My phone and wallet are the things I always take.

entries.example: 這張桌子的表面有點髒。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhāng zhuō zi de biǎo miàn yǒu diǎn zāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The surface of this table is a bit dirty.
entries.question: 你會只看表面就決定喜不喜歡一個人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zhǐ kàn biǎo miàn jiù jué dìng xǐ bu xǐ huan yí gè rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you decide whether you like someone just from appearances?
entries.answer: 不會，表面看到的不一定是真的。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, biǎo miàn kàn dào de bù yí dìng shì zhēn de.
entries.answerEnglish: No. What you see on the surface isn't always true.

entries.example: 行李的重量不能超過二十公斤。
entries.examplePinyin: xíng li de zhòng liàng bù néng chāo guò èr shí gōng jīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Your luggage can't weigh more than twenty kilos.
entries.question: 你旅行時會注意行李的重量嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ lǚ xíng shí huì zhù yì xíng li de zhòng liàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you keep an eye on your luggage weight when you travel?
entries.answer: 會，我每次都先量行李的重量。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi cì dōu xiān liáng xíng li de zhòng liàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always weigh my luggage first.

entries.example: 太冷了，我的手一直抖。
entries.examplePinyin: tài lěng le, wǒ de shǒu yì zhí dǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's so cold my hands won't stop shaking.
entries.question: 你緊張的時候會抖腳嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jǐn zhāng de shí hòu huì dǒu jiǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you jiggle your leg when you're nervous?
entries.answer: 會，我緊張的時候常常抖腳。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ jǐn zhāng de shí hòu cháng cháng dǒu jiǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often jiggle my leg when I'm nervous.

entries.example: 我無法想像沒有手機的生活。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ wú fǎ xiǎng xiàng méi yǒu shǒu jī de shēng huó.
entries.exampleEnglish: I can't imagine life without my phone.
entries.question: 你能想像十年後的自己嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ néng xiǎng xiàng shí nián hòu de zì jǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you imagine yourself ten years from now?
entries.answer: 我想像自己十年後還住在台灣。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng xiàng zì jǐ shí nián hòu hái zhù zài tái wān.
entries.answerEnglish: I imagine myself still living in Taiwan in ten years.

entries.example: 這位醫生很專業。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè wèi yī shēng hěn zhuān yè.
entries.exampleEnglish: This doctor is very professional.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼工作特別需要專業？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me gōng zuò tè bié xū yào zhuān yè?
entries.questionEnglish: Which jobs do you think especially need expertise?
entries.answer: 我覺得醫生的工作特別需要專業。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de yī shēng de gōng zuò tè bié xū yào zhuān yè.
entries.answerEnglish: I think a doctor's work especially needs expertise.

entries.example: 今晚的演出九點開始。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn wǎn de yǎn chū jiǔ diǎn kāi shǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Tonight's show starts at nine.
entries.question: 你最近看過什麼演出？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn kàn guò shén me yǎn chū?
entries.questionEnglish: What performances have you seen recently?
entries.answer: 我上個月看了五月天的演出。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ shàng gè yuè kàn le wǔ yuè tiān de yǎn chū.
entries.answerEnglish: Last month I saw Mayday perform.

entries.example: 我會說一些基本的中文。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ huì shuō yì xiē jī běn de zhōng wén.
entries.exampleEnglish: I can speak some basic Chinese.
entries.question: 在台灣生活，哪句基本的中文最有用？
entries.questionPinyin: zài tái wān shēng huó, nǎ jù jī běn de zhōng wén zuì yǒu yòng?
entries.questionEnglish: Living in Taiwan, which basic Chinese phrase is the most useful?
entries.answer: 「多少錢」是最基本的中文。
entries.answerPinyin: “duō shǎo qián” shì zuì jī běn de zhōng wén.
entries.answerEnglish: "How much is it?" is the most basic Chinese.

entries.example: 我還不太會用中文表達自己。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hái bú tài huì yòng zhōng wén biǎo dá zì jǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm still not very good at expressing myself in Chinese.
entries.question: 你覺得用中文表達想法難嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de yòng zhōng wén biǎo dá xiǎng fǎ nán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you find it hard to express your ideas in Chinese?
entries.answer: 很難，我常常不知道怎麼表達。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn nán, wǒ cháng cháng bù zhī dào zěn me biǎo dá.
entries.answerEnglish: Very hard. I often don't know how to express things.

entries.example: 這家店店員的態度很好。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn diàn yuán de tài dù hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: The staff in this shop have a great attitude.
entries.question: 你覺得工作態度重要嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de gōng zuò tài dù zhòng yào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think attitude at work is important?
entries.answer: 很重要，態度比能力更重要。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn zhòng yào, tài dù bǐ néng lì gèng zhòng yào.
entries.answerEnglish: Very. Attitude matters even more than ability.

entries.example: 他拿到了最佳新人獎。
entries.examplePinyin: tā ná dào le zuì jiā xīn rén jiǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: He won the Best New Artist award.
entries.question: 你得過什麼獎嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dé guò shén me jiǎng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever won a prize?
entries.answer: 我小時候得過游泳比賽的獎。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎo shí hòu dé guò yóu yǒng bǐ sài de jiǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: I won a prize in a swimming contest when I was a kid.

entries.example: 這本書有中文版本嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: zhè běn shū yǒu zhōng wén bǎn běn ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: Is there a Chinese edition of this book?
entries.question: 看電影時，你喜歡原文版本還是中文版本？
entries.questionPinyin: kàn diàn yǐng shí, nǐ xǐ huan yuán wén bǎn běn hái shì zhōng wén bǎn běn?
entries.questionEnglish: When you watch films, do you prefer the original version or the Chinese one?
entries.answer: 我喜歡原文版本，可以聽到演員的聲音。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan yuán wén bǎn běn, kě yǐ tīng dào yǎn yuán de shēng yīn.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer the original, so I can hear the actors' real voices.

entries.example: 他是電腦專家。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì diàn nǎo zhuān jiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a computer expert.
entries.question: 你是哪方面的專家？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shì nǎ fāng miàn de zhuān jiā?
entries.questionEnglish: What are you an expert in?
entries.answer: 我不是專家，但我很會做菜。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bú shì zhuān jiā, dàn wǒ hěn huì zuò cài.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm no expert, but I'm a good cook.

entries.example: 我們的旅行預算不多。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men de lǚ xíng yù suàn bù duō.
entries.exampleEnglish: We don't have a big travel budget.
entries.question: 你出國旅行的預算大概多少？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chū guó lǚ xíng de yù suàn dà gài duō shǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: About how much is your budget for a trip abroad?
entries.answer: 我的預算大概五萬塊台幣。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de yù suàn dà gài wǔ wàn kuài tái bì.
entries.answerEnglish: My budget is about fifty thousand NT dollars.

entries.example: 我還沒回覆老闆的信。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hái méi huí fù lǎo bǎn de xìn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I haven't replied to my boss's email yet.
entries.question: 你通常多快回覆訊息？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tōng cháng duō kuài huí fù xùn xí?
entries.questionEnglish: How quickly do you usually reply to messages?
entries.answer: 我通常一個小時內回覆。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ tōng cháng yí gè xiǎo shí nèi huí fù.
entries.answerEnglish: I usually reply within an hour.

entries.example: 台灣有很多不同的宗教。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān yǒu hěn duō bù tóng de zōng jiào.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are many different religions in Taiwan.
entries.question: 你們國家最大的宗教是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men guó jiā zuì dà de zōng jiào shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the biggest religion in your country?
entries.answer: 我們國家最大的宗教是天主教。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men guó jiā zuì dà de zōng jiào shì tiān zhǔ jiào.
entries.answerEnglish: The biggest religion in my country is Catholicism.

entries.example: 他是台大的教授。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì tái dà de jiào shòu.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a professor at National Taiwan University.
entries.question: 你上大學時最喜歡哪位教授？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shàng dà xué shí zuì xǐ huan nǎ wèi jiào shòu?
entries.questionEnglish: Which professor did you like best at university?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡我的歷史教授。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan wǒ de lì shǐ jiào shòu.
entries.answerEnglish: I liked my history professor best.

entries.example: 一張成人票兩百塊。
entries.examplePinyin: yì zhāng chéng rén piào liǎng bǎi kuài.
entries.exampleEnglish: An adult ticket is two hundred dollars.
entries.question: 你覺得幾歲才算是成人？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de jǐ suì cái suàn shì chéng rén?
entries.questionEnglish: At what age do you think someone counts as an adult?
entries.answer: 我覺得十八歲就是成人了。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de shí bā suì jiù shì chéng rén le.
entries.answerEnglish: I think you're an adult at eighteen.

entries.example: 這個方法很有效。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge fāng fǎ hěn yǒu xiào.
entries.exampleEnglish: This method is very effective.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼學中文的方法最有效？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me xué zhōng wén de fāng fǎ zuì yǒu xiào?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is the most effective way to learn Chinese?
entries.answer: 我覺得跟台灣人聊天最有效。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de gēn tái wān rén liáo tiān zuì yǒu xiào.
entries.answerEnglish: I think chatting with Taiwanese people is the most effective.

entries.example: 我住在宜蘭縣。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zhù zài yí lán xiàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I live in Yilan County.
entries.question: 你最喜歡台灣的哪一個縣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan tái wān de nǎ yí gè xiàn?
entries.questionEnglish: Which county in Taiwan do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡花蓮縣。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan huā lián xiàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I like Hualien County best.

entries.example: 這家店的麵包種類很多。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn de miàn bāo zhǒng lèi hěn duō.
entries.exampleEnglish: This bakery has lots of kinds of bread.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的水果種類多嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān de shuǐ guǒ zhǒng lèi duō ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwan has a lot of kinds of fruit?
entries.answer: 很多，種類比我的國家多。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn duō, zhǒng lèi bǐ wǒ de guó jiā duō.
entries.answerEnglish: Lots. There are more kinds than in my country.

entries.example: 我昨天看完了第三章。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zuó tiān kàn wán le dì sān zhāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I finished chapter three yesterday.
entries.question: 你看書的時候，一天看幾章？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn shū de shí hòu, yì tiān kàn jǐ zhāng?
entries.questionEnglish: When you read a book, how many chapters do you read a day?
entries.answer: 我一天大概看一章。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yì tiān dà gài kàn yì zhāng.
entries.answerEnglish: I read about one chapter a day.

entries.example: 這條河流很乾淨，可以看到魚。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tiáo hé liú hěn gān jìng, kě yǐ kàn dào yú.
entries.exampleEnglish: This river is so clean you can see the fish.
entries.question: 你的家鄉有大河流嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de jiā xiāng yǒu dà hé liú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a big river in your hometown?
entries.answer: 有，我家鄉有一條很長的河流。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiā xiāng yǒu yì tiáo hěn cháng de hé liú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a very long river in my hometown.

entries.example: 在工作方面，他很認真。
entries.examplePinyin: zài gōng zuò fāng miàn, tā hěn rèn zhēn.
entries.exampleEnglish: When it comes to work, he's very conscientious.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣哪方面最好？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān nǎ fāng miàn zuì hǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: In what respect do you think Taiwan is best?
entries.answer: 我覺得交通方面最好。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de jiāo tōng fāng miàn zuì hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: I think the transport is the best thing.

entries.example: 他是我很好的工作夥伴。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì wǒ hěn hǎo de gōng zuò huǒ bàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a great work partner.
entries.question: 你有語言交換的夥伴嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu yǔ yán jiāo huàn de huǒ bàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a language exchange partner?
entries.answer: 有，我的夥伴是一個台灣大學生。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de huǒ bàn shì yí gè tái wān dà xué shēng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my partner is a Taiwanese university student.

entries.example: 他拒絕了我的邀請。
entries.examplePinyin: tā jù jué le wǒ de yāo qǐng.
entries.exampleEnglish: He turned down my invitation.
entries.question: 你很難拒絕別人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ hěn nán jù jué bié rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you find it hard to say no to people?
entries.answer: 對，我很不會拒絕別人。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ hěn bú huì jù jué bié rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm really bad at saying no to people.

entries.example: 菜單上素食的選項不多。
entries.examplePinyin: cài dān shàng sù shí de xuǎn xiàng bù duō.
entries.exampleEnglish: There aren't many vegetarian options on the menu.
entries.question: 點餐的時候，你喜歡選項多還是少？
entries.questionPinyin: diǎn cān de shí hòu, nǐ xǐ huan xuǎn xiàng duō hái shì shǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: When you order food, do you like lots of options or just a few?
entries.answer: 我喜歡選項少一點，比較好決定。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan xuǎn xiàng shǎo yì diǎn, bǐ jiào hǎo jué dìng.
entries.answerEnglish: I like fewer options. It's easier to decide.

entries.example: 家裡的瓦斯用完了。
entries.examplePinyin: jiā lǐ de wǎ sī yòng wán le.
entries.exampleEnglish: We've run out of gas at home.
entries.question: 你家用瓦斯還是電來煮飯？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yòng wǎ sī hái shì diàn lái zhǔ fàn?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you cook with gas or electricity at home?
entries.answer: 我家用瓦斯煮飯。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā yòng wǎ sī zhǔ fàn.
entries.answerEnglish: We cook with gas at home.

entries.example: 除非下雨，不然我們都會去。
entries.examplePinyin: chú fēi xià yǔ, bù rán wǒ men dōu huì qù.
entries.exampleEnglish: We'll go unless it rains.
entries.question: 你週末會工作嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhōu mò huì gōng zuò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you work at the weekend?
entries.answer: 不會，除非有很急的事。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, chú fēi yǒu hěn jí de shì.
entries.answerEnglish: No, unless something urgent comes up.

entries.example: 我明天早上要去面試。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ míng tiān zǎo shàng yào qù miàn shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: I have a job interview tomorrow morning.
entries.question: 你面試的時候會緊張嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ miàn shì de shí hòu huì jǐn zhāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you get nervous at interviews?
entries.answer: 會，我每次面試都很緊張。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi cì miàn shì dōu hěn jǐn zhāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm always nervous at interviews.

entries.example: 今天下午有一場演講。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn tiān xià wǔ yǒu yì chǎng yǎn jiǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a talk this afternoon.
entries.question: 你在很多人面前演講會緊張嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài hěn duō rén miàn qián yǎn jiǎng huì jǐn zhāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you get nervous giving a speech in front of lots of people?
entries.answer: 會，我一演講就很緊張。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ yì yǎn jiǎng jiù hěn jǐn zhāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I get nervous as soon as I start a speech.

entries.example: 明天下雨的可能性很高。
entries.examplePinyin: míng tiān xià yǔ de kě néng xìng hěn gāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a high chance of rain tomorrow.
entries.question: 你覺得你留在台灣工作的可能性高嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ liú zài tái wān gōng zuò de kě néng xìng gāo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: How likely do you think it is that you'll stay and work in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我覺得可能性很高。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de kě néng xìng hěn gāo.
entries.answerEnglish: I think it's very likely.

entries.example: 警察正在調查這件事。
entries.examplePinyin: jǐng chá zhèng zài diào chá zhè jiàn shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: The police are investigating the matter.
entries.question: 你填過網路上的問卷調查嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tián guò wǎng lù shang de wèn juàn diào chá ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever filled out an online survey?
entries.answer: 填過，我常常填網路調查。
entries.answerPinyin: tián guò, wǒ cháng cháng tián wǎng lù diào chá.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often fill out online surveys.

entries.example: 這支舊手錶很值錢。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhī jiù shǒu biǎo hěn zhí qián.
entries.exampleEnglish: This old watch is worth a lot.
entries.question: 你家最值錢的東西是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā zuì zhí qián de dōng xī shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the most valuable thing in your home?
entries.answer: 我家最值錢的是我的電腦。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā zuì zhí qián de shì wǒ de diàn nǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: The most valuable thing in my home is my computer.

entries.example: 學中文對我來說是很大的挑戰。
entries.examplePinyin: xué zhōng wén duì wǒ lái shuō shì hěn dà de tiǎo zhàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Learning Chinese is a big challenge for me.
entries.question: 在台灣生活，最大的挑戰是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: zài tái wān shēng huó, zuì dà de tiǎo zhàn shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the biggest challenge of living in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 最大的挑戰是聽懂台語。
entries.answerPinyin: zuì dà de tiǎo zhàn shì tīng dǒng tái yǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: The biggest challenge is understanding Taiwanese.

entries.example: 我的夢想是環遊世界。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de mèng xiǎng shì huán yóu shì jiè.
entries.exampleEnglish: My dream is to travel around the world.
entries.question: 你的夢想是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de mèng xiǎng shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your dream?
entries.answer: 我的夢想是在台灣開一家咖啡店。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de mèng xiǎng shì zài tái wān kāi yì jiā kā fēi diàn.
entries.answerEnglish: My dream is to open a café in Taiwan.

entries.example: 這道菜缺少一點鹽。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè dào cài quē shǎo yì diǎn yán.
entries.exampleEnglish: This dish needs a little more salt.
entries.question: 你覺得你的生活缺少什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ de shēng huó quē shǎo shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think your life is missing?
entries.answer: 我的生活缺少運動。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de shēng huó quē shǎo yùn dòng.
entries.answerEnglish: My life is short on exercise.

entries.example: 前方路口請右轉。
entries.examplePinyin: qián fāng lù kǒu qǐng yòu zhuǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Turn right at the intersection ahead.
entries.question: 你走路時會看手機，還是看前方？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zǒu lù shí huì kàn shǒu jī, hái shì kàn qián fāng?
entries.questionEnglish: When you walk, do you look at your phone or straight ahead?
entries.answer: 我會看前方，比較安全。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì kàn qián fāng, bǐ jiào ān quán.
entries.answerEnglish: I look ahead. It's safer.

entries.example: 這本雜誌有很多年輕讀者。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè běn zá zhì yǒu hěn duō nián qīng dú zhě.
entries.exampleEnglish: This magazine has lots of young readers.
entries.question: 你覺得現在看紙本書的讀者多嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de xiàn zài kàn zhǐ běn shū de dú zhě duō ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think many people still read printed books these days?
entries.answer: 不多，紙本書的讀者越來越少了。
entries.answerPinyin: bù duō, zhǐ běn shū de dú zhě yuè lái yuè shǎo le.
entries.answerEnglish: Not many. There are fewer and fewer readers of printed books.

entries.example: 今晚的演唱會有一萬個觀眾。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn wǎn de yǎn chàng huì yǒu yí wàn gè guān zhòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Tonight's concert has an audience of ten thousand.
entries.question: 你喜歡當觀眾還是上台表演？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan dāng guān zhòng hái shì shàng tái biǎo yǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer being in the audience or performing on stage?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡當觀眾。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan dāng guān zhòng.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd rather be in the audience.

entries.example: 我最喜歡的樂團是五月天。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan de yuè tuán shì wǔ yuè tiān.
entries.exampleEnglish: My favorite band is Mayday.
entries.question: 你喜歡哪一個樂團？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan nǎ yí gè yuè tuán?
entries.questionEnglish: Which band do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡告五人這個樂團。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan gào wǔ rén zhè ge yuè tuán.
entries.answerEnglish: I like the band Accusefive.

entries.example: 我們週末去農場摘草莓。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zhōu mò qù nóng chǎng zhāi cǎo méi.
entries.exampleEnglish: We're going strawberry picking at a farm this weekend.
entries.question: 你去過台灣的農場嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò tái wān de nóng chǎng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to a farm in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 去過，我去過清境農場。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, wǒ qù guò qīng jìng nóng chǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've been to Qingjing Farm.

entries.example: 請把這份文件寄給我。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng bǎ zhè fèn wén jiàn jì gěi wǒ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please send me this document.
entries.question: 你每天要處理很多文件嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ měi tiān yào chǔ lǐ hěn duō wén jiàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have to deal with lots of documents every day?
entries.answer: 對，我每天要看很多文件。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ měi tiān yào kàn hěn duō wén jiàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have to read lots of documents every day.

entries.example: 這塊餅乾的形狀像愛心。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè kuài bǐng gān de xíng zhuàng xiàng ài xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This cookie is shaped like a heart.
entries.question: 你喜歡什麼形狀的杯子？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan shén me xíng zhuàng de bēi zi?
entries.questionEnglish: What shape of cup do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡形狀簡單的杯子。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan xíng zhuàng jiǎn dān de bēi zi.
entries.answerEnglish: I like cups with a simple shape.

entries.example: 這間健身房的設備很新。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiān jiàn shēn fáng de shè bèi hěn xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The equipment in this gym is very new.
entries.question: 你的辦公室設備好嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de bàn gōng shì shè bèi hǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is the equipment in your office good?
entries.answer: 很好，我們辦公室的設備都很新。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn hǎo, wǒ men bàn gōng shì de shè bèi dōu hěn xīn.
entries.answerEnglish: Very good. All the equipment in our office is new.

entries.example: 朋友給了我很大的力量。
entries.examplePinyin: péng yǒu gěi le wǒ hěn dà de lì liàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: My friends gave me great strength.
entries.question: 你難過的時候，什麼給你力量？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ nán guò de shí hòu, shén me gěi nǐ lì liàng?
entries.questionEnglish: When you're down, what gives you strength?
entries.answer: 家人的支持給我很大的力量。
entries.answerPinyin: jiā rén de zhī chí gěi wǒ hěn dà de lì liàng.
entries.answerEnglish: My family's support gives me great strength.

entries.example: 我的薪水有四分之一拿去付房租。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de xīn shuǐ yǒu sì fēn zhī yī ná qù fù fáng zū.
entries.exampleEnglish: A quarter of my salary goes on rent.
entries.question: 你的薪水有多少拿去付房租？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de xīn shuǐ yǒu duō shǎo ná qù fù fáng zū?
entries.questionEnglish: How much of your salary goes on rent?
entries.answer: 大概四分之一拿去付房租。
entries.answerPinyin: dà gài sì fēn zhī yī ná qù fù fáng zū.
entries.answerEnglish: About a quarter goes on rent.

entries.example: 我家距離捷運站很近。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ jiā jù lí jié yùn zhàn hěn jìn.
entries.exampleEnglish: My home is very close to the MRT station.
entries.question: 你家距離公司多遠？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā jù lí gōng sī duō yuǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: How far is your home from your office?
entries.answer: 我家距離公司大概二十分鐘。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā jù lí gōng sī dà gài èr shí fēn zhōng.
entries.answerEnglish: My home is about twenty minutes from the office.

entries.example: 我每個月都要繳保險費。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi gè yuè dōu yào jiǎo bǎo xiǎn fèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: I have to pay insurance premiums every month.
entries.question: 你在台灣有買保險嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān yǒu mǎi bǎo xiǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you bought insurance in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 有，公司幫我買了保險。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, gōng sī bāng wǒ mǎi le bǎo xiǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my company bought insurance for me.

entries.example: 買東西前，我會先看網路評論。
entries.examplePinyin: mǎi dōng xī qián, wǒ huì xiān kàn wǎng lù píng lùn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Before I buy something, I check the online reviews first.
entries.question: 你去餐廳前會看評論嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù cān tīng qián huì kàn píng lùn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you read reviews before going to a restaurant?
entries.answer: 會，我都先看評論再決定。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōu xiān kàn píng lùn zài jué dìng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always read the reviews before deciding.

entries.example: 我最近睡眠不太好。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zuì jìn shuì mián bú tài hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: I haven't been sleeping well lately.
entries.question: 你的睡眠時間夠嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de shuì mián shí jiān gòu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you get enough sleep?
entries.answer: 不太夠，我每天睡眠不到六小時。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài gòu, wǒ měi tiān shuì mián bú dào liù xiǎo shí.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. I sleep less than six hours a night.

entries.example: 下雨後，鞋子上都是泥土。
entries.examplePinyin: xià yǔ hòu, xié zǐ shàng dōu shì ní tǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: After the rain, my shoes were covered in mud.
entries.question: 你小時候常玩泥土嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu cháng wán ní tǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you often play in the dirt as a child?
entries.answer: 常玩，我很喜歡玩泥土。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng wán, wǒ hěn xǐ huan wán ní tǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I loved playing in the dirt.

entries.example: 這些點數可以兌換一杯咖啡。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè xiē diǎn shù kě yǐ duì huàn yì bēi kā fēi.
entries.exampleEnglish: These points can be redeemed for a cup of coffee.
entries.question: 你都在哪裡兌換外幣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dōu zài nǎ lǐ duì huàn wài bì?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you usually exchange foreign currency?
entries.answer: 我都在機場的銀行兌換。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dōu zài jī chǎng de yín háng duì huàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I usually exchange it at the bank at the airport.

entries.example: 請在表格下方簽名。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng zài biǎo gé xià fāng qiān míng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please sign at the bottom of the form.
entries.question: 你填表格時會先看下方的說明嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tián biǎo gé shí huì xiān kàn xià fāng de shuō míng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you fill in a form, do you read the notes at the bottom first?
entries.answer: 會，我會先看下方的說明。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì xiān kàn xià fāng de shuō míng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I read the notes at the bottom first.

entries.example: 他投籃很準。
entries.examplePinyin: tā tóu lán hěn zhǔn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a very accurate shooter.
entries.question: 你打籃球時投籃準嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dǎ lán qiú shí tóu lán zhǔn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you accurate when you shoot in basketball?
entries.answer: 不太準，我投籃常常沒進。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài zhǔn, wǒ tóu lán cháng cháng méi jìn.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. My shots often miss.

entries.example: 快點走，否則會遲到。
entries.examplePinyin: kuài diǎn zǒu, fǒu zé huì chí dào.
entries.exampleEnglish: Hurry up, or we'll be late.
entries.question: 你早上為什麼要早點出門？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zǎo shàng wèi shén me yào zǎo diǎn chū mén?
entries.questionEnglish: Why do you leave home early in the morning?
entries.answer: 要早點出門，否則捷運很擠。
entries.answerPinyin: yào zǎo diǎn chū mén, fǒu zé jié yùn hěn jǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I have to leave early, otherwise the MRT is packed.

entries.example: 我每週固定去健身房兩次。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi zhōu gù dìng qù jiàn shēn fáng liǎng cì.
entries.exampleEnglish: I go to the gym twice a week, regularly.
entries.question: 你每天有固定的運動時間嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ měi tiān yǒu gù dìng de yùn dòng shí jiān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a fixed time for exercise each day?
entries.answer: 有，我每天晚上固定去跑步。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ měi tiān wǎn shàng gù dìng qù pǎo bù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I go running every evening.

entries.example: 台北市民可以免費參加這個活動。
entries.examplePinyin: tái běi shì mín kě yǐ miǎn fèi cān jiā zhè ge huó dòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taipei residents can join this event for free.
entries.question: 你覺得台北市民友善嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái běi shì mín yǒu shàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think the people of Taipei are friendly?
entries.answer: 很友善，台北市民常幫我指路。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn yǒu shàn, tái běi shì mín cháng bāng wǒ zhǐ lù.
entries.answerEnglish: Very. Taipei people often give me directions.

entries.example: 他把箱子抬起來放上車。
entries.examplePinyin: tā bǎ xiāng zǐ tái qǐ lái fàng shàng chē.
entries.exampleEnglish: He lifted the box and put it in the car.
entries.question: 你搬家時抬起過很重的東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bān jiā shí tái qǐ guò hěn zhòng de dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you lifted anything heavy when moving house?
entries.answer: 有，我跟朋友一起抬起了沙發。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ gēn péng yǒu yì qǐ tái qǐ le shā fā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a friend and I lifted the sofa together.

entries.example: 他聽到這個消息，反應很大。
entries.examplePinyin: tā tīng dào zhè ge xiāo xí, fǎn yìng hěn dà.
entries.exampleEnglish: He reacted strongly when he heard the news.
entries.question: 你第一次吃臭豆腐的反應是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dì yī cì chī chòu dòu fu de fǎn yìng shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What was your reaction the first time you ate stinky tofu?
entries.answer: 我的反應是：好臭，但是很好吃！
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de fǎn yìng shì: hǎo chòu, dàn shì hěn hǎo chī!
entries.answerEnglish: My reaction was: it stinks, but it's delicious!

entries.example: 很多媒體都報導了這件事。
entries.examplePinyin: hěn duō méi tǐ dōu bào dǎo le zhè jiàn shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: A lot of media outlets reported on this.
entries.question: 你平常從什麼媒體看新聞？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ píng cháng cóng shén me méi tǐ kàn xīn wén?
entries.questionEnglish: What media do you usually get your news from?
entries.answer: 我常用社群媒體看新聞。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cháng yòng shè qún méi tǐ kàn xīn wén.
entries.answerEnglish: I usually get my news from social media.

entries.example: 睡覺可以讓大腦休息。
entries.examplePinyin: shuì jiào kě yǐ ràng dà nǎo xiū xí.
entries.exampleEnglish: Sleep lets your brain rest.
entries.question: 你覺得學中文對大腦好嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de xué zhōng wén duì dà nǎo hǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think learning Chinese is good for your brain?
entries.answer: 很好，學中文可以訓練大腦。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn hǎo, xué zhōng wén kě yǐ xùn liàn dà nǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Very. Learning Chinese trains your brain.

entries.example: 我朋友開了一間設計工作室。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ péng yǒu kāi le yì jiān shè jì gōng zuò shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: My friend opened a design studio.
entries.question: 你想要有自己的工作室嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng yào yǒu zì jǐ de gōng zuò shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to have your own studio?
entries.answer: 想，我想要一間攝影工作室。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, wǒ xiǎng yào yì jiān shè yǐng gōng zuò shì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like a photography studio.

entries.example: 我的班機晚上八點起飛。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de bān jī wǎn shàng bā diǎn qǐ fēi.
entries.exampleEnglish: My flight takes off at 8 p.m.
entries.question: 你回國都搭直飛的班機嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huí guó dōu dā zhí fēi de bān jī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you always take a direct flight home?
entries.answer: 不一定，直飛的班機比較貴。
entries.answerPinyin: bù yí dìng, zhí fēi de bān jī bǐ jiào guì.
entries.answerEnglish: Not always. Direct flights are more expensive.

entries.example: 她堅持每天走路上班。
entries.examplePinyin: tā jiān chí měi tiān zǒu lù shàng bān.
entries.exampleEnglish: She insists on walking to work every day.
entries.question: 你有堅持做什麼運動嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu jiān chí zuò shén me yùn dòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there any exercise you stick with?
entries.answer: 有，我堅持每天早上跑步。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiān chí měi tiān zǎo shàng pǎo bù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I keep up running every morning.

entries.example: 他送我一瓶葡萄酒。
entries.examplePinyin: tā sòng wǒ yì píng pú táo jiǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: He gave me a bottle of wine.
entries.question: 你喜歡喝葡萄酒嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan hē pú táo jiǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like wine?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常喝法國的葡萄酒。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ cháng hē fǎ guó de pú táo jiǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often drink French wine.

entries.example: 早上喝咖啡讓我很有活力。
entries.examplePinyin: zǎo shàng hē kā fēi ràng wǒ hěn yǒu huó lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Coffee in the morning gives me energy.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼時候最有活力？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me shí hòu zuì yǒu huó lì?
entries.questionEnglish: When do you feel most energetic?
entries.answer: 我早上最有活力。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zǎo shàng zuì yǒu huó lì.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm most energetic in the morning.

entries.example: 我平均每天走一萬步。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ píng jūn měi tiān zǒu yí wàn bù.
entries.exampleEnglish: On average I walk ten thousand steps a day.
entries.question: 你平均一天睡幾個小時？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ píng jūn yì tiān shuì jǐ gè xiǎo shí?
entries.questionEnglish: On average, how many hours do you sleep a day?
entries.answer: 我平均一天睡七個小時。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ píng jūn yì tiān shuì qī gè xiǎo shí.
entries.answerEnglish: On average I sleep seven hours a day.

entries.example: 工作和生活要保持平衡。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng zuò hé shēng huó yào bǎo chí píng héng.
entries.exampleEnglish: You need to keep a balance between work and life.
entries.question: 你的工作和生活平衡嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng zuò hé shēng huó píng héng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your work-life balance good?
entries.answer: 還不太平衡，我常常加班。
entries.answerPinyin: hái bú tài píng héng, wǒ cháng cháng jiā bān.
entries.answerEnglish: Not very balanced. I often work overtime.

entries.example: 這間咖啡店又明亮又安靜。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiān kā fēi diàn yòu míng liàng yòu ān jìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This café is bright and quiet.
entries.question: 你喜歡明亮的房間嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan míng liàng de fáng jiān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like bright rooms?
entries.answer: 喜歡，明亮的房間讓我心情好。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, míng liàng de fáng jiān ràng wǒ xīn qíng hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, bright rooms put me in a good mood.

entries.example: 我半夜聽到隔壁小孩的哭聲。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bàn yè tīng dào gé bì xiǎo hái de kū shēng.
entries.exampleEnglish: In the middle of the night I heard the neighbor's child crying.
entries.question: 你住的地方晚上會聽到哭聲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhù de dì fāng wǎn shàng huì tīng dào kū shēng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you hear crying at night where you live?
entries.answer: 有時候，樓上寶寶的哭聲很大。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu, lóu shàng bǎo bao de kū shēng hěn dà.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. The baby upstairs cries loudly.

entries.example: 這裡可以用手機付款。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè lǐ kě yǐ yòng shǒu jī fù kuǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: You can pay with your phone here.
entries.question: 你買東西常用什麼方式付款？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi dōng xī cháng yòng shén me fāng shì fù kuǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you usually pay when you shop?
entries.answer: 我常用悠遊卡付款。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cháng yòng yōu yóu kǎ fù kuǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: I usually pay with my EasyCard.

entries.example: 請把檔案寄給我。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng bǎ dǎng àn jì gěi wǒ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please send me the file.
entries.question: 你電腦裡的檔案整理好了嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ diàn nǎo lǐ de dǎng àn zhěng lǐ hǎo le ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are the files on your computer organized?
entries.answer: 沒有，我的檔案很亂。
entries.answerPinyin: méi yǒu, wǒ de dǎng àn hěn luàn.
entries.answerEnglish: No, my files are a mess.

entries.example: 這次旅行的行程很滿。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì lǚ xíng de xíng chéng hěn mǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The itinerary for this trip is packed.
entries.question: 你下次旅行的行程排好了嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xià cì lǚ xíng de xíng chéng pái hǎo le ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you planned the itinerary for your next trip?
entries.answer: 還沒，行程還在想。
entries.answerPinyin: hái méi, xíng chéng hái zài xiǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: Not yet, I'm still working on the itinerary.

entries.example: 我們公司的主管大多是女性。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men gōng sī de zhǔ guǎn dà duō shì nǚ xìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Most of the managers at our company are women.
entries.question: 你的公司女性多還是男性多？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng sī nǚ xìng duō hái shì nán xìng duō?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there more women or men at your company?
entries.answer: 女性比較多，大概有七成。
entries.answerPinyin: nǚ xìng bǐ jiào duō, dà gài yǒu qī chéng.
entries.answerEnglish: More women, about seventy percent.

entries.example: 我很信任我的醫生。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hěn xìn rèn wǒ de yī shēng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I really trust my doctor.
entries.question: 你最信任誰？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xìn rèn shéi?
entries.questionEnglish: Who do you trust the most?
entries.answer: 我最信任我的家人。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xìn rèn wǒ de jiā rén.
entries.answerEnglish: I trust my family the most.

entries.example: 出門前請確認一下天氣。
entries.examplePinyin: chū mén qián qǐng què rèn yí xià tiān qì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Check the weather before you go out.
entries.question: 你出門前會確認什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chū mén qián huì què rèn shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you check before you leave home?
entries.answer: 我會確認有沒有帶鑰匙。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì què rèn yǒu méi yǒu dài yào shi.
entries.answerEnglish: I check that I have my keys.

entries.example: 我的阿公以前是農夫。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de ā gōng yǐ qián shì nóng fū.
entries.exampleEnglish: My grandpa used to be a farmer.
entries.question: 你想當農夫過生活嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng dāng nóng fū guò shēng huó ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to live as a farmer?
entries.answer: 不想，當農夫太辛苦了。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xiǎng, dāng nóng fū tài xīn kǔ le.
entries.answerEnglish: No, being a farmer is too hard.

entries.example: 這段旅程讓我很難忘。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè duàn lǚ chéng ràng wǒ hěn nán wàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This trip was unforgettable for me.
entries.question: 你最難忘的旅程是哪一次？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì nán wàng de lǚ chéng shì nǎ yí cì?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your most unforgettable trip?
entries.answer: 最難忘的旅程是騎機車環島。
entries.answerPinyin: zuì nán wàng de lǚ chéng shì qí jī chē huán dǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: My most unforgettable trip was riding a scooter around Taiwan.

entries.example: 我比較喜歡國內旅遊。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan guó nèi lǚ yóu.
entries.exampleEnglish: I prefer domestic travel.
entries.question: 你在台灣常去國內旅遊嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān cháng qù guó nèi lǚ yóu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often travel around Taiwan?
entries.answer: 常去，國內旅遊很方便。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng qù, guó nèi lǚ yóu hěn fāng biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, traveling within the country is easy.

entries.example: 這是一家很知名的牛肉麵店。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shì yì jiā hěn zhī míng de niú ròu miàn diàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a very well-known beef noodle shop.
entries.question: 你知道台灣有哪些知名的小吃？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào tái wān yǒu nǎ xiē zhī míng de xiǎo chī?
entries.questionEnglish: Which famous Taiwanese snacks do you know?
entries.answer: 很知名的有小籠包和牛肉麵。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn zhī míng de yǒu xiǎo lóng bāo hé niú ròu miàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Well-known ones include xiaolongbao and beef noodles.

entries.example: 這件褲子的長度剛好。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn kù zǐ de cháng dù gāng hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: These trousers are just the right length.
entries.question: 你喜歡什麼長度的頭髮？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan shén me cháng dù de tóu fǎ?
entries.questionEnglish: What length of hair do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡到肩膀的長度。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan dào jiān bǎng de cháng dù.
entries.answerEnglish: I like it shoulder length.

entries.example: 我把網站連結傳給你。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bǎ wǎng zhàn lián jié chuán gěi nǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'll send you the link to the website.
entries.question: 你常傳影片連結給朋友嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng chuán yǐng piàn lián jié gěi péng yǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often send video links to friends?
entries.answer: 常常，我每天都傳連結給朋友。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ měi tiān dōu chuán lián jié gěi péng yǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: All the time. I send my friends links every day.

entries.example: 我的朋友大多住在台北。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de péng yǒu dà duō zhù zài tái běi.
entries.exampleEnglish: Most of my friends live in Taipei.
entries.question: 你週末大多做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhōu mò dà duō zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you mostly do at the weekend?
entries.answer: 我週末大多在家休息。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhōu mò dà duō zài jiā xiū xí.
entries.answerEnglish: At the weekend I mostly rest at home.

entries.example: 我懷疑他沒說實話。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ huái yí tā méi shuō shí huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: I suspect he isn't telling the truth.
entries.question: 你會懷疑網路上的新聞嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì huái yí wǎng lù shang de xīn wén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you doubt the news you read online?
entries.answer: 會，我常懷疑新聞是假的。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng huái yí xīn wén shì jiǎ de.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often suspect the news is fake.

entries.example: 我把他的電話號碼抄下來了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bǎ tā de diàn huà hào mǎ chāo xià lái le.
entries.exampleEnglish: I copied down his phone number.
entries.question: 你上課會把生詞抄下來嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shàng kè huì bǎ shēng cí chāo xià lái ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you copy down new words in class?
entries.answer: 會，我會把生詞抄在本子上。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì bǎ shēng cí chāo zài běn zi shàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I copy new words into my notebook.

entries.example: 可以請你再重複一次嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: kě yǐ qǐng nǐ zài chóng fù yí cì ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: Could you repeat that, please?
entries.question: 你聽不懂時會請別人重複嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tīng bù dǒng shí huì qǐng bié rén chóng fù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you don't understand, do you ask people to repeat?
entries.answer: 會，我會請他們重複一次。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì qǐng tā men chóng fù yí cì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I ask them to say it again.

entries.example: 這張海報的文字太小了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhāng hǎi bào de wén zì tài xiǎo le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The text on this poster is too small.
entries.question: 你覺得中文的文字漂亮嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zhōng wén de wén zì piào liang ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Chinese writing is beautiful?
entries.answer: 很漂亮，繁體的文字特別美。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn piào liang, fán tǐ de wén zì tè bié měi.
entries.answerEnglish: Very. Traditional characters are especially beautiful.

entries.example: 我去便利商店拿包裹。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ qù biàn lì shāng diàn ná bāo guǒ.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm going to the convenience store to pick up a package.
entries.question: 你常在便利商店取包裹嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng zài biàn lì shāng diàn qǔ bāo guǒ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often pick up packages at convenience stores?
entries.answer: 常常，我的包裹都寄到便利商店。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ de bāo guǒ dōu jì dào biàn lì shāng diàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Often. All my packages get sent to the convenience store.

entries.example: 我們要尊重不同的文化。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men yào zūn zhòng bù tóng de wén huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: We should respect different cultures.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣人尊重外國人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān rén zūn zhòng wài guó rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwanese people respect foreigners?
entries.answer: 我覺得大部分台灣人都很尊重外國人。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de dà bù fèn tái wān rén dōu hěn zūn zhòng wài guó rén.
entries.answerEnglish: I think most Taiwanese people respect foreigners a lot.

entries.example: 可以借我一下膠帶嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: kě yǐ jiè wǒ yí xià jiāo dài ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: Could I borrow the tape for a moment?
entries.question: 你家的膠帶放在哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de jiāo dài fàng zài nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you keep the tape at home?
entries.answer: 膠帶放在書桌的抽屜裡。
entries.answerPinyin: jiāo dài fàng zài shū zhuō de chōu tì lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: The tape is in my desk drawer.

entries.example: 我們買了一打啤酒去海邊。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men mǎi le yì dá pí jiǔ qù hǎi biān.
entries.exampleEnglish: We bought a dozen beers and went to the beach.
entries.question: 你一次會買一打啤酒嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yí cì huì mǎi yì dá pí jiǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you buy a dozen beers at once?
entries.answer: 不會，一打太多了。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, yì dá tài duō le.
entries.answerEnglish: No, a dozen is too many.

entries.example: 她穿了一件白色洋裝。
entries.examplePinyin: tā chuān le yí jiàn bái sè yáng zhuāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's wearing a white dress.
entries.question: 你覺得夏天穿洋裝舒服嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de xià tiān chuān yáng zhuāng shū fú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think dresses are comfortable in summer?
entries.answer: 很舒服，夏天我常穿洋裝。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn shū fú, xià tiān wǒ cháng chuān yáng zhuāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Very. I often wear dresses in summer.

entries.example: 我很樂意幫忙。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hěn lè yì bāng máng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm happy to help.
entries.question: 朋友搬家，你樂意去幫忙嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: péng yǒu bān jiā, nǐ lè yì qù bāng máng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: If a friend is moving house, are you happy to help?
entries.answer: 當然，我很樂意幫忙。
entries.answerPinyin: dāng rán, wǒ hěn lè yì bāng máng.
entries.answerEnglish: Of course, I'm glad to help.

entries.example: 我上網搜尋附近的餐廳。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ shàng wǎng sōu xún fù jìn de cān tīng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I searched online for nearby restaurants.
entries.question: 你最常上網搜尋什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì cháng shàng wǎng sōu xún shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you search for online most?
entries.answer: 我最常搜尋好吃的餐廳。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì cháng sōu xún hǎo chī de cān tīng.
entries.answerEnglish: I search for good restaurants most.

entries.example: 大樓的警衛幫我收包裹。
entries.examplePinyin: dà lóu de jǐng wèi bāng wǒ shōu bāo guǒ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The building's security guard takes in my packages.
entries.question: 你住的大樓有警衛嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhù de dà lóu yǒu jǐng wèi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your building have a security guard?
entries.answer: 有，我們大樓的警衛很親切。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men dà lóu de jǐng wèi hěn qīn qiè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our building's guard is very friendly.

entries.example: 我對這次面試很有信心。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ duì zhè cì miàn shì hěn yǒu xìn xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm confident about this interview.
entries.question: 你對說中文有信心嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì shuō zhōng wén yǒu xìn xīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you confident speaking Chinese?
entries.answer: 越來越有信心了。
entries.answerPinyin: yuè lái yuè yǒu xìn xīn le.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm getting more and more confident.

entries.example: 週末我要清理冰箱。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōu mò wǒ yào qīng lǐ bīng xiāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm going to clean out the fridge at the weekend.
entries.question: 你多久清理一次房間？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duō jiǔ qīng lǐ yí cì fáng jiān?
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you clean your room?
entries.answer: 我每個禮拜清理一次房間。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ měi gè lǐ bài qīng lǐ yí cì fáng jiān.
entries.answerEnglish: I clean my room once a week.

entries.example: 請把電視的音量關小一點。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng bǎ diàn shì de yīn liàng guān xiǎo yì diǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please turn the TV volume down a bit.
entries.question: 你聽音樂時音量開很大嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tīng yīn yuè shí yīn liàng kāi hěn dà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you turn the volume up when you listen to music?
entries.answer: 不會，我的音量都開得很小。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ de yīn liàng dōu kāi de hěn xiǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I keep the volume low.

entries.example: 他在地圖上畫了一個圓圈。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài dì tú shàng huà le yí gè yuán quān.
entries.exampleEnglish: He drew a circle on the map.
entries.question: 你會在月曆上畫圓圈標重要的日子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zài yuè lì shàng huà yuán quān biāo zhòng yào de rì zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you circle important dates on your calendar?
entries.answer: 會，重要的日子我會畫圓圈。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, zhòng yào de rì zi wǒ huì huà yuán quān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I circle important days.

entries.example: 你可以推薦一家好吃的餐廳嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: nǐ kě yǐ tuī jiàn yì jiā hǎo chī de cān tīng ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: Can you recommend a good restaurant?
entries.question: 你會推薦朋友來台灣玩嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì tuī jiàn péng yǒu lái tái wān wán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you recommend Taiwan to your friends?
entries.answer: 會，我很推薦大家來台灣。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ hěn tuī jiàn dà jiā lái tái wān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I really recommend everyone come to Taiwan.

entries.example: 台灣的美食吸引了很多遊客。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān de měi shí xī yǐn le hěn duō yóu kè.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan's food attracts a lot of tourists.
entries.question: 台灣的什麼最吸引你？
entries.questionPinyin: tái wān de shén me zuì xī yǐn nǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: What about Taiwan attracts you most?
entries.answer: 台灣的美食最吸引我。
entries.answerPinyin: tái wān de měi shí zuì xī yǐn wǒ.
entries.answerEnglish: Taiwan's food attracts me most.

entries.example: 這個月的電費帳單很貴。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge yuè de diàn fèi zhàng dān hěn guì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This month's electricity bill is very high.
entries.question: 你每個月要付哪些帳單？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ měi gè yuè yào fù nǎ xiē zhàng dān?
entries.questionEnglish: What bills do you have to pay each month?
entries.answer: 我要付手機、水費和電費的帳單。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yào fù shǒu jī, shuǐ fèi hé diàn fèi de zhàng dān.
entries.answerEnglish: I pay my phone, water and electricity bills.

entries.example: 我把頭髮綁起來了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bǎ tóu fǎ bǎng qǐ lái le.
entries.exampleEnglish: I tied my hair up.
entries.question: 你夏天會把頭髮綁起來嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xià tiān huì bǎ tóu fǎ bǎng qǐ lái ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you tie your hair up in summer?
entries.answer: 會，太熱了，我都綁馬尾。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, tài rè le, wǒ dōu bǎng mǎ wěi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, it's too hot. I always wear a ponytail.

entries.example: 秋天的台北很涼爽。
entries.examplePinyin: qiū tiān de tái běi hěn liáng shuǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taipei is nice and cool in autumn.
entries.question: 你喜歡涼爽的天氣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan liáng shuǎng de tiān qì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like cool weather?
entries.answer: 很喜歡，涼爽的天氣最舒服。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn xǐ huan, liáng shuǎng de tiān qì zuì shū fú.
entries.answerEnglish: Very much. Cool weather is the most comfortable.

entries.example: 地很滑，小心不要滑倒。
entries.examplePinyin: dì hěn huá, xiǎo xīn bú yào huá dǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: The floor's slippery; be careful not to slip.
entries.question: 你在下雨天滑倒過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài xià yǔ tiān huá dǎo guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever slipped on a rainy day?
entries.answer: 滑倒過，在捷運站門口。
entries.answerPinyin: huá dǎo guò, zài jié yùn zhàn mén kǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, at the entrance to an MRT station.

entries.example: 我爸爸在工廠上班。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bà ba zài gōng chǎng shàng bān.
entries.exampleEnglish: My dad works in a factory.
entries.question: 你參觀過台灣的觀光工廠嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān guān guò tái wān de guān guāng gōng chǎng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you visited one of Taiwan's tourist factories?
entries.answer: 參觀過，我去過一間餅乾工廠。
entries.answerPinyin: cān guān guò, wǒ qù guò yì jiān bǐng gān gōng chǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I visited a cookie factory.

entries.example: 這隻鳥的翅膀受傷了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhī niǎo de chì bǎng shòu shāng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This bird's wing is injured.
entries.question: 如果你有翅膀，你想飛去哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ nǐ yǒu chì bǎng, nǐ xiǎng fēi qù nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: If you had wings, where would you fly?
entries.answer: 如果有翅膀，我想飛回家。
entries.answerPinyin: rú guǒ yǒu chì bǎng, wǒ xiǎng fēi huí jiā.
entries.answerEnglish: If I had wings, I'd fly home.

entries.example: 老闆在會議上批評了我的報告。
entries.examplePinyin: lǎo bǎn zài huì yì shàng pī píng le wǒ de bào gào.
entries.exampleEnglish: My boss criticized my report in the meeting.
entries.question: 被別人批評時，你會怎麼做？
entries.questionPinyin: bèi bié rén pī píng shí, nǐ huì zěn me zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when someone criticizes you?
entries.answer: 被批評時，我會先冷靜聽完。
entries.answerPinyin: bèi pī píng shí, wǒ huì xiān lěng jìng tīng wán.
entries.answerEnglish: When I'm criticized, I calmly hear them out first.

entries.example: 我需要時間思考一下。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xū yào shí jiān sī kǎo yí xià.
entries.exampleEnglish: I need some time to think.
entries.question: 你喜歡在哪裡思考事情？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zài nǎ lǐ sī kǎo shì qíng?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you like to think things over?
entries.answer: 我喜歡一邊散步一邊思考。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan yì biān sàn bù yì biān sī kǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: I like to think while I'm walking.

entries.example: 他常常抱怨工作太多。
entries.examplePinyin: tā cháng cháng bào yuàn gōng zuò tài duō.
entries.exampleEnglish: He often complains that he has too much work.
entries.question: 你最常抱怨台灣的什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì cháng bào yuàn tái wān de shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you complain about most in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我最常抱怨夏天太熱。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì cháng bào yuàn xià tiān tài rè.
entries.answerEnglish: I complain most about the summers being too hot.

entries.example: 我用手機轉帳給房東。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ yòng shǒu jī zhuǎn zhàng gěi fáng dōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I transfer money to my landlord with my phone.
entries.question: 你付房租是轉帳還是付現金？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ fù fáng zū shì zhuǎn zhàng hái shì fù xiàn jīn?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you pay your rent by bank transfer or in cash?
entries.answer: 我都用網路銀行轉帳。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dōu yòng wǎng lù yín háng zhuǎn zhàng.
entries.answerEnglish: I always pay by online bank transfer.

entries.example: 公司下個月要舉辦尾牙。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng sī xià gè yuè yào jǔ bàn wěi yá.
entries.exampleEnglish: The company is holding its year-end party next month.
entries.question: 你在家舉辦過派對嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài jiā jǔ bàn guò pài duì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever thrown a party at home?
entries.answer: 舉辦過，去年我在家辦了生日派對。
entries.answerPinyin: jǔ bàn guò, qù nián wǒ zài jiā bàn le shēng rì pài duì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I had a birthday party at home last year.

entries.example: 可以轉到新聞頻道嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: kě yǐ zhuǎn dào xīn wén pín dào ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: Can you switch to the news channel?
entries.question: 你最常看哪個頻道？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì cháng kàn nǎ gè pín dào?
entries.questionEnglish: Which channel do you watch most?
entries.answer: 我最常看美食頻道。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì cháng kàn měi shí pín dào.
entries.answerEnglish: I watch food channels most.

entries.example: 醫生叫我注意飲食。
entries.examplePinyin: yī shēng jiào wǒ zhù yì yǐn shí.
entries.exampleEnglish: The doctor told me to watch my diet.
entries.question: 你的飲食習慣健康嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de yǐn shí xí guàn jiàn kāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are your eating habits healthy?
entries.answer: 還好，不過我的飲食有點太油。
entries.answerPinyin: hái hǎo, bú guò wǒ de yǐn shí yǒu diǎn tài yóu.
entries.answerEnglish: They're OK, but my diet is a bit too oily.

entries.example: 會議提前到下午兩點了。
entries.examplePinyin: huì yì tí qián dào xià wǔ liǎng diǎn le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The meeting has been moved up to 2 p.m.
entries.question: 你搭飛機會提前多久到機場？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dā fēi jī huì tí qián duō jiǔ dào jī chǎng?
entries.questionEnglish: How early do you get to the airport when you fly?
entries.answer: 我通常提前兩個小時到。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ tōng cháng tí qián liǎng gè xiǎo shí dào.
entries.answerEnglish: I usually get there two hours early.

entries.example: 東部的海岸非常漂亮。
entries.examplePinyin: dōng bù de hǎi àn fēi cháng piào liang.
entries.exampleEnglish: The east coast is beautiful.
entries.question: 你去過台灣東部的海岸嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò tái wān dōng bù de hǎi àn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to Taiwan's east coast?
entries.answer: 去過，花蓮的海岸很美。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, huā lián de hǎi àn hěn měi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the coast in Hualien is beautiful.

entries.example: 這幾天持續下雨。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jǐ tiān chí xù xià yǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's been raining non-stop for the past few days.
entries.question: 你學中文持續多久了？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xué zhōng wén chí xù duō jiǔ le?
entries.questionEnglish: How long have you kept up your Chinese studies?
entries.answer: 我已經持續學了兩年了。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yǐ jīng chí xù xué le liǎng nián le.
entries.answerEnglish: I've been studying steadily for two years.

entries.example: 開會時請把手機調成震動。
entries.examplePinyin: kāi huì shí qǐng bǎ shǒu jī tiáo chéng zhèn dòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please put your phone on vibrate during the meeting.
entries.question: 你的手機平常開震動還是鈴聲？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de shǒu jī píng cháng kāi zhèn dòng hái shì líng shēng?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you usually keep your phone on vibrate or ring?
entries.answer: 我的手機都開震動。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de shǒu jī dōu kāi zhèn dòng.
entries.answerEnglish: I always keep my phone on vibrate.

entries.example: 我在陽台種了一些種子。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài yáng tái zhòng le yì xiē zhǒng zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: I planted some seeds on my balcony.
entries.question: 你想在陽台種什麼種子？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng zài yáng tái zhòng shén me zhǒng zi?
entries.questionEnglish: What seeds would you like to plant on your balcony?
entries.answer: 我想買一些番茄的種子來種。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì xiē fān qié de zhǒng zi lái zhòng.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to buy some tomato seeds to plant.

entries.example: 車票可以在網路上購買。
entries.examplePinyin: chē piào kě yǐ zài wǎng lù shang gòu mǎi.
entries.exampleEnglish: Tickets can be bought online.
entries.question: 你常在網路上購買東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng zài wǎng lù shang gòu mǎi dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often buy things online?
entries.answer: 常常，我大部分東西都在網路上購買。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ dà bù fèn dōng xī dōu zài wǎng lù shang gòu mǎi.
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I buy most things online.

entries.example: 朋友勸我少喝一點酒。
entries.examplePinyin: péng yǒu quàn wǒ shǎo hē yì diǎn jiǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: My friends urged me to drink less.
entries.question: 你的家人會勸你早點回國嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de jiā rén huì quàn nǐ zǎo diǎn huí guó ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your family urge you to come home soon?
entries.answer: 會，我媽常常勸我回家工作。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ mā cháng cháng quàn wǒ huí jiā gōng zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my mum often urges me to come home and work.

entries.example: 他決定退出這個群組。
entries.examplePinyin: tā jué dìng tuì chū zhè ge qún zǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: He decided to leave this group chat.
entries.question: 你退出過LINE群組嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tuì chū guò LINE qún zǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever left a LINE group?
entries.answer: 有，太吵的群組我就退出。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, tài chǎo de qún zǔ wǒ jiù tuì chū.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I leave groups that are too noisy.

entries.example: 這家店新增了外送服務。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn xīn zēng le wài sòng fú wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop has added a delivery service.
entries.question: 你希望捷運新增哪一條線？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xī wàng jié yùn xīn zēng nǎ yì tiáo xiàn?
entries.questionEnglish: Which MRT line would you like them to add?
entries.answer: 我希望新增一條到我家的線。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xī wàng xīn zēng yì tiáo dào wǒ jiā de xiàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like them to add a line to my neighbourhood.

entries.example: 船長請大家穿上救生衣。
entries.examplePinyin: chuán zhǎng qǐng dà jiā chuān shàng jiù shēng yī.
entries.exampleEnglish: The captain asked everyone to put on life jackets.
entries.question: 你小時候想當船長嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu xiǎng dāng chuán zhǎng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you want to be a ship's captain as a child?
entries.answer: 想過，我覺得當船長很酷。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng guò, wǒ jué de dāng chuán zhǎng hěn kù.
entries.answerEnglish: I did. I thought being a captain was cool.

entries.example: 我先查一下火車時刻表。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xiān chá yí xià huǒ chē shí kè biǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Let me check the train timetable first.
entries.question: 你搭公車前會看時刻表嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dā gōng chē qián huì kàn shí kè biǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you check the timetable before taking the bus?
entries.answer: 會，我都用手機看公車時刻表。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōu yòng shǒu jī kàn gōng chē shí kè biǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always check the bus timetable on my phone.

entries.example: 她還在等她的白馬王子。
entries.examplePinyin: tā hái zài děng tā de bái mǎ wáng zǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's still waiting for her Prince Charming.
entries.question: 你小時候喜歡王子和公主的故事嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu xǐ huan wáng zǐ hé gōng zhǔ de gù shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you like stories about princes and princesses as a child?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我最喜歡青蛙王子的故事。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ zuì xǐ huan qīng wā wáng zǐ de gù shì.
