entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my favourite was The Frog Prince.

entries.example: 我和同伴一起去爬山。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hé tóng bàn yì qǐ qù pá shān.
entries.exampleEnglish: I went hiking with my companions.
entries.question: 你旅行時喜歡有同伴嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ lǚ xíng shí xǐ huan yǒu tóng bàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like having company when you travel?
entries.answer: 喜歡，有同伴比較好玩。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, yǒu tóng bàn bǐ jiào hǎo wán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, it's more fun with companions.

entries.example: 這台電腦保固兩年。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tái diàn nǎo bǎo gù liǎng nián.
entries.exampleEnglish: This computer has a two-year warranty.
entries.question: 你買電器會注意保固嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi diàn qì huì zhù yì bǎo gù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you pay attention to the warranty when you buy appliances?
entries.answer: 會，保固越久越好。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, bǎo gù yuè jiǔ yuè hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the longer the warranty the better.

entries.example: 她很會買東西，是購物女王。
entries.examplePinyin: tā hěn huì mǎi dōng xī, shì gòu wù nǚ wáng.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's great at shopping. She's the queen of shopping.
entries.question: 你的國家以前有女王嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā yǐ qián yǒu nǚ wáng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has your country had a queen?
entries.answer: 有，我的國家以前有一位女王。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de guó jiā yǐ qián yǒu yí wèi nǚ wáng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my country used to have a queen.

entries.example: 這部老電影真是經典。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù lǎo diàn yǐng zhēn shì jīng diǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This old film is a real classic.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪部經典電影？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ bù jīng diǎn diàn yǐng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which classic film do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡的經典電影是《教父》。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan de jīng diǎn diàn yǐng shì 《 jiào fù 》.
entries.answerEnglish: My favourite classic film is The Godfather.

entries.example: 他想找一份穩定的工作。
entries.examplePinyin: tā xiǎng zhǎo yí fèn wěn dìng de gōng zuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: He wants to find a stable job.
entries.question: 你的工作穩定嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng zuò wěn dìng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your job stable?
entries.answer: 很穩定，我在這家公司五年了。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn wěn dìng, wǒ zài zhè jiā gōng sī wǔ nián le.
entries.answerEnglish: Very stable. I've been with this company for five years.

entries.example: 他在尾牙抽到很大的獎品。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài wěi yá chōu dào hěn dà de jiǎng pǐn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He won a big prize in the draw at the year-end party.
entries.question: 你抽過最好的獎品是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chōu guò zuì hǎo de jiǎng pǐn shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the best prize you've ever won in a draw?
entries.answer: 我抽過最好的獎品是一支手機。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ chōu guò zuì hǎo de jiǎng pǐn shì yì zhī shǒu jī.
entries.answerEnglish: The best prize I've won was a mobile phone.

entries.example: 我預訂了週六晚上的餐廳。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ yù dìng le zhōu liù wǎn shàng de cān tīng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I've booked a restaurant for Saturday night.
entries.question: 你出去玩會先預訂飯店嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chū qù wán huì xiān yù dìng fàn diàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you book a hotel in advance when you travel?
entries.answer: 會，我都在網路上預訂。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōu zài wǎng lù shang yù dìng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always book online.

entries.example: 捷運上禁止吃東西。
entries.examplePinyin: jié yùn shàng jìn zhǐ chī dōng xī.
entries.exampleEnglish: Eating is not allowed on the MRT.
entries.question: 你覺得捷運禁止吃東西好嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de jié yùn jìn zhǐ chī dōng xī hǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think banning eating on the MRT is a good idea?
entries.answer: 很好，禁止吃東西比較乾淨。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn hǎo, jìn zhǐ chī dōng xī bǐ jiào gān jìng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, banning food keeps it cleaner.

entries.example: 這家超市賣很多進口零食。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā chāo shì mài hěn duō jìn kǒu líng shí.
entries.exampleEnglish: This supermarket sells lots of imported snacks.
entries.question: 你常買進口的東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng mǎi jìn kǒu de dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often buy imported things?
entries.answer: 常買，我喜歡吃進口巧克力。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng mǎi, wǒ xǐ huan chī jìn kǒu qiǎo kè lì.
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I like imported chocolate.

entries.example: 這兩家公司是競爭對手。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè liǎng jiā gōng sī shì jìng zhēng duì shǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: These two companies are competitors.
entries.question: 你打球時遇過很強的對手嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dǎ qiú shí yù guò hěn qiáng de duì shǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever played against a really strong opponent?
entries.answer: 遇過，上次的對手比我強很多。
entries.answerPinyin: yù guò, shàng cì de duì shǒu bǐ wǒ qiáng hěn duō.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my last opponent was much better than me.

entries.example: 她小時候想當公主。
entries.examplePinyin: tā xiǎo shí hòu xiǎng dāng gōng zhǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: She wanted to be a princess when she was little.
entries.question: 你小時候喜歡哪個公主的故事？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu xǐ huan nǎ gè gōng zhǔ de gù shì?
entries.questionEnglish: Which princess story did you like as a child?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡白雪公主的故事。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan bái xuě gōng zhǔ de gù shì.
entries.answerEnglish: I liked Snow White best.

entries.example: 她很會領導團隊。
entries.examplePinyin: tā hěn huì lǐng dǎo tuán duì.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's very good at leading a team.
entries.question: 你喜歡領導別人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan lǐng dǎo bié rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like leading other people?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我在公司領導一個小團隊。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ zài gōng sī lǐng dǎo yí gè xiǎo tuán duì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I lead a small team at work.

entries.example: 我們隊拿到冠軍了！
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men duì ná dào guàn jūn le!
entries.exampleEnglish: Our team won the championship!
entries.question: 你得過什麼冠軍嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dé guò shén me guàn jūn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever won first place in anything?
entries.answer: 我小時候得過游泳比賽冠軍。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎo shí hòu dé guò yóu yǒng bǐ sài guàn jūn.
entries.answerEnglish: I won a swimming competition when I was a kid.

entries.example: 我把旅行照片放進相簿。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bǎ lǚ xíng zhào piàn fàng jìn xiàng bù.
entries.exampleEnglish: I put my travel photos in an album.
entries.question: 你的手機裡有幾個相簿？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de shǒu jī lǐ yǒu jǐ gè xiàng bù?
entries.questionEnglish: How many albums do you have on your phone?
entries.answer: 我的手機裡有十幾個相簿。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de shǒu jī lǐ yǒu shí jǐ gè xiàng bù.
entries.answerEnglish: I have more than ten albums on my phone.

entries.example: 這家航空公司的服務很好。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā háng kōng gōng sī de fú wù hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This airline's service is very good.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪家航空公司？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ jiā háng kōng gōng sī?
entries.questionEnglish: Which airline do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡台灣的航空公司，服務很好。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan tái wān de háng kōng gōng sī, fú wù hěn hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: I like Taiwanese airlines best. Their service is great.

entries.example: 這部電影有中文字幕。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng yǒu zhōng wén zì mù.
entries.exampleEnglish: This film has Chinese subtitles.
entries.question: 你看台劇的時候會開字幕嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn tái jù de shí hòu huì kāi zì mù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you turn on subtitles when you watch Taiwanese dramas?
entries.answer: 會，我都開中文字幕。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōu kāi zhōng wén zì mù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always turn on Chinese subtitles.

entries.example: 據說這家店的牛肉麵很好吃。
entries.examplePinyin: jù shuō zhè jiā diàn de niú ròu miàn hěn hǎo chī.
entries.exampleEnglish: They say the beef noodles at this shop are great.
entries.question: 你聽說過台灣哪裡的東西特別好吃？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tīng shuō guò tái wān nǎ lǐ de dōng xī tè bié hǎo chī?
entries.questionEnglish: Where in Taiwan have you heard the food is especially good?
entries.answer: 據說台南的小吃最好吃。
entries.answerPinyin: jù shuō tái nán de xiǎo chī zuì hǎo chī.
entries.answerEnglish: They say Tainan has the best snacks.

entries.example: 我在網路上看到這篇報導。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài wǎng lù shang kàn dào zhè piān bào dǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: I saw this report online.
entries.question: 你最近看了什麼有趣的報導？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn kàn le shén me yǒu qù de bào dǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: What interesting news reports have you read lately?
entries.answer: 我看了一篇關於夜市的報導。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ kàn le yì piān guān yú yè shì de bào dǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: I read a report about night markets.

entries.english: line up into; form (a line or shape)
entries.example: 請大家排成一排。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng dà jiā pái chéng yì pái.
entries.exampleEnglish: Everyone, please line up in a row.
entries.question: 你在台灣看過大家排成長長的隊嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān kàn guò dà jiā pái chéng cháng cháng de duì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen people form long queues in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 看過，買雞排的人排成一條長龍。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, mǎi jī pái de rén pái chéng yì tiáo cháng lóng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, people lined up in a huge queue for fried chicken.

entries.example: 他頭腦很好，學東西很快。
entries.examplePinyin: tā tóu nǎo hěn hǎo, xué dōng xī hěn kuài.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's very smart and learns things quickly.
entries.question: 你什麼時候頭腦最清楚？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shén me shí hòu tóu nǎo zuì qīng chǔ?
entries.questionEnglish: When is your mind clearest?
entries.answer: 早上喝完咖啡，我的頭腦最清楚。
entries.answerPinyin: zǎo shàng hē wán kā fēi, wǒ de tóu nǎo zuì qīng chǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: My mind is clearest in the morning after coffee.

entries.example: 這家超商現在有買一送一的優惠。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā chāo shāng xiàn zài yǒu mǎi yí sòng yī de yōu huì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This convenience store has a buy-one-get-one-free deal right now.
entries.question: 你買東西會等優惠嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi dōng xī huì děng yōu huì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you wait for deals before buying things?
entries.answer: 會，我常等週年慶的優惠。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng děng zhōu nián qìng de yōu huì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often wait for the anniversary sale deals.

entries.example: 我每天在公司分析資料。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi tiān zài gōng sī fēn xī zī liào.
entries.exampleEnglish: I analyse data at work every day.
entries.question: 你的工作需要分析資料嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng zuò xū yào fēn xī zī liào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your job involve analysing data?
entries.answer: 需要，我常常分析銷售資料。
entries.answerPinyin: xū yào, wǒ cháng cháng fēn xī xiāo shòu zī liào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often analyse sales data.

entries.example: 我下午要去見一位客戶。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xià wǔ yào qù jiàn yí wèi kè hù.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm meeting a client this afternoon.
entries.question: 你的工作常常見客戶嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng zuò cháng cháng jiàn kè hù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often meet clients for work?
entries.answer: 常常，我每週要見三四個客戶。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ měi zhōu yào jiàn sān sì gè kè hù.
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I meet three or four clients a week.

entries.example: 我用中文跟同事溝通。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ yòng zhōng wén gēn tóng shì gōu tōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I communicate with my colleagues in Chinese.
entries.question: 你和同事用什麼語言溝通？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ hé tóng shì yòng shén me yǔ yán gōu tōng?
entries.questionEnglish: What language do you use to communicate with colleagues?
entries.answer: 我們用中文和英文溝通。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men yòng zhōng wén hé yīng wén gōu tōng.
entries.answerEnglish: We communicate in Chinese and English.

entries.example: 我在飯店大廳等你。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài fàn diàn dà tīng děng nǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'll wait for you in the hotel lobby.
entries.question: 你住的大樓有大廳嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhù de dà lóu yǒu dà tīng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your building have a lobby?
entries.answer: 有，大廳有一位管理員。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, dà tīng yǒu yí wèi guǎn lǐ yuán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a building manager in the lobby.

entries.example: 塞車很嚴重，車子都沒有前進。
entries.examplePinyin: sāi chē hěn yán zhòng, chē zi dōu méi yǒu qián jìn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The traffic jam is so bad the cars aren't moving forward at all.
entries.question: 遇到困難時，你會怎麼做？
entries.questionPinyin: yù dào kùn nán shí, nǐ huì zěn me zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when you run into difficulties?
entries.answer: 我會休息一下，再繼續前進。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì xiū xí yí xià, zài jì xù qián jìn.
entries.answerEnglish: I take a short break, then keep moving forward.

entries.example: 我喜歡在捷運上觀察別人。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xǐ huan zài jié yùn shàng guān chá bié rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: I like watching people on the MRT.
entries.question: 你喜歡觀察別人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan guān chá bié rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like observing other people?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常在咖啡店觀察別人。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ cháng zài kā fēi diàn guān chá bié rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often watch people in coffee shops.

entries.example: 廠商寄了一些樣品來公司。
entries.examplePinyin: chǎng shāng jì le yì xiē yàng pǐn lái gōng sī.
entries.exampleEnglish: The supplier sent some samples to the office.
entries.question: 你買東西前會先試用樣品嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi dōng xī qián huì xiān shì yòng yàng pǐn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you try samples before you buy things?
entries.answer: 會，我常拿化妝品的樣品試用。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng ná huà zhuāng pǐn de yàng pǐn shì yòng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often try out cosmetics samples.

entries.example: 他用棍子把樹上的球弄下來。
entries.examplePinyin: tā yòng gùn zi bǎ shù shàng de qiú nòng xià lái.
entries.exampleEnglish: He used a stick to knock the ball down from the tree.
entries.question: 你爬山時會拿棍子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pá shān shí huì ná gùn zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you carry a stick when you go hiking?
entries.answer: 會，我爬山時會拿一根棍子。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ pá shān shí huì ná yì gēn gùn zi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I take a stick with me when I hike.

entries.example: 我把禮物藏在衣櫃裡。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bǎ lǐ wù cáng zài yī guì lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: I hid the present in the wardrobe.
entries.question: 你會把錢藏在家裡嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì bǎ qián cáng zài jiā lǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you hide money at home?
entries.answer: 會，我把一些錢藏在書裡。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ bǎ yì xiē qián cáng zài shū lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I hide some money inside a book.

entries.example: 店員示範怎麼用這台咖啡機。
entries.examplePinyin: diàn yuán shì fàn zěn me yòng zhè tái kā fēi jī.
entries.exampleEnglish: The clerk demonstrated how to use this coffee machine.
entries.question: 你可以示範一道家鄉菜嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kě yǐ shì fàn yí dào jiā xiāng cài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Could you demonstrate a dish from your hometown?
entries.answer: 可以，我可以示範怎麼做披薩。
entries.answerPinyin: kě yǐ, wǒ kě yǐ shì fàn zěn me zuò pī sà.
entries.answerEnglish: Sure, I can show you how to make pizza.

entries.example: 前面在施工，請走旁邊。
entries.examplePinyin: qián miàn zài shī gōng, qǐng zǒu páng biān.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's construction ahead, please walk around the side.
entries.question: 你家附近有在施工嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn yǒu zài shī gōng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there any construction going on near your home?
entries.answer: 有，樓下在施工，很吵。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, lóu xià zài shī gōng, hěn chǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's construction downstairs, and it's really noisy.

entries.example: 我們爬上山丘看夕陽。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men pá shàng shān qiū kàn xì yáng.
entries.exampleEnglish: We climbed up the hill to watch the sunset.
entries.question: 你家附近有山丘嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn yǒu shān qiū ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there any hills near your home?
entries.answer: 有，我家後面有一座山丘。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiā hòu miàn yǒu yí zuò shān qiū.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a hill behind my place.

entries.example: 高速公路上發生了事故。
entries.examplePinyin: gāo sù gōng lù shang fā shēng le shì gù.
entries.exampleEnglish: There was an accident on the freeway.
entries.question: 你看過交通事故嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò jiāo tōng shì gù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a traffic accident?
entries.answer: 看過，我在路上看過一次小事故。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài lù shang kàn guò yí cì xiǎo shì gù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I once saw a minor accident on the road.

entries.example: 請先選擇商品的類別。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng xiān xuǎn zé shāng pǐn de lèi bié.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please choose the product category first.
entries.question: 你最常看哪個類別的電影？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì cháng kàn nǎ gè lèi bié de diàn yǐng?
entries.questionEnglish: What category of film do you watch most?
entries.answer: 我最常看喜劇這個類別。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì cháng kàn xǐ jù zhè ge lèi bié.
entries.answerEnglish: I watch comedies the most.

entries.example: 我的視力越來越差了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de shì lì yuè lái yuè chà le.
entries.exampleEnglish: My eyesight is getting worse and worse.
entries.question: 你的視力好嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de shì lì hǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your eyesight good?
entries.answer: 不太好，我的視力有點差。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài hǎo, wǒ de shì lì yǒu diǎn chà.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really, my eyesight is a bit poor.

entries.example: 這家公司在全球都有分店。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā gōng sī zài quán qiú dōu yǒu fēn diàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This company has branches all over the world.
entries.question: 你覺得全球暖化嚴重嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de quán qiú nuǎn huà yán zhòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think global warming is serious?
entries.answer: 很嚴重，全球都越來越熱。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn yán zhòng, quán qiú dōu yuè lái yuè rè.
entries.answerEnglish: Very serious. The whole world is getting hotter.

entries.example: 颱風把很多樹枝吹斷了。
entries.examplePinyin: tái fēng bǎ hěn duō shù zhī chuī duàn le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The typhoon snapped a lot of branches.
entries.question: 颱風後，你家附近有很多樹枝嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: tái fēng hòu, nǐ jiā fù jìn yǒu hěn duō shù zhī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: After a typhoon, are there lots of branches around your home?
entries.answer: 有，路上都是樹枝。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, lù shang dōu shì shù zhī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the streets are covered in branches.

entries.example: 開了兩小時的會，還是沒有結論。
entries.examplePinyin: kāi le liǎng xiǎo shí de huì, hái shì méi yǒu jié lùn.
entries.exampleEnglish: We met for two hours and still reached no conclusion.
entries.question: 你寫報告時，結論會寫很長嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiě bào gào shí, jié lùn huì xiě hěn cháng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you write a report, do you write a long conclusion?
entries.answer: 不會，我的結論都很短。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ de jié lùn dōu hěn duǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: No, my conclusions are always short.

entries.example: 我的鑰匙一定在家裡某個地方。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de yào shi yí dìng zài jiā lǐ mǒu gè dì fāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: My keys must be somewhere in the house.
entries.question: 你常把東西忘在某個地方嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng bǎ dōng xī wàng zài mǒu gè dì fāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often leave things somewhere?
entries.answer: 常常，我常把雨傘忘在某個地方。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ cháng bǎ yǔ sǎn wàng zài mǒu gè dì fāng.
entries.answerEnglish: All the time. I often leave my umbrella somewhere.

entries.example: 把牛奶和咖啡混合在一起。
entries.examplePinyin: bǎ niú nǎi hé kā fēi hùn hé zài yì qǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Mix the milk and the coffee together.
entries.question: 你喜歡把不同的飲料混合嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan bǎ bù tóng de yǐn liào hùn hé ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like mixing different drinks?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常把果汁和汽水混合。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ cháng bǎ guǒ zhī hé qì shuǐ hùn hé.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often mix juice with soda.

entries.example: 後面的車一直按喇叭。
entries.examplePinyin: hòu miàn de chē yì zhí àn lǎ ba.
entries.exampleEnglish: The car behind kept honking its horn.
entries.question: 你開車時常按喇叭嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kāi chē shí cháng àn lǎ ba ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you honk the horn a lot when you drive?
entries.answer: 很少，我不喜歡按喇叭。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn shǎo, wǒ bù xǐ huan àn lǎ ba.
entries.answerEnglish: Rarely. I don't like honking.

entries.example: 冬天我的嘴唇很乾。
entries.examplePinyin: dōng tiān wǒ de zuǐ chún hěn gān.
entries.exampleEnglish: My lips get very dry in winter.
entries.question: 冬天你的嘴唇會乾嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: dōng tiān nǐ de zuǐ chún huì gān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do your lips get dry in winter?
entries.answer: 會，我的嘴唇常常很乾。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ de zuǐ chún cháng cháng hěn gān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my lips are often dry.

entries.example: 公司今天有很多訪客。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng sī jīn tiān yǒu hěn duō fǎng kè.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of visitors at the office today.
entries.question: 你家常有訪客嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā cháng yǒu fǎng kè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often have visitors at home?
entries.answer: 不常，我家很少有訪客。
entries.answerPinyin: bù cháng, wǒ jiā hěn shǎo yǒu fǎng kè.
entries.answerEnglish: Not often. We rarely have visitors.

entries.example: 這次的經驗給了我一個教訓。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì de jīng yàn gěi le wǒ yí gè jiào xùn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This experience taught me a lesson.
entries.question: 你學到最大的教訓是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xué dào zuì dà de jiào xùn shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the biggest lesson you've learned?
entries.answer: 我學到的最大教訓是要存錢。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xué dào de zuì dà jiào xùn shì yào cún qián.
entries.answerEnglish: The biggest lesson I've learned is to save money.

entries.example: 番茄屬於水果還是蔬菜？
entries.examplePinyin: fān qié shǔ yú shuǐ guǒ hái shì shū cài?
entries.exampleEnglish: Is a tomato a fruit or a vegetable?
entries.question: 你覺得自己屬於早起的人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ shǔ yú zǎo qǐ de rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're a morning person?
entries.answer: 不是，我屬於晚睡晚起的人。
entries.answerPinyin: bú shì, wǒ shǔ yú wǎn shuì wǎn qǐ de rén.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I'm the type who goes to bed late and gets up late.

entries.example: 進公司以前要先確認身分。
entries.examplePinyin: jìn gōng sī yǐ qián yào xiān què rèn shēn fèn.
entries.exampleEnglish: You have to verify your identity before entering the company.
entries.question: 辦手機時，你用什麼證明身分？
entries.questionPinyin: bàn shǒu jī shí, nǐ yòng shén me zhèng míng shēn fèn?
entries.questionEnglish: When you got your phone plan, what did you use to prove your identity?
entries.answer: 我用居留證證明身分。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yòng jū liú zhèng zhèng míng shēn fèn.
entries.answerEnglish: I used my resident permit to prove my identity.

entries.example: 實際的價錢比網路上貴。
entries.examplePinyin: shí jì de jià qián bǐ wǎng lù shang guì.
entries.exampleEnglish: The actual price is higher than online.
entries.question: 你覺得網路上的照片和實際一樣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de wǎng lù shang de zhào piàn hé shí jì yí yàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think photos online match reality?
entries.answer: 不一樣，實際的東西常常比較小。
entries.answerPinyin: bù yí yàng, shí jì de dōng xī cháng cháng bǐ jiào xiǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: No, the real thing is often smaller.

entries.example: 我的牛排要五分熟。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de niú pái yào wǔ fēn shú.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'd like my steak medium.
entries.question: 你吃牛排要幾分熟？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chī niú pái yào jǐ fēn shú?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you like your steak done?
entries.answer: 我喜歡五分熟。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan wǔ fēn shú.
entries.answerEnglish: I like it medium.

entries.example: 我每個禮拜換一次床單。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi gè lǐ bài huàn yí cì chuáng dān.
entries.exampleEnglish: I change the sheets once a week.
entries.question: 你多久洗一次床單？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duō jiǔ xǐ yí cì chuáng dān?
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you wash your sheets?
entries.answer: 我兩個禮拜洗一次床單。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ liǎng gè lǐ bài xǐ yí cì chuáng dān.
entries.answerEnglish: I wash my sheets every two weeks.

entries.example: 工作壓力會影響心理健康。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng zuò yā lì huì yǐng xiǎng xīn lǐ jiàn kāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Work stress can affect your mental health.
entries.question: 你覺得心理健康重要嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de xīn lǐ jiàn kāng zhòng yào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think mental health is important?
entries.answer: 很重要，心理健康跟身體一樣重要。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn zhòng yào, xīn lǐ jiàn kāng gēn shēn tǐ yí yàng zhòng yào.
entries.answerEnglish: Very. Mental health is as important as physical health.

entries.example: 我的雨傘突然消失了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de yǔ sǎn tú rán xiāo shī le.
entries.exampleEnglish: My umbrella suddenly disappeared.
entries.question: 你的東西常常不見嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de dōng xī cháng cháng bú jiàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do your things often go missing?
entries.answer: 常常，我的筆常常消失。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ de bǐ cháng cháng xiāo shī.
entries.answerEnglish: All the time. My pens keep disappearing.

entries.example: 這位老師的教學很有趣。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè wèi lǎo shī de jiào xué hěn yǒu qù.
entries.exampleEnglish: This teacher's teaching is very interesting.
entries.question: 你喜歡哪種中文教學方式？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan nǎ zhǒng zhōng wén jiào xué fāng shì?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of Chinese teaching do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡用對話的教學方式。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan yòng duì huà de jiào xué fāng shì.
entries.answerEnglish: I like teaching that uses conversation.

entries.example: 這種魚的骨頭很多。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhǒng yú de gǔ tou hěn duō.
entries.exampleEnglish: This kind of fish has a lot of bones.
entries.question: 你吃魚會怕骨頭嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chī yú huì pà gǔ tou ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do the bones bother you when you eat fish?
entries.answer: 會，我很怕魚的骨頭。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ hěn pà yú de gǔ tou.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I really don't like fish bones.

entries.example: 她大學是讀文學的。
entries.examplePinyin: tā dà xué shì dú wén xué de.
entries.exampleEnglish: She studied literature at university.
entries.question: 你喜歡看文學作品嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kàn wén xué zuò pǐn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like reading literature?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我最喜歡英國文學。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ zuì xǐ huan yīng guó wén xué.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like British literature best.

entries.example: 台北是個熱鬧的大都市。
entries.examplePinyin: tái běi shì gè rè nào de dà dū shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taipei is a lively big city.
entries.question: 你喜歡住在大都市嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zhù zài dà dū shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like living in a big city?
entries.answer: 喜歡，大都市生活很方便。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, dà dū shì shēng huó hěn fāng biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, life in a big city is very convenient.

entries.example: 表格上要寫已婚還是未婚。
entries.examplePinyin: biǎo gé shàng yào xiě yǐ hūn hái shì wèi hūn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The form asks whether you're married or single.
entries.question: 你的同事大部分已婚嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de tóng shì dà bù fèn yǐ hūn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are most of your coworkers married?
entries.answer: 對，他們大部分已婚。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, tā men dà bù fèn yǐ hūn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, most of them are married.

entries.example: 我爬山爬到膝蓋好痛。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ pá shān pá dào xī gài hǎo tòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: My knees hurt from hiking.
entries.question: 你爬樓梯時膝蓋會痛嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pá lóu tī shí xī gài huì tòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do your knees hurt when you climb stairs?
entries.answer: 有時候會，我的膝蓋不太好。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu huì, wǒ de xī gài bú tài hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. My knees aren't great.

entries.example: 這個包包很實用。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge bāo bāo hěn shí yòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This bag is very practical.
entries.question: 你覺得學中文實用嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de xué zhōng wén shí yòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think learning Chinese is useful?
entries.answer: 很實用，在台灣每天都用得到。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn shí yòng, zài tái wān měi tiān dōu yòng de dào.
entries.answerEnglish: Very useful. I use it every day in Taiwan.

entries.example: 在台灣買塑膠袋要另外付錢。
entries.examplePinyin: zài tái wān mǎi sù jiāo dài yào lìng wài fù qián.
entries.exampleEnglish: In Taiwan you have to pay extra for plastic bags.
entries.question: 你常用塑膠袋嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng yòng sù jiāo dài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use plastic bags a lot?
entries.answer: 很少，我自己帶袋子，不用塑膠袋。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn shǎo, wǒ zì jǐ dài dài zǐ, bú yòng sù jiāo dài.
entries.answerEnglish: Rarely. I bring my own bag instead of using plastic ones.

entries.example: 他們以前是敵人，現在是朋友。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men yǐ qián shì dí rén, xiàn zài shì péng yǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: They used to be enemies; now they're friends.
entries.question: 你覺得自己最大的敵人是誰？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ zuì dà de dí rén shì shéi?
entries.questionEnglish: Who do you think is your own worst enemy?
entries.answer: 我最大的敵人是我自己。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì dà de dí rén shì wǒ zì jǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: My worst enemy is myself.

entries.example: 住在台灣讓我對中文產生興趣。
entries.examplePinyin: zhù zài tái wān ràng wǒ duì zhōng wén chǎn shēng xìng qù.
entries.exampleEnglish: Living in Taiwan got me interested in Chinese.
entries.question: 你什麼時候對中文產生興趣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shén me shí hòu duì zhōng wén chǎn shēng xìng qù?
entries.questionEnglish: When did you become interested in Chinese?
entries.answer: 我來台灣以後才產生興趣。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ lái tái wān yǐ hòu cái chǎn shēng xìng qù.
entries.answerEnglish: I only got interested after I came to Taiwan.

entries.example: 他用一塊板子把洞擋起來。
entries.examplePinyin: tā yòng yí kuài bǎn zǐ bǎ dòng dǎng qǐ lái.
entries.exampleEnglish: He covered the hole with a board.
entries.question: 你會自己用板子做東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zì jǐ yòng bǎn zǐ zuò dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you ever make things yourself out of boards?
entries.answer: 會，我用板子做了一個書架。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ yòng bǎn zǐ zuò le yí gè shū jià.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I made a bookshelf out of boards.

entries.example: 我們的時間很有限。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men de shí jiān hěn yǒu xiàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Our time is very limited.
entries.question: 你每個月的預算有限嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ měi gè yuè de yù suàn yǒu xiàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your monthly budget limited?
entries.answer: 很有限，我不能常買衣服。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn yǒu xiàn, wǒ bù néng cháng mǎi yī fu.
entries.answerEnglish: Very limited. I can't buy clothes often.

entries.example: 做菜是我生活中的樂趣。
entries.examplePinyin: zuò cài shì wǒ shēng huó zhōng de lè qù.
entries.exampleEnglish: Cooking is one of the pleasures in my life.
entries.question: 你生活中最大的樂趣是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēng huó zhōng zuì dà de lè qù shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the greatest pleasure in your life?
entries.answer: 我最大的樂趣是逛夜市。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì dà de lè qù shì guàng yè shì.
entries.answerEnglish: My greatest pleasure is wandering around night markets.

entries.example: 這杯咖啡太濃了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bēi kā fēi tài nóng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This coffee is too strong.
entries.question: 你喜歡喝濃的咖啡嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan hē nóng de kā fēi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like strong coffee?
entries.answer: 喜歡，越濃越好。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, yuè nóng yuè hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the stronger the better.

entries.example: 我姊姊在醫院當護理師。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ jiě jie zài yī yuàn dāng hù lǐ shī.
entries.exampleEnglish: My older sister works as a nurse in a hospital.
entries.question: 你認識當護理師的朋友嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ rèn shì dāng hù lǐ shī de péng yǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know anyone who works as a nurse?
entries.answer: 認識，我的室友是護理師。
entries.answerPinyin: rèn shì, wǒ de shì yǒu shì hù lǐ shī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my roommate is a nurse.

entries.example: 炸雞配啤酒是最棒的組合。
entries.examplePinyin: zhà jī pèi pí jiǔ shì zuì bàng de zǔ hé.
entries.exampleEnglish: Fried chicken with beer is the best combination.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼食物組合最好吃？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me shí wù zǔ hé zuì hǎo chī?
entries.questionEnglish: Which food combination do you think tastes best?
entries.answer: 我覺得珍奶配雞排是最好的組合。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de zhēn nǎi pèi jī pái shì zuì hǎo de zǔ hé.
entries.answerEnglish: I think bubble tea with a fried chicken cutlet is the best combo.

entries.example: 中午的影子很短。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōng wǔ de yǐng zi hěn duǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Shadows are short at noon.
entries.question: 你小時候玩過踩影子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu wán guò cǎi yǐng zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you play shadow tag as a child?
entries.answer: 玩過，我常和朋友踩影子。
entries.answerPinyin: wán guò, wǒ cháng hé péng yǒu cǎi yǐng zi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often played it with my friends.

entries.example: 這個實驗做了三個月。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge shí yàn zuò le sān gè yuè.
entries.exampleEnglish: This experiment took three months.
entries.question: 你喜歡在廚房做實驗嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zài chú fáng zuò shí yàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like experimenting in the kitchen?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常在廚房做料理實驗。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ cháng zài chú fáng zuò liào lǐ shí yàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often try out cooking experiments.

entries.example: 這是一間很古老的廟。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shì yì jiān hěn gǔ lǎo de miào.
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a very old temple.
entries.question: 你去過台灣古老的廟嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò tái wān gǔ lǎo de miào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to any old temples in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 去過，我去過台南古老的廟。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, wǒ qù guò tái nán gǔ lǎo de miào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've been to old temples in Tainan.

entries.example: 這棵老樹的根很深。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè kē lǎo shù de gēn hěn shēn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This old tree has deep roots.
entries.question: 你覺得你的根在哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ de gēn zài nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you feel your roots are?
entries.answer: 我的根在美國，可是家在台灣。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de gēn zài měi guó, kě shì jiā zài tái wān.
entries.answerEnglish: My roots are in America, but my home is in Taiwan.

entries.english: open (a new business or event); opening
entries.example: 樓下的新餐廳明天開幕。
entries.examplePinyin: lóu xià de xīn cān tīng míng tiān kāi mù.
entries.exampleEnglish: The new restaurant downstairs opens tomorrow.
entries.question: 你家附近最近有新店開幕嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn zuì jìn yǒu xīn diàn kāi mù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have any new shops opened near your home recently?
entries.answer: 有，上週開幕了一家咖啡店。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, shàng zhōu kāi mù le yì jiā kā fēi diàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a coffee shop opened last week.

entries.example: 樓上的噪音讓我睡不著。
entries.examplePinyin: lóu shàng de zào yīn ràng wǒ shuì bù zháo.
entries.exampleEnglish: The noise from upstairs keeps me awake.
entries.question: 你家附近噪音大嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn zào yīn dà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is it noisy around your home?
entries.answer: 很大，機車的噪音很吵。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn dà, jī chē de zào yīn hěn chǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Very. The scooter noise is loud.

entries.example: 他在捷運站大喊我的名字。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài jié yùn zhàn dà hǎn wǒ de míng zì.
entries.exampleEnglish: He shouted my name in the MRT station.
entries.question: 你生氣時會大喊嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēng qì shí huì dà hǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you shout when you're angry?
entries.answer: 不會，我生氣時不會大喊。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ shēng qì shí bú huì dà hǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't shout when I'm angry.

entries.example: 華山這週有一個新展覽。
entries.examplePinyin: huà shān zhè zhōu yǒu yí gè xīn zhǎn lǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a new exhibition at Huashan this week.
entries.question: 你最近去看了什麼展覽？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn qù kàn le shén me zhǎn lǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: What exhibitions have you been to recently?
entries.answer: 我去看了一個攝影展覽。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qù kàn le yí gè shè yǐng zhǎn lǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: I went to a photography exhibition.

entries.example: 他講到家人就很激動。
entries.examplePinyin: tā jiǎng dào jiā rén jiù hěn jī dòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: He gets very emotional when he talks about his family.
entries.question: 你看比賽時會很激動嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn bǐ sài shí huì hěn jī dòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you get worked up when you watch a game?
entries.answer: 會，我看棒球時很激動。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ kàn bàng qiú shí hěn jī dòng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I get really worked up watching baseball.

entries.example: 她看電影看到流眼淚。
entries.examplePinyin: tā kàn diàn yǐng kàn dào liú yǎn lèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: She cried while watching the film.
entries.question: 你看什麼電影會流眼淚？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn shén me diàn yǐng huì liú yǎn lèi?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of films make you cry?
entries.answer: 我看狗狗的電影會流眼淚。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ kàn gǒu gǒu de diàn yǐng huì liú yǎn lèi.
entries.answerEnglish: Films about dogs make me cry.

entries.example: 今年的基本工資又調高了。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn nián de jī běn gōng zī yòu tiáo gāo le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The minimum wage went up again this year.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的基本工資夠嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān de jī běn gōng zī gòu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwan's minimum wage is enough?
entries.answer: 我覺得基本工資不太夠。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de jī běn gōng zī bú tài gòu.
entries.answerEnglish: I don't think the minimum wage is really enough.

entries.example: 他的夢想是當飛行員。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de mèng xiǎng shì dāng fēi xíng yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: His dream is to be a pilot.
entries.question: 你小時候想當飛行員嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu xiǎng dāng fēi xíng yuán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you want to be a pilot when you were a kid?
entries.answer: 想，我小時候想當飛行員。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, wǒ xiǎo shí hòu xiǎng dāng fēi xíng yuán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I wanted to be a pilot as a child.

entries.example: 他講話的語氣不太好。
entries.examplePinyin: tā jiǎng huà de yǔ qì bú tài hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: His tone when he speaks isn't very nice.
entries.question: 你覺得中文的語氣難學嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zhōng wén de yǔ qì nán xué ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you find the tone of voice in Chinese hard to learn?
entries.answer: 很難，我常常語氣用錯。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn nán, wǒ cháng cháng yǔ qì yòng cuò.
entries.answerEnglish: Very. I often use the wrong tone.

entries.example: 我姊姊在醫院工作，要輪班。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ jiě jie zài yī yuàn gōng zuò, yào lún bān.
entries.exampleEnglish: My sister works at a hospital and has to do shift work.
entries.question: 你的工作需要輪班嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng zuò xū yào lún bān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your job involve shift work?
entries.answer: 不用，我不用輪班。
entries.answerPinyin: bú yòng, wǒ bú yòng lún bān.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't work shifts.

entries.example: 這家店的特色是牛肉麵。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn de tè sè shì niú ròu miàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop's specialty is beef noodle soup.
entries.question: 你的家鄉有什麼特色？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de jiā xiāng yǒu shén me tè sè?
entries.questionEnglish: What is special about your hometown?
entries.answer: 我家鄉的特色是起司。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā xiāng de tè sè shì qǐ sī.
entries.answerEnglish: My hometown is known for its cheese.

entries.example: 學中文的第一個階段最難。
entries.examplePinyin: xué zhōng wén de dì yī gè jiē duàn zuì nán.
entries.exampleEnglish: The first stage of learning Chinese is the hardest.
entries.question: 你現在在人生的哪個階段？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiàn zài zài rén shēng de nǎ gè jiē duàn?
entries.questionEnglish: What stage of life are you in now?
entries.answer: 我在努力工作、存錢的階段。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài nǔ lì gōng zuò, cún qián de jiē duàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm at the stage of working hard and saving money.

entries.example: 書都放在架子上。
entries.examplePinyin: shū dōu fàng zài jià zi shàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The books are all on the shelf.
entries.question: 你家廚房有架子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā chú fáng yǒu jià zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have shelves in your kitchen?
entries.answer: 有，我用架子放調味料。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ yòng jià zi fàng tiáo wèi liào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I keep my seasonings on a rack.

entries.example: 這家店的價錢很合理。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn de jià qián hěn hé lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop's prices are very reasonable.
entries.question: 你覺得台北的房租合理嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái běi de fáng zū hé lǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think rents in Taipei are reasonable?
entries.answer: 不太合理，房租太貴了。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài hé lǐ, fáng zū tài guì le.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. Rent is too expensive.

entries.example: 我的感冒還沒完全恢復。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de gǎn mào hái méi wán quán huī fù.
entries.exampleEnglish: I haven't fully recovered from my cold.
entries.question: 你生病多久才會恢復？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēng bìng duō jiǔ cái huì huī fù?
entries.questionEnglish: How long does it take you to recover when you're sick?
entries.answer: 我通常三天就恢復了。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ tōng cháng sān tiān jiù huī fù le.
entries.answerEnglish: I usually recover in three days.

entries.example: 請幫我解開這個結。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng bāng wǒ jiě kāi zhè ge jié.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please help me undo this knot.
entries.question: 你喜歡解開謎題嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan jiě kāi mí tí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like solving puzzles?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我很喜歡解開謎題。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ hěn xǐ huan jiě kāi mí tí.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love solving puzzles.

entries.example: 冷氣要定期清洗。
entries.examplePinyin: lěng qì yào dìng qí qīng xǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Air conditioners need regular cleaning.
entries.question: 你多久清洗一次冷氣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duō jiǔ qīng xǐ yí cì lěng qì?
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you clean your air conditioner?
entries.answer: 我每年夏天清洗一次。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ měi nián xià tiān qīng xǐ yí cì.
entries.answerEnglish: I clean it once every summer.

entries.example: 醫生警告他不要再喝酒。
entries.examplePinyin: yī shēng jǐng gào tā bú yào zài hē jiǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The doctor warned him to stop drinking.
entries.question: 你被警察警告過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bèi jǐng chá jǐng gào guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been given a warning by the police?
entries.answer: 有一次，我騎車太快被警告。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu yí cì, wǒ qí chē tài kuài bèi jǐng gào.
entries.answerEnglish: Once. I got a warning for riding too fast.

entries.example: 我們在屋頂上看煙火。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zài wū dǐng shàng kàn yān huǒ.
entries.exampleEnglish: We watched the fireworks from the roof.
entries.question: 你家的屋頂可以上去嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de wū dǐng kě yǐ shàng qù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you go up on your building's roof?
entries.answer: 可以，我常在屋頂曬衣服。
entries.answerPinyin: kě yǐ, wǒ cháng zài wū dǐng shài yī fu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often dry my laundry on the roof.

entries.example: 老闆一直強調要準時。
entries.examplePinyin: lǎo bǎn yì zhí qiáng diào yào zhǔn shí.
entries.exampleEnglish: The boss keeps stressing that we must be on time.
entries.question: 你的主管常強調什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de zhǔ guǎn cháng qiáng diào shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What does your manager often stress?
entries.answer: 他常強調要準時開會。
entries.answerPinyin: tā cháng qiáng diào yào zhǔn shí kāi huì.
entries.answerEnglish: He often stresses starting meetings on time.

entries.example: 山上的手機訊號很差。
entries.examplePinyin: shān shàng de shǒu jī xùn hào hěn chà.
entries.exampleEnglish: Phone reception in the mountains is bad.
entries.question: 你家的手機訊號好嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de shǒu jī xùn hào hǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is the phone signal good at your place?
entries.answer: 不太好，在房間裡訊號很差。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài hǎo, zài fáng jiān lǐ xùn hào hěn chà.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. The signal is bad in my room.

entries.example: 他看起來很兇，實際上人很好。
entries.examplePinyin: tā kàn qǐ lái hěn xiōng, shí jì shang rén hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: He looks fierce, but actually he's very nice.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣人實際上很熱情嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān rén shí jì shang hěn rè qíng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwanese people are actually very friendly?
entries.answer: 實際上，大部分的人都很熱情。
entries.answerPinyin: shí jì shang, dà bù fèn de rén dōu hěn rè qíng.
entries.answerEnglish: In reality, most people are very friendly.

entries.example: 這家餐廳的氣氛很好。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā cān tīng de qì fēn hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant has a great atmosphere.
entries.question: 你喜歡什麼氣氛的咖啡店？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan shén me qì fēn de kā fēi diàn?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of atmosphere do you like in a coffee shop?
entries.answer: 我喜歡氣氛安靜的咖啡店。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan qì fēn ān jìng de kā fēi diàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I like coffee shops with a quiet atmosphere.

entries.example: 捷運上的乘客都在看手機。
entries.examplePinyin: jié yùn shàng de chéng kè dōu zài kàn shǒu jī.
entries.exampleEnglish: The passengers on the MRT are all looking at their phones.
entries.question: 你覺得捷運乘客有禮貌嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de jié yùn chéng kè yǒu lǐ mào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think MRT passengers are polite?
entries.answer: 很有禮貌，乘客都會排隊。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn yǒu lǐ mào, chéng kè dōu huì pái duì.
entries.answerEnglish: Very polite. The passengers always queue.

entries.example: 我的行李箱輪子壞了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de xíng li xiāng lún zǐ huài le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The wheel on my suitcase is broken.
entries.question: 你的行李箱有幾個輪子？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de xíng li xiāng yǒu jǐ gè lún zǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: How many wheels does your suitcase have?
entries.answer: 我的行李箱有四個輪子。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de xíng li xiāng yǒu sì gè lún zǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: My suitcase has four wheels.

entries.example: 這張桌子是鐵做的，很重。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhāng zhuō zi shì tiě zuò de, hěn zhòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This table is made of iron, so it's heavy.
entries.question: 你覺得鐵做的椅子舒服嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tiě zuò de yǐ zi shū fú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think iron chairs are comfortable?
entries.answer: 鐵做的椅子太硬了，不舒服。
entries.answerPinyin: tiě zuò de yǐ zi tài yìng le, bù shū fú.
entries.answerEnglish: Iron chairs are too hard; they're not comfortable.

entries.example: 我在郵件裡附上了檔案。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài yóu jiàn lǐ fù shàng le dǎng àn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I attached the file to the email.
entries.question: 你寄履歷的時候會附上照片嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jì lǚ lì de shí hòu huì fù shàng zhào piàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you attach a photo when you send your résumé?
entries.answer: 會，我都會附上一張照片。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōu huì fù shàng yì zhāng zhào piàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always attach a photo.

entries.example: 如果需要協助，請告訴櫃檯。
entries.examplePinyin: rú guǒ xū yào xié zhù, qǐng gào sù guì tái.
entries.exampleEnglish: If you need assistance, please tell the front desk.
entries.question: 工作上需要協助時，你會找誰？
entries.questionPinyin: gōng zuò shàng xū yào xié zhù shí, nǐ huì zhǎo shéi?
entries.questionEnglish: Who do you turn to when you need help at work?
entries.answer: 我會請旁邊的同事協助我。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì qǐng páng biān de tóng shì xié zhù wǒ.
entries.answerEnglish: I ask the colleague next to me to help me.

entries.example: 我先生大學是念工程的。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xiān shēng dà xué shì niàn gōng chéng de.
entries.exampleEnglish: My husband studied engineering in college.
entries.question: 你對工程有興趣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì gōng chéng yǒu xìng qù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you interested in engineering?
entries.answer: 有，我大學念的就是工程。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ dà xué niàn de jiù shì gōng chéng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, engineering is actually what I studied in college.

entries.example: 新來的同事很能幹，什麼都會。
entries.examplePinyin: xīn lái de tóng shì hěn néng gàn, shén me dōu huì.
entries.exampleEnglish: The new colleague is very capable and can do everything.
entries.question: 你身邊誰最能幹？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēn biān shéi zuì néng gàn?
entries.questionEnglish: Who is the most capable person around you?
entries.answer: 我媽媽最能幹，什麼都會做。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ mā ma zuì néng gàn, shén me dōu huì zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: My mom is the most capable; she can do anything.

entries.example: 他救了那個小孩，大家都說他是英雄。
entries.examplePinyin: tā jiù le nà ge xiǎo hái, dà jiā dōu shuō tā shì yīng xióng.
entries.exampleEnglish: He saved that child, and everyone says he's a hero.
entries.question: 你心中的英雄是誰？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xīn zhōng de yīng xióng shì shéi?
entries.questionEnglish: Who is your hero?
entries.answer: 我心中的英雄是我爸爸。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xīn zhōng de yīng xióng shì wǒ bà ba.
entries.answerEnglish: My hero is my dad.

entries.example: 台灣的鐵路可以環島一圈。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān de tiě lù kě yǐ huán dǎo yì quān.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan's railway goes all the way around the island.
entries.question: 你喜歡坐火車旅行嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zuò huǒ chē lǚ xíng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like traveling by train?
entries.answer: 喜歡，聽說東部鐵路的風景很美。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, tīng shuō dōng bù tiě lù de fēng jǐng hěn měi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. I've heard the scenery along the eastern railway is beautiful.

entries.example: 可以說得更詳細一點嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: kě yǐ shuō de gèng xiáng xì yì diǎn ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: Could you explain in a bit more detail?
entries.question: 你旅行前會做詳細的計畫嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ lǚ xíng qián huì zuò xiáng xì de jì huà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you make detailed plans before a trip?
entries.answer: 會，我都會做很詳細的計畫。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōu huì zuò hěn xiáng xì de jì huà.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always make very detailed plans.

entries.example: 謝謝你這幾年的陪伴。
entries.examplePinyin: xiè xiè nǐ zhè jǐ nián de péi bàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Thank you for being there for me these past few years.
entries.question: 你覺得誰最需要家人陪伴？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shéi zuì xū yào jiā rén péi bàn?
entries.questionEnglish: Who do you think needs their family's company the most?
entries.answer: 我覺得老人最需要家人陪伴。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de lǎo rén zuì xū yào jiā rén péi bàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I think elderly people need their family's company the most.

entries.example: 別催我，我馬上就好了！
entries.examplePinyin: bié cuī wǒ, wǒ mǎ shàng jiù hǎo le!
entries.exampleEnglish: Don't rush me, I'll be ready in a second!
entries.question: 你等朋友的時候會一直催嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ děng péng yǒu de shí hòu huì yì zhí cuī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you're waiting for a friend, do you keep hurrying them?
entries.answer: 不會，我不喜歡催別人。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ bù xǐ huan cuī bié rén.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't like rushing people.

entries.example: 我很喜歡看海洋紀錄片。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hěn xǐ huan kàn hǎi yáng jì lù piàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I love watching ocean documentaries.
entries.question: 你比較喜歡海洋還是高山？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bǐ jiào xǐ huan hǎi yáng hái shì gāo shān?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer the ocean or the mountains?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡海洋，因為我喜歡游泳。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan hǎi yáng, yīn wèi wǒ xǐ huan yóu yǒng.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer the ocean, because I like swimming.

entries.example: 台北很多公園裡不能抽香菸。
entries.examplePinyin: tái běi hěn duō gōng yuán lǐ bù néng chōu xiāng yān.
entries.exampleEnglish: You can't smoke cigarettes in many of Taipei's parks.
entries.question: 你身邊有人抽香菸嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēn biān yǒu rén chōu xiāng yān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does anyone around you smoke cigarettes?
entries.answer: 有，我爸爸每天都抽一包香菸。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ bà ba měi tiān dōu chōu yì bāo xiāng yān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my dad smokes a pack of cigarettes every day.

entries.example: 大家都要排隊，沒有例外。
entries.examplePinyin: dà jiā dōu yào pái duì, méi yǒu lì wài.
entries.exampleEnglish: Everyone has to line up, no exceptions.
entries.question: 你有什麼每天都做的事？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu shén me měi tiān dōu zuò de shì?
entries.questionEnglish: What's something you do every day?
entries.answer: 我每天都喝咖啡，從來沒有例外。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ měi tiān dōu hē kā fēi, cóng lái méi yǒu lì wài.
entries.answerEnglish: I drink coffee every day, without exception.

entries.example: 這個蛋糕要放冰箱保存。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge dàn gāo yào fàng bīng xiāng bǎo cún.
entries.exampleEnglish: This cake needs to be kept in the fridge.
entries.question: 你會保存旅行的車票嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì bǎo cún lǚ xíng de chē piào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you keep tickets from your trips?
entries.answer: 會，我都把車票保存在一個盒子裡。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōu bǎ chē piào bǎo cún zài yí gè hé zi lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I keep all my tickets in a box.

entries.example: 這次的旅行真的很完美。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì de lǚ xíng zhēn de hěn wán měi.
entries.exampleEnglish: This trip was really perfect.
entries.question: 你覺得完美的週末是什麼樣子？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de wán měi de zhōu mò shì shén me yàng zi?
entries.questionEnglish: What does a perfect weekend look like to you?
entries.answer: 完美的週末就是睡到自然醒。
entries.answerPinyin: wán měi de zhōu mò jiù shì shuì dào zì rán xǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: A perfect weekend is sleeping until I wake up on my own.

entries.example: 這家店的招牌很吸引人。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn de zhāo pái hěn xī yǐn rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop's sign is really eye-catching.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣什麼地方最吸引人？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān shén me dì fāng zuì xī yǐn rén?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is the most attractive thing about Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我覺得夜市最吸引人。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de yè shì zuì xī yǐn rén.
entries.answerEnglish: I think the night markets are the most appealing.

entries.example: 冬天去日本要穿靴子。
entries.examplePinyin: dōng tiān qù rì běn yào chuān xuē zǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: You need to wear boots when you go to Japan in winter.
entries.question: 你有幾雙靴子？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu jǐ shuāng xuē zǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: How many pairs of boots do you have?
entries.answer: 我只有一雙靴子，因為台灣不太冷。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhǐ yǒu yì shuāng xuē zǐ, yīn wèi tái wān bú tài lěng.
entries.answerEnglish: I only have one pair of boots, because Taiwan isn't very cold.

entries.example: 電燈的開關在門旁邊。
entries.examplePinyin: diàn dēng de kāi guān zài mén páng biān.
entries.exampleEnglish: The light switch is next to the door.
entries.question: 你家冷氣的開關在哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā lěng qì de kāi guān zài nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where's the switch for the air conditioner at your place?
entries.answer: 我家冷氣的開關在牆上。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā lěng qì de kāi guān zài qiáng shàng.
entries.answerEnglish: The AC switch at my place is on the wall.

entries.example: 高雄的龍虎塔很有名。
entries.examplePinyin: gāo xióng de lóng hǔ tǎ hěn yǒu míng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Kaohsiung's Dragon and Tiger Pagodas are famous.
entries.question: 你爬過很高的塔嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pá guò hěn gāo de tǎ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever climbed a tall tower?
entries.answer: 爬過，我上過東京鐵塔。
entries.answerPinyin: pá guò, wǒ shàng guò dōng jīng tiě tǎ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've been up Tokyo Tower.

entries.example: 去完海邊，鞋子裡都是沙。
entries.examplePinyin: qù wán hǎi biān, xié zǐ lǐ dōu shì shā.
entries.exampleEnglish: After the beach, my shoes are full of sand.
entries.question: 你喜歡在海邊玩沙嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zài hǎi biān wán shā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like playing in the sand at the beach?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我小時候常常玩沙。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ xiǎo shí hòu cháng cháng wán shā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often played in the sand as a kid.

entries.example: 我們爬到山頂看日出。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men pá dào shān dǐng kàn rì chū.
entries.exampleEnglish: We climbed to the summit to watch the sunrise.
entries.question: 你爬過哪座山的山頂？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pá guò nǎ zuò shān de shān dǐng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which mountain have you climbed to the top of?
entries.answer: 我上過玉山的山頂。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ shàng guò yù shān de shān dǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: I've made it to the top of Jade Mountain.

entries.example: 他寫了一首詩給女朋友。
entries.examplePinyin: tā xiě le yì shǒu shī gěi nǚ péng yǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: He wrote a poem for his girlfriend.
entries.question: 你會背中文詩嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì bèi zhōng wén shī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you recite any Chinese poems?
entries.answer: 會，我會背一首李白的詩。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì bèi yì shǒu lǐ bái de shī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I can recite a poem by Li Bai.

entries.example: 她親了一下寶寶的臉。
entries.examplePinyin: tā qīn le yí xià bǎo bao de liǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: She gave the baby a kiss on the cheek.
entries.question: 你們國家的人見面會親臉頰嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men guó jiā de rén jiàn miàn huì qīn liǎn jiá ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do people in your country kiss on the cheek when they meet?
entries.answer: 會，我們見面會親一下臉頰。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ men jiàn miàn huì qīn yí xià liǎn jiá.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we give a kiss on the cheek when we meet.

entries.example: 跨年夜的台北很瘋狂。
entries.examplePinyin: kuà nián yè de tái běi hěn fēng kuáng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taipei on New Year's Eve is crazy.
entries.question: 你做過最瘋狂的事是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò guò zuì fēng kuáng de shì shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the craziest thing you've ever done?
entries.answer: 我做過最瘋狂的事是一個人騎車環島。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuò guò zuì fēng kuáng de shì shì yí gè rén qí chē huán dǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: The craziest thing I've done is cycle around Taiwan alone.

entries.example: 這條項鍊是銀做的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tiáo xiàng liàn shì yín zuò de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This necklace is made of silver.
entries.question: 你喜歡戴銀的戒指嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan dài yín de jiè zhǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like wearing silver rings?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我的戒指都是銀的。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ de jiè zhǐ dōu shì yín de.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, all my rings are silver.

entries.example: 孩子們在公園玩溜滑梯。
entries.examplePinyin: hái zi men zài gōng yuán wán liū huá tī.
entries.exampleEnglish: The kids are playing on the slide in the park.
entries.question: 你小時候喜歡玩溜滑梯嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu xǐ huan wán liū huá tī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you like going down the slide as a kid?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常常在公園玩溜滑梯。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ cháng cháng zài gōng yuán wán liū huá tī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often played on the slide in the park.

entries.example: 我說服了朋友一起去爬山。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ shuō fú le péng yǒu yì qǐ qù pá shān.
entries.exampleEnglish: I persuaded my friend to go hiking with me.
entries.question: 你最近說服誰做了什麼事？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn shuō fú shéi zuò le shén me shì?
entries.questionEnglish: Who have you recently persuaded to do something?
entries.answer: 我說服我先生每天去運動。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ shuō fú wǒ xiān shēng měi tiān qù yùn dòng.
entries.answerEnglish: I persuaded my husband to exercise every day.

entries.example: 旅客請前往五號登機門。
entries.examplePinyin: lǚ kè qǐng qián wǎng wǔ hào dēng jī mén.
entries.exampleEnglish: Passengers, please proceed to Gate 5.
entries.question: 你下次放假想前往哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xià cì fàng jià xiǎng qián wǎng nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where would you like to head on your next holiday?
entries.answer: 我想前往花蓮看海。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng qián wǎng huā lián kàn hǎi.
entries.answerEnglish: I want to head to Hualien to see the ocean.

entries.example: 我原本想搭捷運，後來坐了計程車。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ yuán běn xiǎng dā jié yùn, hòu lái zuò le jì chéng chē.
entries.exampleEnglish: I was going to take the MRT, but I ended up taking a taxi.
entries.question: 你原本打算在台灣住多久？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yuán běn dǎ suàn zài tái wān zhù duō jiǔ?
entries.questionEnglish: How long did you originally plan to stay in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我原本打算住一年，結果住了五年。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yuán běn dǎ suàn zhù yì nián, jié guǒ zhù le wǔ nián.
entries.answerEnglish: I originally planned to stay a year, but I've been here five.

entries.example: 週末九份老街有很多旅客。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōu mò jiǔ fèn lǎo jiē yǒu hěn duō lǚ kè.
entries.exampleEnglish: Jiufen Old Street has lots of tourists on weekends.
entries.question: 你住的地方旅客多嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhù de dì fāng lǚ kè duō ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there lots of tourists where you live?
entries.answer: 很多，週末到處都是旅客。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn duō, zhōu mò dào chù dōu shì lǚ kè.
entries.answerEnglish: Lots. On weekends there are tourists everywhere.

entries.example: 用繩子把紙箱綁起來。
entries.examplePinyin: yòng shéng zi bǎ zhǐ xiāng bǎng qǐ lái.
entries.exampleEnglish: Tie up the cardboard boxes with rope.
entries.question: 你搬家時會用繩子綁東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bān jiā shí huì yòng shéng zi bǎng dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you tie things up with rope when you move?
entries.answer: 會，我都用繩子把紙箱綁好。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōu yòng shéng zi bǎ zhǐ xiāng bǎng hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I tie up all the boxes with rope.

entries.example: 用電腦的時候要注意姿勢。
entries.examplePinyin: yòng diàn nǎo de shí hòu yào zhù yì zī shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Watch your posture when you use the computer.
entries.question: 你拍照最喜歡擺什麼姿勢？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pāi zhào zuì xǐ huan bǎi shén me zī shì?
entries.questionEnglish: What pose do you like to strike in photos?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡擺比讚的姿勢。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan bǎi bǐ zàn de zī shì.
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite pose is a thumbs-up.

entries.example: 謝謝你寶貴的意見。
entries.examplePinyin: xiè xiè nǐ bǎo guì de yì jiàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Thank you for your valuable feedback.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼東西最寶貴？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me dōng xī zuì bǎo guì?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is most precious?
entries.answer: 我覺得時間最寶貴。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de shí jiān zuì bǎo guì.
entries.answerEnglish: I think time is the most precious thing.

entries.example: 現在很多人用手機存電子發票。
entries.examplePinyin: xiàn zài hěn duō rén yòng shǒu jī cún diàn zǐ fā piào.
entries.exampleEnglish: These days lots of people store e-receipts on their phones.
entries.question: 你常常買電子產品嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng cháng mǎi diàn zǐ chǎn pǐn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often buy electronics?
entries.answer: 常常，我很喜歡買新的電子產品。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ hěn xǐ huan mǎi xīn de diàn zǐ chǎn pǐn.
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I love buying new electronics.

entries.example: 基隆是一個很大的港口。
entries.examplePinyin: jī lóng shì yí gè hěn dà de gǎng kǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: Keelung is a big port.
entries.question: 你去過高雄的港口嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò gāo xióng de gǎng kǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to the harbor in Kaohsiung?
entries.answer: 去過，晚上的港口很漂亮。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, wǎn shàng de gǎng kǒu hěn piào liang.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the harbor is beautiful at night.

entries.example: 媽媽煮了一大鍋湯。
entries.examplePinyin: mā ma zhǔ le yí dà guō tāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Mom made a big pot of soup.
entries.question: 你家有幾個鍋子？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ gè guō zǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: How many pots do you have at home?
entries.answer: 我家有三個鍋子，一個是電鍋。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā yǒu sān gè guō zǐ, yí gè shì diàn guō.
entries.answerEnglish: I have three pots at home, and one is a rice cooker.

entries.example: 我的皮膚很敏感，不能曬太久。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de pí fū hěn mǐn gǎn, bù néng shài tài jiǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: My skin is sensitive, so I can't be in the sun too long.
entries.question: 你對什麼很敏感？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì shén me hěn mǐn gǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: What are you sensitive to?
entries.answer: 我對花粉很敏感，常常打噴嚏。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ duì huā fěn hěn mǐn gǎn, cháng cháng dǎ pēn tì.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm sensitive to pollen and sneeze a lot.

entries.example: 我對這個地方很陌生。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ duì zhè ge dì fāng hěn mò shēng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm not familiar with this place.
entries.question: 你剛來台灣時，覺得陌生嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gāng lái tái wān shí, jué de mò shēng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did Taiwan feel unfamiliar when you first arrived?
entries.answer: 很陌生，我什麼字都看不懂。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn mò shēng, wǒ shén me zì dōu kàn bù dǒng.
entries.answerEnglish: Very. I couldn't read a single word.

entries.example: 她在大學念的是戲劇。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài dà xué niàn de shì xì jù.
entries.exampleEnglish: She studied drama in college.
entries.question: 你喜歡看哪一國的戲劇？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kàn nǎ yì guó de xì jù?
entries.questionEnglish: Which country's dramas do you like to watch?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡看韓國的戲劇。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan kàn hán guó de xì jù.
entries.answerEnglish: I like Korean dramas best.

entries.example: 這份報告我修改了三次。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè fèn bào gào wǒ xiū gǎi le sān cì.
entries.exampleEnglish: I revised this report three times.
entries.question: 你寫完東西會再修改嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiě wán dōng xī huì zài xiū gǎi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you revise things after you write them?
entries.answer: 會，我寫完都會再修改一次。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ xiě wán dōu huì zài xiū gǎi yí cì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always revise once more after I finish.

entries.example: 我每天早上先看電子郵件。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng xiān kàn diàn zǐ yóu jiàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Every morning I check my email first.
entries.question: 你一天會收到幾封郵件？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yì tiān huì shōu dào jǐ fēng yóu jiàn?
entries.questionEnglish: How many emails do you get a day?
entries.answer: 我一天大概收到五十封郵件。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yì tiān dà gài shōu dào wǔ shí fēng yóu jiàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I get about fifty emails a day.

entries.example: 我把冷氣調整到二十六度。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bǎ lěng qì tiáo zhěng dào èr shí liù dù.
entries.exampleEnglish: I set the AC to 26 degrees.
entries.question: 來台灣以後，你調整了哪些習慣？
entries.questionPinyin: lái tái wān yǐ hòu, nǐ tiáo zhěng le nǎ xiē xí guàn?
entries.questionEnglish: Which habits have you adjusted since coming to Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我調整了吃飯時間，現在比較早吃晚餐。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ tiáo zhěng le chī fàn shí jiān, xiàn zài bǐ jiào zǎo chī wǎn cān.
entries.answerEnglish: I adjusted my mealtimes; now I eat dinner earlier.

entries.example: 今天空氣污染很嚴重，要戴口罩。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn tiān kōng qì wū rǎn hěn yán zhòng, yào dài kǒu zhào.
entries.exampleEnglish: Air pollution is bad today, so wear a mask.
entries.question: 你住的地方空氣污染嚴重嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhù de dì fāng kōng qì wū rǎn yán zhòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is air pollution bad where you live?
entries.answer: 不太嚴重，但是冬天污染比較多。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài yán zhòng, dàn shì dōng tiān wū rǎn bǐ jiào duō.
entries.answerEnglish: Not too bad, but there's more pollution in winter.

entries.example: 小心，地上有電線。
entries.examplePinyin: xiǎo xīn, dì shàng yǒu diàn xiàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Careful, there's a wire on the floor.
entries.question: 你書桌下面的電線亂不亂？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shū zhuō xià miàn de diàn xiàn luàn bu luàn?
entries.questionEnglish: Are the cords under your desk messy?
entries.answer: 很亂，我書桌下面都是電線。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn luàn, wǒ shū zhuō xià miàn dōu shì diàn xiàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Very messy. There are cords all over under my desk.

entries.example: 夜市有用紙網撈金魚的遊戲。
entries.examplePinyin: yè shì yǒu yòng zhǐ wǎng lāo jīn yú de yóu xì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Night markets have a game where you scoop goldfish with a paper net.
entries.question: 你在夜市玩過撈金魚嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài yè shì wán guò lāo jīn yú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever tried goldfish scooping at a night market?
entries.answer: 玩過，可是紙網一下就破了。
entries.answerPinyin: wán guò, kě shì zhǐ wǎng yí xià jiù pò le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but the paper net tore right away.

entries.example: 師傅明天會來安裝冷氣。
entries.examplePinyin: shī fu míng tiān huì lái ān zhuāng lěng qì.
entries.exampleEnglish: The technician is coming to install the air conditioner tomorrow.
entries.question: 你手機上安裝了學中文的軟體嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shǒu jī shàng ān zhuāng le xué zhōng wén de ruǎn tǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you installed any Chinese-learning apps on your phone?
entries.answer: 有，我安裝了兩個學中文的軟體。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ ān zhuāng le liǎng gè xué zhōng wén de ruǎn tǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've installed two apps for learning Chinese.

entries.example: 我們週末要去買新家具。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zhōu mò yào qù mǎi xīn jiā jù.
entries.exampleEnglish: We're going to buy new furniture this weekend.
entries.question: 你家裡最喜歡哪件家具？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā lǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ jiàn jiā jù?
entries.questionEnglish: Which piece of furniture in your home do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡的家具是客廳的沙發。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan de jiā jù shì kè tīng de shā fā.
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite piece of furniture is the living room sofa.

entries.example: 我的鄰居生了一對雙胞胎。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de lín jū shēng le yí duì shuāng bāo tāi.
entries.exampleEnglish: My neighbor had twins.
entries.question: 你認識雙胞胎嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ rèn shì shuāng bāo tāi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know any twins?
entries.answer: 認識，我同事就是雙胞胎。
entries.answerPinyin: rèn shì, wǒ tóng shì jiù shì shuāng bāo tāi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my coworker is a twin.

entries.example: 她做事很有效率。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zuò shì hěn yǒu xiào lǜ.
entries.exampleEnglish: She works very efficiently.
entries.question: 你什麼時候工作最有效率？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shén me shí hòu gōng zuò zuì yǒu xiào lǜ?
entries.questionEnglish: When do you work most efficiently?
entries.answer: 我早上工作最有效率。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zǎo shàng gōng zuò zuì yǒu xiào lǜ.
entries.answerEnglish: I work most efficiently in the morning.

entries.example: 他每天騎電動機車上班。
entries.examplePinyin: tā měi tiān qí diàn dòng jī chē shàng bān.
entries.exampleEnglish: He rides an electric scooter to work every day.
entries.question: 你想買電動機車嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng mǎi diàn dòng jī chē ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to buy an electric scooter?
entries.answer: 想，電動機車比較安靜。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, diàn dòng jī chē bǐ jiào ān jìng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, electric scooters are quieter.

entries.example: 小朋友在沙灘上挖沙。
entries.examplePinyin: xiǎo péng yǒu zài shā tān shàng wā shā.
entries.exampleEnglish: The kids are digging in the sand on the beach.
entries.question: 你去過農場挖地瓜嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò nóng chǎng wā dì guā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever dug up sweet potatoes on a farm?
entries.answer: 去過，挖地瓜很好玩。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, wā dì guā hěn hǎo wán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, digging up sweet potatoes is a lot of fun.

entries.example: 這條皮帶太長了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tiáo pí dài tài cháng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This belt is too long.
entries.question: 你上班會繫皮帶嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shàng bān huì jì pí dài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you wear a belt to work?
entries.answer: 會，我上班都會繫皮帶。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ shàng bān dōu huì jì pí dài.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always wear a belt to work.

entries.example: 我想去沙漠看星星。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xiǎng qù shā mò kàn xīng xīng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I want to go stargazing in the desert.
entries.question: 你去過沙漠嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò shā mò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been to a desert?
entries.answer: 去過，我去過埃及的沙漠。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, wǒ qù guò āi jí de shā mò.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've been to the desert in Egypt.

entries.example: 台灣是美食天堂。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān shì měi shí tiān táng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan is a food paradise.
entries.question: 你覺得哪裡是購物天堂？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǎ lǐ shì gòu wù tiān táng?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you think is a shopping paradise?
entries.answer: 我覺得東京是購物天堂。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de dōng jīng shì gòu wù tiān táng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think Tokyo is a shopping paradise.

entries.example: 我打電話詢問飯店還有沒有空房。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ dǎ diàn huà xún wèn fàn diàn hái yǒu méi yǒu kòng fáng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I called the hotel to ask if they had any rooms available.
entries.question: 找房子的時候，你會詢問什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: zhǎo fáng zi de shí hòu, nǐ huì xún wèn shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: When you're looking for an apartment, what do you ask about?
entries.answer: 我會詢問房租和水電費。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì xún wèn fáng zū hé shuǐ diàn fèi.
entries.answerEnglish: I ask about the rent and utilities.

entries.example: 我還欠他一百塊。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hái qiàn tā yì bǎi kuài.
entries.exampleEnglish: I still owe him a hundred dollars.
entries.question: 你現在有欠別人錢嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiàn zài yǒu qiàn bié rén qián ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you owe anyone money right now?
entries.answer: 沒有，我不喜歡欠別人錢。
entries.answerPinyin: méi yǒu, wǒ bù xǐ huan qiàn bié rén qián.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't like owing people money.

entries.example: 唱KTV是台灣人常見的娛樂。
entries.examplePinyin: chàng KTV shì tái wān rén cháng jiàn de yú lè.
entries.exampleEnglish: Karaoke is a common form of entertainment in Taiwan.
entries.question: 你週末有什麼娛樂？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhōu mò yǒu shén me yú lè?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do for fun on weekends?
entries.answer: 我週末的娛樂是看電影。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhōu mò de yú lè shì kàn diàn yǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: On weekends I go to the movies for fun.

entries.example: 從這個角度拍照比較好看。
entries.examplePinyin: cóng zhè ge jiǎo dù pāi zhào bǐ jiào hǎo kàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Photos look better from this angle.
entries.question: 你覺得從外國人的角度看，台灣怎麼樣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de cóng wài guó rén de jiǎo dù kàn, tái wān zěn me yàng?
entries.questionEnglish: From a foreigner's perspective, what do you think of Taiwan?
entries.answer: 從我的角度看，台灣很安全，也很方便。
entries.answerPinyin: cóng wǒ de jiǎo dù kàn, tái wān hěn ān quán, yě hěn fāng biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: From my perspective, Taiwan is very safe and convenient.

entries.example: 問題來了，就要勇敢面對。
entries.examplePinyin: wèn tí lái le, jiù yào yǒng gǎn miàn duì.
entries.exampleEnglish: When problems come, you have to face them bravely.
entries.question: 你怎麼面對工作上的壓力？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zěn me miàn duì gōng zuò shàng de yā lì?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you deal with pressure at work?
entries.answer: 我會冷靜面對，一件一件處理。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì lěng jìng miàn duì, yí jiàn yi jiàn chǔ lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I face it calmly and handle things one at a time.

entries.example: 我們暫停一下，休息五分鐘。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zhàn tíng yí xià, xiū xí wǔ fēn zhōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's pause and take a five-minute break.
entries.question: 看影片時你常按暫停嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: kàn yǐng piàn shí nǐ cháng àn zhàn tíng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often hit pause when watching videos?
entries.answer: 常常，我會按暫停查生字。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ huì àn zhàn tíng chá shēng zì.
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I pause to look up new words.

entries.example: 這碗湯要加一點胡椒。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè wǎn tāng yào jiā yì diǎn hú jiāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This soup needs a bit of pepper.
entries.question: 你吃東西喜歡加胡椒嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chī dōng xī xǐ huan jiā hú jiāo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like adding pepper to your food?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我吃牛排一定加胡椒。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ chī niú pái yí dìng jiā hú jiāo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always put pepper on my steak.

entries.example: 週末我們去國家音樂廳聽音樂會。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōu mò wǒ men qù guó jiā yīn yuè tīng tīng yīn yuè huì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This weekend we're going to a concert at the National Concert Hall.
entries.question: 你喜歡去聽音樂會嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan qù tīng yīn yuè huì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like going to concerts?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我一年會去聽好幾場音樂會。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ yì nián huì qù tīng hǎo jǐ chǎng yīn yuè huì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I go to several concerts a year.

entries.example: 光是房租就要兩萬塊。
entries.examplePinyin: guāng shì fáng zū jiù yào liǎng wàn kuài.
entries.exampleEnglish: The rent alone is twenty thousand.
entries.question: 你每個月光是吃飯要花多少錢？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ měi gè yuè guāng shì chī fàn yào huā duō shǎo qián?
entries.questionEnglish: How much do you spend each month just on food?
entries.answer: 光是吃飯就要一萬塊左右。
entries.answerPinyin: guāng shì chī fàn jiù yào yí wàn kuài zuǒ yòu.
entries.answerEnglish: Food alone costs around ten thousand.

entries.example: 我臨時有事，今天不能去了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ lín shí yǒu shì, jīn tiān bù néng qù le.
entries.exampleEnglish: Something came up at the last minute; I can't go today.
entries.question: 你常常臨時改變計畫嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng cháng lín shí gǎi biàn jì huà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often change plans at the last minute?
entries.answer: 有時候，我會臨時取消約會。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu, wǒ huì lín shí qǔ xiāo yuē huì.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. I cancel plans at the last minute.

entries.example: 她在醫院的實驗室工作。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài yī yuàn de shí yàn shì gōng zuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: She works in a hospital lab.
entries.question: 你在實驗室工作過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài shí yàn shì gōng zuò guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever worked in a lab?
entries.answer: 工作過，我以前在大學的實驗室打工。
entries.answerPinyin: gōng zuò guò, wǒ yǐ qián zài dà xué de shí yàn shì dǎ gōng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I used to have a part-time job in a university lab.

entries.example: 廟裡的鐘每天早上都會響。
entries.examplePinyin: miào lǐ de zhōng měi tiān zǎo shàng dōu huì xiǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The temple bell rings every morning.
entries.question: 你家附近聽得到鐘聲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn tīng de dào zhōng shēng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you hear bells near your home?
entries.answer: 聽得到，附近教堂的鐘聲很好聽。
entries.answerPinyin: tīng de dào, fù jìn jiào táng de zhōng shēng hěn hǎo tīng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the bells at the nearby church sound lovely.

entries.example: 我個人覺得這家比較好吃。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ gè rén jué de zhè jiā bǐ jiào hǎo chī.
entries.exampleEnglish: Personally, I think this place is tastier.
entries.question: 你個人比較喜歡台北還是台中？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gè rén bǐ jiào xǐ huan tái běi hái shì tái zhōng?
entries.questionEnglish: Personally, do you prefer Taipei or Taichung?
entries.answer: 我個人比較喜歡台中，生活比較輕鬆。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ gè rén bǐ jiào xǐ huan tái zhōng, shēng huó bǐ jiào qīng sōng.
entries.answerEnglish: Personally, I prefer Taichung; life is more relaxed there.

entries.example: 這個天氣預報很準確。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge tiān qì yù bào hěn zhǔn què.
entries.exampleEnglish: This weather forecast is very accurate.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的天氣預報準確嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān de tiān qì yù bào zhǔn què ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwan's weather forecasts are accurate?
entries.answer: 不太準確，常常說不下雨卻下雨。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài zhǔn què, cháng cháng shuō bú xià yǔ què xià yǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: Not very. It often says no rain, and then it rains.

entries.example: 我常常在網路上購物。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ cháng cháng zài wǎng lù shang gòu wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: I often shop online.
entries.question: 你喜歡網路購物嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan wǎng lù gòu wù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like online shopping?
