entries.answer: 喜歡，網路購物很方便。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǎng lù gòu wù hěn fāng biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, online shopping is convenient.

entries.example: 市長宣布明天放颱風假。
entries.examplePinyin: shì zhǎng xuān bù míng tiān fàng tái fēng jià.
entries.exampleEnglish: The mayor announced a typhoon day off tomorrow.
entries.question: 你知道你們城市的市長是誰嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào nǐ men chéng shì de shì zhǎng shì shéi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know who your city's mayor is?
entries.answer: 我不知道我們的市長是誰。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bù zhī dào wǒ men de shì zhǎng shì shéi.
entries.answerEnglish: I don't know who our mayor is.

entries.example: 我的助理幫我安排了明天的會議。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de zhù lǐ bāng wǒ ān pái le míng tiān de huì yì.
entries.exampleEnglish: My assistant arranged tomorrow's meeting for me.
entries.question: 你的工作需要助理嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng zuò xū yào zhù lǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your job need an assistant?
entries.answer: 需要，我希望有一個助理幫我。
entries.answerPinyin: xū yào, wǒ xī wàng yǒu yí gè zhù lǐ bāng wǒ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I wish I had an assistant to help me.

entries.example: 按這個按鈕，門就會開。
entries.examplePinyin: àn zhè ge àn niǔ, mén jiù huì kāi.
entries.exampleEnglish: Press this button and the door will open.
entries.question: 你的手機有幾個按鈕？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de shǒu jī yǒu jǐ gè àn niǔ?
entries.questionEnglish: How many buttons does your phone have?
entries.answer: 我的手機只有三個按鈕。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de shǒu jī zhǐ yǒu sān gè àn niǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: My phone has only three buttons.

entries.example: 進大樓前要先在櫃檯登記。
entries.examplePinyin: jìn dà lóu qián yào xiān zài guì tái dēng jì.
entries.exampleEnglish: You have to sign in at the front desk before entering the building.
entries.question: 你參加活動常常要先登記嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān jiā huó dòng cháng cháng yào xiān dēng jì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often have to register before joining events?
entries.answer: 對，很多活動都要先上網登記。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, hěn duō huó dòng dōu yào xiān shàng wǎng dēng jì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, many events require you to register online first.

entries.example: 導遊拿著一面黃色的旗子。
entries.examplePinyin: dǎo yóu ná zhe yí miàn huáng sè de qí zǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The tour guide is holding a yellow flag.
entries.question: 看比賽時，你會帶旗子去加油嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: kàn bǐ sài shí, nǐ huì dài qí zǐ qù jiā yóu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you bring a flag to cheer when you watch a game?
entries.answer: 會，我會帶一面小旗子去加油。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì dài yí miàn xiǎo qí zǐ qù jiā yóu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I bring a small flag to cheer.

entries.example: 這張圖表看得出今年賣得比較好。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhāng tú biǎo kàn de chū jīn nián mài de bǐ jiào hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This chart shows that sales are better this year.
entries.question: 你工作的時候常做圖表嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gōng zuò de shí hòu cháng zuò tú biǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often make charts at work?
entries.answer: 常做，我每個月都要做好幾張圖表。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng zuò, wǒ měi gè yuè dōu yào zuò hǎo jǐ zhāng tú biǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have to make several charts every month.

entries.example: 這個醬有點辣，你要小心。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge jiàng yǒu diǎn là, nǐ yào xiǎo xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This sauce is a bit spicy; be careful.
entries.question: 你吃水餃喜歡沾什麼醬？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chī shuǐ jiǎo xǐ huan zhān shén me jiàng?
entries.questionEnglish: What sauce do you like to dip dumplings in?
entries.answer: 我喜歡沾醬油和辣椒醬。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan zhān jiàng yóu hé là jiāo jiàng.
entries.answerEnglish: I like soy sauce and chili sauce.

entries.example: 上課的時候，我可以錄音嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: shàng kè de shí hòu, wǒ kě yǐ lù yīn ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: May I record during class?
entries.question: 你會錄音練習說中文嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì lù yīn liàn xí shuō zhōng wén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you record yourself to practice speaking Chinese?
entries.answer: 會，我每天錄音，再聽自己的發音。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi tiān lù yīn, zài tīng zì jǐ de fā yīn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I record myself every day and then listen to my pronunciation.

entries.example: 這個便當的數量有限，要早點買。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge biàn dāng de shù liàng yǒu xiàn, yào zǎo diǎn mǎi.
entries.exampleEnglish: These lunch boxes are limited, so buy them early.
entries.question: 買東西時，你重視品質還是數量？
entries.questionPinyin: mǎi dōng xī shí, nǐ zhòng shì pǐn zhí hái shì shù liàng?
entries.questionEnglish: When shopping, do you care more about quality or quantity?
entries.answer: 我比較重視品質，數量不用多。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào zhòng shì pǐn zhí, shù liàng bú yòng duō.
entries.answerEnglish: I care more about quality; I don't need a lot.

entries.example: 這個品牌的手機在台灣很有名。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge pǐn pái de shǒu jī zài tái wān hěn yǒu míng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This brand of phone is very well known in Taiwan.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪個運動品牌？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ gè yùn dòng pǐn pái?
entries.questionEnglish: Which sports brand do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡日本的運動品牌。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan rì běn de yùn dòng pǐn pái.
entries.answerEnglish: I like Japanese sports brands best.

entries.example: 我姊姊懷孕了，明年三月生。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ jiě jie huái yùn le, míng nián sān yuè shēng.
entries.exampleEnglish: My older sister is pregnant; she's due next March.
entries.question: 在捷運上，你會讓座給懷孕的人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zài jié yùn shàng, nǐ huì ràng zuò gěi huái yùn de rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: On the MRT, do you give your seat to pregnant women?
entries.answer: 會，看到懷孕的人我一定讓座。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, kàn dào huái yùn de rén wǒ yí dìng ràng zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always give up my seat when I see a pregnant woman.

entries.example: 我瘦了，現在褲子很鬆。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ shòu le, xiàn zài kù zǐ hěn sōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I've lost weight; my pants are loose now.
entries.question: 你喜歡穿比較鬆的衣服嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chuān bǐ jiào sōng de yī fu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like to wear looser clothes?
entries.answer: 喜歡，鬆一點的衣服比較舒服。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, sōng yì diǎn de yī fu bǐ jiào shū fú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, looser clothes are more comfortable.

entries.example: 朋友失戀了，我去安慰她。
entries.examplePinyin: péng yǒu shī liàn le, wǒ qù ān wèi tā.
entries.exampleEnglish: My friend went through a breakup, so I went to comfort her.
entries.question: 你難過的時候，誰會安慰你？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ nán guò de shí hòu, shéi huì ān wèi nǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: When you're sad, who comforts you?
entries.answer: 我的室友常常安慰我。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de shì yǒu cháng cháng ān wèi wǒ.
entries.answerEnglish: My roommate often comforts me.

entries.example: 我在德國參觀了一座很美的城堡。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài dé guó cān guān le yí zuò hěn měi de chéng bǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: I visited a beautiful castle in Germany.
entries.question: 你想去哪個國家看城堡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ gè guó jiā kàn chéng bǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: Which country would you like to visit to see castles?
entries.answer: 我想去英國看城堡。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng qù yīng guó kàn chéng bǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to go to the UK to see castles.

entries.example: 我跟你打賭，他今天又會遲到。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ gēn nǐ dǎ dǔ, tā jīn tiān yòu huì chí dào.
entries.exampleEnglish: I bet you he'll be late again today.
entries.question: 你跟朋友打賭過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gēn péng yǒu dǎ dǔ guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever made a bet with a friend?
entries.answer: 有，我跟朋友打賭誰先學會騎機車。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ gēn péng yǒu dǎ dǔ shéi xiān xué huì qí jī chē.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I bet a friend on who would learn to ride a scooter first.

entries.example: 那個投手投球投得很快。
entries.examplePinyin: nà ge tóu shǒu tóu qiú tóu de hěn kuài.
entries.exampleEnglish: That pitcher throws really fast.
entries.question: 你會投棒球嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì tóu bàng qiú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you pitch a baseball?
entries.answer: 會一點，可是我投得不太準。
entries.answerPinyin: huì yì diǎn, kě shì wǒ tóu de bú tài zhǔn.
entries.answerEnglish: A little, but my throws aren't very accurate.

entries.example: 這支影片是我們自己製作的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhī yǐng piàn shì wǒ men zì jǐ zhì zuò de.
entries.exampleEnglish: We made this video ourselves.
entries.question: 你自己製作過影片嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zì jǐ zhì zuò guò yǐng piàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever made a video yourself?
entries.answer: 有，我製作過介紹台灣美食的影片。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ zhì zuò guò jiè shào tái wān měi shí de yǐng piàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've made a video introducing Taiwanese food.

entries.example: 公車要開了，請站穩。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng chē yào kāi le, qǐng zhàn wěn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The bus is about to move; please hold on and stand steady.
entries.question: 你騎腳踏車騎得穩嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qí jiǎo tà chē qí de wěn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you ride a bike steadily?
entries.answer: 騎得很穩，我每天騎車上班。
entries.answerPinyin: qí de hěn wěn, wǒ měi tiān qí chē shàng bān.
entries.answerEnglish: Very steadily; I ride to work every day.

entries.example: 我下週要參加朋友的結婚典禮。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xià zhōu yào cān jiā péng yǒu de jié hūn diǎn lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Next week I'm going to a friend's wedding ceremony.
entries.question: 你最近參加過什麼典禮？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn cān jiā guò shén me diǎn lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: What ceremony have you attended recently?
entries.answer: 我上個月參加了妹妹的畢業典禮。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ shàng gè yuè cān jiā le mèi mei de bì yè diǎn lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Last month I went to my younger sister's graduation ceremony.

entries.example: 我可以借用一下你的充電器嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ kě yǐ jiè yòng yí xià nǐ de chōng diàn qì ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: Could I borrow your charger for a moment?
entries.question: 你常跟同事借用東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng gēn tóng shì jiè yòng dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often borrow things from coworkers?
entries.answer: 不常，有時候會借用他們的筆。
entries.answerPinyin: bù cháng, yǒu shí hòu huì jiè yòng tā men de bǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Not often; sometimes I borrow their pens.

entries.english: remove; get rid of; leave out
entries.example: 這句話太長了，把後面三個字去掉吧。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jù huà tài cháng le, bǎ hòu miàn sān gè zì qù diào ba.
entries.exampleEnglish: This sentence is too long; let's cut the last three characters.
entries.question: 你點餐時會請老闆去掉什麼嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ diǎn cān shí huì qǐng lǎo bǎn qù diào shén me ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you order food, do you ask them to leave anything out?
entries.answer: 會，我都請老闆去掉香菜。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōu qǐng lǎo bǎn qù diào xiāng cài.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always ask them to leave out the cilantro.

entries.example: 牧場裡有很多母牛。
entries.examplePinyin: mù chǎng lǐ yǒu hěn duō mǔ niú.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are many cows on the ranch.
entries.question: 你摸過母牛嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mō guò mǔ niú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever touched a cow?
entries.answer: 摸過，我在花蓮的牧場摸過母牛。
entries.answerPinyin: mō guò, wǒ zài huā lián de mù chǎng mō guò mǔ niú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I touched a cow at a ranch in Hualien.

entries.example: 他今天開會的時候表現得很好。
entries.examplePinyin: tā jīn tiān kāi huì de shí hòu biǎo xiàn de hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: He did really well in today's meeting.
entries.question: 你覺得你這個月的工作表現怎麼樣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ zhè ge yuè de gōng zuò biǎo xiàn zěn me yàng?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you think your work performance has been this month?
entries.answer: 還不錯，主管說我的表現很好。
entries.answerPinyin: hái bú cuò, zhǔ guǎn shuō wǒ de biǎo xiàn hěn hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Not bad; my boss said my performance was good.

entries.example: 廚房的水龍頭壞了，一直漏水。
entries.examplePinyin: chú fáng de shuǐ lóng tóu huài le, yì zhí lòu shuǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The kitchen faucet is broken and keeps leaking.
entries.question: 你家的水龍頭有熱水嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de shuǐ lóng tóu yǒu rè shuǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your faucet have hot water?
entries.answer: 有，浴室的水龍頭有熱水。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, yù shì de shuǐ lóng tóu yǒu rè shuǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the bathroom faucet has hot water.

entries.example: 最近流感病毒很多，記得戴口罩。
entries.examplePinyin: zuì jìn liú gǎn bìng dú hěn duō, jì de dài kǒu zhào.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a lot of flu going around; remember to wear a mask.
entries.question: 你的電腦中過病毒嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de diàn nǎo zhòng guò bìng dú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has your computer ever gotten a virus?
entries.answer: 中過，那個病毒讓我的檔案都不見了。
entries.answerPinyin: zhòng guò, nà ge bìng dú ràng wǒ de dǎng àn dōu bú jiàn le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, that virus made all my files disappear.

entries.example: 一個人搬來台灣需要很大的勇氣。
entries.examplePinyin: yí gè rén bān lái tái wān xū yào hěn dà de yǒng qì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Moving to Taiwan alone takes a lot of courage.
entries.question: 你做過最需要勇氣的事是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò guò zuì xū yào yǒng qì de shì shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the thing you've done that took the most courage?
entries.answer: 最需要勇氣的是一個人來台灣。
entries.answerPinyin: zuì xū yào yǒng qì de shì yí gè rén lái tái wān.
entries.answerEnglish: What took the most courage was coming to Taiwan alone.

entries.example: 我要一杯原味優格，不要加糖。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ yào yì bēi yuán wèi yōu gé, bú yào jiā táng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'd like a plain yogurt, no sugar.
entries.question: 你吃蛋餅喜歡原味還是加起司？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chī dàn bǐng xǐ huan yuán wèi hái shì jiā qǐ sī?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like your egg crepe plain or with cheese?
entries.answer: 我喜歡原味的，比較清淡。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan yuán wèi de, bǐ jiào qīng dàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I like it plain; it's lighter.

entries.example: 這件衣服是純棉的，很舒服。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn yī fu shì chún mián de, hěn shū fú.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shirt is pure cotton; it's very comfortable.
entries.question: 你喜歡穿棉的衣服嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chuān mián de yī fu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like wearing cotton clothes?
entries.answer: 喜歡，台灣夏天穿棉的最舒服。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, tái wān xià tiān chuān mián de zuì shū fú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, cotton is the most comfortable in Taiwan's summer.

entries.example: 我們在山上租了一間小屋。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zài shān shàng zū le yì jiān xiǎo wū.
entries.exampleEnglish: We rented a cabin in the mountains.
entries.question: 你想住在海邊的小屋嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng zhù zài hǎi biān de xiǎo wū ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to live in a little cottage by the sea?
entries.answer: 想，我想退休後住在海邊的小屋。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, wǒ xiǎng tuì xiū hòu zhù zài hǎi biān de xiǎo wū.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, after I retire I'd like to live in a seaside cottage.

entries.example: 我對台灣的廟很好奇。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ duì tái wān de miào hěn hào qí.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm curious about Taiwan's temples.
entries.question: 你對台灣的什麼最好奇？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì tái wān de shén me zuì hào qí?
entries.questionEnglish: What about Taiwan are you most curious about?
entries.answer: 我對台灣的傳統節日最好奇。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ duì tái wān de chuán tǒng jié rì zuì hào qí.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm most curious about Taiwan's traditional festivals.

entries.example: 他爸爸是一位有名的音樂家。
entries.examplePinyin: tā bà ba shì yí wèi yǒu míng de yīn yuè jiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: His father is a famous musician.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪位音樂家？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ wèi yīn yuè jiā?
entries.questionEnglish: Which musician do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡的音樂家是莫札特。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan de yīn yuè jiā shì mò zhá tè.
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite musician is Mozart.

entries.example: 我們公司上班要穿制服。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men gōng sī shàng bān yào chuān zhì fú.
entries.exampleEnglish: At our company we have to wear a uniform.
entries.question: 你的工作需要穿制服嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng zuò xū yào chuān zhì fú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have to wear a uniform for your job?
entries.answer: 不需要，我們公司沒有制服。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xū yào, wǒ men gōng sī méi yǒu zhì fú.
entries.answerEnglish: No, our company has no uniform.

entries.example: 我在市場買了一串香蕉。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài shì chǎng mǎi le yí chuàn xiāng jiāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a bunch of bananas at the market.
entries.question: 你身上帶著一串鑰匙嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēn shàng dài zhe yí chuàn yào shi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you carrying a bunch of keys?
entries.answer: 對，我帶著一串家裡和公司的鑰匙。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ dài zhe yí chuàn jiā lǐ hé gōng sī de yào shi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a bunch of keys for home and the office.

entries.example: 在淡水看夕陽很浪漫。
entries.examplePinyin: zài dàn shuǐ kàn xì yáng hěn làng màn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Watching the sunset in Tamsui is very romantic.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼樣的約會最浪漫？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me yàng de yuē huì zuì làng màn?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of date do you think is most romantic?
entries.answer: 我覺得在海邊看星星最浪漫。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de zài hǎi biān kàn xīng xīng zuì làng màn.
entries.answerEnglish: I think stargazing by the sea is the most romantic.

entries.example: 租這間房子要付兩個月的押金。
entries.examplePinyin: zū zhè jiān fáng zi yào fù liǎng gè yuè de yā jīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Renting this apartment requires a two-month deposit.
entries.question: 你租房子的押金是多少？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zū fáng zi de yā jīn shì duō shǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: How much was the deposit on your apartment?
entries.answer: 我的押金是兩個月的房租。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de yā jīn shì liǎng gè yuè de fáng zū.
entries.answerEnglish: My deposit was two months' rent.

entries.example: 我用刷子刷鞋子。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ yòng shuā zi shuā xié zǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: I clean my shoes with a brush.
entries.question: 你家浴室有刷子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yù shì yǒu shuā zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a brush in your bathroom?
entries.answer: 有，我用刷子打掃浴室。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ yòng shuā zi dǎ sǎo yù shì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I use a brush to clean the bathroom.

entries.example: 他們結婚十年後離婚了。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men jié hūn shí nián hòu lí hūn le.
entries.exampleEnglish: They got divorced after ten years of marriage.
entries.question: 你覺得現在的人比較容易離婚嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de xiàn zài de rén bǐ jiào róng yì lí hūn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think people get divorced more easily nowadays?
entries.answer: 我覺得是，現在離婚的人比以前多。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de shì, xiàn zài lí hūn de rén bǐ yǐ qián duō.
entries.answerEnglish: I think so; more people get divorced now than before.

entries.english: pay (a bill or fee); hand in
entries.example: 這個月的電費我還沒繳。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge yuè de diàn fèi wǒ hái méi jiǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: I haven't paid this month's electricity bill yet.
entries.question: 你都去哪裡繳水電費？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dōu qù nǎ lǐ jiǎo shuǐ diàn fèi?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you pay your utility bills?
entries.answer: 我都在便利商店繳水電費。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dōu zài biàn lì shāng diàn jiǎo shuǐ diàn fèi.
entries.answerEnglish: I pay my utility bills at the convenience store.

entries.english: a mess; chaos; a total mess
entries.example: 搬家以後，我的房間一團亂。
entries.examplePinyin: bān jiā yǐ hòu, wǒ de fáng jiān yì tuán luàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Since the move, my room has been a mess.
entries.question: 你的房間現在是一團亂嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de fáng jiān xiàn zài shì yì tuán luàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your room a mess right now?
entries.answer: 對，我的桌子上一團亂。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ de zhuō zi shàng yì tuán luàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my desk is a mess.

entries.example: 熬夜會傷害身體。
entries.examplePinyin: áo yè huì shāng hài shēn tǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Staying up late is bad for your body.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼習慣最傷害身體？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me xí guàn zuì shāng hài shēn tǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Which habit do you think harms the body most?
entries.answer: 我覺得抽菸最傷害身體。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de chōu yān zuì shāng hài shēn tǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I think smoking harms the body most.

entries.example: 他突然來看我，我很意外。
entries.examplePinyin: tā tú rán lái kàn wǒ, wǒ hěn yì wài.
entries.exampleEnglish: I was surprised when he suddenly came to see me.
entries.question: 來台灣以後，什麼事讓你最意外？
entries.questionPinyin: lái tái wān yǐ hòu, shén me shì ràng nǐ zuì yì wài?
entries.questionEnglish: Since coming to Taiwan, what has surprised you most?
entries.answer: 最讓我意外的是便利商店那麼多。
entries.answerPinyin: zuì ràng wǒ yì wài de shì biàn lì shāng diàn nà me duō.
entries.answerEnglish: What surprised me most is how many convenience stores there are.

entries.example: 台北捷運大概午夜就停了。
entries.examplePinyin: tái běi jié yùn dà gài wǔ yè jiù tíng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The Taipei MRT stops running around midnight.
entries.question: 你常常午夜以後才睡覺嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng cháng wǔ yè yǐ hòu cái shuì jiào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often go to bed after midnight?
entries.answer: 常常，我很少在午夜前睡覺。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ hěn shǎo zài wǔ yè qián shuì jiào.
entries.answerEnglish: Often; I rarely go to sleep before midnight.

entries.example: 我最喜歡看喜劇電影。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan kàn xǐ jù diàn yǐng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Comedy films are my favorite.
entries.question: 你喜歡看喜劇還是恐怖片？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kàn xǐ jù hái shì kǒng bù piàn?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer comedies or horror movies?
entries.answer: 我喜歡看喜劇，看了心情很好。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan kàn xǐ jù, kàn le xīn qíng hěn hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: I like comedies; they put me in a good mood.

entries.example: 我很想念媽媽做的飯菜。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hěn xiǎng niàn mā ma zuò de fàn cài.
entries.exampleEnglish: I really miss my mom's cooking.
entries.question: 你最想念哪裡的飯菜？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xiǎng niàn nǎ lǐ de fàn cài?
entries.questionEnglish: Whose cooking do you miss most?
entries.answer: 我最想念家裡的飯菜。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xiǎng niàn jiā lǐ de fàn cài.
entries.answerEnglish: I miss home cooking most.

entries.example: 這家店的門會自動打開。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn de mén huì zì dòng dǎ kāi.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop's door opens automatically.
entries.question: 你的手機會自動更新嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de shǒu jī huì zì dòng gēng xīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your phone update automatically?
entries.answer: 會，我的手機每天晚上自動更新。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ de shǒu jī měi tiān wǎn shàng zì dòng gēng xīn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my phone updates automatically every night.

entries.example: 我朋友很會變魔術。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ péng yǒu hěn huì biàn mó shù.
entries.exampleEnglish: My friend is great at magic tricks.
entries.question: 你會變魔術嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì biàn mó shù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you do magic tricks?
entries.answer: 會一點，我會用紙牌變魔術。
entries.answerPinyin: huì yì diǎn, wǒ huì yòng zhǐ pái biàn mó shù.
entries.answerEnglish: A little; I can do card tricks.

entries.example: 洗好的衣服要摺好放進衣櫃。
entries.examplePinyin: xǐ hǎo de yī fu yào zhé hǎo fàng jìn yī guì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Clean laundry should be folded and put in the closet.
entries.question: 你洗完衣服會馬上摺嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ wán yī fu huì mǎ shàng zhé ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you fold your clothes right after washing them?
entries.answer: 不會，我常常放兩天才摺。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ cháng cháng fàng liǎng tiān cái zhé.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I often leave them two days before folding.

entries.example: 他是一個很成功的商人。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì yí gè hěn chéng gōng de shāng rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a very successful businessman.
entries.question: 你想當商人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng dāng shāng rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to be a businessperson?
entries.answer: 不想，我覺得當商人壓力太大。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xiǎng, wǒ jué de dāng shāng rén yā lì tài dà.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I think being in business is too stressful.

entries.english: until; by the time; wait until
entries.example: 等到下班，我們再去吃飯。
entries.examplePinyin: děng dào xià bān, wǒ men zài qù chī fàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's wait until we're off work and then go eat.
entries.question: 你要等到放假才去旅行嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yào děng dào fàng jià cái qù lǚ xíng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you going to wait until the holidays to travel?
entries.answer: 對，我要等到過年再去日本。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ yào děng dào guò nián zài qù rì běn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'll wait until Chinese New Year to go to Japan.

entries.example: 我正在尋找新的工作。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zhèng zài xún zhǎo xīn de gōng zuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm looking for a new job.
entries.question: 你現在正在尋找什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiàn zài zhèng zài xún zhǎo shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What are you looking for right now?
entries.answer: 我正在尋找便宜的房子。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhèng zài xún zhǎo pián yi de fáng zi.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm looking for a cheap place to live.

entries.example: 百貨公司週年慶有很多折扣。
entries.examplePinyin: bǎi huò gōng sī zhōu nián qìng yǒu hěn duō zhé kòu.
entries.exampleEnglish: Department stores have lots of discounts during their anniversary sales.
entries.question: 你買東西會等有折扣再買嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi dōng xī huì děng yǒu zhé kòu zài mǎi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you wait for discounts before buying things?
entries.answer: 會，我都等週年慶有折扣才買。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōu děng zhōu nián qìng yǒu zhé kòu cái mǎi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always wait for the anniversary sale discounts.

entries.example: 你的名字英文怎麼拼？
entries.examplePinyin: nǐ de míng zì yīng wén zěn me pīn?
entries.exampleEnglish: How do you spell your name in English?
entries.question: 你的英文名字很難拼嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de yīng wén míng zì hěn nán pīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your English name hard to spell?
entries.answer: 有一點，很多人都拼錯我的名字。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu yì diǎn, hěn duō rén dōu pīn cuò wǒ de míng zì.
entries.answerEnglish: A bit; lots of people misspell my name.

entries.example: 一個人在國外，有時候很孤單。
entries.examplePinyin: yí gè rén zài guó wài, yǒu shí hòu hěn gū dān.
entries.exampleEnglish: Living abroad on your own, you sometimes feel lonely.
entries.question: 你在台灣會覺得孤單嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān huì jué de gū dān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you feel lonely in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 剛來的時候很孤單，現在朋友很多。
entries.answerPinyin: gāng lái de shí hòu hěn gū dān, xiàn zài péng yǒu hěn duō.
entries.answerEnglish: I was lonely when I first came, but now I have lots of friends.

entries.example: 老闆稱讚我這次做得很好。
entries.examplePinyin: lǎo bǎn chēng zàn wǒ zhè cì zuò de hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: My boss praised me for doing a great job this time.
entries.question: 台灣人常稱讚你的中文嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: tái wān rén cháng chēng zàn nǐ de zhōng wén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do Taiwanese people often compliment your Chinese?
entries.answer: 常常，很多人稱讚我的中文很好。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, hěn duō rén chēng zàn wǒ de zhōng wén hěn hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Often; lots of people tell me my Chinese is great.

entries.example: 他做得比較少，薪水卻比較多，真不公平！
entries.examplePinyin: tā zuò de bǐ jiào shǎo, xīn shuǐ què bǐ jiào duō, zhēn bù gōng píng!
entries.exampleEnglish: He does less but gets paid more. It's so unfair!
entries.question: 你遇過什麼不公平的事？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yù guò shén me bù gōng píng de shì?
entries.questionEnglish: What unfair things have you experienced?
entries.answer: 外國人租房子比較難，我覺得不公平。
entries.answerPinyin: wài guó rén zū fáng zi bǐ jiào nán, wǒ jué de bù gōng píng.
entries.answerEnglish: It's harder for foreigners to rent a place; I think that's unfair.

entries.example: 他在樂團裡負責打鼓。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài yuè tuán lǐ fù zé dǎ gǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: He plays the drums in the band.
entries.question: 你學過打鼓嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xué guò dǎ gǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever learned to play the drums?
entries.answer: 學過，我小時候學了三年的鼓。
entries.answerPinyin: xué guò, wǒ xiǎo shí hòu xué le sān nián de gǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I learned the drums for three years as a kid.

entries.example: 捷運上的廣播有四種語言。
entries.examplePinyin: jié yùn shàng de guǎng bò yǒu sì zhǒng yǔ yán.
entries.exampleEnglish: MRT announcements are made in four languages.
entries.question: 你開車的時候會聽廣播嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kāi chē de shí hòu huì tīng guǎng bò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you listen to the radio when you drive?
entries.answer: 會，我常聽英文廣播。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng tīng yīng wén guǎng bò.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often listen to English radio.

entries.example: 我們用氣球裝飾辦公室。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men yòng qì qiú zhuāng shì bàn gōng shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: We decorated the office with balloons.
entries.question: 過節的時候，你會裝飾家裡嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: guò jié de shí hòu, nǐ huì zhuāng shì jiā lǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you decorate your home for holidays?
entries.answer: 會，聖誕節我會裝飾一棵聖誕樹。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, shèng dàn jié wǒ huì zhuāng shì yì kē shèng dàn shù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, at Christmas I decorate a Christmas tree.

entries.example: 有緊急的事，請打我的手機。
entries.examplePinyin: yǒu jǐn jí de shì, qǐng dǎ wǒ de shǒu jī.
entries.exampleEnglish: If anything urgent comes up, call my cell phone.
entries.question: 你遇到緊急的事會打給誰？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yù dào jǐn jí de shì huì dǎ gěi shéi?
entries.questionEnglish: Who do you call when there's an emergency?
entries.answer: 遇到緊急的事，我會打給我的室友。
entries.answerPinyin: yù dào jǐn jí de shì, wǒ huì dǎ gěi wǒ de shì yǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: In an emergency, I'd call my roommate.

entries.example: 我很後悔沒有早點學中文。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hěn hòu huǐ méi yǒu zǎo diǎn xué zhōng wén.
entries.exampleEnglish: I really regret not learning Chinese sooner.
entries.question: 你有什麼後悔的事嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu shén me hòu huǐ de shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there anything you regret?
entries.answer: 我後悔大學的時候沒有出國讀書。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ hòu huǐ dà xué de shí hòu méi yǒu chū guó dú shū.
entries.answerEnglish: I regret not studying abroad in college.

entries.example: 他的書桌總是很整齊。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de shū zhuō zǒng shì hěn zhěng qí.
entries.exampleEnglish: His desk is always tidy.
entries.question: 你的衣櫃整齊嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de yī guì zhěng qí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your closet neat?
entries.answer: 不太整齊，衣服都亂放。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài zhěng qí, yī fu dōu luàn fàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Not very; my clothes are all over the place.

entries.example: 遇到地震要保持冷靜。
entries.examplePinyin: yù dào dì zhèn yào bǎo chí lěng jìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Stay calm in an earthquake.
entries.question: 你遇到問題的時候冷靜嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yù dào wèn tí de shí hòu lěng jìng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you calm when you run into problems?
entries.answer: 我會先深呼吸，讓自己冷靜下來。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì xiān shēn hū xī, ràng zì jǐ lěng jìng xià lái.
entries.answerEnglish: I take a deep breath first to calm myself down.

entries.example: 這班車是開往淡水的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bān chē shì kāi wǎng dàn shuǐ de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This train is bound for Tamsui.
entries.question: 你每天搭開往哪裡的捷運？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ měi tiān dā kāi wǎng nǎ lǐ de jié yùn?
entries.questionEnglish: Where is the MRT train you take every day bound for?
entries.answer: 我每天搭開往南港展覽館的捷運。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ měi tiān dā kāi wǎng nán gǎng zhǎn lǎn guǎn de jié yùn.
entries.answerEnglish: Every day I take the MRT bound for Nangang Exhibition Center.

entries.example: 這台腳踏車是台灣製造的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tái jiǎo tà chē shì tái wān zhì zào de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This bike was made in Taiwan.
entries.question: 你身上有台灣製造的東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēn shàng yǒu tái wān zhì zào de dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have anything made in Taiwan on you?
entries.answer: 有，我的手機殼是台灣製造的。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de shǒu jī ké shì tái wān zhì zào de.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my phone case was made in Taiwan.

entries.example: 這個醫生治好了我的頭痛。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge yī shēng zhì hǎo le wǒ de tóu tòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This doctor cured my headaches.
entries.question: 你覺得中藥可以治好感冒嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zhōng yào kě yǐ zhì hǎo gǎn mào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Chinese medicine can cure a cold?
entries.answer: 我覺得中藥不一定能治好感冒。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de zhōng yào bù yí dìng néng zhì hǎo gǎn mào.
entries.answerEnglish: I don't think Chinese medicine can always cure a cold.

entries.example: 天氣預報說明天會下雨。
entries.examplePinyin: tiān qì yù bào shuō míng tiān huì xià yǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The weather forecast says it'll rain tomorrow.
entries.question: 你每天出門前會看天氣預報嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ měi tiān chū mén qián huì kàn tiān qì yù bào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you check the weather forecast every day before going out?
entries.answer: 會，我每天早上都看天氣預報。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng dōu kàn tiān qì yù bào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I check the forecast every morning.

entries.english: worth it; a good deal; cost-effective
entries.example: 買一送一，真划算！
entries.examplePinyin: mǎi yí sòng yī, zhēn huá suàn!
entries.exampleEnglish: Buy one, get one free. What a deal!
entries.question: 你覺得在台灣買什麼最划算？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zài tái wān mǎi shén me zuì huá suàn?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is the best deal in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我覺得水果最划算，又便宜又好吃。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de shuǐ guǒ zuì huá suàn, yòu pián yi yòu hǎo chī.
entries.answerEnglish: I think fruit is the best deal: cheap and delicious.

entries.example: 我的駕照筆試合格了！
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de jià zhào bǐ shì hé gé le!
entries.exampleEnglish: I passed the written part of my driving test!
entries.question: 你考駕照的時候，一次就合格了嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kǎo jià zhào de shí hòu, yí cì jiù hé gé le ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you took your driving test, did you pass the first time?
entries.answer: 對，我第一次考就合格了。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ dì yī cì kǎo jiù hé gé le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I passed on my first try.

entries.example: 過年前我們把家裡徹底打掃了一遍。
entries.examplePinyin: guò nián qián wǒ men bǎ jiā lǐ chè dǐ dǎ sǎo le yí biàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Before Lunar New Year we gave the whole house a thorough cleaning.
entries.question: 你多久徹底打掃一次家裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duō jiǔ chè dǐ dǎ sǎo yí cì jiā lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you clean your home thoroughly?
entries.answer: 我大概一個月徹底打掃一次。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dà gài yí gè yuè chè dǐ dǎ sǎo yí cì.
entries.answerEnglish: I do a thorough clean about once a month.

entries.example: 夜市有很多油炸的食物。
entries.examplePinyin: yè shì yǒu hěn duō yóu zhà de shí wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's lots of deep-fried food at the night market.
entries.question: 你常吃油炸的東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng chī yóu zhà de dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often eat deep-fried food?
entries.answer: 不常，油炸的東西不太健康。
entries.answerPinyin: bù cháng, yóu zhà de dōng xī bú tài jiàn kāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Not often. Deep-fried food isn't very healthy.

entries.english: take part in; participate; get involved
entries.example: 我很想參與這個計畫。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hěn xiǎng cān yù zhè ge jì huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'd really like to be part of this project.
entries.question: 你參與過什麼志工活動？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān yù guò shén me zhì gōng huó dòng?
entries.questionEnglish: What volunteer activities have you taken part in?
entries.answer: 我參與過海邊的淨灘活動。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cān yù guò hǎi biān de jìng tān huó dòng.
entries.answerEnglish: I've taken part in a beach cleanup.

entries.example: 這份文件要印彩色的嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: zhè fèn wén jiàn yào yìn cǎi sè de ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: Should this document be printed in color?
entries.question: 你喜歡穿彩色的衣服嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chuān cǎi sè de yī fu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like wearing colorful clothes?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我有很多彩色的衣服。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ yǒu hěn duō cǎi sè de yī fu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have lots of colorful clothes.

entries.example: 昨天的颱風好嚇人。
entries.examplePinyin: zuó tiān de tái fēng hǎo xià rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: Yesterday's typhoon was really scary.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼電影最嚇人？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me diàn yǐng zuì xià rén?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of movie do you find scariest?
entries.answer: 我覺得日本的鬼片最嚇人。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de rì běn de guǐ piàn zuì xià rén.
entries.answerEnglish: I think Japanese ghost movies are the scariest.

entries.example: 海裡有很多奇怪的生物。
entries.examplePinyin: hǎi lǐ yǒu hěn duō qí guài de shēng wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of strange creatures in the sea.
entries.question: 你最怕哪種生物？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì pà nǎ zhǒng shēng wù?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of creature are you most afraid of?
entries.answer: 我最怕蟑螂這種生物。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì pà zhāng láng zhè zhǒng shēng wù.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm most afraid of cockroaches.

entries.example: 我們的團隊由五個人組成。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men de tuán duì yóu wǔ gè rén zǔ chéng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Our team is made up of five people.
entries.question: 你的家庭由幾個人組成？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de jiā tíng yóu jǐ gè rén zǔ chéng?
entries.questionEnglish: How many people make up your family?
entries.answer: 我的家庭由四個人組成。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de jiā tíng yóu sì gè rén zǔ chéng.
entries.answerEnglish: My family is made up of four people.

entries.example: 她的事業做得很成功。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de shì yè zuò de hěn chéng gōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Her career has been very successful.
entries.question: 你覺得事業和家庭哪個重要？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shì yè hé jiā tíng nǎ gè zhòng yào?
entries.questionEnglish: Which do you think matters more, career or family?
entries.answer: 我覺得家庭比事業重要。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de jiā tíng bǐ shì yè zhòng yào.
entries.answerEnglish: I think family matters more than career.

entries.example: 我爸爸週末常打高爾夫球。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bà ba zhōu mò cháng dǎ gāo ěr fū qiú.
entries.exampleEnglish: My dad often plays golf on weekends.
entries.question: 你打過高爾夫球嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dǎ guò gāo ěr fū qiú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever played golf?
entries.answer: 打過一次高爾夫球，可是很難。
entries.answerPinyin: dǎ guò yí cì gāo ěr fū qiú, kě shì hěn nán.
entries.answerEnglish: I played golf once, but it was hard.

entries.example: 我爸爸下個月要動手術。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bà ba xià gè yuè yào dòng shǒu shù.
entries.exampleEnglish: My dad is having surgery next month.
entries.question: 動完手術以後，通常要做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: dòng wán shǒu shù yǐ hòu, tōng cháng yào zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do people usually need to do after surgery?
entries.answer: 動完手術以後，通常要好好休息。
entries.answerPinyin: dòng wán shǒu shù yǐ hòu, tōng cháng yào hǎo hǎo xiū xí.
entries.answerEnglish: After surgery, people usually need plenty of rest.

entries.example: 你有發燒的症狀嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: nǐ yǒu fā shāo de zhèng zhuàng ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: Do you have a fever?
entries.question: 感冒常見的症狀有哪些？
entries.questionPinyin: gǎn mào cháng jiàn de zhèng zhuàng yǒu nǎ xiē?
entries.questionEnglish: What are the common symptoms of a cold?
entries.answer: 感冒常見的症狀是喉嚨痛和咳嗽。
entries.answerPinyin: gǎn mào cháng jiàn de zhèng zhuàng shì hóu lóng tòng hé ké sou.
entries.answerEnglish: The common symptoms of a cold are a sore throat and a cough.

entries.example: 我一眼就認出她了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ yì yǎn jiù rèn chū tā le.
entries.exampleEnglish: I recognized her at a glance.
entries.question: 你有一眼就愛上的東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu yì yǎn jiù ài shàng de dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there anything you fell in love with at first sight?
entries.answer: 有，我一眼就愛上了現在的房子。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ yì yǎn jiù ài shàng le xiàn zài de fáng zi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I fell in love with my current home the moment I saw it.

entries.example: 山上收訊不好，電話打不通。
entries.examplePinyin: shān shàng shōu xùn bù hǎo, diàn huà dǎ bù tōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The reception is bad up in the mountains, so calls don't go through.
entries.question: 你家的手機收訊好嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de shǒu jī shōu xùn hǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is the phone reception good at your place?
entries.answer: 不太好，我房間的收訊很差。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài hǎo, wǒ fáng jiān de shōu xùn hěn chà.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. The reception in my room is bad.

entries.example: 現在是網路時代。
entries.examplePinyin: xiàn zài shì wǎng lù shí dài.
entries.exampleEnglish: We live in the internet age.
entries.question: 你最想活在哪個時代？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xiǎng huó zài nǎ gè shí dài?
entries.questionEnglish: Which era would you most like to live in?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡現在這個時代。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan xiàn zài zhè ge shí dài.
entries.answerEnglish: I like the times we live in now best.

entries.example: 我的童年是在鄉下過的。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de tóng nián shì zài xiāng xià guò de.
entries.exampleEnglish: I spent my childhood in the countryside.
entries.question: 你的童年快樂嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de tóng nián kuài lè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Was your childhood happy?
entries.answer: 很快樂，我的童年常在海邊玩。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn kuài lè, wǒ de tóng nián cháng zài hǎi biān wán.
entries.answerEnglish: Very happy. I spent a lot of my childhood playing by the sea.

entries.example: 我把椅子放低一點，比較舒服。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bǎ yǐ zi fàng dī yì diǎn, bǐ jiào shū fú.
entries.exampleEnglish: I lowered my chair a bit; it's more comfortable.
entries.question: 跟長輩說話時，你會放低音量嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: gēn zhǎng bèi shuō huà shí, nǐ huì fàng dī yīn liàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you lower your voice when talking to elders?
entries.answer: 會，我會放低音量，說話慢一點。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì fàng dī yīn liàng, shuō huà màn yì diǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I lower my voice and speak more slowly.

entries.example: 這個廣告很有創意。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge guǎng gào hěn yǒu chuàng yì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This ad is really creative.
entries.question: 你覺得自己有創意嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ yǒu chuàng yì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're creative?
entries.answer: 我覺得我滿有創意的。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de wǒ mǎn yǒu chuàng yì de.
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm pretty creative.

entries.example: 他是一位游泳運動員。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì yí wèi yóu yǒng yùn dòng yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a competitive swimmer.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪一位運動員？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ yí wèi yùn dòng yuán?
entries.questionEnglish: Who's your favorite athlete?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡台灣的羽球運動員。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan tái wān de yǔ qiú yùn dòng yuán.
entries.answerEnglish: I like Taiwan's badminton players best.

entries.example: 我想提升我的中文能力。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xiǎng tí shēng wǒ de zhōng wén néng lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: I want to improve my Chinese.
entries.question: 你想怎麼提升你的中文？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng zěn me tí shēng nǐ de zhōng wén?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you want to improve your Chinese?
entries.answer: 我想多跟台灣人聊天來提升中文。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng duō gēn tái wān rén liáo tiān lái tí shēng zhōng wén.
entries.answerEnglish: I want to chat more with Taiwanese people to improve my Chinese.

entries.example: 有問題可以問服務人員。
entries.examplePinyin: yǒu wèn tí kě yǐ wèn fú wù rén yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: If you have questions, you can ask the staff.
entries.question: 你們公司有多少工作人員？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men gōng sī yǒu duō shǎo gōng zuò rén yuán?
entries.questionEnglish: How many staff does your company have?
entries.answer: 我們公司有五十個工作人員。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men gōng sī yǒu wǔ shí gè gōng zuò rén yuán.
entries.answerEnglish: Our company has fifty staff.

entries.example: 週末我去醫院當志工。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōu mò wǒ qù yī yuàn dāng zhì gōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: On weekends I volunteer at a hospital.
entries.question: 你當過志工嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dāng guò zhì gōng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever volunteered?
entries.answer: 當過，我在圖書館當過志工。
entries.answerPinyin: dāng guò, wǒ zài tú shū guǎn dāng guò zhì gōng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've volunteered at a library.

entries.example: 我剪頭髮都找同一位設計師。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ jiǎn tóu fǎ dōu zhǎo tóng yí wèi shè jì shī.
entries.exampleEnglish: I always get my hair cut by the same stylist.
entries.question: 你想當設計師嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng dāng shè jì shī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to be a designer?
entries.answer: 想，我想當室內設計師。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, wǒ xiǎng dāng shì nèi shè jì shī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to be an interior designer.

entries.example: 今年的畢業生很難找工作。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn nián de bì yè shēng hěn nán zhǎo gōng zuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: This year's graduates are having a hard time finding jobs.
entries.question: 你是哪一年的大學畢業生？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shì nǎ yì nián de dà xué bì yè shēng?
entries.questionEnglish: What year did you graduate from university?
entries.answer: 我是2018年的大學畢業生。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ shì 2018 nián de dà xué bì yè shēng.
entries.answerEnglish: I graduated from university in 2018.

entries.example: 請給我完整的資料。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng gěi wǒ wán zhěng de zī liào.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please give me the complete information.
entries.question: 你讀過一本完整的中文小說嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dú guò yì běn wán zhěng de zhōng wén xiǎo shuō ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever read a whole novel in Chinese?
entries.answer: 還沒，我只讀過完整的短篇故事。
entries.answerPinyin: hái méi, wǒ zhǐ dú guò wán zhěng de duǎn piān gù shì.
entries.answerEnglish: Not yet. I've only read complete short stories.

entries.example: 很多青少年喜歡去西門町。
entries.examplePinyin: hěn duō qīng shào nián xǐ huan qù xī mén dīng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Lots of teenagers like going to Ximending.
entries.question: 你是青少年的時候喜歡做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shì qīng shào nián de shí hòu xǐ huan zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What did you like to do when you were a teenager?
entries.answer: 我是青少年的時候喜歡打電動。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ shì qīng shào nián de shí hòu xǐ huan dǎ diàn dòng.
entries.answerEnglish: When I was a teenager, I liked playing video games.

entries.example: 他十歲的時候跟家人移民到美國。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shí suì de shí hòu gēn jiā rén yí mín dào měi guó.
entries.exampleEnglish: He moved to the US with his family when he was ten.
entries.question: 你想移民到其他國家嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng yí mín dào qí tā guó jiā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to emigrate to another country?
entries.answer: 我已經移民到台灣了。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yǐ jīng yí mín dào tái wān le.
entries.answerEnglish: I've already immigrated to Taiwan.

entries.example: 他上個月辭職了。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shàng gè yuè cí zhí le.
entries.exampleEnglish: He quit his job last month.
entries.question: 你辭職過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cí zhí guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever quit a job?
entries.answer: 我辭職過一次，因為工作太累了。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cí zhí guò yí cì, yīn wèi gōng zuò tài lèi le.
entries.answerEnglish: I quit once because the job was too exhausting.

entries.example: 我聽得懂他們的對話。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ tīng de dǒng tā men de duì huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: I can understand their conversation.
entries.question: 你能用中文跟店員對話嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ néng yòng zhōng wén gēn diàn yuán duì huà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you have a conversation with shop staff in Chinese?
entries.answer: 可以，簡單的對話沒問題。
entries.answerPinyin: kě yǐ, jiǎn dān de duì huà méi wèn tí.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, simple conversations are no problem.

entries.example: 辦公室裡常常有笑聲。
entries.examplePinyin: bàn gōng shì lǐ cháng cháng yǒu xiào shēng.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's often laughter in the office.
entries.question: 你家裡常常有笑聲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā lǐ cháng cháng yǒu xiào shēng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there often laughter in your home?
entries.answer: 有，我家裡每天都有笑聲。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiā lǐ měi tiān dōu yǒu xiào shēng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's laughter in my home every day.

entries.example: 他是一個很可靠的同事。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì yí gè hěn kě kào de tóng shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a very dependable coworker.
entries.question: 你覺得自己可靠嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ kě kào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're reliable?
entries.answer: 我覺得我很可靠，朋友常找我幫忙。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de wǒ hěn kě kào, péng yǒu cháng zhǎo wǒ bāng máng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm very reliable; my friends often ask me for help.

entries.example: 家裡的垃圾桶滿了。
entries.examplePinyin: jiā lǐ de lè sè tǒng mǎn le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The trash can at home is full.
entries.question: 你家有幾個垃圾桶？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ gè lè sè tǒng?
entries.questionEnglish: How many trash cans do you have at home?
entries.answer: 我家有三個垃圾桶。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā yǒu sān gè lè sè tǒng.
entries.answerEnglish: We have three trash cans at home.

entries.example: 這個App每月要付一百元。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge App měi yuè yào fù yì bǎi yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: This app costs a hundred dollars a month.
entries.question: 你每月花多少錢吃飯？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ měi yuè huā duō shǎo qián chī fàn?
entries.questionEnglish: How much do you spend on food each month?
entries.answer: 我每月大概花一萬元吃飯。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ měi yuè dà gài huā yí wàn yuán chī fàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I spend about ten thousand dollars a month on food.

entries.example: 我昨天晚上做了一個惡夢。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shàng zuò le yí gè è mèng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I had a nightmare last night.
entries.question: 你常做惡夢嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng zuò è mèng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often have nightmares?
entries.answer: 不常，我很少做惡夢。
entries.answerPinyin: bù cháng, wǒ hěn shǎo zuò è mèng.
entries.answerEnglish: Not often. I rarely have nightmares.

entries.example: 這篇新聞的標題很誇張。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè piān xīn wén de biāo tí hěn kuā zhāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This news story's headline is really over the top.
entries.question: 你看新聞時只看標題嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn xīn wén shí zhǐ kàn biāo tí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you read the news, do you only read the headlines?
entries.answer: 有時候，我太忙就只看標題。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu, wǒ tài máng jiù zhǐ kàn biāo tí.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. When I'm too busy, I only read the headlines.

entries.example: 她是台灣很有名的女演員。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì tái wān hěn yǒu míng de nǚ yǎn yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's a very famous actress in Taiwan.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪位女演員？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ wèi nǚ yǎn yuán?
entries.questionEnglish: Who's your favorite actress?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡一位韓國女演員。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan yí wèi hán guó nǚ yǎn yuán.
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite is a Korean actress.

entries.example: 我哥哥在海外工作很多年了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ gē ge zài hǎi wài gōng zuò hěn duō nián le.
entries.exampleEnglish: My older brother has worked overseas for many years.
entries.question: 你在海外住多久了？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài hǎi wài zhù duō jiǔ le?
entries.questionEnglish: How long have you lived overseas?
entries.answer: 我在海外住了三年了。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài hǎi wài zhù le sān nián le.
entries.answerEnglish: I've lived overseas for three years.

entries.example: 在捷運上吃東西違反規定。
entries.examplePinyin: zài jié yùn shàng chī dōng xī wéi fǎn guī dìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Eating on the MRT is against the rules.
entries.question: 你違反過交通規則嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ wéi fǎn guò jiāo tōng guī zé ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever broken a traffic rule?
entries.answer: 有，我騎機車違反過交通規則。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ qí jī chē wéi fǎn guò jiāo tōng guī zé.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've broken traffic rules on my scooter.

entries.example: 太魯閣的風景非常壯觀。
entries.examplePinyin: tài lǔ gé de fēng jǐng fēi cháng zhuàng guān.
entries.exampleEnglish: The scenery at Taroko is truly spectacular.
entries.question: 你在台灣看過什麼壯觀的風景？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān kàn guò shén me zhuàng guān de fēng jǐng?
entries.questionEnglish: What spectacular scenery have you seen in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我覺得阿里山的日出最壯觀。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de ā lǐ shān de rì chū zuì zhuàng guān.
entries.answerEnglish: I think the sunrise at Alishan is the most spectacular.

entries.example: 請照著螢幕上的指示操作。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng zhào zhe yíng mù shàng de zhǐ shì cāo zuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please follow the instructions on the screen.
entries.question: 你組家具時會看指示嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zǔ jiā jù shí huì kàn zhǐ shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you read the instructions when you put furniture together?
entries.answer: 會，我都照著指示一步一步做。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōu zhào zhe zhǐ shì yí bù yi bù zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always follow the instructions step by step.

entries.example: 我們隊終於得到勝利了！
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men duì zhōng yú dé dào shèng lì le!
entries.exampleEnglish: Our team finally won!
entries.question: 你最近看的比賽，哪一隊勝利了？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn kàn de bǐ sài, nǎ yí duì shèng lì le?
entries.questionEnglish: In the last game you watched, which team won?
entries.answer: 我支持的那一隊勝利了。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhī chí de nà yí duì shèng lì le.
entries.answerEnglish: The team I support won.

entries.example: 這間咖啡店的光線很好。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiān kā fēi diàn de guāng xiàn hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This café has nice lighting.
entries.question: 你喜歡光線很亮的房間嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan guāng xiàn hěn liàng de fáng jiān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like brightly lit rooms?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我喜歡光線好的房間。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ xǐ huan guāng xiàn hǎo de fáng jiān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like rooms with good light.

entries.example: 他的話引起大家的注意。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de huà yǐn qǐ dà jiā de zhù yì.
entries.exampleEnglish: What he said caught everyone's attention.
entries.question: 什麼事情最容易引起你的興趣？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shì qíng zuì róng yì yǐn qǐ nǐ de xìng qù?
entries.questionEnglish: What most easily catches your interest?
entries.answer: 美食最容易引起我的興趣。
entries.answerPinyin: měi shí zuì róng yì yǐn qǐ wǒ de xìng qù.
entries.answerEnglish: Good food catches my interest most easily.

entries.example: 那個少年在便利商店打工。
entries.examplePinyin: nà ge shào nián zài biàn lì shāng diàn dǎ gōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: That teenage boy works part-time at the convenience store.
entries.question: 你少年時期喜歡做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shào nián shí qí xǐ huan zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What did you like doing as a teenager?
entries.answer: 我少年時期很喜歡打籃球。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ shào nián shí qí hěn xǐ huan dǎ lán qiú.
entries.answerEnglish: As a teenager I loved playing basketball.

entries.example: 這家酒吧週末有爵士樂表演。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā jiǔ bā zhōu mò yǒu jué shì yuè biǎo yǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This bar has jazz performances on weekends.
entries.question: 你喜歡聽爵士樂嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan tīng jué shì yuè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like listening to jazz?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我工作時常聽爵士樂。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ gōng zuò shí cháng tīng jué shì yuè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often listen to jazz while I work.

entries.example: 報告的截止日期是星期五。
entries.examplePinyin: bào gào de jié zhǐ rì qí shì xīng qí wǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The report's deadline is Friday.
entries.question: 你最近有什麼截止日期嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn yǒu shén me jié zhǐ rì qí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any deadlines coming up?
entries.answer: 有，我的報告截止日期是明天。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de bào gào jié zhǐ rì qí shì míng tiān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my report is due tomorrow.

entries.example: 我買了一個新的相機鏡頭。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ mǎi le yí gè xīn de xiàng jī jìng tóu.
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a new camera lens.
entries.question: 你喜歡在鏡頭前說話嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zài jìng tóu qián shuō huà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like talking in front of the camera?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，我在鏡頭前會緊張。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xǐ huan, wǒ zài jìng tóu qián huì jǐn zhāng.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I get nervous in front of the camera.

entries.example: 婚禮的場地已經訂好了。
entries.examplePinyin: hūn lǐ de chǎng dì yǐ jīng dìng hǎo le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The wedding venue is already booked.
entries.question: 辦生日派對，你喜歡什麼場地？
entries.questionPinyin: bàn shēng rì pài duì, nǐ xǐ huan shén me chǎng dì?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of venue do you like for a birthday party?
entries.answer: 我喜歡用KTV包廂當場地。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan yòng KTV bāo xiāng dàng chǎng dì.
entries.answerEnglish: I like using a KTV room as the venue.

entries.example: 演唱會在高雄的體育場舉行。
entries.examplePinyin: yǎn chàng huì zài gāo xióng de tǐ yù chǎng jǔ xíng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The concert is being held at a stadium in Kaohsiung.
entries.question: 你去過體育場看比賽嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò tǐ yù chǎng kàn bǐ sài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to a stadium to watch a game?
entries.answer: 去過，我在體育場看過足球比賽。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, wǒ zài tǐ yù chǎng kàn guò zú qiú bǐ sài.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've seen a soccer match at a stadium.

entries.example: 昨天的球賽好精彩！
entries.examplePinyin: zuó tiān de qiú sài hǎo jīng cǎi!
entries.exampleEnglish: Yesterday's game was so exciting!
entries.question: 你最近看過什麼精彩的電影？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn kàn guò shén me jīng cǎi de diàn yǐng?
entries.questionEnglish: What great movies have you seen lately?
entries.answer: 我上週看的動作片很精彩。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ shàng zhōu kàn de dòng zuò piàn hěn jīng cǎi.
entries.answerEnglish: The action movie I saw last week was great.

entries.example: 我們昨天在KTV唱了通宵。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zuó tiān zài KTV chàng le tōng xiāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: We sang at KTV all night yesterday.
entries.question: 你有沒有通宵工作過？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu tōng xiāo gōng zuò guò?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever worked all night?
entries.answer: 有，我上個月通宵趕報告。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ shàng gè yuè tōng xiāo gǎn bào gào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, last month I stayed up all night finishing a report.

entries.example: 我猜不到，可以給我一點提示嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ cāi bú dào, kě yǐ gěi wǒ yì diǎn tí shì ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: I can't guess—can you give me a hint?
entries.question: 猜謎語時，你需要提示嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: cāi mí yǔ shí, nǐ xū yào tí shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you need hints when solving riddles?
entries.answer: 需要，沒有提示我猜不出來。
entries.answerPinyin: xū yào, méi yǒu tí shì wǒ cāi bù chū lái.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, without hints I can't guess.

entries.example: 我家浴室的天花板漏水了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ jiā yù shì de tiān huā bǎn lòu shuǐ le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The ceiling in my bathroom is leaking.
entries.question: 你家曾經漏水過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā céng jīng lòu shuǐ guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has your home ever had a leak?
entries.answer: 有，颱風天時我家窗戶漏水。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, tái fēng tiān shí wǒ jiā chuāng hù lòu shuǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my window leaked during a typhoon.

entries.example: 去日本前，我先換了日幣。
entries.examplePinyin: qù rì běn qián, wǒ xiān huàn le rì bì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Before going to Japan, I exchanged some yen.
entries.question: 你去日本時換了多少日幣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù rì běn shí huàn le duō shǎo rì bì?
entries.questionEnglish: How much yen did you exchange when you went to Japan?
entries.answer: 我換了五萬日幣。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huàn le wǔ wàn rì bì.
entries.answerEnglish: I exchanged fifty thousand yen.

entries.example: 她說中文說得很有自信。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shuō zhōng wén shuō de hěn yǒu zì xìn.
entries.exampleEnglish: She speaks Chinese with confidence.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shuō zhōng wén shí yǒu zì xìn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you confident when you speak Chinese?
entries.answer: 還好，說簡單的中文時比較有自信。
entries.answerPinyin: hái hǎo, shuō jiǎn dān de zhōng wén shí bǐ jiào yǒu zì xìn.
entries.answerEnglish: So-so; I'm more confident when speaking simple Chinese.

entries.example: 我的存款不夠買房子。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de cún kuǎn bú gòu mǎi fáng zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: My savings aren't enough to buy a home.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ de cún kuǎn gòu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you have enough savings?
entries.answer: 不夠，我的存款還很少。
entries.answerPinyin: bú gòu, wǒ de cún kuǎn hái hěn shǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: No, my savings are still small.

entries.example: 我們約定好星期六見面。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men yuē dìng hǎo xīng qí liù jiàn miàn.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gēn péng yǒu yǒu shén me yuē dìng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any arrangements with your friends?
entries.answer: 有，我們約定每年一起去旅行。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men yuē dìng měi nián yì qǐ qù lǚ xíng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we agreed to travel together every year.

entries.example: 這個軟體還在測試中。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge ruǎn tǐ hái zài cè shì zhōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This software is still being tested.
entries.question: 你做過網路上的心理測試嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò guò wǎng lù shang de xīn lǐ cè shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you taken online personality quizzes?
entries.answer: 做過，我很愛做心理測試。
entries.answerPinyin: zuò guò, wǒ hěn ài zuò xīn lǐ cè shì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love doing those quizzes.

entries.example: 考慮到預算，我們選了便宜的飯店。
entries.examplePinyin: kǎo lǜ dào yù suàn, wǒ men xuǎn le pián yi de fàn diàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Considering our budget, we chose a cheap hotel.
entries.question: 考慮到房租，你會住在台北嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: kǎo lǜ dào fáng zū, nǐ huì zhù zài tái běi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Considering the rent, would you live in Taipei?
entries.answer: 考慮到房租，我選擇住在新北。
entries.answerPinyin: kǎo lǜ dào fáng zū, wǒ xuǎn zé zhù zài xīn běi.
entries.answerEnglish: Considering the rent, I chose to live in New Taipei.

entries.example: 我買了一件棒球隊的球衣。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ mǎi le yí jiàn bàng qiú duì de qiú yī.
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a baseball team jersey.
entries.question: 你有收藏球衣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu shōu cáng qiú yī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you collect jerseys?
entries.answer: 有，我有三件籃球球衣。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ yǒu sān jiàn lán qiú qiú yī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have three basketball jerseys.

entries.example: 我男朋友很貼心。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ nán péng yǒu hěn tiē xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: My boyfriend is very thoughtful.
entries.question: 你身邊誰最貼心？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēn biān shéi zuì tiē xīn?
entries.questionEnglish: Who's the most thoughtful person around you?
entries.answer: 我妹妹最貼心。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ mèi mei zuì tiē xīn.
entries.answerEnglish: My younger sister is the most thoughtful.

entries.example: 他點頭表示同意。
entries.examplePinyin: tā diǎn tóu biǎo shì tóng yì.
entries.exampleEnglish: He nodded to show he agreed.
entries.question: 你都怎麼對朋友表示謝意？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dōu zěn me duì péng yǒu biǎo shì xiè yì?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you show your thanks to friends?
entries.answer: 我會請朋友吃飯表示謝意。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì qǐng péng yǒu chī fàn biǎo shì xiè yì.
entries.answerEnglish: I treat them to a meal to say thanks.

entries.answer: 有，我家裝了火災警報器。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiā zhuāng le huǒ zāi jǐng bào qì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we installed a fire alarm.

entries.example: 這座橋連接兩個城市。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zuò qiáo lián jiē liǎng gè chéng shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This bridge connects two cities.
entries.question: 你的手機可以連接電視嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de shǒu jī kě yǐ lián jiē diàn shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can your phone connect to your TV?
entries.answer: 可以，我常用手機連接電視看影片。
entries.answerPinyin: kě yǐ, wǒ cháng yòng shǒu jī lián jiē diàn shì kàn yǐng piàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often connect my phone to the TV to watch videos.

entries.example: 我們換個話題吧。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men huàn gè huà tí ba.
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's change the subject.
entries.question: 你跟朋友最常聊什麼話題？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gēn péng yǒu zuì cháng liáo shén me huà tí?
entries.questionEnglish: What topics do you talk about most with friends?
entries.answer: 我們最常聊工作的話題。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men zuì cháng liáo gōng zuò de huà tí.
entries.answerEnglish: We talk about work most often.

entries.example: 學會說中文是我最大的成就。
entries.examplePinyin: xué huì shuō zhōng wén shì wǒ zuì dà de chéng jiù.
entries.exampleEnglish: Learning to speak Chinese is my biggest achievement.
entries.question: 你最驕傲的成就是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jiāo ào de chéng jiù shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What achievement are you proudest of?
entries.answer: 我最驕傲的成就是跑完馬拉松。

entries.answerEnglish: The achievement I'm proudest of is finishing a marathon.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de fáng zū bāo kuò shuǐ diàn ma?

entries.answer: 不包括，水電要另外付。

entries.answerEnglish: No, utilities are paid separately.

entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài jì suàn zhè ge yuè huā le duō shǎo qián.

entries.question: 你會計算每天吃了多少熱量嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì jì suàn měi tiān chī le duō shǎo rè liàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you count how many calories you eat each day?
entries.answer: 不會，我從來不計算熱量。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ cóng lái bú jì suàn rè liàng.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I never count calories.

entries.example: 我保證明天不會遲到。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bǎo zhèng míng tiān bú huì chí dào.
entries.exampleEnglish: I promise I won't be late tomorrow.
entries.question: 你能保證每天練習中文嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ néng bǎo zhèng měi tiān liàn xí zhōng wén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you promise to practice Chinese every day?
entries.answer: 我保證每天練習半小時。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǎo zhèng měi tiān liàn xí bàn xiǎo shí.
entries.answerEnglish: I promise to practice half an hour a day.

entries.example: 吃到好吃的牛肉麵，我就很滿足了。
entries.examplePinyin: chī dào hǎo chī de niú ròu miàn, wǒ jiù hěn mǎn zú le.

entries.question: 什麼事會讓你覺得很滿足？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shì huì ràng nǐ jué de hěn mǎn zú?
entries.questionEnglish: What makes you feel satisfied?
entries.answer: 週末睡到自然醒讓我很滿足。
entries.answerPinyin: zhōu mò shuì dào zì rán xǐng ràng wǒ hěn mǎn zú.
entries.answerEnglish: Sleeping in on weekends makes me feel content.

entries.example: 我家的天花板有點低。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ jiā de tiān huā bǎn yǒu diǎn dī.
entries.exampleEnglish: The ceiling in my home is a bit low.
entries.question: 你家的天花板高嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de tiān huā bǎn gāo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is the ceiling high in your home?
entries.answer: 不高，我家的天花板很低。
entries.answerPinyin: bù gāo, wǒ jiā de tiān huā bǎn hěn dī.
entries.answerEnglish: No, my ceiling is low.

entries.english: short essay; short piece of writing
entries.example: 我每天用中文寫一篇短文。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi tiān yòng zhōng wén xiě yì piān duǎn wén.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yòng zhōng wén xiě guò duǎn wén ma?

entries.answer: 寫過，我寫過一篇介紹家鄉的短文。

entries.answer: 會，我的舌頭會又麻又痛。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ de shé tou huì yòu má yòu tòng.

entries.examplePinyin: tā jiǎ zhuāng méi kàn dào wǒ.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ céng jīng jiǎ zhuāng tīng dǒng zhōng wén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever pretended to understand Chinese?
entries.answer: 常常，我常假裝聽得懂。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ cháng jiǎ zhuāng tīng de dǒng.

entries.examplePinyin: jié yùn shàng yǒu mò shēng rén gēn wǒ shuō huà.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì gēn mò shēng rén liáo tiān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you chat with strangers?
entries.answer: 會，我常跟陌生人聊天練中文。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng gēn mò shēng rén liáo tiān liàn zhōng wén.

entries.answer: 常常，我小時候很調皮，常被處罰。

entries.example: 這次旅行的住宿已經訂好了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì lǚ xíng de zhù sù yǐ jīng dìng hǎo le.

entries.answer: 沒有，我家沒有車庫。
entries.answerPinyin: méi yǒu, wǒ jiā méi yǒu chē kù.
entries.answerEnglish: No, we don't have a garage.

entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men kāi chē yán zhe hǎi biān de gōng lù zǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: We drove along the coastal highway.
entries.question: 你在台灣騎過哪條公路？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān qí guò nǎ tiáo gōng lù?
entries.questionEnglish: Which highway have you ridden on in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我騎過花東的海岸公路。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qí guò huā dōng de hǎi àn gōng lù.
entries.answerEnglish: I've ridden the coastal highway in Hualien and Taitung.

entries.example: 已經連續下了三天雨。
entries.examplePinyin: yǐ jīng lián xù xià le sān tiān yǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's rained three days in a row.
entries.question: 你最多連續工作過幾天？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì duō lián xù gōng zuò guò jǐ tiān?

entries.answer: 我最多連續工作過十天。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì duō lián xù gōng zuò guò shí tiān.
entries.answerEnglish: At most, ten days in a row.

entries.examplePinyin: kè tīng de dì tǎn gāi xǐ le.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā lǐ yǒu dì tǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have carpets at home?
entries.answer: 有，我客廳有一塊地毯。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ kè tīng yǒu yí kuài dì tǎn.

entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bà qù nián bǎ yān jiè diào le.

entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng jiè diào shuì qián huá shǒu jī de xí guàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I want to quit scrolling on my phone before bed.

entries.example: 我下定決心要學好中文。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xià dìng jué xīn yào xué hǎo zhōng wén.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jīn nián xià le shén me jué xīn?
entries.questionEnglish: What have you resolved to do this year?
entries.answer: 我下決心每天運動。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xià jué xīn měi tiān yùn dòng.
entries.answerEnglish: I've resolved to exercise every day.

entries.example: 地板擦得好乾淨，都發亮了。
entries.examplePinyin: dì bǎn cā de hǎo gān jìng, dōu fā liàng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The floor has been cleaned so well that it shines.
entries.question: 你看過會發亮的螢火蟲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò huì fā liàng de yíng huǒ chóng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen fireflies glowing?
entries.answer: 看過，螢火蟲在山上一閃一閃地發亮。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, yíng huǒ chóng zài shān shàng yì shǎn yì shǎn de fā liàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've seen fireflies twinkling and glowing in the mountains.

entries.example: 不好意思，打斷一下。
entries.examplePinyin: bù hǎo yì si, dǎ duàn yí xià.
entries.exampleEnglish: Sorry to interrupt.
entries.question: 別人說話時，你會打斷嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: bié rén shuō huà shí, nǐ huì dǎ duàn ma?

entries.answer: 不會，我不喜歡打斷別人說話。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ bù xǐ huan dǎ duàn bié rén shuō huà.

entries.example: 我考過華語考試，拿到一張證書。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ kǎo guò huá yǔ kǎo shì, ná dào yì zhāng zhèng shū.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu shén me zhèng shū?

entries.answer: 我有一張潛水證書。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yǒu yì zhāng qián shuǐ zhèng shū.

entries.question: 你們公司有多少職員？

entries.answer: 我們公司有五十個職員。

entries.answerEnglish: Our company has fifty staff.

entries.examplePinyin: zhè kē yào yào pèi shuǐ tūn xià.
entries.exampleEnglish: Swallow this pill with water.
entries.question: 吃藥時，你可以一次吞下很多顆嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: chī yào shí, nǐ kě yǐ yí cì tūn xià hěn duō kē ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you take medicine, can you swallow several pills at once?
entries.answer: 不行，我一次只能吞下一顆。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xíng, wǒ yí cì zhǐ néng tūn xià yì kē.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I can only swallow one at a time.

entries.example: 請先到一樓的接待處登記。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng xiān dào yī lóu de jiē dài chù dēng jì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please check in at reception on the first floor first.
entries.question: 你們公司的接待處在幾樓？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men gōng sī de jiē dài chù zài jǐ lóu?
entries.questionEnglish: Which floor is your company's reception on?
entries.answer: 我們公司的接待處在一樓。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men gōng sī de jiē dài chù zài yī lóu.
entries.answerEnglish: Our company's reception is on the first floor.

entries.example: 夏天的山上有很多昆蟲。
entries.examplePinyin: xià tiān de shān shàng yǒu hěn duō kūn chóng.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of insects in the mountains in summer.
entries.question: 你最怕什麼昆蟲？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì pà shén me kūn chóng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which insect are you most afraid of?
entries.answer: 我最怕蟑螂這種昆蟲。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì pà zhāng láng zhè zhǒng kūn chóng.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm most afraid of cockroaches.

entries.english: break down; be out of order
entries.example: 捷運故障了，我上班遲到了。
entries.examplePinyin: jié yùn gù zhàng le, wǒ shàng bān chí dào le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The MRT broke down, so I was late for work.
entries.question: 你的手機故障過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de shǒu jī gù zhàng guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has your phone ever broken down?
entries.answer: 有，上個月我的手機故障了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, shàng gè yuè wǒ de shǒu jī gù zhàng le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my phone stopped working last month.

entries.example: 我們在海邊搭帳篷。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zài hǎi biān dā zhàng péng.
entries.exampleEnglish: We pitched a tent by the sea.
entries.question: 你睡過帳篷嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shuì guò zhàng péng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever slept in a tent?
entries.answer: 睡過，去露營的時候睡帳篷。
entries.answerPinyin: shuì guò, qù lù yíng de shí hòu shuì zhàng péng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I slept in a tent when I went camping.

entries.example: 抽菸對肺不好。
entries.examplePinyin: chōu yān duì fèi bù hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Smoking is bad for your lungs.
entries.question: 你覺得台北的空氣對肺好嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái běi de kōng qì duì fèi hǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taipei's air is good for your lungs?
entries.answer: 不太好，空氣不好會傷肺。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài hǎo, kōng qì bù hǎo huì shāng fèi.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. Bad air hurts your lungs.

entries.example: 你知道誰發明了電話嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: nǐ zhī dào shéi fā míng le diàn huà ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: Do you know who invented the telephone?
entries.question: 你覺得最棒的發明是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zuì bàng de fā míng shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is the best invention?
entries.answer: 我覺得手機是最棒的發明。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de shǒu jī shì zuì bàng de fā míng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think the mobile phone is the best invention.

entries.example: 夏天用電多，電力常常不夠。
entries.examplePinyin: xià tiān yòng diàn duō, diàn lì cháng cháng bú gòu.
entries.exampleEnglish: People use a lot of electricity in summer, so power often runs short.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣夏天的電力夠用嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān xià tiān de diàn lì gòu yòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwan has enough electric power in summer?
entries.answer: 我覺得夏天的電力有點不夠。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de xià tiān de diàn lì yǒu diǎn bú gòu.
entries.answerEnglish: I think power is a bit short in summer.

entries.example: 我需要一根針和一些線。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xū yào yì gēn zhēn hé yì xiē xiàn.

entries.question: 你怕打針嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pà dǎ zhēn ma?

entries.answer: 我很怕打針。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ hěn pà dǎ zhēn.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm really scared of injections.

entries.example: 我弟弟在大學念物理。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ dì di zài dà xué niàn wù lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: My younger brother studies physics at university.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǐ qián xǐ huan shàng wù lǐ kè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you use to like physics class?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，我覺得物理很難。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xǐ huan, wǒ jué de wù lǐ hěn nán.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I found physics hard.

entries.example: 下雨後，路上都是泥巴。
entries.examplePinyin: xià yǔ hòu, lù shang dōu shì ní bā.
entries.exampleEnglish: After the rain, the road is all mud.
entries.question: 你小時候玩過泥巴嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu wán guò ní bā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you play in the mud as a child?
entries.answer: 玩過，我小時候常常玩泥巴。
entries.answerPinyin: wán guò, wǒ xiǎo shí hòu cháng cháng wán ní bā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often played in the mud as a kid.

entries.example: 這家咖啡店的裝潢很有藝術感。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā kā fēi diàn de zhuāng huáng hěn yǒu yì shù gǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This café's decor is really artistic.
entries.question: 你覺得台北哪裡很有藝術感？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái běi nǎ lǐ hěn yǒu yì shù gǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: Where in Taipei feels really artistic to you?
entries.answer: 我覺得華山文創園區很有藝術感。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de huà shān wén chuàng yuán qū hěn yǒu yì shù gǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: I think Huashan Creative Park is very artistic.

entries.example: 我每天早上吃一些堅果。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng chī yì xiē jiān guǒ.
entries.exampleEnglish: I eat some nuts every morning.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃堅果嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī jiān guǒ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like nuts?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常把堅果當點心。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ cháng bǎ jiān guǒ dāng diǎn xīn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often snack on nuts.

entries.example: 我的腳趾踢到桌子，好痛！
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de jiǎo zhǐ tī dào zhuō zi, hǎo tòng!
entries.exampleEnglish: I stubbed my toe on the table. It hurts!
entries.question: 你的腳趾受過傷嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de jiǎo zhǐ shòu guò shāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever hurt your toe?
entries.answer: 有，我踢到桌腳，腳趾腫了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ tī dào zhuō jiǎo, jiǎo zhǐ zhǒng le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I kicked a table leg and my toe swelled up.

entries.examplePinyin: tā yóu yù le hěn jiǔ cái jué dìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: He hesitated for a long time before deciding.
entries.question: 買東西時，你常常猶豫嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: mǎi dōng xī shí, nǐ cháng cháng yóu yù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often hesitate when shopping?
entries.answer: 會，我買衣服常常猶豫很久。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ mǎi yī fu cháng cháng yóu yù hěn jiǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often hesitate for ages when buying clothes.

entries.example: 這包藥粉要加水喝。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bāo yào fěn yào jiā shuǐ hē.
entries.exampleEnglish: This packet of powdered medicine should be taken with water.
entries.question: 你煮菜時常加胡椒粉嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhǔ cài shí cháng jiā hú jiāo fěn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often add pepper when you cook?
entries.answer: 會，我煮湯常加一點胡椒粉。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ zhǔ tāng cháng jiā yì diǎn hú jiāo fěn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often add a little pepper to soup.

entries.example: 我跌倒了，手肘受傷了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ dié dǎo le, shǒu zhǒu shòu shāng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: I fell and hurt my elbow.
entries.question: 你的手肘受過傷嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de shǒu zhǒu shòu guò shāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever hurt your elbow?
entries.answer: 有，打籃球時手肘受過傷。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, dǎ lán qiú shí shǒu zhǒu shòu guò shāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I hurt my elbow playing basketball.

entries.example: 你有資格參加這個比賽。
entries.examplePinyin: nǐ yǒu zī gé cān jiā zhè ge bǐ sài.

entries.question: 你覺得你有資格教什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ yǒu zī gé jiāo shén me?

entries.answer: 我覺得我有資格教英文。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de wǒ yǒu zī gé jiāo yīng wén.
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm qualified to teach English.

entries.example: 天氣太熱，冰淇淋都融化了。
entries.examplePinyin: tiān qì tài rè, bīng qí lín dōu róng huà le.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's so hot that the ice cream has melted.
entries.question: 台灣的夏天會讓你熱到快融化嗎？

entries.questionEnglish: Does Taiwan's summer make you feel like you're melting?
entries.answer: 會，夏天熱到我快融化了。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, xià tiān rè dào wǒ kuài róng huà le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the summer is so hot I'm almost melting.

entries.example: 房間裡有淡淡的花香。
entries.examplePinyin: fáng jiān lǐ yǒu dàn dàn de huā xiāng.

entries.question: 你喜歡淡淡的香水味嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan dàn dàn de xiāng shuǐ wèi ma?
