entries.questionPinyin: zuò lún yǐ de rén zài tái wān chū mén fāng biàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is it easy for wheelchair users to get around in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 還算方便，坐輪椅也能搭公車和捷運。
entries.answerPinyin: hái suàn fāng biàn, zuò lún yǐ yě néng dā gōng chē hé jié yùn.
entries.answerEnglish: Fairly easy. Wheelchair users can take buses and the MRT.

entries.example: 我們公司這個月來了三個新人。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men gōng sī zhè ge yuè lái le sān gè xīn rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: Three new people joined our company this month.
entries.question: 你剛到公司當新人時緊張嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gāng dào gōng sī dāng xīn rén shí jǐn zhāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Were you nervous when you were new at your company?
entries.answer: 很緊張，當新人的時候什麼都不懂。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn jǐn zhāng, dāng xīn rén de shí hòu shén me dōu bù dǒng.
entries.answerEnglish: Very nervous. As a newcomer, I didn't know anything.

entries.example: 這場比賽沒有輸家，大家都很棒。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè chǎng bǐ sài méi yǒu shū jiā, dà jiā dōu hěn bàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are no losers in this game; everyone did great.
entries.question: 玩遊戲當輸家時，你會生氣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: wán yóu xì dāng shū jiā shí, nǐ huì shēng qì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you get angry when you lose a game?
entries.answer: 不會，當輸家也沒關係，好玩就好。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, dāng shū jiā yě méi guān xì, hǎo wán jiù hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: No. It's fine to be the loser, as long as it's fun.

entries.example: 我去運動用品店買了一雙球鞋。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ qù yùn dòng yòng pǐn diàn mǎi le yì shuāng qiú xié.
entries.exampleEnglish: I went to a sporting goods store and bought a pair of sneakers.
entries.question: 你常去哪裡買運動用品？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng qù nǎ lǐ mǎi yùn dòng yòng pǐn?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you usually buy sports gear?
entries.answer: 我常在網路上買運動用品。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cháng zài wǎng lù shang mǎi yùn dòng yòng pǐn.
entries.answerEnglish: I often buy sports gear online.

entries.example: 長時間看手機對眼睛不好。
entries.examplePinyin: cháng shí jiān kàn shǒu jī duì yǎn jīng bù hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Looking at your phone for long periods is bad for your eyes.
entries.question: 你上班需要長時間坐著嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shàng bān xū yào cháng shí jiān zuò zhe ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have to sit for long periods at work?
entries.answer: 對，我上班要長時間坐在電腦前。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ shàng bān yào cháng shí jiān zuò zài diàn nǎo qián.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have to sit at a computer for long hours at work.

entries.example: 我常去家附近的髮廊剪頭髮。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ cháng qù jiā fù jìn de fǎ láng jiǎn tóu fǎ.
entries.exampleEnglish: I usually get my hair cut at a salon near my home.
entries.question: 你多久去一次髮廊？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duō jiǔ qù yí cì fǎ láng?
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you go to the hair salon?
entries.answer: 我大概兩個月去一次髮廊。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dà gài liǎng gè yuè qù yí cì fǎ láng.
entries.answerEnglish: I go to the salon about every two months.

entries.example: 這家麵店的味道十年不變。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā miàn diàn de wèi dào shí nián bú biàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This noodle shop's flavor has stayed the same for ten years.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣什麼東西一直不變？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān shén me dōng xī yì zhí bú biàn?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think has never changed in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我覺得夜市的熱鬧一直不變。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de yè shì de rè nào yì zhí bú biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I think the buzz of the night markets never changes.

entries.example: 這件事請你幫我保密。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn shì qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ bǎo mì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please keep this a secret for me.
entries.question: 朋友告訴你祕密，你會保密嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: péng yǒu gào sù nǐ mì mì, nǐ huì bǎo mì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: If a friend tells you a secret, do you keep it?
entries.answer: 會，我一定會幫朋友保密。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ yí dìng huì bāng péng yǒu bǎo mì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always keep my friends' secrets.

entries.example: 他開會時講了很多廢話。
entries.examplePinyin: tā kāi huì shí jiǎng le hěn duō fèi huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: He talked a lot of nonsense in the meeting.
entries.question: 你討厭別人講廢話嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tǎo yàn bié rén jiǎng fèi huà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you hate it when people talk nonsense?
entries.answer: 很討厭，開會講廢話很浪費時間。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn tǎo yàn, kāi huì jiǎng fèi huà hěn làng fèi shí jiān.
entries.answerEnglish: I hate it. Talking nonsense in meetings wastes time.

entries.example: 這座公園下個月會重新開放。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zuò gōng yuán xià gè yuè huì chóng xīn kāi fàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This park will reopen next month.
entries.question: 你最希望哪個地方重新開放？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xī wàng nǎ gè dì fāng chóng xīn kāi fàng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which place do you most hope will reopen?
entries.answer: 我希望家附近的老戲院可以重新開放。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xī wàng jiā fù jìn de lǎo xì yuàn kě yǐ chóng xīn kāi fàng.
entries.answerEnglish: I hope the old theater near my home can reopen.

entries.example: 我的貓生病了，要帶牠去看獸醫。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de māo shēng bìng le, yào dài tā qù kàn shòu yī.
entries.exampleEnglish: My cat is sick, so I need to take it to the vet.
entries.question: 你多久帶寵物看一次獸醫？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duō jiǔ dài chǒng wù kàn yí cì shòu yī?
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you take your pet to the vet?
entries.answer: 我每年帶我的狗看一次獸醫。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ měi nián dài wǒ de gǒu kàn yí cì shòu yī.
entries.answerEnglish: I take my dog to the vet once a year.

entries.example: 會議還在進行中，請等一下。
entries.examplePinyin: huì yì hái zài jìn xíng zhōng, qǐng děng yí xià.
entries.exampleEnglish: The meeting is still in progress; please wait a moment.
entries.question: 你現在有什麼計畫在進行中？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiàn zài yǒu shén me jì huà zài jìn xíng zhōng?
entries.questionEnglish: What plans do you have underway right now?
entries.answer: 我的學中文計畫正在進行中。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de xué zhōng wén jì huà zhèng zài jìn xíng zhōng.
entries.answerEnglish: My plan to learn Chinese is underway.

entries.example: 這首歌讓人想起大學的時候。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shǒu gē ràng rén xiǎng qǐ dà xué de shí hòu.
entries.exampleEnglish: This song brings back memories of college.
entries.question: 什麼食物最讓人想起家鄉？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shí wù zuì ràng rén xiǎng qǐ jiā xiāng?
entries.questionEnglish: What food reminds you most of home?
entries.answer: 我覺得媽媽煮的湯最讓人想起家鄉。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de mā ma zhǔ de tāng zuì ràng rén xiǎng qǐ jiā xiāng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think Mom's soup reminds you of home the most.

entries.example: 這家飯店的服務是一流的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā fàn diàn de fú wù shì yì liú de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This hotel's service is first-rate.
entries.question: 你覺得哪家餐廳的服務是一流的？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǎ jiā cān tīng de fú wù shì yì liú de?
entries.questionEnglish: Which restaurant do you think has first-rate service?
entries.answer: 我覺得那家日本料理店的服務是一流的。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de nà jiā rì běn liào lǐ diàn de fú wù shì yì liú de.
entries.answerEnglish: I think that Japanese restaurant's service is first-rate.

entries.example: 我週末去做了腳底按摩。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zhōu mò qù zuò le jiǎo dǐ àn mó.
entries.exampleEnglish: I got a foot massage on the weekend.
entries.question: 你喜歡去按摩嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan qù àn mó ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like getting massages?
entries.answer: 很喜歡，按摩完覺得很放鬆。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn xǐ huan, àn mó wán jué de hěn fàng sōng.
entries.answerEnglish: I love it. I feel so relaxed after a massage.

entries.example: 媽媽燉了一鍋牛肉湯。
entries.examplePinyin: mā ma dùn le yì guō niú ròu tāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Mom simmered a pot of beef soup.
entries.question: 冬天你會在家燉湯嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: dōng tiān nǐ huì zài jiā dùn tāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you make stewed soups at home in winter?
entries.answer: 會，我冬天常常燉雞湯。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōng tiān cháng cháng dùn jī tāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often simmer chicken soup in winter.

entries.example: 那個傢伙每次開會都遲到。
entries.examplePinyin: nà ge jiā huo měi cì kāi huì dōu chí dào.
entries.exampleEnglish: That guy is late for every meeting.
entries.question: 你的同事裡有很好笑的傢伙嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de tóng shì lǐ yǒu hěn hǎo xiào de jiā huo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there any really funny guys among your coworkers?
entries.answer: 有，有個傢伙每天都講笑話。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, yǒu gè jiā huo měi tiān dōu jiǎng xiào huà.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's one guy who tells jokes every day.

entries.example: 她在藥妝店買了很多化妝品。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài yào zhuāng diàn mǎi le hěn duō huà zhuāng pǐn.
entries.exampleEnglish: She bought a lot of cosmetics at the drugstore.
entries.question: 你常在哪裡買化妝品？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng zài nǎ lǐ mǎi huà zhuāng pǐn?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you usually buy cosmetics?
entries.answer: 我常在藥妝店買化妝品。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cháng zài yào zhuāng diàn mǎi huà zhuāng pǐn.
entries.answerEnglish: I usually buy cosmetics at the drugstore.

entries.example: 週末晚上夜店人很多。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōu mò wǎn shàng yè diàn rén hěn duō.
entries.exampleEnglish: Nightclubs are packed on weekend nights.
entries.question: 你去過台北的夜店嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò tái běi de yè diàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to a nightclub in Taipei?
entries.answer: 去過，我跟朋友去過信義區的夜店。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, wǒ gēn péng yǒu qù guò xìn yì qū de yè diàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I went to a club in Xinyi District with friends.

entries.example: 這個抽屜是上鎖的，打不開。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge chōu tì shì shàng suǒ de, dǎ bù kāi.
entries.exampleEnglish: This drawer is locked; it won't open.
entries.question: 你出門時一定會把門上鎖嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chū mén shí yí dìng huì bǎ mén shàng suǒ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you always lock the door when you go out?
entries.answer: 會，我出門一定會把門上鎖。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ chū mén yí dìng huì bǎ mén shàng suǒ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always lock the door when I go out.

entries.example: 動物園裡的企鵝好可愛。
entries.examplePinyin: dòng wù yuán lǐ de qì é hǎo kě ài.
entries.exampleEnglish: The penguins at the zoo are so cute.
entries.question: 你在哪裡看過企鵝？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài nǎ lǐ kàn guò qì é?
entries.questionEnglish: Where have you seen penguins?
entries.answer: 我在台北動物園看過企鵝。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài tái běi dòng wù yuán kàn guò qì é.
entries.answerEnglish: I've seen penguins at the Taipei Zoo.

entries.example: 我的同事是從蘇格蘭來的。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de tóng shì shì cóng sū gé lán lái de.
entries.exampleEnglish: My coworker is from Scotland.
entries.question: 你去過蘇格蘭嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò sū gé lán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to Scotland?
entries.answer: 去過，蘇格蘭的風景很美。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, sū gé lán de fēng jǐng hěn měi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, Scotland's scenery is beautiful.

entries.example: 他是一名職業足球員。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì yì míng zhí yè zú qiú yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a professional soccer player.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪位足球員？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ wèi zú qiú yuán?
entries.questionEnglish: Who's your favorite soccer player?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡梅西這位足球員。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan méi xī zhè wèi zú qiú yuán.
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite soccer player is Messi.

entries.example: 她在一家科技公司做公關。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài yì jiā kē jì gōng sī zuò gōng guān.
entries.exampleEnglish: She does PR at a tech company.
entries.question: 你覺得做公關需要什麼能力？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zuò gōng guān xū yào shén me néng lì?
entries.questionEnglish: What skills do you think PR work needs?
entries.answer: 做公關要很會跟人溝通。
entries.answerPinyin: zuò gōng guān yào hěn huì gēn rén gōu tōng.
entries.answerEnglish: People in PR need to be good at communicating.

entries.example: 這家餐廳最低消費是一人兩百元。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā cān tīng zuì dī xiāo fèi shì yì rén liǎng bǎi yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant has a minimum charge of NT$200 per person.
entries.question: 你每個月在吃的方面消費多少？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ měi gè yuè zài chī de fāng miàn xiāo fèi duō shǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: How much do you spend on food each month?
entries.answer: 我每個月吃的方面大概消費一萬塊。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ měi gè yuè chī de fāng miàn dà gài xiāo fèi yí wàn kuài.
entries.answerEnglish: I spend about ten thousand dollars a month on food.

entries.example: 我在網路上看了那段新聞影片。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài wǎng lù shang kàn le nà duàn xīn wén yǐng piàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I watched that news clip online.
entries.question: 你常在手機上看新聞影片嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng zài shǒu jī shàng kàn xīn wén yǐng piàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often watch news videos on your phone?
entries.answer: 常看，新聞影片比文章好懂。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng kàn, xīn wén yǐng piàn bǐ wén zhāng hǎo dǒng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, news videos are easier to understand than articles.

entries.example: 用中文開會對我來說還是有點吃力。
entries.examplePinyin: yòng zhōng wén kāi huì duì wǒ lái shuō hái shì yǒu diǎn chī lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Meetings in Chinese are still a bit of a struggle for me.
entries.question: 用中文看新聞對你來說吃力嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: yòng zhōng wén kàn xīn wén duì nǐ lái shuō chī lì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is reading the news in Chinese hard going for you?
entries.answer: 有點吃力，很多字我還不會。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu diǎn chī lì, hěn duō zì wǒ hái bú huì.
entries.answerEnglish: It's a bit of a struggle; there are lots of characters I don't know yet.

entries.example: 週末我們在河岸騎腳踏車。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōu mò wǒ men zài hé àn qí jiǎo tà chē.
entries.exampleEnglish: On weekends we ride bikes along the riverbank.
entries.question: 你喜歡在河岸散步嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zài hé àn sàn bù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like walking along the riverbank?
entries.answer: 喜歡，晚上在河岸散步很舒服。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǎn shàng zài hé àn sàn bù hěn shū fú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, it's lovely to walk by the river in the evening.

entries.example: 她是公司裡最資深的工程師。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì gōng sī lǐ zuì zī shēn de gōng chéng shī.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's the most senior engineer in the company.
entries.question: 在你的公司，誰最資深？
entries.questionPinyin: zài nǐ de gōng sī, shéi zuì zī shēn?
entries.questionEnglish: Who's the most senior person at your company?
entries.answer: 我們部門的經理最資深，做了二十年。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men bù mén de jīng lǐ zuì zī shēn, zuò le èr shí nián.
entries.answerEnglish: Our department manager is the most senior; he's been there twenty years.

entries.example: 我們在規劃下個月的旅行。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zài guī huà xià gè yuè de lǚ xíng.
entries.exampleEnglish: We're planning next month's trip.
entries.question: 你怎麼規劃週末的時間？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zěn me guī huà zhōu mò de shí jiān?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you plan your weekends?
entries.answer: 我會先規劃好要去哪裡玩。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì xiān guī huà hǎo yào qù nǎ lǐ wán.
entries.answerEnglish: I plan where I'm going to go first.

entries.example: 從捷運站步行五分鐘就到了。
entries.examplePinyin: cóng jié yùn zhàn bù xíng wǔ fēn zhōng jiù dào le.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's a five-minute walk from the MRT station.
entries.question: 從你家步行到捷運站要多久？
entries.questionPinyin: cóng nǐ jiā bù xíng dào jié yùn zhàn yào duō jiǔ?
entries.questionEnglish: How long does it take to walk from your home to the MRT station?
entries.answer: 步行大概十分鐘。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xíng dà gài shí fēn zhōng.
entries.answerEnglish: About ten minutes on foot.

entries.example: 陽台的角落有一張蜘蛛網。
entries.examplePinyin: yáng tái de jiǎo luò yǒu yì zhāng zhī zhū wǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a spider web in the corner of the balcony.
entries.question: 你家裡常常有蜘蛛網嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā lǐ cháng cháng yǒu zhī zhū wǎng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there often spider webs in your home?
entries.answer: 陽台上常常有蜘蛛網。
entries.answerPinyin: yáng tái shàng cháng cháng yǒu zhī zhū wǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: There often are on the balcony.

entries.english: specially; on purpose; all the way
entries.example: 他特地從台中來台北看我。
entries.examplePinyin: tā tè dì cóng tái zhōng lái tái běi kàn wǒ.
entries.exampleEnglish: He came all the way from Taichung to Taipei just to see me.
entries.question: 你曾經特地去哪裡吃東西？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ céng jīng tè dì qù nǎ lǐ chī dōng xī?
entries.questionEnglish: Where have you ever gone specially to eat something?
entries.answer: 我特地去台南吃牛肉湯。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ tè dì qù tái nán chī niú ròu tāng.
entries.answerEnglish: I went to Tainan specially for beef soup.

entries.example: 爐子上還在煮湯，小心燙。
entries.examplePinyin: lú zi shàng hái zài zhǔ tāng, xiǎo xīn tàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's still soup on the stove; careful, it's hot.
entries.question: 你家的爐子是瓦斯的還是電的？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de lú zi shì wǎ sī de hái shì diàn de?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your stove gas or electric?
entries.answer: 我家的爐子是瓦斯的。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā de lú zi shì wǎ sī de.
entries.answerEnglish: Our stove is gas.

entries.example: 多看書可以增加詞彙。
entries.examplePinyin: duō kàn shū kě yǐ zēng jiā cí huì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Reading more can expand your vocabulary.
entries.question: 你怎麼學新的中文詞彙？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zěn me xué xīn de zhōng wén cí huì?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you learn new Chinese vocabulary?
entries.answer: 我每天用手機背十個新詞彙。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ měi tiān yòng shǒu jī bèi shí gè xīn cí huì.
entries.answerEnglish: I memorize ten new words on my phone every day.

entries.example: 我的祖父母住在南部的鄉下。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de zǔ fù mǔ zhù zài nán bù de xiāng xià.
entries.exampleEnglish: My grandparents live in the countryside in the south.
entries.question: 你的祖父母住在哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de zǔ fù mǔ zhù zài nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do your grandparents live?
entries.answer: 我的祖父母住在美國德州。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de zǔ fù mǔ zhù zài měi guó dé zhōu.
entries.answerEnglish: My grandparents live in Texas.

entries.example: 這張桌子的寬度是八十公分。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhāng zhuō zi de kuān dù shì bā shí gōng fēn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This table is 80 centimeters wide.
entries.question: 買床之前，你會先量房間的寬度嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: mǎi chuáng zhī qián, nǐ huì xiān liáng fáng jiān de kuān dù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Before you buy a bed, do you measure the width of the room?
entries.answer: 會，我一定會先量好寬度。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ yí dìng huì xiān liáng hǎo kuān dù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always measure the width first.

entries.example: 我想買一個透明的手機殼。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí gè tòu míng de shǒu jī ké.
entries.exampleEnglish: I want to buy a clear phone case.
entries.question: 你覺得公司的薪水應該透明嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de gōng sī de xīn shuǐ yīng gāi tòu míng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think company salaries should be transparent?
entries.answer: 我覺得應該透明，這樣比較公平。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de yīng gāi tòu míng, zhè yàng bǐ jiào gōng píng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think they should be transparent; it's fairer.

entries.example: 我把掉下來的釦子縫回去了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bǎ diào xià lái de kòu zi féng huí qù le.
entries.exampleEnglish: I sewed the button that fell off back on.
entries.question: 你會自己縫釦子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zì jǐ féng kòu zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you sew a button on yourself?
entries.answer: 會，我會自己縫釦子。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì zì jǐ féng kòu zi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I can sew buttons on myself.

entries.example: 冬天很多人得流感。
entries.examplePinyin: dōng tiān hěn duō rén dé liú gǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Lots of people get the flu in winter.
entries.question: 怎麼做可以預防流感？
entries.questionPinyin: zěn me zuò kě yǐ yù fáng liú gǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: What can you do to prevent the flu?
entries.answer: 打疫苗可以預防流感。
entries.answerPinyin: dǎ yì miáo kě yǐ yù fáng liú gǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Getting vaccinated helps prevent the flu.

entries.example: 台北跟我想像中的不太一樣。
entries.examplePinyin: tái běi gēn wǒ xiǎng xiàng zhōng de bú tài yí yàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taipei is a bit different from what I imagined.
entries.question: 台灣跟你想像中的一樣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: tái wān gēn nǐ xiǎng xiàng zhōng de yí yàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is Taiwan what you imagined?
entries.answer: 台灣比我想像中更方便。
entries.answerPinyin: tái wān bǐ wǒ xiǎng xiàng zhōng gèng fāng biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Taiwan is more convenient than I imagined.

entries.example: 這個英文單字的拼字錯了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge yīng wén dān zì de pīn zì cuò le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This English word is spelled wrong.
entries.question: 你打字的時候常常拼字錯誤嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dǎ zì de shí hòu cháng cháng pīn zì cuò wù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often make spelling mistakes when you type?
entries.answer: 有時候會，手機會幫我改拼字。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu huì, shǒu jī huì bāng wǒ gǎi pīn zì.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. My phone corrects my spelling.

entries.example: 沙發要橫著才搬得進門。
entries.examplePinyin: shā fā yào héng zhe cái bān de jìn mén.
entries.exampleEnglish: The sofa has to go in sideways to fit through the door.
entries.question: 你看影片的時候會把手機橫著拿嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn yǐng piàn de shí hòu huì bǎ shǒu jī héng zhe ná ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you hold your phone sideways when you watch videos?
entries.answer: 會，我看影片都橫著拿手機。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ kàn yǐng piàn dōu héng zhe ná shǒu jī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always hold it sideways for videos.

entries.example: 這間套房的房租太不合理了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiān tào fáng de fáng zū tài bù hé lǐ le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The rent for this studio is completely unreasonable.
entries.question: 你覺得哪些規定很不合理？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǎ xiē guī dìng hěn bù hé lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Which rules do you think are unreasonable?
entries.answer: 我覺得公司不能穿短褲很不合理。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de gōng sī bù néng chuān duǎn kù hěn bù hé lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I think it's unreasonable that we can't wear shorts at work.

entries.example: 百貨公司的內衣在打折。
entries.examplePinyin: bǎi huò gōng sī de nèi yī zài dǎ zhé.
entries.exampleEnglish: Underwear is on sale at the department store.
entries.question: 出國旅行時，你會帶幾件內衣？
entries.questionPinyin: chū guó lǚ xíng shí, nǐ huì dài jǐ jiàn nèi yī?
entries.questionEnglish: How many pieces of underwear do you pack for a trip abroad?
entries.answer: 我通常帶五件內衣。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ tōng cháng dài wǔ jiàn nèi yī.
entries.answerEnglish: I usually pack five.

entries.example: 感冒很容易傳染給別人。
entries.examplePinyin: gǎn mào hěn róng yì chuán rǎn gěi bié rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: Colds spread easily to other people.
entries.question: 怎麼樣可以避免傳染感冒？
entries.questionPinyin: zěn me yàng kě yǐ bì miǎn chuán rǎn gǎn mào?
entries.questionEnglish: How can you avoid spreading a cold?
entries.answer: 戴口罩可以避免傳染感冒。
entries.answerPinyin: dài kǒu zhào kě yǐ bì miǎn chuán rǎn gǎn mào.
entries.answerEnglish: Wearing a mask helps avoid spreading a cold.

entries.example: 我爸媽不贊成我搬出去住。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bà mā bú zàn chéng wǒ bān chū qù zhù.
entries.exampleEnglish: My parents don't approve of me moving out.
entries.question: 你不贊成什麼樣的行為？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bú zàn chéng shén me yàng de xíng wéi?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of behavior do you disapprove of?
entries.answer: 我不贊成在捷運上大聲講電話。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bú zàn chéng zài jié yùn shàng dà shēng jiǎng diàn huà.
entries.answerEnglish: I disapprove of talking loudly on the phone on the MRT.

entries.example: 捷運站外有街頭表演者在唱歌。
entries.examplePinyin: jié yùn zhàn wài yǒu jiē tóu biǎo yǎn zhě zài chàng gē.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a street performer singing outside the MRT station.
entries.question: 你會給街頭表演者錢嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì gěi jiē tóu biǎo yǎn zhě qián ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you give money to street performers?
entries.answer: 會，如果表演者唱得好，我會給一點。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, rú guǒ biǎo yǎn zhě chàng de hǎo, wǒ huì gěi yì diǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, if the performer is good, I give a little.

entries.example: 他開會的時候一直打哈欠。
entries.examplePinyin: tā kāi huì de shí hòu yì zhí dǎ hā qian.
entries.exampleEnglish: He kept yawning during the meeting.
entries.question: 你什麼時候最常打哈欠？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shén me shí hòu zuì cháng dǎ hā qian?
entries.questionEnglish: When do you yawn the most?
entries.answer: 下午開會的時候我最常打哈欠。
entries.answerPinyin: xià wǔ kāi huì de shí hòu wǒ zuì cháng dǎ hā qian.
entries.answerEnglish: I yawn most in afternoon meetings.

entries.example: 塞車了，更糟的是還下大雨。
entries.examplePinyin: sāi chē le, gèng zāo de shì hái xià dà yǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: We're stuck in traffic, and worse still, it's pouring.
entries.question: 下大雨和颱風，哪個更糟？
entries.questionPinyin: xià dà yǔ hé tái fēng, nǎ gè gèng zāo?
entries.questionEnglish: Which is worse, heavy rain or a typhoon?
entries.answer: 颱風更糟，連門都不能出。
entries.answerPinyin: tái fēng gèng zāo, lián mén dōu bù néng chū.
entries.answerEnglish: A typhoon is worse; you can't even go out.

entries.example: 陳是台灣很常見的姓氏。
entries.examplePinyin: chén shì tái wān hěn cháng jiàn de xìng shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Chen is a very common surname in Taiwan.
entries.question: 你的姓氏在你的國家常見嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de xìng shì zài nǐ de guó jiā cháng jiàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your surname common in your country?
entries.answer: 很常見，很多人都是這個姓氏。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn cháng jiàn, hěn duō rén dōu shì zhè ge xìng shì.
entries.answerEnglish: Very common. Lots of people have that surname.

entries.example: 那個店員對客人很不友善。
entries.examplePinyin: nà ge diàn yuán duì kè rén hěn bù yǒu shàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: That clerk is very unfriendly to customers.
entries.question: 你在台灣遇過不友善的人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān yù guò bù yǒu shàn de rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you met any unfriendly people in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 很少，只遇過一次很不友善的司機。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn shǎo, zhǐ yù guò yí cì hěn bù yǒu shàn de sī jī.
entries.answerEnglish: Rarely. I've only met one really unfriendly driver.

entries.example: 請給我一份護照影本。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng gěi wǒ yí fèn hù zhào yǐng běn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please give me a copy of your passport.
entries.question: 辦居留證要準備什麼影本？
entries.questionPinyin: bàn jū liú zhèng yào zhǔn bèi shén me yǐng běn?
entries.questionEnglish: What copies do you need to apply for a residence permit?
entries.answer: 要準備護照影本和照片。
entries.answerPinyin: yào zhǔn bèi hù zhào yǐng běn hé zhào piàn.
entries.answerEnglish: You need a copy of your passport and some photos.

entries.example: 我的美髮師很會剪短髮。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de měi fǎ shī hěn huì jiǎn duǎn fǎ.
entries.exampleEnglish: My hairdresser is great at short haircuts.
entries.question: 你有固定的美髮師嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu gù dìng de měi fǎ shī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a regular hairdresser?
entries.answer: 有，我都找同一位美髮師。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ dōu zhǎo tóng yí wèi měi fǎ shī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always go to the same hairdresser.

entries.example: 那個老闆對客人很不誠實。
entries.examplePinyin: nà ge lǎo bǎn duì kè rén hěn bù chéng shí.
entries.exampleEnglish: That shop owner is dishonest with customers.
entries.question: 你能接受朋友不誠實嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ néng jiē shòu péng yǒu bù chéng shí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you accept a friend being dishonest?
entries.answer: 不能，我最討厭不誠實的人。
entries.answerPinyin: bù néng, wǒ zuì tǎo yàn bù chéng shí de rén.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I can't stand dishonest people.

entries.example: 搬家真的很累人。
entries.examplePinyin: bān jiā zhēn de hěn lèi rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: Moving house is really exhausting.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼事最累人？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me shì zuì lèi rén?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you find most tiring?
entries.answer: 我覺得照顧小孩最累人。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de zhào gù xiǎo hái zuì lèi rén.
entries.answerEnglish: I think looking after kids is the most tiring.

entries.example: 我買了包裝紙來包禮物。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ mǎi le bāo zhuāng zhǐ lái bāo lǐ wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought wrapping paper to wrap the present.
entries.question: 你包禮物喜歡用什麼包裝紙？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bāo lǐ wù xǐ huan yòng shén me bāo zhuāng zhǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of wrapping paper do you like to use for gifts?
entries.answer: 我喜歡用素色的包裝紙。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan yòng sù sè de bāo zhuāng zhǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I like plain wrapping paper.

entries.example: 她在公司裡的地位很高。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài gōng sī lǐ de dì wèi hěn gāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: She has a high standing in the company.
entries.question: 在你的國家，老師的地位高嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zài nǐ de guó jiā, lǎo shī de dì wèi gāo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do teachers have high status in your country?
entries.answer: 還不錯，老師的地位滿高的。
entries.answerPinyin: hái bú cuò, lǎo shī de dì wèi mǎn gāo de.
entries.answerEnglish: Not bad. Teachers have fairly high status.

entries.example: 感恩節的時候，我們家會吃火雞。
entries.examplePinyin: gǎn ēn jié de shí hòu, wǒ men jiā huì chī huǒ jī.
entries.exampleEnglish: At Thanksgiving my family eats turkey.
entries.question: 你吃過嘉義的火雞肉飯嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chī guò jiā yì de huǒ jī ròu fàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you tried Chiayi turkey rice?
entries.answer: 吃過，嘉義的火雞肉飯很好吃。
entries.answerPinyin: chī guò, jiā yì de huǒ jī ròu fàn hěn hǎo chī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, Chiayi turkey rice is delicious.

entries.example: 夜市裡有很多賣吃的小販。
entries.examplePinyin: yè shì lǐ yǒu hěn duō mài chī de xiǎo fàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of food vendors at the night market.
entries.question: 你常跟夜市的小販聊天嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng gēn yè shì de xiǎo fàn liáo tiān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often chat with night market vendors?
entries.answer: 會，我跟賣雞排的小販很熟。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ gēn mài jī pái de xiǎo fàn hěn shú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I know the fried chicken vendor well.

entries.example: 我想在台灣長期住下去。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xiǎng zài tái wān cháng qí zhù xià qù.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'd like to live in Taiwan long-term.
entries.question: 你打算在台灣長期工作嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dǎ suàn zài tái wān cháng qí gōng zuò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you planning to work in Taiwan long-term?
entries.answer: 對，我打算在台灣長期工作。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ dǎ suàn zài tái wān cháng qí gōng zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I plan to work in Taiwan long-term.

entries.example: 她很有天分，學什麼都很快。
entries.examplePinyin: tā hěn yǒu tiān fèn, xué shén me dōu hěn kuài.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's very gifted and picks everything up quickly.
entries.question: 你覺得自己在哪方面有天分？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ zài nǎ fāng miàn yǒu tiān fèn?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think you're gifted at?
entries.answer: 我覺得我在語言方面有天分。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de wǒ zài yǔ yán fāng miàn yǒu tiān fèn.
entries.answerEnglish: I think I have a gift for languages.

entries.example: 動物園裡有三隻狼。
entries.examplePinyin: dòng wù yuán lǐ yǒu sān zhī láng.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are three wolves at the zoo.
entries.question: 你看過真的狼嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò zhēn de láng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a real wolf?
entries.answer: 看過，我在加拿大看過狼。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài jiā ná dà kàn guò láng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw wolves in Canada.

entries.example: 老闆肯定了我們這次的努力。
entries.examplePinyin: lǎo bǎn kěn dìng le wǒ men zhè cì de nǔ lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: The boss recognized our hard work this time.
entries.question: 你覺得在工作上被肯定重要嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zài gōng zuò shàng bèi kěn dìng zhòng yào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think recognition at work is important?
entries.answer: 很重要，被肯定讓我更有動力。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn zhòng yào, bèi kěn dìng ràng wǒ gèng yǒu dòng lì.
entries.answerEnglish: Very. Being recognized motivates me more.

entries.example: 開車的時候不要分心看手機。
entries.examplePinyin: kāi chē de shí hòu bú yào fēn xīn kàn shǒu jī.
entries.exampleEnglish: Don't get distracted by your phone while driving.
entries.question: 工作的時候，什麼最容易讓你分心？
entries.questionPinyin: gōng zuò de shí hòu, shén me zuì róng yì ràng nǐ fēn xīn?
entries.questionEnglish: What distracts you most easily at work?
entries.answer: 手機通知最容易讓我分心。
entries.answerPinyin: shǒu jī tōng zhī zuì róng yì ràng wǒ fēn xīn.
entries.answerEnglish: Phone notifications distract me the most.

entries.example: 這本中文教科書很實用。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè běn zhōng wén jiào kē shū hěn shí yòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This Chinese textbook is very practical.
entries.question: 你現在用哪本中文教科書？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiàn zài yòng nǎ běn zhōng wén jiào kē shū?
entries.questionEnglish: Which Chinese textbook are you using now?
entries.answer: 我用語言中心發的教科書。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yòng yǔ yán zhōng xīn fā de jiào kē shū.
entries.answerEnglish: I use the textbook the language center gave us.

entries.example: 他跪下來向女朋友求婚。
entries.examplePinyin: tā guì xià lái xiàng nǚ péng yǒu qiú hūn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He knelt down and proposed to his girlfriend.
entries.question: 在你的國家，求婚要跪下嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zài nǐ de guó jiā, qiú hūn yào guì xià ma?
entries.questionEnglish: In your country, do people kneel to propose?
entries.answer: 要，很多男生會跪下來求婚。
entries.answerPinyin: yào, hěn duō nán shēng huì guì xià lái qiú hūn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, lots of men kneel down to propose.

entries.example: 這個月的業績達到目標了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge yuè de yè jī dá dào mù biāo le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This month's sales hit the target.
entries.question: 你今年的目標達到了嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jīn nián de mù biāo dá dào le ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you reached your goals this year?
entries.answer: 還沒，希望年底可以達到。
entries.answerPinyin: hái méi, xī wàng nián dǐ kě yǐ dá dào.
entries.answerEnglish: Not yet. I hope to by the end of the year.

entries.example: 他用手指戳了我一下。
entries.examplePinyin: tā yòng shǒu zhǐ chuō le wǒ yí xià.
entries.exampleEnglish: He poked me with his finger.
entries.question: 你想叫朋友的時候會戳他嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng jiào péng yǒu de shí hòu huì chuō tā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you poke your friends to get their attention?
entries.answer: 會，我會戳一下他的肩膀。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì chuō yí xià tā de jiān bǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I poke them on the shoulder.

entries.example: 我太依賴手機了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ tài yī lài shǒu jī le.
entries.exampleEnglish: I rely on my phone too much.
entries.question: 你覺得自己很依賴手機嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ hěn yī lài shǒu jī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you depend on your phone a lot?
entries.answer: 對，我出門很依賴手機導航。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ chū mén hěn yī lài shǒu jī dǎo háng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I rely on my phone's navigation when I go out.

entries.english: straight line; in a straight line
entries.example: 從這裡直線走過去就到了。
entries.examplePinyin: cóng zhè lǐ zhí xiàn zǒu guò qù jiù dào le.
entries.exampleEnglish: Just walk straight on from here and you're there.
entries.question: 你不用尺能畫出直線嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bú yòng chǐ néng huà chū zhí xiàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you draw a straight line without a ruler?
entries.answer: 不能，我不用尺畫不出直線。
entries.answerPinyin: bù néng, wǒ bú yòng chǐ huà bù chū zhí xiàn.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I can't draw a straight line without one.

entries.example: 我想要靠走道的位子。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xiǎng yào kào zǒu dào de wèi zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'd like an aisle seat.
entries.question: 坐飛機時，你喜歡靠窗還是靠走道？
entries.questionPinyin: zuò fēi jī shí, nǐ xǐ huan kào chuāng hái shì kào zǒu dào?
entries.questionEnglish: On a plane, do you prefer the window or the aisle?
entries.answer: 我喜歡靠走道，上廁所比較方便。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan kào zǒu dào, shàng cè suǒ bǐ jiào fāng biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I like the aisle; it's easier to get to the restroom.

entries.english: speechless; at a loss for words
entries.example: 我感動得說不出話。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ gǎn dòng de shuō bù chū huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: I was so moved I couldn't speak.
entries.question: 什麼事讓你驚訝得說不出話？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shì ràng nǐ jīng yà de shuō bù chū huà?
entries.questionEnglish: What has ever left you speechless with surprise?
entries.answer: 第一次看到太魯閣，我驚訝得說不出話。
entries.answerPinyin: dì yī cì kàn dào tài lǔ gé, wǒ jīng yà de shuō bù chū huà.
entries.answerEnglish: The first time I saw Taroko Gorge, I was speechless.

entries.example: 飛機開始下降了。
entries.examplePinyin: fēi jī kāi shǐ xià jiàng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The plane has started its descent.
entries.question: 最近你那裡的氣溫下降了嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zuì jìn nǐ nà lǐ de qì wēn xià jiàng le ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has the temperature dropped where you are lately?
entries.answer: 有，這幾天氣溫下降很多。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, zhè jǐ tiān qì wēn xià jiàng hěn duō.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, it's dropped a lot in the past few days.

entries.example: 水族館裡有一隻很大的鯊魚。
entries.examplePinyin: shuǐ zú guǎn lǐ yǒu yì zhī hěn dà de shā yú.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a huge shark in the aquarium.
entries.question: 你在海裡看過鯊魚嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài hǎi lǐ kàn guò shā yú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a shark in the sea?
entries.answer: 沒有，我只在水族館看過鯊魚。
entries.answerPinyin: méi yǒu, wǒ zhǐ zài shuǐ zú guǎn kàn guò shā yú.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I've only seen sharks in aquariums.

entries.example: 他是這支棒球隊的投手。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì zhè zhī bàng qiú duì de tóu shǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's the pitcher on this baseball team.
entries.question: 你知道哪位台灣的投手？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào nǎ wèi tái wān de tóu shǒu?
entries.questionEnglish: Which Taiwanese pitcher do you know?
entries.answer: 我知道王建民，他是很有名的投手。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhī dào wáng jiàn mín, tā shì hěn yǒu míng de tóu shǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: I know Wang Chien-ming; he's a very famous pitcher.

entries.example: 這只是我很主觀的看法。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhǐ shì wǒ hěn zhǔ guān de kàn fǎ.
entries.exampleEnglish: This is just my very subjective opinion.
entries.question: 你覺得美食評價很主觀嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de měi shí píng jià hěn zhǔ guān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think food reviews are subjective?
entries.answer: 對，好不好吃真的很主觀。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, hǎo bu hǎo chī zhēn de hěn zhǔ guān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, whether food tastes good is really subjective.

entries.example: 這個概念有點難懂。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge gài niàn yǒu diǎn nán dǒng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This concept is a bit hard to understand.
entries.question: 學中文時，哪個概念最難？
entries.questionPinyin: xué zhōng wén shí, nǎ gè gài niàn zuì nán?
entries.questionEnglish: When learning Chinese, which concept is the hardest?
entries.answer: 我覺得「了」這個概念最難。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de “le” zhè ge gài niàn zuì nán.
entries.answerEnglish: I think the concept of "le" is the hardest.

entries.example: 我不小心把杯子摔碎了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bù xiǎo xīn bǎ bēi zi shuāi suì le.
entries.exampleEnglish: I accidentally dropped the cup and smashed it.
entries.question: 你摔碎過什麼東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shuāi suì guò shén me dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever smashed anything by dropping it?
entries.answer: 我摔碎過一個很貴的盤子。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ shuāi suì guò yí gè hěn guì de pán zi.
entries.answerEnglish: I once broke a very expensive plate.

entries.example: 這個醬汁配沙拉很好吃。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge jiàng zhī pèi shā lā hěn hǎo chī.
entries.exampleEnglish: This dressing goes really well with salad.
entries.question: 你吃沙拉喜歡加什麼醬汁？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chī shā lā xǐ huan jiā shén me jiàng zhī?
entries.questionEnglish: What dressing do you like on your salad?
entries.answer: 我喜歡加和風醬汁。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan jiā hé fēng jiàng zhī.
entries.answerEnglish: I like Japanese-style dressing.

entries.example: 我在台北居住了三年。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài tái běi jū zhù le sān nián.
entries.exampleEnglish: I've lived in Taipei for three years.
entries.question: 你在台灣居住多久了？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān jū zhù duō jiǔ le?
entries.questionEnglish: How long have you lived in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我在台灣居住兩年了。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài tái wān jū zhù liǎng nián le.
entries.answerEnglish: I've lived in Taiwan for two years.

entries.example: 這間房子的租期是一年。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiān fáng zi de zū qí shì yì nián.
entries.exampleEnglish: The lease on this place is one year.
entries.question: 你租的房子租期多長？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zū de fáng zi zū qí duō cháng?
entries.questionEnglish: How long is the lease on the place you rent?
entries.answer: 我的租期是兩年。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de zū qí shì liǎng nián.
entries.answerEnglish: My lease is two years.

entries.example: 路燈照亮了整條街。
entries.examplePinyin: lù dēng zhào liàng le zhěng tiáo jiē.
entries.exampleEnglish: The streetlights lit up the whole street.
entries.question: 你喜歡用什麼燈照亮房間？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan yòng shén me dēng zhào liàng fáng jiān?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of light do you like to light your room?
entries.answer: 我喜歡用黃色的燈照亮房間。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan yòng huáng sè de dēng zhào liàng fáng jiān.
entries.answerEnglish: I like to light my room with warm yellow lights.

entries.example: 我媽媽很喜歡百合花。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ mā ma hěn xǐ huan bǎi hé huā.
entries.exampleEnglish: My mom really likes lilies.
entries.question: 你喜歡百合嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan bǎi hé ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like lilies?
entries.answer: 喜歡，百合很香。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, bǎi hé hěn xiāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, lilies smell lovely.

entries.example: 冬天的衣物很難乾。
entries.examplePinyin: dōng tiān de yī wù hěn nán gān.
entries.exampleEnglish: Winter clothes take a long time to dry.
entries.question: 你的衣物都怎麼弄乾？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de yī wù dōu zěn me nòng gān?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you dry your clothes?
entries.answer: 我的衣物都用烘衣機烘乾。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de yī wù dōu yòng hōng yī jī hōng gān.
entries.answerEnglish: I dry all my clothes in the dryer.

entries.example: 我聽到樓上有腳步聲。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ tīng dào lóu shàng yǒu jiǎo bù shēng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I hear footsteps upstairs.
entries.question: 你會聽到鄰居的腳步聲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì tīng dào lín jū de jiǎo bù shēng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you hear your neighbours' footsteps?
entries.answer: 會，晚上常聽到樓上的腳步聲。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǎn shàng cháng tīng dào lóu shàng de jiǎo bù shēng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often hear footsteps upstairs at night.

entries.example: 我們週末去清境的牧場玩。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zhōu mò qù qīng jìng de mù chǎng wán.
entries.exampleEnglish: We went to a ranch in Cingjing at the weekend.
entries.question: 你去過台灣的牧場嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò tái wān de mù chǎng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to a ranch in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 去過，我去過宜蘭的牧場。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, wǒ qù guò yí lán de mù chǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've been to a ranch in Yilan.

entries.example: 圖書館員幫我找到那本書。
entries.examplePinyin: tú shū guǎn yuán bāng wǒ zhǎo dào nà běn shū.
entries.exampleEnglish: The librarian helped me find that book.
entries.question: 你想當圖書館員嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng dāng tú shū guǎn yuán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to be a librarian?
entries.answer: 不想，圖書館員的工作太安靜了。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xiǎng, tú shū guǎn yuán de gōng zuò tài ān jìng le.
entries.answerEnglish: No, a librarian's job is too quiet for me.

entries.english: a large amount; in large quantities; abundance
entries.example: 颱風帶來了大量雨水。
entries.examplePinyin: tái fēng dài lái le dà liàng yǔ shuǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The typhoon brought a huge amount of rain.
entries.question: 你會一次買大量的東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì yí cì mǎi dà liàng de dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you buy things in large quantities?
entries.answer: 會，我常在好市多買大量衛生紙。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng zài hǎo shì duō mǎi dà liàng wèi shēng zhǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often buy toilet paper in bulk at Costco.

entries.examplePinyin: xiǎo gǒu tiǎn le wǒ de shǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: The puppy licked my hand.
entries.question: 你吃冰淇淋喜歡用舔的還是咬的？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chī bīng qí lín xǐ huan yòng tiǎn de hái shì yǎo de?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer to lick or bite ice cream?
entries.answer: 我喜歡用舔的，慢慢吃。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan yòng tiǎn de, màn màn chī.
entries.answerEnglish: I like to lick it and eat it slowly.

entries.example: 我的住處離捷運站很近。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de zhù chù lí jié yùn zhàn hěn jìn.
entries.exampleEnglish: My place is very close to the MRT station.
entries.question: 你的住處離公司遠嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de zhù chù lí gōng sī yuǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your place far from your office?
entries.answer: 不遠，我的住處走路十分鐘就到。
entries.answerPinyin: bù yuǎn, wǒ de zhù chù zǒu lù shí fēn zhōng jiù dào.
entries.answerEnglish: No, it's a ten-minute walk from my place.

entries.example: 這家餐廳結合了台菜和法國菜。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā cān tīng jié hé le tái cài hé fǎ guó cài.
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant combines Taiwanese and French cooking.
entries.question: 你喜歡結合不同文化的料理嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan jié hé bù tóng wén huà de liào lǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like food that combines different cultures?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我覺得結合東西方的菜很有趣。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ jué de jié hé dōng xī fāng de cài hěn yǒu qù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I find dishes that combine East and West interesting.

entries.example: 政府全面禁止塑膠吸管。
entries.examplePinyin: zhèng fǔ quán miàn jìn zhǐ sù jiāo xī guǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The government has banned plastic straws across the board.
entries.question: 你覺得應該全面禁止塑膠袋嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de yīng gāi quán miàn jìn zhǐ sù jiāo dài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think plastic bags should be banned completely?
entries.answer: 應該，我覺得要全面禁止塑膠袋。
entries.answerPinyin: yīng gāi, wǒ jué de yào quán miàn jìn zhǐ sù jiāo dài.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I think plastic bags should be banned completely.

entries.example: 他是我工作上的導師。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì wǒ gōng zuò shàng de dǎo shī.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's my mentor at work.
entries.question: 你工作上有導師嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gōng zuò shàng yǒu dǎo shī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a mentor at work?
entries.answer: 有，我的主管就像我的導師。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de zhǔ guǎn jiù xiàng wǒ de dǎo shī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my manager is like a mentor to me.

entries.example: 我想好好布置我的新家。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xiǎng hǎo hǎo bù zhì wǒ de xīn jiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: I want to furnish my new home nicely.
entries.question: 你喜歡怎麼布置房間？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zěn me bù zhì fáng jiān?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you like to decorate your room?
entries.answer: 我喜歡用植物布置房間。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan yòng zhí wù bù zhì fáng jiān.
entries.answerEnglish: I like to decorate my room with plants.

entries.example: 我想去北極看極光。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xiǎng qù běi jí kàn jí guāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I want to go to the Arctic to see the northern lights.
entries.question: 你想去北極旅行嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng qù běi jí lǚ xíng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to travel to the Arctic?
entries.answer: 想，我想去北極看北極熊。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, wǒ xiǎng qù běi jí kàn běi jí xióng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to go to the Arctic to see polar bears.

entries.example: 辦公室用玻璃做隔間。
entries.examplePinyin: bàn gōng shì yòng bō lí zuò gé jiān.
entries.exampleEnglish: The office uses glass partitions.
entries.question: 你的辦公室有隔間嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de bàn gōng shì yǒu gé jiān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your office have cubicles?
entries.answer: 有，每個人都有自己的隔間。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, měi gè rén dōu yǒu zì jǐ de gé jiān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, everyone has their own cubicle.

entries.example: 你可以隨意選一個位子。
entries.examplePinyin: nǐ kě yǐ suí yì xuǎn yí gè wèi zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: You can pick any seat you like.
entries.question: 週末你喜歡隨意走走嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zhōu mò nǐ xǐ huan suí yì zǒu zǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like to wander around at the weekend?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常在台北隨意逛逛。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ cháng zài tái běi suí yì guàng guàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often wander around Taipei.

entries.example: 請幫我問候你的家人。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng bāng wǒ wèn hòu nǐ de jiā rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please give my regards to your family.
entries.question: 你跟鄰居見面會問候嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gēn lín jū jiàn miàn huì wèn hòu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you greet your neighbours when you see them?
entries.answer: 會，我會跟鄰居點頭問候。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì gēn lín jū diǎn tóu wèn hòu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I nod and say hello to my neighbours.

entries.example: 我想單獨跟你談一談。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xiǎng dān dú gēn nǐ tán yi tán.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'd like to talk to you alone.
entries.question: 你喜歡單獨旅行嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan dān dú lǚ xíng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like travelling on your own?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常常單獨去旅行。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ cháng cháng dān dú qù lǚ xíng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often travel on my own.

entries.example: 這張床墊太軟了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhāng chuáng diàn tài ruǎn le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This mattress is too soft.
entries.question: 你喜歡軟的還是硬的床墊？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan ruǎn de hái shì yìng de chuáng diàn?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer a soft or a firm mattress?
entries.answer: 我喜歡硬一點的床墊。

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de diàn nǎo zhuō miàn yǒu hěn duō zī liào jiá ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there lots of folders on your computer desktop?
entries.answer: 有，我的桌面有很多資料夾。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de zhuō miàn yǒu hěn duō zī liào jiá.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my desktop has lots of folders.

entries.example: 我們在澎湖吃了新鮮的龍蝦。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zài péng hú chī le xīn xiān de lóng xiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: We ate fresh lobster in Penghu.
entries.question: 你吃過龍蝦嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chī guò lóng xiā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever eaten lobster?
entries.answer: 吃過，我生日時吃過一次龍蝦。
entries.answerPinyin: chī guò, wǒ shēng rì shí chī guò yí cì lóng xiā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I had lobster once on my birthday.

entries.example: 我把檔案複製到隨身碟裡。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bǎ dǎng àn fù zhì dào suí shēn dié lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: I copied the file onto a flash drive.
entries.question: 你工作時常常複製貼上嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gōng zuò shí cháng cháng fù zhì tiē shàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you copy and paste a lot at work?
entries.answer: 常常，我每天都要複製貼上很多資料。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ měi tiān dōu yào fù zhì tiē shàng hěn duō zī liào.
entries.answerEnglish: All the time; I copy and paste lots of data every day.

entries.example: 新家的客廳很寬敞。
entries.examplePinyin: xīn jiā de kè tīng hěn kuān chǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The living room in the new place is very spacious.
entries.question: 你的房間寬敞嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de fáng jiān kuān chǎng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your room spacious?
entries.answer: 我的房間不太寬敞，可是很舒服。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de fáng jiān bú tài kuān chǎng, kě shì hěn shū fú.
entries.answerEnglish: My room isn't very spacious, but it's comfortable.

entries.example: 小孩在公園玩得髒兮兮的。
entries.examplePinyin: xiǎo hái zài gōng yuán wán de zāng xī xī de.
entries.exampleEnglish: The kids got filthy playing in the park.
entries.question: 你最近什麼時候弄得髒兮兮的？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn shén me shí hòu nòng de zāng xī xī de?
entries.questionEnglish: When did you last get really dirty?
entries.answer: 上週爬山遇到下雨，我全身髒兮兮的。
entries.answerPinyin: shàng zhōu pá shān yù dào xià yǔ, wǒ quán shēn zāng xī xī de.
entries.answerEnglish: Last week it rained while I was hiking and I got filthy.

entries.example: 我在便利商店買了一支刮鬍刀。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài biàn lì shāng diàn mǎi le yì zhī guā hú dāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a razor at the convenience store.
entries.question: 你用電動刮鬍刀嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yòng diàn dòng guā hú dāo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use an electric razor?
entries.answer: 不用，我用一般的刮鬍刀。
entries.answerPinyin: bú yòng, wǒ yòng yì bān de guā hú dāo.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I use a regular razor.

entries.example: 捷運通車後，上班時間縮短了。
entries.examplePinyin: jié yùn tōng chē hòu, shàng bān shí jiān suō duǎn le.
entries.exampleEnglish: Since the MRT line opened, my commute has gotten shorter.
entries.question: 你想縮短通勤時間嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng suō duǎn tōng qín shí jiān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you want to shorten your commute?
entries.answer: 想，我想搬到公司附近，縮短通勤時間。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, wǒ xiǎng bān dào gōng sī fù jìn, suō duǎn tōng qín shí jiān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I want to move near work to cut my commute.

entries.example: 這位太空人在太空待了半年。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè wèi tài kōng rén zài tài kōng dài le bàn nián.
entries.exampleEnglish: This astronaut spent half a year in space.
entries.question: 你小時候想當太空人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu xiǎng dāng tài kōng rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you want to be an astronaut as a kid?
entries.answer: 想，我小時候很想當太空人。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, wǒ xiǎo shí hòu hěn xiǎng dāng tài kōng rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I really wanted to be an astronaut as a kid.

entries.example: 我們這個月達成業績目標了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zhè ge yuè dá chéng yè jī mù biāo le.
entries.exampleEnglish: We hit our sales target this month.
entries.question: 你今年達成了什麼目標？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jīn nián dá chéng le shén me mù biāo?
entries.questionEnglish: What goals have you achieved this year?
entries.answer: 我今年達成了存錢的目標。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jīn nián dá chéng le cún qián de mù biāo.
entries.answerEnglish: This year I reached my savings goal.

entries.example: 我女兒是我做菜的好幫手。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ nǚ ér shì wǒ zuò cài de hǎo bāng shǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: My daughter is a great helper in the kitchen.
entries.question: 你做家事時有幫手嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò jiā shì shí yǒu bāng shǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a helper with housework?
entries.answer: 有，掃地機器人是我的好幫手。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, sǎo dì jī qì rén shì wǒ de hǎo bāng shǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my robot vacuum is a great helper.

entries.example: 他們去峇里島度蜜月。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men qù bā lǐ dǎo dù mì yuè.
entries.exampleEnglish: They went to Bali for their honeymoon.
entries.question: 你想去哪裡度蜜月？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ lǐ dù mì yuè?
entries.questionEnglish: Where would you like to go for a honeymoon?
entries.answer: 我想去北海道度蜜月。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng qù běi hǎi dào dù mì yuè.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to go to Hokkaido for my honeymoon.

entries.example: 公園的樹上有一隻松鼠。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng yuán de shù shàng yǒu yì zhī sōng shǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a squirrel in the tree in the park.
entries.question: 你在台灣看過松鼠嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān kàn guò sōng shǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen squirrels in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 看過，我在大安森林公園看過松鼠。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài dà ān sēn lín gōng yuán kàn guò sōng shǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've seen squirrels in Daan Forest Park.

entries.example: 煮飯的時候我會穿圍裙。
entries.examplePinyin: zhǔ fàn de shí hòu wǒ huì chuān wéi qún.
entries.exampleEnglish: I wear an apron when I cook.
entries.question: 你做菜時會穿圍裙嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò cài shí huì chuān wéi qún ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you wear an apron when you cook?
entries.answer: 會，穿圍裙衣服才不會弄髒。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, chuān wéi qún yī fu cái bú huì nòng zāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, wearing an apron keeps my clothes clean.

entries.example: 十分瀑布非常壯觀。
entries.examplePinyin: shí fēn pù bù fēi cháng zhuàng guān.
entries.exampleEnglish: Shifen Waterfall is spectacular.
entries.question: 你去過台灣的哪個瀑布？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò tái wān de nǎ gè pù bù?
entries.questionEnglish: Which waterfall in Taiwan have you been to?
entries.answer: 我去過十分瀑布，很漂亮。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qù guò shí fēn pù bù, hěn piào liang.
entries.answerEnglish: I've been to Shifen Waterfall; it's beautiful.

entries.example: 我吃太多糖，有一顆蛀牙。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ chī tài duō táng, yǒu yì kē zhù yá.
entries.exampleEnglish: I ate too much sugar and got a cavity.
entries.question: 你怎麼預防蛀牙？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zěn me yù fáng zhù yá?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you prevent cavities?
entries.answer: 我每天刷兩次牙，預防蛀牙。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ měi tiān shuā liǎng cì yá, yù fáng zhù yá.
entries.answerEnglish: I brush twice a day to prevent cavities.

entries.examplePinyin: chéng shì hé xiāng xià de shōu rù yǒu chā jù.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's an income gap between cities and the countryside.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的貧富差距大嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān de pín fù chā jù dà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think the wealth gap in Taiwan is big?
entries.answer: 我覺得台灣的貧富差距越來越大。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de tái wān de pín fù chā jù yuè lái yuè dà.
entries.answerEnglish: I think Taiwan's wealth gap is getting bigger.

entries.example: 不好意思，今晚已經沒有空房了。
entries.examplePinyin: bù hǎo yì si, jīn wǎn yǐ jīng méi yǒu kòng fáng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: Sorry, there are no vacancies tonight.
entries.question: 你訂飯店時遇過沒有空房的情況嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dìng fàn diàn shí yù guò méi yǒu kòng fáng de qíng kuàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever found no vacancies when booking a hotel?
entries.answer: 遇過，連假的時候常常沒有空房。
entries.answerPinyin: yù guò, lián jià de shí hòu cháng cháng méi yǒu kōng fáng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are often no vacancies on long weekends.

entries.examplePinyin: dài shàng yǎn jìng, wǒ cái kàn qīng chǔ cài dān.
entries.exampleEnglish: I could only read the menu clearly once I put on my glasses.
entries.question: 不戴眼鏡，你看得清楚嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: bú dài yǎn jìng, nǐ kàn de qīng chǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you see clearly without your glasses?
entries.answer: 不行，我要戴眼鏡才看清楚。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xíng, wǒ yào dài yǎn jìng cái kàn qīng chǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I need my glasses to see clearly.

entries.question: 你覺得台灣哪裡的風景最優美？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān nǎ lǐ de fēng jǐng zuì yōu měi?

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan chī nǎ zhǒng jiān guǒ?

entries.answer: 我最喜歡吃烤過的杏仁。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan chī kǎo guò de xìng rén.
entries.answerEnglish: I like roasted almonds best.

entries.examplePinyin: lǎo bǎn míng què de shuō jīn nián bù jiā xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The boss said plainly there'd be no raises this year.

entries.questionPinyin: jù jué bié rén shí, nǐ huì shuō de hěn míng què ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you turn someone down, do you say so clearly?
entries.answer: 會，我會很明確地說「不要」。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì hěn míng què de shuō “bú yào”.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ cài de shí hòu huì chōng xǐ jǐ cì?

entries.answer: 我通常會沖洗三次。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ tōng cháng huì chōng xǐ sān cì.
entries.answerEnglish: I usually rinse them three times.

entries.examplePinyin: dōng tiān wǒ hěn xǐ huan chī rè rè de dùn cài.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zì jǐ zhǔ dùn cài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you make stew yourself?
entries.answer: 會，我常煮牛肉燉菜。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng zhǔ niú ròu dùn cài.

entries.examplePinyin: zhuō shàng dōu shì miàn bāo xiè, kuài cā yi cā.

entries.answer: 不會，我都把麵包屑丟掉。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ dōu bǎ miàn bāo xiè diū diào.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I always throw the crumbs away.

entries.example: 倉庫裡有很多裝水果的木箱。
entries.examplePinyin: cāng kù lǐ yǒu hěn duō zhuāng shuǐ guǒ de mù xiāng.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā lǐ yǒu mù xiāng ma?

entries.answer: 有，我用一個舊木箱放書。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ yòng yí gè jiù mù xiāng fàng shū.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I keep books in an old wooden crate.

entries.example: 很多人對新的停車規定很不滿。
entries.examplePinyin: hěn duō rén duì xīn de tíng chē guī dìng hěn bù mǎn.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì shēng huó zhōng de shén me shì hěn bù mǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: What in your life are you dissatisfied with?
entries.answer: 我對房租一直漲很不滿。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ duì fáng zū yì zhí zhǎng hěn bù mǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm unhappy that the rent keeps going up.

entries.example: 我早餐常吃幾顆核桃。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zǎo cān cháng chī jǐ kē hé táo.
entries.exampleEnglish: I often eat a few walnuts for breakfast.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃核桃嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī hé táo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like walnuts?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常把核桃加在優格裡。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ cháng bǎ hé táo jiā zài yōu gé lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often add walnuts to my yogurt.

entries.example: 我們及時趕上了最後一班捷運。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men jí shí gǎn shàng le zuì hòu yì bān jié yùn.
entries.exampleEnglish: We made it in time for the last MRT train.
entries.question: 你有沒有及時趕上過末班車？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu jí shí gǎn shàng guò mò bān chē?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever made it just in time for the last train?
entries.answer: 有，上次我及時趕上了末班捷運。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, shàng cì wǒ jí shí gǎn shàng le mò bān jié yùn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, last time I made it just in time for the last MRT.

entries.example: 我的台灣朋友說話時表情豐富。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de tái wān péng yǒu shuō huà shí biǎo qíng fēng fù.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shuō huà de shí hòu biǎo qíng fēng fù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you expressive when you talk?
entries.answer: 是啊，朋友都說我表情豐富。
entries.answerPinyin: shì a, péng yǒu dōu shuō wǒ biǎo qíng fēng fù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my friends all say I'm very expressive.

entries.english: to meet up; to join; to converge
entries.example: 我們六點在台北車站會合。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men liù diǎn zài tái běi chē zhàn huì hé.
entries.exampleEnglish: We'll meet up at Taipei Main Station at six.
entries.question: 你跟朋友出去玩，通常在哪裡會合？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gēn péng yǒu chū qù wán, tōng cháng zài nǎ lǐ huì hé?
entries.questionEnglish: When you go out with friends, where do you usually meet up?
entries.answer: 我們通常在捷運站出口會合。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men tōng cháng zài jié yùn zhàn chū kǒu huì hé.

entries.example: 以前台灣的農夫用水牛耕田。
entries.examplePinyin: yǐ qián tái wān de nóng fū yòng shuǐ niú gēng tián.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān kàn guò shuǐ niú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen a water buffalo in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 看過，我在台南的鄉下看過水牛。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài tái nán de xiāng xià kàn guò shuǐ niú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw water buffalo in the countryside in Tainan.

entries.examplePinyin: gǎn mào hǎo le, kě shì tā hái shì hěn xū ruò.
entries.exampleEnglish: His cold is better, but he's still very weak.
entries.question: 身體虛弱的時候，吃什麼比較好？
entries.questionPinyin: shēn tǐ xū ruò de shí hòu, chī shén me bǐ jiào hǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: What's good to eat when you're feeling weak?
entries.answer: 身體虛弱的時候可以喝雞湯。
entries.answerPinyin: shēn tǐ xū ruò de shí hòu kě yǐ hē jī tāng.

entries.example: 冬天路邊有人在賣糖炒栗子。
entries.examplePinyin: dōng tiān lù biān yǒu rén zài mài táng chǎo lì zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: In winter people sell roasted chestnuts by the roadside.
entries.question: 你吃過糖炒栗子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chī guò táng chǎo lì zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you had roasted chestnuts?
entries.answer: 吃過，冬天的栗子又香又甜。

entries.examplePinyin: zhòng yào de zì wǒ dōu huì huà dǐ xiàn.

entries.question: 你看書的時候會畫底線嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn shū de shí hòu huì huà dǐ xiàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you underline things when you read?
entries.answer: 會，我常在重點下面畫底線。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng zài zhòng diǎn xià miàn huà dǐ xiàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often underline the key points.

entries.example: 在好市多買東西一定要推手推車。
entries.examplePinyin: zài hǎo shì duō mǎi dōng xī yí dìng yào tuī shǒu tuī chē.
entries.exampleEnglish: When you shop at Costco you definitely need a trolley.
entries.question: 你去超市會用手推車嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù chāo shì huì yòng shǒu tuī chē ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use a trolley at the supermarket?
entries.answer: 會，買很多東西時我會用手推車。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, mǎi hěn duō dōng xī shí wǒ huì yòng shǒu tuī chē.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when I buy a lot I use a trolley.

entries.example: 台北車站的地下街像迷宮一樣。
entries.examplePinyin: tái běi chē zhàn de dì xià jiē xiàng mí gōng yí yàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The underground mall at Taipei Main Station is like a maze.
entries.question: 你在台北車站會迷路嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái běi chē zhàn huì mí lù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you get lost at Taipei Main Station?
entries.answer: 會，台北車站就像一個大迷宮。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, tái běi chē zhàn jiù xiàng yí gè dà mí gōng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, Taipei Main Station is like a giant maze.

entries.example: 去那家餐廳最好事先訂位。
entries.examplePinyin: qù nà jiā cān tīng zuì hǎo shì xiān dìng wèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's best to book in advance for that restaurant.
entries.question: 你去餐廳吃飯會事先訂位嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù cān tīng chī fàn huì shì xiān dìng wèi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you book in advance when you eat out?
entries.answer: 週末的時候我都會事先訂位。
entries.answerPinyin: zhōu mò de shí hòu wǒ dōu huì shì xiān dìng wèi.
entries.answerEnglish: On weekends I always book in advance.

entries.example: 上班一直遲到很不負責任。
entries.examplePinyin: shàng bān yì zhí chí dào hěn bú fù zé rèn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Always being late for work is very irresponsible.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼行為很不負責任？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me xíng wéi hěn bú fù zé rèn?
entries.questionEnglish: What behaviour do you think is very irresponsible?
entries.answer: 我覺得亂丟垃圾很不負責任。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de luàn diū lè sè hěn bú fù zé rèn.
entries.answerEnglish: I think littering is very irresponsible.

entries.english: to give off smoke; to smoke
entries.example: 那台機車的引擎在冒煙。
entries.examplePinyin: nà tái jī chē de yǐn qíng zài mào yān.
entries.exampleEnglish: That scooter's engine is smoking.
entries.question: 你煮飯時鍋子冒煙過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhǔ fàn shí guō zi mào yān guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has your pan ever started smoking while you were cooking?
entries.answer: 有，我煎牛排時鍋子冒煙了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiān niú pái shí guō zi mào yān le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my pan smoked when I was frying steak.

entries.example: 下雨了，烤肉活動延期一週。
entries.examplePinyin: xià yǔ le, kǎo ròu huó dòng yán qí yì zhōu.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's raining, so the barbecue has been postponed a week.
entries.question: 你的旅行曾經延期過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de lǚ xíng céng jīng yán qí guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has a trip of yours ever been postponed?
entries.answer: 有，因為颱風我的旅行延期了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, yīn wèi tái fēng wǒ de lǚ xíng yán qí le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my trip was postponed because of a typhoon.

entries.example: 人類在一九六九年第一次登上月球。
entries.examplePinyin: rén lèi zài yī jiǔ liù jiǔ nián dì yī cì dēng shàng yuè qiú.
entries.exampleEnglish: Humans first landed on the moon in 1969.
entries.question: 你想去月球旅行嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng qù yuè qiú lǚ xíng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to travel to the moon?
entries.answer: 想，我想在月球上看地球。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, wǒ xiǎng zài yuè qiú shàng kàn dì qiú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to look at the Earth from the moon.

entries.example: 我爸爸每天提公事包上班。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bà ba měi tiān tí gōng shì bāo shàng bān.
entries.exampleEnglish: My dad carries a briefcase to work every day.
entries.question: 你上班會帶公事包嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shàng bān huì dài gōng shì bāo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you take a briefcase to work?
entries.answer: 不會，我不帶公事包，都背後背包。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ bú dài gōng shì bāo, dōu bēi hòu bēi bāo.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't take a briefcase; I use a backpack.

entries.example: 我都用海綿洗碗。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ dōu yòng hǎi mián xǐ wǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I always wash the dishes with a sponge.
entries.question: 你洗碗用海綿還是菜瓜布？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ wǎn yòng hǎi mián hái shì cài guā bù?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you wash dishes with a sponge or a scrubber?
entries.answer: 我用海綿，比較不會刮傷碗。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yòng hǎi mián, bǐ jiào bú huì guā shāng wǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: I use a sponge; it's less likely to scratch the dishes.

entries.example: 這個門把壞了，門打不開。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge mén bǎ huài le, mén dǎ bù kāi.
entries.exampleEnglish: This doorknob is broken, so the door won't open.
entries.question: 你家的門把是圓的還是長的？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de mén bǎ shì yuán de hái shì cháng de?
entries.questionEnglish: Are the door handles in your home round or long?
entries.answer: 我家的門把是長的。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā de mén bǎ shì cháng de.
entries.answerEnglish: The door handles in my home are long ones.

entries.example: 這個天氣預報常常不準確。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge tiān qì yù bào cháng cháng bù zhǔn què.
entries.exampleEnglish: This weather forecast is often inaccurate.
entries.question: 你覺得手機的天氣預報準嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shǒu jī de tiān qì yù bào zhǔn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your phone's weather forecast is accurate?
entries.answer: 有時候很不準確。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu hěn bù zhǔn què.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes it's very inaccurate.

entries.example: 他拿鏟子在院子裡挖洞。
entries.examplePinyin: tā ná chǎn zi zài yuàn zi lǐ wā dòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's digging a hole in the yard with a shovel.
entries.question: 你種花的時候會用鏟子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhòng huā de shí hòu huì yòng chǎn zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use a shovel when you plant flowers?
entries.answer: 會，我用一把小鏟子種花。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ yòng yì bǎ xiǎo chǎn zi zhòng huā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I use a small trowel to plant flowers.

entries.example: 公園的湖裡有兩隻天鵝。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng yuán de hú lǐ yǒu liǎng zhī tiān é.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are two swans on the lake in the park.
entries.question: 你看過黑色的天鵝嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò hēi sè de tiān é ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a black swan?
entries.answer: 看過，我在澳洲看過黑天鵝。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài ào zhōu kàn guò hēi tiān é.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've seen black swans in Australia.

entries.example: 我阿公還留著一台舊打字機。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ ā gōng hái liú zhe yì tái jiù dǎ zì jī.
entries.exampleEnglish: My grandpa still has an old typewriter.
entries.question: 你用過打字機嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yòng guò dǎ zì jī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever used a typewriter?
entries.answer: 用過，我小時候在家用過打字機。
entries.answerPinyin: yòng guò, wǒ xiǎo shí hòu zài jiā yòng guò dǎ zì jī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I used a typewriter at home when I was little.

entries.example: 新郎今天穿得很帥。
entries.examplePinyin: xīn láng jīn tiān chuān de hěn shuài.
entries.exampleEnglish: The groom looks very handsome today.
entries.question: 你覺得新郎應該穿什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de xīn láng yīng gāi chuān shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think a groom should wear?
entries.answer: 我覺得新郎應該穿黑色西裝。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de xīn láng yīng gāi chuān hēi sè xī zhuāng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think the groom should wear a black suit.

entries.example: 我想點蠟燭，可是找不到打火機。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xiǎng diǎn là zhú, kě shì zhǎo bú dào dǎ huǒ jī.
entries.exampleEnglish: I want to light a candle, but I can't find a lighter.
entries.question: 你身上會帶打火機嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēn shàng huì dài dǎ huǒ jī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you carry a lighter?
entries.answer: 不會，我不抽菸，所以不帶打火機。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ bù chōu yān, suǒ yǐ bú dài dǎ huǒ jī.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't smoke, so I don't carry a lighter.

entries.example: 我奶奶只會說家鄉的方言。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ nǎi nai zhǐ huì shuō jiā xiāng de fāng yán.
entries.exampleEnglish: My grandma only speaks her hometown dialect.
entries.question: 你的國家有很多方言嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā yǒu hěn duō fāng yán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there many dialects in your country?
entries.answer: 有，我們國家有很多種方言。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men guó jiā yǒu hěn duō zhǒng fāng yán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my country has many dialects.

entries.example: 這家飯店的房間好豪華！
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā fàn diàn de fáng jiān hǎo háo huá!
entries.exampleEnglish: The rooms in this hotel are so luxurious!
entries.question: 你住過豪華的飯店嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhù guò háo huá de fàn diàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you stayed in a luxurious hotel?
entries.answer: 住過，我在杜拜住過豪華飯店。
entries.answerPinyin: zhù guò, wǒ zài dù bài zhù guò háo huá fàn diàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I stayed in a luxury hotel in Dubai.

entries.english: a puff of; a whiff of; a surge of
entries.example: 廚房傳來一股好香的味道。
entries.examplePinyin: chú fáng chuán lái yì gǔ hǎo xiāng de wèi dào.
entries.exampleEnglish: A lovely smell is coming from the kitchen.
entries.question: 你走進夜市會聞到一股什麼味道？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zǒu jìn yè shì huì wén dào yì gǔ shén me wèi dào?
entries.questionEnglish: What smell hits you when you walk into a night market?
entries.answer: 我會聞到一股臭豆腐的味道。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì wén dào yì gǔ chòu dòu fu de wèi dào.
entries.answerEnglish: I catch a whiff of stinky tofu.

entries.example: 這棟老房子的正面很漂亮。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè dòng lǎo fáng zi de zhèng miàn hěn piào liang.
entries.exampleEnglish: The front of this old house is very pretty.
entries.question: 拍照時，你喜歡拍正面還是側面？
entries.questionPinyin: pāi zhào shí, nǐ xǐ huan pāi zhèng miàn hái shì cè miàn?
entries.questionEnglish: When having your photo taken, do you prefer front-on or profile?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡拍正面。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan pāi zhèng miàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer front-on photos.

entries.example: 這首歌的節奏很快。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shǒu gē de jié zòu hěn kuài.
entries.exampleEnglish: This song has a fast rhythm.
entries.question: 你喜歡節奏快的音樂嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan jié zòu kuài de yīn yuè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like music with a fast rhythm?
entries.answer: 喜歡，節奏快的音樂讓我有精神。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, jié zòu kuài de yīn yuè ràng wǒ yǒu jīng shén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, fast-paced music gives me energy.

entries.example: 服務生給了每個人一條餐巾。
entries.examplePinyin: fú wù shēng gěi le měi gè rén yì tiáo cān jīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The waiter gave everyone a napkin.
entries.question: 你在家吃飯會用餐巾嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài jiā chī fàn huì yòng cān jīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use napkins when you eat at home?
entries.answer: 會，我都用餐巾紙擦嘴。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōu yòng cān jīn zhǐ cā zuǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always wipe my mouth with a paper napkin.

entries.example: 冬天我常常喝熱薑茶。
entries.examplePinyin: dōng tiān wǒ cháng cháng hē rè jiāng chá.
entries.exampleEnglish: In winter I often drink hot ginger tea.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃有薑的菜嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī yǒu jiāng de cài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like dishes with ginger in them?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我覺得薑可以讓身體變暖。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ jué de jiāng kě yǐ ràng shēn tǐ biàn nuǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I think ginger warms you up.

entries.example: 他很厚臉皮，常常跟我借錢。
entries.examplePinyin: tā hěn hòu liǎn pí, cháng cháng gēn wǒ jiè qián.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's shameless; he's always borrowing money from me.
entries.question: 你覺得插隊的人厚臉皮嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de chā duì de rén hòu liǎn pí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think people who cut in line are shameless?
entries.answer: 對，插隊的人真的很厚臉皮。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, chā duì de rén zhēn de hěn hòu liǎn pí.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, people who cut in line are really shameless.

entries.example: 我們中文課明天有小考。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zhōng wén kè míng tiān yǒu xiǎo kǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Our Chinese class has a quiz tomorrow.
entries.question: 你的中文課常常有小考嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de zhōng wén kè cháng cháng yǒu xiǎo kǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your Chinese class often have quizzes?
entries.answer: 有，我們每個禮拜都有小考。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men měi gè lǐ bài dōu yǒu xiǎo kǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we have a quiz every week.

entries.english: to remove; to take off; to detach
entries.example: 請先把電池拆下來。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng xiān bǎ diàn chí chāi xià lái.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please take the battery out first.
entries.question: 你會自己拆下冷氣的濾網嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zì jǐ chāi xià lěng qì de lǜ wǎng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you remove the air conditioner filter yourself?
entries.answer: 會，我每個月拆下來洗一次。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi gè yuè chāi xià lái xǐ yí cì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I take it off and wash it once a month.

entries.example: 這部電影的主角是一隻狗。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng de zhǔ jué shì yì zhī gǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: The main character of this film is a dog.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪部電影的主角？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ bù diàn yǐng de zhǔ jué?
entries.questionEnglish: Which film's main character do you like most?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡《哈利波特》的主角。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan 《 hā lì bō tè 》 de zhǔ jué.
entries.answerEnglish: I like the main character of Harry Potter most.

entries.example: 愛迪生是很有名的發明家。
entries.examplePinyin: ài dí shēng shì hěn yǒu míng de fā míng jiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: Edison is a very famous inventor.
entries.question: 你最佩服哪一位發明家？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì pèi fú nǎ yí wèi fā míng jiā?
entries.questionEnglish: Which inventor do you admire most?
entries.answer: 我最佩服愛迪生這位發明家。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì pèi fú ài dí shēng zhè wèi fā míng jiā.
entries.answerEnglish: The inventor I admire most is Edison.

entries.example: 我們住在山上的一個小村莊。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zhù zài shān shàng de yí gè xiǎo cūn zhuāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: We live in a small village in the mountains.
entries.question: 你喜歡住在小村莊嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zhù zài xiǎo cūn zhuāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to live in a small village?
entries.answer: 喜歡，小村莊很安靜。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, xiǎo cūn zhuāng hěn ān jìng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, small villages are very quiet.

entries.example: 這家麵包店的餐包又軟又香。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā miàn bāo diàn de cān bāo yòu ruǎn yòu xiāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This bakery's buns are soft and fragrant.
entries.question: 你早餐會吃餐包嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zǎo cān huì chī cān bāo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you eat bread rolls for breakfast?
entries.answer: 會，我常吃兩個奶油餐包。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng chī liǎng gè nǎi yóu cān bāo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often have two butter rolls.

entries.example: 寒冷的早上，我想喝熱豆漿。
entries.examplePinyin: hán lěng de zǎo shàng, wǒ xiǎng hē rè dòu jiāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: On cold mornings, I want hot soy milk.
entries.question: 你喜歡寒冷的天氣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan hán lěng de tiān qì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like cold weather?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，寒冷的天氣讓我不想出門。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xǐ huan, hán lěng de tiān qì ràng wǒ bù xiǎng chū mén.
entries.answerEnglish: No, cold weather makes me not want to go out.

entries.example: 我的朋友是一位鋼琴家。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de péng yǒu shì yí wèi gāng qín jiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: My friend is a pianist.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪一位鋼琴家？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ yí wèi gāng qín jiā?
entries.questionEnglish: Which pianist do you like most?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡的鋼琴家是蕭邦。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan de gāng qín jiā shì xiāo bāng.
entries.answerEnglish: My favourite pianist is Chopin.

entries.example: 我在捷運上無意中聽到別人吵架。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài jié yùn shàng wú yì zhōng tīng dào bié rén chǎo jià.
entries.exampleEnglish: On the MRT I overheard some people arguing.
entries.question: 你在捷運上無意中聽到過什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài jié yùn shàng wú yì zhōng tīng dào guò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What have you overheard on the MRT?
entries.answer: 我無意中聽到有人在講八卦。
