entries.answerPinyin: wǒ wú yì zhōng tīng dào yǒu rén zài jiǎng bā guà.
entries.answerEnglish: I overheard someone gossiping.

entries.example: 這個杯子是金屬做的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge bēi zi shì jīn shǔ zuò de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This cup is made of metal.
entries.question: 你喜歡金屬做的家具嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan jīn shǔ zuò de jiā jù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like metal furniture?
entries.answer: 不太喜歡，金屬家具摸起來很冰。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài xǐ huan, jīn shǔ jiā jù mō qǐ lái hěn bīng.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really; metal furniture feels cold to the touch.

entries.english: to avoid; to escape; to run away from
entries.example: 遇到問題不要逃避。
entries.examplePinyin: yù dào wèn tí bú yào táo bì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Don't run away from problems.
entries.question: 你會逃避做家事嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì táo bì zuò jiā shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you avoid doing housework?
entries.answer: 會，我常常逃避洗碗。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng cháng táo bì xǐ wǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often avoid washing the dishes.

entries.example: 小女孩在草地上開心地旋轉。
entries.examplePinyin: xiǎo nǚ hái zài cǎo dì shàng kāi xīn de xuán zhuǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The little girl spun happily on the grass.
entries.question: 你坐過遊樂園的旋轉咖啡杯嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò guò yóu lè yuán de xuán zhuǎn kā fēi bēi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ridden the spinning teacups at an amusement park?
entries.answer: 坐過，旋轉咖啡杯讓我好暈。
entries.answerPinyin: zuò guò, xuán zhuǎn kā fēi bēi ràng wǒ hǎo yūn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the spinning teacups made me really dizzy.

entries.example: 這支手錶的時間很精確。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhī shǒu biǎo de shí jiān hěn jīng què.
entries.exampleEnglish: This watch keeps very accurate time.
entries.question: 你覺得手機地圖精確嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shǒu jī dì tú jīng què ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think the maps on your phone are accurate?
entries.answer: 大部分很精確，但有時候會錯。
entries.answerPinyin: dà bù fèn hěn jīng què, dàn yǒu shí hòu huì cuò.
entries.answerEnglish: Mostly they're accurate, but sometimes they're wrong.

entries.example: 台北房租很貴，然而大家還是想住在這裡。
entries.examplePinyin: tái běi fáng zū hěn guì, rán ér dà jiā hái shì xiǎng zhù zài zhè lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Rent in Taipei is expensive, yet everyone still wants to live here.
entries.question: 台北生活方便，然而有什麼缺點？
entries.questionPinyin: tái běi shēng huó fāng biàn, rán ér yǒu shén me quē diǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: Life in Taipei is convenient, but what are its drawbacks?
entries.answer: 台北很方便，然而房租太貴了。
entries.answerPinyin: tái běi hěn fāng biàn, rán ér fáng zū tài guì le.
entries.answerEnglish: Taipei is convenient; however, rent is too high.

entries.example: 這條路的盡頭有一家咖啡店。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tiáo lù de jìn tóu yǒu yì jiā kā fēi diàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a café at the end of this road.
entries.question: 你家那條街的盡頭有什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā nà tiáo jiē de jìn tóu yǒu shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's at the end of your street?
entries.answer: 我家那條街的盡頭是一個公園。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā nà tiáo jiē de jìn tóu shì yí gè gōng yuán.
entries.answerEnglish: There's a park at the end of my street.

entries.example: 因為天氣惡劣，今天的船班都取消了。
entries.examplePinyin: yīn wèi tiān qì è liè, jīn tiān de chuán bān dōu qǔ xiāo le.
entries.exampleEnglish: Because of the bad weather, all of today's ferries were cancelled.
entries.question: 天氣惡劣的時候，你還會出門嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: tiān qì è liè de shí hòu, nǐ hái huì chū mén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you still go out when the weather is bad?
entries.answer: 天氣惡劣的時候，我都待在家裡。
entries.answerPinyin: tiān qì è liè de shí hòu, wǒ dōu dài zài jiā lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: When the weather is bad, I stay at home.

entries.example: 公司的新政策是每週可以在家工作一天。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng sī de xīn zhèng cè shì měi zhōu kě yǐ zài jiā gōng zuò yì tiān.
entries.exampleEnglish: The company's new policy is that we can work from home one day a week.
entries.question: 你覺得政府應該有什麼新政策？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zhèng fǔ yīng gāi yǒu shén me xīn zhèng cè?
entries.questionEnglish: What new policy do you think the government should have?
entries.answer: 我覺得應該有更好的租屋政策。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de yīng gāi yǒu gèng hǎo de zū wū zhèng cè.
entries.answerEnglish: I think there should be a better housing rental policy.

entries.example: 這次的結果比我預期的好。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì de jié guǒ bǐ wǒ yù qí de hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: The result was better than I expected.
entries.question: 台灣的生活和你預期的一樣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: tái wān de shēng huó hé nǐ yù qí de yí yàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is life in Taiwan what you expected?
entries.answer: 不太一樣，比我預期的方便很多。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài yí yàng, bǐ wǒ yù qí de fāng biàn hěn duō.
entries.answerEnglish: Not quite. It's much more convenient than I expected.

entries.example: 請在這裡稍等片刻。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng zài zhè lǐ shāo děng piàn kè.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please wait here a moment.
entries.question: 你工作累的時候會休息片刻嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gōng zuò lèi de shí hòu huì xiū xí piàn kè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you're tired at work, do you take a short break?
entries.answer: 會，我會下樓買杯咖啡，休息片刻。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì xià lóu mǎi bēi kā fēi, xiū xí piàn kè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I go downstairs, get a coffee and rest for a bit.

entries.example: 這位按摩師的力道剛剛好。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè wèi àn mó shī de lì dào gāng gāng hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This masseur's pressure is just right.
entries.question: 你按摩的時候喜歡力道大一點嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ àn mó de shí hòu xǐ huan lì dào dà yì diǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you get a massage, do you like firmer pressure?
entries.answer: 我喜歡力道大一點，比較舒服。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan lì dào dà yì diǎn, bǐ jiào shū fú.
entries.answerEnglish: I like it a bit firmer. It feels better.

entries.example: 架子太高了，我搆不到。
entries.examplePinyin: jià zi tài gāo le, wǒ gòu bú dào.
entries.exampleEnglish: The shelf is too high. I can't reach it.
entries.question: 你在家裡有搆不到的地方嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài jiā lǐ yǒu gòu bú dào de dì fāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there places at home you can't reach?
entries.answer: 有，冰箱上面我搆不到。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, bīng xiāng shàng miàn wǒ gòu bú dào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I can't reach the top of the fridge.

entries.example: 她在公司的職位很高。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài gōng sī de zhí wèi hěn gāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: She holds a senior position in the company.
entries.question: 你在公司是什麼職位？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài gōng sī shì shén me zhí wèi?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your position at your company?
entries.answer: 我的職位是業務經理。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de zhí wèi shì yè wù jīng lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm a sales manager.

entries.example: 這份報告有很多專業術語。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè fèn bào gào yǒu hěn duō zhuān yè shù yǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: This report has a lot of technical terms.
entries.question: 你工作的時候會用到很多術語嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gōng zuò de shí hòu huì yòng dào hěn duō shù yǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use a lot of technical terms at work?
entries.answer: 會，我的工作有很多電腦術語。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ de gōng zuò yǒu hěn duō diàn nǎo shù yǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my job involves lots of computer terms.

entries.example: 我的手機可用空間不多了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de shǒu jī kě yòng kōng jiān bù duō le.
entries.exampleEnglish: My phone is running out of free storage.
entries.question: 你的手機還有很多可用空間嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de shǒu jī hái yǒu hěn duō kě yòng kōng jiān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your phone still have lots of free storage?
entries.answer: 不多了，可用空間只剩一點點。
entries.answerPinyin: bù duō le, kě yòng kōng jiān zhǐ shèng yì diǎn diǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Not much. There's only a little free space left.

entries.example: 半導體是台灣很重要的產業。
entries.examplePinyin: bàn dǎo tǐ shì tái wān hěn zhòng yào de chǎn yè.
entries.exampleEnglish: Semiconductors are a very important industry in Taiwan.
entries.question: 你在哪一個產業工作？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài nǎ yí gè chǎn yè gōng zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: What industry do you work in?
entries.answer: 我在科技產業工作。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài kē jì chǎn yè gōng zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: I work in the tech industry.

entries.example: 他們在網路上籌錢幫助流浪狗。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men zài wǎng lù shang chóu qián bāng zhù liú làng gǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: They're raising money online to help stray dogs.
entries.question: 你參加過籌錢幫助別人的活動嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān jiā guò chóu qián bāng zhù bié rén de huó dòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever taken part in raising money to help others?
entries.answer: 參加過，我們幫一家醫院籌錢。
entries.answerPinyin: cān jiā guò, wǒ men bāng yì jiā yī yuàn chóu qián.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we raised money for a hospital.

entries.example: 今天東北季風很強勁。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn tiān dōng běi jì fēng hěn qiáng jìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The northeast monsoon is really strong today.
entries.question: 你遇過強勁的颱風嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yù guò qiáng jìng de tái fēng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been through a strong typhoon?
entries.answer: 遇過，那次的風很強勁，樹都倒了。
entries.answerPinyin: yù guò, nà cì de fēng hěn qiáng jìng, shù dōu dǎo le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. The wind was so strong that trees fell down.

entries.example: 他是我們公司的前任經理。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì wǒ men gōng sī de qián rèn jīng lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's our company's former manager.
entries.question: 你覺得前任的老闆比現在的好嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de qián rèn de lǎo bǎn bǐ xiàn zài de hǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your previous boss was better than your current one?
entries.answer: 我覺得前任老闆比較好，他很少讓我們加班。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de qián rèn lǎo bǎn bǐ jiào hǎo, tā hěn shǎo ràng wǒ men jiā bān.
entries.answerEnglish: I think my previous boss was better. He rarely made us work overtime.

entries.example: 他是一個很好的領導者。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì yí gè hěn hǎo de lǐng dǎo zhě.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a very good leader.
entries.question: 你覺得好的領導者需要什麼特質？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de hǎo de lǐng dǎo zhě xū yào shén me tè zhí?
entries.questionEnglish: What qualities do you think a good leader needs?
entries.answer: 我覺得好的領導者要會聽別人的意見。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de hǎo de lǐng dǎo zhě yào huì tīng bié rén de yì jiàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I think a good leader needs to listen to other people's opinions.

entries.example: 這個檯燈的底座很重。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge tái dēng de dǐ zuò hěn zhòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The base of this desk lamp is heavy.
entries.question: 你買檯燈的時候會注意底座嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi tái dēng de shí hòu huì zhù yì dǐ zuò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you buy a desk lamp, do you pay attention to the base?
entries.answer: 會，底座重一點比較不會倒。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, dǐ zuò zhòng yì diǎn bǐ jiào bú huì dǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. A heavier base means it won't tip over.

entries.example: 部長今天在新聞上說明新政策。
entries.examplePinyin: bù zhǎng jīn tiān zài xīn wén shàng shuō míng xīn zhèng cè.
entries.exampleEnglish: The minister explained the new policy on the news today.
entries.question: 如果你當部長，你想做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ nǐ dāng bù zhǎng, nǐ xiǎng zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: If you were a minister, what would you want to do?
entries.answer: 如果我當部長，我想多蓋公園。
entries.answerPinyin: rú guǒ wǒ dāng bù zhǎng, wǒ xiǎng duō gài gōng yuán.
entries.answerEnglish: If I were a minister, I'd build more parks.

entries.example: 最近的菜價一直上漲。
entries.examplePinyin: zuì jìn de cài jià yì zhí shàng zhǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Vegetable prices keep going up lately.
entries.question: 你覺得台北的房租上漲得快嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái běi de fáng zū shàng zhǎng de kuài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think rents in Taipei are rising fast?
entries.answer: 很快，我的房租今年上漲了兩千塊。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn kuài, wǒ de fáng zū jīn nián shàng zhǎng le liǎng qiān kuài.
entries.answerEnglish: Very fast. My rent went up two thousand this year.

entries.example: 這裡以前是軍事基地。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè lǐ yǐ qián shì jūn shì jī dì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This used to be a military base.
entries.question: 你對軍事新聞有興趣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì jūn shì xīn wén yǒu xìng qù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you interested in military news?
entries.answer: 沒什麼興趣，我很少看軍事新聞。
entries.answerPinyin: méi shén me xìng qù, wǒ hěn shǎo kàn jūn shì xīn wén.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. I rarely read military news.

entries.example: 他朝我走過來。
entries.examplePinyin: tā cháo wǒ zǒu guò lái.
entries.exampleEnglish: He walked towards me.
entries.question: 你家的窗戶朝哪個方向？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de chuāng hù cháo nǎ gè fāng xiàng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which direction do your windows face?
entries.answer: 我家的窗戶朝東，早上很亮。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā de chuāng hù cháo dōng, zǎo shàng hěn liàng.
entries.answerEnglish: My windows face east, so it's bright in the morning.

entries.example: 這家店只賣單一口味的冰淇淋。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn zhǐ mài dān yī kǒu wèi de bīng qí lín.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop only sells one flavor of ice cream.
entries.question: 你覺得只靠單一收入安全嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zhǐ kào dān yī shōu rù ān quán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think relying on a single income is safe?
entries.answer: 不太安全，單一收入的風險比較高。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài ān quán, dān yī shōu rù de fēng xiǎn bǐ jiào gāo.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. A single income is riskier.

entries.example: 政府官員今天去災區看看。
entries.examplePinyin: zhèng fǔ guān yuán jīn tiān qù zāi qū kàn kàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Government officials visited the disaster area today.
entries.question: 你見過政府官員嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiàn guò zhèng fǔ guān yuán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever met a government official?
entries.answer: 見過，有一位官員來我們公司參觀。
entries.answerPinyin: jiàn guò, yǒu yí wèi guān yuán lái wǒ men gōng sī cān guān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, an official once came to visit our company.

entries.example: 我在一家貿易公司上班。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài yì jiā mào yì gōng sī shàng bān.
entries.exampleEnglish: I work for a trading company.
entries.question: 你的國家和台灣有很多貿易嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā hé tái wān yǒu hěn duō mào yì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there much trade between your country and Taiwan?
entries.answer: 有，我們的貿易很多，特別是電子產品。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men de mào yì hěn duō, tè bié shì diàn zǐ chǎn pǐn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a lot of trade, especially in electronics.

entries.example: 遇到問題時，可以尋求專業的幫助。
entries.examplePinyin: yù dào wèn tí shí, kě yǐ xún qiú zhuān yè de bāng zhù.
entries.exampleEnglish: When you run into problems, you can seek professional help.
entries.question: 你工作有壓力時，會向誰尋求幫助？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gōng zuò yǒu yā lì shí, huì xiàng shéi xún qiú bāng zhù?
entries.questionEnglish: When you're stressed at work, who do you turn to for help?
entries.answer: 我會向我的好朋友尋求建議。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì xiàng wǒ de hǎo péng yǒu xún qiú jiàn yì.
entries.answerEnglish: I go to my best friend for advice.

entries.example: 表格上面有填寫的範例。
entries.examplePinyin: biǎo gé shàng miàn yǒu tián xiě de fàn lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a sample of how to fill it in at the top of the form.
entries.question: 你寫報告的時候，會先看範例嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiě bào gào de shí hòu, huì xiān kàn fàn lì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you write a report, do you look at a sample first?
entries.answer: 會，看範例比較知道怎麼寫。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, kàn fàn lì bǐ jiào zhī dào zěn me xiě.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. Looking at a sample helps me know how to write it.

entries.example: 她在公司負責財務。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài gōng sī fù zé cái wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's in charge of finance at her company.
entries.question: 你家的財務是誰管？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de cái wù shì shéi guǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: Who manages the finances in your household?
entries.answer: 我家的財務都是我太太在管。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā de cái wù dōu shì wǒ tài tài zài guǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: My wife manages all our finances.

entries.example: 這台機器很容易操作。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tái jī qì hěn róng yì cāo zuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: This machine is easy to operate.
entries.question: 你會操作咖啡機嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì cāo zuò kā fēi jī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know how to use a coffee machine?
entries.answer: 會，我們公司的咖啡機很好操作。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ men gōng sī de kā fēi jī hěn hǎo cāo zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the coffee machine at work is easy to use.

entries.example: 他們兩個人常常有衝突。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men liǎng gè rén cháng cháng yǒu chōng tú.
entries.exampleEnglish: Those two often clash.
entries.question: 你跟室友有過衝突嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gēn shì yǒu yǒu guò chōng tú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had a conflict with a roommate?
entries.answer: 有過小衝突，因為他太吵了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu guò xiǎo chōng tú, yīn wèi tā tài chǎo le.
entries.answerEnglish: A small one, because he was too noisy.

entries.example: 很多工會今天上街抗議。
entries.examplePinyin: hěn duō gōng huì jīn tiān shàng jiē kàng yì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Many unions took to the streets in protest today.
entries.question: 你的公司有工會嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng sī yǒu gōng huì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company have a union?
entries.answer: 沒有，我們公司沒有工會。
entries.answerPinyin: méi yǒu, wǒ men gōng sī méi yǒu gōng huì.
entries.answerEnglish: No, our company doesn't have a union.

entries.example: 公司有一個員工旅遊基金。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng sī yǒu yí gè yuán gōng lǚ yóu jī jīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The company has a staff travel fund.
entries.question: 你有買基金嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu mǎi jī jīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you invest in funds?
entries.answer: 有，我每個月都買一點基金。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ měi gè yuè dōu mǎi yì diǎn jī jīn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I put a little into funds every month.

entries.example: 這隻狗有二十磅重。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhī gǒu yǒu èr shí bàng zhòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This dog weighs twenty pounds.
entries.question: 你的國家用公斤還是磅？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā yòng gōng jīn hái shì bàng?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your country use kilograms or pounds?
entries.answer: 我的國家用磅，不用公斤。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de guó jiā yòng bàng, bú yòng gōng jīn.
entries.answerEnglish: My country uses pounds, not kilograms.

entries.example: 這家公司的標誌是一隻鳥。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā gōng sī de biāo zhì shì yì zhī niǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This company's logo is a bird.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪家公司的標誌？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ jiā gōng sī de biāo zhì?
entries.questionEnglish: Which company logo do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡蘋果的標誌，很簡單。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan píng guǒ de biāo zhì, hěn jiǎn dān.
entries.answerEnglish: I like Apple's logo best. It's simple.

entries.example: 那隻狗突然攻擊了一個路人。
entries.examplePinyin: nà zhī gǒu tú rán gōng jí le yí gè lù rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: That dog suddenly attacked a passer-by.
entries.question: 山上的猴子為什麼會攻擊遊客？
entries.questionPinyin: shān shàng de hóu zi wèi shén me huì gōng jí yóu kè?
entries.questionEnglish: Why do monkeys in the mountains attack tourists?
entries.answer: 牠們想搶遊客的食物，所以會攻擊人。
entries.answerPinyin: tā men xiǎng qiǎng yóu kè de shí wù, suǒ yǐ huì gōng jí rén.
entries.answerEnglish: They want to grab tourists' food, so they attack people.

entries.example: 這雙鞋已經沒有庫存了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shuāng xié yǐ jīng méi yǒu kù cún le.
entries.exampleEnglish: These shoes are out of stock.
entries.question: 你想買的東西常常沒有庫存嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng mǎi de dōng xī cháng cháng méi yǒu kù cún ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are the things you want to buy often out of stock?
entries.answer: 常常，我喜歡的東西很快就沒有庫存了。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ xǐ huan de dōng xī hěn kuài jiù méi yǒu kù cún le.
entries.answerEnglish: Often. The things I like sell out fast.

entries.example: 我們要先了解客戶的需求。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men yào xiān liǎo jiě kè hù de xū qiú.
entries.exampleEnglish: We need to understand our clients' needs first.
entries.question: 你找房子的時候有什麼需求？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhǎo fáng zi de shí hòu yǒu shén me xū qiú?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you need when you look for an apartment?
entries.answer: 我的需求是離捷運站近，還要有陽台。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de xū qiú shì lí jié yùn zhàn jìn, hái yào yǒu yáng tái.
entries.answerEnglish: What I need is somewhere close to an MRT station, with a balcony.

entries.example: 第一次在台灣騎機車，我心裡充滿恐懼。
entries.examplePinyin: dì yī cì zài tái wān qí jī chē, wǒ xīn lǐ chōng mǎn kǒng jù.
entries.exampleEnglish: The first time I rode a scooter in Taiwan, I was full of fear.
entries.question: 你最大的恐懼是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì dà de kǒng jù shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your biggest fear?
entries.answer: 我最大的恐懼是在很多人面前說中文。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì dà de kǒng jù shì zài hěn duō rén miàn qián shuō zhōng wén.
entries.answerEnglish: My biggest fear is speaking Chinese in front of lots of people.

entries.example: 隔壁一直在敲打牆壁，好像在裝潢。
entries.examplePinyin: gé bì yì zhí zài qiāo dǎ qiáng bì, hǎo xiàng zài zhuāng huáng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Next door keeps banging on the wall. They seem to be renovating.
entries.question: 你家附近常常有人在敲打東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn cháng cháng yǒu rén zài qiāo dǎ dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do people often bang on things near your home?
entries.answer: 有，樓上在裝潢，每天都在敲打。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, lóu shàng zài zhuāng huáng, měi tiān dōu zài qiāo dǎ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the flat upstairs is being renovated, and they're banging away every day.

entries.example: 颱風過後，軍隊來幫忙清理街道。
entries.examplePinyin: tái fēng guò hòu, jūn duì lái bāng máng qīng lǐ jiē dào.
entries.exampleEnglish: After the typhoon, the army came to help clean up the streets.
entries.question: 你的國家有很大的軍隊嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā yǒu hěn dà de jūn duì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your country have a big army?
entries.answer: 我們國家的軍隊不大，人很少。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men guó jiā de jūn duì bú dà, rén hěn shǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: My country's army isn't big. There aren't many soldiers.

entries.example: 運動可以幫你釋放壓力。
entries.examplePinyin: yùn dòng kě yǐ bāng nǐ shì fàng yā lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Exercise can help you release stress.
entries.question: 你平常怎麼釋放壓力？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ píng cháng zěn me shì fàng yā lì?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you usually relieve stress?
entries.answer: 我週末去爬山釋放壓力。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhōu mò qù pá shān shì fàng yā lì.
entries.answerEnglish: I go hiking at weekends to relieve stress.

entries.example: 地震以後，很多國家送來援助。
entries.examplePinyin: dì zhèn yǐ hòu, hěn duō guó jiā sòng lái yuán zhù.
entries.exampleEnglish: After the earthquake, many countries sent aid.
entries.question: 你的國家常常給別的國家援助嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā cháng cháng gěi bié de guó jiā yuán zhù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your country often give aid to other countries?
entries.answer: 會，我們常提供醫療援助。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ men cháng tí gōng yī liáo yuán zhù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we often provide medical aid.

entries.example: 這件襯衫和你的褲子很相配。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn chèn shān hé nǐ de kù zi hěn xiāng pèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shirt goes well with your trousers.
entries.question: 你覺得你爸媽很相配嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ bà mā hěn xiāng pèi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your parents are a good match?
entries.answer: 很相配，他們都喜歡旅行。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn xiāng pèi, tā men dōu xǐ huan lǚ xíng.
entries.answerEnglish: They're a great match. They both love traveling.

entries.example: 這份工作需要很多體力勞動。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè fèn gōng zuò xū yào hěn duō tǐ lì láo dòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This job involves a lot of physical labor.
entries.question: 勞動節你們公司放假嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: láo dòng jié nǐ men gōng sī fàng jià ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company have Labor Day off?
entries.answer: 有，勞動節我們放一天假。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, láo dòng jié wǒ men fàng yì tiān jià.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we get a day off on Labor Day.

entries.example: 冷氣運轉的聲音太大，我睡不著。
entries.examplePinyin: lěng qì yùn zhuǎn de shēng yīn tài dà, wǒ shuì bù zháo.
entries.exampleEnglish: The air conditioner runs too loudly. I can't sleep.
entries.question: 你家的冷氣晚上都在運轉嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de lěng qì wǎn shàng dōu zài yùn zhuǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your air conditioner run all night?
entries.answer: 夏天會，冷氣整晚都在運轉。
entries.answerPinyin: xià tiān huì, lěng qì zhěng wǎn dōu zài yùn zhuǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: In summer, yes. It runs all night.

entries.example: 每天早上去跑步需要很強的意志。
entries.examplePinyin: měi tiān zǎo shàng qù pǎo bù xū yào hěn qiáng de yì zhì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Going running every morning takes strong willpower.
entries.question: 你覺得自己的意志強嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ de yì zhì qiáng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you have strong willpower?
entries.answer: 我的意志不太強，常常想吃宵夜。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de yì zhì bú tài qiáng, cháng cháng xiǎng chī xiāo yè.
entries.answerEnglish: My willpower isn't very strong. I often want a late-night snack.

entries.example: 兩家公司終於達成協議了。
entries.examplePinyin: liǎng jiā gōng sī zhōng yú dá chéng xié yì le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The two companies finally reached an agreement.
entries.question: 你跟室友或家人怎麼分配家事？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gēn shì yǒu huò jiā rén zěn me fēn pèi jiā shì?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you and your roommates or family split the housework?
entries.answer: 我們有協議，每個人輪流倒垃圾。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men yǒu xié yì, měi gè rén lún liú dào lè sè.
entries.answerEnglish: We have an agreement: everyone takes turns taking out the trash.

entries.example: 颱風即將來台灣，明天可能放颱風假。
entries.examplePinyin: tái fēng jí jiāng lái tái wān, míng tiān kě néng fàng tái fēng jià.
entries.exampleEnglish: A typhoon is about to hit Taiwan, so we might get a typhoon day off tomorrow.
entries.question: 你有什麼即將到來的計畫嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu shén me jí jiāng dào lái de jì huà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any upcoming plans?
entries.answer: 我即將搬家，下個月要搬到台中。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jí jiāng bān jiā, xià gè yuè yào bān dào tái zhōng.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm about to move. Next month I'm moving to Taichung.

entries.example: 火車窗外都是綠色的田地。
entries.examplePinyin: huǒ chē chuāng wài dōu shì lǜ sè de tián dì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Outside the train window there's nothing but green fields.
entries.question: 你的家鄉有很多田地嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de jiā xiāng yǒu hěn duō tián dì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there lots of fields where you grew up?
entries.answer: 有，我家附近到處都是田地。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiā fù jìn dào chù dōu shì tián dì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are fields everywhere near my home.

entries.example: 這家飯店有供應免費早餐。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā fàn diàn yǒu gōng yìng miǎn fèi zǎo cān.
entries.exampleEnglish: This hotel offers free breakfast.
entries.question: 你們公司有供應午餐嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men gōng sī yǒu gōng yìng wǔ cān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company provide lunch?
entries.answer: 沒有，公司只供應咖啡和茶。
entries.answerPinyin: méi yǒu, gōng sī zhǐ gōng yìng kā fēi hé chá.
entries.answerEnglish: No, the company only provides coffee and tea.

entries.example: 我在網路上下了一筆訂單。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài wǎng lù shang xià le yì bǐ dìng dān.
entries.exampleEnglish: I placed an order online.
entries.question: 你上一次在網路下訂單是什麼時候？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shàng yí cì zài wǎng lù xià dìng dān shì shén me shí hòu?
entries.questionEnglish: When did you last place an order online?
entries.answer: 上個星期，我在蝦皮下了一筆訂單。
entries.answerPinyin: shàng gè xīng qí, wǒ zài xiā pí xià le yì bǐ dìng dān.
entries.answerEnglish: Last week. I placed an order on Shopee.

entries.example: 這個型號的冷氣比較省電。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge xíng hào de lěng qì bǐ jiào shěng diàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This model of air conditioner uses less electricity.
entries.question: 你的手機是什麼型號？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de shǒu jī shì shén me xíng hào?
entries.questionEnglish: What model is your phone?
entries.answer: 我的手機是舊型號，用了五年了。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de shǒu jī shì jiù xíng hào, yòng le wǔ nián le.
entries.answerEnglish: My phone is an old model. I've had it for five years.

entries.example: 警察還在找證據。
entries.examplePinyin: jǐng chá hái zài zhǎo zhèng jù.
entries.exampleEnglish: The police are still looking for evidence.
entries.question: 你覺得有外星人存在的證據嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de yǒu wài xīng rén cún zài de zhèng jù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think there's any evidence that aliens exist?
entries.answer: 我覺得沒有證據，但我還是相信。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de méi yǒu zhèng jù, dàn wǒ hái shì xiāng xìn.
entries.answerEnglish: I don't think there's any evidence, but I still believe in them.

entries.example: 這件衣服的布料很透氣，夏天穿剛好。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn yī fu de bù liào hěn tòu qì, xià tiān chuān gāng hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shirt's fabric breathes well. It's perfect for summer.
entries.question: 你買衣服的時候會注意布料嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi yī fu de shí hòu huì zhù yì bù liào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you pay attention to the fabric when you buy clothes?
entries.answer: 會，我喜歡棉的布料，比較舒服。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ xǐ huan mián de bù liào, bǐ jiào shū fú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like cotton. It's more comfortable.

entries.example: 下過雨以後，山上的空氣格外新鮮。
entries.examplePinyin: xià guò yǔ yǐ hòu, shān shàng de kōng qì gé wài xīn xiān.
entries.exampleEnglish: After the rain, the mountain air is exceptionally fresh.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼時候的台北格外漂亮？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me shí hòu de tái běi gé wài piào liang?
entries.questionEnglish: When do you think Taipei looks especially beautiful?
entries.answer: 晚上的台北格外漂亮，到處都是燈。
entries.answerPinyin: wǎn shàng de tái běi gé wài piào liang, dào chù dōu shì dēng.
entries.answerEnglish: Taipei is especially beautiful at night, with lights everywhere.

entries.example: 這個新聞的來源可靠嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge xīn wén de lái yuán kě kào ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: Is the source of this news reliable?
entries.question: 你的主要收入來源是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de zhǔ yào shōu rù lái yuán shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your main source of income?
entries.answer: 我的收入來源是教英文。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de shōu rù lái yuán shì jiāo yīng wén.
entries.answerEnglish: My income comes from teaching English.

entries.example: 這張優惠券只能在特定的店使用。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhāng yōu huì quàn zhǐ néng zài tè dìng de diàn shǐ yòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This coupon can only be used at certain shops.
entries.question: 你只喝特定牌子的咖啡嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhǐ hē tè dìng pái zi de kā fēi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you only drink one particular brand of coffee?
entries.answer: 不會，我沒有特定喜歡的牌子。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ méi yǒu tè dìng xǐ huan de pái zi.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't have a particular favorite brand.

entries.english: climb to the top of; get onto; board
entries.example: 我們早上五點就登上了玉山。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zǎo shàng wǔ diǎn jiù dēng shàng le yù shān.
entries.exampleEnglish: We reached the top of Jade Mountain at five in the morning.
entries.question: 你登上過台灣最高的山嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dēng shàng guò tái wān zuì gāo de shān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever climbed Taiwan's highest mountain?
entries.answer: 還沒，我希望明年能登上玉山。
entries.answerPinyin: hái méi, wǒ xī wàng míng nián néng dēng shàng yù shān.
entries.answerEnglish: Not yet. I hope to climb Jade Mountain next year.

entries.example: 熬夜是一個不良的習慣。
entries.examplePinyin: áo yè shì yí gè bù liáng de xí guàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Staying up late is a bad habit.
entries.question: 你有什麼不良的生活習慣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu shén me bù liáng de shēng huó xí guàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any bad habits?
entries.answer: 我常常熬夜，這是我最大的不良習慣。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cháng cháng áo yè, zhè shì wǒ zuì dà de bù liáng xí guàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I often stay up late. That's my worst habit.

entries.example: 監視器拍到了小偷的影像。
entries.examplePinyin: jiān shì qì pāi dào le xiǎo tōu de yǐng xiàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The security camera caught the thief on video.
entries.question: 你的手機拍的影像清楚嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de shǒu jī pāi de yǐng xiàng qīng chǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are the pictures your phone takes clear?
entries.answer: 很清楚，晚上拍的影像也很好。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn qīng chǔ, wǎn shàng pāi de yǐng xiàng yě hěn hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Very clear. Even pictures taken at night look good.

entries.example: 這家外送平台的送餐範圍很大。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā wài sòng píng tái de sòng cān fàn wéi hěn dà.
entries.exampleEnglish: This delivery app covers a large area.
entries.question: 你租房子的預算範圍是多少？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zū fáng zi de yù suàn fàn wéi shì duō shǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your budget range for rent?
entries.answer: 我的預算範圍是一萬到一萬五。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de yù suàn fàn wéi shì yí wàn dào yí wàn wǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: My budget is between ten and fifteen thousand.

entries.example: 我在蚊子咬的地方塗了一點藥。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài wén zi yǎo de dì fāng tú le yì diǎn yào.
entries.exampleEnglish: I put a little ointment on the mosquito bite.
entries.question: 你出門前會塗防曬乳嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chū mén qián huì tú fáng shài rǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you put on sunscreen before you go out?
entries.answer: 夏天我一定會塗防曬乳。
entries.answerPinyin: xià tiān wǒ yí dìng huì tú fáng shài rǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: In summer I always put on sunscreen.

entries.example: 價錢是我租房子最重要的因素。
entries.examplePinyin: jià qián shì wǒ zū fáng zi zuì zhòng yào de yīn sù.
entries.exampleEnglish: Price is the most important factor when I rent a place.
entries.question: 你選工作時，最重要的因素是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xuǎn gōng zuò shí, zuì zhòng yào de yīn sù shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: When you choose a job, what's the most important factor?
entries.answer: 最重要的因素是工作時間，我不想常加班。
entries.answerPinyin: zuì zhòng yào de yīn sù shì gōng zuò shí jiān, wǒ bù xiǎng cháng jiā bān.
entries.answerEnglish: The most important factor is the hours. I don't want to work overtime a lot.

entries.example: 儘管下大雨，夜市還是很多人。
entries.examplePinyin: jǐn guǎn xià dà yǔ, yè shì hái shì hěn duō rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: Despite the heavy rain, the night market was still crowded.
entries.question: 下雨天你還會出去玩嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: xià yǔ tiān nǐ hái huì chū qù wán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you still go out on rainy days?
entries.answer: 會，儘管下雨，我還是會去咖啡廳。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, jǐn guǎn xià yǔ, wǒ hái shì huì qù kā fēi tīng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. Even when it's raining, I still go to cafés.

entries.example: 我在捷運上遺失了錢包，後來找到了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài jié yùn shàng yí shī le qián bāo, hòu lái zhǎo dào le.
entries.exampleEnglish: I lost my wallet on the MRT, but I found it later.
entries.question: 你在台灣遺失過東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān yí shī guò dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever lost anything in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 有，我遺失過手機，但有人送回來。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ yí shī guò shǒu jī, dàn yǒu rén sòng huí lái.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I lost my phone once, but someone brought it back.

entries.example: 這間餐廳可以容納一百個人。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiān cān tīng kě yǐ róng nà yì bǎi gè rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant can hold a hundred people.
entries.question: 你家可以容納幾個客人？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā kě yǐ róng nà jǐ gè kè rén?
entries.questionEnglish: How many guests can your home hold?
entries.answer: 我家很小，只能容納四個人。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā hěn xiǎo, zhǐ néng róng nà sì gè rén.
entries.answerEnglish: My place is small. It can only fit four people.

entries.example: 這棟大樓的結構很穩，不怕地震。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè dòng dà lóu de jié gòu hěn wěn, bú pà dì zhèn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This building's structure is solid. It can withstand earthquakes.
entries.question: 你覺得中文句子的結構難嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zhōng wén jù zi de jié gòu nán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Chinese sentence structure is difficult?
entries.answer: 不難，中文的結構比英文簡單。
entries.answerPinyin: bù nán, zhōng wén de jié gòu bǐ yīng wén jiǎn dān.
entries.answerEnglish: It's not hard. Chinese structure is simpler than English.

entries.example: 他們為了晚餐吃什麼爭論了很久。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men wèi le wǎn cān chī shén me zhēng lùn le hěn jiǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: They argued for ages about what to have for dinner.
entries.question: 你常常跟朋友爭論什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng cháng gēn péng yǒu zhēng lùn shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you often argue about with your friends?
entries.answer: 我們常常爭論哪家牛肉麵最好吃。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men cháng cháng zhēng lùn nǎ jiā niú ròu miàn zuì hǎo chī.
entries.answerEnglish: We often argue about which beef noodle shop is the best.

entries.example: 我從這次的工作經驗受益很多。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ cóng zhè cì de gōng zuò jīng yàn shòu yì hěn duō.
entries.exampleEnglish: I benefited a lot from this work experience.
entries.question: 你覺得學中文讓你受益很多嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de xué zhōng wén ràng nǐ shòu yì hěn duō ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you feel learning Chinese has benefited you a lot?
entries.answer: 對，學中文讓我在工作上受益很多。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, xué zhōng wén ràng wǒ zài gōng zuò shàng shòu yì hěn duō.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, learning Chinese has helped me a lot at work.

entries.example: 這個理論聽起來很好，但很難做到。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge lǐ lùn tīng qǐ lái hěn hǎo, dàn hěn nán zuò dào.
entries.exampleEnglish: This theory sounds good, but it's hard to put into practice.
entries.question: 學語言，你比較喜歡學理論還是多練習？
entries.questionPinyin: xué yǔ yán, nǐ bǐ jiào xǐ huan xué lǐ lùn hái shì duō liàn xí?
entries.questionEnglish: When learning a language, do you prefer studying theory or practicing a lot?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡練習，理論太無聊了。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan liàn xí, lǐ lùn tài wú liáo le.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer practicing. Theory is too boring.

entries.example: 老闆要跟每個人個別談話。
entries.examplePinyin: lǎo bǎn yào gēn měi gè rén gè bié tán huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: The boss wants to talk to everyone individually.
entries.question: 你喜歡個別上課還是團體上課？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan gè bié shàng kè hái shì tuán tǐ shàng kè?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer one-to-one lessons or group classes?
entries.answer: 我喜歡個別上課，老師會比較注意我。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan gè bié shàng kè, lǎo shī huì bǐ jiào zhù yì wǒ.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer one-to-one lessons. The teacher pays more attention to me.

entries.example: 我傳訊息給他，他還沒回應。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ chuán xùn xí gěi tā, tā hái méi huí yìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I messaged him, but he hasn't responded yet.
entries.question: 你在網路上看到不好的留言，會回應嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài wǎng lù shang kàn dào bù hǎo de liú yán, huì huí yìng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you see nasty comments online, do you respond?
entries.answer: 不會，我覺得不回應比較好。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ jué de bù huí yìng bǐ jiào hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: No. I think it's better not to respond.

entries.example: 我還不太會辨認這些中文字。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hái bú tài huì biàn rèn zhè xiē zhōng wén zì.
entries.exampleEnglish: I still can't really recognize these Chinese characters.
entries.question: 你能辨認繁體字和簡體字嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ néng biàn rèn fán tǐ zì hé jiǎn tǐ zì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you tell Traditional and Simplified characters apart?
entries.answer: 可以，我很容易辨認繁體字。
entries.answerPinyin: kě yǐ, wǒ hěn róng yì biàn rèn fán tǐ zì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I can easily recognize Traditional characters.

entries.example: 這家機構提供免費的中文課。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā jī gòu tí gōng miǎn fèi de zhōng wén kè.
entries.exampleEnglish: This organization offers free Chinese classes.
entries.question: 你在什麼機構工作？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài shén me jī gòu gōng zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of organization do you work for?
entries.answer: 我在一家教育機構教英文。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài yì jiā jiào yù jī gòu jiāo yīng wén.
entries.answerEnglish: I teach English at an education company.

entries.example: 多睡覺可以幫助身體的細胞恢復。
entries.examplePinyin: duō shuì jiào kě yǐ bāng zhù shēn tǐ de xì bāo huī fù.
entries.exampleEnglish: Getting more sleep helps the body's cells recover.
entries.question: 你覺得自己有運動細胞嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ yǒu yùn dòng xì bāo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're naturally sporty?
entries.answer: 沒有，我完全沒有運動細胞。
entries.answerPinyin: méi yǒu, wǒ wán quán méi yǒu yùn dòng xì bāo.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I'm not sporty at all.

entries.example: 她在銀行開始了她的職業生涯。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài yín háng kāi shǐ le tā de zhí yè shēng yá.
entries.exampleEnglish: She began her career at a bank.
entries.question: 你對未來的職業生涯有什麼計畫？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì wèi lái de zhí yè shēng yá yǒu shén me jì huà?
entries.questionEnglish: What plans do you have for your future career?
entries.answer: 我希望我的職業生涯能在台灣發展。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xī wàng wǒ de zhí yè shēng yá néng zài tái wān fā zhǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: I hope to build my career in Taiwan.

entries.example: 請不要在門口放置腳踏車。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng bú yào zài mén kǒu fàng zhì jiǎo tà chē.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please don't leave bicycles at the entrance.
entries.question: 你家門口放置了什麼東西？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā mén kǒu fàng zhì le shén me dōng xī?
entries.questionEnglish: What have you put by your front door?
entries.answer: 我家門口放置了一個鞋櫃。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā mén kǒu fàng zhì le yí gè xié guì.
entries.answerEnglish: There's a shoe cabinet by my front door.

entries.example: 火箭今天早上成功發射了。
entries.examplePinyin: huǒ jiàn jīn tiān zǎo shàng chéng gōng fā shè le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The rocket was launched successfully this morning.
entries.question: 你看過火箭發射嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò huǒ jiàn fā shè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a rocket launch?
entries.answer: 我只在電視上看過火箭發射。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhǐ zài diàn shì shàng kàn guò huǒ jiàn fā shè.
entries.answerEnglish: I've only seen a rocket launch on TV.

entries.example: 這些食物要存放在冰箱裡。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè xiē shí wù yào cún fàng zài bīng xiāng lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: This food needs to be stored in the fridge.
entries.question: 旅行時，你會把行李存放在哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: lǚ xíng shí, nǐ huì bǎ xíng li cún fàng zài nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: When you travel, where do you leave your luggage?
entries.answer: 我會把行李存放在飯店櫃台。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì bǎ xíng li cún fàng zài fàn diàn guì tái.
entries.answerEnglish: I leave my luggage at the hotel front desk.

entries.example: 這一區犯罪率很低，晚上很安全。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè yì qū fàn zuì lǜ hěn dī, wǎn shàng hěn ān quán.
entries.exampleEnglish: The crime rate in this area is low, so it's safe at night.
entries.question: 台灣的犯罪率高嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: tái wān de fàn zuì lǜ gāo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is the crime rate in Taiwan high?
entries.answer: 不高，台灣的犯罪率很低。
entries.answerPinyin: bù gāo, tái wān de fàn zuì lǜ hěn dī.
entries.answerEnglish: No, Taiwan's crime rate is low.

entries.example: 聽到好消息，她露出了笑容。
entries.examplePinyin: tīng dào hǎo xiāo xí, tā lù chū le xiào róng.
entries.exampleEnglish: When she heard the good news, she broke into a smile.
entries.question: 什麼事會讓你露出笑容？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shì huì ràng nǐ lù chū xiào róng?
entries.questionEnglish: What makes you smile?
entries.answer: 看到可愛的狗，我就會露出笑容。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn dào kě ài de gǒu, wǒ jiù huì lù chū xiào róng.
entries.answerEnglish: Seeing a cute dog always makes me smile.

entries.example: 週末的夜市往往人很多。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōu mò de yè shì wǎng wǎng rén hěn duō.
entries.exampleEnglish: Night markets tend to be crowded at the weekend.
entries.question: 你壓力大的時候，往往會做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yā lì dà de shí hòu, wǎng wǎng huì zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: When you're stressed, what do you tend to do?
entries.answer: 壓力大的時候，我往往會吃很多。
entries.answerPinyin: yā lì dà de shí hòu, wǒ wǎng wǎng huì chī hěn duō.
entries.answerEnglish: When I'm stressed, I tend to eat a lot.

entries.example: 地震的時候，整棟樓都在搖動。
entries.examplePinyin: dì zhèn de shí hòu, zhěng dòng lóu dōu zài yáo dòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: During the earthquake, the whole building was shaking.
entries.question: 你遇過讓房子搖動的大地震嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yù guò ràng fáng zi yáo dòng de dà dì zhèn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been in an earthquake strong enough to shake the building?
entries.answer: 遇過，那次整棟房子都在搖動。
entries.answerPinyin: yù guò, nà cì zhěng dòng fáng zi dōu zài yáo dòng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. That time the whole building was shaking.

entries.example: 我們需要新的行銷策略。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men xū yào xīn de xíng xiāo cè lüè.
entries.exampleEnglish: We need a new marketing strategy.
entries.question: 你學中文有什麼好策略？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xué zhōng wén yǒu shén me hǎo cè lüè?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a good strategy for learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 我的策略是每天跟同事說中文。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de cè lüè shì měi tiān gēn tóng shì shuō zhōng wén.
entries.answerEnglish: My strategy is to speak Chinese with my coworkers every day.

entries.example: 這個問題一直存在。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge wèn tí yì zhí cún zài.
entries.exampleEnglish: This problem has always been there.
entries.question: 你相信鬼存在嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiāng xìn guǐ cún zài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you believe ghosts exist?
entries.answer: 我不相信鬼存在。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bù xiāng xìn guǐ cún zài.
entries.answerEnglish: I don't believe ghosts exist.

entries.example: 這個計畫下個月開始執行。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge jì huà xià gè yuè kāi shǐ zhí xíng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This plan will be put into action next month.
entries.question: 你覺得做計畫難，還是執行難？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zuò jì huà nán, hái shì zhí xíng nán?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think making a plan is harder, or carrying it out?
entries.answer: 我覺得執行比較難。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de zhí xíng bǐ jiào nán.
entries.answerEnglish: I think carrying it out is harder.

entries.example: 開車的時候要專注。
entries.examplePinyin: kāi chē de shí hòu yào zhuān zhù.
entries.exampleEnglish: You need to concentrate when you drive.
entries.question: 你在什麼地方工作最專注？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài shén me dì fāng gōng zuò zuì zhuān zhù?
entries.questionEnglish: Where can you concentrate on work best?
entries.answer: 我在咖啡廳工作最專注。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài kā fēi tīng gōng zuò zuì zhuān zhù.
entries.answerEnglish: I concentrate best working in a café.

entries.example: 他終於說出了真相。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zhōng yú shuō chū le zhēn xiàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: He finally told the truth.
entries.question: 你覺得網路新聞說的都是真相嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de wǎng lù xīn wén shuō de dōu shì zhēn xiàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think online news always tells the truth?
entries.answer: 不一定，有些新聞不是真相。
entries.answerPinyin: bù yí dìng, yǒu xiē xīn wén bú shì zhēn xiàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Not always. Some news isn't the truth.

entries.example: 他的新書下個月出版。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de xīn shū xià gè yuè chū bǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: His new book comes out next month.
entries.question: 如果你出版一本書，你想寫什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ nǐ chū bǎn yì běn shū, nǐ xiǎng xiě shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: If you published a book, what would you write about?
entries.answer: 我想出版一本關於台灣生活的書。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng chū bǎn yì běn guān yú tái wān shēng huó de shū.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to publish a book about life in Taiwan.

entries.example: 我的原則是不在週末工作。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de yuán zé shì bú zài zhōu mò gōng zuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: My rule is not to work at the weekend.
entries.question: 你生活中有什麼原則？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēng huó zhōng yǒu shén me yuán zé?
entries.questionEnglish: What principles do you live by?
entries.answer: 我的原則是不借錢給朋友。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de yuán zé shì bú jiè qián gěi péng yǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: My rule is never to lend money to friends.

entries.example: 聽到這個消息，大家心情都很沉重。
entries.examplePinyin: tīng dào zhè ge xiāo xí, dà jiā xīn qíng dōu hěn chén zhòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: When we heard the news, everyone felt very heavy-hearted.
entries.question: 什麼事會讓你覺得壓力很沉重？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shì huì ràng nǐ jué de yā lì hěn chén zhòng?
entries.questionEnglish: What makes the pressure feel heavy for you?
entries.answer: 工作太多的時候，我覺得壓力很沉重。
entries.answerPinyin: gōng zuò tài duō de shí hòu, wǒ jué de yā lì hěn chén zhòng.
entries.answerEnglish: When I have too much work, the pressure feels very heavy.

entries.example: 多洗手可以防止感冒。
entries.examplePinyin: duō xǐ shǒu kě yǐ fáng zhǐ gǎn mào.
entries.exampleEnglish: Washing your hands often can prevent colds.
entries.question: 夏天你怎麼防止被蚊子咬？
entries.questionPinyin: xià tiān nǐ zěn me fáng zhǐ bèi wén zi yǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you keep from getting bitten by mosquitoes in summer?
entries.answer: 我會擦防蚊液來防止被咬。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì cā fáng wén yì lái fáng zhǐ bèi yǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: I put on mosquito repellent to keep from getting bitten.

entries.example: 請不要站在月台邊緣。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng bú yào zhàn zài yuè tái biān yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please don't stand at the edge of the platform.
entries.question: 在派對上，你會覺得自己是邊緣人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zài pài duì shàng, nǐ huì jué de zì jǐ shì biān yuán rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: At parties, do you ever feel like an outsider?
entries.answer: 有時候會，不認識人的時候我就像邊緣人。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu huì, bú rèn shì rén de shí hòu wǒ jiù xiàng biān yuán rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. When I don't know anyone, I feel like an outsider.

entries.example: 颱風造成了巨大的損失。
entries.examplePinyin: tái fēng zào chéng le jù dà de sǔn shī.
entries.exampleEnglish: The typhoon caused enormous damage.
entries.question: 來台灣後，你的生活有巨大的改變嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: lái tái wān hòu, nǐ de shēng huó yǒu jù dà de gǎi biàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has your life changed hugely since you came to Taiwan?
entries.answer: 有，我的生活有了巨大的改變。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de shēng huó yǒu le jù dà de gǎi biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my life has changed enormously.

entries.example: 這片森林還保持原始的樣子。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè piàn sēn lín hái bǎo chí yuán shǐ de yàng zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: This forest is still in its original, untouched state.
entries.question: 你喜歡去原始的自然環境旅行嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan qù yuán shǐ de zì rán huán jìng lǚ xíng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like traveling to unspoiled natural places?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我喜歡去原始的山林走走。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ xǐ huan qù yuán shǐ de shān lín zǒu zǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like walking in untouched mountain forests.

entries.example: 吃了藥以後，疼痛好多了。
entries.examplePinyin: chī le yào yǐ hòu, téng tòng hǎo duō le.
entries.exampleEnglish: After taking the medicine, the pain is much better.
entries.question: 長時間用電腦，哪裡容易疼痛？
entries.questionPinyin: cháng shí jiān yòng diàn nǎo, nǎ lǐ róng yì téng tòng?
entries.questionEnglish: After using a computer for a long time, where do people tend to ache?
entries.answer: 長時間用電腦，肩膀和脖子容易疼痛。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng shí jiān yòng diàn nǎo, jiān bǎng hé bó zi róng yì téng tòng.
entries.answerEnglish: Using a computer for a long time tends to make your shoulders and neck ache.

entries.example: 這支手機的電池需要更換了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhī shǒu jī de diàn chí xū yào gēng huàn le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This phone's battery needs replacing.
entries.question: 你多久更換一次手機？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duō jiǔ gēng huàn yí cì shǒu jī?
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you replace your phone?
entries.answer: 我大概三年更換一次手機。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dà gài sān nián gēng huàn yí cì shǒu jī.
entries.answerEnglish: I replace my phone about every three years.

entries.example: 多數人週末都會出去玩。
entries.examplePinyin: duō shù rén zhōu mò dōu huì chū qù wán.
entries.exampleEnglish: Most people go out at the weekend.
entries.question: 在你的公司，多數同事是哪裡人？
entries.questionPinyin: zài nǐ de gōng sī, duō shù tóng shì shì nǎ lǐ rén?
entries.questionEnglish: At your company, where are most of your coworkers from?
entries.answer: 多數同事是台灣人。
entries.answerPinyin: duō shù tóng shì shì tái wān rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Most of my coworkers are Taiwanese.

entries.example: 我爸爸喜歡收藏老唱片。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bà ba xǐ huan shōu cáng lǎo chàng piàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: My dad likes collecting old records.
entries.question: 你有收藏什麼東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu shōu cáng shén me dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you collect anything?
entries.answer: 我收藏了很多國家的硬幣。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ shōu cáng le hěn duō guó jiā de yìng bì.
entries.answerEnglish: I've collected coins from lots of countries.

entries.example: 這次選舉有三位候選人。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì xuǎn jǔ yǒu sān wèi hòu xuǎn rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are three candidates in this election.
entries.question: 選舉的時候，你怎麼選候選人？
entries.questionPinyin: xuǎn jǔ de shí hòu, nǐ zěn me xuǎn hòu xuǎn rén?
entries.questionEnglish: At election time, how do you choose a candidate?
entries.answer: 我會先看候選人說要做什麼。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì xiān kàn hòu xuǎn rén shuō yào zuò shén me.
entries.answerEnglish: First I look at what the candidates say they'll do.

entries.example: 名片上要寫你的職稱。
entries.examplePinyin: míng piàn shàng yào xiě nǐ de zhí chēng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Your business card should show your job title.
entries.question: 你在公司的職稱是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài gōng sī de zhí chēng shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your job title at your company?
entries.answer: 我的職稱是專案經理。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de zhí chēng shì zhuān àn jīng lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: My title is project manager.

entries.example: 他們的婚姻很幸福。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men de hūn yīn hěn xìng fú.
entries.exampleEnglish: They have a very happy marriage.
entries.question: 你覺得幸福的婚姻需要什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de xìng fú de hūn yīn xū yào shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think a happy marriage needs?
entries.answer: 我覺得幸福的婚姻需要互相尊重。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de xìng fú de hūn yīn xū yào hù xiāng zūn zhòng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think a happy marriage needs mutual respect.

entries.example: 出門前請確保門有鎖好。
entries.examplePinyin: chū mén qián qǐng què bǎo mén yǒu suǒ hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please make sure the door is locked before you go out.
entries.question: 出國前，你怎麼確保東西都帶了？
entries.questionPinyin: chū guó qián, nǐ zěn me què bǎo dōng xī dōu dài le?
entries.questionEnglish: Before going abroad, how do you make sure you've packed everything?
entries.answer: 我會寫清單，確保東西都帶了。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì xiě qīng dān, què bǎo dōng xī dōu dài le.
entries.answerEnglish: I write a checklist to make sure I've got everything.

entries.example: 我換了一個比較便宜的手機方案。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ huàn le yí gè bǐ jiào pián yi de shǒu jī fāng àn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I switched to a cheaper phone plan.
entries.question: 你的手機方案每個月多少錢？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de shǒu jī fāng àn měi gè yuè duō shǎo qián?
entries.questionEnglish: How much is your phone plan each month?
entries.answer: 我的方案每個月四百九十九塊。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de fāng àn měi gè yuè sì bǎi jiǔ shí jiǔ kuài.
entries.answerEnglish: My plan is 499 dollars a month.

entries.example: 他顯然不想去。
entries.examplePinyin: tā xiǎn rán bù xiǎng qù.
entries.exampleEnglish: He obviously doesn't want to go.
entries.question: 你覺得你的同事今天心情好嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ de tóng shì jīn tiān xīn qíng hǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your coworker is in a good mood today?
entries.answer: 顯然不好，他一句話都沒說。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎn rán bù hǎo, tā yí jù huà dōu méi shuō.
entries.answerEnglish: Obviously not. He hasn't said a word.

entries.example: 他是這個協會的主席。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì zhè ge xié huì de zhǔ xí.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's the chairman of this association.
entries.question: 你們公司開會時，誰當主席？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men gōng sī kāi huì shí, shéi dāng zhǔ xí?
entries.questionEnglish: Who chairs the meetings at your company?
entries.answer: 通常是我們經理當主席。
entries.answerPinyin: tōng cháng shì wǒ men jīng lǐ dāng zhǔ xí.
entries.answerEnglish: Usually our manager chairs them.

entries.example: 每個公民都有投票的權利。
entries.examplePinyin: měi gè gōng mín dōu yǒu tóu piào de quán lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Every citizen has the right to vote.
entries.question: 你是哪個國家的公民？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shì nǎ gè guó jiā de gōng mín?
entries.questionEnglish: Which country are you a citizen of?
entries.answer: 我是加拿大公民。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ shì jiā ná dà gōng mín.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm a Canadian citizen.

entries.example: 天空中出現了一個不明物體。
entries.examplePinyin: tiān kōng zhōng chū xiàn le yí gè bù míng wù tǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: An unidentified object appeared in the sky.
entries.question: 你看過天空中的不明物體嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò tiān kōng zhōng de bù míng wù tǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen an unidentified object in the sky?
entries.answer: 沒有，我從來沒看過不明物體。
entries.answerPinyin: méi yǒu, wǒ cóng lái méi kàn guò bù míng wù tǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I've never seen an unidentified object.

entries.example: 明天的會議改為下午三點。
entries.examplePinyin: míng tiān de huì yì gǎi wéi xià wǔ sān diǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Tomorrow's meeting has been moved to 3 p.m.
entries.question: 如果下大雨，你的週末計畫會改為什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ xià dà yǔ, nǐ de zhōu mò jì huà huì gǎi wéi shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: If it pours with rain, what do your weekend plans change to?
entries.answer: 我會改為在家看電影。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì gǎi wéi zài jiā kàn diàn yǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: I'll stay home and watch movies instead.

entries.example: 這一區是台北的商業中心。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè yì qū shì tái běi de shāng yè zhōng xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This area is Taipei's business center.
entries.question: 你喜歡住在商業區嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zhù zài shāng yè qū ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like living in a commercial district?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，商業區太吵了。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xǐ huan, shāng yè qū tài chǎo le.
entries.answerEnglish: No, commercial districts are too noisy.

entries.example: 她工作很積極，老闆很喜歡她。
entries.examplePinyin: tā gōng zuò hěn jī jí, lǎo bǎn hěn xǐ huan tā.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's very proactive at work, and the boss likes her a lot.
entries.question: 你學中文的態度積極嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xué zhōng wén de tài dù jī jí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you proactive about learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 我很積極，每天都練習。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ hěn jī jí, měi tiān dōu liàn xí.
entries.answerEnglish: Very. I practice every day.

entries.example: 他參加了一個登山協會。
entries.examplePinyin: tā cān jiā le yí gè dēng shān xié huì.
entries.exampleEnglish: He joined a hiking association.
entries.question: 你有參加什麼協會嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu cān jiā shén me xié huì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you belong to any associations?
entries.answer: 我參加了台北的攝影協會。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cān jiā le tái běi de shè yǐng xié huì.
entries.answerEnglish: I've joined a photography society in Taipei.

entries.example: 在台灣，一般人不能帶武器。
entries.examplePinyin: zài tái wān, yì bān rén bù néng dài wǔ qì.
entries.exampleEnglish: In Taiwan, ordinary people can't carry weapons.
entries.question: 機場為什麼要檢查行李裡有沒有武器？
entries.questionPinyin: jī chǎng wèi shén me yào jiǎn chá xíng li lǐ yǒu méi yǒu wǔ qì?
entries.questionEnglish: Why do airports check luggage for weapons?
entries.answer: 為了安全，機場不讓旅客帶武器上飛機。
entries.answerPinyin: wèi le ān quán, jī chǎng bú ràng lǚ kè dài wǔ qì shàng fēi jī.
entries.answerEnglish: For safety, airports don't let passengers take weapons on planes.

entries.example: 會說英文是他的優勢。
entries.examplePinyin: huì shuō yīng wén shì tā de yōu shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Speaking English is his advantage.
entries.question: 你覺得你找工作的優勢是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ zhǎo gōng zuò de yōu shì shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think your advantages are when job hunting?
entries.answer: 我的優勢是會說三種語言。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de yōu shì shì huì shuō sān zhǒng yǔ yán.
entries.answerEnglish: My advantage is that I speak three languages.

entries.example: 夢想很美，但現實很難。
entries.examplePinyin: mèng xiǎng hěn měi, dàn xiàn shí hěn nán.
entries.exampleEnglish: Dreams are beautiful, but reality is hard.
entries.question: 在台灣生活的現實，跟你想的一樣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zài tái wān shēng huó de xiàn shí, gēn nǐ xiǎng de yí yàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is the reality of living in Taiwan what you expected?
entries.answer: 不太一樣，現實比我想的難。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài yí yàng, xiàn shí bǐ wǒ xiǎng de nán.
entries.answerEnglish: Not quite. The reality is harder than I thought.

entries.example: 昨天電視上有總統候選人的辯論。
entries.examplePinyin: zuó tiān diàn shì shàng yǒu zǒng tǒng hòu xuǎn rén de biàn lùn.
entries.exampleEnglish: There was a presidential candidates' debate on TV yesterday.
entries.question: 你喜歡跟朋友辯論嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan gēn péng yǒu biàn lùn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like debating with friends?
entries.answer: 喜歡，但是我們不辯論政治。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, dàn shì wǒ men bú biàn lùn zhèng zhì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but we don't debate politics.

entries.example: 這碗湯的味道很濃郁。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè wǎn tāng de wèi dào hěn nóng yù.
entries.exampleEnglish: This soup has a very rich flavor.
entries.question: 你喜歡味道濃郁的咖啡嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan wèi dào nóng yù de kā fēi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like coffee with a rich flavor?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我喜歡很濃郁的黑咖啡。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ xǐ huan hěn nóng yù de hēi kā fēi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like really rich black coffee.

entries.example: 新聞一直在報導這起事件。
entries.examplePinyin: xīn wén yī zhí zài bào dǎo zhè qǐ shì jiàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The news keeps reporting on this incident.
entries.question: 最近有什麼新聞事件讓你印象很深？
entries.questionPinyin: zuì jìn yǒu shén me xīn wén shì jiàn ràng nǐ yìn xiàng hěn shēn?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a recent news event that left a strong impression on you?
entries.answer: 最近的地震事件讓我印象很深。
entries.answerPinyin: zuì jìn de dì zhèn shì jiàn ràng wǒ yìn xiàng hěn shēn.
entries.answerEnglish: The recent earthquake made a strong impression on me.

entries.example: 年輕一代比較少看電視。
entries.examplePinyin: nián qīng yí dài bǐ jiào shǎo kàn diàn shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: The younger generation watches less TV.
entries.question: 你這一代人跟父母那一代有什麼不同？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhè yí dài rén gēn fù mǔ nà yí dài yǒu shén me bù tóng?
entries.questionEnglish: How is your generation different from your parents'?
entries.answer: 我們這一代比較常換工作。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men zhè yí dài bǐ jiào cháng huàn gōng zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: Our generation changes jobs more often.

entries.example: 政府打算改革教育制度。
entries.examplePinyin: zhèng fǔ dǎ suàn gǎi gé jiào yù zhì dù.
entries.exampleEnglish: The government plans to reform the education system.
entries.question: 你覺得你的國家最需要改革什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ de guó jiā zuì xū yào gǎi gé shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think your country most needs to reform?
entries.answer: 我覺得我們最需要改革交通。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de wǒ men zuì xū yào gǎi gé jiāo tōng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think we most need to reform transport.

entries.example: 我沒察覺到他不高興。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ méi chá jué dào tā bù gāo xìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I didn't notice he was upset.
entries.question: 你能察覺朋友心情不好嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ néng chá jué péng yǒu xīn qíng bù hǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you tell when a friend is in a bad mood?
entries.answer: 可以，我很容易察覺朋友心情不好。
entries.answerPinyin: kě yǐ, wǒ hěn róng yì chá jué péng yǒu xīn qíng bù hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I easily sense when a friend is down.

entries.example: 這棟大樓有健身房和游泳池等設施。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè dòng dà lóu yǒu jiàn shēn fáng hé yóu yǒng chí děng shè shī.
entries.exampleEnglish: This building has facilities such as a gym and a pool.
entries.question: 你家附近有什麼運動設施？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn yǒu shén me yùn dòng shè shī?
entries.questionEnglish: What sports facilities are there near your home?
entries.answer: 我家附近有公園和籃球場等運動設施。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā fù jìn yǒu gōng yuán hé lán qiú chǎng děng yùn dòng shè shī.
entries.answerEnglish: Near my home there are sports facilities like a park and basketball courts.

entries.example: 學語言的關鍵是多練習。
entries.examplePinyin: xué yǔ yán de guān jiàn shì duō liàn xí.
entries.exampleEnglish: The key to learning a language is practicing a lot.
entries.question: 你覺得學好中文的關鍵是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de xué hǎo zhōng wén de guān jiàn shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is the key to learning Chinese well?
entries.answer: 我覺得關鍵是每天開口說。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de guān jiàn shì měi tiān kāi kǒu shuō.
entries.answerEnglish: I think the key is speaking out loud every day.

entries.example: 他參加了一場烹飪競賽。
entries.examplePinyin: tā cān jiā le yì chǎng pēng rèn jìng sài.
entries.exampleEnglish: He entered a cooking competition.
entries.question: 你參加過什麼競賽嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān jiā guò shén me jìng sài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever entered a competition?
entries.answer: 我參加過一次攝影競賽。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cān jiā guò yí cì shè yǐng jìng sài.
entries.answerEnglish: I once entered a photography contest.

entries.example: 這間美術館有很多有名的畫作。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiān měi shù guǎn yǒu hěn duō yǒu míng de huà zuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: This art museum has many famous paintings.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪一幅畫作？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ yì fú huà zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: Which painting do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡梵谷的〈星夜〉這幅畫作。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan fàn gǔ de 〈 xīng yè 〉 zhè fú huà zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: I like Van Gogh's "The Starry Night" best.

entries.example: 老闆把水果放在秤上。
entries.examplePinyin: lǎo bǎn bǎ shuǐ guǒ fàng zài chèng shàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The shopkeeper put the fruit on the scale.
entries.question: 你在家做菜會用秤嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài jiā zuò cài huì yòng chèng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use a kitchen scale when you cook at home?
entries.answer: 會，做蛋糕的時候我會用秤。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, zuò dàn gāo de shí hòu wǒ huì yòng chèng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I use a scale when I bake cakes.

entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ cháng dú zì qù kàn diàn yǐng.

entries.questionPinyin: gōng zuò shùn lì de shí hòu, nǐ jué de shì shéi de gōng láo?

entries.answer: 我覺得是整個團隊的功勞。

entries.answer: 我每天跑步來增強體力。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ měi tiān pǎo bù lái zēng qiáng tǐ lì.
entries.answerEnglish: I run every day to build up my stamina.

entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're a smart consumer?
entries.answer: 是，我是很會比價的消費者。

entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm a consumer who's good at comparing prices.

entries.answer: 我覺得核能有好處，也有風險。

entries.answerEnglish: I think nuclear power has benefits, but also risks.

entries.answerEnglish: Very hard. A judge has to be completely fair.

entries.answerEnglish: I don't think the profit is high, but it's fun.

entries.exampleEnglish: He found his job entirely on his own.
entries.question: 你在台灣遇到問題時，依靠誰？

entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ kě yǐ yán cháng jià qí, nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ lǐ?

entries.questionPinyin: xià tiān gāo wēn de shí hòu, nǐ huì chū mén ma?
