entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā cān tīng de míng shēng hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant has a very good reputation.
entries.question: 你覺得名聲重要嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de míng shēng zhòng yào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think reputation matters?
entries.answer: 重要，但我覺得名聲不是一切。
entries.answerPinyin: zhòng yào, dàn wǒ jué de míng shēng bú shì yí qiè.
entries.answerEnglish: It matters, but I don't think reputation is everything.

entries.example: 台北的工作機會多，但是競爭激烈。
entries.examplePinyin: tái běi de gōng zuò jī huì duō, dàn shì jìng zhēng jī liè.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taipei has lots of jobs, but the competition is fierce.
entries.question: 你的行業競爭激烈嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de háng yè jìng zhēng jī liè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your industry very competitive?
entries.answer: 對，我們這一行競爭激烈。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ men zhè yì háng jìng zhēng jī liè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my line of work is very competitive.

entries.example: 這種物質對身體不好。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhǒng wù zhí duì shēn tǐ bù hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This substance is bad for your health.
entries.question: 你覺得物質生活重要嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de wù zhí shēng huó zhòng yào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think material comfort is important?
entries.answer: 我覺得物質生活不是最重要的。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de wù zhí shēng huó bú shì zuì zhòng yào de.
entries.answerEnglish: I don't think material comfort is the most important thing.

entries.example: 我們週末去國家戲劇院看音樂劇。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zhōu mò qù guó jiā xì jù yuàn kàn yīn yuè jù.
entries.exampleEnglish: We're going to the National Theater to see a musical this weekend.
entries.question: 你看過什麼音樂劇？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò shén me yīn yuè jù?
entries.questionEnglish: What musicals have you seen?
entries.answer: 我在倫敦看過一部很棒的音樂劇。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài lún dūn kàn guò yí bù hěn bàng de yīn yuè jù.
entries.answerEnglish: I saw a great musical in London.

entries.example: 她看到蟑螂就大聲尖叫。
entries.examplePinyin: tā kàn dào zhāng láng jiù dà shēng jiān jiào.
entries.exampleEnglish: She screamed when she saw the cockroach.
entries.question: 你看到什麼會尖叫？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn dào shén me huì jiān jiào?
entries.questionEnglish: What makes you scream when you see it?
entries.answer: 我看到老鼠一定會尖叫。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ kàn dào lǎo shǔ yí dìng huì jiān jiào.
entries.answerEnglish: I always scream when I see a mouse.

entries.example: 這個游泳池的深度是兩公尺。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge yóu yǒng chí de shēn dù shì liǎng gōng chǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: This pool is two meters deep.
entries.question: 你喜歡有深度的電影嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan yǒu shēn dù de diàn yǐng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like movies with depth?
entries.answer: 喜歡，有深度的電影讓我想很多。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, yǒu shēn dù de diàn yǐng ràng wǒ xiǎng hěn duō.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, deep movies make me think a lot.

entries.example: 工作太多，我一個人應付不來。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng zuò tài duō, wǒ yí gè rén yìng fù bù lái.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's too much work for me to handle alone.
entries.question: 工作壓力大的時候，你怎麼應付？
entries.questionPinyin: gōng zuò yā lì dà de shí hòu, nǐ zěn me yìng fù?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you cope when work gets stressful?
entries.answer: 我會先去運動，再回來慢慢應付。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì xiān qù yùn dòng, zài huí lái màn màn yìng fù.
entries.answerEnglish: I go work out first, then come back and deal with it bit by bit.

entries.example: 今年颱風少，芒果的產量很高。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn nián tái fēng shǎo, máng guǒ de chǎn liàng hěn gāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: There were few typhoons this year, so the mango harvest is big.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣哪種水果產量最多？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān nǎ zhǒng shuǐ guǒ chǎn liàng zuì duō?
entries.questionEnglish: Which fruit do you think Taiwan produces the most of?
entries.answer: 我覺得香蕉的產量最多。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de xiāng jiāo de chǎn liàng zuì duō.
entries.answerEnglish: I think bananas have the biggest output.

entries.example: 他們把老房子改造成咖啡廳。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men bǎ lǎo fáng zi gǎi zào chéng kā fēi tīng.
entries.exampleEnglish: They turned an old house into a café.
entries.question: 如果可以，你想怎麼改造你的房間？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ kě yǐ, nǐ xiǎng zěn me gǎi zào nǐ de fáng jiān?
entries.questionEnglish: If you could, how would you remodel your room?
entries.answer: 我想把房間改造成一間小書房。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng bǎ fáng jiān gǎi zào chéng yì jiān xiǎo shū fáng.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to turn my room into a small study.

entries.example: 這次升職是你應得的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì shēng zhí shì nǐ yīng dé de.
entries.exampleEnglish: You deserve this promotion.
entries.question: 你覺得你應得更多假期嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ yīng dé gèng duō jià qí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you deserve more vacation time?
entries.answer: 當然，我工作這麼辛苦，這是我應得的。
entries.answerPinyin: dāng rán, wǒ gōng zuò zhè me xīn kǔ, zhè shì wǒ yīng dé de.
entries.answerEnglish: Of course. I work so hard; I've earned it.

entries.example: 這座老廟已經修復好了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zuò lǎo miào yǐ jīng xiū fù hǎo le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This old temple has been restored.
entries.question: 你會自己修復舊家具嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zì jǐ xiū fù jiù jiā jù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you restore old furniture yourself?
entries.answer: 會，我修復過一張舊椅子。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ xiū fù guò yì zhāng jiù yǐ zi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I once restored an old chair.

entries.example: 這位神父在台灣住了三十年。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè wèi shén fù zài tái wān zhù le sān shí nián.
entries.exampleEnglish: This priest has lived in Taiwan for thirty years.
entries.question: 你認識任何神父嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ rèn shì rèn hé shén fù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know any priests?
entries.answer: 認識，我家附近教堂的神父很友善。
entries.answerPinyin: rèn shì, wǒ jiā fù jìn jiào táng de shén fù hěn yǒu shàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the priest at the church near my home is very friendly.

entries.example: 以前猴硐的人靠挖煤生活。
entries.examplePinyin: yǐ qián hóu dòng de rén kào wā méi shēng huó.
entries.exampleEnglish: People in Houtong used to make a living mining coal.
entries.question: 你覺得還應該用煤發電嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de hái yīng gāi yòng méi fā diàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think we should still use coal to generate electricity?
entries.answer: 我覺得不應該再用煤發電了。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de bú yīng gāi zài yòng méi fā diàn le.
entries.answerEnglish: I don't think we should use coal for power anymore.

entries.example: 這次颱風的風雨很猛烈。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì tái fēng de fēng yǔ hěn měng liè.
entries.exampleEnglish: The wind and rain from this typhoon were fierce.
entries.question: 你遇過很猛烈的颱風嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yù guò hěn měng liè de tái fēng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been through a really fierce typhoon?
entries.answer: 遇過，去年那個颱風特別猛烈。
entries.answerPinyin: yù guò, qù nián nà ge tái fēng tè bié měng liè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, last year's typhoon was especially fierce.

entries.example: 山上的空氣很純淨。
entries.examplePinyin: shān shàng de kōng qì hěn chún jìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The air in the mountains is very pure.
entries.question: 你覺得哪裡的空氣最純淨？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǎ lǐ de kōng qì zuì chún jìng?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you think the air is purest?
entries.answer: 我覺得合歡山的空氣最純淨。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de hé huān shān de kōng qì zuì chún jìng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think the air on Hehuan Mountain is the purest.

entries.example: 他沒受過正規的音樂訓練。
entries.examplePinyin: tā méi shòu guò zhèng guī de yīn yuè xùn liàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's never had formal music training.
entries.question: 你上過正規的中文課嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shàng guò zhèng guī de zhōng wén kè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever taken formal Chinese classes?
entries.answer: 上過，我在師大上過正規的中文課。
entries.answerPinyin: shàng guò, wǒ zài shī dà shàng guò zhèng guī de zhōng wén kè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I took formal Chinese classes at NTNU.

entries.example: 他努力控制心裡的怒氣。
entries.examplePinyin: tā nǔ lì kòng zhì xīn lǐ de nù qì.
entries.exampleEnglish: He tried hard to control his anger.
entries.question: 你生氣的時候怎麼消除怒氣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēng qì de shí hòu zěn me xiāo chú nù qì?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you get rid of your anger when you're mad?
entries.answer: 我會去跑步，讓怒氣慢慢消失。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì qù pǎo bù, ràng nù qì màn màn xiāo shī.
entries.answerEnglish: I go for a run and let my anger fade.

entries.example: 每當下雨，我就想喝熱湯。
entries.examplePinyin: měi dāng xià yǔ, wǒ jiù xiǎng hē rè tāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Whenever it rains, I feel like having hot soup.
entries.question: 每當你心情不好，你會做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: měi dāng nǐ xīn qíng bù hǎo, nǐ huì zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do whenever you're in a bad mood?
entries.answer: 每當心情不好，我就去河邊散步。
entries.answerPinyin: měi dāng xīn qíng bù hǎo, wǒ jiù qù hé biān sàn bù.
entries.answerEnglish: Whenever I'm in a bad mood, I go for a walk by the river.

entries.example: 騎機車不戴安全帽是違法的。
entries.examplePinyin: qí jī chē bú dài ān quán mào shì wéi fǎ de.
entries.exampleEnglish: Riding a scooter without a helmet is illegal.
entries.question: 在你的國家，什麼事是違法的？
entries.questionPinyin: zài nǐ de guó jiā, shén me shì shì wéi fǎ de?
entries.questionEnglish: In your country, what is illegal?
entries.answer: 在我的國家，在路上喝酒是違法的。
entries.answerPinyin: zài wǒ de guó jiā, zài lù shang hē jiǔ shì wéi fǎ de.
entries.answerEnglish: In my country, drinking in the street is illegal.

entries.example: 健康比財富更重要。
entries.examplePinyin: jiàn kāng bǐ cái fù gèng zhòng yào.
entries.exampleEnglish: Health is more important than wealth.
entries.question: 你覺得財富能帶來快樂嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de cái fù néng dài lái kuài lè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think wealth brings happiness?
entries.answer: 我覺得財富不一定能帶來快樂。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de cái fù bù yí dìng néng dài lái kuài lè.
entries.answerEnglish: I don't think wealth necessarily brings happiness.

entries.example: 我抵擋不了雞排的香味。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ dǐ dǎng bù liǎo jī pái de xiāng wèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: I can't resist the smell of fried chicken cutlets.
entries.question: 你抵擋得了甜點的誘惑嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dǐ dǎng de liǎo tián diǎn de yòu huò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you resist the temptation of desserts?
entries.answer: 抵擋不了，我每天都要吃甜點。
entries.answerPinyin: dǐ dǎng bù liǎo, wǒ měi tiān dōu yào chī tián diǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I have to have dessert every day.

entries.example: 發票上的總金額是三百五十元。
entries.examplePinyin: fā piào shàng de zǒng jīn é shì sān bǎi wǔ shí yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: The total on the receipt is 350 NT dollars.
entries.question: 你這個月網購的總金額是多少？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhè ge yuè wǎng gòu de zǒng jīn é shì duō shǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: How much have you spent shopping online this month in total?
entries.answer: 總金額大概五千塊吧。
entries.answerPinyin: zǒng jīn é dà gài wǔ qiān kuài ba.
entries.answerEnglish: The total is about five thousand dollars, I think.

entries.example: 在台灣，紅色象徵好運。
entries.examplePinyin: zài tái wān, hóng sè xiàng zhēng hǎo yùn.
entries.exampleEnglish: In Taiwan, red symbolizes good luck.
entries.question: 在你的國家，什麼顏色象徵好運？
entries.questionPinyin: zài nǐ de guó jiā, shén me yán sè xiàng zhēng hǎo yùn?
entries.questionEnglish: In your country, what color symbolizes good luck?
entries.answer: 在我的國家，綠色象徵好運。
entries.answerPinyin: zài wǒ de guó jiā, lǜ sè xiàng zhēng hǎo yùn.
entries.answerEnglish: In my country, green symbolizes good luck.

entries.example: 孩子們在公園盪鞦韆。
entries.examplePinyin: hái zi men zài gōng yuán dàng qiū qiān.
entries.exampleEnglish: The kids are on the swings in the park.
entries.question: 你小時候喜歡盪鞦韆嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu xǐ huan dàng qiū qiān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you like playing on swings as a kid?
entries.answer: 很喜歡，我常常把鞦韆盪得很高。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn xǐ huan, wǒ cháng cháng bǎ qiū qiān dàng de hěn gāo.
entries.answerEnglish: I loved it. I used to swing really high.

entries.example: 去山上走走，心靈會比較平靜。
entries.examplePinyin: qù shān shàng zǒu zǒu, xīn líng huì bǐ jiào píng jìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: A walk in the mountains brings peace of mind.
entries.question: 你怎麼讓自己的心靈平靜？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zěn me ràng zì jǐ de xīn líng píng jìng?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you find peace of mind?
entries.answer: 我會去寺廟坐一坐，讓心靈平靜。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì qù sì miào zuò yi zuò, ràng xīn líng píng jìng.
entries.answerEnglish: I go sit in a temple for a while to calm my mind.

entries.example: 臭豆腐的氣味很特別。
entries.examplePinyin: chòu dòu fu de qì wèi hěn tè bié.
entries.exampleEnglish: Stinky tofu has a very distinctive smell.
entries.question: 你最喜歡什麼氣味？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan shén me qì wèi?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your favorite smell?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡剛煮好的咖啡的氣味。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan gāng zhǔ hǎo de kā fēi de qì wèi.
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite smell is freshly brewed coffee.

entries.example: 台北的生活步調很快。
entries.examplePinyin: tái běi de shēng huó bù diào hěn kuài.
entries.exampleEnglish: Life in Taipei moves at a fast pace.
entries.question: 你喜歡快步調還是慢步調的生活？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kuài bù diào hái shì màn bù diào de shēng huó?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer a fast-paced or slow-paced life?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡慢步調的生活，像台東那樣。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan màn bù diào de shēng huó, xiàng tái dōng nà yàng.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer a slower pace of life, like in Taitung.

entries.example: 小狗把骨頭埋在院子裡。
entries.examplePinyin: xiǎo gǒu bǎ gǔ tou mái zài yuàn zi lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The puppy buried its bone in the yard.
entries.question: 你小時候埋過什麼東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu mái guò shén me dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you ever bury anything as a kid?
entries.answer: 埋過，我在樹下埋過一個小盒子。
entries.answerPinyin: mái guò, wǒ zài shù xià mái guò yí gè xiǎo hé zi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I buried a little box under a tree.

entries.example: 起初我聽不懂台語，現在懂一點了。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐ chū wǒ tīng bù dǒng tái yǔ, xiàn zài dǒng yì diǎn le.
entries.exampleEnglish: At first I couldn't understand Taiwanese, but now I understand a little.
entries.question: 你起初為什麼來台灣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qǐ chū wèi shén me lái tái wān?
entries.questionEnglish: Why did you come to Taiwan in the first place?
entries.answer: 我起初是來台灣學中文的。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qǐ chū shì lái tái wān xué zhōng wén de.
entries.answerEnglish: I originally came to Taiwan to study Chinese.

entries.example: 她的興趣很廣泛。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de xìng qù hěn guǎng fàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: She has a wide range of interests.
entries.question: 你的興趣廣泛嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de xìng qù guǎng fàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a wide range of interests?
entries.answer: 很廣泛，我喜歡運動、音樂和旅行。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn guǎng fàn, wǒ xǐ huan yùn dòng, yīn yuè hé lǚ xíng.
entries.answerEnglish: Very wide. I like sports, music and travel.

entries.example: 最近的天氣很極端，一下熱一下冷。
entries.examplePinyin: zuì jìn de tiān qì hěn jí duān, yí xià rè yí xià lěng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The weather's been extreme lately: hot one minute, cold the next.
entries.question: 你覺得自己的想法極端嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ jí duān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your views are extreme?
entries.answer: 不會，我的想法一點也不極端。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ de xiǎng fǎ yì diǎn yě bù jí duān.
entries.answerEnglish: No, my views aren't extreme at all.

entries.example: 一直找不到工作，讓他很焦慮。
entries.examplePinyin: yì zhí zhǎo bú dào gōng zuò, ràng tā hěn jiāo lǜ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Not being able to find a job has made him very anxious.
entries.question: 什麼事會讓你焦慮？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shì huì ràng nǐ jiāo lǜ?
entries.questionEnglish: What makes you anxious?
entries.answer: 工作太多的時候，我會很焦慮。
entries.answerPinyin: gōng zuò tài duō de shí hòu, wǒ huì hěn jiāo lǜ.
entries.answerEnglish: I get anxious when I have too much work.

entries.example: 用了這瓶洗髮精，頭髮變得很滑順。
entries.examplePinyin: yòng le zhè píng xǐ fǎ jīng, tóu fǎ biàn de hěn huá shùn.
entries.exampleEnglish: After using this shampoo, my hair became very silky.
entries.question: 你喜歡口感滑順的布丁嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kǒu gǎn huá shùn de bù dīng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like pudding with a smooth texture?
entries.answer: 喜歡，越滑順的布丁越好吃。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, yuè huá shùn de bù dīng yuè hǎo chī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the smoother the pudding, the better.

entries.example: 這件毛衣摸起來很粗糙。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn máo yī mō qǐ lái hěn cū cāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This sweater feels rough.
entries.question: 你的手冬天會變粗糙嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de shǒu dōng tiān huì biàn cū cāo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do your hands get rough in winter?
entries.answer: 會，冬天我的手很粗糙，要擦乳液。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, dōng tiān wǒ de shǒu hěn cū cāo, yào cā rǔ yì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my hands get rough in winter, so I use lotion.

entries.example: 這次颱風讓很多作物都壞了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì tái fēng ràng hěn duō zuò wù dōu huài le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This typhoon ruined a lot of crops.
entries.question: 你的家鄉主要種什麼作物？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de jiā xiāng zhǔ yào zhòng shén me zuò wù?
entries.questionEnglish: What crops are mainly grown in your hometown?
entries.answer: 我的家鄉主要的作物是玉米。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de jiā xiāng zhǔ yào de zuò wù shì yù mǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: The main crop in my hometown is corn.

entries.example: 夏天用電太多，電力負荷很大。
entries.examplePinyin: xià tiān yòng diàn tài duō, diàn lì fù hè hěn dà.
entries.exampleEnglish: In summer we use so much electricity that the grid is under heavy load.
entries.question: 你最近的工作量負荷得了嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn de gōng zuò liàng fù hè de liǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you handle your workload lately?
entries.answer: 有點負荷不了，我每天都加班。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu diǎn fù hè bù liǎo, wǒ měi tiān dōu jiā bān.
entries.answerEnglish: I can barely handle it; I'm working overtime every day.

entries.example: 他在公司的級別比我高。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài gōng sī de jí bié bǐ wǒ gāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's at a higher rank than me in the company.
entries.question: 在你的公司，級別高的人薪水比較多嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zài nǐ de gōng sī, jí bié gāo de rén xīn shuǐ bǐ jiào duō ma?
entries.questionEnglish: In your company, do people at higher levels earn more?
entries.answer: 對，級別越高，薪水越多。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, jí bié yuè gāo, xīn shuǐ yuè duō.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the higher the level, the higher the pay.

entries.example: 下樓梯的時候，請扶著欄杆。
entries.examplePinyin: xià lóu tī de shí hòu, qǐng fú zhe lán gān.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please hold the railing when you go down the stairs.
entries.question: 你會在陽台的欄杆上曬東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zài yáng tái de lán gān shàng shài dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you hang things to dry on your balcony railing?
entries.answer: 會，我常常把棉被掛在欄杆上曬。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng cháng bǎ mián bèi guà zài lán gān shàng shài.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often hang my comforter on the railing to air it in the sun.

entries.example: 她每個月都捐錢給慈善團體。
entries.examplePinyin: tā měi gè yuè dōu juān qián gěi cí shàn tuán tǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: She donates money to charity every month.
entries.question: 你捐過錢給慈善團體嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ juān guò qián gěi cí shàn tuán tǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever donated money to a charity?
entries.answer: 捐過，我每年都捐給一個慈善團體。
entries.answerPinyin: juān guò, wǒ měi nián dōu juān gěi yí gè cí shàn tuán tǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I donate to a charity every year.

entries.example: 台北的房價高得驚人。
entries.examplePinyin: tái běi de fáng jià gāo de jīng rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: Housing prices in Taipei are astonishingly high.
entries.question: 台灣有什麼讓你覺得很驚人？
entries.questionPinyin: tái wān yǒu shén me ràng nǐ jué de hěn jīng rén?
entries.questionEnglish: What about Taiwan do you find amazing?
entries.answer: 台灣便利商店的數量很驚人。
entries.answerPinyin: tái wān biàn lì shāng diàn de shù liàng hěn jīng rén.
entries.answerEnglish: The number of convenience stores in Taiwan is amazing.

entries.example: 水從這根管子流出來。
entries.examplePinyin: shuǐ cóng zhè gēn guǎn zi liú chū lái.
entries.exampleEnglish: Water comes out of this pipe.
entries.question: 你家的水管出過問題嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de shuǐ guǎn chū guò wèn tí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have the pipes in your home ever had problems?
entries.answer: 有，上個月廚房的管子漏水。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, shàng gè yuè chú fáng de guǎn zi lòu shuǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a pipe in the kitchen leaked last month.

entries.example: 我終於克服了怕水的問題。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zhōng yú kè fú le pà shuǐ de wèn tí.
entries.exampleEnglish: I finally got over my fear of water.
entries.question: 學中文的時候，你克服了什麼困難？
entries.questionPinyin: xué zhōng wén de shí hòu, nǐ kè fú le shén me kùn nán?
entries.questionEnglish: What difficulties have you overcome while learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 我克服了聲調的問題，現在說得比較好了。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ kè fú le shēng diào de wèn tí, xiàn zài shuō de bǐ jiào hǎo le.
entries.answerEnglish: I overcame my trouble with tones, and now I speak better.

entries.example: 我在公司還很資淺，要學的很多。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài gōng sī hái hěn zī qiǎn, yào xué de hěn duō.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm still junior at the company and have a lot to learn.
entries.question: 你在公司算資深還是資淺？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài gōng sī suàn zī shēn hái shì zī qiǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you senior or junior at your company?
entries.answer: 我還很資淺，才來半年。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ hái hěn zī qiǎn, cái lái bàn nián.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm still junior; I've only been there six months.

entries.example: 傷口要保持乾淨，不然會感染。
entries.examplePinyin: shāng kǒu yào bǎo chí gān jìng, bù rán huì gǎn rǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Keep the wound clean, or it will get infected.
entries.question: 怎麼做可以避免感染流感？
entries.questionPinyin: zěn me zuò kě yǐ bì miǎn gǎn rǎn liú gǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: What can you do to avoid catching the flu?
entries.answer: 常常洗手、打疫苗，可以避免感染。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng xǐ shǒu, dǎ yì miáo, kě yǐ bì miǎn gǎn rǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Washing your hands often and getting vaccinated helps you avoid infection.

entries.example: 我在墾丁的海邊撿了很多貝殼。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài kěn dīng de hǎi biān jiǎn le hěn duō bèi ké.
entries.exampleEnglish: I picked up lots of seashells on the beach in Kenting.
entries.question: 你在海邊撿過貝殼嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài hǎi biān jiǎn guò bèi ké ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever collected shells at the beach?
entries.answer: 撿過，我家裡有一盒貝殼。
entries.answerPinyin: jiǎn guò, wǒ jiā lǐ yǒu yì hé bèi ké.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a box of shells at home.

entries.example: 你的臉色好蒼白，還好嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: nǐ de liǎn sè hǎo cāng bái, hái hǎo ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: You look so pale. Are you OK?
entries.question: 你生病的時候臉色會蒼白嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēng bìng de shí hòu liǎn sè huì cāng bái ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you look pale when you're sick?
entries.answer: 會，我感冒的時候臉色很蒼白。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ gǎn mào de shí hòu liǎn sè hěn cāng bái.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I look very pale when I have a cold.

entries.example: 那真是一個愚蠢的決定。
entries.examplePinyin: nà zhēn shì yí gè yú chǔn de jué dìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: That was a really foolish decision.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼行為很愚蠢？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me xíng wéi hěn yú chǔn?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of behavior do you think is foolish?
entries.answer: 我覺得騎車滑手機很愚蠢。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de qí chē huá shǒu jī hěn yú chǔn.
entries.answerEnglish: I think looking at your phone while riding is foolish.

entries.example: 以前有錢人家裡都有僕人。
entries.examplePinyin: yǐ qián yǒu qián rén jiā lǐ dōu yǒu pú rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: In the past, wealthy families all had servants.
entries.question: 如果有一個僕人，你想讓他做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ yǒu yí gè pú rén, nǐ xiǎng ràng tā zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: If you had a servant, what would you have them do?
entries.answer: 我想讓僕人幫我打掃房子。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng ràng pú rén bāng wǒ dǎ sǎo fáng zi.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd have the servant clean my house.

entries.example: 買衣服以前，我會先看標籤。
entries.examplePinyin: mǎi yī fu yǐ qián, wǒ huì xiān kàn biāo qiān.
entries.exampleEnglish: Before I buy clothes, I check the label.
entries.question: 你買食物的時候會看標籤嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi shí wù de shí hòu huì kàn biāo qiān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you read the labels when you buy food?
entries.answer: 會，我都會看營養標籤。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōu huì kàn yíng yǎng biāo qiān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always read the nutrition label.

entries.example: 她是我們公司的高階主管。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì wǒ men gōng sī de gāo jiē zhǔ guǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's a senior executive at our company.
entries.question: 你想上高階的中文課嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng shàng gāo jiē de zhōng wén kè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to take an advanced Chinese class?
entries.answer: 想，我明年想上高階的課。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, wǒ míng nián xiǎng shàng gāo jiē de kè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I want to take an advanced class next year.

entries.example: 石頭一丟進水裡就沉下去了。
entries.examplePinyin: shí tou yì diū jìn shuǐ lǐ jiù chén xià qù le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The stone sank as soon as it was thrown into the water.
entries.question: 你游泳的時候會一直往下沉嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yóu yǒng de shí hòu huì yì zhí wǎng xià chén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you keep sinking when you swim?
entries.answer: 不會，我很會游泳，不會沉下去。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ hěn huì yóu yǒng, bú huì chén xià qù.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I'm a good swimmer, so I don't sink.

entries.example: 現在的年輕人傾向晚一點結婚。
entries.examplePinyin: xiàn zài de nián qīng rén qīng xiàng wǎn yì diǎn jié hūn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Young people nowadays tend to marry later.
entries.question: 你傾向自己煮飯還是外食？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qīng xiàng zì jǐ zhǔ fàn hái shì wài shí?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you tend to cook for yourself or eat out?
entries.answer: 我傾向外食，因為比較方便。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qīng xiàng wài shí, yīn wèi bǐ jiào fāng biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I tend to eat out, because it's more convenient.

entries.example: 冬天的到來，讓人想吃薑母鴨。
entries.examplePinyin: dōng tiān de dào lái, ràng rén xiǎng chī jiāng mǔ yā.
entries.exampleEnglish: The arrival of winter makes people crave ginger duck.
entries.question: 你最期待哪個節日的到來？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì qí dài nǎ gè jié rì de dào lái?
entries.questionEnglish: Which holiday are you most looking forward to?
entries.answer: 我最期待春節的到來。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì qí dài chūn jié de dào lái.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm most looking forward to Chinese New Year.

entries.example: 這裡的水果要秤重算錢。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè lǐ de shuǐ guǒ yào chèng zhòng suàn qián.
entries.exampleEnglish: The fruit here is priced by weight.
entries.question: 你寄包裹以前會先秤重嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jì bāo guǒ yǐ qián huì xiān chèng zhòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you weigh your packages before mailing them?
entries.answer: 會，我都先秤重再去郵局寄。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōu xiān chèng zhòng zài qù yóu jú jì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always weigh them first, then go to the post office.

entries.example: 他在偏遠的山區當醫生。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài piān yuǎn de shān qū dāng yī shēng.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a doctor in a remote mountain area.
entries.question: 你想住在偏遠的地方嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng zhù zài piān yuǎn de dì fāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to live somewhere remote?
entries.answer: 不想，偏遠的地方交通不方便。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xiǎng, piān yuǎn de dì fāng jiāo tōng bù fāng biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: No, getting around in remote places is inconvenient.

entries.example: 這家小店的甜點讓人很驚豔。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā xiǎo diàn de tián diǎn ràng rén hěn jīng yàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The desserts at this little shop are stunning.
entries.question: 你吃過讓你驚豔的台灣小吃嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chī guò ràng nǐ jīng yàn de tái wān xiǎo chī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you had any Taiwanese street food that wowed you?
entries.answer: 吃過，割包讓我很驚豔。
entries.answerPinyin: chī guò, gē bāo ràng wǒ hěn jīng yàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, gua bao really wowed me.

entries.example: 我們討論了很久，最終決定去花蓮。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men tǎo lùn le hěn jiǔ, zuì zhōng jué dìng qù huā lián.
entries.exampleEnglish: We talked it over for a long time and finally decided to go to Hualien.
entries.question: 你學中文的最終目標是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xué zhōng wén de zuì zhōng mù biāo shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your ultimate goal in learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 我的最終目標是用中文工作。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de zuì zhōng mù biāo shì yòng zhōng wén gōng zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: My ultimate goal is to work in Chinese.

entries.example: 我同事是咖啡愛好者，每天喝三杯。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ tóng shì shì kā fēi ài hào zhě, měi tiān hē sān bēi.
entries.exampleEnglish: My coworker is a coffee lover; he drinks three cups a day.
entries.question: 你是什麼運動的愛好者？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shì shén me yùn dòng de ài hào zhě?
entries.questionEnglish: What sport are you a fan of?
entries.answer: 我是棒球愛好者，常去看比賽。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ shì bàng qiú ài hào zhě, cháng qù kàn bǐ sài.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm a baseball fan; I often go to games.

entries.example: 我和我太太是在捷運上相遇的。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hé wǒ tài tài shì zài jié yùn shàng xiāng yù de.
entries.exampleEnglish: My wife and I met on the MRT.
entries.question: 你和你最好的朋友在哪裡相遇？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ hé nǐ zuì hǎo de péng yǒu zài nǎ lǐ xiāng yù?
entries.questionEnglish: Where did you meet your best friend?
entries.answer: 我們是在語言學校相遇的。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men shì zài yǔ yán xué xiào xiāng yù de.
entries.answerEnglish: We met at a language school.

entries.example: 他爺爺七十歲的時候失明了。
entries.examplePinyin: tā yé ye qī shí suì de shí hòu shī míng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: His grandfather went blind at seventy.
entries.question: 你覺得失明的人在台北生活方便嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shī míng de rén zài tái běi shēng huó fāng biàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think life in Taipei is convenient for blind people?
entries.answer: 還算方便，捷運對失明的人很友善。
entries.answerPinyin: hái suàn fāng biàn, jié yùn duì shī míng de rén hěn yǒu shàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Fairly convenient; the MRT is friendly to blind people.

entries.example: 看到他們結婚，我心裡充滿了喜悅。
entries.examplePinyin: kàn dào tā men jié hūn, wǒ xīn lǐ chōng mǎn le xǐ yuè.
entries.exampleEnglish: Seeing them get married filled my heart with joy.
entries.question: 最近什麼事讓你感到喜悅？
entries.questionPinyin: zuì jìn shén me shì ràng nǐ gǎn dào xǐ yuè?
entries.questionEnglish: What has brought you joy recently?
entries.answer: 通過中文考試讓我感到很喜悅。
entries.answerPinyin: tōng guò zhōng wén kǎo shì ràng wǒ gǎn dào hěn xǐ yuè.
entries.answerEnglish: Passing my Chinese exam filled me with joy.

entries.example: 沒有主管的許可，不能進這個房間。
entries.examplePinyin: méi yǒu zhǔ guǎn de xǔ kě, bù néng jìn zhè ge fáng jiān.
entries.exampleEnglish: You can't enter this room without the manager's permission.
entries.question: 你在台灣工作需要工作許可嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān gōng zuò xū yào gōng zuò xǔ kě ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you need a work permit to work in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 需要，我去年申請了工作許可。
entries.answerPinyin: xū yào, wǒ qù nián shēn qǐng le gōng zuò xǔ kě.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I applied for a work permit last year.

entries.example: 他用一根竿子把樹上的球拿下來。
entries.examplePinyin: tā yòng yì gēn gān zi bǎ shù shàng de qiú ná xià lái.
entries.exampleEnglish: He used a pole to get the ball down from the tree.
entries.question: 你家陽台有曬衣服的竿子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yáng tái yǒu shài yī fu de gān zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a pole for drying clothes on your balcony?
entries.answer: 有，我們陽台有兩根竿子。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men yáng tái yǒu liǎng gēn gān zi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are two poles on our balcony.

entries.example: 這個設計很有想像力。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge shè jì hěn yǒu xiǎng xiàng lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This design is very imaginative.
entries.question: 你覺得自己有想像力嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ yǒu xiǎng xiàng lì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're imaginative?
entries.answer: 我覺得我很有想像力，喜歡畫畫。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de wǒ hěn yǒu xiǎng xiàng lì, xǐ huan huà huà.
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm quite imaginative; I like drawing.

entries.example: 我在歐洲旅行時參觀了一座宮殿。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài ōu zhōu lǚ xíng shí cān guān le yí zuò gōng diàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: When I traveled in Europe, I visited a palace.
entries.question: 你參觀過哪個國家的宮殿？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān guān guò nǎ gè guó jiā de gōng diàn?
entries.questionEnglish: Which country's palaces have you visited?
entries.answer: 我參觀過英國和法國的宮殿。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cān guān guò yīng guó hé fǎ guó de gōng diàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I've visited palaces in the UK and France.

entries.example: 我們這次去墾丁住在一間度假村。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zhè cì qù kěn dīng zhù zài yì jiān dù jià cūn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This time in Kenting we stayed at a resort.
entries.question: 你喜歡住度假村還是民宿？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zhù dù jià cūn hái shì mín sù?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer staying at resorts or B&Bs?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡住度假村，比較舒服。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan zhù dù jià cūn, bǐ jiào shū fú.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer resorts; they're more comfortable.

entries.example: 去爬玉山前，要先準備好裝備。
entries.examplePinyin: qù pá yù shān qián, yào xiān zhǔn bèi hǎo zhuāng bèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: Before climbing Jade Mountain, you need to get your gear ready.
entries.question: 你運動的時候需要什麼裝備？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yùn dòng de shí hòu xū yào shén me zhuāng bèi?
entries.questionEnglish: What gear do you need when you exercise?
entries.answer: 我騎腳踏車需要安全帽和其他裝備。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qí jiǎo tà chē xū yào ān quán mào hé qí tā zhuāng bèi.
entries.answerEnglish: For cycling I need a helmet and other gear.

entries.example: 白色的桌子上有很多咖啡的痕跡。
entries.examplePinyin: bái sè de zhuō zi shàng yǒu hěn duō kā fēi de hén jī.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of coffee marks on the white table.
entries.question: 你的行李箱上有很多痕跡嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de xíng li xiāng shàng yǒu hěn duō hén jī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your suitcase have a lot of marks on it?
entries.answer: 有，上面都是旅行留下的痕跡。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, shàng miàn dōu shì lǚ xíng liú xià de hén jī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, it's covered in marks from my travels.

entries.example: 這個包包是用真的皮革做的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge bāo bāo shì yòng zhēn de pí gé zuò de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This bag is made of real leather.
entries.question: 你有皮革做的東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu pí gé zuò de dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have anything made of leather?
entries.answer: 有，我的皮夾是皮革做的。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de pí jiā shì pí gé zuò de.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my wallet is made of leather.

entries.example: 這個公式可以幫你算每個月的花費。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge gōng shì kě yǐ bāng nǐ suàn měi gè yuè de huā fèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: This formula can help you calculate your monthly expenses.
entries.question: 你工作的時候會用到公式嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gōng zuò de shí hòu huì yòng dào gōng shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use formulas at work?
entries.answer: 會，我常在表格裡用公式算錢。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng zài biǎo gé lǐ yòng gōng shì suàn qián.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often use formulas in spreadsheets to calculate money.

entries.example: 悠遊卡的儲值上限是一萬元。
entries.examplePinyin: yōu yóu kǎ de chú zhí shàng xiàn shì yí wàn yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: The top-up limit on an EasyCard is NT$10,000.
entries.question: 你每個月買衣服的花費有上限嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ měi gè yuè mǎi yī fu de huā fèi yǒu shàng xiàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a monthly limit on what you spend on clothes?
entries.answer: 有，我每個月的上限是三千塊。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ měi gè yuè de shàng xiàn shì sān qiān kuài.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my monthly limit is three thousand dollars.

entries.example: 他的中文說得很出色，像台灣人一樣。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de zhōng wén shuō de hěn chū sè, xiàng tái wān rén yí yàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: His Chinese is excellent, just like a Taiwanese person's.
entries.question: 你身邊誰的工作表現最出色？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēn biān shéi de gōng zuò biǎo xiàn zuì chū sè?
entries.questionEnglish: Who around you does the most outstanding work?
entries.answer: 我的主管表現最出色，大家都很佩服她。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de zhǔ guǎn biǎo xiàn zuì chū sè, dà jiā dōu hěn pèi fú tā.
entries.answerEnglish: My supervisor is the most outstanding; everyone admires her.

entries.example: 找了一個月的工作都沒有消息，他覺得很絕望。
entries.examplePinyin: zhǎo le yí gè yuè de gōng zuò dōu méi yǒu xiāo xí, tā jué de hěn jué wàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: After a month of job hunting with no news, he felt desperate.
entries.question: 你有沒有覺得很絕望的時候？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu jué de hěn jué wàng de shí hòu?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever felt hopeless?
entries.answer: 有，剛來台灣找不到房子時很絕望。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, gāng lái tái wān zhǎo bú dào fáng zi shí hěn jué wàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when I first came to Taiwan and couldn't find a place, I felt desperate.

entries.example: 買零食前，我會先看成分。
entries.examplePinyin: mǎi líng shí qián, wǒ huì xiān kàn chéng fèn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Before buying snacks, I check the ingredients.
entries.question: 你買東西會看成分嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi dōng xī huì kàn chéng fèn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you check the ingredients when you shop?
entries.answer: 會，我會看成分有沒有花生。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì kàn chéng fèn yǒu méi yǒu huā shēng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I check whether the ingredients include peanuts.

entries.example: 這部台劇的情節很吸引人。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù tái jù de qíng jié hěn xī yǐn rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: The plot of this Taiwanese drama is really gripping.
entries.question: 你喜歡情節簡單還是複雜的電影？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan qíng jié jiǎn dān hái shì fù zá de diàn yǐng?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like movies with simple or complicated plots?
entries.answer: 我喜歡情節複雜一點的電影。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan qíng jié fù zá yì diǎn de diàn yǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: I like movies with more complicated plots.

entries.example: 這件事跟我沒關係，我是無辜的！
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn shì gēn wǒ méi guān xì, wǒ shì wú gū de!
entries.exampleEnglish: This has nothing to do with me; I'm innocent!
entries.question: 你小時候做錯事會裝無辜嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu zuò cuò shì huì zhuāng wú gū ma?
entries.questionEnglish: As a kid, did you act innocent when you did something wrong?
entries.answer: 會，我常常裝出很無辜的樣子。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng cháng zhuāng chū hěn wú gū de yàng zi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often put on an innocent look.

entries.example: 我用平底鍋煎蛋。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ yòng píng dǐ guō jiān dàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I fry eggs in a frying pan.
entries.question: 你家有平底鍋嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yǒu píng dǐ guō ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a frying pan at home?
entries.answer: 有，我常用平底鍋做早餐。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ cháng yòng píng dǐ guō zuò zǎo cān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often use the frying pan to make breakfast.

entries.example: 我們的友誼已經十年了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men de yǒu yì yǐ jīng shí nián le.
entries.exampleEnglish: Our friendship has lasted ten years.
entries.question: 你覺得網路上的友誼是真的嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de wǎng lù shang de yǒu yì shì zhēn de ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think online friendships are real?
entries.answer: 我覺得網路上也可以有真的友誼。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de wǎng lù shang yě kě yǐ yǒu zhēn de yǒu yì.
entries.answerEnglish: I think real friendships can happen online too.

entries.example: 從台北去宜蘭要經過雪山隧道。
entries.examplePinyin: cóng tái běi qù yí lán yào jīng guò xuě shān suì dào.
entries.exampleEnglish: To get from Taipei to Yilan you go through the Hsuehshan Tunnel.
entries.question: 你走過最長的隧道在哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zǒu guò zuì cháng de suì dào zài nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where is the longest tunnel you've been through?
entries.answer: 我走過最長的隧道是雪山隧道。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zǒu guò zuì cháng de suì dào shì xuě shān suì dào.
entries.answerEnglish: The longest tunnel I've been through is the Hsuehshan Tunnel.

entries.example: 搬家公司開了一輛大貨車來。
entries.examplePinyin: bān jiā gōng sī kāi le yí liàng dà huò chē lái.
entries.exampleEnglish: The moving company came with a big truck.
entries.question: 你搬家的時候有租貨車嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bān jiā de shí hòu yǒu zū huò chē ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you rent a truck when you moved?
entries.answer: 有，我租了一輛小貨車。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ zū le yí liàng xiǎo huò chē.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I rented a small truck.

entries.example: 外面好熱，我們找個陰涼的地方休息吧。
entries.examplePinyin: wài miàn hǎo rè, wǒ men zhǎo gè yīn liáng de dì fāng xiū xí ba.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's so hot out; let's find a shady spot to rest.
entries.question: 夏天你喜歡去哪裡找陰涼的地方？
entries.questionPinyin: xià tiān nǐ xǐ huan qù nǎ lǐ zhǎo yīn liáng de dì fāng?
entries.questionEnglish: In summer, where do you like to go to find some shade?
entries.answer: 我喜歡去公園大樹下陰涼的地方。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan qù gōng yuán dà shù xià yīn liáng de dì fāng.
entries.answerEnglish: I like the shady spots under the big trees in the park.

entries.example: 他的道歉很真誠，我原諒他了。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de dào qiàn hěn zhēn chéng, wǒ yuán liàng tā le.
entries.exampleEnglish: His apology was sincere, so I forgave him.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣人對你真誠嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān rén duì nǐ zhēn chéng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwanese people are sincere with you?
entries.answer: 很真誠，我的台灣朋友都很照顧我。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn zhēn chéng, wǒ de tái wān péng yǒu dōu hěn zhào gù wǒ.
entries.answerEnglish: Very sincere; my Taiwanese friends take good care of me.

entries.example: 這個月工作很辛苦，我買了新鞋給自己當獎賞。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge yuè gōng zuò hěn xīn kǔ, wǒ mǎi le xīn xié gěi zì jǐ dàng jiǎng shǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Work was hard this month, so I bought myself new shoes as a reward.
entries.question: 你完成一件大事後，會給自己什麼獎賞？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ wán chéng yí jiàn dà shì hòu, huì gěi zì jǐ shén me jiǎng shǎng?
entries.questionEnglish: After finishing something big, how do you reward yourself?
entries.answer: 我會吃一頓好吃的當作獎賞。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì chī yí dùn hǎo chī de dàng zuò jiǎng shǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: I treat myself to a nice meal as a reward.

entries.example: 學中文有什麼訣竅嗎？
entries.examplePinyin: xué zhōng wén yǒu shén me jué qiào ma?
entries.exampleEnglish: Is there any trick to learning Chinese?
entries.question: 你學語言有什麼訣竅？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xué yǔ yán yǒu shén me jué qiào?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your trick for learning languages?
entries.answer: 我的訣竅是每天跟台灣人聊天。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de jué qiào shì měi tiān gēn tái wān rén liáo tiān.
entries.answerEnglish: My secret is chatting with Taiwanese people every day.

entries.example: 這次旅行的亮點是看日出。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì lǚ xíng de liàng diǎn shì kàn rì chū.
entries.exampleEnglish: The highlight of this trip was watching the sunrise.
entries.question: 你今年最大的亮點是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jīn nián zuì dà de liàng diǎn shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What has been your biggest highlight this year?
entries.answer: 今年最大的亮點是我通過了中文考試。
entries.answerPinyin: jīn nián zuì dà de liàng diǎn shì wǒ tōng guò le zhōng wén kǎo shì.
entries.answerEnglish: My biggest highlight this year was passing my Chinese exam.

entries.example: 昨天附近的工廠發生爆炸，大家都嚇到了。
entries.examplePinyin: zuó tiān fù jìn de gōng chǎng fā shēng bào zhà, dà jiā dōu xià dào le.
entries.exampleEnglish: Yesterday there was an explosion at a nearby factory, and everyone was shocked.
entries.question: 你的手機訊息常常爆炸嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de shǒu jī xùn xí cháng cháng bào zhà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your phone often get flooded with messages?
entries.answer: 會，過年的時候群組訊息都會爆炸。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, guò nián de shí hòu qún zǔ xùn xí dōu huì bào zhà.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, at Chinese New Year my group chats explode with messages.

entries.example: 他的聲音很響亮，大家都聽得很清楚。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de shēng yīn hěn xiǎng liàng, dà jiā dōu tīng de hěn qīng chǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: His voice is loud and clear; everyone can hear him well.
entries.question: 你覺得自己的聲音響亮嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ de shēng yīn xiǎng liàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your voice is loud and clear?
entries.answer: 不太響亮，我說話比較小聲。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài xiǎng liàng, wǒ shuō huà bǐ jiào xiǎo shēng.
entries.answerEnglish: Not very; I speak rather softly.

entries.example: 地震以後，大家迅速離開大樓。
entries.examplePinyin: dì zhèn yǐ hòu, dà jiā xùn sù lí kāi dà lóu.
entries.exampleEnglish: After the earthquake, everyone quickly left the building.
entries.question: 你回覆訊息的速度迅速嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huí fù xùn xí de sù dù xùn sù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you reply to messages quickly?
entries.answer: 很迅速，我通常五分鐘內就回。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn xùn sù, wǒ tōng cháng wǔ fēn zhōng nèi jiù huí.
entries.answerEnglish: Very quickly; I usually reply within five minutes.

entries.example: 颱風天不出門是明智的選擇。
entries.examplePinyin: tái fēng tiān bù chū mén shì míng zhì de xuǎn zé.
entries.exampleEnglish: Staying in on a typhoon day is a wise choice.
entries.question: 你做過最明智的決定是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò guò zuì míng zhì de jué dìng shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the wisest decision you've ever made?
entries.answer: 我最明智的決定是來台灣學中文。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì míng zhì de jué dìng shì lái tái wān xué zhōng wén.
entries.answerEnglish: My wisest decision was coming to Taiwan to study Chinese.

entries.example: 運動可以減輕工作的壓力。
entries.examplePinyin: yùn dòng kě yǐ jiǎn qīng gōng zuò de yā lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Exercise can ease work stress.
entries.question: 你都怎麼減輕壓力？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dōu zěn me jiǎn qīng yā lì?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you relieve stress?
entries.answer: 我會去河濱公園跑步減輕壓力。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì qù hé bīn gōng yuán pǎo bù jiǎn qīng yā lì.
entries.answerEnglish: I go running in the riverside park to relieve stress.

entries.example: 台北的房租對年輕人是很大的負擔。
entries.examplePinyin: tái běi de fáng zū duì nián qīng rén shì hěn dà de fù dān.
entries.exampleEnglish: Rent in Taipei is a big burden for young people.
entries.question: 你覺得生活中最大的負擔是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shēng huó zhōng zuì dà de fù dān shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the biggest burden in your life?
entries.answer: 我最大的負擔是房租。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì dà de fù dān shì fáng zū.
entries.answerEnglish: My biggest burden is rent.

entries.english: hard to avoid; inevitably; bound to
entries.example: 剛搬到台灣，難免會不習慣。
entries.examplePinyin: gāng bān dào tái wān, nán miǎn huì bù xí guàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: When you've just moved to Taiwan, you're bound to feel out of place.
entries.question: 說中文的時候，你難免會犯什麼錯？
entries.questionPinyin: shuō zhōng wén de shí hòu, nǐ nán miǎn huì fàn shén me cuò?
entries.questionEnglish: When you speak Chinese, what mistakes are you bound to make?
entries.answer: 我難免會說錯聲調。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ nán miǎn huì shuō cuò shēng diào.
entries.answerEnglish: I inevitably get some tones wrong.

entries.example: 這個問題你可以打電話諮詢客服。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge wèn tí nǐ kě yǐ dǎ diàn huà zī xún kè fú.
entries.exampleEnglish: You can call customer service to ask about this problem.
entries.question: 你遇到法律問題會找誰諮詢？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yù dào fǎ lǜ wèn tí huì zhǎo shéi zī xún?
entries.questionEnglish: Who do you consult when you have a legal problem?
entries.answer: 我會去諮詢律師或是有經驗的朋友。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì qù zī xún lǜ shī huò shì yǒu jīng yàn de péng yǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd consult a lawyer or an experienced friend.

entries.example: 在紅線停車是違規的。
entries.examplePinyin: zài hóng xiàn tíng chē shì wéi guī de.
entries.exampleEnglish: Parking on a red line is against the rules.
entries.question: 你騎機車違規被罰過錢嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qí jī chē wéi guī bèi fá guò qián ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been fined for a traffic violation on your scooter?
entries.answer: 有，我沒有兩段式左轉，違規被罰了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ méi yǒu liǎng duàn shì zuǒ zhuǎn, wéi guī bèi fá le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I didn't do a two-stage left turn and got fined.

entries.example: 我很佩服我的主管，她什麼都會。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hěn pèi fú wǒ de zhǔ guǎn, tā shén me dōu huì.
entries.exampleEnglish: I really admire my boss; she can do everything.
entries.question: 你最佩服的人是誰？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì pèi fú de rén shì shéi?
entries.questionEnglish: Who do you admire most?
entries.answer: 我最佩服我媽媽，她很堅強。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì pèi fú wǒ mā ma, tā hěn jiān qiáng.
entries.answerEnglish: I admire my mom most; she's very strong.

entries.example: 很多垃圾漂在海上，看了很難過。
entries.examplePinyin: hěn duō lè sè piāo zài hǎi shàng, kàn le hěn nán guò.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's sad to see so much trash floating on the sea.
entries.question: 你去海邊會在水上漂著休息嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù hǎi biān huì zài shuǐ shàng piāo zhe xiū xí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: At the beach, do you float on the water to rest?
entries.answer: 會，我喜歡躺在海上漂一下。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ xǐ huan tǎng zài hǎi shàng piāo yí xià.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like to lie back and float on the sea for a bit.

entries.example: 他每次遲到都有不同的藉口。
entries.examplePinyin: tā měi cì chí dào dōu yǒu bù tóng de jiè kǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: Every time he's late, he has a different excuse.
entries.question: 你不想去運動時會找什麼藉口？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bù xiǎng qù yùn dòng shí huì zhǎo shén me jiè kǒu?
entries.questionEnglish: What excuse do you use when you don't want to exercise?
entries.answer: 我常用下雨當藉口。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cháng yòng xià yǔ dàng jiè kǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: I often use rain as an excuse.

entries.example: 我倒車的時候不小心撞到牆。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ dào chē de shí hòu bù xiǎo xīn zhuàng dào qiáng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I accidentally hit a wall while reversing.
entries.question: 你開車的時候，倒車容易嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kāi chē de shí hòu, dào chē róng yì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you drive, is reversing easy for you?
entries.answer: 不容易，我倒車入庫常常失敗。
entries.answerPinyin: bù róng yì, wǒ dào chē rù kù cháng cháng shī bài.
entries.answerEnglish: Not easy; I often mess up reverse parking.

entries.example: 半夜手機突然響起地震警報。
entries.examplePinyin: bàn yè shǒu jī tú rán xiǎng qǐ dì zhèn jǐng bào.
entries.exampleEnglish: In the middle of the night, my phone suddenly sounded an earthquake alert.
entries.question: 你收到地震警報的時候會怎麼做？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shōu dào dì zhèn jǐng bào de shí hòu huì zěn me zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when you get an earthquake alert?
entries.answer: 我收到警報就會躲到桌子下面。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ shōu dào jǐng bào jiù huì duǒ dào zhuō zi xià miàn.
entries.answerEnglish: When I get the alert, I hide under a table.

entries.example: 洗完熱水澡，浴室裡都是蒸氣。
entries.examplePinyin: xǐ wán rè shuǐ zǎo, yù shì lǐ dōu shì zhēng qì.
entries.exampleEnglish: After a hot shower, the bathroom is full of steam.
entries.question: 你用過蒸氣熨斗嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yòng guò zhēng qì yùn dǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever used a steam iron?
entries.answer: 用過，蒸氣熨斗燙衣服很方便。
entries.answerPinyin: yòng guò, zhēng qì yùn dǒu tàng yī fu hěn fāng biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a steam iron makes ironing easy.

entries.example: 這棟大樓的內部很新。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè dòng dà lóu de nèi bù hěn xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The inside of this building is very new.
entries.question: 你們公司內部常開會嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men gōng sī nèi bù cháng kāi huì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company hold a lot of internal meetings?
entries.answer: 很常，我們公司內部每天都開會。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn cháng, wǒ men gōng sī nèi bù měi tiān dōu kāi huì.
entries.answerEnglish: Very often; we have internal meetings every day.

entries.example: 今天是我們的結婚紀念日。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn tiān shì wǒ men de jié hūn jì niàn rì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Today is our wedding anniversary.
entries.question: 你會慶祝什麼紀念日？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì qìng zhù shén me jì niàn rì?
entries.questionEnglish: What anniversaries do you celebrate?
entries.answer: 我會跟女朋友慶祝交往紀念日。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì gēn nǚ péng yǒu qìng zhù jiāo wǎng jì niàn rì.
entries.answerEnglish: My girlfriend and I celebrate the anniversary of when we got together.

entries.example: 台灣人的熱情讓我印象深刻。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān rén de rè qíng ràng wǒ yìn xiàng shēn kè.
entries.exampleEnglish: The warmth of Taiwanese people really impressed me.
entries.question: 台灣什麼地方讓你印象深刻？
entries.questionPinyin: tái wān shén me dì fāng ràng nǐ yìn xiàng shēn kè?
entries.questionEnglish: What place in Taiwan left a deep impression on you?
entries.answer: 太魯閣讓我印象深刻。
entries.answerPinyin: tài lǔ gé ràng wǒ yìn xiàng shēn kè.
entries.answerEnglish: Taroko Gorge left a deep impression on me.

entries.example: 這個便宜的價錢可能是陷阱。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge pián yi de jià qián kě néng shì xiàn jǐng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This cheap price might be a trap.
entries.question: 你在網路上遇過購物陷阱嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài wǎng lù shang yù guò gòu wù xiàn jǐng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever fallen into a shopping trap online?
entries.answer: 遇過，我買到假貨，那是一個陷阱。
entries.answerPinyin: yù guò, wǒ mǎi dào jiǎ huò, nà shì yí gè xiàn jǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I bought a fake; it was a trap.

entries.example: 這艘船要在海上航行三天。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè sāo chuán yào zài hǎi shàng háng xíng sān tiān.
entries.exampleEnglish: This ship will sail at sea for three days.
entries.question: 你想搭郵輪在海上航行嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng dā yóu lún zài hǎi shàng háng xíng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to sail on a cruise ship?
entries.answer: 想，我想搭郵輪航行到日本。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, wǒ xiǎng dā yóu lún háng xíng dào rì běn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to take a cruise to Japan.

entries.example: 我的老闆很慷慨，常請我們吃飯。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de lǎo bǎn hěn kāng kǎi, cháng qǐng wǒ men chī fàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: My boss is generous and often treats us to meals.
entries.question: 你身邊最慷慨的人是誰？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēn biān zuì kāng kǎi de rén shì shéi?
entries.questionEnglish: Who is the most generous person around you?
entries.answer: 我爺爺最慷慨，常常幫助別人。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yé ye zuì kāng kǎi, cháng cháng bāng zhù bié rén.
entries.answerEnglish: My grandfather is the most generous; he often helps others.

entries.example: 工作一直出問題，讓我很心煩。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng zuò yì zhí chū wèn tí, ràng wǒ hěn xīn fán.
entries.exampleEnglish: Problems keep coming up at work, and it's got me upset.
entries.question: 你心煩的時候會做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xīn fán de shí hòu huì zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when you're upset?
entries.answer: 我心煩的時候會去散步。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xīn fán de shí hòu huì qù sàn bù.
entries.answerEnglish: When I'm upset, I go for a walk.

entries.example: 同事今天給了我一張喜帖。
entries.examplePinyin: tóng shì jīn tiān gěi le wǒ yì zhāng xǐ tiě.
entries.exampleEnglish: A coworker gave me a wedding invitation today.
entries.question: 你今年收到幾張喜帖？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jīn nián shōu dào jǐ zhāng xǐ tiě?
entries.questionEnglish: How many wedding invitations have you received this year?
entries.answer: 我今年收到三張喜帖。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jīn nián shōu dào sān zhāng xǐ tiě.
entries.answerEnglish: I've received three wedding invitations this year.

entries.example: 我買了一台五十吋的電視。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ mǎi le yì tái wǔ shí cùn de diàn shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a 50-inch TV.
entries.question: 你的電腦螢幕是幾吋的？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de diàn nǎo yíng mù shì jǐ cùn de?
entries.questionEnglish: How many inches is your computer screen?
entries.answer: 我的螢幕是二十七吋的。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de yíng mù shì èr shí qī cùn de.
entries.answerEnglish: My screen is 27 inches.

entries.example: 這首歌的旋律很好記。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shǒu gē de xuán lǜ hěn hǎo jì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This song's melody is easy to remember.
entries.question: 你最近一直想到哪首歌的旋律？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn yì zhí xiǎng dào nǎ shǒu gē de xuán lǜ?
entries.questionEnglish: Which song's melody has been stuck in your head lately?
entries.answer: 我一直想到垃圾車音樂的旋律。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yì zhí xiǎng dào lè sè chē yīn yuè de xuán lǜ.
entries.answerEnglish: I keep hearing the garbage truck's melody in my head.

entries.example: 天空突然出現一道閃光，接著就打雷了。
entries.examplePinyin: tiān kōng tú rán chū xiàn yí dào shǎn guāng, jiē zhe jiù dǎ léi le.
entries.exampleEnglish: A flash suddenly lit up the sky, and then came the thunder.
entries.question: 你拍照的時候常開閃光燈嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pāi zhào de shí hòu cháng kāi shǎn guāng dēng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often use the flash when taking photos?
entries.answer: 很少，我不喜歡閃光燈拍出來的照片。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn shǎo, wǒ bù xǐ huan shǎn guāng dēng pāi chū lái de zhào piàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Rarely; I don't like photos taken with the flash.

entries.example: 他的志向是開一家自己的咖啡店。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de zhì xiàng shì kāi yì jiā zì jǐ de kā fēi diàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: His ambition is to open his own café.
entries.question: 你小時候的志向是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu de zhì xiàng shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What was your childhood ambition?
entries.answer: 我小時候的志向是當太空人。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎo shí hòu de zhì xiàng shì dāng tài kōng rén.
entries.answerEnglish: As a kid my dream was to be an astronaut.

entries.example: 這場颱風帶來很大的洪水。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè chǎng tái fēng dài lái hěn dà de hóng shuǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: This typhoon brought massive flooding.
entries.question: 你的家鄉發生過洪水嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de jiā xiāng fā shēng guò hóng shuǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has your hometown ever had a flood?
entries.answer: 發生過，幾年前的洪水淹了很多房子。
entries.answerPinyin: fā shēng guò, jǐ nián qián de hóng shuǐ yān le hěn duō fáng zi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a flood a few years ago left many houses underwater.

entries.example: 他的個性很溫和，很少生氣。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de gè xìng hěn wēn hé, hěn shǎo shēng qì.
entries.exampleEnglish: He has a gentle personality and rarely gets angry.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的冬天溫和嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān de dōng tiān wēn hé ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwan's winter is mild?
entries.answer: 很溫和，比我家鄉暖和多了。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn wēn hé, bǐ wǒ jiā xiāng nuǎn huo duō le.
entries.answerEnglish: Very mild; much warmer than my hometown.

entries.example: 世界上有七大洲。
entries.examplePinyin: shì jiè shàng yǒu qī dà zhōu.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are seven continents in the world.
entries.question: 你去過哪些洲？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò nǎ xiē zhōu?
entries.questionEnglish: Which continents have you been to?
entries.answer: 我去過亞洲、歐洲和美洲。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qù guò yà zhōu, ōu zhōu hé měi zhōu.
entries.answerEnglish: I've been to Asia, Europe, and the Americas.

entries.example: 山上有人受傷，消防隊馬上去救援。
entries.examplePinyin: shān shàng yǒu rén shòu shāng, xiāo fáng duì mǎ shàng qù jiù yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: Someone got hurt on the mountain, and firefighters went to the rescue right away.
entries.question: 如果你在山上迷路，會怎麼找人救援？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ nǐ zài shān shàng mí lù, huì zěn me zhǎo rén jiù yuán?
entries.questionEnglish: If you got lost in the mountains, how would you get help?
entries.answer: 我會打一一九請消防隊來救援。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì dǎ yì yī jiǔ qǐng xiāo fáng duì lái jiù yuán.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd call 119 and ask the fire department to come rescue me.

entries.english: rider (of a scooter or motorbike); knight
entries.example: 下雨天路很滑，機車騎士要小心。
entries.examplePinyin: xià yǔ tiān lù hěn huá, jī chē qí shì yào xiǎo xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Roads are slippery when it rains, so scooter riders should be careful.
entries.question: 你是機車騎士嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shì jī chē qí shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you a scooter rider?
entries.answer: 不是，我不敢在台北當機車騎士。
entries.answerPinyin: bú shì, wǒ bù gǎn zài tái běi dāng jī chē qí shì.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't dare ride a scooter in Taipei.

entries.example: 這種藥丸一天吃兩顆。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhǒng yào wán yì tiān chī liǎng kē.
entries.exampleEnglish: Take two of these pills a day.
entries.question: 你吃藥丸的時候會很難吞嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chī yào wán de shí hòu huì hěn nán tūn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you find pills hard to swallow?
entries.answer: 會，太大的藥丸我吞不下去。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, tài dà de yào wán wǒ tūn bú xià qù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I can't swallow pills that are too big.

entries.example: 門後面有掛鉤，可以掛包包。
entries.examplePinyin: mén hòu miàn yǒu guà gōu, kě yǐ guà bāo bāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a hook behind the door where you can hang your bag.
entries.question: 你家的浴室有掛鉤嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de yù shì yǒu guà gōu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a hook in your bathroom?
entries.answer: 有，我用掛鉤掛毛巾。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ yòng guà gōu guà máo jīn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I hang my towels on hooks.

entries.example: 我在公司放了一把備用鑰匙。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài gōng sī fàng le yì bǎ bèi yòng yào shi.
entries.exampleEnglish: I keep a spare key at the office.
entries.question: 你出門會帶備用的行動電源嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chū mén huì dài bèi yòng de xíng dòng diàn yuán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you bring a backup power bank when you go out?
entries.answer: 會，我一定帶一個備用的行動電源。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ yí dìng dài yí gè bèi yòng de xíng dòng diàn yuán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always bring a backup power bank.

entries.example: 台北馬拉松每年有很多跑者參加。
entries.examplePinyin: tái běi mǎ lā sōng měi nián yǒu hěn duō pǎo zhě cān jiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: Many runners take part in the Taipei Marathon every year.
entries.question: 你覺得自己算是跑者嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ suàn shì pǎo zhě ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you call yourself a runner?
entries.answer: 算是，我是一個業餘跑者。
entries.answerPinyin: suàn shì, wǒ shì yí gè yè yú pǎo zhě.
entries.answerEnglish: Sort of; I'm an amateur runner.

entries.example: 開餐廳需要申請營業執照。
entries.examplePinyin: kāi cān tīng xū yào shēn qǐng yíng yè zhí zhào.
entries.exampleEnglish: Opening a restaurant requires a business license.
entries.question: 你有什麼專業執照嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu shén me zhuān yè zhí zhào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any professional licenses?
entries.answer: 有，我有教英文的執照。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ yǒu jiāo yīng wén de zhí zhào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a license to teach English.

entries.example: 她的外套上有一個可愛的別針。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de wài tào shàng yǒu yí gè kě ài de bié zhēn.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a cute pin on her jacket.
entries.question: 你喜歡在包包上別別針嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zài bāo bāo shàng bié bié zhēn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like putting pins on your bag?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我的包包上有很多別針。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ de bāo bāo shàng yǒu hěn duō bié zhēn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are lots of pins on my bag.

entries.example: 我爸爸年輕的時候在海軍當兵。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bà ba nián qīng de shí hòu zài hǎi jūn dāng bīng.
entries.exampleEnglish: My dad did his military service in the navy when he was young.
entries.question: 你想過去海軍工作嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng guò qù hǎi jūn gōng zuò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever thought about joining the navy?
entries.answer: 沒想過，我會暈船，不適合海軍。
entries.answerPinyin: méi xiǎng guò, wǒ huì yùn chuán, bú shì hé hǎi jūn.
entries.answerEnglish: Never; I get seasick, so the navy isn't for me.

entries.example: 這個品種的芒果特別甜。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge pǐn zhǒng de máng guǒ tè bié tián.
entries.exampleEnglish: This variety of mango is especially sweet.
entries.question: 你喜歡什麼品種的狗？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan shén me pǐn zhǒng de gǒu?
entries.questionEnglish: What breed of dog do you like?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡柴犬這個品種。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan chái quǎn zhè ge pǐn zhǒng.
entries.answerEnglish: I like the Shiba Inu breed best.

entries.example: 一場大雨毀掉了我們的野餐。
entries.examplePinyin: yì chǎng dà yǔ huǐ diào le wǒ men de yě cān.
entries.exampleEnglish: A heavy rain ruined our picnic.
entries.question: 你有沒有被天氣毀掉的旅行？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu bèi tiān qì huǐ diào de lǚ xíng?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had a trip ruined by the weather?
entries.answer: 有，颱風毀掉了我的墾丁之旅。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, tái fēng huǐ diào le wǒ de kěn dīng zhī lǚ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a typhoon ruined my trip to Kenting.

entries.example: 從這裡可以看到整個海灣。
entries.examplePinyin: cóng zhè lǐ kě yǐ kàn dào zhěng gè hǎi wān.
entries.exampleEnglish: From here you can see the whole bay.
entries.question: 你看過最美的海灣在哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò zuì měi de hǎi wān zài nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where's the most beautiful bay you've seen?
entries.answer: 我看過最美的海灣在墾丁。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ kàn guò zuì měi de hǎi wān zài kěn dīng.
entries.answerEnglish: The most beautiful bay I've seen is in Kenting.

entries.example: 他很會逗小孩開心。
entries.examplePinyin: tā hěn huì dòu xiǎo hái kāi xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's great at making kids laugh.
entries.question: 你會怎麼逗朋友開心？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zěn me dòu péng yǒu kāi xīn?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you cheer your friends up?
entries.answer: 我會講笑話逗他們開心。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì jiǎng xiào huà dòu tā men kāi xīn.
entries.answerEnglish: I tell jokes to make them laugh.

entries.example: 去山上前，記得噴防蚊液。
entries.examplePinyin: qù shān shàng qián, jì de pēn fáng wén yì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Before heading to the mountains, remember to spray on mosquito repellent.
entries.question: 你出門前會噴香水嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chū mén qián huì pēn xiāng shuǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you spray on perfume before going out?
entries.answer: 會，我上班前會噴一點香水。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ shàng bān qián huì pēn yì diǎn xiāng shuǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I spray on a little perfume before work.

entries.example: 很榮幸認識你。
entries.examplePinyin: hěn róng xìng rèn shì nǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's an honor to meet you.
entries.question: 你覺得最榮幸的一件事是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zuì róng xìng de yí jiàn shì shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What has made you feel most honored?
entries.answer: 能代表公司去日本開會，我覺得很榮幸。
entries.answerPinyin: néng dài biǎo gōng sī qù rì běn kāi huì, wǒ jué de hěn róng xìng.
entries.answerEnglish: I felt very honored to represent my company at a meeting in Japan.

entries.example: 喝不了牛奶的人可以用豆漿當替代品。
entries.examplePinyin: hē bù liǎo niú nǎi de rén kě yǐ yòng dòu jiāng dàng tì dài pǐn.
entries.exampleEnglish: People who can't drink milk can use soy milk as a substitute.
entries.question: 你會用什麼當咖啡的替代品？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì yòng shén me dàng kā fēi de tì dài pǐn?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you use as a substitute for coffee?
entries.answer: 我會喝綠茶當咖啡的替代品。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì hē lǜ chá dàng kā fēi de tì dài pǐn.
entries.answerEnglish: I drink green tea as a substitute for coffee.

entries.example: 這部電影又長又乏味。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng yòu cháng yòu fá wèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: This movie is long and dull.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼工作很乏味？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me gōng zuò hěn fá wèi?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of work do you find tedious?
entries.answer: 我覺得一直輸入資料很乏味。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de yì zhí shū rù zī liào hěn fá wèi.
entries.answerEnglish: I find typing in data all day tedious.

entries.example: 他刻意不回我的訊息。
entries.examplePinyin: tā kè yì bù huí wǒ de xùn xí.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's deliberately not answering my messages.
entries.question: 你會刻意少吃甜的東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì kè yì shǎo chī tián de dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you make a point of eating fewer sweet things?
entries.answer: 會，我最近刻意少喝含糖飲料。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ zuì jìn kè yì shǎo hē hán táng yǐn liào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, lately I've been deliberately drinking fewer sugary drinks.

entries.example: 天氣逐漸變冷了。
entries.examplePinyin: tiān qì zhú jiàn biàn lěng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The weather is gradually getting colder.
entries.question: 你逐漸習慣台灣的生活了嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhú jiàn xí guàn tái wān de shēng huó le ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you gradually getting used to life in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 是的，我已經逐漸習慣這裡的生活了。
entries.answerPinyin: shì de, wǒ yǐ jīng zhú jiàn xí guàn zhè lǐ de shēng huó le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm gradually getting used to life here.

entries.example: 他說那句話沒有惡意。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shuō nà jù huà méi yǒu è yì.
entries.exampleEnglish: He didn't mean anything bad by saying that.
entries.question: 網路上的惡意留言，你會在意嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: wǎng lù shang de è yì liú yán, nǐ huì zài yì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do nasty comments online bother you?
entries.answer: 不會，我不太在意網路上的惡意留言。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ bú tài zài yì wǎng lù shang de è yì liú yán.
entries.answerEnglish: No, nasty comments online don't really bother me.

entries.example: 這裡以前是一間廢棄的工廠。

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò fèi qì de jiàn zhú ma?

entries.answer: 去過，我去過一間廢棄的老醫院，很可怕。

entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I once went to an abandoned old hospital. It was scary.

entries.examplePinyin: wǎng lù shang de yáo yán bú yào suí biàn xiāng xìn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Don't just believe the rumors you see online.
entries.question: 你聽過關於公司的謠言嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tīng guò guān yú gōng sī de yáo yán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you heard any rumors about your company?
entries.answer: 聽過，可是我覺得那只是謠言。
entries.answerPinyin: tīng guò, kě shì wǒ jué de nà zhǐ shì yáo yán.
entries.answerEnglish: I have, but I think it's just a rumor.

entries.example: 這道菜很有家鄉風味。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè dào cài hěn yǒu jiā xiāng fēng wèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: This dish really tastes like home.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪種風味的料理？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ zhǒng fēng wèi de liào lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: What style of cooking do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡泰式風味的料理。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan tài shì fēng wèi de liào lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I like Thai-style food best.

entries.example: 我想跟朋友合夥開咖啡店。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xiǎng gēn péng yǒu hé huǒ kāi kā fēi diàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I want to open a coffee shop together with a friend.
entries.question: 你會跟朋友合夥做生意嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì gēn péng yǒu hé huǒ zuò shēng yì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you go into business with a friend?
entries.answer: 不會，我怕跟朋友合夥會吵架。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ pà gēn péng yǒu hé huǒ huì chǎo jià.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I'm afraid we'd end up fighting if we were partners.

entries.example: 請假要先交書面申請。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng jià yào xiān jiāo shū miàn shēn qǐng.
entries.exampleEnglish: To take leave, you need to hand in a written request first.
entries.question: 你們公司請假要寫書面申請嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men gōng sī qǐng jià yào xiě shū miàn shēn qǐng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company require a written request to take leave?
entries.answer: 要，我們要先交書面申請。
entries.answerPinyin: yào, wǒ men yào xiān jiāo shū miàn shēn qǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we have to hand in a written request first.

entries.example: 她的態度很堅定。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de tài dù hěn jiān dìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: She was very firm about it.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xué zhōng wén de jué xīn jiān dìng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: How firm is your determination to learn Chinese?
entries.answer: 很堅定，我一定要學好中文。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn jiān dìng, wǒ yí dìng yào xué hǎo zhōng wén.
entries.answerEnglish: Very firm. I'm going to learn Chinese well no matter what.

entries.example: 這家民宿常有外國旅人來住。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā mín sù cháng yǒu wài guó lǚ rén lái zhù.
entries.exampleEnglish: Foreign travelers often stay at this guesthouse.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ shì shén me yàng de lǚ rén?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of traveler do you think you are?
entries.answer: 我是喜歡慢慢走的旅人。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ shì xǐ huan màn màn zǒu de lǚ rén.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm the kind of traveler who likes to take it slow.

entries.example: 我哥哥很喜歡看賽車。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ gē ge hěn xǐ huan kàn sài chē.
entries.exampleEnglish: My older brother loves watching car racing.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò sài chē bǐ sài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever watched a car race?
entries.answer: 看過，我在電視上看過賽車。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài diàn shì shàng kàn guò sài chē.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've watched car racing on TV.

entries.example: 這裡是看夕陽的絕佳地點。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè lǐ shì kàn xì yáng de jué jiā dì diǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a perfect spot for watching the sunset.
entries.question: 你知道哪裡是看夜景的絕佳地點？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào nǎ lǐ shì kàn yè jǐng de jué jiā dì diǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know a great spot for night views?
entries.answer: 象山是看夜景的絕佳地點。
entries.answerPinyin: xiàng shān shì kàn yè jǐng de jué jiā dì diǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Elephant Mountain is a great spot for night views.

entries.example: 我們先用現有的資料就好。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men xiān yòng xiàn yǒu de zī liào jiù hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's just use the data we already have for now.
entries.question: 你對現有的手機滿意嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì xiàn yǒu de shǒu jī mǎn yì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you happy with the phone you have now?
entries.answer: 滿意，現有的手機還很好用。
entries.answerPinyin: mǎn yì, xiàn yǒu de shǒu jī hái hěn hǎo yòng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my current phone still works well.

entries.example: 他在一家大企業上班。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài yì jiā dà qì yè shàng bān.
entries.exampleEnglish: He works at a big company.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng zài dà qì yè hái shì xiǎo gōng sī gōng zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you rather work at a big company or a small one?
entries.answer: 我想在大企業工作。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng zài dà qì yè gōng zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to work at a big company.

entries.examplePinyin: mā zǔ shì tái wān zhòng yào de mín jiān xìn yǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Mazu is an important part of Taiwan's folk religion.
entries.question: 你知道哪些台灣的民間故事？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào nǎ xiē tái wān de mín jiān gù shì?
entries.questionEnglish: Which Taiwanese folk tales do you know?
entries.answer: 我知道虎姑婆這個民間故事。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhī dào hǔ gū pó zhè ge mín jiān gù shì.
entries.answerEnglish: I know the folk tale of Grandaunt Tiger.

entries.example: 這家店只賣本土的水果。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn zhǐ mài běn tǔ de shuǐ guǒ.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop only sells locally grown fruit.
entries.question: 你喜歡台灣本土的品牌嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan tái wān běn tǔ de pǐn pái ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like Taiwan's homegrown brands?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常買本土品牌的衣服。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ cháng mǎi běn tǔ pǐn pái de yī fu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often buy clothes from local brands.

entries.example: 這間是天主教的教堂。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiān shì tiān zhǔ jiào de jiào táng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a Catholic church.
entries.question: 你的家人信天主教嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de jiā rén xìn tiān zhǔ jiào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is anyone in your family Catholic?
entries.answer: 我媽媽信天主教。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ mā ma xìn tiān zhǔ jiào.
entries.answerEnglish: My mom is Catholic.

entries.example: 這份報告要用百分比表示。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè fèn bào gào yào yòng bǎi fēn bǐ biǎo shì.

entries.question: 你每個月存多少百分比的薪水？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ měi gè yuè cún duō shǎo bǎi fēn bǐ de xīn shuǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: What percentage of your salary do you save each month?
entries.answer: 我存的百分比不高，大約百分之十。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cún de bǎi fēn bǐ bù gāo, dà yuē bǎi fēn zhī shí.
entries.answerEnglish: Not a high percentage, about ten percent.

entries.examplePinyin: tái wān yǒu hěn duō bù tóng de zú qún.

entries.question: 你的國家有幾個主要族群？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā yǒu jǐ gè zhǔ yào zú qún?

entries.answer: 我的國家有三個主要族群。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de guó jiā yǒu sān gè zhǔ yào zú qún.

entries.english: implement; put into effect; carry out
entries.example: 公司下個月開始實施新規定。

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men gōng sī yǒu shí shī zài jiā shàng bān ma?

entries.answer: 有，公司去年開始實施了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, gōng sī qù nián kāi shǐ shí shī le.

entries.answer: 一部分是基因，一部分是環境。
entries.answerPinyin: yí bù fèn shì jī yīn, yí bù fèn shì huán jìng.

entries.example: 運動可以幫我消除壓力。

entries.answer: 我用跑步來消除壓力。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yòng pǎo bù lái xiāo chú yā lì.
entries.answerEnglish: I go running to relieve stress.

entries.example: 這台機械壞了，要找人來修。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tái jī xiè huài le, yào zhǎo rén lái xiū.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì jī xiè yǒu xìng qù ma?

entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ hěn xǐ huan yán jiù jī xiè.

entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men yán zhe shān shàng de xiǎo jìng màn màn zǒu.

entries.question: 你喜歡走森林裡的小徑嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zǒu sēn lín lǐ de xiǎo jìng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like walking on forest trails?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我週末常走陽明山的小徑。

entries.examplePinyin: tā zài bào gào lǐ yǐn yòng le hěn duō shù jù.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiě wén zhāng shí cháng yǐn yòng míng yán ma?

entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā gōng sī zài tái běi shè lì le xīn bàn gōng shì.

entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de gōng sī zài tái wān shè lì shí nián le.

entries.examplePinyin: tā de jiǎo shāng yǐ jīng fù yuán le.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēng bìng hòu tōng cháng duō jiǔ huì fù yuán?
entries.questionEnglish: How long does it usually take you to recover when you're sick?
entries.answer: 我感冒大概一週就會復原。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ gǎn mào dà gài yì zhōu jiù huì fù yuán.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng qù huà láng kàn huà ma?

entries.answer: 不常，我一年去一兩次畫廊。
entries.answerPinyin: bù cháng, wǒ yì nián qù yì liǎng cì huà láng.

entries.examplePinyin: jī dàn yǒu hěn duō dàn bái zhí.

entries.answer: 不太一致，我們常常意見不同。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài yí zhì, wǒ men cháng cháng yì jiàn bù tóng.

entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zì jǐ zǔ zhuāng le zhè zhāng shū zhuō.

entries.answer: 會，我在IKEA買的家具都自己組裝。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ zài IKEA mǎi de jiā jù dōu zì jǐ zǔ zhuāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I assemble all the furniture I buy at IKEA myself.

entries.example: 最近不景氣，生意很差。
entries.examplePinyin: zuì jìn bù jǐng qì, shēng yì hěn chà.

entries.question: 不景氣的時候，你會少花錢嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: bù jǐng qì de shí hòu, nǐ huì shǎo huā qián ma?

entries.answer: 會，不景氣的時候我會少出去吃飯。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, bù jǐng qì de shí hòu wǒ huì shǎo chū qù chī fàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when the economy is bad I eat out less.

entries.example: 他小時候家裡很貧窮。
entries.examplePinyin: tā xiǎo shí hòu jiā lǐ hěn pín qióng.

entries.question: 你覺得怎麼做能減少貧窮？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zěn me zuò néng jiǎn shǎo pín qióng?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think can reduce poverty?
entries.answer: 我覺得教育可以減少貧窮。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de jiào yù kě yǐ jiǎn shǎo pín qióng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think education can reduce poverty.

entries.example: 我想出去走走，轉換一下心情。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xiǎng chū qù zǒu zǒu, zhuǎn huàn yí xià xīn qíng.

entries.question: 你想轉換工作跑道嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng zhuǎn huàn gōng zuò pǎo dào ma?

entries.answer: 想，我想轉換跑道去當老師。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, wǒ xiǎng zhuǎn huàn pǎo dào qù dāng lǎo shī.

entries.example: 在捷運上吃東西會被罰款。
entries.examplePinyin: zài jié yùn shàng chī dōng xī huì bèi fá kuǎn.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bèi fá kuǎn guò ma?
