entries.answer: 有，我亂停車被罰款過一次。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ luàn tíng chē bèi fá kuǎn guò yí cì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I was fined once for illegal parking.

entries.example: 我哥哥在一家公司當顧問。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ gē ge zài yì jiā gōng sī dāng gù wèn.
entries.exampleEnglish: My older brother is a consultant at a company.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng dāng gù wèn ma?

entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, wǒ xiǎng dāng kē jì gōng sī de gù wèn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to be a consultant for tech companies.

entries.examplePinyin: tā fēi cháng rè ài tā de gōng zuò.

entries.answer: 我熱愛爬山。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ rè ài pá shān.
entries.answerEnglish: I love hiking.

entries.example: 今天中午的陽光很強烈。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn tiān zhōng wǔ de yáng guāng hěn qiáng liè.
entries.exampleEnglish: The midday sun is really strong today.
entries.question: 你有什麼強烈的願望嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu shén me qiáng liè de yuàn wàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there something you strongly wish for?
entries.answer: 有，我有一個強烈的願望，就是環島。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ yǒu yí gè qiáng liè de yuàn wàng, jiù shì huán dǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a strong wish to travel around the whole island.

entries.example: 這個小鎮主要靠農業。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge xiǎo zhèn zhǔ yào kào nóng yè.
entries.exampleEnglish: This small town relies mainly on farming.
entries.question: 你對農業有興趣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì nóng yè yǒu xìng qù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you interested in farming?
entries.answer: 有，我以後想在鄉下從事農業。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ yǐ hòu xiǎng zài xiāng xià cóng shì nóng yè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, someday I'd like to farm in the countryside.

entries.example: 颱風把樹枝折斷了。
entries.examplePinyin: tái fēng bǎ shù zhī zhé duàn le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The typhoon snapped the tree branches.
entries.question: 你的雨傘被風折斷過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de yǔ sǎn bèi fēng zhé duàn guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has your umbrella ever been snapped by the wind?
entries.answer: 有，颱風天我的雨傘被折斷了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, tái fēng tiān wǒ de yǔ sǎn bèi zhé duàn le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my umbrella snapped on a typhoon day.

entries.example: 李白是很有名的詩人。
entries.examplePinyin: lǐ bái shì hěn yǒu míng de shī rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: Li Bai is a very famous poet.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪一位詩人？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ yí wèi shī rén?
entries.questionEnglish: Who's your favorite poet?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡的詩人是李白。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan de shī rén shì lǐ bái.
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite poet is Li Bai.

entries.example: 我們公司的總部在新竹。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men gōng sī de zǒng bù zài xīn zhú.
entries.exampleEnglish: Our company's headquarters are in Hsinchu.
entries.question: 你們公司的總部在哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men gōng sī de zǒng bù zài nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where is your company's headquarters?
entries.answer: 我們公司的總部在台北。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men gōng sī de zǒng bù zài tái běi.
entries.answerEnglish: Our company's headquarters are in Taipei.

entries.example: 請用濕紙巾擦拭桌面。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng yòng shī zhǐ jīn cā shì zhuō miàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please wipe the table with a wet wipe.
entries.question: 你多久擦拭一次手機螢幕？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duō jiǔ cā shì yí cì shǒu jī yíng mù?
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you wipe your phone screen?
entries.answer: 我每天都會擦拭手機螢幕。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ měi tiān dōu huì cā shì shǒu jī yíng mù.
entries.answerEnglish: I wipe my phone screen every day.

entries.example: 他最近承受很大的壓力。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zuì jìn chéng shòu hěn dà de yā lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's been under a lot of pressure lately.
entries.question: 工作壓力大的時候，你承受得了嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: gōng zuò yā lì dà de shí hòu, nǐ chéng shòu de liǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When work gets stressful, can you handle it?
entries.answer: 承受得了，我會用運動來減壓。
entries.answerPinyin: chéng shòu de liǎo, wǒ huì yòng yùn dòng lái jiǎn yā.
entries.answerEnglish: I can handle it. I exercise to relieve stress.

entries.example: 加拿大有十個省。
entries.examplePinyin: jiā ná dà yǒu shí gè shěng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Canada has ten provinces.
entries.question: 你的國家分成很多省嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā fēn chéng hěn duō shěng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your country divided into many provinces?
entries.answer: 對，我的國家分成十個省。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ de guó jiā fēn chéng shí gè shěng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my country is divided into ten provinces.

entries.example: 台南出產很多芒果。
entries.examplePinyin: tái nán chū chǎn hěn duō máng guǒ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Tainan produces lots of mangoes.
entries.question: 你的家鄉出產什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de jiā xiāng chū chǎn shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What does your hometown produce?
entries.answer: 我的家鄉出產很多葡萄酒。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de jiā xiāng chū chǎn hěn duō pú táo jiǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: My hometown produces a lot of wine.

entries.example: 因為下雨的緣故，比賽取消了。
entries.examplePinyin: yīn wèi xià yǔ de yuán gù, bǐ sài qǔ xiāo le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The game was canceled because of the rain.
entries.question: 你是因為什麼緣故來台灣的？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shì yīn wèi shén me yuán gù lái tái wān de?
entries.questionEnglish: What brought you to Taiwan?
entries.answer: 因為工作的緣故，我來到台灣。
entries.answerPinyin: yīn wèi gōng zuò de yuán gù, wǒ lái dào tái wān.
entries.answerEnglish: I came to Taiwan because of work.

entries.example: 他的舉動讓大家很感動。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de jǔ dòng ràng dà jiā hěn gǎn dòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: What he did really touched everyone.
entries.question: 什麼舉動會讓你覺得沒禮貌？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me jǔ dòng huì ràng nǐ jué de méi lǐ mào?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of behavior do you find rude?
entries.answer: 在捷運上大聲講電話的舉動很沒禮貌。
entries.answerPinyin: zài jié yùn shàng dà shēng jiǎng diàn huà de jǔ dòng hěn méi lǐ mào.
entries.answerEnglish: Talking loudly on the phone on the MRT is rude.

entries.example: 明天北部會有大範圍降雨。
entries.examplePinyin: míng tiān běi bù huì yǒu dà fàn wéi jiàng yǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: There will be widespread rain in the north tomorrow.
entries.question: 你遇過大範圍停電嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yù guò dà fàn wéi tíng diàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever experienced a widespread blackout?
entries.answer: 遇過，那次大範圍停電好幾個小時。
entries.answerPinyin: yù guò, nà cì dà fàn wéi tíng diàn hǎo jǐ gè xiǎo shí.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, that big blackout lasted several hours.

entries.example: 我大學念的是心理學。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ dà xué niàn de shì xīn lǐ xué.
entries.exampleEnglish: I studied psychology at university.
entries.question: 你對心理學有興趣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì xīn lǐ xué yǒu xìng qù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you interested in psychology?
entries.answer: 有，我常看心理學的書。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ cháng kàn xīn lǐ xué de shū.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often read psychology books.

entries.example: 警察終於抓到兇手了。
entries.examplePinyin: jǐng chá zhōng yú zhuā dào xiōng shǒu le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The police finally caught the killer.
entries.question: 推理小說裡，通常什麼時候會知道兇手是誰？
entries.questionPinyin: tuī lǐ xiǎo shuō lǐ, tōng cháng shén me shí hòu huì zhī dào xiōng shǒu shì shéi?
entries.questionEnglish: In a mystery novel, when do you usually find out who the killer is?
entries.answer: 通常到最後才會知道兇手是誰。
entries.answerPinyin: tōng cháng dào zuì hòu cái huì zhī dào xiōng shǒu shì shéi.
entries.answerEnglish: Usually you only find out who the killer is at the very end.

entries.example: 我工作時喜歡聽古典音樂。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ gōng zuò shí xǐ huan tīng gǔ diǎn yīn yuè.
entries.exampleEnglish: I like listening to classical music while I work.
entries.question: 你喜歡聽古典音樂嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan tīng gǔ diǎn yīn yuè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like listening to classical music?
entries.answer: 喜歡，古典音樂讓我很放鬆。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, gǔ diǎn yīn yuè ràng wǒ hěn fàng sōng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, classical music relaxes me.

entries.example: 我相信命運是自己決定的。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xiāng xìn mìng yùn shì zì jǐ jué dìng de.
entries.exampleEnglish: I believe we decide our own fate.
entries.question: 你相信命運嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiāng xìn mìng yùn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you believe in fate?
entries.answer: 我不太相信命運。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bú tài xiāng xìn mìng yùn.
entries.answerEnglish: I don't really believe in fate.

entries.example: 這件衣服洗了幾次就褪色了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn yī fu xǐ le jǐ cì jiù tuì sè le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shirt faded after just a few washes.
entries.question: 你的衣服常常褪色嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de yī fu cháng cháng tuì sè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do your clothes fade often?
entries.answer: 有些便宜的衣服很容易褪色。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu xiē pián yi de yī fu hěn róng yì tuì sè.
entries.answerEnglish: Some cheap clothes fade easily.

entries.example: 這場車禍真是一場悲劇。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè chǎng chē huò zhēn shì yì chǎng bēi jù.
entries.exampleEnglish: This car accident was a real tragedy.
entries.question: 你喜歡看悲劇電影嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kàn bēi jù diàn yǐng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like watching tragic movies?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，悲劇電影讓我很難過。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xǐ huan, bēi jù diàn yǐng ràng wǒ hěn nán guò.
entries.answerEnglish: No, tragedies make me too sad.

entries.example: 她穿得很樸素。
entries.examplePinyin: tā chuān de hěn pǔ sù.
entries.exampleEnglish: She dresses very plainly.
entries.question: 你喜歡樸素的衣服嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan pǔ sù de yī fu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like plain, simple clothes?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我平常都穿得很樸素。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ píng cháng dōu chuān de hěn pǔ sù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I usually dress very simply.

entries.example: 店家答應賠償我的損失。
entries.examplePinyin: diàn jiā dā ying péi cháng wǒ de sǔn shī.
entries.exampleEnglish: The shop agreed to compensate me for my loss.
entries.question: 你要求過別人賠償嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yāo qiú guò bié rén péi cháng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever asked someone for compensation?
entries.answer: 有，搬家公司弄壞桌子，有賠償我。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, bān jiā gōng sī nòng huài zhuō zi, yǒu péi cháng wǒ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the movers broke my table and paid me for it.

entries.english: voluntary; volunteer to; of one's own free will
entries.example: 加班是自願的，不是強迫的。
entries.examplePinyin: jiā bān shì zì yuàn de, bú shì qiǎng pò de.
entries.exampleEnglish: Overtime is voluntary, not compulsory.
entries.question: 你會自願幫同事做事嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zì yuàn bāng tóng shì zuò shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you volunteer to help your coworkers?
entries.answer: 會，我常自願幫同事。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng zì yuàn bāng tóng shì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often offer to help my coworkers.

entries.example: 我小時候很愛看希臘神話。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xiǎo shí hòu hěn ài kàn xī là shén huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: When I was little, I loved reading Greek myths.
entries.question: 你知道哪些有名的神話？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào nǎ xiē yǒu míng de shén huà?
entries.questionEnglish: What famous myths do you know?
entries.answer: 我知道很多希臘神話的故事。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhī dào hěn duō xī là shén huà de gù shì.
entries.answerEnglish: I know a lot of stories from Greek mythology.

entries.example: 電梯裡貼了停水的公告。
entries.examplePinyin: diàn tī lǐ tiē le tíng shuǐ de gōng gào.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a notice in the elevator about a water outage.
entries.question: 你會看大樓的公告嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì kàn dà lóu de gōng gào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you read the notices in your building?
entries.answer: 會，我每天都會看電梯裡的公告。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi tiān dōu huì kàn diàn tī lǐ de gōng gào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I read the notices in the elevator every day.

entries.example: 我常幻想自己中樂透。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ cháng huàn xiǎng zì jǐ zhòng lè tòu.
entries.exampleEnglish: I often daydream about winning the lottery.
entries.question: 你常幻想什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng huàn xiǎng shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you often daydream about?
entries.answer: 我常幻想自己住在海邊。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cháng huàn xiǎng zì jǐ zhù zài hǎi biān.
entries.answerEnglish: I often daydream about living by the sea.

entries.example: 他看著帳單一直嘆氣。
entries.examplePinyin: tā kàn zhe zhàng dān yì zhí tàn qì.
entries.exampleEnglish: He kept sighing as he looked at the bill.
entries.question: 你什麼時候會嘆氣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shén me shí hòu huì tàn qì?
entries.questionEnglish: When do you sigh?
entries.answer: 星期一早上我常常嘆氣。
entries.answerPinyin: xīng qí yī zǎo shàng wǒ cháng cháng tàn qì.
entries.answerEnglish: I sigh a lot on Monday mornings.

entries.example: 我很喜歡看偵探小說。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hěn xǐ huan kàn zhēn tàn xiǎo shuō.
entries.exampleEnglish: I love reading detective novels.
entries.question: 你喜歡看偵探電影嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kàn zhēn tàn diàn yǐng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like detective movies?
entries.answer: 喜歡，偵探電影很刺激。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, zhēn tàn diàn yǐng hěn cì jī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, detective movies are exciting.

entries.example: 路上有個大坑，騎車要小心。
entries.examplePinyin: lù shang yǒu gè dà kēng, qí chē yào xiǎo xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a big hole in the road, so be careful on your scooter.
entries.question: 你家附近的路上有坑嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn de lù shang yǒu kēng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there holes in the roads near your home?
entries.answer: 有，我家附近的路上有好幾個坑。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiā fù jìn de lù shang yǒu hǎo jǐ gè kēng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are several holes in the road near my home.

entries.example: 萬聖節他戴了一個可怕的面具。
entries.examplePinyin: wàn shèng jié tā dài le yí gè kě pà de miàn jù.
entries.exampleEnglish: He wore a scary mask for Halloween.
entries.question: 萬聖節你會戴面具嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: wàn shèng jié nǐ huì dài miàn jù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you wear a mask on Halloween?
entries.answer: 會，我去年戴了一個鬼面具。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ qù nián dài le yí gè guǐ miàn jù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, last year I wore a ghost mask.

entries.example: 我第一次去國家戲劇院看歌劇。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ dì yī cì qù guó jiā xì jù yuàn kàn gē jù.
entries.exampleEnglish: I went to the National Theater to see an opera for the first time.
entries.question: 你喜歡看歌劇嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kàn gē jù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like going to the opera?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我每年都去看一次歌劇。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ měi nián dōu qù kàn yí cì gē jù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I go to an opera once a year.

entries.example: 這條街以前很繁榮。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tiáo jiē yǐ qián hěn fán róng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This street used to be very prosperous.
entries.question: 你的家鄉繁榮嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de jiā xiāng fán róng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your hometown prosperous?
entries.answer: 我的家鄉很繁榮，有很多商店。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de jiā xiāng hěn fán róng, yǒu hěn duō shāng diàn.
entries.answerEnglish: My hometown is thriving; it has lots of shops.

entries.example: 在山洞裡大叫會有回音。
entries.examplePinyin: zài shān dòng lǐ dà jiào huì yǒu huí yīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: If you shout in a cave, you'll hear an echo.
entries.question: 你在哪裡聽過回音？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài nǎ lǐ tīng guò huí yīn?
entries.questionEnglish: Where have you heard an echo?
entries.answer: 我在山谷裡聽過回音。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài shān gǔ lǐ tīng guò huí yīn.
entries.answerEnglish: I've heard an echo in a valley.

entries.example: 直升機把受傷的人送到醫院。
entries.examplePinyin: zhí shēng jī bǎ shòu shāng de rén sòng dào yī yuàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: A helicopter took the injured person to the hospital.
entries.question: 你坐過直升機嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò guò zhí shēng jī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been in a helicopter?
entries.answer: 沒有，可是我很想坐直升機。
entries.answerPinyin: méi yǒu, kě shì wǒ hěn xiǎng zuò zhí shēng jī.
entries.answerEnglish: No, but I'd really like to ride in a helicopter.

entries.example: 她送我一顆漂亮的水晶。
entries.examplePinyin: tā sòng wǒ yì kē piào liang de shuǐ jīng.
entries.exampleEnglish: She gave me a beautiful crystal.
entries.question: 你相信水晶會帶來好運嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiāng xìn shuǐ jīng huì dài lái hǎo yùn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you believe crystals bring good luck?
entries.answer: 不太相信，可是我覺得水晶很漂亮。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài xiāng xìn, kě shì wǒ jué de shuǐ jīng hěn piào liang.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really, but I think crystals are pretty.

entries.example: 小狗在草地上開心地跳躍。
entries.examplePinyin: xiǎo gǒu zài cǎo dì shàng kāi xīn de tiào yuè.
entries.exampleEnglish: The puppy is happily leaping around on the grass.
entries.question: 你喜歡做有跳躍動作的運動嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zuò yǒu tiào yuè dòng zuò de yùn dòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like exercise that involves jumping?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，跳躍對我的膝蓋不好。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xǐ huan, tiào yuè duì wǒ de xī gài bù hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: No, jumping is bad for my knees.

entries.example: 我們公司分成三個小隊比賽。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men gōng sī fēn chéng sān gè xiǎo duì bǐ sài.
entries.exampleEnglish: Our company split into three teams to compete.
entries.question: 你參加過什麼小隊嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān jiā guò shén me xiǎo duì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been part of a team or squad?
entries.answer: 我參加過公司的籃球小隊。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cān jiā guò gōng sī de lán qiú xiǎo duì.
entries.answerEnglish: I've been on my company's basketball team.

entries.example: 我迫不及待想去夜市吃東西。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ pò bù jí dài xiǎng qù yè shì chī dōng xī.
entries.exampleEnglish: I can't wait to go eat at the night market.
entries.question: 你迫不及待想做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pò bù jí dài xiǎng zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What can't you wait to do?
entries.answer: 我迫不及待想去日本旅行。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ pò bù jí dài xiǎng qù rì běn lǚ xíng.
entries.answerEnglish: I can't wait to travel to Japan.

entries.example: 這部電影的劇本寫得很好。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng de jù běn xiě de hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This movie's script is very well written.
entries.question: 你想寫電影劇本嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng xiě diàn yǐng jù běn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to write a screenplay?
entries.answer: 想，我想寫一個愛情劇本。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, wǒ xiǎng xiě yí gè ài qíng jù běn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to write a romance script.

entries.example: 我在公司當行銷專員。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài gōng sī dāng xíng xiāo zhuān yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: I work as a marketing specialist at my company.
entries.question: 你的職稱是專員嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de zhí chēng shì zhuān yuán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your job title "specialist"?
entries.answer: 對，我是人資專員。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ shì rén zī zhuān yuán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm an HR specialist.

entries.example: 我哥哥在銀行業工作。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ gē ge zài yín háng yè gōng zuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: My older brother works in banking.
entries.question: 你想在銀行業工作嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng zài yín háng yè gōng zuò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to work in banking?
entries.answer: 不想，我覺得銀行業壓力很大。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xiǎng, wǒ jué de yín háng yè yā lì hěn dà.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I think banking is very stressful.

entries.example: 他很不情願地去加班。
entries.examplePinyin: tā hěn bù qíng yuàn de qù jiā bān.
entries.exampleEnglish: He went to work overtime very reluctantly.
entries.question: 你做過什麼不情願的事？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò guò shén me bù qíng yuàn de shì?
entries.questionEnglish: What have you done reluctantly?
entries.answer: 我很不情願地參加了尾牙表演。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ hěn bù qíng yuàn de cān jiā le wěi yá biǎo yǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: I very reluctantly performed at the year-end company party.

entries.example: 最後我們兩個都妥協了。
entries.examplePinyin: zuì hòu wǒ men liǎng gè dōu tuǒ xié le.
entries.exampleEnglish: In the end we both compromised.
entries.question: 你跟家人吵架時會妥協嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gēn jiā rén chǎo jià shí huì tuǒ xié ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you compromise when you argue with family?
entries.answer: 會，我通常會先妥協。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ tōng cháng huì xiān tuǒ xié.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm usually the first to compromise.

entries.example: 這場比賽由一家銀行贊助。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè chǎng bǐ sài yóu yì jiā yín háng zàn zhù.
entries.exampleEnglish: This competition is sponsored by a bank.
entries.question: 你贊助過什麼活動嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zàn zhù guò shén me huó dòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever sponsored anything?
entries.answer: 有，我每個月贊助一個慈善團體。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ měi gè yuè zàn zhù yí gè cí shàn tuán tǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I support a charity every month.

entries.example: 下大雨時，排水溝的水都滿了。
entries.examplePinyin: xià dà yǔ shí, pái shuǐ gōu de shuǐ dōu mǎn le.
entries.exampleEnglish: When it pours, the gutters fill right up.
entries.question: 你家門口的排水溝會塞住嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā mén kǒu de pái shuǐ gōu huì sāi zhù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does the drain outside your home get blocked?
entries.answer: 會，颱風天排水溝常常塞住。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, tái fēng tiān pái shuǐ gōu cháng cháng sāi zhù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, it often gets blocked on typhoon days.

entries.example: 她在比賽中拿到了一面獎牌。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài bǐ sài zhōng ná dào le yí miàn jiǎng pái.
entries.exampleEnglish: She won a medal in the competition.
entries.question: 你得過獎牌嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dé guò jiǎng pái ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever won a medal?
entries.answer: 得過，我跑馬拉松拿過一面獎牌。
entries.answerPinyin: dé guò, wǒ pǎo mǎ lā sōng ná guò yí miàn jiǎng pái.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I got a medal for running a marathon.

entries.example: 這個洞穴裡住著很多蝙蝠。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge dòng xuè lǐ zhù zhe hěn duō biān fú.
entries.exampleEnglish: Lots of bats live in this cave.
entries.question: 你去過洞穴探險嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò dòng xuè tàn xiǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever gone exploring in a cave?
entries.answer: 去過，我在越南進過一個大洞穴。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, wǒ zài yuè nán jìn guò yí gè dà dòng xuè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I went into a huge cave in Vietnam.

entries.example: 山上的獵人很了解動物。
entries.examplePinyin: shān shàng de liè rén hěn liǎo jiě dòng wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: The hunters in the mountains know a lot about animals.
entries.question: 你的國家有很多獵人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā yǒu hěn duō liè rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there many hunters in your country?
entries.answer: 有，我的國家有不少獵人。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de guó jiā yǒu bù shǎo liè rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are quite a few hunters in my country.

entries.example: 這次選舉，她以壓倒性的票數獲勝。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì xuǎn jǔ, tā yǐ yā dǎo xìng de piào shù huò shèng.
entries.exampleEnglish: She won this election by an overwhelming number of votes.
entries.question: 你看過哪場壓倒性的比賽？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò nǎ chǎng yā dǎo xìng de bǐ sài?
entries.questionEnglish: What one-sided game have you seen, where one team overwhelmed the other?
entries.answer: 我看過一場籃球賽，主隊壓倒性獲勝。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ kàn guò yì chǎng lán qiú sài, zhǔ duì yā dǎo xìng huò shèng.
entries.answerEnglish: I saw a basketball game where the home team won overwhelmingly.

entries.example: 那個官員因為貪汙被抓了。
entries.examplePinyin: nà ge guān yuán yīn wèi tān wū bèi zhuā le.
entries.exampleEnglish: That official was arrested for corruption.
entries.question: 官員貪汙會有什麼結果？
entries.questionPinyin: guān yuán tān wū huì yǒu shén me jié guǒ?
entries.questionEnglish: What happens to officials who are corrupt?
entries.answer: 官員貪汙被抓到，可能要坐牢。
entries.answerPinyin: guān yuán tān wū bèi zhuā dào, kě néng yào zuò láo.
entries.answerEnglish: Corrupt officials who get caught may go to prison.

entries.example: 比賽還沒結束，不要認輸！
entries.examplePinyin: bǐ sài hái méi jié shù, bú yào rèn shū!
entries.exampleEnglish: The game isn't over yet—don't give up!
entries.question: 跟朋友吵架時，你會先認輸嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: gēn péng yǒu chǎo jià shí, nǐ huì xiān rèn shū ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you argue with a friend, are you the first to give in?
entries.answer: 不會，我很少先認輸。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ hěn shǎo xiān rèn shū.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I rarely give in first.

entries.example: 地震的時候，大家都很恐慌。
entries.examplePinyin: dì zhèn de shí hòu, dà jiā dōu hěn kǒng huāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Everyone panicked during the earthquake.
entries.question: 遇到地震時，你會恐慌嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: yù dào dì zhèn shí, nǐ huì kǒng huāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you panic when there's an earthquake?
entries.answer: 第一次遇到地震時，我很恐慌。
entries.answerPinyin: dì yī cì yù dào dì zhèn shí, wǒ hěn kǒng huāng.
entries.answerEnglish: The first time I experienced an earthquake, I panicked.

entries.example: 老闆用獎金激勵員工。
entries.examplePinyin: lǎo bǎn yòng jiǎng jīn jī lì yuán gōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The boss motivates employees with bonuses.
entries.question: 什麼事最能激勵你？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shì zuì néng jī lì nǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: What motivates you the most?
entries.answer: 朋友的支持最能激勵我。
entries.answerPinyin: péng yǒu de zhī chí zuì néng jī lì wǒ.
entries.answerEnglish: My friends' support motivates me the most.

entries.example: 晚上公園裡有很多蝙蝠。
entries.examplePinyin: wǎn shàng gōng yuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō biān fú.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of bats in the park at night.
entries.question: 你看過蝙蝠嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò biān fú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a bat?
entries.answer: 看過，我在山上看過蝙蝠。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài shān shàng kàn guò biān fú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've seen bats in the mountains.

entries.example: 公司每個月給我交通津貼。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng sī měi gè yuè gěi wǒ jiāo tōng jīn tiē.
entries.exampleEnglish: My company gives me a transportation allowance every month.
entries.question: 你的公司有什麼津貼嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng sī yǒu shén me jīn tiē ma?
entries.questionEnglish: What allowances does your company give?
entries.answer: 我們公司有午餐津貼。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men gōng sī yǒu wǔ cān jīn tiē.
entries.answerEnglish: Our company gives a lunch allowance.

entries.example: 法官判他有罪。
entries.examplePinyin: fǎ guān pàn tā yǒu zuì.
entries.exampleEnglish: The judge found him guilty.
entries.question: 法官要有什麼才能判人有罪？
entries.questionPinyin: fǎ guān yào yǒu shén me cái néng pàn rén yǒu zuì?
entries.questionEnglish: What does a judge need before finding someone guilty?
entries.answer: 法官要有足夠的證據才能判人有罪。
entries.answerPinyin: fǎ guān yào yǒu zú gòu de zhèng jù cái néng pàn rén yǒu zuì.
entries.answerEnglish: A judge needs enough evidence to find someone guilty.

entries.example: 我週末都在剪輯旅行的影片。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zhōu mò dōu zài jiǎn jí lǚ xíng de yǐng piàn.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zì jǐ jiǎn jí yǐng piàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you edit videos yourself?
entries.answer: 會，我常用手機剪輯影片。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng yòng shǒu jī jiǎn jí yǐng piàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often edit videos on my phone.

entries.example: 我們要一起對抗這次的疫情。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men yào yì qǐ duì kàng zhè cì de yì qíng.
entries.exampleEnglish: We need to fight this outbreak together.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yòng shén me fāng fǎ duì kàng yā lì?

entries.answer: 我用運動來對抗壓力。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yòng yùn dòng lái duì kàng yā lì.
entries.answerEnglish: I fight stress by exercising.

entries.example: 她的家人信伊斯蘭教。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de jiā rén xìn yī sī lán jiào.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu péng yǒu xìn yī sī lán jiào ma?

entries.answer: 有，我的同事信伊斯蘭教。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de tóng shì xìn yī sī lán jiào.

entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men gōng sī míng nián yào gēn lìng yì jiā hé bìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Our company is merging with another one next year.

entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ gōng sī hé bìng, nǐ huì dān xīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: If your company merged, would you worry?
entries.answer: 會，公司合併以後可能會裁員。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, gōng sī hé bìng yǐ hòu kě néng huì cái yuán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, after a merger there might be layoffs.

entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de zū yuē xià gè yuè dào qí.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de zū yuē shén me shí hòu dào qí?

entries.answer: 我的租約明年三月到期。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de zū yuē míng nián sān yuè dào qí.

entries.example: 海生館裡有很多海洋生物。
entries.examplePinyin: hǎi shēng guǎn lǐ yǒu hěn duō hǎi yáng shēng wù.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ yì zhǒng hǎi yáng shēng wù?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your favorite sea creature?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡的海洋生物是海豚。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan de hǎi yáng shēng wù shì hǎi tún.
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite sea creature is the dolphin.

entries.example: 我每年都要繳保險費。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi nián dōu yào jiǎo bǎo xiǎn fèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: I have to pay insurance premiums every year.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yí gè yuè fù duō shǎo bǎo xiǎn fèi?
entries.questionEnglish: How much do you pay for insurance each month?
entries.answer: 我一個月付三千塊保險費。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yí gè yuè fù sān qiān kuài bǎo xiǎn fèi.
entries.answerEnglish: I pay three thousand dollars a month for insurance.

entries.examplePinyin: tā dé dào hěn duō nián qīng rén de xuǎn piào.
entries.exampleEnglish: He got a lot of young people's votes.
entries.question: 你上次投下選票是什麼時候？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shàng cì tóu xià xuǎn piào shì shén me shí hòu?
entries.questionEnglish: When did you last cast a vote?
entries.answer: 我上次投下選票是兩年前。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ shàng cì tóu xià xuǎn piào shì liǎng nián qián.
entries.answerEnglish: I last voted two years ago.

entries.example: 她爸爸是一位銀行家。
entries.examplePinyin: tā bà ba shì yí wèi yín háng jiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: Her father is a banker.
entries.question: 你想當銀行家嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng dāng yín háng jiā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you want to be a banker?
entries.answer: 不想，銀行家的壓力太大了。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xiǎng, yín háng jiā de yā lì tài dà le.
entries.answerEnglish: No, bankers are under too much pressure.

entries.english: give in; make a concession; concede
entries.example: 最後老闆讓步，同意我們放假。
entries.examplePinyin: zuì hòu lǎo bǎn ràng bù, tóng yì wǒ men fàng jià.

entries.questionPinyin: gōng zuò shàng yì jiàn bù tóng shí, nǐ huì ràng bù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you disagree with someone at work, do you give in?
entries.answer: 有時候會，我會讓步一點。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu huì, wǒ huì ràng bù yì diǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes; I'll give a little.

entries.example: 他出差都搭商務艙。
entries.examplePinyin: tā chū chāi dōu dā shāng wù cāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: He always flies business class on work trips.
entries.question: 你坐過商務艙嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò guò shāng wù cāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever flown business class?
entries.answer: 坐過一次，商務艙真的很舒服。
entries.answerPinyin: zuò guò yí cì, shāng wù cāng zhēn de hěn shū fú.
entries.answerEnglish: Once—business class is really comfortable.

entries.example: 這幅畫在拍賣會上賣了一百萬。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè fú huà zài pāi mài huì shàng mài le yì bǎi wàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This painting sold for a million at auction.
entries.question: 你在網路拍賣上買過東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài wǎng lù pāi mài shàng mǎi guò dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you bought anything on an online auction site?
entries.answer: 買過，我在網路拍賣買過二手相機。
entries.answerPinyin: mǎi guò, wǒ zài wǎng lù pāi mài mǎi guò èr shǒu xiàng jī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I bought a used camera on an online auction site.

entries.example: 她為了家人犧牲了很多。
entries.examplePinyin: tā wèi le jiā rén xī shēng le hěn duō.
entries.exampleEnglish: She sacrificed a lot for her family.
entries.question: 你為了工作犧牲過什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ wèi le gōng zuò xī shēng guò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What have you sacrificed for work?
entries.answer: 我為了工作犧牲了很多睡覺時間。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ wèi le gōng zuò xī shēng le hěn duō shuì jiào shí jiān.
entries.answerEnglish: I've sacrificed a lot of sleep for work.

entries.example: 那個明星的經紀人很兇。
entries.examplePinyin: nà ge míng xīng de jīng jì rén hěn xiōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: That celebrity's agent is really fierce.
entries.question: 如果你是明星，你需要經紀人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ nǐ shì míng xīng, nǐ xū yào jīng jì rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: If you were a celebrity, would you need an agent?
entries.answer: 需要，經紀人可以幫我安排工作。
entries.answerPinyin: xū yào, jīng jì rén kě yǐ bāng wǒ ān pái gōng zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, an agent could arrange my work for me.

entries.example: 這位大使會說很流利的中文。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè wèi dà shǐ huì shuō hěn liú lì de zhōng wén.
entries.exampleEnglish: This ambassador speaks very fluent Chinese.
entries.question: 你見過你們國家的大使嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiàn guò nǐ men guó jiā de dà shǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever met your country's ambassador?
entries.answer: 見過一次，那位大使人很好。
entries.answerPinyin: jiàn guò yí cì, nà wèi dà shǐ rén hěn hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Once—the ambassador was really nice.

entries.example: 我對他的笑話已經免疫了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ duì tā de xiào huà yǐ jīng miǎn yì le.
entries.exampleEnglish: I've become immune to his jokes.
entries.question: 你對什麼事情已經免疫了？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì shén me shì qíng yǐ jīng miǎn yì le?
entries.questionEnglish: What have you become immune to?
entries.answer: 我對台灣的地震已經免疫了。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ duì tái wān de dì zhèn yǐ jīng miǎn yì le.
entries.answerEnglish: I've become immune to Taiwan's earthquakes.

entries.example: 這塊玻璃要用機器切割。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè kuài bō lí yào yòng jī qì qiē gē.
entries.exampleEnglish: This piece of glass has to be cut by machine.
entries.question: 你會把工作和生活切割開來嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì bǎ gōng zuò hé shēng huó qiē gē kāi lái ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you keep work and life separate?
entries.answer: 會，下班後我會把工作切割開來。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, xià bān hòu wǒ huì bǎ gōng zuò qiē gē kāi lái.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, after work I cut myself off from work.

entries.example: 我在電視上看到火箭發射。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài diàn shì shàng kàn dào huǒ jiàn fā shè.
entries.exampleEnglish: I watched a rocket launch on TV.
entries.question: 你看過火箭發射嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò huǒ jiàn fā shè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a rocket launch?
entries.answer: 看過，我在網路上看過火箭發射。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài wǎng lù shang kàn guò huǒ jiàn fā shè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've watched a rocket launch online.

entries.example: 球進了，大家都在歡呼。
entries.examplePinyin: qiú jìn le, dà jiā dōu zài huān hū.
entries.exampleEnglish: The ball went in and everyone cheered.
entries.question: 看球賽時，你會大聲歡呼嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: kàn qiú sài shí, nǐ huì dà shēng huān hū ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you cheer loudly when watching games?
entries.answer: 會，我支持的隊得分時我會歡呼。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ zhī chí de duì dé fēn shí wǒ huì huān hū.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I cheer when my team scores.

entries.example: 機車的廢氣讓空氣很差。
entries.examplePinyin: jī chē de fèi qì ràng kōng qì hěn chà.
entries.exampleEnglish: Scooter exhaust makes the air bad.
entries.question: 你覺得機車廢氣是大問題嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de jī chē fèi qì shì dà wèn tí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think scooter exhaust is a big problem?
entries.answer: 是，路上的廢氣讓我很難呼吸。
entries.answerPinyin: shì, lù shang de fèi qì ràng wǒ hěn nán hū xī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the exhaust on the road makes it hard for me to breathe.

entries.example: 做蛋糕前，先把鮮奶油打發。
entries.examplePinyin: zuò dàn gāo qián, xiān bǎ xiān nǎi yóu dǎ fā.
entries.exampleEnglish: Before making the cake, whip the cream first.
entries.question: 你有空時都怎麼打發時間？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu kòng shí dōu zěn me dǎ fā shí jiān?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you kill time when you're free?
entries.answer: 我都看劇來打發時間。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dōu kàn jù lái dǎ fā shí jiān.
entries.answerEnglish: I watch shows to kill time.

entries.example: 這題太難了，我投降！
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tí tài nán le, wǒ tóu xiáng!
entries.exampleEnglish: This question is too hard—I give up!
entries.question: 學中文時，你曾經想投降嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: xué zhōng wén shí, nǐ céng jīng xiǎng tóu xiáng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever wanted to give up while learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 有，聲調太難時我很想投降。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, shēng diào tài nán shí wǒ hěn xiǎng tóu xiáng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when the tones get too hard, I want to give up.

entries.example: 這只是一個很微小的改變。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhǐ shì yí gè hěn wéi xiǎo de gǎi biàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This is just a tiny change.
entries.question: 你最近有什麼微小的改變嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn yǒu shén me wéi xiǎo de gǎi biàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you made any small changes lately?
entries.answer: 我開始每天走路上班，這是個微小的改變。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ kāi shǐ měi tiān zǒu lù shàng bān, zhè shì gè wéi xiǎo de gǎi biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I've started walking to work every day—a small change.

entries.example: 我要去大使館辦簽證。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ yào qù dà shǐ guǎn bàn qiān zhèng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I need to go to the embassy for a visa.
entries.question: 你的國家在台灣有大使館嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā zài tái wān yǒu dà shǐ guǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your country have an embassy in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 沒有大使館，只有辦事處。
entries.answerPinyin: méi yǒu dà shǐ guǎn, zhǐ yǒu bàn shì chù.
entries.answerEnglish: No embassy—just a representative office.

entries.example: 喝酒過量對身體不好。
entries.examplePinyin: hē jiǔ guò liàng duì shēn tǐ bù hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Drinking too much is bad for your health.
entries.question: 你覺得自己喝咖啡過量嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ hē kā fēi guò liàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you drink too much coffee?
entries.answer: 可能過量了，我每天喝四杯。
entries.answerPinyin: kě néng guò liàng le, wǒ měi tiān hē sì bēi.
entries.answerEnglish: Probably too much—I drink four cups a day.

entries.example: 他週末在河濱公園打橄欖球。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zhōu mò zài hé bīn gōng yuán dǎ gǎn lǎn qiú.
entries.exampleEnglish: He plays rugby at the riverside park on weekends.
entries.question: 你看過橄欖球比賽嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò gǎn lǎn qiú bǐ sài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever watched a rugby match?
entries.answer: 看過，我很喜歡看橄欖球比賽。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ hěn xǐ huan kàn gǎn lǎn qiú bǐ sài.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love watching rugby.

entries.example: 我們搭郵輪去了沖繩。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men dā yóu lún qù le chōng shéng.
entries.exampleEnglish: We took a cruise to Okinawa.
entries.question: 你搭過郵輪嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dā guò yóu lún ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been on a cruise?
entries.answer: 搭過，我跟家人搭郵輪去過日本。
entries.answerPinyin: dā guò, wǒ gēn jiā rén dā yóu lún qù guò rì běn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I took a cruise to Japan with my family.

entries.example: 她花錢很謹慎。
entries.examplePinyin: tā huā qián hěn jǐn shèn.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's very careful with money.
entries.question: 你花錢謹慎嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huā qián jǐn shèn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you careful with money?
entries.answer: 很謹慎，我每個月都會記帳。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn jǐn shèn, wǒ měi gè yuè dōu huì jì zhàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Very careful—I keep track of my spending every month.

entries.example: 他們兩個人之間有火花。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men liǎng gè rén zhī jiān yǒu huǒ huā.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a spark between the two of them.
entries.question: 你跟另一半第一次見面有火花嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gēn lìng yí bàn dì yī cì jiàn miàn yǒu huǒ huā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Was there a spark when you first met your partner?
entries.answer: 有，我們第一次見面就有火花。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men dì yī cì jiàn miàn jiù yǒu huǒ huā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there was a spark the first time we met.

entries.example: 她的先生是一位外交官。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de xiān shēng shì yí wèi wài jiāo guān.
entries.exampleEnglish: Her husband is a diplomat.
entries.question: 你想當外交官嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng dāng wài jiāo guān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you want to be a diplomat?
entries.answer: 想，我覺得外交官的工作很有趣。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, wǒ jué de wài jiāo guān de gōng zuò hěn yǒu qù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I think a diplomat's job is interesting.

entries.example: 我推測他今天不會來了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ tuī cè tā jīn tiān bú huì lái le.
entries.exampleEnglish: My guess is he won't come today.
entries.question: 你推測明年房價會怎麼樣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tuī cè míng nián fáng jià huì zěn me yàng?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you guess will happen to housing prices next year?
entries.answer: 我推測明年房價還會漲。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ tuī cè míng nián fáng jià hái huì zhǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd guess housing prices will keep rising.

entries.example: 每天搭計程車太奢侈了。
entries.examplePinyin: měi tiān dā jì chéng chē tài shē chǐ le.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taking a taxi every day is too extravagant.
entries.question: 你做過最奢侈的事是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò guò zuì shē chǐ de shì shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the most extravagant thing you've done?
entries.answer: 我做過最奢侈的事是住五星級飯店。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuò guò zuì shē chǐ de shì shì zhù wǔ xīng jí fàn diàn.
entries.answerEnglish: The most extravagant thing I've done is stay at a five-star hotel.

entries.example: 他是業餘的攝影師。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì yè yú de shè yǐng shī.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's an amateur photographer.
entries.question: 你業餘時間喜歡做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yè yú shí jiān xǐ huan zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you like doing in your spare time?
entries.answer: 我業餘時間喜歡畫畫。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yè yú shí jiān xǐ huan huà huà.
entries.answerEnglish: In my spare time I like painting.

entries.example: 加拿大總理今天發表了演講。
entries.examplePinyin: jiā ná dà zǒng lǐ jīn tiān fā biǎo le yǎn jiǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The Canadian prime minister gave a speech today.
entries.question: 你們國家的領導人是總統還是總理？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men guó jiā de lǐng dǎo rén shì zǒng tǒng hái shì zǒng lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your country's leader a president or a prime minister?
entries.answer: 我們國家的領導人是總理。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men guó jiā de lǐng dǎo rén shì zǒng lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Our country's leader is a prime minister.

entries.example: 剩餘的菜可以打包帶走。
entries.examplePinyin: shèng yú de cài kě yǐ dǎ bāo dài zǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: You can take the leftover food to go.
entries.question: 吃不完時，你會把剩餘的菜帶走嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: chī bù wán shí, nǐ huì bǎ shèng yú de cài dài zǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you can't finish, do you take the leftovers home?
entries.answer: 會，我都會把剩餘的菜打包。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōu huì bǎ shèng yú de cài dǎ bāo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always pack up the leftovers.

entries.example: 工作一直做不好，讓我很有挫折感。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng zuò yì zhí zuò bù hǎo, ràng wǒ hěn yǒu cuò zhé gǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Not being able to get my work right makes me really frustrated.
entries.question: 什麼事最讓你有挫折感？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shì zuì ràng nǐ yǒu cuò zhé gǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: What frustrates you the most?
entries.answer: 聽不懂台語的時候，我最有挫折感。
entries.answerPinyin: tīng bù dǒng tái yǔ de shí hòu, wǒ zuì yǒu cuò zhé gǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: I feel most frustrated when I can't understand Taiwanese.

entries.example: 我爺爺很喜歡收藏古董。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ yé ye hěn xǐ huan shōu cáng gǔ dǒng.
entries.exampleEnglish: My grandpa loves collecting antiques.
entries.question: 你家裡有古董嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā lǐ yǒu gǔ dǒng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any antiques at home?
entries.answer: 有，我們家有一個古董花瓶。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men jiā yǒu yí gè gǔ dǒng huā píng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we have an antique vase.

entries.example: 下班了，終於解放了！
entries.examplePinyin: xià bān le, zhōng yú jiě fàng le!
entries.exampleEnglish: Work's over—free at last!
entries.question: 什麼時候你會覺得解放了？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shí hòu nǐ huì jué de jiě fàng le?
entries.questionEnglish: When do you feel set free?
entries.answer: 星期五下班時，我覺得解放了。
entries.answerPinyin: xīng qí wǔ xià bān shí, wǒ jué de jiě fàng le.
entries.answerEnglish: When I get off work on Friday, I feel free.

entries.example: 我常接到騷擾電話。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ cháng jiē dào sāo rǎo diàn huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: I often get nuisance calls.
entries.question: 你接過騷擾電話嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiē guò sāo rǎo diàn huà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever received harassing calls?
entries.answer: 接過，我每週都接到騷擾電話。
entries.answerPinyin: jiē guò, wǒ měi zhōu dōu jiē dào sāo rǎo diàn huà.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I get nuisance calls every week.

entries.example: 這頓晚餐是她精心準備的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè dùn wǎn cān shì tā jīng xīn zhǔn bèi de.
entries.exampleEnglish: She prepared this dinner with great care.
entries.question: 你曾經精心準備過什麼禮物？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ céng jīng jīng xīn zhǔn bèi guò shén me lǐ wù?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever put a lot of care into a gift?
entries.answer: 我曾經精心做了一本相簿送給女朋友。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ céng jīng jīng xīn zuò le yì běn xiàng bù sòng gěi nǚ péng yǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: I once carefully made a photo album for my girlfriend.

entries.example: 我外婆家以前有一口井。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ wài pó jiā yǐ qián yǒu yì kǒu jǐng.
entries.exampleEnglish: My grandma's house used to have a well.
entries.question: 你家鄉還有人用井水嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā xiāng hái yǒu rén yòng jǐng shuǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do people in your hometown still use well water?
entries.answer: 有，鄉下還有人用井水。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, xiāng xià hái yǒu rén yòng jǐng shuǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, some people in the countryside still use well water.

entries.example: 我的同事是猶太人。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de tóng shì shì yóu tài rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: My coworker is Jewish.
entries.question: 你有猶太人朋友嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu yóu tài rén péng yǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have Jewish friends?
entries.answer: 有，我大學同學是猶太人。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ dà xué tóng xué shì yóu tài rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, one of my college classmates is Jewish.

entries.example: 她在一家出版社上班。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài yì jiā chū bǎn shè shàng bān.
entries.exampleEnglish: She works at a publishing house.
entries.question: 你想在出版社工作嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng zài chū bǎn shè gōng zuò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to work at a publishing house?
entries.answer: 想，我很想在出版社當編輯。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, wǒ hěn xiǎng zài chū bǎn shè dāng biān jí.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd love to be an editor at a publisher.

entries.example: 他對伊斯蘭文化很有興趣。
entries.examplePinyin: tā duì yī sī lán wén huà hěn yǒu xìng qù.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's very interested in Islamic culture.
entries.question: 你去過伊斯蘭國家嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò yī sī lán guó jiā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to an Islamic country?
entries.answer: 去過，我去過好幾個伊斯蘭國家。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, wǒ qù guò hǎo jǐ gè yī sī lán guó jiā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've been to several Islamic countries.

entries.example: 颱風讓很多人無家可歸。
entries.examplePinyin: tái fēng ràng hěn duō rén wú jiā kě guī.
entries.exampleEnglish: The typhoon left many people homeless.
entries.question: 你的城市有很多無家可歸的人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de chéng shì yǒu hěn duō wú jiā kě guī de rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there many homeless people in your city?
entries.answer: 有，車站附近有很多無家可歸的人。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, chē zhàn fù jìn yǒu hěn duō wú jiā kě guī de rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are many homeless people near the station.

entries.example: 冷氣可以自動調節溫度。
entries.examplePinyin: lěng qì kě yǐ zì dòng tiáo jié wēn dù.
entries.exampleEnglish: The air conditioner adjusts the temperature automatically.
entries.question: 你都怎麼調節工作壓力？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dōu zěn me tiáo jié gōng zuò yā lì?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you manage work stress?
entries.answer: 我會去爬山調節壓力。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì qù pá shān tiáo jié yā lì.
entries.answerEnglish: I go hiking to relieve stress.

entries.example: 他因為不明原因住院了。
entries.examplePinyin: tā yīn wèi bù míng yuán yīn zhù yuàn le.
entries.exampleEnglish: He was hospitalized for unknown reasons.
entries.question: 你相信有不明飛行物嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiāng xìn yǒu bù míng fēi xíng wù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you believe in UFOs?
entries.answer: 我相信，宇宙裡一定有不明飛行物。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiāng xìn, yǔ zhòu lǐ yí dìng yǒu bù míng fēi xíng wù.
entries.answerEnglish: I do—there must be UFOs out in the universe.

entries.example: 根據統計，台灣人很愛喝手搖飲。
entries.examplePinyin: gēn jù tǒng jì, tái wān rén hěn ài hē shǒu yáo yǐn.
entries.exampleEnglish: According to statistics, Taiwanese people love hand-shaken drinks.
entries.question: 你會統計自己每個月花多少錢嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì tǒng jì zì jǐ měi gè yuè huā duō shǎo qián ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you keep track of how much you spend each month?
entries.answer: 會，我用手機統計每個月的花費。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ yòng shǒu jī tǒng jì měi gè yuè de huā fèi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I track my monthly spending on my phone.

entries.example: 她今天擦了粉紅色的腮紅。
entries.examplePinyin: tā jīn tiān cā le fěn hóng sè de sāi hóng.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's wearing pink blush today.
entries.question: 你平常會擦腮紅嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ píng cháng huì cā sāi hóng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you usually wear blush?
entries.answer: 會，我出門都會擦一點腮紅。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ chū mén dōu huì cā yì diǎn sāi hóng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I put on a little blush whenever I go out.

entries.examplePinyin: tā míng tiān yào qù fǎ yuàn zuò zhèng.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò fǎ yuàn ma?

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zài liǎn shū shàng zhāng tiē shēng huó zhào ma?

entries.answer: 很少，我不太在臉書張貼照片。

entries.answerEnglish: Rarely; I don't post photos on Facebook much.

entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men yuè guò nà zuò shān jiù dào le.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ céng jīng zuò chē yuè guò guó jiè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever crossed a border by car?
entries.answer: 有，我在歐洲坐車越過國界。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ zài ōu zhōu zuò chē yuè guò guó jiè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I crossed a border by car in Europe.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zhào gù fù mǔ shì yì wù ma?

entries.answer: 是，我覺得照顧父母是我的義務。
entries.answerPinyin: shì, wǒ jué de zhào gù fù mǔ shì wǒ de yì wù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I think it's my duty to care for my parents.

entries.questionPinyin: xuǎn gōng zuò shí, nǐ zuì dà de kǎo liáng shì shén me?

entries.answerEnglish: My biggest consideration is the salary.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xī wàng tái wān yǐn jìn nǐ men guó jiā de shén me?

entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xī wàng tái wān yǐn jìn wǒ men guó jiā de miàn bāo.
entries.answerEnglish: I wish Taiwan would bring in bread from my country.

entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I pray every morning.

entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my cheeks turn red after just a little.

entries.examplePinyin: zhè tào xī zhuāng shì wǒ dìng zhì de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This suit was custom-made for me.

entries.answer: 買過，我在台南訂製過一件旗袍。
entries.answerPinyin: mǎi guò, wǒ zài tái nán dìng zhì guò yí jiàn qí páo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I had a qipao made to order in Tainan.

entries.answerEnglish: I think the decor is secondary.

entries.answer: 會，我會分送伴手禮給同事。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì fēn sòng bàn shǒu lǐ gěi tóng shì.

entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōu bǎ cái wù fàng zài qián miàn.

entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì tóu rù de xìng qù shì shè yǐng.

entries.exampleEnglish: He goes to practice shooting every weekend.
entries.question: 射擊是奧運的比賽項目嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: shè jí shì ào yùn de bǐ sài xiàng mù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is shooting an Olympic event?
entries.answer: 是，射擊是奧運的比賽項目。
entries.answerPinyin: shì, shè jí shì ào yùn de bǐ sài xiàng mù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, shooting is an Olympic event.

entries.example: 小心，這把刀的刀刃很利。
entries.examplePinyin: xiǎo xīn, zhè bǎ dāo de dāo rèn hěn lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Careful, the blade of this knife is very sharp.
entries.question: 你家菜刀的刀刃還利嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā cài dāo de dāo rèn hái lì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is the blade of your kitchen knife still sharp?
entries.answer: 不太利了，刀刃有點鈍。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài lì le, dāo rèn yǒu diǎn dùn.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really, the blade is a bit dull.

entries.example: 捷運每班車大約間隔五分鐘。
entries.examplePinyin: jié yùn měi bān chē dà yuē jiàn gé wǔ fēn zhōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: MRT trains come about every five minutes.
entries.question: 你家附近的公車間隔多久？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn de gōng chē jiàn gé duō jiǔ?
entries.questionEnglish: How far apart are the buses near your home?
entries.answer: 大概間隔十五分鐘一班。
entries.answerPinyin: dà gài jiàn gé shí wǔ fēn zhōng yì bān.
entries.answerEnglish: There's one about every fifteen minutes.

entries.example: 這幅畫現在在故宮展出。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè fú huà xiàn zài zài gù gōng zhǎn chū.
entries.exampleEnglish: This painting is on display at the National Palace Museum now.
entries.question: 你想看故宮展出的什麼東西？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng kàn gù gōng zhǎn chū de shén me dōng xī?
entries.questionEnglish: What would you like to see on display at the National Palace Museum?
entries.answer: 我想看故宮展出的翠玉白菜。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng kàn gù gōng zhǎn chū de cuì yù bái cài.
entries.answerEnglish: I want to see the Jadeite Cabbage on display there.

entries.example: 這件襯衫是絲做的，要手洗。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn chèn shān shì sī zuò de, yào shǒu xǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shirt is made of silk, so it has to be hand-washed.
entries.question: 你有絲做的衣服嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu sī zuò de yī fu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any clothes made of silk?
entries.answer: 有，我有一條絲做的領帶。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ yǒu yì tiáo sī zuò de lǐng dài.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a silk tie.

entries.example: 牆上有一根釘子，可以掛畫。
entries.examplePinyin: qiáng shàng yǒu yì gēn dīng zi, kě yǐ guà huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a nail in the wall for hanging a picture.
entries.question: 你會自己在牆上釘釘子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zì jǐ zài qiáng shàng dìng dīng zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you put nails in the wall yourself?
entries.answer: 會，我常自己釘釘子掛照片。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng zì jǐ dìng dīng zi guà zhào piàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often hammer in nails myself to hang photos.

entries.example: 請幫我寫這份報告的摘要。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng bāng wǒ xiě zhè fèn bào gào de zhāi yào.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please write a summary of this report for me.
entries.question: 你工作時常常要寫摘要嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gōng zuò shí cháng cháng yào xiě zhāi yào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often have to write summaries at work?
entries.answer: 會，我每週都要寫會議摘要。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi zhōu dōu yào xiě huì yì zhāi yào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have to write meeting summaries every week.

entries.example: 請把剩菜放進容器裡。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng bǎ shèng cài fàng jìn róng qì lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please put the leftovers in a container.
entries.question: 你買外帶時會自己帶容器嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi wài dài shí huì zì jǐ dài róng qì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you bring your own container when you buy takeout?
entries.answer: 會，我買豆花會帶自己的容器。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ mǎi dòu huā huì dài zì jǐ de róng qì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I bring my own container when I buy douhua.

entries.example: 這些花是人造的，不是真的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè xiē huā shì rén zào de, bú shì zhēn de.
entries.exampleEnglish: These flowers are artificial, not real.
entries.question: 你喜歡人造花還是真花？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan rén zào huā hái shì zhēn huā?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer artificial flowers or real ones?
entries.answer: 我喜歡真花，人造花不夠漂亮。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan zhēn huā, rén zào huā bú gòu piào liang.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer real flowers; artificial ones aren't pretty enough.

entries.example: 這個杯子的花紋很細緻。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge bēi zi de huā wén hěn xì zhì.
entries.exampleEnglish: The pattern on this cup is very delicate.
entries.question: 你覺得哪裡的手工藝很細緻？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǎ lǐ de shǒu gōng yì hěn xì zhì?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you think the handicrafts are very fine?
entries.answer: 我覺得鶯歌的陶瓷很細緻。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de yīng gē de táo cí hěn xì zhì.
entries.answerEnglish: I think the pottery from Yingge is very fine.

entries.example: 這只是一場非正式的會議。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhǐ shì yì chǎng fēi zhèng shì de huì yì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This is just an informal meeting.
entries.question: 你喜歡正式還是非正式的聚會？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zhèng shì hái shì fēi zhèng shì de jù huì?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer formal or informal gatherings?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡非正式的聚會。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan fēi zhèng shì de jù huì.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer informal gatherings.

entries.example: 這部電影的特效很逼真。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng de tè xiào hěn bī zhēn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The special effects in this movie are very realistic.
entries.question: 你看過很逼真的蠟像嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò hěn bī zhēn de là xiàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen very lifelike wax figures?
entries.answer: 看過，那些蠟像做得好逼真。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, nà xiē là xiàng zuò de hǎo bī zhēn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, those wax figures were so lifelike.

entries.example: 這個規定太荒謬了！
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge guī dìng tài huāng miù le!
entries.exampleEnglish: This rule is absolutely ridiculous!
entries.question: 你聽過什麼荒謬的規定？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tīng guò shén me huāng miù de guī dìng?
entries.questionEnglish: What ridiculous rules have you heard of?
entries.answer: 我聽過上班不能喝水這種荒謬的規定。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ tīng guò shàng bān bù néng hē shuǐ zhè zhǒng huāng miù de guī dìng.
entries.answerEnglish: I've heard of an absurd rule that you can't drink water at work.

entries.example: 我學中文純粹是因為興趣。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xué zhōng wén chún cuì shì yīn wèi xìng qù.
entries.exampleEnglish: I study Chinese purely out of interest.
entries.question: 你來台灣純粹是為了工作嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ lái tái wān chún cuì shì wèi le gōng zuò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you come to Taiwan purely for work?
entries.answer: 不是純粹為了工作，我也很喜歡台灣。
entries.answerPinyin: bú shì chún cuì wèi le gōng zuò, wǒ yě hěn xǐ huan tái wān.
entries.answerEnglish: Not purely for work. I also really like Taiwan.

entries.example: 這座山裡有很多礦物。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zuò shān lǐ yǒu hěn duō kuàng wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of minerals in this mountain.
entries.question: 你覺得喝什麼水比較健康？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de hē shén me shuǐ bǐ jiào jiàn kāng?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of water do you think is healthier?
entries.answer: 我覺得有礦物質的水比較健康。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de yǒu kuàng wù zhí de shuǐ bǐ jiào jiàn kāng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think water with minerals in it is healthier.

entries.example: 這條山路很陡，要小心走。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tiáo shān lù hěn dǒu, yào xiǎo xīn zǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: This mountain path is steep, so walk carefully.
entries.question: 你爬過很陡的山嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pá guò hěn dǒu de shān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever climbed a very steep mountain?
entries.answer: 爬過，象山的樓梯很陡。
entries.answerPinyin: pá guò, xiàng shān de lóu tī hěn dǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the steps up Elephant Mountain are very steep.

entries.example: 她的戒指上有一顆鑽石。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de jiè zhǐ shàng yǒu yì kē zuàn shí.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a diamond on her ring.
entries.question: 你覺得結婚一定要買鑽石嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de jié hūn yí dìng yào mǎi zuàn shí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you have to buy a diamond to get married?
entries.answer: 不一定，我覺得鑽石太貴了。
entries.answerPinyin: bù yí dìng, wǒ jué de zuàn shí tài guì le.
entries.answerEnglish: Not necessarily. I think diamonds are too expensive.

entries.example: 樹上有一個鳥巢。
entries.examplePinyin: shù shàng yǒu yí gè niǎo cháo.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a bird's nest in the tree.
entries.question: 你家附近有鳥巢嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn yǒu niǎo cháo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there any birds' nests near your home?
entries.answer: 有，我家陽台上有一個鳥巢。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiā yáng tái shàng yǒu yí gè niǎo cháo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a bird's nest on my balcony.

entries.example: 那位舞者跳得很美。
entries.examplePinyin: nà wèi wǔ zhě tiào de hěn měi.
entries.exampleEnglish: That dancer dances beautifully.
entries.question: 你喜歡看舞者表演嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kàn wǔ zhě biǎo yǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like watching dancers perform?
entries.answer: 喜歡，舞者的動作都很美。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǔ zhě de dòng zuò dōu hěn měi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, dancers' movements are all so beautiful.

entries.example: 公園裡有一座很大的雕像。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng yuán lǐ yǒu yí zuò hěn dà de diāo xiàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a big statue in the park.
entries.question: 你在台灣看過什麼雕像？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān kàn guò shén me diāo xiàng?
entries.questionEnglish: What statues have you seen in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我在朱銘美術館看過很多雕像。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài zhū míng měi shù guǎn kàn guò hěn duō diāo xiàng.
entries.answerEnglish: I saw lots of statues at the Juming Museum.

entries.example: 這兩條路互相垂直。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè liǎng tiáo lù hù xiāng chuí zhí.
entries.exampleEnglish: These two roads are perpendicular to each other.
entries.question: 你住的地方，路是互相垂直的嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhù de dì fāng, lù shì hù xiāng chuí zhí de ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Where you live, are the roads at right angles to each other?
entries.answer: 對，我家附近的路大多互相垂直。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ jiā fù jìn de lù dà duō hù xiāng chuí zhí.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, most of the roads near my home are at right angles.

entries.example: 糖在熱水裡溶解得很快。
entries.examplePinyin: táng zài rè shuǐ lǐ róng jiě de hěn kuài.
entries.exampleEnglish: Sugar dissolves quickly in hot water.
entries.question: 你泡咖啡會等糖溶解嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pào kā fēi huì děng táng róng jiě ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you make coffee, do you wait for the sugar to dissolve?
entries.answer: 會，我會攪一攪，讓糖溶解。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì jiǎo yi jiǎo, ràng táng róng jiě.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I stir it so the sugar dissolves.

entries.example: 爺爺的耳朵有點聾，要大聲說話。
entries.examplePinyin: yé ye de ěr duo yǒu diǎn lóng, yào dà shēng shuō huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: Grandpa is a bit deaf, so you need to speak loudly.
entries.question: 你會把音樂開得很大聲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì bǎ yīn yuè kāi de hěn dà shēng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you play your music really loud?
entries.answer: 不會，我怕耳朵會聾。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ pà ěr duo huì lóng.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I'm afraid I'd go deaf.

entries.example: 搭飛機不能帶太多液體。
entries.examplePinyin: dā fēi jī bù néng dài tài duō yì tǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: You can't take too much liquid on a plane.
entries.question: 你搭飛機時會帶液體嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dā fēi jī shí huì dài yì tǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you take liquids with you when you fly?
entries.answer: 不會，我把液體都放在行李箱。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ bǎ yì tǐ dōu fàng zài xíng li xiāng.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I put all liquids in my suitcase.

entries.example: 他用筷子用得很熟練。
entries.examplePinyin: tā yòng kuài zi yòng de hěn shú liàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's very skilled with chopsticks.
entries.question: 你用筷子用得熟練嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yòng kuài zi yòng de shú liàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you good at using chopsticks?
entries.answer: 還算熟練，我每天都用筷子吃飯。
entries.answerPinyin: hái suàn shú liàn, wǒ měi tiān dōu yòng kuài zi chī fàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Pretty good. I eat with chopsticks every day.

entries.example: 工作一直出錯，讓他很沮喪。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng zuò yì zhí chū cuò, ràng tā hěn jǔ sàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Making mistakes at work again and again got him down.
entries.question: 你沮喪的時候會做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jǔ sàng de shí hòu huì zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when you feel down?
entries.answer: 我沮喪的時候會去跑步。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jǔ sàng de shí hòu huì qù pǎo bù.
entries.answerEnglish: When I feel down, I go for a run.

entries.example: 這把刀太鈍了，切不動肉。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bǎ dāo tài dùn le, qiē bú dòng ròu.
entries.exampleEnglish: This knife is too blunt to cut the meat.
entries.question: 你家的剪刀很鈍嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de jiǎn dāo hěn dùn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are the scissors at your home blunt?
entries.answer: 有一點鈍，該換新的了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu yì diǎn dùn, gāi huàn xīn de le.
entries.answerEnglish: A bit blunt. It's time to get new ones.

entries.example: 今年的房租大幅上漲。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn nián de fáng zū dà fú shàng zhǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Rents have gone up sharply this year.
entries.question: 你覺得台北的物價大幅上漲了嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái běi de wù jià dà fú shàng zhǎng le ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think prices in Taipei have risen sharply?
entries.answer: 對，外食的價錢大幅上漲了。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wài shí de jià qián dà fú shàng zhǎng le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the cost of eating out has gone up a lot.

entries.example: 別買不必要的東西。
entries.examplePinyin: bié mǎi bú bì yào de dōng xī.
entries.exampleEnglish: Don't buy things you don't need.
entries.question: 你常買不必要的東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng mǎi bú bì yào de dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often buy unnecessary things?
entries.answer: 常常，我常買不必要的衣服。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ cháng mǎi bú bì yào de yī fu.
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I often buy clothes I don't need.

entries.example: 他的演講內容很空洞。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de yǎn jiǎng nèi róng hěn kōng dòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: His speech was empty of real content.
entries.question: 你覺得廣告的話常常很空洞嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de guǎng gào de huà cháng cháng hěn kōng dòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think advertising slogans are often hollow?
entries.answer: 對，很多廣告的話都很空洞。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, hěn duō guǎng gào de huà dōu hěn kōng dòng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a lot of advertising slogans are empty.

entries.example: 他不幸在車禍中受傷了。
entries.examplePinyin: tā bú xìng zài chē huò zhōng shòu shāng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: He was unfortunately injured in a car accident.
entries.question: 你看新聞時，常看到不幸的消息嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn xīn wén shí, cháng kàn dào bú xìng de xiāo xí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often see unfortunate stories in the news?
entries.answer: 常常，新聞裡有很多不幸的消息。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, xīn wén lǐ yǒu hěn duō bú xìng de xiāo xí.
entries.answerEnglish: Often. There are lots of sad stories in the news.

entries.example: 看到可疑的人，請報警。
entries.examplePinyin: kàn dào kě yí de rén, qǐng bào jǐng.
entries.exampleEnglish: If you see anyone suspicious, please call the police.
entries.question: 你在捷運上看過可疑的東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài jié yùn shàng kàn guò kě yí de dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen anything suspicious on the MRT?
entries.answer: 沒有，我沒看過可疑的東西。
entries.answerPinyin: méi yǒu, wǒ méi kàn guò kě yí de dōng xī.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I've never seen anything suspicious.

entries.example: 第一次穿西裝，我覺得很彆扭。
entries.examplePinyin: dì yī cì chuān xī zhuāng, wǒ jué de hěn biè niu.
entries.exampleEnglish: Wearing a suit for the first time, I felt awkward.
entries.question: 你用中文講電話會覺得彆扭嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yòng zhōng wén jiǎng diàn huà huì jué de biè niu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you feel awkward talking on the phone in Chinese?
entries.answer: 會，用中文講電話我覺得很彆扭。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, yòng zhōng wén jiǎng diàn huà wǒ jué de hěn biè niu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I feel awkward talking on the phone in Chinese.

entries.example: 小心，別把蛋壓碎了。
entries.examplePinyin: xiǎo xīn, bié bǎ dàn yā suì le.
entries.exampleEnglish: Careful, don't crush the eggs.
entries.question: 買菜時，你怕東西被壓碎嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: mǎi cài shí, nǐ pà dōng xī bèi yā suì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When buying groceries, do you worry things will get crushed?
entries.answer: 會，我會把雞蛋放上面，免得壓碎。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì bǎ jī dàn fàng shàng miàn, miǎn de yā suì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I put the eggs on top so they don't get crushed.

entries.examplePinyin: wǒ jiā de gǒu duì wǒ hěn zhōng xīn.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de gǒu bǐ māo zhōng xīn ma?

entries.answer: 對，我覺得狗比貓忠心。

entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I think dogs are more loyal than cats.

entries.examplePinyin: suǒ yǒu dōng xī dōu shì yóu yuán zǐ zǔ chéng de.

entries.questionEnglish: Do you know what an atom is?
entries.answer: 知道，原子是非常小的東西。

entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often get scared watching horror movies.

entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've screwed together a bookcase myself.

entries.examplePinyin: chī dōng xī yào màn màn jiáo.

entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi gè zhōu mò dōu cā liàng pí xié.

entries.answer: 不會，但我想學編織。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, dàn wǒ xiǎng xué biān zhī.
entries.answerEnglish: No, but I'd like to learn to knit.
