entries.questionEnglish: How do you like to spend a lazy weekend?
entries.answer: 我喜歡慵懶地躺在沙發上看電影。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan yōng lǎn de tǎng zài shā fā shàng kàn diàn yǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: I like to lie lazily on the sofa and watch movies.

entries.example: 這個壁爐是裝飾性的，不能真的用。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge bì lú shì zhuāng shì xìng de, bù néng zhēn de yòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This fireplace is just decorative; you can't actually use it.
entries.question: 你家裡有裝飾性的東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā lǐ yǒu zhuāng shì xìng de dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any decorative things at home?
entries.answer: 有，我在牆上掛了一些裝飾性的盤子。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ zài qiáng shàng guà le yì xiē zhuāng shì xìng de pán zi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I hung some decorative plates on the wall.

entries.example: 他說的那句話是對我的侮辱。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shuō de nà jù huà shì duì wǒ de wǔ rǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: What he said was an insult to me.
entries.question: 被別人侮辱的時候，你會怎麼做？
entries.questionPinyin: bèi bié rén wǔ rǔ de shí hòu, nǐ huì zěn me zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when someone insults you?
entries.answer: 被侮辱的時候，我會直接離開。
entries.answerPinyin: bèi wǔ rǔ de shí hòu, wǒ huì zhí jiē lí kāi.
entries.answerEnglish: When I'm insulted, I just leave.

entries.example: 這些香蕉放太久，已經腐爛了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè xiē xiāng jiāo fàng tài jiǔ, yǐ jīng fǔ làn le.
entries.exampleEnglish: These bananas were left too long and have rotted.
entries.question: 你冰箱裡的水果常腐爛嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bīng xiāng lǐ de shuǐ guǒ cháng fǔ làn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does the fruit in your fridge often go bad?
entries.answer: 常常，我總是忘記吃，水果就腐爛了。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ zǒng shì wàng jì chī, shuǐ guǒ jiù fǔ làn le.
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I always forget to eat it, and then it rots.

entries.example: 他個性很急躁，不喜歡等人。
entries.examplePinyin: tā gè xìng hěn jí zào, bù xǐ huan děng rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's very impatient by nature and hates waiting for people.
entries.question: 你覺得自己個性急躁嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ gè xìng jí zào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you have an impatient personality?
entries.answer: 有一點，排隊太久我就會急躁。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu yì diǎn, pái duì tài jiǔ wǒ jiù huì jí zào.
entries.answerEnglish: A bit. If I wait in line too long, I get impatient.

entries.example: 這種蛇是無害的，不用怕。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhǒng shé shì wú hài de, bú yòng pà.
entries.exampleEnglish: This kind of snake is harmless; don't be afraid.
entries.question: 你覺得手機對身體無害嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shǒu jī duì shēn tǐ wú hài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think phones are harmless to your health?
entries.answer: 我不覺得手機完全無害。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bù jué de shǒu jī wán quán wú hài.
entries.answerEnglish: I don't think phones are completely harmless.

entries.example: 我很厭惡別人在捷運上大聲講電話。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hěn yàn wù bié rén zài jié yùn shàng dà shēng jiǎng diàn huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: I really can't stand people talking loudly on the phone on the MRT.
entries.question: 你最厭惡什麼樣的行為？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì yàn wù shén me yàng de xíng wéi?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of behavior do you hate most?
entries.answer: 我最厭惡別人插隊。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì yàn wù bié rén chā duì.
entries.answerEnglish: What I hate most is people cutting in line.

entries.example: 他在大家面前罵我，讓我很難堪。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài dà jiā miàn qián mà wǒ, ràng wǒ hěn nán kān.
entries.exampleEnglish: He scolded me in front of everyone, which really embarrassed me.
entries.question: 什麼事情會讓你覺得難堪？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shì qíng huì ràng nǐ jué de nán kān?
entries.questionEnglish: What makes you feel embarrassed?
entries.answer: 在路上跌倒會讓我很難堪。
entries.answerPinyin: zài lù shang dié dǎo huì ràng wǒ hěn nán kān.
entries.answerEnglish: Falling down in the street would embarrass me.

entries.example: 我在酒吧點了一品脫啤酒。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài jiǔ bā diǎn le yì pǐn tuō pí jiǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: I ordered a pint of beer at the bar.
entries.question: 你一次可以喝幾品脫啤酒？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yí cì kě yǐ hē jǐ pǐn tuō pí jiǔ?
entries.questionEnglish: How many pints of beer can you drink in one go?
entries.answer: 我大概可以喝兩品脫啤酒。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dà gài kě yǐ hē liǎng pǐn tuō pí jiǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: I can drink about two pints of beer.

entries.english: marvel; be amazed; exclaim in wonder
entries.example: 太魯閣的風景讓人驚嘆。
entries.examplePinyin: tài lǔ gé de fēng jǐng ràng rén jīng tàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The scenery at Taroko is amazing.
entries.question: 台灣有什麼地方讓你驚嘆？
entries.questionPinyin: tái wān yǒu shén me dì fāng ràng nǐ jīng tàn?
entries.questionEnglish: What place in Taiwan amazed you?
entries.answer: 阿里山的日出讓我很驚嘆。
entries.answerPinyin: ā lǐ shān de rì chū ràng wǒ hěn jīng tàn.
entries.answerEnglish: The sunrise at Alishan amazed me.

entries.example: 在美國，很多人一次買一加侖的牛奶。
entries.examplePinyin: zài měi guó, hěn duō rén yí cì mǎi yì jiā lún de niú nǎi.
entries.exampleEnglish: In the US, many people buy milk a gallon at a time.
entries.question: 你知道一加侖是幾公升嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào yì jiā lún shì jǐ gōng shēng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know how many liters are in a gallon?
entries.answer: 一加侖大概是四公升。
entries.answerPinyin: yì jiā lún dà gài shì sì gōng shēng.
entries.answerEnglish: A gallon is about four liters.

entries.example: 我們在機場短暫見了一面。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zài jī chǎng duǎn zhàn jiàn le yí miàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: We met briefly at the airport.
entries.question: 你曾經在別的國家短暫住過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ céng jīng zài bié de guó jiā duǎn zhàn zhù guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever lived briefly in another country?
entries.answer: 有，我在日本短暫住過三個月。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ zài rì běn duǎn zhàn zhù guò sān gè yuè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I lived in Japan for a short three months.

entries.example: 這首歌我反覆聽了好幾次。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shǒu gē wǒ fǎn fù tīng le hǎo jǐ cì.
entries.exampleEnglish: I listened to this song over and over.
entries.question: 學新單字時，你會反覆練習嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: xué xīn dān zì shí, nǐ huì fǎn fù liàn xí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you learn new words, do you practice them repeatedly?
entries.answer: 會，我每天反覆練習新單字。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi tiān fǎn fù liàn xí xīn dān zì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I practice new words over and over every day.

entries.example: 最近的房價讓年輕人很擔憂。
entries.examplePinyin: zuì jìn de fáng jià ràng nián qīng rén hěn dān yōu.
entries.exampleEnglish: Recent housing prices have young people very worried.
entries.question: 你最擔憂的事情是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì dān yōu de shì qíng shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What are you most worried about?
entries.answer: 我最擔憂家人的健康。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì dān yōu jiā rén de jiàn kāng.
entries.answerEnglish: I worry most about my family's health.

entries.example: 這首歌的歌詞很動人。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shǒu gē de gē cí hěn dòng rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: The lyrics of this song are very moving.
entries.question: 你看過很動人的電影嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò hěn dòng rén de diàn yǐng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen a very moving film?
entries.answer: 看過，那部電影的故事很動人。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, nà bù diàn yǐng de gù shì hěn dòng rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the story of that film was very moving.

entries.example: 這段山路很陡，要用手攀爬。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè duàn shān lù hěn dǒu, yào yòng shǒu pān pá.
entries.exampleEnglish: This part of the trail is steep, so you have to climb with your hands.
entries.question: 你敢攀爬很高的地方嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gǎn pān pá hěn gāo de dì fāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you dare to climb very high places?
entries.answer: 不敢，我不敢攀爬太高的地方。
entries.answerPinyin: bù gǎn, wǒ bù gǎn pān pá tài gāo de dì fāng.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't dare climb anywhere too high.

entries.example: 因為預算受限，我們只能住便宜的飯店。
entries.examplePinyin: yīn wèi yù suàn shòu xiàn, wǒ men zhǐ néng zhù pián yi de fàn diàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Because our budget is limited, we can only stay in cheap hotels.
entries.question: 你在台灣生活，有什麼受限的地方？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān shēng huó, yǒu shén me shòu xiàn de dì fāng?
entries.questionEnglish: In what ways are you limited living in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 因為中文不好，我找工作很受限。
entries.answerPinyin: yīn wèi zhōng wén bù hǎo, wǒ zhǎo gōng zuò hěn shòu xiàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Because my Chinese isn't good, my job search is limited.

entries.example: 這台卡車可以載十公噸的貨。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tái kǎ chē kě yǐ zài shí gōng dūn de huò.
entries.exampleEnglish: This truck can carry ten tonnes of goods.
entries.question: 你知道一公噸是幾公斤嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào yì gōng dūn shì jǐ gōng jīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know how many kilograms are in a tonne?
entries.answer: 一公噸是一千公斤。
entries.answerPinyin: yì gōng dūn shì yì qiān gōng jīn.
entries.answerEnglish: A tonne is a thousand kilograms.

entries.example: 下大雨時，我們找不到任何遮蔽物。
entries.examplePinyin: xià dà yǔ shí, wǒ men zhǎo bú dào rèn hé zhē bì wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: When the downpour started, we couldn't find any shelter.
entries.question: 下雨沒帶傘時，你會找什麼遮蔽物？
entries.questionPinyin: xià yǔ méi dài sǎn shí, nǐ huì zhǎo shén me zhē bì wù?
entries.questionEnglish: When it rains and you have no umbrella, what do you use for cover?
entries.answer: 我會找騎樓當遮蔽物。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì zhǎo qí lóu dàng zhē bì wù.
entries.answerEnglish: I look for an arcade walkway to use as cover.

entries.example: 這場比賽的裁判很公正。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè chǎng bǐ sài de cái pàn hěn gōng zhèng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The referee in this game was very fair.
entries.question: 你覺得你的老闆公正嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ de lǎo bǎn gōng zhèng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your boss is fair?
entries.answer: 我覺得他很公正，對大家都一樣。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de tā hěn gōng zhèng, duì dà jiā dōu yí yàng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think he's fair; he treats everyone the same.

entries.example: 天氣是這次旅行最大的變數。
entries.examplePinyin: tiān qì shì zhè cì lǚ xíng zuì dà de biàn shù.
entries.exampleEnglish: The weather is the biggest unknown on this trip.
entries.question: 你的旅行計畫常有什麼變數？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de lǚ xíng jì huà cháng yǒu shén me biàn shù?
entries.questionEnglish: What variables often affect your travel plans?
entries.answer: 天氣是我旅行最大的變數。
entries.answerPinyin: tiān qì shì wǒ lǚ xíng zuì dà de biàn shù.
entries.answerEnglish: The weather is the biggest variable in my travels.

entries.example: 請幫我把這份報告裝訂起來。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng bāng wǒ bǎ zhè fèn bào gào zhuāng dìng qǐ lái.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please bind this report for me.
entries.question: 你常去影印店裝訂資料嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng qù yǐng yìn diàn zhuāng dìng zī liào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often go to a copy shop to have documents bound?
entries.answer: 常去，我會在影印店裝訂報告。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng qù, wǒ huì zài yǐng yìn diàn zhuāng dìng bào gào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I get my reports bound at the copy shop.

entries.example: 這部電影的視覺效果很棒。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng de shì jué xiào guǒ hěn bàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This movie's visual effects are great.
entries.question: 你覺得哪部電影的視覺效果最好？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǎ bù diàn yǐng de shì jué xiào guǒ zuì hǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: Which movie do you think has the best visual effects?
entries.answer: 我覺得《阿凡達》的視覺效果最好。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de 《 ā fán dá 》 de shì jué xiào guǒ zuì hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: I think Avatar has the best visual effects.

entries.example: 這張圖表清楚呈現了今年的業績。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhāng tú biǎo qīng chǔ chéng xiàn le jīn nián de yè jī.
entries.exampleEnglish: This chart clearly shows this year's sales.
entries.question: 你喜歡用什麼方式呈現報告？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan yòng shén me fāng shì chéng xiàn bào gào?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you like to present your reports?
entries.answer: 我喜歡用圖片呈現報告內容。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan yòng tú piàn chéng xiàn bào gào nèi róng.
entries.answerEnglish: I like to present my reports with pictures.

entries.example: 這棟房子的骨架已經蓋好了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè dòng fáng zi de gǔ jià yǐ jīng gài hǎo le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The frame of this house is already built.
entries.question: 你寫報告前會先寫骨架嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiě bào gào qián huì xiān xiě gǔ jià ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Before writing a report, do you write an outline first?
entries.answer: 會，我會先寫好報告的骨架。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì xiān xiě hǎo bào gào de gǔ jià.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I write the framework of the report first.

entries.example: 水是由氫和氧構成的。
entries.examplePinyin: shuǐ shì yóu qīng hé yǎng gòu chéng de.
entries.exampleEnglish: Water is made up of hydrogen and oxygen.
entries.question: 你覺得幸福的生活由什麼構成？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de xìng fú de shēng huó yóu shén me gòu chéng?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think makes up a happy life?
entries.answer: 我覺得幸福由家人和健康構成。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de xìng fú yóu jiā rén hé jiàn kāng gòu chéng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think happiness is made up of family and health.

entries.example: 他是研究台灣的歷史學家。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì yán jiù tái wān de lì shǐ xué jiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a historian who studies Taiwan.
entries.question: 你看過歷史學家寫的書嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò lì shǐ xué jiā xiě de shū ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you read a book written by a historian?
entries.answer: 看過，我讀過一本歷史學家寫的台灣史。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ dú guò yì běn lì shǐ xué jiā xiě de tái wān shǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've read a history of Taiwan written by a historian.

entries.example: 這位學者專門研究台灣的語言。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè wèi xué zhě zhuān mén yán jiù tái wān de yǔ yán.
entries.exampleEnglish: This scholar specializes in the languages of Taiwan.
entries.question: 你的家人裡有學者嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de jiā rén lǐ yǒu xué zhě ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a scholar in your family?
entries.answer: 有，我舅舅是一位學者。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiù jiu shì yí wèi xué zhě.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my uncle is an academic.

entries.example: 這支手錶可以偵測你的心跳。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhī shǒu biǎo kě yǐ zhēn cè nǐ de xīn tiào.
entries.exampleEnglish: This watch can detect your heart rate.
entries.question: 你家有裝煙霧偵測器嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yǒu zhuāng yān wù zhēn cè qì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a smoke detector at home?
entries.answer: 有，廚房有裝煙霧偵測器。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, chú fáng yǒu zhuāng yān wù zhēn cè qì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a smoke detector in the kitchen.

entries.example: 我很想念在遠方的家人。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hěn xiǎng niàn zài yuǎn fāng de jiā rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: I really miss my family far away.
entries.question: 你在遠方有想念的人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài yuǎn fāng yǒu xiǎng niàn de rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there someone far away whom you miss?
entries.answer: 有，我很想念遠方的爸媽。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ hěn xiǎng niàn yuǎn fāng de bà mā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I really miss my parents far away.

entries.example: 我已經在網路上提交了申請。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ yǐ jīng zài wǎng lù shang tí jiāo le shēn qǐng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I've already submitted the application online.
entries.question: 你工作上常要提交什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gōng zuò shàng cháng yào tí jiāo shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you often have to submit at work?
entries.answer: 我每週都要提交工作報告。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ měi zhōu dōu yào tí jiāo gōng zuò bào gào.
entries.answerEnglish: I have to submit a work report every week.

entries.example: 我運動的頻率是一週三次。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ yùn dòng de pín lǜ shì yì zhōu sān cì.
entries.exampleEnglish: I exercise three times a week.
entries.question: 你回國的頻率是多少？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huí guó de pín lǜ shì duō shǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you go back to your home country?
entries.answer: 我回國的頻率是一年一次。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huí guó de pín lǜ shì yì nián yí cì.
entries.answerEnglish: I go back home once a year.

entries.example: 這句話字面上的意思很簡單。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jù huà zì miàn shàng de yì sī hěn jiǎn dān.
entries.exampleEnglish: The literal meaning of this sentence is simple.
entries.question: 你看過字面上很好笑的中文詞嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò zì miàn shàng hěn hǎo xiào de zhōng wén cí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen any Chinese words that are funny when taken literally?
entries.answer: 有，「熊貓」字面上是像熊的貓。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, “xióng māo” zì miàn shàng shì xiàng xióng de māo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, 'panda' literally means 'bear cat'.

entries.example: 這個停車位是給身心障礙者用的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge tíng chē wèi shì gěi shēn xīn zhàng ài zhě yòng de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This parking space is for people with disabilities.
entries.question: 你的公司有身心障礙的同事嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng sī yǒu shēn xīn zhàng ài de tóng shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company have any coworkers with disabilities?
entries.answer: 有，我們有一位身心障礙的同事。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men yǒu yí wèi shēn xīn zhàng ài de tóng shì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we have a coworker with a disability.

entries.example: 這種洗衣精的用量很少。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhǒng xǐ yī jīng de yòng liàng hěn shǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: You only need a small amount of this laundry detergent.
entries.question: 你做菜時，鹽的用量多嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò cài shí, yán de yòng liàng duō ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use a lot of salt when you cook?
entries.answer: 不多，我做菜時鹽的用量很少。
entries.answerPinyin: bù duō, wǒ zuò cài shí yán de yòng liàng hěn shǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I use very little salt when I cook.

entries.example: 湖上有山的倒影，好漂亮。
entries.examplePinyin: hú shàng yǒu shān de dào yǐng, hǎo piào liang.
entries.exampleEnglish: The mountains are reflected in the lake. So pretty.
entries.question: 你喜歡拍水裡的倒影嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan pāi shuǐ lǐ de dào yǐng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like taking photos of reflections in water?
entries.answer: 喜歡，日月潭的倒影很美。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, rì yuè tán de dào yǐng hěn měi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the reflections on Sun Moon Lake are beautiful.

entries.example: 我週末參加了一個咖啡工作坊。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zhōu mò cān jiā le yí gè kā fēi gōng zuò fāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I went to a coffee workshop on the weekend.
entries.question: 你參加過什麼工作坊？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān jiā guò shén me gōng zuò fāng?
entries.questionEnglish: What workshops have you taken part in?
entries.answer: 我參加過一個做皮包的工作坊。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cān jiā guò yí gè zuò pí bāo de gōng zuò fāng.
entries.answerEnglish: I took part in a leather bag–making workshop.

entries.example: 夏天要節約用電。
entries.examplePinyin: xià tiān yào jié yuē yòng diàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: We should save electricity in summer.
entries.question: 你在家怎麼節約用水？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài jiā zěn me jié yuē yòng shuǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you save water at home?
entries.answer: 我洗澡很快，這樣可以節約用水。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ zǎo hěn kuài, zhè yàng kě yǐ jié yuē yòng shuǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I take quick showers, which saves water.

entries.example: 泰國是一個王國。
entries.examplePinyin: tài guó shì yí gè wáng guó.
entries.exampleEnglish: Thailand is a kingdom.
entries.question: 你去過哪個王國旅行？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò nǎ gè wáng guó lǚ xíng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which kingdom have you traveled to?
entries.answer: 我去過泰國，那是一個王國。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qù guò tài guó, nà shì yí gè wáng guó.
entries.answerEnglish: I've been to Thailand. It's a kingdom.

entries.example: 我奶奶每天都讀聖經。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ nǎi nai měi tiān dōu dú shèng jīng.
entries.exampleEnglish: My grandma reads the Bible every day.
entries.question: 你讀過聖經嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dú guò shèng jīng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you read the Bible?
entries.answer: 讀過，我小時候常讀聖經。
entries.answerPinyin: dú guò, wǒ xiǎo shí hòu cháng dú shèng jīng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often read the Bible as a child.

entries.example: 請照著牌子上的指引走。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng zhào zhe pái zi shàng de zhǐ yǐn zǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please follow the directions on the sign.
entries.question: 你在台灣迷路時，會看什麼指引？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān mí lù shí, huì kàn shén me zhǐ yǐn?
entries.questionEnglish: When you get lost in Taiwan, what directions do you follow?
entries.answer: 我會看捷運站裡的指引。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì kàn jié yùn zhàn lǐ de zhǐ yǐn.
entries.answerEnglish: I follow the signs in the MRT station.

entries.example: 他只是聳肩，什麼都沒說。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zhǐ shì sǒng jiān, shén me dōu méi shuō.
entries.exampleEnglish: He just shrugged and said nothing.
entries.question: 你不知道答案時會聳肩嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bù zhī dào dá àn shí huì sǒng jiān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you shrug when you don't know the answer?
entries.answer: 會，我常常聳肩說不知道。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng cháng sǒng jiān shuō bù zhī dào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often shrug and say I don't know.

entries.example: 主管指派我負責這個案子。
entries.examplePinyin: zhǔ guǎn zhǐ pài wǒ fù zé zhè ge àn zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: My manager assigned me to be in charge of this project.
entries.question: 你的主管常指派你做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de zhǔ guǎn cháng zhǐ pài nǐ zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What does your manager often assign you to do?
entries.answer: 主管常指派我寫報告。
entries.answerPinyin: zhǔ guǎn cháng zhǐ pài wǒ xiě bào gào.
entries.answerEnglish: My manager often assigns me to write reports.

entries.example: 在不加班的前提下，我願意接這個工作。
entries.examplePinyin: zài bù jiā bān de qián tí xià, wǒ yuàn yì jiē zhè ge gōng zuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm willing to take this job on the condition there's no overtime.
entries.question: 你換工作的前提是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huàn gōng zuò de qián tí shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your precondition for changing jobs?
entries.answer: 我換工作的前提是薪水更高。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huàn gōng zuò de qián tí shì xīn shuǐ gèng gāo.
entries.answerEnglish: My precondition for changing jobs is a higher salary.

entries.example: 這個小問題演變成大麻煩。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge xiǎo wèn tí yǎn biàn chéng dà má fán.
entries.exampleEnglish: This small problem turned into a big mess.
entries.question: 你和朋友的誤會曾經演變成吵架嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ hé péng yǒu de wù huì céng jīng yǎn biàn chéng chǎo jià ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has a misunderstanding with a friend ever turned into an argument?
entries.answer: 有一次，小誤會演變成大吵架。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu yí cì, xiǎo wù huì yǎn biàn chéng dà chǎo jià.
entries.answerEnglish: Once, a small misunderstanding turned into a big fight.

entries.example: 這個包包很好看，但實用性不高。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge bāo bāo hěn hǎo kàn, dàn shí yòng xìng bù gāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This bag looks nice, but it's not very practical.
entries.question: 你買東西比較重視外表還是實用性？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi dōng xī bǐ jiào zhòng shì wài biǎo hái shì shí yòng xìng?
entries.questionEnglish: When you shop, do you care more about looks or practicality?
entries.answer: 我比較重視實用性。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào zhòng shì shí yòng xìng.
entries.answerEnglish: I care more about practicality.

entries.example: 一加一等於二是個簡單的等式。
entries.examplePinyin: yì jiā yī děng yú èr shì gè jiǎn dān de děng shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: One plus one equals two is a simple equation.
entries.question: 你以前在學校喜歡算等式嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǐ qián zài xué xiào xǐ huan suàn děng shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you like working out equations at school?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，我一看到等式就頭痛。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xǐ huan, wǒ yí kàn dào děng shì jiù tóu tòng.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I got a headache whenever I saw an equation.

entries.example: 工廠不能隨便排放廢水。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng chǎng bù néng suí biàn pái fàng fèi shuǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Factories can't just discharge wastewater.
entries.question: 你覺得機車排放的廢氣多嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de jī chē pái fàng de fèi qì duō ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think scooters emit a lot of exhaust?
entries.answer: 很多，機車排放的廢氣讓空氣很差。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn duō, jī chē pái fàng de fèi qì ràng kōng qì hěn chà.
entries.answerEnglish: A lot. Scooter exhaust makes the air really bad.

entries.example: 我和我姐姐分別住在台北和台中。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hé wǒ jiě jie fēn bié zhù zài tái běi hé tái zhōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: My sister and I live in Taipei and Taichung respectively.
entries.question: 你的家人分別住在哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de jiā rén fēn bié zhù zài nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do the members of your family each live?
entries.answer: 我爸媽和我分別住在美國和台灣。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bà mā hé wǒ fēn bié zhù zài měi guó hé tái wān.
entries.answerEnglish: My parents and I live in the US and Taiwan respectively.

entries.example: 他每天加班，覺得自己像工作的奴隸。
entries.examplePinyin: tā měi tiān jiā bān, jué de zì jǐ xiàng gōng zuò de nú lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: He works overtime every day and feels like a slave to his job.
entries.question: 你覺得自己是手機的奴隸嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ shì shǒu jī de nú lì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you feel like a slave to your phone?
entries.answer: 有一點，我好像是手機的奴隸。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu yì diǎn, wǒ hǎo xiàng shì shǒu jī de nú lì.
entries.answerEnglish: A bit. I seem to be a slave to my phone.

entries.example: 台灣的文化很有多樣性。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān de wén huà hěn yǒu duō yàng xìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan's culture is very diverse.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的哪方面很有多樣性？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān de nǎ fāng miàn hěn yǒu duō yàng xìng?
entries.questionEnglish: In what way do you think Taiwan is very diverse?
entries.answer: 我覺得台灣的食物很有多樣性。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de tái wān de shí wù hěn yǒu duō yàng xìng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think Taiwan's food is very diverse.

entries.example: 節儉是一種美德。
entries.examplePinyin: jié jiǎn shì yì zhǒng měi dé.
entries.exampleEnglish: Thrift is a virtue.
entries.question: 你覺得最重要的美德是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zuì zhòng yào de měi dé shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is the most important virtue?
entries.answer: 我覺得誠實是最重要的美德。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de chéng shí shì zuì zhòng yào de měi dé.
entries.answerEnglish: I think honesty is the most important virtue.

entries.example: 這件牛仔褲上有一個補丁。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn niú zǎi kù shàng yǒu yí gè bǔ dīng.
entries.exampleEnglish: These jeans have a patch on them.
entries.question: 你的衣服上有補丁嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de yī fu shàng yǒu bǔ dīng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do any of your clothes have patches?
entries.answer: 有，我的舊褲子上有補丁。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de jiù kù zi shàng yǒu bǔ dīng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my old pants have a patch.

entries.example: 這家公司請的都是業界菁英。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā gōng sī qǐng de dōu shì yè jiè jīng yīng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This company hires only the industry's elite.
entries.question: 你覺得自己是菁英嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ shì jīng yīng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you consider yourself part of the elite?
entries.answer: 不是，我只是普通人，不是菁英。
entries.answerPinyin: bú shì, wǒ zhǐ shì pǔ tōng rén, bú shì jīng yīng.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I'm just an ordinary person, not elite.

entries.example: 理論上，這班車十分鐘後會到。
entries.examplePinyin: lǐ lùn shàng, zhè bān chē shí fēn zhōng hòu huì dào.
entries.exampleEnglish: In theory, this bus will arrive in ten minutes.
entries.question: 理論上，你每天應該睡幾個小時？
entries.questionPinyin: lǐ lùn shàng, nǐ měi tiān yīng gāi shuì jǐ gè xiǎo shí?
entries.questionEnglish: In theory, how many hours should you sleep a day?
entries.answer: 理論上要睡八個小時，但我做不到。
entries.answerPinyin: lǐ lùn shàng yào shuì bā gè xiǎo shí, dàn wǒ zuò bú dào.
entries.answerEnglish: In theory, eight hours, but I can't manage it.

entries.example: 我忽略了信裡的一個重要細節。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hū lüè le xìn lǐ de yí gè zhòng yào xì jié.
entries.exampleEnglish: I overlooked an important detail in the letter.
entries.question: 你常忽略身體的不舒服嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng hū lüè shēn tǐ de bù shū fú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often ignore physical discomfort?
entries.answer: 會，工作忙的時候我常忽略它。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, gōng zuò máng de shí hòu wǒ cháng hū lüè tā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when work is busy I often ignore it.

entries.example: 爬山很消耗體力。
entries.examplePinyin: pá shān hěn xiāo hào tǐ lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Hiking uses up a lot of energy.
entries.question: 什麼運動最消耗你的體力？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me yùn dòng zuì xiāo hào nǐ de tǐ lì?
entries.questionEnglish: What exercise takes the most out of you?
entries.answer: 游泳最消耗我的體力。
entries.answerPinyin: yóu yǒng zuì xiāo hào wǒ de tǐ lì.
entries.answerEnglish: Swimming takes the most out of me.

entries.example: 她的新髮型吸引了大家的目光。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de xīn fǎ xíng xī yǐn le dà jiā de mù guāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Her new hairstyle caught everyone's eye.
entries.question: 你在意別人的目光嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài yì bié rén de mù guāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you care how others look at you?
entries.answer: 以前很在意，現在不在意別人的目光了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǐ qián hěn zài yì, xiàn zài bú zài yì bié rén de mù guāng le.
entries.answerEnglish: I used to, but now I don't care how people look at me.

entries.example: 他的伴侶是台灣人。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de bàn lǚ shì tái wān rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: His partner is Taiwanese.
entries.question: 你的伴侶也住在台灣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de bàn lǚ yě zhù zài tái wān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your partner live in Taiwan too?
entries.answer: 對，我的伴侶在台北工作。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ de bàn lǚ zài tái běi gōng zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my partner works in Taipei.

entries.example: 牧場上的牛群在吃草。
entries.examplePinyin: mù chǎng shàng de niú qún zài chī cǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: The cattle on the ranch are grazing.
entries.question: 你在台灣看過牛群嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān kàn guò niú qún ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen a herd of cattle in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 看過，我在牧場看過牛群。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài mù chǎng kàn guò niú qún.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've seen cattle at a ranch.

entries.example: 會員有優先入場的特權。
entries.examplePinyin: huì yuán yǒu yōu xiān rù chǎng de tè quán.
entries.exampleEnglish: Members have the privilege of entering first.
entries.question: 你覺得外國人在台灣有特權嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de wài guó rén zài tái wān yǒu tè quán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think foreigners have privileges in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 有一點，外國人有時候有特權。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu yì diǎn, wài guó rén yǒu shí hòu yǒu tè quán.
entries.answerEnglish: A little. Foreigners sometimes get special treatment.

entries.example: 公司不能歧視女性員工。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng sī bù néng qí shì nǚ xìng yuán gōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Companies must not discriminate against female employees.
entries.question: 在工作上被歧視，可以找誰幫忙？
entries.questionPinyin: zài gōng zuò shàng bèi qí shì, kě yǐ zhǎo shéi bāng máng?
entries.questionEnglish: Who can you turn to if you face discrimination at work?
entries.answer: 在工作上被歧視，可以找勞工局幫忙。
entries.answerPinyin: zài gōng zuò shàng bèi qí shì, kě yǐ zhǎo láo gōng jú bāng máng.
entries.answerEnglish: If you face discrimination at work, you can ask the Labor Affairs Bureau for help.

entries.example: 我家屋頂裝了太陽能板。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ jiā wū dǐng zhuāng le tài yáng néng bǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: We installed solar panels on our roof.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣應該多用太陽能嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān yīng gāi duō yòng tài yáng néng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwan should use more solar energy?
entries.answer: 應該，台灣很適合用太陽能。
entries.answerPinyin: yīng gāi, tái wān hěn shì hé yòng tài yáng néng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, Taiwan is well suited to solar energy.

entries.example: 太陽慢慢從地平線升起來。
entries.examplePinyin: tài yáng màn màn cóng dì píng xiàn shēng qǐ lái.
entries.exampleEnglish: The sun slowly rose over the horizon.
entries.question: 你喜歡看地平線上的日出嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kàn dì píng xiàn shàng de rì chū ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like watching the sun rise over the horizon?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我在墾丁看過地平線上的日出。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ zài kěn dīng kàn guò dì píng xiàn shàng de rì chū.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw the sunrise on the horizon in Kenting.

entries.example: 警察找到了一條重要的線索。
entries.examplePinyin: jǐng chá zhǎo dào le yì tiáo zhòng yào de xiàn suǒ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The police found an important clue.
entries.question: 你喜歡玩找線索的遊戲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan wán zhǎo xiàn suǒ de yóu xì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like games where you look for clues?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常和朋友玩密室逃脫找線索。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ cháng hé péng yǒu wán mì shì táo tuō zhǎo xiàn suǒ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often do escape rooms with friends and hunt for clues.

entries.example: 我已經打了三劑疫苗。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ yǐ jīng dǎ le sān jì yì miáo.
entries.exampleEnglish: I've already had three doses of the vaccine.
entries.question: 你打過幾劑流感疫苗？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dǎ guò jǐ jì liú gǎn yì miáo?
entries.questionEnglish: How many doses of the flu vaccine have you had?
entries.answer: 我打過兩劑流感疫苗。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dǎ guò liǎng jì liú gǎn yì miáo.
entries.answerEnglish: I've had two doses of the flu vaccine.

entries.examplePinyin: zhè tiáo shān lù hěn dǒu qiào, yào xiǎo xīn zǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: This mountain path is very steep, so walk carefully.
entries.question: 你爬過很陡峭的山嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pá guò hěn dǒu qiào de shān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever climbed a very steep mountain?
entries.answer: 爬過，合歡山有一段路很陡峭。
entries.answerPinyin: pá guò, hé huān shān yǒu yí duàn lù hěn dǒu qiào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, part of the trail on Hehuan Mountain is very steep.

entries.example: 高血壓是一種慢性病。
entries.examplePinyin: gāo xiě yā shì yì zhǒng màn xìng bìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: High blood pressure is a chronic illness.
entries.question: 常見的慢性病有哪些？
entries.questionPinyin: cháng jiàn de màn xìng bìng yǒu nǎ xiē?
entries.questionEnglish: What are some common chronic illnesses?
entries.answer: 糖尿病和高血壓都是常見的慢性病。
entries.answerPinyin: táng niào bìng hé gāo xiě yā dōu shì cháng jiàn de màn xìng bìng.
entries.answerEnglish: Diabetes and high blood pressure are both common chronic illnesses.

entries.example: 爺爺留給他一筆遺產。
entries.examplePinyin: yé ye liú gěi tā yì bǐ yí chǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: His grandfather left him an inheritance.
entries.question: 你去過哪些世界遺產？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò nǎ xiē shì jiè yí chǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: Which World Heritage Sites have you visited?
entries.answer: 我去過日本的富士山，那是世界遺產。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qù guò rì běn de fù shì shān, nà shì shì jiè yí chǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: I've been to Mount Fuji in Japan, which is a World Heritage Site.

entries.example: 婚禮的儀式十點開始。
entries.examplePinyin: hūn lǐ de yí shì shí diǎn kāi shǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The wedding ceremony starts at ten.
entries.question: 你的國家結婚時有什麼特別的儀式？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā jié hūn shí yǒu shén me tè bié de yí shì?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there any special rituals at weddings in your country?
entries.answer: 我們結婚時有交換戒指的儀式。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men jié hūn shí yǒu jiāo huàn jiè zhǐ de yí shì.
entries.answerEnglish: At our weddings there's a ring exchange ceremony.

entries.example: 這些木材是用來蓋房子的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè xiē mù cái shì yòng lái gài fáng zi de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This timber is for building houses.
entries.question: 你喜歡用木材做的家具嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan yòng mù cái zuò de jiā jù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like furniture made of wood?
entries.answer: 喜歡，木材做的家具感覺很溫暖。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, mù cái zuò de jiā jù gǎn jué hěn wēn nuǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, wooden furniture feels warm.

entries.example: 狗對主人非常忠誠。
entries.examplePinyin: gǒu duì zhǔ rén fēi cháng zhōng chéng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Dogs are very loyal to their owners.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼動物最忠誠？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me dòng wù zuì zhōng chéng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which animal do you think is the most loyal?
entries.answer: 我覺得狗最忠誠。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de gǒu zuì zhōng chéng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think dogs are the most loyal.

entries.example: 吵架的時候要保持理性。
entries.examplePinyin: chǎo jià de shí hòu yào bǎo chí lǐ xìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Stay rational when you argue.
entries.question: 你覺得自己是理性的人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ shì lǐ xìng de rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're a rational person?
entries.answer: 我覺得我滿理性的，很少衝動。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de wǒ mǎn lǐ xìng de, hěn shǎo chōng dòng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm fairly rational; I'm rarely impulsive.

entries.example: 這間老倉庫改建成了咖啡廳。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiān lǎo cāng kù gǎi jiàn chéng le kā fēi tīng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This old warehouse was converted into a café.
entries.question: 你去過老房子改建的店嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò lǎo fáng zi gǎi jiàn de diàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to a shop in a converted old house?
entries.answer: 去過，大稻埕有很多老房子改建的店。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, dà dào chéng yǒu hěn duō lǎo fáng zi gǎi jiàn de diàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, Dadaocheng has lots of shops in converted old houses.

entries.example: 去爬山要穿得輕便一點。
entries.examplePinyin: qù pá shān yào chuān de qīng biàn yì diǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Wear something light and comfortable for hiking.
entries.question: 週末你喜歡穿得輕便一點嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zhōu mò nǐ xǐ huan chuān de qīng biàn yì diǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like to dress casually on weekends?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我週末都穿得很輕便。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ zhōu mò dōu chuān de hěn qīng biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always dress casually on weekends.

entries.example: 這幅畫太抽象了，我看不懂。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè fú huà tài chōu xiàng le, wǒ kàn bù dǒng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This painting is too abstract; I don't get it.
entries.question: 你喜歡抽象的藝術嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chōu xiàng de yì shù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like abstract art?
entries.answer: 不太喜歡，抽象的畫我常常看不懂。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài xǐ huan, chōu xiàng de huà wǒ cháng cháng kàn bù dǒng.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. I often don't understand abstract paintings.

entries.example: 用這條線傳輸資料比較快。
entries.examplePinyin: yòng zhè tiáo xiàn chuán shū zī liào bǐ jiào kuài.
entries.exampleEnglish: Transferring data with this cable is faster.
entries.question: 你用什麼方法傳輸照片？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yòng shén me fāng fǎ chuán shū zhào piàn?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you transfer photos?
entries.answer: 我用藍牙或LINE傳輸照片。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yòng lán yá huò LINE chuán shū zhào piàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I transfer photos by Bluetooth or LINE.

entries.example: 我們用望遠鏡看月亮。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men yòng wàng yuǎn jìng kàn yuè liàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: We looked at the moon through a telescope.
entries.question: 你用過望遠鏡看星星嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yòng guò wàng yuǎn jìng kàn xīng xīng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever looked at the stars through a telescope?
entries.answer: 用過，我在合歡山用望遠鏡看過星星。
entries.answerPinyin: yòng guò, wǒ zài hé huān shān yòng wàng yuǎn jìng kàn guò xīng xīng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've looked at stars through a telescope on Hehuan Mountain.

entries.example: 表演結束後，人群慢慢散開了。
entries.examplePinyin: biǎo yǎn jié shù hòu, rén qún màn màn sàn kāi le.
entries.exampleEnglish: After the show ended, the crowd slowly dispersed.
entries.question: 你們聚餐完會馬上散開嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men jù cān wán huì mǎ shàng sàn kāi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: After a group dinner, do you all leave right away?
entries.answer: 不會，我們常常聊很久才散開。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ men cháng cháng liáo hěn jiǔ cái sàn kāi.
entries.answerEnglish: No, we usually chat for a long time before we go our separate ways.

entries.example: 博物館裡有一把古代的劍。
entries.examplePinyin: bó wù guǎn lǐ yǒu yì bǎ gǔ dài de jiàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's an ancient sword in the museum.
entries.question: 你看過有人在公園練劍嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò yǒu rén zài gōng yuán liàn jiàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen people practicing with swords in a park?
entries.answer: 看過，早上公園裡有阿姨在練太極劍。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, zǎo shàng gōng yuán lǐ yǒu ā yí zài liàn tài jí jiàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, in the mornings there are older ladies practicing tai chi sword in the park.

entries.example: 這家店有網路商店，也有實體店。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn yǒu wǎng lù shāng diàn, yě yǒu shí tǐ diàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop has an online store and a physical one.
entries.question: 你喜歡上實體課還是線上課？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan shàng shí tǐ kè hái shì xiàn shàng kè?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer in-person classes or online classes?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡上實體課。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan shàng shí tǐ kè.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer in-person classes.

entries.example: 每個房間都配備冷氣和冰箱。
entries.examplePinyin: měi gè fáng jiān dōu pèi bèi lěng qì hé bīng xiāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Every room is equipped with air conditioning and a fridge.
entries.question: 你的公司給你配備了什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng sī gěi nǐ pèi bèi le shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What has your company equipped you with?
entries.answer: 公司給我配備了一台筆電和一支手機。
entries.answerPinyin: gōng sī gěi wǒ pèi bèi le yì tái bǐ diàn hé yì zhī shǒu jī.
entries.answerEnglish: The company gave me a laptop and a phone.

entries.example: 今晚中華隊對上日本隊。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn wǎn zhōng huá duì duì shàng rì běn duì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Tonight Chinese Taipei goes up against Japan.
entries.question: 你最想看哪兩隊對上？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xiǎng kàn nǎ liǎng duì duì shàng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which two teams would you most like to see play each other?
entries.answer: 我最想看台灣對上韓國。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xiǎng kàn tái wān duì shàng hán guó.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd most like to see Taiwan versus Korea.

entries.example: 太魯閣的懸崖又高又陡。
entries.examplePinyin: tài lǔ gé de xuán yá yòu gāo yòu dǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: The cliffs at Taroko are high and steep.
entries.question: 你敢站在懸崖旁邊往下看嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gǎn zhàn zài xuán yá páng biān wǎng xià kàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you dare to stand at the edge of a cliff and look down?
entries.answer: 不敢，站在懸崖旁邊我會腿軟。
entries.answerPinyin: bù gǎn, zhàn zài xuán yá páng biān wǒ huì tuǐ ruǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: No way. Standing by a cliff makes my legs go weak.

entries.example: 台南的運河晚上很漂亮。
entries.examplePinyin: tái nán de yùn hé wǎn shàng hěn piào liang.
entries.exampleEnglish: The canal in Tainan is beautiful at night.
entries.question: 你去過有運河的城市嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò yǒu yùn hé de chéng shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to a city with canals?
entries.answer: 去過，我去過阿姆斯特丹，那裡有很多運河。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, wǒ qù guò ā mǔ sī tè dān, nà lǐ yǒu hěn duō yùn hé.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've been to Amsterdam, which has lots of canals.

entries.example: 咖啡機的過濾器要常常洗。
entries.examplePinyin: kā fēi jī de guò lǜ qì yào cháng cháng xǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The coffee machine's filter needs washing often.
entries.question: 你家的水有用過濾器嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de shuǐ yǒu yòng guò lǜ qì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use a water filter at home?
entries.answer: 有，我們在水龍頭裝了過濾器。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men zài shuǐ lóng tóu zhuāng le guò lǜ qì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we installed a filter on the tap.

entries.example: 這個小島很孤立，船一週只來一次。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge xiǎo dǎo hěn gū lì, chuán yì zhōu zhǐ lái yí cì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This little island is very isolated; the boat only comes once a week.
entries.question: 你剛到台灣時覺得孤立嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gāng dào tái wān shí jué de gū lì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you feel isolated when you first arrived in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 有一點，我不會說中文，覺得很孤立。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu yì diǎn, wǒ bú huì shuō zhōng wén, jué de hěn gū lì.
entries.answerEnglish: A little. I couldn't speak Chinese, so I felt isolated.

entries.example: 地上有很多玻璃碎片，小心！
entries.examplePinyin: dì shàng yǒu hěn duō bō lí suì piàn, xiǎo xīn!
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of glass shards on the floor — careful!
entries.question: 杯子破了，你怎麼清理碎片？
entries.questionPinyin: bēi zi pò le, nǐ zěn me qīng lǐ suì piàn?
entries.questionEnglish: When a glass breaks, how do you clean up the pieces?
entries.answer: 我先用掃把掃碎片，再用膠帶黏小的。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiān yòng sào bǎ sǎo suì piàn, zài yòng jiāo dài nián xiǎo de.
entries.answerEnglish: I sweep up the pieces with a broom, then pick up the small ones with tape.

entries.example: 我最近睡眠不足，上班很累。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zuì jìn shuì mián bù zú, shàng bān hěn lèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: I haven't been getting enough sleep lately, so I'm tired at work.
entries.question: 你常常睡眠不足嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng cháng shuì mián bù zú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often not get enough sleep?
entries.answer: 常常，工作太忙，我常睡眠不足。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, gōng zuò tài máng, wǒ cháng shuì mián bù zú.
entries.answerEnglish: Often. Work is so busy that I'm often short on sleep.

entries.example: 台灣人很有人情味。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān rén hěn yǒu rén qíng wèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwanese people are very warm and kind.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣哪裡最有人情味？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān nǎ lǐ zuì yǒu rén qíng wèi?
entries.questionEnglish: Where in Taiwan do you think people are the warmest?
entries.answer: 我覺得傳統市場最有人情味。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de chuán tǒng shì chǎng zuì yǒu rén qíng wèi.
entries.answerEnglish: I think traditional markets have the most human warmth.

entries.example: 這種藥要有醫生的處方才能買。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhǒng yào yào yǒu yī shēng de chǔ fāng cái néng mǎi.
entries.exampleEnglish: You need a doctor's prescription to buy this medicine.
entries.question: 在台灣，哪些藥需要處方？
entries.questionPinyin: zài tái wān, nǎ xiē yào xū yào chǔ fāng?
entries.questionEnglish: In Taiwan, which medicines need a prescription?
entries.answer: 在台灣，抗生素需要醫生的處方。
entries.answerPinyin: zài tái wān, kàng shēng sù xū yào yī shēng de chǔ fāng.
entries.answerEnglish: In Taiwan, antibiotics need a doctor's prescription.

entries.example: 這個帆布包很耐用。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge fān bù bāo hěn nài yòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This canvas bag is very durable.
entries.question: 你有帆布做的包包嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu fān bù zuò de bāo bāo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a canvas bag?
entries.answer: 有，我上班都背一個帆布包。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ shàng bān dōu bēi yí gè fān bù bāo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I carry a canvas bag to work.

entries.example: 相信你的直覺吧！
entries.examplePinyin: xiāng xìn nǐ de zhí jué ba!
entries.exampleEnglish: Trust your gut!
entries.question: 做決定時，你常常相信直覺嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zuò jué dìng shí, nǐ cháng cháng xiāng xìn zhí jué ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often trust your intuition when making decisions?
entries.answer: 常常，我的直覺通常是對的。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ de zhí jué tōng cháng shì duì de.
entries.answerEnglish: Often. My intuition is usually right.

entries.example: 這條巷子又暗又骯髒。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tiáo xiàng zi yòu àn yòu āng zāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This alley is dark and filthy.
entries.question: 你去過最骯髒的地方是哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò zuì āng zāng de dì fāng shì nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the dirtiest place you've ever been?
entries.answer: 我去過最骯髒的地方是一間公廁。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qù guò zuì āng zāng de dì fāng shì yì jiān gōng cè.
entries.answerEnglish: The dirtiest place I've been to was a public toilet.

entries.example: 他在網路上很有影響力。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài wǎng lù shang hěn yǒu yǐng xiǎng lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's very influential online.
entries.question: 你覺得誰對你最有影響力？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shéi duì nǐ zuì yǒu yǐng xiǎng lì?
entries.questionEnglish: Who do you think has had the most influence on you?
entries.answer: 我覺得我的老師對我最有影響力。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de wǒ de lǎo shī duì wǒ zuì yǒu yǐng xiǎng lì.
entries.answerEnglish: I think my teacher has had the most influence on me.

entries.example: 請不要妨礙別人工作。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng bú yào fáng ài bié rén gōng zuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please don't interfere with other people's work.
entries.question: 什麼事常常妨礙你睡覺？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shì cháng cháng fáng ài nǐ shuì jiào?
entries.questionEnglish: What often keeps you from sleeping?
entries.answer: 樓上的噪音常常妨礙我睡覺。
entries.answerPinyin: lóu shàng de zào yīn cháng cháng fáng ài wǒ shuì jiào.
entries.answerEnglish: Noise from upstairs often keeps me from sleeping.

entries.example: 路邊的電線桿上貼了很多廣告。
entries.examplePinyin: lù biān de diàn xiàn gān shàng tiē le hěn duō guǎng gào.
entries.exampleEnglish: The utility pole by the road is covered in ads.
entries.question: 你用過高爾夫球桿嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yòng guò gāo ěr fū qiú gān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever used a golf club?
entries.answer: 用過，我借朋友的球桿打過一次。
entries.answerPinyin: yòng guò, wǒ jiè péng yǒu de qiú gān dǎ guò yí cì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I borrowed a friend's club and played once.

entries.example: 我媽一直碎碎念，要我早點睡。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ mā yì zhí suì suì niàn, yào wǒ zǎo diǎn shuì.
entries.exampleEnglish: My mom keeps nagging me to go to bed early.
entries.question: 你家誰最愛碎碎念？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā shéi zuì ài suì suì niàn?
entries.questionEnglish: Who in your family grumbles the most?
entries.answer: 我爸爸最愛碎碎念。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bà ba zuì ài suì suì niàn.
entries.answerEnglish: My dad grumbles the most.

entries.example: 這首歌獻給我的媽媽。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shǒu gē xiàn gěi wǒ de mā ma.
entries.exampleEnglish: This song is dedicated to my mom.
entries.question: 如果你寫一本書，你想獻給誰？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ nǐ xiě yì běn shū, nǐ xiǎng xiàn gěi shéi?
entries.questionEnglish: If you wrote a book, who would you dedicate it to?
entries.answer: 我想把書獻給我的太太。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng bǎ shū xiàn gěi wǒ de tài tài.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd dedicate it to my wife.

entries.example: 吃飽後不要做劇烈運動。
entries.examplePinyin: chī bǎo hòu bú yào zuò jù liè yùn dòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Don't do intense exercise right after eating.
entries.question: 你喜歡做劇烈的運動嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zuò jù liè de yùn dòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like intense exercise?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，我只做不太劇烈的運動，像瑜伽。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xǐ huan, wǒ zhǐ zuò bú tài jù liè de yùn dòng, xiàng yú jiā.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I only do gentler exercise, like yoga.

entries.example: 他繼承了爸爸的麵店。
entries.examplePinyin: tā jì chéng le bà ba de miàn diàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He took over his father's noodle shop.
entries.question: 你想繼承家裡的事業嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng jì chéng jiā lǐ de shì yè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to take over the family business?
entries.answer: 不想，我不想繼承家裡的工廠。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xiǎng, wǒ bù xiǎng jì chéng jiā lǐ de gōng chǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't want to take over the family factory.

entries.example: 我們已經有初步的計畫了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men yǐ jīng yǒu chū bù de jì huà le.
entries.exampleEnglish: We already have a preliminary plan.
entries.question: 你對台灣的初步印象是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì tái wān de chū bù yìn xiàng shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What was your first impression of Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我的初步印象是台灣人很友善。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de chū bù yìn xiàng shì tái wān rén hěn yǒu shàn.
entries.answerEnglish: My first impression was that Taiwanese people are friendly.

entries.example: 地震以後，這座廟重建了。
entries.examplePinyin: dì zhèn yǐ hòu, zhè zuò miào chóng jiàn le.
entries.exampleEnglish: After the earthquake, this temple was rebuilt.
entries.question: 你的城市有重建過的老建築嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de chéng shì yǒu chóng jiàn guò de lǎo jiàn zhú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there old buildings in your city that have been rebuilt?
entries.answer: 有，市中心的老教堂重建過。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, shì zhōng xīn de lǎo jiào táng chóng jiàn guò.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the old church downtown was rebuilt.

entries.example: 這份工作有一百多個申請人。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè fèn gōng zuò yǒu yì bǎi duō gè shēn qǐng rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: This job has over a hundred applicants.
entries.question: 申請簽證時，申請人要準備什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: shēn qǐng qiān zhèng shí, shēn qǐng rén yào zhǔn bèi shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: When applying for a visa, what does the applicant need to prepare?
entries.answer: 申請人要準備護照和照片。
entries.answerPinyin: shēn qǐng rén yào zhǔn bèi hù zhào hé zhào piàn.
entries.answerEnglish: The applicant needs to prepare a passport and photos.

entries.example: 這個年輕人很有前途。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge nián qīng rén hěn yǒu qián tú.
entries.exampleEnglish: This young person has a bright future.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼行業最有前途？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me háng yè zuì yǒu qián tú?
entries.questionEnglish: Which industry do you think is the most promising?
entries.answer: 我覺得綠能產業最有前途。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de lǜ néng chǎn yè zuì yǒu qián tú.
entries.answerEnglish: I think the green energy industry is the most promising.

entries.example: 球掉到地上又彈起來。
entries.examplePinyin: qiú diào dào dì shàng yòu tán qǐ lái.
entries.exampleEnglish: The ball hit the ground and bounced back up.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼球彈起來最高？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me qiú tán qǐ lái zuì gāo?
entries.questionEnglish: Which kind of ball do you think bounces the highest?
entries.answer: 我覺得彈力球彈起來最高。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de tán lì qiú tán qǐ lái zuì gāo.
entries.answerEnglish: I think a bouncy ball bounces the highest.

entries.example: 瑞士是一個中立的國家。
entries.examplePinyin: ruì shì shì yí gè zhōng lì de guó jiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: Switzerland is a neutral country.
entries.question: 朋友吵架時，你會保持中立嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: péng yǒu chǎo jià shí, nǐ huì bǎo chí zhōng lì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When friends argue, do you stay neutral?
entries.answer: 會，我通常保持中立。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ tōng cháng bǎo chí zhōng lì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I usually stay neutral.

entries.example: 吃完後，請把托盤放回櫃台。
entries.examplePinyin: chī wán hòu, qǐng bǎ tuō pán fàng huí guì tái.
entries.exampleEnglish: When you're done eating, please return your tray to the counter.
entries.question: 在速食店吃完，你會收托盤嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zài sù shí diàn chī wán, nǐ huì shōu tuō pán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you clear your tray after eating at a fast food place?
entries.answer: 會，我都會把托盤放回去。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōu huì bǎ tuō pán fàng huí qù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always put my tray back.

entries.example: 我們在淡水碼頭搭船去八里。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zài dàn shuǐ mǎ tóu dā chuán qù bā lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: We took a boat from the Tamsui pier to Bali.
entries.question: 你在台灣去過哪個碼頭？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān qù guò nǎ gè mǎ tóu?
entries.questionEnglish: Which pier have you been to in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我去過淡水的漁人碼頭。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qù guò dàn shuǐ de yú rén mǎ tóu.
entries.answerEnglish: I've been to Fisherman's Wharf in Tamsui.

entries.example: 有家人在身邊，我很有安心感。
entries.examplePinyin: yǒu jiā rén zài shēn biān, wǒ hěn yǒu ān xīn gǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Having family around gives me a sense of security.
entries.question: 什麼東西讓你有安心感？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me dōng xī ràng nǐ yǒu ān xīn gǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: What gives you a sense of security?
entries.answer: 住在有管理員的大樓讓我很有安心感。
entries.answerPinyin: zhù zài yǒu guǎn lǐ yuán de dà lóu ràng wǒ hěn yǒu ān xīn gǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Living in a building with a doorman makes me feel secure.

entries.example: 我們不應該對外國人有偏見。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men bú yīng gāi duì wài guó rén yǒu piān jiàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: We shouldn't be prejudiced against foreigners.
entries.question: 你覺得人為什麼會有偏見？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de rén wèi shén me huì yǒu piān jiàn?
entries.questionEnglish: Why do you think people become prejudiced?
entries.answer: 因為不了解，所以人會有偏見。
entries.answerPinyin: yīn wèi bù liǎo jiě, suǒ yǐ rén huì yǒu piān jiàn.
entries.answerEnglish: People become prejudiced because they don't understand others.

entries.example: 工作的時候，老闆一直在旁邊監督。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng zuò de shí hòu, lǎo bǎn yì zhí zài páng biān jiān dū.
entries.exampleEnglish: The boss keeps watching over us while we work.
entries.question: 你喜歡有人監督你工作嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan yǒu rén jiān dū nǐ gōng zuò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like having someone supervise your work?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，有人監督我會很緊張。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xǐ huan, yǒu rén jiān dū wǒ huì hěn jǐn zhāng.
entries.answerEnglish: No, being supervised makes me nervous.

entries.example: 人家說魔鬼藏在細節裡。
entries.examplePinyin: rén jiā shuō mó guǐ cáng zài xì jié lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: They say the devil is in the details.
entries.question: 你小時候相信有魔鬼嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu xiāng xìn yǒu mó guǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you believe in the devil as a child?
entries.answer: 相信，我以為魔鬼住在黑暗的地方。
entries.answerPinyin: xiāng xìn, wǒ yǐ wéi mó guǐ zhù zài hēi àn de dì fāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I thought the devil lived in dark places.

entries.english: tuck in; stuff into; cram into
entries.example: 他把襯衫塞進褲子裡。
entries.examplePinyin: tā bǎ chèn shān sāi jìn kù zi lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: He tucked his shirt into his trousers.
entries.question: 你出國時會把很多東西塞進行李箱嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chū guó shí huì bǎ hěn duō dōng xī sāi jìn xíng li xiāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you cram lots of things into your suitcase when you go abroad?
entries.answer: 會，我常把太多衣服塞進行李箱。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng bǎ tài duō yī fu sāi jìn xíng li xiāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often cram too many clothes into my suitcase.

entries.example: 撐過這個星期就放假了！
entries.examplePinyin: chēng guò zhè ge xīng qí jiù fàng jià le!
entries.exampleEnglish: Just get through this week and then it's vacation!
entries.question: 你怎麼撐過台灣的夏天？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zěn me chēng guò tái wān de xià tiān?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you get through the Taiwanese summer?
entries.answer: 我靠冷氣和冰飲料撐過夏天。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ kào lěng qì hé bīng yǐn liào chēng guò xià tiān.
entries.answerEnglish: I get through it with air conditioning and cold drinks.

entries.example: 他輕拍我的肩膀說加油。
entries.examplePinyin: tā qīng pāi wǒ de jiān bǎng shuō jiā yóu.
entries.exampleEnglish: He patted me on the shoulder and told me to keep going.
entries.question: 朋友難過時，你會輕拍他的背嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: péng yǒu nán guò shí, nǐ huì qīng pāi tā de bèi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When a friend is upset, do you pat them on the back?
entries.answer: 會，我會輕拍他的背安慰他。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì qīng pāi tā de bèi ān wèi tā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I pat them on the back to comfort them.

entries.example: 這個木頭雕刻是在三義買的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge mù tou diāo kè shì zài sān yì mǎi de.
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought this wood carving in Sanyi.
entries.question: 你試過雕刻嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shì guò diāo kè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever tried carving?
entries.answer: 沒試過，但是我很喜歡看木頭雕刻。
entries.answerPinyin: méi shì guò, dàn shì wǒ hěn xǐ huan kàn mù tou diāo kè.
entries.answerEnglish: No, but I love looking at wood carvings.

entries.example: 我在網路論壇上問問題。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài wǎng lù lùn tán shàng wèn wèn tí.
entries.exampleEnglish: I asked a question on an online forum.
entries.question: 你常上哪個網路論壇？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng shàng nǎ gè wǎng lù lùn tán?
entries.questionEnglish: Which online forums do you often visit?
entries.answer: 我常上PTT這個論壇。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cháng shàng PTT zhè ge lùn tán.
entries.answerEnglish: I often go on the PTT forum.

entries.example: 他在電腦領域工作了十年。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài diàn nǎo lǐng yù gōng zuò le shí nián.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's worked in the computer field for ten years.
entries.question: 你在哪個領域工作？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài nǎ gè lǐng yù gōng zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: Which field do you work in?
entries.answer: 我在教育領域工作。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài jiào yù lǐng yù gōng zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: I work in education.

entries.example: 演唱會上有很漂亮的雷射燈光。
entries.examplePinyin: yǎn chàng huì shàng yǒu hěn piào liang de léi shè dēng guāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The concert had beautiful laser lights.
entries.question: 你看過雷射表演嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò léi shè biǎo yǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a laser show?
entries.answer: 看過，我在跨年晚會看過雷射表演。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài kuà nián wǎn huì kàn guò léi shè biǎo yǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw a laser show at a New Year's Eve party.

entries.example: 我在二手店找到一件寶物。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài èr shǒu diàn zhǎo dào yí jiàn bǎo wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: I found a treasure in a second-hand shop.
entries.question: 你家有什麼寶物嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yǒu shén me bǎo wù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there any treasure in your home?
entries.answer: 我家的寶物是一台老相機。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā de bǎo wù shì yì tái lǎo xiàng jī.
entries.answerEnglish: Our treasure is an old camera.

entries.example: 這款手機很搶手，很快就賣完了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè kuǎn shǒu jī hěn qiǎng shǒu, hěn kuài jiù mài wán le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This phone model is in high demand; it sold out quickly.
entries.question: 現在台灣什麼東西最搶手？
entries.questionPinyin: xiàn zài tái wān shén me dōng xī zuì qiǎng shǒu?
entries.questionEnglish: What's most in demand in Taiwan right now?
entries.answer: 我覺得演唱會的門票最搶手。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de yǎn chàng huì de mén piào zuì qiǎng shǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: I think concert tickets are the most sought-after.

entries.example: 他看到帳單就皺眉了。
entries.examplePinyin: tā kàn dào zhàng dān jiù zhòu méi le.
entries.exampleEnglish: He frowned when he saw the bill.
entries.question: 什麼事會讓你皺眉？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shì huì ràng nǐ zhòu méi?
entries.questionEnglish: What makes you frown?
entries.answer: 捷運上有人大聲講電話會讓我皺眉。
entries.answerPinyin: jié yùn shàng yǒu rén dà shēng jiǎng diàn huà huì ràng wǒ zhòu méi.
entries.answerEnglish: People talking loudly on the phone on the MRT makes me frown.

entries.example: 喝過多的咖啡會睡不著。
entries.examplePinyin: hē guò duō de kā fēi huì shuì bù zháo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Drinking too much coffee will keep you awake.
entries.question: 你覺得你花過多的時間在手機上嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ huā guò duō de shí jiān zài shǒu jī shàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you spend too much time on your phone?
entries.answer: 是，我花過多的時間在手機上了。
entries.answerPinyin: shì, wǒ huā guò duō de shí jiān zài shǒu jī shàng le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I spend too much time on my phone.

entries.example: 下週我要去台中參加研討會。
entries.examplePinyin: xià zhōu wǒ yào qù tái zhōng cān jiā yán tǎo huì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Next week I'm going to Taichung for a seminar.
entries.question: 你參加過什麼研討會？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān jiā guò shén me yán tǎo huì?
entries.questionEnglish: What seminars have you attended?
entries.answer: 我參加過一場教育研討會。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cān jiā guò yì chǎng jiào yù yán tǎo huì.
entries.answerEnglish: I've attended an education conference.

entries.example: 營火在海邊燃燒了一整晚。
entries.examplePinyin: yíng huǒ zài hǎi biān rán shāo le yì zhěng wǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The campfire burned on the beach all night.
entries.question: 你做什麼運動來燃燒卡路里？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò shén me yùn dòng lái rán shāo kǎ lù lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: What exercise do you do to burn calories?
entries.answer: 我靠跑步來燃燒卡路里。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ kào pǎo bù lái rán shāo kǎ lù lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I burn calories by running.

entries.example: 這個鍋子是銅做的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge guō zi shì tóng zuò de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This pot is made of copper.
entries.question: 你家有銅做的東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yǒu tóng zuò de dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have anything made of copper at home?
entries.answer: 有，我們有一個銅做的茶壺。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men yǒu yí gè tóng zuò de chá hú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we have a copper teapot.

entries.example: 海邊的微風好舒服。
entries.examplePinyin: hǎi biān de wéi fēng hǎo shū fú.
entries.exampleEnglish: The sea breeze feels so nice.
entries.question: 你喜歡在有微風的晚上散步嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zài yǒu wéi fēng de wǎn shàng sàn bù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like walking on breezy evenings?
entries.answer: 喜歡，有微風的晚上很涼快。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, yǒu wéi fēng de wǎn shàng hěn liáng kuai.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, breezy evenings are nice and cool.

entries.example: 台語和客家話有很多相似之處。
entries.examplePinyin: tái yǔ hé kè jiā huà yǒu hěn duō xiāng sì zhī chù.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwanese and Hakka have a lot in common.
entries.question: 你的母語和中文有相似之處嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de mǔ yǔ hé zhōng wén yǒu xiāng sì zhī chù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your native language have anything in common with Chinese?
entries.answer: 很少，只有一點點相似之處。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn shǎo, zhǐ yǒu yì diǎn diǎn xiāng sì zhī chù.
entries.answerEnglish: Very little; there are only a few similarities.

entries.example: 山上有一棵孤零零的樹。
entries.examplePinyin: shān shàng yǒu yì kē gū líng líng de shù.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a lone tree on the mountain.
entries.question: 一個人過節時，你會覺得孤零零的嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: yí gè rén guò jié shí, nǐ huì jué de gū líng líng de ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you feel all alone when you spend a holiday by yourself?
entries.answer: 會，一個人過年覺得孤零零的。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, yí gè rén guò nián jué de gū líng líng de.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, spending Lunar New Year by myself makes me feel all alone.

entries.example: 埃及有很古老的文明。
entries.examplePinyin: āi jí yǒu hěn gǔ lǎo de wén míng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Egypt has an ancient civilization.
entries.question: 你對哪個古代文明有興趣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì nǎ gè gǔ dài wén míng yǒu xìng qù?
entries.questionEnglish: Which ancient civilization are you interested in?
entries.answer: 我對馬雅文明很有興趣。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ duì mǎ yǎ wén míng hěn yǒu xìng qù.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm very interested in Maya civilization.

entries.example: 孩子們用黏土做了小動物。
entries.examplePinyin: hái zi men yòng nián tǔ zuò le xiǎo dòng wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: The kids made little animals out of clay.
entries.question: 你小時候玩過黏土嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu wán guò nián tǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you play with clay as a child?
entries.answer: 玩過，我用黏土做過一隻小狗。
entries.answerPinyin: wán guò, wǒ yòng nián tǔ zuò guò yì zhī xiǎo gǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I made a little dog out of clay.

entries.example: 我上了一個月的密集中文課。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ shàng le yí gè yuè de mì jí zhōng wén kè.
entries.exampleEnglish: I took a one-month intensive Chinese course.
entries.question: 你上過密集的語言課嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shàng guò mì jí de yǔ yán kè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever taken an intensive language course?
entries.answer: 上過，我在師大上過三個月的密集班。
entries.answerPinyin: shàng guò, wǒ zài shī dà shàng guò sān gè yuè de mì jí bān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I did a three-month intensive course at NTNU.

entries.example: 我們去參觀了一座大教堂。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men qù cān guān le yí zuò dà jiào táng.
entries.exampleEnglish: We went to visit a cathedral.
entries.question: 你去過哪座有名的大教堂？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò nǎ zuò yǒu míng de dà jiào táng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which famous cathedral have you visited?
entries.answer: 我去過巴黎的聖母院大教堂。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qù guò bā lí de shèng mǔ yuàn dà jiào táng.
entries.answerEnglish: I've been to Notre-Dame Cathedral in Paris.

entries.example: 清明節台灣人會祭拜祖先。
entries.examplePinyin: qīng míng jié tái wān rén huì jì bài zǔ xiān.
entries.exampleEnglish: On Tomb Sweeping Day, Taiwanese people honor their ancestors.
entries.question: 你的國家有紀念祖先的節日嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā yǒu jì niàn zǔ xiān de jié rì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a holiday in your country for remembering ancestors?
entries.answer: 有，我們也有紀念祖先的節日。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men yě yǒu jì niàn zǔ xiān de jié rì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we also have a holiday to remember our ancestors.

entries.example: 我們開香檳慶祝新年。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men kāi xiāng bīn qìng zhù xīn nián.
entries.exampleEnglish: We opened champagne to celebrate the New Year.
entries.question: 你什麼時候會喝香檳？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shén me shí hòu huì hē xiāng bīn?
entries.questionEnglish: When do you drink champagne?
entries.answer: 過生日的時候，我會喝香檳。
entries.answerPinyin: guò shēng rì de shí hòu, wǒ huì hē xiāng bīn.
entries.answerEnglish: I drink champagne on my birthday.

entries.example: 這道菜只用了極少的油。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè dào cài zhǐ yòng le jí shǎo de yóu.
entries.exampleEnglish: This dish uses very little oil.
entries.question: 你多久吃一次速食？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duō jiǔ chī yí cì sù shí?
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you eat fast food?
entries.answer: 我極少吃速食，大概一個月一次。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jí shǎo chī sù shí, dà gài yí gè yuè yī cì.
entries.answerEnglish: I very rarely eat fast food, about once a month.

entries.example: 請把繩子拉緊一點。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng bǎ shéng zi lā jǐn yì diǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please pull the rope a bit tighter.
entries.question: 你的鞋帶常常鬆掉嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de xié dài cháng cháng sōng diào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do your shoelaces often come undone?
entries.answer: 常常，所以我會把鞋帶拉緊。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, suǒ yǐ wǒ huì bǎ xié dài lā jǐn.
entries.answerEnglish: Often, so I pull them tight.

entries.example: 她很有音樂的天賦。
entries.examplePinyin: tā hěn yǒu yīn yuè de tiān fù.
entries.exampleEnglish: She has a real gift for music.
entries.question: 你覺得自己有什麼天賦？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ yǒu shén me tiān fù?
entries.questionEnglish: What natural talents do you think you have?
entries.answer: 我覺得我有學語言的天賦。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de wǒ yǒu xué yǔ yán de tiān fù.
entries.answerEnglish: I think I have a gift for languages.

entries.example: 請寫上收件人的名字和地址。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng xiě shàng shōu jiàn rén de míng zì hé dì zhǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please write the recipient's name and address.
entries.question: 在超商寄包裹時要寫什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: zài chāo shāng jì bāo guǒ shí yào xiě shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you need to write when sending a parcel at a convenience store?
entries.answer: 要寫收件人的名字、地址和電話。
entries.answerPinyin: yào xiě shōu jiàn rén de míng zì, dì zhǐ hé diàn huà.
entries.answerEnglish: You need to write the recipient's name, address and phone number.

entries.example: 現在很多人用虛擬貨幣。
entries.examplePinyin: xiàn zài hěn duō rén yòng xū nǐ huò bì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Lots of people use cryptocurrency now.
entries.question: 你玩過虛擬實境的遊戲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ wán guò xū nǐ shí jìng de yóu xì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever played a virtual reality game?
entries.answer: 玩過，虛擬實境的遊戲很好玩。
entries.answerPinyin: wán guò, xū nǐ shí jìng de yóu xì hěn hǎo wán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, VR games are really fun.

entries.example: 醫生說這是一種常見的症候群。
entries.examplePinyin: yī shēng shuō zhè shì yì zhǒng cháng jiàn de zhèng hòu qún.
entries.exampleEnglish: The doctor said this is a common syndrome.
entries.question: 你聽過哪些症候群？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tīng guò nǎ xiē zhèng hòu qún?
entries.questionEnglish: Which syndromes have you heard of?
entries.answer: 我聽過「星期一症候群」，很多上班族都有。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ tīng guò “xīng qí yī zhèng hòu qún”, hěn duō shàng bān zú dōu yǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: I've heard of 'Monday syndrome' (the Monday blues); lots of office workers have it.

entries.example: 他們在角落低語，不知道在說什麼。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men zài jiǎo luò dī yǔ, bù zhī dào zài shuō shén me.
entries.exampleEnglish: They're murmuring in the corner; who knows what they're saying.
entries.question: 在什麼地方，你會跟朋友低語？
entries.questionPinyin: zài shén me dì fāng, nǐ huì gēn péng yǒu dī yǔ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where would you whisper with a friend?
entries.answer: 在圖書館或電影院，我會跟朋友低語。
entries.answerPinyin: zài tú shū guǎn huò diàn yǐng yuàn, wǒ huì gēn péng yǒu dī yǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: In a library or a cinema, I whisper with my friends.

entries.example: 故宮有很多古代的青銅器。
entries.examplePinyin: gù gōng yǒu hěn duō gǔ dài de qīng tóng qì.
entries.exampleEnglish: The National Palace Museum has many ancient bronzes.
entries.question: 你在博物館看過青銅器嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài bó wù guǎn kàn guò qīng tóng qì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen bronze vessels in a museum?
entries.answer: 看過，我在故宮看過很多青銅器。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài gù gōng kàn guò hěn duō qīng tóng qì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've seen lots of bronze vessels at the Palace Museum.

entries.example: 這兩個價格只有些微的差別。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè liǎng gè jià gé zhǐ yǒu xiē wéi de chā bié.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's only a slight difference between these two prices.
entries.question: 你覺得台北和台中的天氣差很多嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái běi hé tái zhōng de tiān qì chà hěn duō ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is the weather in Taipei very different from Taichung's?
entries.answer: 只有些微的差別，台中比較少下雨。
entries.answerPinyin: zhǐ yǒu xiē wéi de chā bié, tái zhōng bǐ jiào shǎo xià yǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: Only slightly; Taichung gets less rain.

entries.example: 這次颱風的持續時間比較長。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì tái fēng de chí xù shí jiān bǐ jiào cháng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This typhoon lasted longer than usual.
entries.question: 你每次運動大概多久？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ měi cì yùn dòng dà gài duō jiǔ?
entries.questionEnglish: About how long is each of your workouts?
entries.answer: 我每次運動的持續時間大概一個小時。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ měi cì yùn dòng de chí xù shí jiān dà gài yí gè xiǎo shí.
entries.answerEnglish: Each workout lasts about an hour.

entries.example: 一支探險隊去了南極。
entries.examplePinyin: yì zhī tàn xiǎn duì qù le nán jí.
entries.exampleEnglish: An expedition went to Antarctica.
entries.question: 如果參加探險隊，你想去哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ cān jiā tàn xiǎn duì, nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: If you joined an expedition, where would you want to go?
entries.answer: 我想跟探險隊去南極看企鵝。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng gēn tàn xiǎn duì qù nán jí kàn qì é.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to go to Antarctica with an expedition to see penguins.

entries.example: 老闆介入以後，問題很快就解決了。
entries.examplePinyin: lǎo bǎn jiè rù yǐ hòu, wèn tí hěn kuài jiù jiě jué le.
entries.exampleEnglish: Once the boss stepped in, the problem was quickly solved.
entries.question: 朋友吵架時，你會介入嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: péng yǒu chǎo jià shí, nǐ huì jiè rù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When your friends argue, do you step in?
entries.answer: 通常不會，我不想介入別人的事。
entries.answerPinyin: tōng cháng bú huì, wǒ bù xiǎng jiè rù bié rén de shì.
entries.answerEnglish: Usually not; I don't want to get involved in other people's business.

entries.example: 太魯閣有很多大理石。
entries.examplePinyin: tài lǔ gé yǒu hěn duō dà lǐ shí.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taroko has lots of marble.
entries.question: 你喜歡大理石的桌子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan dà lǐ shí de zhuō zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like marble tables?
entries.answer: 喜歡，大理石的桌子看起來很高級。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, dà lǐ shí de zhuō zi kàn qǐ lái hěn gāo jí.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, marble tables look really classy.

entries.example: 她買了一個草編包。
entries.examplePinyin: tā mǎi le yí gè cǎo biān bāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: She bought a straw bag.
entries.question: 夏天你喜歡戴草編帽嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: xià tiān nǐ xǐ huan dài cǎo biān mào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like wearing a straw hat in summer?
entries.answer: 喜歡，草編帽很涼，也很好看。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, cǎo biān mào hěn liáng, yě hěn hǎo kàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, straw hats are cool and look nice too.

entries.example: 這個門把是黃銅做的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge mén bǎ shì huáng tóng zuò de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This door handle is made of brass.
entries.question: 你家有黃銅做的東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yǒu huáng tóng zuò de dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have anything made of brass at home?
entries.answer: 有，我家的檯燈是黃銅的。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiā de tái dēng shì huáng tóng de.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my desk lamp is brass.

entries.example: 很多電影都在講政治陰謀。
entries.examplePinyin: hěn duō diàn yǐng dōu zài jiǎng zhèng zhì yīn móu.
entries.exampleEnglish: Lots of movies are about political conspiracies.
entries.question: 你相信陰謀論嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiāng xìn yīn móu lùn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you believe in conspiracy theories?
entries.answer: 不太相信，我覺得很多陰謀論都是假的。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài xiāng xìn, wǒ jué de hěn duō yīn móu lùn dōu shì jiǎ de.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really; I think a lot of conspiracy theories are fake.

entries.example: 這家零售商在全台有很多店。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā líng shòu shāng zài quán tái yǒu hěn duō diàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This retailer has lots of stores all over Taiwan.
entries.question: 你常去哪一家零售商買東西？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng qù nǎ yì jiā líng shòu shāng mǎi dōng xī?
entries.questionEnglish: Which retailer do you usually shop at?
entries.answer: 我常去附近的超市，它是大型零售商。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cháng qù fù jìn de chāo shì, tā shì dà xíng líng shòu shāng.
entries.answerEnglish: I usually go to the supermarket nearby; it's a big retailer.

entries.example: 運動是我的發洩管道。
entries.examplePinyin: yùn dòng shì wǒ de fā xiè guǎn dào.
entries.exampleEnglish: Exercise is my outlet.
entries.question: 壓力大的時候，你有什麼發洩管道？
entries.questionPinyin: yā lì dà de shí hòu, nǐ yǒu shén me fā xiè guǎn dào?
entries.questionEnglish: When you're stressed, what outlet do you have?
entries.answer: 唱KTV是我最好的發洩管道。
entries.answerPinyin: chàng KTV shì wǒ zuì hǎo de fā xiè guǎn dào.
entries.answerEnglish: Singing karaoke is my best outlet.

entries.example: 公司做了一份匿名問卷。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng sī zuò le yí fèn nì míng wèn juàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The company ran an anonymous survey.
entries.question: 你在網路上留言會匿名嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài wǎng lù shang liú yán huì nì míng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you comment anonymously online?
entries.answer: 有時候會，匿名比較敢說真話。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu huì, nì míng bǐ jiào gǎn shuō zhēn huà.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes; when you're anonymous you dare to tell the truth.

entries.example: 這家公司有很多專利。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā gōng sī yǒu hěn duō zhuān lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This company holds many patents.
entries.question: 如果有好點子，你會申請專利嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ yǒu hǎo diǎn zi, nǐ huì shēn qǐng zhuān lì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: If you had a good idea, would you apply for a patent?
entries.answer: 會，我會先申請專利再賣產品。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì xiān shēn qǐng zhuān lì zài mài chǎn pǐn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd apply for a patent before selling the product.

entries.example: 他的回答很含糊。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de huí dá hěn hán hu.
entries.exampleEnglish: His answer was vague.
entries.question: 不想回答問題時，你會怎麼說？
entries.questionPinyin: bù xiǎng huí dá wèn tí shí, nǐ huì zěn me shuō?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you say when you don't want to answer a question?
entries.answer: 我會說得很含糊，像是「再看看吧」。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì shuō de hěn hán hu, xiàng shì “zài kàn kàn ba”.
entries.answerEnglish: I keep it vague and say something like 'We'll see.'

entries.example: 媽媽勸阻我一個人去爬山。
entries.examplePinyin: mā ma quàn zǔ wǒ yí gè rén qù pá shān.
entries.exampleEnglish: My mom tried to talk me out of hiking alone.
entries.question: 朋友要做危險的事，你會勸阻他嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: péng yǒu yào zuò wéi xiǎn de shì, nǐ huì quàn zǔ tā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: If a friend wants to do something dangerous, would you try to stop them?
entries.answer: 會，我一定會勸阻他。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ yí dìng huì quàn zǔ tā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd definitely try to talk them out of it.

entries.example: 這家餐廳很有異國風味。
