entries.answerEnglish: I'm planning to dress up as a witch and wear a black hat.

entries.example: 這個廣告很容易誤導消費者。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge guǎng gào hěn róng yì wù dǎo xiāo fèi zhě.
entries.exampleEnglish: This ad can easily mislead consumers.
entries.question: 你被網路上的新聞誤導過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bèi wǎng lù shang de xīn wén wù dǎo guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been misled by news online?
entries.answer: 有，我被假新聞誤導過一次。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ bèi jiǎ xīn wén wù dǎo guò yí cì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I was misled by fake news once.

entries.example: 這種流行病大多在冬天出現。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhǒng liú xíng bìng dà duō zài dōng tiān chū xiàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This epidemic disease mostly appears in winter.
entries.question: 流行病期間，大家應該怎麼做？
entries.questionPinyin: liú xíng bìng qí jiān, dà jiā yīng gāi zěn me zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: During an epidemic, what should people do?
entries.answer: 流行病期間要常洗手、戴口罩。
entries.answerPinyin: liú xíng bìng qí jiān yào cháng xǐ shǒu, dài kǒu zhào.
entries.answerEnglish: During an epidemic, wash your hands often and wear a mask.

entries.example: 我不太吃乳製品，例如起司。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bú tài chī rǔ zhì pǐn, lì rú qǐ sī.
entries.exampleEnglish: I don't eat much dairy, like cheese.
entries.question: 你每天會吃乳製品嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ měi tiān huì chī rǔ zhì pǐn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you eat dairy every day?
entries.answer: 會，我早餐常吃優格這類乳製品。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ zǎo cān cháng chī yōu gé zhè lèi rǔ zhì pǐn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. For breakfast I often have dairy like yogurt.

entries.example: 這家醫院以前是修女開的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā yī yuàn yǐ qián shì xiū nǚ kāi de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This hospital was originally run by nuns.
entries.question: 你認識當修女的人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ rèn shì dāng xiū nǚ de rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know anyone who is a nun?
entries.answer: 認識，我阿姨是一位修女。
entries.answerPinyin: rèn shì, wǒ ā yí shì yí wèi xiū nǚ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. My aunt is a nun.

entries.example: 朋友常取笑我的中文發音。
entries.examplePinyin: péng yǒu cháng qǔ xiào wǒ de zhōng wén fā yīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: My friends often tease me about my Chinese pronunciation.
entries.question: 朋友取笑你的時候，你會生氣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: péng yǒu qǔ xiào nǐ de shí hòu, nǐ huì shēng qì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When your friends tease you, do you get angry?
entries.answer: 不會，朋友取笑我只是開玩笑。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, péng yǒu qǔ xiào wǒ zhǐ shì kāi wán xiào.
entries.answerEnglish: No. When my friends tease me, they're just joking.

entries.example: 這件洋裝有很多蕾絲。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn yáng zhuāng yǒu hěn duō lěi sī.
entries.exampleEnglish: This dress has a lot of lace.
entries.question: 你喜歡有蕾絲的衣服嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan yǒu lěi sī de yī fu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like clothes with lace?
entries.answer: 不太喜歡，蕾絲穿起來有點癢。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài xǐ huan, lěi sī chuān qǐ lái yǒu diǎn yǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. Lace is a bit itchy to wear.

entries.example: 炒飯裡有豌豆和紅蘿蔔。
entries.examplePinyin: chǎo fàn lǐ yǒu wān dòu hé hóng luó bo.
entries.exampleEnglish: The fried rice has peas and carrots in it.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃豌豆嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī wān dòu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like peas?
entries.answer: 不太喜歡，我常把豌豆挑出來。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài xǐ huan, wǒ cháng bǎ wān dòu tiāo chū lái.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. I often pick the peas out.

entries.example: 他手上有一道小時候留下的疤痕。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shǒu shàng yǒu yí dào xiǎo shí hòu liú xià de bā hén.
entries.exampleEnglish: He has a scar on his hand from when he was little.
entries.question: 有什麼方法可以讓疤痕變淡？
entries.questionPinyin: yǒu shén me fāng fǎ kě yǐ ràng bā hén biàn dàn?
entries.questionEnglish: What can you do to make a scar fade?
entries.answer: 可以擦藥膏，疤痕會慢慢變淡。
entries.answerPinyin: kě yǐ cā yào gāo, bā hén huì màn màn biàn dàn.
entries.answerEnglish: You can put ointment on it, and the scar will slowly fade.

entries.example: 他是籃球界的傳奇人物。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì lán qiú jiè de chuán qí rén wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a legend in the basketball world.
entries.question: 你心中的傳奇人物是誰？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xīn zhōng de chuán qí rén wù shì shéi?
entries.questionEnglish: Who is a legend in your eyes?
entries.answer: 我心中的傳奇人物是我的爺爺。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xīn zhōng de chuán qí rén wù shì wǒ de yé ye.
entries.answerEnglish: In my eyes, my grandpa is a legend.

entries.example: 這兩個字長得很像，很難區分。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè liǎng gè zì zhǎng de hěn xiàng, hěn nán qū fēn.
entries.exampleEnglish: These two characters look alike and are hard to tell apart.
entries.question: 你會區分繁體字和簡體字嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì qū fēn fán tǐ zì hé jiǎn tǐ zì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you tell Traditional and Simplified characters apart?
entries.answer: 會，繁體字的筆畫比較多，很好區分。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, fán tǐ zì de bǐ huà bǐ jiào duō, hěn hǎo qū fēn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. Traditional characters have more strokes, so they're easy to tell apart.

entries.example: 晚上的九份有一種魔幻的感覺。
entries.examplePinyin: wǎn shàng de jiǔ fèn yǒu yì zhǒng mó huàn de gǎn jué.
entries.exampleEnglish: Jiufen at night has a magical feel.
entries.question: 你去過哪個很魔幻的地方？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò nǎ gè hěn mó huàn de dì fāng?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been anywhere that felt magical?
entries.answer: 我覺得阿里山的雲海很魔幻。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de ā lǐ shān de yún hǎi hěn mó huàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I think the sea of clouds at Alishan is magical.

entries.example: 長時間開車很容易疲勞。
entries.examplePinyin: cháng shí jiān kāi chē hěn róng yì pí láo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Driving for a long time makes you tired easily.
entries.question: 你工作疲勞時會做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gōng zuò pí láo shí huì zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when you're worn out at work?
entries.answer: 工作疲勞時，我會起來走一走。
entries.answerPinyin: gōng zuò pí láo shí, wǒ huì qǐ lái zǒu yi zǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: When I'm worn out at work, I get up and walk around.

entries.example: 他們說愛情是永恆的。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men shuō ài qíng shì yǒng héng de.
entries.exampleEnglish: They say love is eternal.
entries.question: 你相信永恆的友情嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiāng xìn yǒng héng de yǒu qíng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you believe in everlasting friendship?
entries.answer: 相信，我和老朋友的友情是永恆的。
entries.answerPinyin: xiāng xìn, wǒ hé lǎo péng yǒu de yǒu qíng shì yǒng héng de.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. My friendship with my old friends will last forever.

entries.example: 家裡有蟑螂，我去買了殺蟲劑。
entries.examplePinyin: jiā lǐ yǒu zhāng láng, wǒ qù mǎi le shā chóng jì.
entries.exampleEnglish: There were cockroaches at home, so I bought some bug spray.
entries.question: 家裡有蟑螂時，你會用殺蟲劑嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: jiā lǐ yǒu zhāng láng shí, nǐ huì yòng shā chóng jì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When there are cockroaches at home, do you use bug spray?
entries.answer: 會，我會用殺蟲劑噴牠們。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì yòng shā chóng jì pēn tā men.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. I spray them with bug spray.

entries.example: 這個客人很難對付。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge kè rén hěn nán duì fù.
entries.exampleEnglish: This customer is hard to deal with.
entries.question: 你遇過很難對付的客人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yù guò hěn nán duì fù de kè rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had a customer who was hard to deal with?
entries.answer: 遇過，那個客人真的很難對付。
entries.answerPinyin: yù guò, nà ge kè rén zhēn de hěn nán duì fù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. That customer was really difficult.

entries.example: 主管批准了我的請假。
entries.examplePinyin: zhǔ guǎn pī zhǔn le wǒ de qǐng jià.
entries.exampleEnglish: My supervisor approved my leave.
entries.question: 你請假需要誰批准？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qǐng jià xū yào shéi pī zhǔn?
entries.questionEnglish: Who has to approve your leave?
entries.answer: 我請假需要主管批准。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qǐng jià xū yào zhǔ guǎn pī zhǔn.
entries.answerEnglish: My supervisor has to approve my leave.

entries.example: 我把舊報紙綁成一捆。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bǎ jiù bào zhǐ bǎng chéng yì kǔn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I tied the old newspapers into a bundle.
entries.question: 你家的舊報紙怎麼回收？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de jiù bào zhǐ zěn me huí shōu?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you recycle old newspapers at home?
entries.answer: 我把舊報紙綁成一捆，拿去回收。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǎ jiù bào zhǐ bǎng chéng yì kǔn, ná qù huí shōu.
entries.answerEnglish: I tie the old newspapers into a bundle and take them to recycling.

entries.example: 連假塞車是可預期的。
entries.examplePinyin: lián jià sāi chē shì kě yù qí de.
entries.exampleEnglish: Traffic jams on long weekends are predictable.
entries.question: 你喜歡可預期的生活，還是驚喜？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kě yù qí de shēng huó, hái shì jīng xǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer a predictable life or surprises?
entries.answer: 我喜歡可預期的生活，比較安心。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan kě yù qí de shēng huó, bǐ jiào ān xīn.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer a predictable life. It makes me feel at ease.

entries.example: 我負責協調兩個部門的工作。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ fù zé xié tiáo liǎng gè bù mén de gōng zuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm in charge of coordinating the work of two departments.
entries.question: 你的工作需要常常協調別人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng zuò xū yào cháng cháng xié tiáo bié rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your job require you to coordinate with others a lot?
entries.answer: 需要，我每天都要協調很多人的時間。
entries.answerPinyin: xū yào, wǒ měi tiān dōu yào xié tiáo hěn duō rén de shí jiān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. Every day I have to coordinate lots of people's schedules.

entries.example: 抗生素要照醫生的指示吃。
entries.examplePinyin: kàng shēng sù yào zhào yī shēng de zhǐ shì chī.
entries.exampleEnglish: Antibiotics should be taken as the doctor instructs.
entries.question: 為什麼不能隨便吃抗生素？
entries.questionPinyin: wèi shén me bù néng suí biàn chī kàng shēng sù?
entries.questionEnglish: Why shouldn't people take antibiotics carelessly?
entries.answer: 隨便吃抗生素，細菌會產生抗藥性。
entries.answerPinyin: suí biàn chī kàng shēng sù, xì jùn huì chǎn shēng kàng yào xìng.
entries.answerEnglish: If people take antibiotics carelessly, bacteria become resistant.

entries.example: 公司下週要部署新的系統。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng sī xià zhōu yào bù shù xīn de xì tǒng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The company will deploy a new system next week.
entries.question: 你的公司最近部署了什麼新東西？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng sī zuì jìn bù shù le shén me xīn dōng xī?
entries.questionEnglish: What new things has your company rolled out recently?
entries.answer: 我們最近部署了新的會議軟體。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men zuì jìn bù shù le xīn de huì yì ruǎn tǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: We recently rolled out new meeting software.

entries.example: 路上有一個凸起，騎車要小心。
entries.examplePinyin: lù shang yǒu yí gè tū qǐ, qí chē yào xiǎo xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a bump in the road, so be careful when you ride.
entries.question: 騎車時你會注意路面的凸起嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: qí chē shí nǐ huì zhù yì lù miàn de tū qǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you watch out for bumps in the road when you ride?
entries.answer: 會，看到凸起我就會騎慢一點。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, kàn dào tū qǐ wǒ jiù huì qí màn yì diǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when I see a bump I slow down.

entries.example: 這是全國性的比賽，很多人參加。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shì quán guó xìng de bǐ sài, hěn duō rén cān jiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's a nationwide competition, and lots of people take part.
entries.question: 你參加過全國性的活動嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān jiā guò quán guó xìng de huó dòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever taken part in a national event?
entries.answer: 參加過，我跑過一次全國性的馬拉松。
entries.answerPinyin: cān jiā guò, wǒ pǎo guò yí cì quán guó xìng de mǎ lā sōng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I once ran a national marathon.

entries.example: 工人在修理地下的管線。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng rén zài xiū lǐ dì xià de guǎn xiàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The workers are repairing the underground pipes.
entries.question: 你家的管線出過問題嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de guǎn xiàn chū guò wèn tí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have the pipes in your home ever had problems?
entries.answer: 出過，浴室的管線去年塞住了。
entries.answerPinyin: chū guò, yù shì de guǎn xiàn qù nián sāi zhù le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the bathroom pipes got clogged last year.

entries.example: 每個國家都想保護自己的領土。
entries.examplePinyin: měi gè guó jiā dōu xiǎng bǎo hù zì jǐ de lǐng tǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Every country wants to protect its own territory.
entries.question: 你的國家領土大不大？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā lǐng tǔ dà bu dà?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your country's territory large?
entries.answer: 很大，我們國家的領土比台灣大很多。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn dà, wǒ men guó jiā de lǐng tǔ bǐ tái wān dà hěn duō.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my country's territory is much bigger than Taiwan's.

entries.example: 夜市裡有無數的小吃攤。
entries.examplePinyin: yè shì lǐ yǒu wú shù de xiǎo chī tān.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are countless food stalls at the night market.
entries.question: 有什麼電影你看過無數次？
entries.questionPinyin: yǒu shén me diàn yǐng nǐ kàn guò wú shù cì?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a movie you've watched countless times?
entries.answer: 有一部卡通，我小時候看過無數次。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu yí bù kǎ tōng, wǒ xiǎo shí hòu kàn guò wú shù cì.
entries.answerEnglish: There's a cartoon I watched countless times as a kid.

entries.example: 他脾氣很火爆，常常跟人吵架。
entries.examplePinyin: tā pí qì hěn huǒ bào, cháng cháng gēn rén chǎo jià.
entries.exampleEnglish: He has a fiery temper and often argues with people.
entries.question: 你身邊有脾氣火爆的人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēn biān yǒu pí qì huǒ bào de rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there anyone around you with an explosive temper?
entries.answer: 有，我老闆的脾氣有點火爆。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ lǎo bǎn de pí qì yǒu diǎn huǒ bào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my boss is a bit hot-tempered.

entries.example: 加班費剛好抵銷了計程車錢。
entries.examplePinyin: jiā bān fèi gāng hǎo dǐ xiāo le jì chéng chē qián.
entries.exampleEnglish: The overtime pay just offset the taxi fares.
entries.question: 你覺得運動能抵銷吃宵夜嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de yùn dòng néng dǐ xiāo chī xiāo yè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think exercise can offset late-night snacking?
entries.answer: 可以抵銷一點，但不能天天吃。
entries.answerPinyin: kě yǐ dǐ xiāo yì diǎn, dàn bù néng tiān tiān chī.
entries.answerEnglish: It can offset it a little, but you can't eat them every day.

entries.example: 他十年前移居到台灣。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shí nián qián yí jū dào tái wān.
entries.exampleEnglish: He moved to Taiwan ten years ago.
entries.question: 你為什麼移居台灣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ wèi shén me yí jū tái wān?
entries.questionEnglish: Why did you move to Taiwan?
entries.answer: 因為工作，我三年前移居台灣。
entries.answerPinyin: yīn wèi gōng zuò, wǒ sān nián qián yí jū tái wān.
entries.answerEnglish: I moved to Taiwan three years ago for work.

entries.example: 對面車子的強光讓我看不清楚路。
entries.examplePinyin: duì miàn chē zi de qiáng guāng ràng wǒ kàn bù qīng chǔ lù.
entries.exampleEnglish: The glare from the oncoming car made it hard to see the road.
entries.question: 遇到刺眼的強光，你會怎麼辦？
entries.questionPinyin: yù dào cì yǎn de qiáng guāng, nǐ huì zěn me bàn?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when you face a dazzling glare?
entries.answer: 我會戴太陽眼鏡，擋住強光。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì dài tài yáng yǎn jìng, dǎng zhù qiáng guāng.
entries.answerEnglish: I put on sunglasses to block the glare.

entries.example: 報告有一個錯字，我馬上更正了。
entries.examplePinyin: bào gào yǒu yí gè cuò zì, wǒ mǎ shàng gēng zhèng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: There was a typo in the report, and I corrected it right away.
entries.question: 別人叫錯你的名字，你會更正嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: bié rén jiào cuò nǐ de míng zì, nǐ huì gēng zhèng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: If someone gets your name wrong, do you correct them?
entries.answer: 會，我會很客氣地更正他。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì hěn kè qì de gēng zhèng tā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I correct them very politely.

entries.example: 兩台車在路口發生碰撞。
entries.examplePinyin: liǎng tái chē zài lù kǒu fā shēng pèng zhuàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Two cars collided at the intersection.
entries.question: 騎腳踏車要怎麼避免碰撞？
entries.questionPinyin: qí jiǎo tà chē yào zěn me bì miǎn pèng zhuàng?
entries.questionEnglish: How can you avoid collisions when cycling?
entries.answer: 騎慢一點，注意路口，就能避免碰撞。
entries.answerPinyin: qí màn yì diǎn, zhù yì lù kǒu, jiù néng bì miǎn pèng zhuàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Ride slower and watch the intersections, and you can avoid collisions.

entries.example: 一大片鳥群從海上飛過。
entries.examplePinyin: yí dà piàn niǎo qún cóng hǎi shàng fēi guò.
entries.exampleEnglish: A huge flock of birds flew over the sea.
entries.question: 你在哪裡看過很大的鳥群？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài nǎ lǐ kàn guò hěn dà de niǎo qún?
entries.questionEnglish: Where have you seen a huge flock of birds?
entries.answer: 我在關渡的濕地看過很大的鳥群。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài guān dù de shī dì kàn guò hěn dà de niǎo qún.
entries.answerEnglish: I saw a huge flock of birds at the Guandu wetlands.

entries.example: 打完疫苗以後，身體會產生抗體。
entries.examplePinyin: dǎ wán yì miáo yǐ hòu, shēn tǐ huì chǎn shēng kàng tǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: After a vaccination, the body produces antibodies.
entries.question: 要怎麼知道身體有沒有抗體？
entries.questionPinyin: yào zěn me zhī dào shēn tǐ yǒu méi yǒu kàng tǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: How can you find out whether the body has antibodies?
entries.answer: 可以去醫院驗血，檢查有沒有抗體。
entries.answerPinyin: kě yǐ qù yī yuàn yàn xiě, jiǎn chá yǒu méi yǒu kàng tǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: You can get a blood test at a hospital to check for antibodies.

entries.example: 他看到公車來了，就猛衝過去。
entries.examplePinyin: tā kàn dào gōng chē lái le, jiù měng chōng guò qù.
entries.exampleEnglish: He saw the bus coming and dashed over.
entries.question: 你曾經為了趕捷運猛衝嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ céng jīng wèi le gǎn jié yùn měng chōng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever dashed to catch the MRT?
entries.answer: 有，我常常猛衝去趕末班車。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ cháng cháng měng chōng qù gǎn mò bān chē.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often dash to catch the last train.

entries.example: 這位指揮家很有名。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè wèi zhǐ huī jiā hěn yǒu míng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This conductor is very famous.
entries.question: 你知道哪位有名的指揮家？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào nǎ wèi yǒu míng de zhǐ huī jiā?
entries.questionEnglish: Which famous conductors do you know?
entries.answer: 我知道小澤征爾，他是日本的指揮家。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhī dào xiǎo zé zhēng ěr, tā shì rì běn de zhǐ huī jiā.
entries.answerEnglish: I know Seiji Ozawa; he's a Japanese conductor.

entries.example: 今年很乾旱，水庫快沒水了。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn nián hěn gān hàn, shuǐ kù kuài méi shuǐ le.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's been very dry this year, and the reservoirs are almost empty.
entries.question: 你的國家常常發生乾旱嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā cháng cháng fā shēng gān hàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your country often have droughts?
entries.answer: 不常，但是夏天有時候會乾旱。
entries.answerPinyin: bù cháng, dàn shì xià tiān yǒu shí hòu huì gān hàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Not often, but sometimes there's a drought in summer.

entries.example: 這次颱風很有破壞性。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì tái fēng hěn yǒu pò huài xìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This typhoon was very destructive.
entries.question: 你覺得哪種天災最有破壞性？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǎ zhǒng tiān zāi zuì yǒu pò huài xìng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which kind of natural disaster do you think is the most destructive?
entries.answer: 我覺得地震最有破壞性。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de dì zhèn zuì yǒu pò huài xìng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think earthquakes are the most destructive.

entries.example: 這個軟體跟我的電腦不相容。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge ruǎn tǐ gēn wǒ de diàn nǎo bù xiāng róng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This software isn't compatible with my computer.
entries.question: 你的手機和電腦相容嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de shǒu jī hé diàn nǎo xiāng róng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are your phone and computer compatible?
entries.answer: 相容，它們是同一個牌子的。
entries.answerPinyin: xiāng róng, tā men shì tóng yí gè pái zi de.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, they're the same brand.

entries.example: 面試要穿得體面一點。
entries.examplePinyin: miàn shì yào chuān de tǐ miàn yì diǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: You should dress respectably for an interview.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼是體面的工作？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me shì tǐ miàn de gōng zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think counts as a respectable job?
entries.answer: 我覺得能養活自己的工作都很體面。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de néng yǎng huó zì jǐ de gōng zuò dōu hěn tǐ miàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I think any job that supports you is respectable.

entries.example: 媽媽是我們家的支柱。
entries.examplePinyin: mā ma shì wǒ men jiā de zhī zhù.
entries.exampleEnglish: Mom is the pillar of our family.
entries.question: 誰是你生活中的支柱？
entries.questionPinyin: shéi shì nǐ shēng huó zhōng de zhī zhù?
entries.questionEnglish: Who is the pillar of your life?
entries.answer: 我的家人是我最大的支柱。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de jiā rén shì wǒ zuì dà de zhī zhù.
entries.answerEnglish: My family is my biggest support.

entries.example: 吵架以後，他們終於和解了。
entries.examplePinyin: chǎo jià yǐ hòu, tā men zhōng yú hé jiě le.
entries.exampleEnglish: After the argument, they finally made up.
entries.question: 跟朋友吵架後，你會主動和解嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: gēn péng yǒu chǎo jià hòu, nǐ huì zhǔ dòng hé jiě ma?
entries.questionEnglish: After a fight with a friend, do you take the first step to make up?
entries.answer: 會，我通常會先道歉，跟他和解。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ tōng cháng huì xiān dào qiàn, gēn tā hé jiě.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I usually apologize first and make peace with them.

entries.example: 他說的話很惡毒。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shuō de huà hěn è dú.
entries.exampleEnglish: What he said was really vicious.
entries.question: 你在網路上看過惡毒的留言嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài wǎng lù shang kàn guò è dú de liú yán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen vicious comments online?
entries.answer: 看過，有些人的留言真的很惡毒。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, yǒu xiē rén de liú yán zhēn de hěn è dú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, some people's comments are really vicious.

entries.example: 這份文件是公司機密。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè fèn wén jiàn shì gōng sī jī mì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This document is company confidential.
entries.question: 你的工作要處理機密資料嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng zuò yào chǔ lǐ jī mì zī liào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you handle confidential information at work?
entries.answer: 有時候，我們有一些客戶的機密資料。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu, wǒ men yǒu yì xiē kè hù de jī mì zī liào.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. We have some confidential client data.

entries.example: 這件洋裝的設計很女性化。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn yáng zhuāng de shè jì hěn nǚ xìng huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: This dress has a very feminine design.
entries.question: 你覺得粉紅色很女性化嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de fěn hóng sè hěn nǚ xìng huà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think pink is very feminine?
entries.answer: 不會，我覺得粉紅色不一定女性化。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ jué de fěn hóng sè bù yí dìng nǚ xìng huà.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't think pink is necessarily feminine.

entries.example: 他們拿著火把走進山洞。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men ná zhe huǒ bǎ zǒu jìn shān dòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: They walked into the cave carrying torches.
entries.question: 你在哪裡看過人拿火把？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài nǎ lǐ kàn guò rén ná huǒ bǎ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where have you seen people carrying torches?
entries.answer: 我在電影和祭典裡看過人拿火把。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài diàn yǐng hé jì diǎn lǐ kàn guò rén ná huǒ bǎ.
entries.answerEnglish: I've seen people carrying torches in movies and at festivals.

entries.example: 他用手指彈了一下我的額頭。
entries.examplePinyin: tā yòng shǒu zhǐ tán le yí xià wǒ de é tóu.
entries.exampleEnglish: He flicked my forehead with his finger.
entries.question: 你小時候玩過彈額頭的遊戲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu wán guò tán é tóu de yóu xì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you play forehead-flicking games as a kid?
entries.answer: 玩過，輸的人就要被彈額頭。
entries.answerPinyin: wán guò, shū de rén jiù yào bèi tán é tóu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, whoever lost got their forehead flicked.

entries.example: 他們過著簡樸的生活。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men guò zhe jiǎn pǔ de shēng huó.
entries.exampleEnglish: They live a simple life.
entries.question: 你喜歡簡樸的生活嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan jiǎn pǔ de shēng huó ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like a simple life?
entries.answer: 喜歡，簡樸的生活讓我比較輕鬆。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, jiǎn pǔ de shēng huó ràng wǒ bǐ jiào qīng sōng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a simple life makes me feel more relaxed.

entries.example: 爺爺走路要用手杖。
entries.examplePinyin: yé ye zǒu lù yào yòng shǒu zhàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Grandpa needs a cane to walk.
entries.question: 你的家人有用手杖嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de jiā rén yǒu yòng shǒu zhàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does anyone in your family use a cane?
entries.answer: 有，我奶奶出門都要帶手杖。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ nǎi nai chū mén dōu yào dài shǒu zhàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my grandma always takes a cane when she goes out.

entries.example: 這座橋橫跨整條河。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zuò qiáo héng kuà zhěng tiáo hé.
entries.exampleEnglish: This bridge spans the whole river.
entries.question: 你看過橫跨大海的橋嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò héng kuà dà hǎi de qiáo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a bridge that spans the sea?
entries.answer: 看過，澎湖有一座大橋橫跨海上。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, péng hú yǒu yí zuò dà qiáo héng kuà hǎi shàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a big bridge in Penghu that spans the sea.

entries.example: 夜市是美食的樂園。
entries.examplePinyin: yè shì shì měi shí de lè yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: Night markets are a food paradise.
entries.question: 你心中的樂園在哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xīn zhōng de lè yuán zài nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where is your idea of paradise?
entries.answer: 我心中的樂園是海邊的小鎮。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xīn zhōng de lè yuán shì hǎi biān de xiǎo zhèn.
entries.answerEnglish: My paradise is a little town by the sea.

entries.example: 我們終止了跟那家公司的合約。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zhōng zhǐ le gēn nà jiā gōng sī de hé yuē.
entries.exampleEnglish: We terminated our contract with that company.
entries.question: 你曾經終止過手機合約嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ céng jīng zhōng zhǐ guò shǒu jī hé yuē ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever terminated a phone contract?
entries.answer: 有，我去年終止了舊的手機合約。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ qù nián zhōng zhǐ le jiù de shǒu jī hé yuē.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I terminated my old phone contract last year.

entries.example: 這家公司的口號很好記。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā gōng sī de kǒu hào hěn hǎo jì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This company's slogan is easy to remember.
entries.question: 你記得哪個廣告的口號？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jì de nǎ gè guǎng gào de kǒu hào?
entries.questionEnglish: Which advertising slogan do you remember?
entries.answer: 我記得全家便利商店的口號：全家就是你家。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jì de quán jiā biàn lì shāng diàn de kǒu hào: quán jiā jiù shì nǐ jiā.
entries.answerEnglish: I remember FamilyMart's slogan: FamilyMart is your home.

entries.example: 進口車的關稅很高。
entries.examplePinyin: jìn kǒu chē de guān shuì hěn gāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: The tariffs on imported cars are high.
entries.question: 你在網路上買國外的東西要付關稅嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài wǎng lù shang mǎi guó wài de dōng xī yào fù guān shuì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have to pay customs duty when you buy things from abroad online?
entries.answer: 有時候要，買貴的東西就要付關稅。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu yào, mǎi guì de dōng xī jiù yào fù guān shuì.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. For expensive things I have to pay duty.

entries.example: 這是季節性的水果，只有夏天有。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shì jì jié xìng de shuǐ guǒ, zhǐ yǒu xià tiān yǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a seasonal fruit; it's only available in summer.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪種季節性的水果？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ zhǒng jì jié xìng de shuǐ guǒ?
entries.questionEnglish: Which seasonal fruit do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡芒果，它是夏天季節性的水果。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan máng guǒ, tā shì xià tiān jì jié xìng de shuǐ guǒ.
entries.answerEnglish: I like mangoes best; they're a seasonal summer fruit.

entries.example: 衣服上還殘留著香水味。
entries.examplePinyin: yī fu shàng hái cán liú zhe xiāng shuǐ wèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: The smell of perfume still lingers on the clothes.
entries.question: 你會擔心蔬菜有農藥殘留嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì dān xīn shū cài yǒu nóng yào cán liú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you worry about pesticide residue on vegetables?
entries.answer: 會，所以我洗菜會多洗幾次，減少殘留。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, suǒ yǐ wǒ xǐ cài huì duō xǐ jǐ cì, jiǎn shǎo cán liú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, so I wash vegetables a few extra times to reduce the residue.

entries.example: 這家酒吧的燈光很昏暗。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā jiǔ bā de dēng guāng hěn hūn àn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The lighting in this bar is very dim.
entries.question: 你喜歡燈光昏暗的餐廳嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan dēng guāng hūn àn de cān tīng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like dimly lit restaurants?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，太昏暗我看不清楚菜單。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xǐ huan, tài hūn àn wǒ kàn bù qīng chǔ cài dān.
entries.answerEnglish: No, when it's too dim I can't read the menu.

entries.example: 昨天下午突然下冰雹。
entries.examplePinyin: zuó tiān xià wǔ tú rán xià bīng báo.
entries.exampleEnglish: It suddenly hailed yesterday afternoon.
entries.question: 你看過下冰雹嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò xià bīng báo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen hail?
entries.answer: 看過，我在家鄉看過很大的冰雹。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài jiā xiāng kàn guò hěn dà de bīng báo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've seen huge hailstones in my hometown.

entries.example: 停電時，醫院會用發電機。
entries.examplePinyin: tíng diàn shí, yī yuàn huì yòng fā diàn jī.
entries.exampleEnglish: When the power goes out, hospitals use generators.
entries.question: 停電時，哪些地方需要發電機？
entries.questionPinyin: tíng diàn shí, nǎ xiē dì fāng xū yào fā diàn jī?
entries.questionEnglish: Which places need generators during a power outage?
entries.answer: 醫院和大樓都需要發電機。
entries.answerPinyin: yī yuàn hé dà lóu dōu xū yào fā diàn jī.
entries.answerEnglish: Hospitals and big buildings need generators.

entries.example: 我的白襯衫上有一塊汙漬。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de bái chèn shān shàng yǒu yí kuài wū zì.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a stain on my white shirt.
entries.question: 衣服上有汙漬，你會怎麼處理？
entries.questionPinyin: yī fu shàng yǒu wū zì, nǐ huì zěn me chǔ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when your clothes have a stain?
entries.answer: 我會先用肥皂洗掉汙漬。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì xiān yòng féi zào xǐ diào wū zì.
entries.answerEnglish: I wash the stain out with soap first.

entries.example: 這支口紅的顏色很持久。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhī kǒu hóng de yán sè hěn chí jiǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The color of this lipstick is long-lasting.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼樣的友誼比較持久？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me yàng de yǒu yì bǐ jiào chí jiǔ?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of friendship do you think lasts longer?
entries.answer: 我覺得互相信任的友誼比較持久。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de hù xiāng xìn rèn de yǒu yì bǐ jiào chí jiǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: I think friendships built on mutual trust last longer.

entries.example: 多吃蔬菜可以補充纖維。
entries.examplePinyin: duō chī shū cài kě yǐ bǔ chōng xiān wéi.
entries.exampleEnglish: Eating more vegetables gives you more fiber.
entries.question: 你每天吃的纖維夠嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ měi tiān chī de xiān wéi gòu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you get enough fiber every day?
entries.answer: 不太夠，我應該多吃有纖維的蔬菜。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài gòu, wǒ yīng gāi duō chī yǒu xiān wéi de shū cài.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. I should eat more vegetables with fiber.

entries.example: 我把花移植到大一點的盆子。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bǎ huā yí zhí dào dà yì diǎn de pén zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: I transplanted the flowers into a bigger pot.
entries.question: 植物長大了，你會幫它移植嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zhí wù zhǎng dà le, nǐ huì bāng tā yí zhí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When a plant grows bigger, do you transplant it?
entries.answer: 會，我會把它移植到比較大的盆子。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì bǎ tā yí zhí dào bǐ jiào dà de pén zi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I transplant it into a bigger pot.

entries.example: 多吃蔬菜對腸道很好。
entries.examplePinyin: duō chī shū cài duì cháng dào hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Eating more vegetables is good for your gut.
entries.question: 吃什麼對腸道比較好？
entries.questionPinyin: chī shén me duì cháng dào bǐ jiào hǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: What foods are better for the gut?
entries.answer: 優格和蔬菜對腸道很好。
entries.answerPinyin: yōu gé hé shū cài duì cháng dào hěn hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yogurt and vegetables are good for the gut.

entries.example: 記者扭曲了他的意思。
entries.examplePinyin: jì zhě niǔ qū le tā de yì sī.
entries.exampleEnglish: The reporter distorted what he meant.
entries.question: 你覺得新聞常常扭曲事實嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de xīn wén cháng cháng niǔ qū shì shí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think the news often distorts the facts?
entries.answer: 有些新聞會扭曲事實，要小心看。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu xiē xīn wén huì niǔ qū shì shí, yào xiǎo xīn kàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Some news distorts the facts, so read carefully.

entries.example: 這幾年房價急速上漲。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jǐ nián fáng jià jí sù shàng zhǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Housing prices have risen rapidly in recent years.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的物價急速上漲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān de wù jià jí sù shàng zhǎng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think prices in Taiwan are rising rapidly?
entries.answer: 對，這幾年物價急速上漲。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, zhè jǐ nián wù jià jí sù shàng zhǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, prices have shot up these past few years.

entries.example: 她跳舞的樣子很優雅。
entries.examplePinyin: tā tiào wǔ de yàng zi hěn yōu yǎ.
entries.exampleEnglish: She dances very gracefully.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼樣的人很優雅？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me yàng de rén hěn yōu yǎ?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of person do you think is elegant?
entries.answer: 我覺得說話溫柔的人很優雅。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de shuō huà wēn róu de rén hěn yōu yǎ.
entries.answerEnglish: I think people who speak gently are elegant.

entries.example: 公司今年大幅削減預算。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng sī jīn nián dà fú xuē jiǎn yù suàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The company slashed its budget this year.
entries.question: 如果要省錢，你會削減哪些花費？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ yào shěng qián, nǐ huì xuē jiǎn nǎ xiē huā fèi?
entries.questionEnglish: If you needed to save money, which expenses would you cut?
entries.answer: 我會削減外食和買衣服的花費。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì xuē jiǎn wài shí hé mǎi yī fu de huā fèi.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd cut spending on eating out and clothes.

entries.example: 我低估了台北的塞車。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ dī gū le tái běi de sāi chē.
entries.exampleEnglish: I underestimated the traffic in Taipei.
entries.question: 你曾經低估過什麼事情的難度？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ céng jīng dī gū guò shén me shì qíng de nán dù?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever underestimated how hard something was?
entries.answer: 我低估了學中文的難度。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dī gū le xué zhōng wén de nán dù.
entries.answerEnglish: I underestimated how hard it is to learn Chinese.

entries.example: 每天都有很多瑣碎的事要做。
entries.examplePinyin: měi tiān dōu yǒu hěn duō suǒ suì de shì yào zuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of trivial things to do every day.
entries.question: 工作上哪些瑣碎的事最煩？
entries.questionPinyin: gōng zuò shàng nǎ xiē suǒ suì de shì zuì fán?
entries.questionEnglish: Which petty tasks at work are the most annoying?
entries.answer: 我覺得報帳這種瑣碎的事最煩。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de bào zhàng zhè zhǒng suǒ suì de shì zuì fán.
entries.answerEnglish: I find petty stuff like filing expense claims the most annoying.

entries.example: 小朋友在公園裡單腳跳。
entries.examplePinyin: xiǎo péng yǒu zài gōng yuán lǐ dān jiǎo tiào.
entries.exampleEnglish: The kids are hopping on one foot in the park.
entries.question: 你可以單腳跳多久？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kě yǐ dān jiǎo tiào duō jiǔ?
entries.questionEnglish: How long can you hop on one foot?
entries.answer: 我可以單腳跳一分鐘左右。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ kě yǐ dān jiǎo tiào yì fēn zhōng zuǒ yòu.
entries.answerEnglish: I can hop on one foot for about a minute.

entries.example: 辦公室裡有很多流言。
entries.examplePinyin: bàn gōng shì lǐ yǒu hěn duō liú yán.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are a lot of rumors going around the office.
entries.question: 你會相信辦公室的流言嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì xiāng xìn bàn gōng shì de liú yán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you believe office gossip?
entries.answer: 不會，我覺得流言大多不是真的。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ jué de liú yán dà duō bú shì zhēn de.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I think most rumors aren't true.

entries.example: 愛因斯坦是有名的物理學家。
entries.examplePinyin: ài yīn sī tǎn shì yǒu míng de wù lǐ xué jiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: Einstein is a famous physicist.
entries.question: 你知道哪些有名的物理學家？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào nǎ xiē yǒu míng de wù lǐ xué jiā?
entries.questionEnglish: Which famous physicists do you know of?
entries.answer: 我知道愛因斯坦和霍金，他們都是物理學家。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhī dào ài yīn sī tǎn hé huò jīn, tā men dōu shì wù lǐ xué jiā.
entries.answerEnglish: I know Einstein and Hawking; they were both physicists.

entries.example: 這家店的生意最近下滑了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn de shēng yì zuì jìn xià huá le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop's business has slumped recently.
entries.question: 你覺得自己的體力有下滑嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ de tǐ lì yǒu xià huá ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you feel your stamina has declined?
entries.answer: 有，過了三十歲體力就下滑了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, guò le sān shí suì tǐ lì jiù xià huá le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my stamina dropped after I turned thirty.

entries.example: 公司強制大家參加訓練。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng sī qiáng zhì dà jiā cān jiā xùn liàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The company makes training mandatory for everyone.
entries.question: 你的公司會強制加班嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng sī huì qiáng zhì jiā bān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company make overtime compulsory?
entries.answer: 不會，我們公司不會強制加班。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ men gōng sī bú huì qiáng zhì jiā bān.
entries.answerEnglish: No, my company doesn't force us to work overtime.

entries.example: 這個三人組在街頭唱歌表演。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge sān rén zǔ zài jiē tóu chàng gē biǎo yǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This trio performs songs on the street.
entries.question: 你有固定的三人組朋友嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu gù dìng de sān rén zǔ péng yǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a regular trio of friends?
entries.answer: 有，我跟兩個同事是午餐三人組。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ gēn liǎng gè tóng shì shì wǔ cān sān rén zǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, two coworkers and I are a lunch trio.

entries.example: 迷路的時候，我覺得很無助。
entries.examplePinyin: mí lù de shí hòu, wǒ jué de hěn wú zhù.
entries.exampleEnglish: When I got lost, I felt really helpless.
entries.question: 在台灣，你什麼時候覺得很無助？
entries.questionPinyin: zài tái wān, nǐ shén me shí hòu jué de hěn wú zhù?
entries.questionEnglish: When have you felt helpless in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 剛來台灣看不懂中文時，我很無助。
entries.answerPinyin: gāng lái tái wān kàn bù dǒng zhōng wén shí, wǒ hěn wú zhù.
entries.answerEnglish: When I first came and couldn't read Chinese, I felt helpless.

entries.example: 我學會了三個吉他和弦。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xué huì le sān gè jí tā hé xián.
entries.exampleEnglish: I've learned three guitar chords.
entries.question: 你會彈幾個吉他和弦？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì tán jǐ gè jí tā hé xián?
entries.questionEnglish: How many guitar chords can you play?
entries.answer: 我只會彈四個簡單的和弦。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhǐ huì tán sì gè jiǎn dān de hé xián.
entries.answerEnglish: I can only play four simple chords.

entries.example: 這家店的名字很引人好奇。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn de míng zì hěn yǐn rén hào qí.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop's name is intriguing.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣有什麼引人好奇的習俗？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān yǒu shén me yǐn rén hào qí de xí sú?
entries.questionEnglish: Which Taiwanese customs do you find intriguing?
entries.answer: 我覺得廟裡的抽籤很引人好奇。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de miào lǐ de chōu qiān hěn yǐn rén hào qí.
entries.answerEnglish: I find the fortune sticks at temples intriguing.

entries.example: 我爸爸四十歲就禿頭了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bà ba sì shí suì jiù tū tóu le.
entries.exampleEnglish: My dad went bald at forty.
entries.question: 你擔心以後會禿頭嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dān xīn yǐ hòu huì tū tóu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you worry about going bald later?
entries.answer: 有點擔心，我爸爸也是禿頭。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu diǎn dān xīn, wǒ bà ba yě shì tū tóu.
entries.answerEnglish: A little. My dad is bald too.

entries.example: 老闆的話讓大家士氣大增。
entries.examplePinyin: lǎo bǎn de huà ràng dà jiā shì qì dà zēng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The boss's words gave everyone's morale a big boost.
entries.question: 你們公司怎麼提升士氣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men gōng sī zěn me tí shēng shì qì?
entries.questionEnglish: How does your company boost morale?
entries.answer: 我們公司會發獎金來提升士氣。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men gōng sī huì fā jiǎng jīn lái tí shēng shì qì.
entries.answerEnglish: My company gives out bonuses to boost morale.

entries.example: 她工作很敬業，從不遲到。
entries.examplePinyin: tā gōng zuò hěn jìng yè, cóng bù chí dào.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's very dedicated to her work and is never late.
entries.question: 你覺得自己工作敬業嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ gōng zuò jìng yè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're dedicated to your work?
entries.answer: 我覺得我很敬業，每天都很早到公司。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de wǒ hěn jìng yè, měi tiān dōu hěn zǎo dào gōng sī.
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm very dedicated; I get to the office early every day.

entries.example: 這個披薩上有橄欖。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge pī sà shàng yǒu gǎn lǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are olives on this pizza.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃橄欖嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī gǎn lǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like olives?
entries.answer: 不太喜歡，我覺得橄欖有點鹹。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài xǐ huan, wǒ jué de gǎn lǎn yǒu diǎn xián.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. I find olives a bit salty.

entries.example: 中秋節，大家在烤架上烤肉。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōng qiū jié, dà jiā zài kǎo jià shàng kǎo ròu.
entries.exampleEnglish: At Mid-Autumn Festival, everyone barbecues on grills.
entries.question: 中秋節你會用烤架烤肉嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zhōng qiū jié nǐ huì yòng kǎo jià kǎo ròu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you barbecue on a grill at Mid-Autumn Festival?
entries.answer: 會，我們會在家門口用烤架烤肉。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ men huì zài jiā mén kǒu yòng kǎo jià kǎo ròu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we barbecue on a grill in front of our home.

entries.example: 在台灣，買賣象牙是違法的。
entries.examplePinyin: zài tái wān, mǎi mài xiàng yá shì wéi fǎ de.
entries.exampleEnglish: In Taiwan, buying and selling ivory is illegal.
entries.question: 你覺得應該禁止買賣象牙嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de yīng gāi jìn zhǐ mǎi mài xiàng yá ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think the ivory trade should be banned?
entries.answer: 應該，買賣象牙會傷害大象。
entries.answerPinyin: yīng gāi, mǎi mài xiàng yá huì shāng hài dà xiàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the ivory trade harms elephants.

entries.example: 工人正在攪拌水泥。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng rén zhèng zài jiǎo bàn shuǐ ní.
entries.exampleEnglish: The workers are mixing cement.
entries.question: 你喜歡水泥牆的咖啡館嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan shuǐ ní qiáng de kā fēi guǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like cafes with concrete walls?
entries.answer: 喜歡，水泥牆看起來很有個性。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, shuǐ ní qiáng kàn qǐ lái hěn yǒu gè xìng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, concrete walls have a lot of character.

entries.example: 他每天運動，身體很強健。
entries.examplePinyin: tā měi tiān yùn dòng, shēn tǐ hěn qiáng jiàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He exercises every day and is very strong.
entries.question: 你怎麼讓身體更強健？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zěn me ràng shēn tǐ gèng qiáng jiàn?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you make your body stronger?
entries.answer: 我每天跑步，讓身體更強健。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ měi tiān pǎo bù, ràng shēn tǐ gèng qiáng jiàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I run every day to make my body stronger.

entries.example: 新聞說今晚可以看到彗星。
entries.examplePinyin: xīn wén shuō jīn wǎn kě yǐ kàn dào huì xīng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The news says we can see a comet tonight.
entries.question: 你親眼看過彗星嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qīn yǎn kàn guò huì xīng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a comet with your own eyes?
entries.answer: 沒看過，我很想看一次彗星。
entries.answerPinyin: méi kàn guò, wǒ hěn xiǎng kàn yí cì huì xīng.
entries.answerEnglish: No, but I'd love to see a comet once.

entries.example: 這支手機的預設語言是英文。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhī shǒu jī de yù shè yǔ yán shì yīng wén.
entries.exampleEnglish: This phone's default language is English.
entries.question: 你的手機預設語言是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de shǒu jī yù shè yǔ yán shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the default language on your phone?
entries.answer: 我手機的預設語言是中文。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ shǒu jī de yù shè yǔ yán shì zhōng wén.
entries.answerEnglish: My phone's default language is Chinese.

entries.example: 一杯咖啡賣三百塊，太離譜了！
entries.examplePinyin: yì bēi kā fēi mài sān bǎi kuài, tài lí pǔ le!
entries.exampleEnglish: Three hundred dollars for a coffee? That's outrageous!
entries.question: 你遇過最離譜的價格是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yù guò zuì lí pǔ de jià gé shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the most outrageous price you've come across?
entries.answer: 機場的一瓶水賣一百塊，很離譜。
entries.answerPinyin: jī chǎng de yì píng shuǐ mài yì bǎi kuài, hěn lí pǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: A bottle of water at the airport cost a hundred dollars. Ridiculous.

entries.example: 這顆芒果已經熟透了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè kē máng guǒ yǐ jīng shú tòu le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This mango is fully ripe.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃熟透的香蕉嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī shú tòu de xiāng jiāo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like very ripe bananas?
entries.answer: 喜歡，熟透的香蕉比較甜。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, shú tòu de xiāng jiāo bǐ jiào tián.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, fully ripe bananas are sweeter.

entries.example: 他喜歡喝台灣的威士忌。
entries.examplePinyin: tā xǐ huan hē tái wān de wēi shì jì.
entries.exampleEnglish: He likes drinking Taiwanese whisky.
entries.question: 你喝過台灣的威士忌嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ hē guò tái wān de wēi shì jì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever tried Taiwanese whisky?
entries.answer: 喝過，我覺得台灣的威士忌很好喝。
entries.answerPinyin: hē guò, wǒ jué de tái wān de wēi shì jì hěn hǎo hē.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I think Taiwanese whisky is really good.

entries.example: 請把表格裡的字對齊。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng bǎ biǎo gé lǐ de zì duì qí.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please align the text in the table.
entries.question: 整理桌子時，你會把東西對齊嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zhěng lǐ zhuō zi shí, nǐ huì bǎ dōng xī duì qí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you tidy your desk, do you line things up?
entries.answer: 會，我喜歡把書排好對齊。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ xǐ huan bǎ shū pái hǎo duì qí.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like to line my books up neatly.

entries.example: 車子開過去，水濺到我身上。
entries.examplePinyin: chē zi kāi guò qù, shuǐ jiàn dào wǒ shēn shàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: A car drove past and splashed water on me.
entries.question: 下雨天，你被車子濺過水嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: xià yǔ tiān, nǐ bèi chē zi jiàn guò shuǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been splashed by a car on a rainy day?
entries.answer: 有，昨天公車把水濺到我褲子上。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, zuó tiān gōng chē bǎ shuǐ jiàn dào wǒ kù zi shàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, yesterday a bus splashed water on my trousers.

entries.example: 房間很安靜，只聽到時鐘滴答響。
entries.examplePinyin: fáng jiān hěn ān jìng, zhǐ tīng dào shí zhōng dī dā xiǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The room is quiet; you can only hear the clock ticking.
entries.question: 時鐘的滴答聲會吵到你睡覺嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: shí zhōng de dī dā shēng huì chǎo dào nǐ shuì jiào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does the ticking of a clock keep you awake?
entries.answer: 會，時鐘的滴答聲讓我睡不著。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, shí zhōng de dī dā shēng ràng wǒ shuì bù zháo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the ticking of a clock keeps me awake.

entries.english: be called; be known as; dub
entries.example: 這種水果在台灣被稱作芭樂。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhǒng shuǐ guǒ zài tái wān bèi chēng zuò bā lè.
entries.exampleEnglish: This fruit is called bala in Taiwan.
entries.question: 你的家鄉有什麼特別的稱呼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de jiā xiāng yǒu shén me tè bié de chēng hu?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your hometown have a special nickname?
entries.answer: 我的家鄉被稱作雨城，因為常下雨。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de jiā xiāng bèi chēng zuò yǔ chéng, yīn wèi cháng xià yǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: My hometown is known as the Rain City because it rains a lot.

entries.example: 他的論點很有道理。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de lùn diǎn hěn yǒu dào lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: His argument makes a lot of sense.
entries.question: 開會時，你會提出自己的論點嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: kāi huì shí, nǐ huì tí chū zì jǐ de lùn diǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you put forward your own arguments in meetings?
entries.answer: 會，我會用資料支持我的論點。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì yòng zī liào zhī chí wǒ de lùn diǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I back up my arguments with data.

entries.example: 我最喜歡貝多芬的第九號交響曲。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan bèi duō fēn de dì jiǔ hào jiāo xiǎng qǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: My favorite is Beethoven's Ninth Symphony.
entries.question: 你聽過哪首有名的交響曲？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tīng guò nǎ shǒu yǒu míng de jiāo xiǎng qǔ?
entries.questionEnglish: Which famous symphonies have you heard?
entries.answer: 我聽過貝多芬的第五號交響曲。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ tīng guò bèi duō fēn de dì wǔ hào jiāo xiǎng qǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: I've heard Beethoven's Fifth Symphony.

entries.example: 櫻花樹長出了很多花苞。
entries.examplePinyin: yīng huā shù zhǎng chū le hěn duō huā bāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: The cherry tree has put out lots of buds.
entries.question: 你種的花有花苞了嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhòng de huā yǒu huā bāo le ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do the flowers you planted have buds yet?
entries.answer: 有，我陽台的玫瑰長出花苞了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ yáng tái de méi guī zhǎng chū huā bāo le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the roses on my balcony have buds.

entries.example: 山上的天氣難以預測。
entries.examplePinyin: shān shàng de tiān qì nán yǐ yù cè.
entries.exampleEnglish: The weather in the mountains is unpredictable.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的天氣難以預測嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān de tiān qì nán yǐ yù cè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwan's weather is unpredictable?
entries.answer: 對，台灣夏天的午後雷陣雨難以預測。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, tái wān xià tiān de wǔ hòu léi zhèn yǔ nán yǐ yù cè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, summer afternoon thunderstorms in Taiwan are hard to predict.

entries.example: 消防員英勇地救出了三個人。
entries.examplePinyin: xiāo fáng yuán yīng yǒng de jiù chū le sān gè rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: The firefighters heroically rescued three people.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼樣的人很英勇？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me yàng de rén hěn yīng yǒng?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of person do you think is heroic?
entries.answer: 我覺得救人的消防員很英勇。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de jiù rén de xiāo fáng yuán hěn yīng yǒng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think firefighters who save people are heroic.

entries.example: 這雙鞋是劣質品，穿一次就壞了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shuāng xié shì liè zhí pǐn, chuān yí cì jiù huài le.
entries.exampleEnglish: These shoes are poor quality; they broke after one wear.
entries.question: 你買過劣質的東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi guò liè zhí de dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever bought something of poor quality?
entries.answer: 買過，網路上買的劣質耳機很快就壞了。
entries.answerPinyin: mǎi guò, wǎng lù shang mǎi de liè zhí ěr jī hěn kuài jiù huài le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, some cheap earphones I bought online broke quickly.

entries.example: 蟑螂是家裡最常見的害蟲。
entries.examplePinyin: zhāng láng shì jiā lǐ zuì cháng jiàn de hài chóng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Cockroaches are the most common pests at home.
entries.question: 你家最常見的害蟲是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā zuì cháng jiàn de hài chóng shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What is the most common pest in your home?
entries.answer: 我家最常見的害蟲是蚊子。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā zuì cháng jiàn de hài chóng shì wén zi.
entries.answerEnglish: The most common pest in my home is mosquitoes.

entries.example: 我在博物館看過一艘潛水艇。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài bó wù guǎn kàn guò yì sāo qián shuǐ tǐng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I saw a submarine at a museum.
entries.question: 你想坐潛水艇去海底看看嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng zuò qián shuǐ tǐng qù hǎi dǐ kàn kàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to go to the bottom of the sea in a submarine?
entries.answer: 想，坐潛水艇看魚一定很酷。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, zuò qián shuǐ tǐng kàn yú yí dìng hěn kù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, watching fish from a submarine must be really cool.

entries.example: 這個音訊檔太大，傳不過去。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge yīn xùn dǎng tài dà, chuán bú guò qù.
entries.exampleEnglish: This audio file is too big to send.
entries.question: 你線上開會時用音訊還是視訊？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiàn shàng kāi huì shí yòng yīn xùn hái shì shì xùn?
entries.questionEnglish: In online meetings, do you use audio only or video?
entries.answer: 我通常只用音訊，不開鏡頭。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ tōng cháng zhǐ yòng yīn xùn, bù kāi jìng tóu.
entries.answerEnglish: I usually use audio only and keep my camera off.

entries.example: 雨滴不停地敲擊著窗戶。
entries.examplePinyin: yǔ dī bù tíng de qiāo jī zhe chuāng hù.
entries.exampleEnglish: Raindrops kept rapping on the window.
entries.question: 你緊張的時候會敲擊桌子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jǐn zhāng de shí hòu huì qiāo jí zhuō zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you tap on the table when you're nervous?
entries.answer: 會，我常用手指敲擊桌子。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng yòng shǒu zhǐ qiāo jí zhuō zi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often tap the table with my fingers.

entries.example: 這次旅行加深了我們的友情。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì lǚ xíng jiā shēn le wǒ men de yǒu qíng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This trip deepened our friendship.
entries.question: 什麼事可以加深你對台灣的了解？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shì kě yǐ jiā shēn nǐ duì tái wān de liǎo jiě?
entries.questionEnglish: What could deepen your understanding of Taiwan?
entries.answer: 跟台灣朋友聊天可以加深我的了解。
entries.answerPinyin: gēn tái wān péng yǒu liáo tiān kě yǐ jiā shēn wǒ de liǎo jiě.
entries.answerEnglish: Chatting with Taiwanese friends deepens my understanding.

entries.example: 我很喜歡讀這位作家的散文。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hěn xǐ huan dú zhè wèi zuò jiā de sǎn wén.
entries.exampleEnglish: I really like reading this writer's essays.
entries.question: 你喜歡看小說還是散文？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kàn xiǎo shuō hái shì sǎn wén?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer reading novels or prose essays?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡看短篇散文。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan kàn duǎn piān sǎn wén.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer reading short essays.

entries.example: 他的行李在海關被扣留了。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de xíng li zài hǎi guān bèi kòu liú le.
entries.exampleEnglish: His luggage was held at customs.
entries.question: 行李在海關被扣留時該怎麼辦？
entries.questionPinyin: xíng li zài hǎi guān bèi kòu liú shí gāi zěn me bàn?
entries.questionEnglish: What should you do if your luggage is held at customs?
entries.answer: 行李被扣留的話，要找海關人員問清楚。
entries.answerPinyin: xíng li bèi kòu liú de huà, yào zhǎo hǎi guān rén yuán wèn qīng chǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: If your luggage is held, ask the customs officers about it.

entries.example: 她常常參加慈善活動。
entries.examplePinyin: tā cháng cháng cān jiā cí shàn huó dòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: She often takes part in charity events.
entries.question: 你參加過慈善活動嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān jiā guò cí shàn huó dòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever taken part in a charity event?
entries.answer: 參加過，我去年參加了慈善路跑。
entries.answerPinyin: cān jiā guò, wǒ qù nián cān jiā le cí shàn lù pǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I did a charity run last year.

entries.example: 這副耳機的立體聲效果很好。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè fù ěr jī de lì tǐ shēng xiào guǒ hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: These headphones have great stereo sound.
entries.question: 你聽音樂在意立體聲效果嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tīng yīn yuè zài yì lì tǐ shēng xiào guǒ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you care about stereo effects when listening to music?
entries.answer: 很在意，我喜歡立體聲效果好的耳機。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn zài yì, wǒ xǐ huan lì tǐ shēng xiào guǒ hǎo de ěr jī.
entries.answerEnglish: Very much; I like headphones with good stereo.

entries.example: 她從小就有氣喘。
entries.examplePinyin: tā cóng xiǎo jiù yǒu qì chuǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: She has had asthma since she was a child.
entries.question: 氣喘發作的時候應該怎麼辦？
entries.questionPinyin: qì chuǎn fā zuò de shí hòu yīng gāi zěn me bàn?
entries.questionEnglish: What should you do during an asthma attack?
entries.answer: 氣喘發作時要馬上用藥，再去看醫生。
entries.answerPinyin: qì chuǎn fā zuò shí yào mǎ shàng yòng yào, zài qù kàn yī shēng.
entries.answerEnglish: During an asthma attack, use your medicine right away, then see a doctor.

entries.example: 這個價錢便宜得難以置信。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge jià qián pián yi de nán yǐ zhì xìn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This price is unbelievably cheap.
entries.question: 你在台灣遇過難以置信的事嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān yù guò nán yǐ zhì xìn de shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has anything unbelievable happened to you in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我掉了錢包又找回來，真是難以置信。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ diào le qián bāo yòu zhǎo huí lái, zhēn shì nán yǐ zhì xìn.
entries.answerEnglish: I lost my wallet and got it back. Unbelievable.

entries.example: 颱風快來了，天氣開始惡化。
entries.examplePinyin: tái fēng kuài lái le, tiān qì kāi shǐ è huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: The typhoon is coming and the weather is getting worse.
entries.question: 你覺得台北的交通惡化了嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái běi de jiāo tōng è huà le ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taipei's traffic has got worse?
entries.answer: 對，我覺得最近交通惡化了很多。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ jué de zuì jìn jiāo tōng è huà le hěn duō.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I think traffic has got a lot worse lately.

entries.example: 把這個旋鈕往右轉，聲音就會變大。
entries.examplePinyin: bǎ zhè ge xuán niǔ wǎng yòu zhuǎn, shēng yīn jiù huì biàn dà.
entries.exampleEnglish: Turn this knob to the right and the volume goes up.
entries.question: 你家的瓦斯爐有旋鈕嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de wǎ sī lú yǒu xuán niǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your gas stove have knobs?
entries.answer: 有，轉一下旋鈕就能開火。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, zhuǎn yí xià xuán niǔ jiù néng kāi huǒ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, just turn the knob to light it.

entries.example: 這家麵包店的酥皮很香。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā miàn bāo diàn de sū pí hěn xiāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This bakery's flaky pastry smells wonderful.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃有酥皮的點心嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī yǒu sū pí de diǎn xīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like snacks made with flaky pastry?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我最愛吃酥皮蛋塔。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ zuì ài chī sū pí dàn tǎ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love flaky egg tarts most.

entries.example: 這棟老房子下個月要拆除。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè dòng lǎo fáng zi xià gè yuè yào chāi chú.
entries.exampleEnglish: This old building will be demolished next month.
entries.question: 你覺得老房子應該拆除嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de lǎo fáng zi yīng gāi chāi chú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think old buildings should be demolished?
entries.answer: 我覺得有歷史的老房子不應該拆除。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de yǒu lì shǐ de lǎo fáng zi bú yīng gāi chāi chú.
entries.answerEnglish: I think historic old buildings shouldn't be demolished.

entries.example: 他把魚餌掛在魚鉤上。
entries.examplePinyin: tā bǎ yú ěr guà zài yú gōu shàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: He put the bait on the hook.
entries.question: 你去釣魚會用什麼魚餌？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù diào yú huì yòng shén me yú ěr?
entries.questionEnglish: What bait do you use when you go fishing?
entries.answer: 我常用蝦子當魚餌。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ cháng yòng xiā zi dàng yú ěr.
entries.answerEnglish: I often use shrimp as bait.

entries.example: 我的老闆每天都精力充沛。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de lǎo bǎn měi tiān dōu jīng lì chōng pèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: My boss is full of energy every day.
entries.question: 你一天中什麼時候最精力充沛？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yì tiān zhōng shén me shí hòu zuì jīng lì chōng pèi?
entries.questionEnglish: When in the day are you most energetic?
entries.answer: 我早上喝完咖啡最精力充沛。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zǎo shàng hē wán kā fēi zuì jīng lì chōng pèi.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm most energetic in the morning after coffee.

entries.example: 這棟房子是戰後蓋的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè dòng fáng zi shì zhàn hòu gài de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This house was built after the war.
entries.question: 你知道台灣戰後的歷史嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào tái wān zhàn hòu de lì shǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know Taiwan's postwar history?
entries.answer: 知道一點，戰後台灣經濟發展很快。
entries.answerPinyin: zhī dào yì diǎn, zhàn hòu tái wān jīng jì fā zhǎn hěn kuài.
entries.answerEnglish: A little; Taiwan's economy grew fast after the war.

entries.example: 請把瓶子直立放好，不然會漏。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng bǎ píng zi zhí lì fàng hǎo, bù rán huì lòu.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please keep the bottle upright or it will leak.
entries.question: 你習慣把書直立放在書架上嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xí guàn bǎ shū zhí lì fàng zài shū jià shàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you usually stand your books upright on the shelf?
entries.answer: 對，我都把書直立放好。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ dōu bǎ shū zhí lì fàng hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always stand them upright.

entries.example: 這些家具用貨運送到台中。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè xiē jiā jù yòng huò yùn sòng dào tái zhōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This furniture is being shipped to Taichung by freight.
entries.question: 你寄大東西會用貨運嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jì dà dōng xī huì yòng huò yùn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use freight shipping for large items?
entries.answer: 會，我寄冰箱的時候用了貨運。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ jì bīng xiāng de shí hòu yòng le huò yùn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I used freight when I sent a fridge.

entries.example: 每年冬天，很多鳥會遷移到台灣。
entries.examplePinyin: měi nián dōng tiān, hěn duō niǎo huì qiān yí dào tái wān.
entries.exampleEnglish: Every winter, many birds migrate to Taiwan.
entries.question: 你知道哪些動物會遷移嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào nǎ xiē dòng wù huì qiān yí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Which animals do you know that migrate?
entries.answer: 我知道鯨魚和很多鳥都會遷移。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhī dào jīng yú hé hěn duō niǎo dōu huì qiān yí.
entries.answerEnglish: I know whales and many birds migrate.

entries.example: 寶寶一看到媽媽就咯咯笑。
entries.examplePinyin: bǎo bao yí kàn dào mā ma jiù gē gē xiào.

entries.question: 什麼事會讓你咯咯笑？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shì huì ràng nǐ gē gē xiào?
entries.questionEnglish: What makes you giggle?
entries.answer: 看搞笑影片會讓我咯咯笑。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn gǎo xiào yǐng piàn huì ràng wǒ gē gē xiào.
entries.answerEnglish: Funny videos make me giggle.

entries.example: 台灣的郵政服務很方便。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān de yóu zhèng fú wù hěn fāng biàn.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng shǐ yòng yóu zhèng fú wù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often use the postal service?
entries.answer: 常用，台灣的郵政服務又快又便宜。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng yòng, tái wān de yóu zhèng fú wù yòu kuài yòu pián yi.
entries.answerEnglish: Often; Taiwan's postal service is fast and cheap.

entries.example: 這家店的衣服都是批發來的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn de yī fu dōu shì pī fā lái de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop's clothes are all bought wholesale.
entries.question: 你去過批發市場買東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò pī fā shì chǎng mǎi dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you shopped at a wholesale market?
entries.answer: 去過，我在五分埔批發市場買過衣服。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, wǒ zài wǔ fēn pǔ pī fā shì chǎng mǎi guò yī fu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I bought clothes at the Wufenpu wholesale market.

entries.example: 三月的陽明山櫻花盛開。
entries.examplePinyin: sān yuè de yáng míng shān yīng huā shèng kāi.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan qù kàn huā shèng kāi de dì fāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like visiting places where flowers are in bloom?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我每年都去看櫻花盛開。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ měi nián dōu qù kàn yīng huā shèng kāi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, every year I go to see the cherry blossoms in bloom.

entries.example: 大家都來祝賀他升職。
entries.examplePinyin: dà jiā dōu lái zhù hè tā shēng zhí.

entries.questionPinyin: péng yǒu jié hūn shí, nǐ huì zěn me zhù hè?

entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì bāo hóng bāo zhù hè tā men.
entries.answerEnglish: I give them a red envelope to congratulate them.

entries.example: 他賣了房子，變成百萬富翁。
entries.examplePinyin: tā mài le fáng zi, biàn chéng bǎi wàn fù wēng.

entries.question: 如果你是百萬富翁，你想做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ nǐ shì bǎi wàn fù wēng, nǐ xiǎng zuò shén me?

entries.answer: 如果我是百萬富翁，我想環遊世界。
entries.answerPinyin: rú guǒ wǒ shì bǎi wàn fù wēng, wǒ xiǎng huán yóu shì jiè.
entries.answerEnglish: If I were a millionaire, I'd travel around the world.

entries.example: 這場比賽有一百位參賽者。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè chǎng bǐ sài yǒu yì bǎi wèi cān sài zhě.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dāng guò bǐ sài de cān sài zhě ma?

entries.answer: 當過，我是路跑比賽的參賽者。
entries.answerPinyin: dāng guò, wǒ shì lù pǎo bǐ sài de cān sài zhě.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I was a runner in a road race.

entries.example: 這個消息來源很可信。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge xiāo xí lái yuán hěn kě xìn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This source is very credible.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de wǎng lù xīn wén kě xìn ma?

entries.answerEnglish: Some is credible and some isn't.

entries.example: 台北有一座很大的清真寺。
entries.examplePinyin: tái běi yǒu yí zuò hěn dà de qīng zhēn sì.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a big mosque in Taipei.
entries.question: 你去過台北的清真寺嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò tái běi de qīng zhēn sì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to the mosque in Taipei?
entries.answer: 去過，台北清真寺很漂亮。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, tái běi qīng zhēn sì hěn piào liang.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the Taipei mosque is beautiful.

entries.example: 這條老街鋪著石板。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tiáo lǎo jiē pū zhe shí bǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This old street is paved with stone slabs.
entries.question: 你喜歡走石板路嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zǒu shí bǎn lù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like walking on stone-paved roads?
entries.answer: 喜歡，石板路很有古早味。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, shí bǎn lù hěn yǒu gǔ zǎo wèi.

entries.examplePinyin: nà wèi jiàn shēn jiào liàn jī ròu fā dá.
