entries.question: 你想變得肌肉發達嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng biàn de jī ròu fā dá ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to become muscular?
entries.answer: 想，我希望自己肌肉發達一點。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, wǒ xī wàng zì jǐ jī ròu fā dá yì diǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to be a bit more muscular.

entries.example: 颱風來之前，居民都撤離了。
entries.examplePinyin: tái fēng lái zhī qián, jū mín dōu chè lí le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The residents all evacuated before the typhoon came.
entries.question: 火災時應該怎麼撤離大樓？
entries.questionPinyin: huǒ zāi shí yīng gāi zěn me chè lí dà lóu?
entries.questionEnglish: How should you evacuate a building in a fire?
entries.answer: 要走樓梯撤離，不要搭電梯。
entries.answerPinyin: yào zǒu lóu tī chè lí, bú yào dā diàn tī.
entries.answerEnglish: Evacuate by the stairs, not the elevator.

entries.example: 這張照片是合成的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhāng zhào piàn shì hé chéng de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This photo is a composite.
entries.question: 你會用手機合成照片嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì yòng shǒu jī hé chéng zhào piàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you combine photos on your phone?
entries.answer: 會，我常用軟體合成照片。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng yòng ruǎn tǐ hé chéng zhào piàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often combine photos with an app.

entries.example: 這部漫畫在網路上連載。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù màn huà zài wǎng lù shang lián zǎi.
entries.exampleEnglish: This comic is serialized online.
entries.question: 你有在追連載的漫畫嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu zài zhuī lián zǎi de màn huà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you following any serialized comics?
entries.answer: 有，我每週都看一部連載的漫畫。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ měi zhōu dōu kàn yí bù lián zǎi de màn huà.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I read a serialized comic every week.

entries.example: 前面的機車突然超車。
entries.examplePinyin: qián miàn de jī chē tú rán chāo chē.
entries.exampleEnglish: The scooter in front suddenly overtook.
entries.question: 你開車時常常超車嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kāi chē shí cháng cháng chāo chē ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often overtake when you drive?
entries.answer: 不常，我覺得超車很危險。
entries.answerPinyin: bù cháng, wǒ jué de chāo chē hěn wéi xiǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Not often; I think overtaking is dangerous.

entries.example: 這家網店說明天會出貨。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā wǎng diàn shuō míng tiān huì chū huò.
entries.exampleEnglish: This online shop says it will ship tomorrow.
entries.question: 你網購的時候在意多快出貨嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ wǎng gòu de shí hòu zài yì duō kuài chū huò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you shop online, do you care how fast items ship?
entries.answer: 在意，我希望店家當天就出貨。
entries.answerPinyin: zài yì, wǒ xī wàng diàn jiā dàng tiān jiù chū huò.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I hope the seller ships the same day.

entries.example: 孩子們很喜歡海盜的故事。
entries.examplePinyin: hái zi men hěn xǐ huan hǎi dào de gù shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Kids love pirate stories.
entries.question: 你小時候喜歡看海盜電影嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu xǐ huan kàn hǎi dào diàn yǐng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you like pirate movies as a child?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我最愛看海盜電影。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ zuì ài kàn hǎi dào diàn yǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, pirate movies were my favorite.

entries.example: 蠟燭的蠟滴到桌上了。
entries.examplePinyin: là zhú de là dī dào zhuō shàng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: Candle wax dripped onto the table.
entries.question: 你會幫車子打蠟嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì bāng chē zi dǎ là ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you wax your car?
entries.answer: 會，我每個月幫車子打一次蠟。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi gè yuè bāng chē zi dǎ yí cì là.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I wax my car once a month.

entries.example: 我買了一個手機支架。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ mǎi le yí gè shǒu jī zhī jià.
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a phone stand.
entries.question: 你開車時會用手機支架嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kāi chē shí huì yòng shǒu jī zhī jià ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use a phone holder when driving?
entries.answer: 會，我用支架看導航。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ yòng zhī jià kàn dǎo háng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I use a holder to see the GPS.

entries.example: 我們在酒吧玩飛鏢。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zài jiǔ bā wán fēi biāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: We played darts at the bar.
entries.question: 你玩過射飛鏢嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ wán guò shè fēi biāo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever played darts?
entries.answer: 玩過，但我射飛鏢不太準。
entries.answerPinyin: wán guò, dàn wǒ shè fēi biāo bú tài zhǔn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but I'm not very accurate at darts.

entries.example: 海浪拍打著岩石。
entries.examplePinyin: hǎi làng pāi dǎ zhe yán shí.
entries.exampleEnglish: The waves are beating against the rocks.
entries.question: 你按摩時喜歡別人拍打背嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ àn mó shí xǐ huan bié rén pāi dǎ bèi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: During a massage, do you like having your back patted?
entries.answer: 喜歡，輕輕拍打很舒服。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, qīng qīng pāi dǎ hěn shū fú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, gentle patting feels great.

entries.example: 工作上遇到挫折不要放棄。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng zuò shàng yù dào cuò zhé bú yào fàng qì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Don't give up when you hit setbacks at work.
entries.question: 你學中文遇過什麼挫折？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xué zhōng wén yù guò shén me cuò zhé?
entries.questionEnglish: What setbacks have you had learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 聲調是我最大的挫折。
entries.answerPinyin: shēng diào shì wǒ zuì dà de cuò zhé.
entries.answerEnglish: Tones are my biggest frustration.

entries.example: 輪到你洗牌了。
entries.examplePinyin: lún dào nǐ xǐ pái le.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's your turn to shuffle.
entries.question: 你玩撲克牌時會洗牌嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ wán pū kè pái shí huì xǐ pái ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you shuffle when you play cards?
entries.answer: 會，我洗牌洗得很快。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ xǐ pái xǐ de hěn kuài.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I shuffle really fast.

entries.example: 我不想挨餓，所以帶了零食。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng ái è, suǒ yǐ dài le líng shí.
entries.exampleEnglish: I didn't want to go hungry, so I brought snacks.
entries.question: 你減肥的時候會挨餓嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiǎn féi de shí hòu huì ái è ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you go hungry when you're dieting?
entries.answer: 不會，我不喜歡挨餓。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ bù xǐ huan ái è.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't like going hungry.

entries.example: 烤肉的時候用鋁箔包玉米。
entries.examplePinyin: kǎo ròu de shí hòu yòng lǚ bó bāo yù mǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Wrap the corn in foil at the barbecue.
entries.question: 你烤東西會用鋁箔紙嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kǎo dōng xī huì yòng lǚ bó zhǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use foil when you grill or bake?
entries.answer: 會，我用鋁箔紙包魚來烤。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ yòng lǚ bó zhǐ bāo yú lái kǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I wrap fish in foil to grill it.

entries.example: 球迷一直高喊球員的名字。
entries.examplePinyin: qiú mí yì zhí gāo hǎn qiú yuán de míng zì.
entries.exampleEnglish: The fans kept chanting the player's name.
entries.question: 看球賽的時候你會高喊加油嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: kàn qiú sài de shí hòu nǐ huì gāo hǎn jiā yóu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you shout and cheer at ball games?
entries.answer: 會，我常常跟大家一起高喊加油。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng cháng gēn dà jiā yì qǐ gāo hǎn jiā yóu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often shout and cheer with everyone.

entries.example: 總統的車隊剛剛經過這條路。
entries.examplePinyin: zǒng tǒng de chē duì gāng gāng jīng guò zhè tiáo lù.
entries.exampleEnglish: The president's motorcade just passed along this road.
entries.question: 你在路上看過結婚的車隊嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài lù shang kàn guò jié hūn de chē duì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a wedding convoy on the road?
entries.answer: 看過，結婚的車隊都很漂亮。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, jié hūn de chē duì dōu hěn piào liang.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, wedding convoys are always pretty.

entries.example: 超人穿著紅色的披風。
entries.examplePinyin: chāo rén chuān zhe hóng sè de pī fēng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Superman wears a red cape.
entries.question: 你小時候穿過披風扮超人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu chuān guò pī fēng bàn chāo rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you ever wear a cape to dress up as Superman as a kid?
entries.answer: 穿過，我很喜歡那件紅披風。
entries.answerPinyin: chuān guò, wǒ hěn xǐ huan nà jiàn hóng pī fēng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I loved that red cape.

entries.example: 釘子刺穿了我的鞋底。
entries.examplePinyin: dīng zi cì chuān le wǒ de xié dǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: A nail pierced the sole of my shoe.
entries.question: 騎車時輪胎被刺穿要怎麼辦？
entries.questionPinyin: qí chē shí lún tāi bèi cì chuān yào zěn me bàn?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do if your tire is punctured while riding?
entries.answer: 輪胎被刺穿的話，要去機車行補胎。
entries.answerPinyin: lún tāi bèi cì chuān de huà, yào qù jī chē háng bǔ tāi.
entries.answerEnglish: If the tire is punctured, go to a scooter shop to patch it.

entries.example: 我們在機場跟朋友道別。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zài jī chǎng gēn péng yǒu dào bié.
entries.exampleEnglish: We said goodbye to our friends at the airport.
entries.question: 你離開家鄉的時候跟誰道別？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ lí kāi jiā xiāng de shí hòu gēn shéi dào bié?
entries.questionEnglish: Who did you say goodbye to when you left home?
entries.answer: 我跟家人和朋友道別。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ gēn jiā rén hé péng yǒu dào bié.
entries.answerEnglish: I said goodbye to my family and friends.

entries.example: 博物館裡有一輛老火車頭。
entries.examplePinyin: bó wù guǎn lǐ yǒu yí liàng lǎo huǒ chē tóu.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's an old locomotive in the museum.
entries.question: 你看過蒸汽火車頭嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò zhēng qì huǒ chē tóu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a steam locomotive?
entries.answer: 看過，我在集集看過老火車頭。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài jí jí kàn guò lǎo huǒ chē tóu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw an old locomotive in Jiji.

entries.example: 玩遊戲機要先換代幣。
entries.examplePinyin: wán yóu xì jī yào xiān huàn dài bì.
entries.exampleEnglish: You have to get tokens before playing the arcade machines.
entries.question: 你玩過要用代幣的遊戲機嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ wán guò yào yòng dài bì de yóu xì jī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you played arcade games that take tokens?
entries.answer: 玩過，夜市的遊戲機要用代幣。
entries.answerPinyin: wán guò, yè shì de yóu xì jī yào yòng dài bì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the games at night markets take tokens.

entries.example: 牧羊人帶著羊上山。
entries.examplePinyin: mù yáng rén dài zhe yáng shàng shān.
entries.exampleEnglish: The shepherd takes the sheep up the mountain.
entries.question: 你的國家還有牧羊人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā hái yǒu mù yáng rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there still shepherds in your country?
entries.answer: 有，鄉下還有一些牧羊人。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, xiāng xià hái yǒu yì xiē mù yáng rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are still some shepherds in the countryside.

entries.example: 他寫了一本自傳。
entries.examplePinyin: tā xiě le yì běn zì zhuàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He wrote an autobiography.
entries.question: 你喜歡看名人的自傳嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kàn míng rén de zì zhuàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like reading celebrities' autobiographies?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我最近在看一本自傳。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ zuì jìn zài kàn yì běn zì zhuàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm reading an autobiography right now.

entries.example: 他為了躲避記者，從後門離開。
entries.examplePinyin: tā wèi le duǒ bì jì zhě, cóng hòu mén lí kāi.
entries.exampleEnglish: He left by the back door to dodge reporters.
entries.question: 你小時候玩過躲避球嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu wán guò duǒ bì qiú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you play dodgeball as a kid?
entries.answer: 玩過，我很愛玩躲避球。
entries.answerPinyin: wán guò, wǒ hěn ài wán duǒ bì qiú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I loved playing dodgeball.

entries.example: 那個店員的態度很傲慢。
entries.examplePinyin: nà ge diàn yuán de tài dù hěn ào màn.
entries.exampleEnglish: That shop assistant's attitude was very arrogant.
entries.question: 你遇過傲慢的人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yù guò ào màn de rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever met an arrogant person?
entries.answer: 遇過，我以前的主管很傲慢。
entries.answerPinyin: yù guò, wǒ yǐ qián de zhǔ guǎn hěn ào màn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my former supervisor was very arrogant.

entries.example: 那位國會議員明天要訪問台灣。
entries.examplePinyin: nà wèi guó huì yì yuán míng tiān yào fǎng wèn tái wān.
entries.exampleEnglish: That congressman will visit Taiwan tomorrow.
entries.question: 你知道你們那區的國會議員是誰嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào nǐ men nà qū de guó huì yì yuán shì shéi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know who your area's member of parliament is?
entries.answer: 知道，我們那區的國會議員很年輕。
entries.answerPinyin: zhī dào, wǒ men nà qū de guó huì yì yuán hěn nián qīng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our area's representative is very young.

entries.example: 這幅畫是他的傑作。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè fú huà shì tā de jié zuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: This painting is his masterpiece.
entries.question: 你覺得哪部電影是傑作？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǎ bù diàn yǐng shì jié zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: Which film do you think is a masterpiece?
entries.answer: 我覺得《神隱少女》是一部傑作。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de 《 shén yǐn shào nǚ 》 shì yí bù jié zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: I think Spirited Away is a masterpiece.

entries.example: 這張桌子是橢圓的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhāng zhuō zi shì tuǒ yuán de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This table is oval.
entries.question: 你喜歡圓形還是橢圓形的鏡子？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan yuán xíng hái shì tuǒ yuán xíng de jìng zi?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer round or oval mirrors?
entries.answer: 我喜歡橢圓形的鏡子。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan tuǒ yuán xíng de jìng zi.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer oval mirrors.

entries.example: 我在陽台的花上加了一點肥料。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài yáng tái de huā shàng jiā le yì diǎn féi liào.
entries.exampleEnglish: I added some fertilizer to the flowers on the balcony.
entries.question: 你種植物會用肥料嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhòng zhí wù huì yòng féi liào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use fertilizer for your plants?
entries.answer: 會，我每個月放一次肥料。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi gè yuè fàng yí cì féi liào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I add fertilizer once a month.

entries.example: 我每週刷洗一次浴室。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi zhōu shuā xǐ yí cì yù shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: I scrub the bathroom once a week.
entries.question: 你多久刷洗一次浴室？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duō jiǔ shuā xǐ yí cì yù shì?
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you scrub your bathroom?
entries.answer: 我每兩週刷洗一次浴室。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ měi liǎng zhōu shuā xǐ yí cì yù shì.
entries.answerEnglish: I scrub the bathroom every two weeks.

entries.example: 新聞說有個商人被綁架了。
entries.examplePinyin: xīn wén shuō yǒu gè shāng rén bèi bǎng jià le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The news said a businessman was kidnapped.
entries.question: 遇到綁架案要打幾號報警？
entries.questionPinyin: yù dào bǎng jià àn yào dǎ jǐ hào bào jǐng?
entries.questionEnglish: What number do you call to report a kidnapping?
entries.answer: 遇到綁架要馬上打110報警。
entries.answerPinyin: yù dào bǎng jià yào mǎ shàng dǎ 110 bào jǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: For a kidnapping, call 110 right away.

entries.example: 這根柱子支撐著整個屋頂。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè gēn zhù zi zhī chēng zhe zhěng gè wū dǐng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This pillar holds up the whole roof.
entries.question: 工作很累的時候，是什麼支撐著你？
entries.questionPinyin: gōng zuò hěn lèi de shí hòu, shì shén me zhī chēng zhe nǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: When work is exhausting, what keeps you going?
entries.answer: 家人的鼓勵一直支撐著我。
entries.answerPinyin: jiā rén de gǔ lì yì zhí zhī chēng zhe wǒ.
entries.answerEnglish: My family's encouragement keeps me going.

entries.example: 人民開始反抗不公平的法律。
entries.examplePinyin: rén mín kāi shǐ fǎn kàng bù gōng píng de fǎ lǜ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The people began to resist the unfair laws.
entries.question: 你小時候會反抗父母嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu huì fǎn kàng fù mǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you rebel against your parents as a child?
entries.answer: 會，我青春期常常反抗父母。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ qīng chūn qí cháng cháng fǎn kàng fù mǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, as a teenager I often rebelled against my parents.

entries.example: 湯裡加一小撮鹽就好。
entries.examplePinyin: tāng lǐ jiā yì xiǎo cuō yán jiù hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Just add a pinch of salt to the soup.
entries.question: 你煮菜的時候會加一小撮糖嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhǔ cài de shí hòu huì jiā yì xiǎo cuō táng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you add a pinch of sugar when you cook?
entries.answer: 會，我炒菜會加一小撮糖。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ chǎo cài huì jiā yì xiǎo cuō táng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I add a pinch of sugar when stir-frying.

entries.example: 我的工作時間很不規則。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de gōng zuò shí jiān hěn bù guī zé.
entries.exampleEnglish: My working hours are very irregular.
entries.question: 你的上班時間規則嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de shàng bān shí jiān guī zé ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are your working hours regular?
entries.answer: 很不規則，常常要加班。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn bù guī zé, cháng cháng yào jiā bān.
entries.answerEnglish: Very irregular; I often work overtime.

entries.example: 面試前我們先模擬一次。
entries.examplePinyin: miàn shì qián wǒ men xiān mó nǐ yí cì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's do a mock run before the interview.
entries.question: 考駕照前你做過模擬考嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: kǎo jià zhào qián nǐ zuò guò mó nǐ kǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you take mock tests before your driving test?
entries.answer: 做過，我做了很多次模擬考。
entries.answerPinyin: zuò guò, wǒ zuò le hěn duō cì mó nǐ kǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I did lots of mock tests.

entries.example: 我爸媽年輕時常去跳迪斯可。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bà mā nián qīng shí cháng qù tiào dí sī kě.
entries.exampleEnglish: My parents often went disco dancing when they were young.
entries.question: 你喜歡迪斯可音樂嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan dí sī kě yīn yuè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like disco music?
entries.answer: 喜歡，迪斯可音樂很適合跳舞。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, dí sī kě yīn yuè hěn shì hé tiào wǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, disco music is great for dancing.

entries.example: 這兩個會議的時間重疊了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè liǎng gè huì yì de shí jiān chóng dié le.
entries.exampleEnglish: These two meetings overlap.
entries.question: 你的工作和上課時間會重疊嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng zuò hé shàng kè shí jiān huì chóng dié ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do your work hours and class times overlap?
entries.answer: 有時候會重疊，所以很忙。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu huì chóng dié, suǒ yǐ hěn máng.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes they overlap, so I'm busy.

entries.example: 我撞到桌子，腳瘀青了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zhuàng dào zhuō zi, jiǎo yū qīng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: I bumped into the table and bruised my leg.
entries.question: 瘀青的時候你會冰敷嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: yū qīng de shí hòu nǐ huì bīng fū ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you put ice on a bruise?
entries.answer: 會，瘀青先冰敷比較好。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, yū qīng xiān bīng fū bǐ jiào hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, it's better to ice a bruise first.

entries.example: 只是一隻小蟲，別大驚小怪。
entries.examplePinyin: zhǐ shì yì zhī xiǎo chóng, bié dà jīng xiǎo guài.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's only a little bug; don't make a fuss.
entries.question: 你會為了小事大驚小怪嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì wèi le xiǎo shì dà jīng xiǎo guài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you make a fuss over little things?
entries.answer: 不會，我很少大驚小怪。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ hěn shǎo dà jīng xiǎo guài.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I rarely make a fuss.

entries.example: 她對下屬很好。
entries.examplePinyin: tā duì xià shǔ hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: She treats her staff very well.
entries.question: 你在公司有下屬嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài gōng sī yǒu xià shǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have people reporting to you at work?
entries.answer: 有，我有三個下屬。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ yǒu sān gè xià shǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have three people under me.

entries.example: 安平古堡有好幾門大砲。
entries.examplePinyin: ān píng gǔ bǎo yǒu hǎo jǐ mén dà pào.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are several cannons at Anping Fort.
entries.question: 你在古蹟看過大砲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài gǔ jī kàn guò dà pào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen cannons at historic sites?
entries.answer: 看過，我在安平古堡看過大砲。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài ān píng gǔ bǎo kàn guò dà pào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw cannons at Anping Fort.

entries.example: 她發現有人一直跟蹤她。
entries.examplePinyin: tā fā xiàn yǒu rén yì zhí gēn zōng tā.
entries.exampleEnglish: She noticed someone kept following her.
entries.question: 發現被跟蹤的時候該怎麼辦？
entries.questionPinyin: fā xiàn bèi gēn zōng de shí hòu gāi zěn me bàn?
entries.questionEnglish: What should someone do if they notice they're being followed?
entries.answer: 發現被跟蹤要去人多的地方，然後報警。
entries.answerPinyin: fā xiàn bèi gēn zōng yào qù rén duō de dì fāng, rán hòu bào jǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: If you're being followed, go somewhere crowded, then call the police.

entries.example: 公司派出兩個人去台中出差。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng sī pài chū liǎng gè rén qù tái zhōng chū chāi.
entries.exampleEnglish: The company sent two people to Taichung on business.
entries.question: 你的公司常派員工出國嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng sī cháng pài yuán gōng chū guó ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company often send staff abroad?
entries.answer: 會，公司去年派出十個人去日本。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, gōng sī qù nián pài chū shí gè rén qù rì běn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the company sent ten people to Japan last year.

entries.example: 馬路兩側都是小吃攤。
entries.examplePinyin: mǎ lù liǎng cè dōu shì xiǎo chī tān.
entries.exampleEnglish: Both sides of the road are lined with food stalls.
entries.question: 你家附近的路兩邊有什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn de lù liǎng biān yǒu shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's on either side of the road near your home?
entries.answer: 路的兩側有很多樹。
entries.answerPinyin: lù de liǎng cè yǒu hěn duō shù.
entries.answerEnglish: There are lots of trees on both sides of the road.

entries.example: 把麵糊倒進鍋子裡做鬆餅。
entries.examplePinyin: bǎ miàn hù dǎo jìn guō zi lǐ zuò sōng bǐng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Pour the batter into the pan to make pancakes.
entries.question: 你會自己做鬆餅麵糊嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zì jǐ zuò sōng bǐng miàn hù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you make your own pancake batter?
entries.answer: 會，我用蛋和麵粉做麵糊。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ yòng dàn hé miàn fěn zuò miàn hù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I make batter with eggs and flour.

entries.example: 我哥哥對天文學很有興趣。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ gē ge duì tiān wén xué hěn yǒu xìng qù.
entries.exampleEnglish: My brother is very interested in astronomy.
entries.question: 你對天文學有興趣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì tiān wén xué yǒu xìng qù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you interested in astronomy?
entries.answer: 有，我喜歡看星星，也喜歡天文學。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ xǐ huan kàn xīng xīng, yě xǐ huan tiān wén xué.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like stargazing and astronomy.

entries.example: 太魯閣的山非常雄偉。
entries.examplePinyin: tài lǔ gé de shān fēi cháng xióng wěi.
entries.exampleEnglish: The mountains at Taroko are truly majestic.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣哪裡的風景最雄偉？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān nǎ lǐ de fēng jǐng zuì xióng wěi?
entries.questionEnglish: Where in Taiwan do you think the scenery is most majestic?
entries.answer: 我覺得太魯閣最雄偉。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de tài lǔ gé zuì xióng wěi.
entries.answerEnglish: I think Taroko is the most majestic.

entries.example: 這艘客輪從基隆開到馬祖。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè sāo kè lún cóng jī lóng kāi dào mǎ zǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: This passenger ship sails from Keelung to Matsu.
entries.question: 你坐過客輪嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò guò kè lún ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever taken a passenger ship?
entries.answer: 坐過，我坐客輪去過澎湖。
entries.answerPinyin: zuò guò, wǒ zuò kè lún qù guò péng hú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I took a ship to Penghu.

entries.example: 他說話的態度很誠懇。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shuō huà de tài dù hěn chéng kěn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He speaks very sincerely.
entries.question: 你喜歡什麼樣的朋友？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan shén me yàng de péng yǒu?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of friends do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡誠懇的朋友，讓我很放心。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan chéng kěn de péng yǒu, ràng wǒ hěn fàng xīn.
entries.answerEnglish: I like sincere friends; I feel I can trust them.

entries.example: 他的老闆很冷酷，從來不笑。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de lǎo bǎn hěn lěng kù, cóng lái bú xiào.
entries.exampleEnglish: His boss is cold and never smiles.
entries.question: 你喜歡電影裡冷酷的角色嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan diàn yǐng lǐ lěng kù de jué sè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like cold, ruthless characters in films?
entries.answer: 喜歡，冷酷的角色很有魅力。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, lěng kù de jué sè hěn yǒu mèi lì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, cold characters are really charismatic.

entries.example: 這家公司一年賺超過一兆元。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā gōng sī yì nián zhuàn chāo guò yí zhào yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: This company earns over a trillion dollars a year.
entries.question: 你知道一兆後面有幾個零嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào yí zhào hòu miàn yǒu jǐ gè líng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know how many zeros a trillion has?
entries.answer: 一兆後面有十二個零。
entries.answerPinyin: yí zhào hòu miàn yǒu shí èr gè líng.
entries.answerEnglish: A trillion has twelve zeros.

entries.example: 公司動員所有員工一起打掃。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng sī dòng yuán suǒ yǒu yuán gōng yì qǐ dǎ sǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: The company mobilized all its staff to clean up together.
entries.question: 你們社區會動員大家做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men shè qū huì dòng yuán dà jiā zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What does your community mobilize everyone to do?
entries.answer: 我們社區會動員大家一起掃街。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men shè qū huì dòng yuán dà jiā yì qǐ sǎo jiē.
entries.answerEnglish: Our community gets everyone out to sweep the streets.

entries.example: 天氣太熱，讓人很煩躁。
entries.examplePinyin: tiān qì tài rè, ràng rén hěn fán zào.
entries.exampleEnglish: The heat makes people irritable.
entries.question: 什麼事會讓你覺得煩躁？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shì huì ràng nǐ jué de fán zào?
entries.questionEnglish: What makes you feel irritated?
entries.answer: 塞車會讓我很煩躁。
entries.answerPinyin: sāi chē huì ràng wǒ hěn fán zào.
entries.answerEnglish: Traffic jams make me really irritated.

entries.example: 他從小就立志當醫生。
entries.examplePinyin: tā cóng xiǎo jiù lì zhì dāng yī shēng.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's aspired to be a doctor since childhood.
entries.question: 你小時候立志做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu lì zhì zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What did you aspire to be as a child?
entries.answer: 我小時候立志當老師。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎo shí hòu lì zhì dāng lǎo shī.
entries.answerEnglish: As a child I wanted to be a teacher.

entries.example: 平裝書比精裝書便宜。
entries.examplePinyin: píng zhuāng shū bǐ jīng zhuāng shū pián yi.
entries.exampleEnglish: Paperbacks are cheaper than hardcovers.
entries.question: 你比較常買平裝書還是精裝書？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bǐ jiào cháng mǎi píng zhuāng shū hái shì jīng zhuāng shū?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you usually buy paperbacks or hardcovers?
entries.answer: 我比較常買平裝書。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào cháng mǎi píng zhuāng shū.
entries.answerEnglish: I usually buy paperbacks.

entries.example: 石油價格又漲了。
entries.examplePinyin: shí yóu jià gé yòu zhǎng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: Oil prices have gone up again.
entries.question: 你覺得石油價格會影響生活嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shí yóu jià gé huì yǐng xiǎng shēng huó ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think oil prices affect daily life?
entries.answer: 會，石油一漲價，什麼都變貴。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, shí yóu yì zhǎng jià, shén me dōu biàn guì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when oil goes up, everything gets pricier.

entries.example: 我聽到蚊子的嗡嗡聲。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ tīng dào wén zi de wēng wēng shēng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I can hear a mosquito buzzing.
entries.question: 晚上聽到蚊子的聲音你會怎麼辦？
entries.questionPinyin: wǎn shàng tīng dào wén zi de shēng yīn nǐ huì zěn me bàn?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when you hear a mosquito at night?
entries.answer: 我會起來找蚊子，嗡嗡聲很吵。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì qǐ lái zhǎo wén zi, wēng wēng shēng hěn chǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: I get up to find it; the buzzing is so noisy.

entries.example: 我的房東脾氣有點古怪。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de fáng dōng pí qì yǒu diǎn gǔ guài.
entries.exampleEnglish: My landlord is a bit eccentric.
entries.question: 你身邊有古怪的朋友嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēn biān yǒu gǔ guài de péng yǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any eccentric friends?
entries.answer: 有，我有個朋友很古怪，但人很好。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ yǒu gè péng yǒu hěn gǔ guài, dàn rén hěn hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, one friend is eccentric but very nice.

entries.example: 比賽的勝利者可以拿到獎金。
entries.examplePinyin: bǐ sài de shèng lì zhě kě yǐ ná dào jiǎng jīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The winner of the contest gets prize money.
entries.question: 你玩遊戲常是勝利者嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ wán yóu xì cháng shì shèng lì zhě ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you often the winner when you play games?
entries.answer: 不一定，但我常是最後的勝利者。
entries.answerPinyin: bù yí dìng, dàn wǒ cháng shì zuì hòu de shèng lì zhě.
entries.answerEnglish: Not always, but I'm often the final winner.

entries.example: 我請裁縫幫我改褲子。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ qǐng cái feng bāng wǒ gǎi kù zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: I had a tailor alter my trousers.
entries.question: 你找過裁縫改衣服嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhǎo guò cái feng gǎi yī fu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had a tailor alter your clothes?
entries.answer: 找過，市場裡的裁縫改得很好。
entries.answerPinyin: zhǎo guò, shì chǎng lǐ de cái feng gǎi de hěn hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the tailor at the market did a great job.

entries.example: 他在一家大集團上班。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài yì jiā dà jí tuán shàng bān.
entries.exampleEnglish: He works for a big conglomerate.
entries.question: 你知道台灣有哪些大集團嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào tái wān yǒu nǎ xiē dà jí tuán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Which big business groups in Taiwan do you know?
entries.answer: 我知道台塑集團很有名。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhī dào tái sù jí tuán hěn yǒu míng.
entries.answerEnglish: I know the Formosa Plastics Group is famous.

entries.example: 很多人聚集在廣場看煙火。
entries.examplePinyin: hěn duō rén jù jí zài guǎng chǎng kàn yān huǒ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Lots of people gathered in the square to watch fireworks.
entries.question: 跨年的時候人們會聚集在哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: kuà nián de shí hòu rén men huì jù jí zài nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do people gather on New Year's Eve?
entries.answer: 很多人會聚集在台北101附近。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn duō rén huì jù jí zài tái běi 101 fù jìn.
entries.answerEnglish: Lots of people gather around Taipei 101.

entries.example: 這座樓梯是螺旋形的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zuò lóu tī shì luó xuán xíng de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This staircase is spiral-shaped.
entries.question: 你家有螺旋樓梯嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yǒu luó xuán lóu tī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a spiral staircase in your home?
entries.answer: 沒有，但我很喜歡螺旋樓梯。
entries.answerPinyin: méi yǒu, dàn wǒ hěn xǐ huan luó xuán lóu tī.
entries.answerEnglish: No, but I really like spiral staircases.

entries.example: 我們在公園架設了一個大螢幕。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zài gōng yuán jià shè le yí gè dà yíng mù.
entries.exampleEnglish: We set up a big screen in the park.
entries.question: 你自己架設過網站嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zì jǐ jià shè guò wǎng zhàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever set up a website yourself?
entries.answer: 架設過，我幫朋友的咖啡廳架設了網站。
entries.answerPinyin: jià shè guò, wǒ bāng péng yǒu de kā fēi tīng jià shè le wǎng zhàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I set up a website for my friend's café.

entries.example: 我爸很頑固，都不聽別人的意見。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bà hěn wán gù, dōu bù tīng bié rén de yì jiàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: My dad is very stubborn; he never listens to other people's opinions.
entries.question: 你家誰最頑固？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā shéi zuì wán gù?
entries.questionEnglish: Who is the most stubborn person in your family?
entries.answer: 我爺爺最頑固，他從來不肯用手機。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yé ye zuì wán gù, tā cóng lái bù kěn yòng shǒu jī.
entries.answerEnglish: My grandpa is the most stubborn; he refuses to ever use a phone.

entries.example: 我奶奶有關節炎，下雨天膝蓋會痛。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ nǎi nai yǒu guān jié yán, xià yǔ tiān xī gài huì tòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: My grandma has arthritis; her knees hurt on rainy days.
entries.question: 關節炎常常發生在什麼人身上？
entries.questionPinyin: guān jié yán cháng cháng fā shēng zài shén me rén shēn shàng?
entries.questionEnglish: Who usually gets arthritis?
entries.answer: 關節炎常常發生在年紀大的人身上。
entries.answerPinyin: guān jié yán cháng cháng fā shēng zài nián jì dà de rén shēn shàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Arthritis usually affects older people.

entries.example: 今天天空很陰沉，好像快下雨了。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn tiān tiān kōng hěn yīn chén, hǎo xiàng kuài xià yǔ le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The sky is gloomy today; it looks like it's about to rain.
entries.question: 天氣陰沉的時候，你心情好嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: tiān qì yīn chén de shí hòu, nǐ xīn qíng hǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you in a good mood when the weather is gloomy?
entries.answer: 不太好，天氣陰沉的時候我不想出門。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài hǎo, tiān qì yīn chén de shí hòu wǒ bù xiǎng chū mén.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. When it's gloomy I don't feel like going out.

entries.example: 恆春半島在台灣的最南邊。
entries.examplePinyin: héng chūn bàn dǎo zài tái wān de zuì nán biān.
entries.exampleEnglish: The Hengchun Peninsula is at the southern tip of Taiwan.
entries.question: 你去過哪個半島玩？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò nǎ gè bàn dǎo wán?
entries.questionEnglish: Which peninsula have you visited?
entries.answer: 我去過恆春半島，那裡的海很漂亮。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qù guò héng chūn bàn dǎo, nà lǐ de hǎi hěn piào liang.
entries.answerEnglish: I've been to the Hengchun Peninsula; the sea there is beautiful.

entries.example: 工地有一台很高的起重機。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng dì yǒu yì tái hěn gāo de qǐ zhòng jī.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a very tall crane at the construction site.
entries.question: 你家附近有起重機在蓋大樓嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn yǒu qǐ zhòng jī zài gài dà lóu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there cranes building something near your home?
entries.answer: 有，對面的工地有兩台起重機。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, duì miàn de gōng dì yǒu liǎng tái qǐ zhòng jī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the construction site across the street has two cranes.

entries.example: 農夫春天在田裡播種。
entries.examplePinyin: nóng fū chūn tiān zài tián lǐ bò zhǒng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Farmers sow seeds in the fields in spring.
entries.question: 你在陽台播種過什麼植物嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài yáng tái bò zhǒng guò shén me zhí wù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever sown any plants on your balcony?
entries.answer: 我播種過番茄，現在長得很高了。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bò zhǒng guò fān qié, xiàn zài zhǎng de hěn gāo le.
entries.answerEnglish: I've sown tomatoes, and now they've grown really tall.

entries.example: 他對員工很無情。
entries.examplePinyin: tā duì yuán gōng hěn wú qíng.
entries.exampleEnglish: He is ruthless toward his employees.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼樣的老闆很無情？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me yàng de lǎo bǎn hěn wú qíng?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of boss do you think is heartless?
entries.answer: 隨便開除員工的老闆很無情。
entries.answerPinyin: suí biàn kāi chú yuán gōng de lǎo bǎn hěn wú qíng.
entries.answerEnglish: A boss who fires people on a whim is heartless.

entries.example: 這次颱風沒有造成太大的損傷。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì tái fēng méi yǒu zào chéng tài dà de sǔn shāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This typhoon didn't cause much damage.
entries.question: 你覺得常滑手機會損傷眼睛嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de cháng huá shǒu jī huì sǔn shāng yǎn jīng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think using your phone a lot damages your eyes?
entries.answer: 會，一直看手機會損傷眼睛。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, yì zhí kàn shǒu jī huì sǔn shāng yǎn jīng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, looking at your phone all the time damages your eyes.

entries.english: act for; acting (in a post); agent
entries.example: 店長請假，這週由我代理。
entries.examplePinyin: diàn zhǎng qǐng jià, zhè zhōu yóu wǒ dài lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The store manager is on leave, so I'm filling in this week.
entries.question: 你代理過別人的工作嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dài lǐ guò bié rén de gōng zuò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever covered someone else's job?
entries.answer: 代理過，同事休假時我代理他的工作。
entries.answerPinyin: dài lǐ guò, tóng shì xiū jià shí wǒ dài lǐ tā de gōng zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I covered a coworker's job while he was on vacation.

entries.example: 搬家公司派了三個搬運工來。
entries.examplePinyin: bān jiā gōng sī pài le sān gè bān yùn gōng lái.
entries.exampleEnglish: The moving company sent three movers.
entries.question: 你搬家時會請搬運工嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bān jiā shí huì qǐng bān yùn gōng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you hire movers when you move house?
entries.answer: 會，上次我請了兩個搬運工幫忙。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, shàng cì wǒ qǐng le liǎng gè bān yùn gōng bāng máng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, last time I hired two movers to help.

entries.example: 公司要統一大家的報告格式。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng sī yào tǒng yī dà jiā de bào gào gé shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: The company wants to standardize everyone's report format.
entries.question: 你覺得公司的制服應該統一嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de gōng sī de zhì fú yīng gāi tǒng yī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think company uniforms should be standardized?
entries.answer: 應該，統一的制服看起來比較專業。
entries.answerPinyin: yīng gāi, tǒng yī de zhì fú kàn qǐ lái bǐ jiào zhuān yè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, matching uniforms look more professional.

entries.example: 鶯歌有很多賣陶瓷的店。
entries.examplePinyin: yīng gē yǒu hěn duō mài táo cí de diàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Yingge has lots of shops selling ceramics.
entries.question: 你家有陶瓷做的碗嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yǒu táo cí zuò de wǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have ceramic bowls at home?
entries.answer: 有，我在鶯歌買了幾個陶瓷碗。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ zài yīng gē mǎi le jǐ gè táo cí wǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I bought a few ceramic bowls in Yingge.

entries.example: 這部電影的高潮在最後十分鐘。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng de gāo cháo zài zuì hòu shí fēn zhōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The climax of this movie is in the last ten minutes.
entries.question: 你看小說會先偷看高潮嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn xiǎo shuō huì xiān tōu kàn gāo cháo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you peek at the climax when reading a novel?
entries.answer: 不會，我喜歡慢慢看到高潮。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ xǐ huan màn màn kàn dào gāo cháo.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I like to reach the climax slowly.

entries.example: 我阿嬤年輕的時候很吃苦耐勞。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ ā mó nián qīng de shí hòu hěn chī kǔ nài láo.
entries.exampleEnglish: My grandma was very hardworking and tough when she was young.
entries.question: 你覺得自己吃苦耐勞嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ chī kǔ nài láo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you can endure hardship and work hard?
entries.answer: 我覺得我滿吃苦耐勞的，加班也不抱怨。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de wǒ mǎn chī kǔ nài láo de, jiā bān yě bú bào yuàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm pretty tough; I don't complain even when working overtime.

entries.example: 夜市的老闆大聲叫賣。
entries.examplePinyin: yè shì de lǎo bǎn dà shēng jiào mài.
entries.exampleEnglish: The night market vendors loudly hawk their goods.
entries.question: 你在夜市聽過老闆叫賣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài yè shì tīng guò lǎo bǎn jiào mài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you heard vendors hawking at a night market?
entries.answer: 聽過，賣衣服的老闆叫賣得很大聲。
entries.answerPinyin: tīng guò, mài yī fu de lǎo bǎn jiào mài de hěn dà shēng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the clothes sellers hawk really loudly.

entries.example: 她戴了一頂金色的假髮。
entries.examplePinyin: tā dài le yì dǐng jīn sè de jiǎ fǎ.
entries.exampleEnglish: She wore a blond wig.
entries.question: 你戴過假髮嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dài guò jiǎ fǎ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever worn a wig?
entries.answer: 戴過，萬聖節的時候我戴過假髮。
entries.answerPinyin: dài guò, wàn shèng jié de shí hòu wǒ dài guò jiǎ fǎ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I wore a wig on Halloween.

entries.example: 出去露營帶一把萬用刀很方便。
entries.examplePinyin: chū qù lù yíng dài yì bǎ wàn yòng dāo hěn fāng biàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: A multi-purpose knife is handy to bring when camping.
entries.question: 你家有什麼萬用的東西？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yǒu shén me wàn yòng de dōng xī?
entries.questionEnglish: What all-purpose things do you have at home?
entries.answer: 我家的電鍋很萬用，什麼都能煮。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā de diàn guō hěn wàn yòng, shén me dōu néng zhǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: Our rice cooker is all-purpose; it can cook anything.

entries.example: 外面持續不斷地下雨。
entries.examplePinyin: wài miàn chí xù bú duàn de xià yǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: It keeps raining nonstop outside.
entries.question: 你家附近有持續不斷的噪音嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn yǒu chí xù bú duàn de zào yīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there constant noise near your home?
entries.answer: 有，隔壁工地每天持續不斷地施工。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, gé bì gōng dì měi tiān chí xù bú duàn de shī gōng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the construction site next door works nonstop every day.

entries.example: 週末我們去鄰近的小鎮逛逛吧。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōu mò wǒ men qù lín jìn de xiǎo zhèn guàng guàng ba.
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's go explore a nearby town this weekend.
entries.question: 你去過台灣鄰近的哪些國家？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò tái wān lín jìn de nǎ xiē guó jiā?
entries.questionEnglish: Which of Taiwan's neighboring countries have you been to?
entries.answer: 我去過日本和菲律賓，都是台灣鄰近的國家。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qù guò rì běn hé fēi lǜ bīn, dōu shì tái wān lín jìn de guó jiā.
entries.answerEnglish: I've been to Japan and the Philippines, both neighbors of Taiwan.

entries.example: 現實有時候很殘酷。
entries.examplePinyin: xiàn shí yǒu shí hòu hěn cán kù.
entries.exampleEnglish: Reality is sometimes harsh.
entries.question: 你覺得職場很殘酷嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zhí chǎng hěn cán kù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think the workplace is brutal?
entries.answer: 有時候很殘酷，表現不好就會被換掉。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu hěn cán kù, biǎo xiàn bù hǎo jiù huì bèi huàn diào.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes it's brutal; if you don't perform well, you get replaced.

entries.example: 我朋友在樂團裡吹小號。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ péng yǒu zài yuè tuán lǐ chuī xiǎo hào.
entries.exampleEnglish: My friend plays trumpet in a band.
entries.question: 你聽過有人現場吹小號嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tīng guò yǒu rén xiàn chǎng chuī xiǎo hào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever heard someone play the trumpet live?
entries.answer: 聽過，我在爵士酒吧聽過有人吹小號。
entries.answerPinyin: tīng guò, wǒ zài jué shì jiǔ bā tīng guò yǒu rén chuī xiǎo hào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I heard someone play the trumpet at a jazz bar.

entries.example: 這首歌的節奏很輕快。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shǒu gē de jié zòu hěn qīng kuài.
entries.exampleEnglish: This song has a light, lively rhythm.
entries.question: 你喜歡聽輕快的音樂嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan tīng qīng kuài de yīn yuè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like listening to upbeat music?
entries.answer: 喜歡，早上我會聽輕快的音樂。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, zǎo shàng wǒ huì tīng qīng kuài de yīn yuè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I listen to upbeat music in the morning.

entries.example: 列印之前，先預覽一下。
entries.examplePinyin: liè yìn zhī qián, xiān yù lǎn yí xià.
entries.exampleEnglish: Preview it before you print.
entries.question: 你寄重要的信前會先預覽嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jì zhòng yào de xìn qián huì xiān yù lǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you preview important emails before sending them?
entries.answer: 會，我寄信前都會先預覽一次。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ jì xìn qián dōu huì xiān yù lǎn yí cì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always preview an email once before sending it.

entries.example: 我很想去地中海旅行。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hěn xiǎng qù dì zhōng hǎi lǚ xíng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'd really like to travel to the Mediterranean.
entries.question: 你吃過地中海料理嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chī guò dì zhōng hǎi liào lǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had Mediterranean food?
entries.answer: 吃過，我很喜歡地中海料理。
entries.answerPinyin: chī guò, wǒ hěn xǐ huan dì zhōng hǎi liào lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love Mediterranean food.

entries.example: 夏天吃涼麵很清爽。
entries.examplePinyin: xià tiān chī liáng miàn hěn qīng shuǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Cold noodles are refreshing in summer.
entries.question: 夏天你喜歡吃什麼清爽的東西？
entries.questionPinyin: xià tiān nǐ xǐ huan chī shén me qīng shuǎng de dōng xī?
entries.questionEnglish: What refreshing food do you like in summer?
entries.answer: 我喜歡吃愛玉，很清爽。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan chī ài yù, hěn qīng shuǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: I like aiyu jelly; it's very refreshing.

entries.example: 咖啡的香氣好濃。
entries.examplePinyin: kā fēi de xiāng qì hǎo nóng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The aroma of the coffee is so rich.
entries.question: 你最喜歡什麼香氣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan shén me xiāng qì?
entries.questionEnglish: What scent do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡剛烤好的麵包的香氣。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan gāng kǎo hǎo de miàn bāo de xiāng qì.
entries.answerEnglish: I love the aroma of freshly baked bread most.

entries.example: 過年的年夜飯很豐盛。
entries.examplePinyin: guò nián de nián yè fàn hěn fēng shèng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The Lunar New Year's Eve dinner is a lavish feast.
entries.question: 你吃過最豐盛的一餐是什麼？

entries.answer: 朋友的喜酒是我吃過最豐盛的一餐。
entries.answerPinyin: péng yǒu de xǐ jiǔ shì wǒ chī guò zuì fēng shèng de yì cān.
entries.answerEnglish: My friend's wedding banquet was the most lavish meal I've had.

entries.example: 我每天早上喝一杯濃縮咖啡。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng hē yì bēi nóng suō kā fēi.

entries.question: 你喝過濃縮咖啡嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ hē guò nóng suō kā fēi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had espresso?
entries.answer: 喝過，濃縮咖啡太苦了。
entries.answerPinyin: hē guò, nóng suō kā fēi tài kǔ le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, espresso is too bitter.

entries.example: 我家附近有很多流浪貓。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ jiā fù jìn yǒu hěn duō liú làng māo.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of stray cats near my home.
entries.question: 你餵過流浪貓嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ wèi guò liú làng māo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever fed stray cats?
entries.answer: 餵過，我常常餵公司樓下的流浪貓。
entries.answerPinyin: wèi guò, wǒ cháng cháng wèi gōng sī lóu xià de liú làng māo.

entries.example: 麻煩幫我把這個消息傳遞給大家。
entries.examplePinyin: má fán bāng wǒ bǎ zhè ge xiāo xí chuán dì gěi dà jiā.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men gōng sī yòng shén me chuán dì xùn xí?

entries.answer: 我們公司用LINE傳遞訊息。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men gōng sī yòng LINE chuán dì xùn xí.
entries.answerEnglish: Our company uses LINE to pass on messages.

entries.example: 泡溫泉可以舒緩壓力。
entries.examplePinyin: pào wēn quán kě yǐ shū huǎn yā lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Soaking in a hot spring can relieve stress.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yòng shén me fāng fǎ shū huǎn yā lì?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you relieve stress?
entries.answer: 我用運動來舒緩壓力。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yòng yùn dòng lái shū huǎn yā lì.
entries.answerEnglish: I relieve stress by exercising.

entries.example: 那位明星身邊有兩個保鑣。
entries.examplePinyin: nà wèi míng xīng shēn biān yǒu liǎng gè bǎo biāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: That celebrity has two bodyguards with him.
entries.question: 你覺得明星需要保鑣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de míng xīng xū yào bǎo biāo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think celebrities need bodyguards?
entries.answer: 需要，粉絲太多的話就需要保鑣。
entries.answerPinyin: xū yào, fěn sī tài duō de huà jiù xū yào bǎo biāo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, if they have too many fans they need bodyguards.

entries.example: 薪水要先扣除勞健保。
entries.examplePinyin: xīn shuǐ yào xiān kòu chú láo jiàn bǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Labor and health insurance are deducted from your salary first.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de xīn shuǐ měi gè yuè huì kòu chú shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's deducted from your salary each month?
entries.answer: 我的薪水會扣除勞保和健保。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de xīn shuǐ huì kòu chú láo bǎo hé jiàn bǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Labor insurance and health insurance are deducted from my pay.

entries.example: 青菜放太久，變得軟趴趴的。
entries.examplePinyin: qīng cài fàng tài jiǔ, biàn de ruǎn pā pā de.
entries.exampleEnglish: The greens were left too long and went limp.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃軟趴趴的薯條嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī ruǎn pā pā de shǔ tiáo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like soggy fries?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，軟趴趴的薯條不好吃。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xǐ huan, ruǎn pā pā de shǔ tiáo bù hǎo chī.
entries.answerEnglish: No, soggy fries don't taste good.

entries.example: 這支球隊今年被降級了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhī qiú duì jīn nián bèi jiàng jí le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This team was relegated this year.
entries.question: 你的會員等級被降級過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de huì yuán děng jí bèi jiàng jí guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has your membership tier ever been downgraded?
entries.answer: 有，我很少搭飛機，會員就被降級了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ hěn shǎo dā fēi jī, huì yuán jiù bèi jiàng jí le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I rarely flew, so my membership got downgraded.

entries.example: 這間教會的牧師人很好。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiān jiào huì de mù shī rén hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: The pastor of this church is very kind.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ rèn shì dāng mù shī de rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know anyone who is a pastor?
entries.answer: 認識，我朋友的爸爸是牧師。
entries.answerPinyin: rèn shì, wǒ péng yǒu de bà ba shì mù shī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my friend's father is a pastor.

entries.example: 夜空中的星星一直閃爍。
entries.examplePinyin: yè kōng zhōng de xīng xīng yì zhí shǎn shuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: The stars keep twinkling in the night sky.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài nǎ lǐ kàn guò mǎn tiān xīng xīng shǎn shuò?
entries.questionEnglish: Where have you seen a sky full of twinkling stars?
entries.answer: 我在合歡山看過滿天星星閃爍。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài hé huān shān kàn guò mǎn tiān xīng xīng shǎn shuò.
entries.answerEnglish: I saw a sky full of twinkling stars on Hehuan Mountain.

entries.example: 最後一百公尺他開始衝刺。
entries.examplePinyin: zuì hòu yì bǎi gōng chǐ tā kāi shǐ chōng cì.
entries.exampleEnglish: He started sprinting in the last hundred meters.
entries.question: 工作截止前，你會最後衝刺嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: gōng zuò jié zhǐ qián, nǐ huì zuì hòu chōng cì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you make a final push before a work deadline?
entries.answer: 會，我常常在截止前一天衝刺。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng cháng zài jié zhǐ qián yì tiān chōng cì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often make a final push the day before the deadline.

entries.example: 士兵向國旗敬禮。
entries.examplePinyin: shì bīng xiàng guó qí jìng lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The soldiers saluted the flag.
entries.question: 在你的國家，什麼人需要敬禮？
entries.questionPinyin: zài nǐ de guó jiā, shén me rén xū yào jìng lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: In your country, who has to salute?
entries.answer: 在我的國家，軍人和警察需要敬禮。
entries.answerPinyin: zài wǒ de guó jiā, jūn rén hé jǐng chá xū yào jìng lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: In my country, soldiers and police officers have to salute.

entries.example: 我的主管很嚴厲。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de zhǔ guǎn hěn yán lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: My supervisor is very strict.
entries.question: 你小時候，爸媽很嚴厲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu, bà mā hěn yán lì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Were your parents strict when you were young?
entries.answer: 我爸爸很嚴厲，我媽媽比較溫柔。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bà ba hěn yán lì, wǒ mā ma bǐ jiào wēn róu.
entries.answerEnglish: My dad was very strict; my mom was gentler.

entries.example: 我用圖釘把海報釘在牆上。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ yòng tú dīng bǎ hǎi bào dìng zài qiáng shàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I pinned the poster to the wall with thumbtacks.
entries.question: 你的辦公室會用圖釘嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de bàn gōng shì huì yòng tú dīng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use thumbtacks at your office?
entries.answer: 會，我用圖釘把行事曆釘在牆上。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ yòng tú dīng bǎ xíng shì lì dìng zài qiáng shàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I use thumbtacks to pin my calendar to the wall.

entries.example: 這個便當盒是鋁做的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge biàn dāng hé shì lǚ zuò de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This lunch box is made of aluminum.
entries.question: 你家有鋁做的鍋子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yǒu lǚ zuò de guō zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have aluminum pots at home?
entries.answer: 有，我家有一個鋁鍋。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiā yǒu yí gè lǚ guō.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we have an aluminum pot.

entries.example: 我們公司每季開一次大會。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men gōng sī měi jì kāi yí cì dà huì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Our company holds a big meeting every quarter.
entries.question: 你每季都會買新衣服嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ měi jì dōu huì mǎi xīn yī fu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you buy new clothes every season?
entries.answer: 不會，我沒有每季都買新衣服。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ méi yǒu měi jì dōu mǎi xīn yī fu.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't buy new clothes every season.

entries.example: 政府發放了消費券給大家。
entries.examplePinyin: zhèng fǔ fā fàng le xiāo fèi quàn gěi dà jiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: The government gave out shopping vouchers to everyone.
entries.question: 你們公司會發放年終獎金嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men gōng sī huì fā fàng nián zhōng jiǎng jīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company give out year-end bonuses?
entries.answer: 會，我們公司過年前會發放年終獎金。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ men gōng sī guò nián qián huì fā fàng nián zhōng jiǎng jīn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our company gives out year-end bonuses before Lunar New Year.

entries.example: 這家店七天內可以無條件退貨。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn qī tiān nèi kě yǐ wú tiáo jiàn tuì huò.
entries.exampleEnglish: This store accepts returns within seven days, no questions asked.
entries.question: 你喜歡可以無條件退貨的店嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kě yǐ wú tiáo jiàn tuì huò de diàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like stores that take returns unconditionally?
entries.answer: 喜歡，可以無條件退貨比較放心。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, kě yǐ wú tiáo jiàn tuì huò bǐ jiào fàng xīn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, unconditional returns give me peace of mind.

entries.example: 颱風來了，這條路被封鎖了。
entries.examplePinyin: tái fēng lái le, zhè tiáo lù bèi fēng suǒ le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The typhoon came and this road was closed off.
entries.question: 你在LINE上封鎖過別人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài LINE shàng fēng suǒ guò bié rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever blocked someone on LINE?
entries.answer: 有，我封鎖過一直傳廣告的人。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ fēng suǒ guò yì zhí chuán guǎng gào de rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've blocked people who kept sending ads.

entries.example: 商品有問題，我申請了退款。
entries.examplePinyin: shāng pǐn yǒu wèn tí, wǒ shēn qǐng le tuì kuǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The item was faulty, so I requested a refund.
entries.question: 你網購的時候申請過退款嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ wǎng gòu de shí hòu shēn qǐng guò tuì kuǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever requested a refund when shopping online?
entries.answer: 申請過，賣家三天就退款給我了。
entries.answerPinyin: shēn qǐng guò, mài jiā sān tiān jiù tuì kuǎn gěi wǒ le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the seller refunded me within three days.

entries.example: 他匆忙地跑去趕捷運。
entries.examplePinyin: tā cōng máng de pǎo qù gǎn jié yùn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He rushed off to catch the MRT.
entries.question: 你早上出門會很匆忙嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zǎo shàng chū mén huì hěn cōng máng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you in a rush when you leave home in the morning?
entries.answer: 會，我早上出門常常很匆忙。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ zǎo shàng chū mén cháng cháng hěn cōng máng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm often in a rush when I leave in the morning.

entries.example: 我奶奶很節儉，從來不浪費。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ nǎi nai hěn jié jiǎn, cóng lái bú làng fèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: My grandma is very thrifty and never wastes anything.
entries.question: 你是節儉的人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shì jié jiǎn de rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you a thrifty person?
entries.answer: 我滿節儉的，很少買不需要的東西。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ mǎn jié jiǎn de, hěn shǎo mǎi bù xū yào de dōng xī.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm pretty thrifty; I rarely buy things I don't need.

entries.example: 開會時請把手機調成靜音。
entries.examplePinyin: kāi huì shí qǐng bǎ shǒu jī tiáo chéng jìng yīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please set your phone to silent during the meeting.
entries.question: 你的手機常常開靜音嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de shǒu jī cháng cháng kāi jìng yīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your phone often on silent?
entries.answer: 常常，上班的時候我都開靜音。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, shàng bān de shí hòu wǒ dōu kāi jìng yīn.
entries.answerEnglish: Often; I keep it on silent at work.

entries.example: 他的腳傷已經康復了。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de jiǎo shāng yǐ jīng kāng fù le.
entries.exampleEnglish: His foot injury has healed.
entries.question: 生病後怎麼樣可以比較快康復？
entries.questionPinyin: shēng bìng hòu zěn me yàng kě yǐ bǐ jiào kuài kāng fù?
entries.questionEnglish: How can someone recover faster after being ill?
entries.answer: 多休息、多喝水，可以比較快康復。
entries.answerPinyin: duō xiū xí, duō hē shuǐ, kě yǐ bǐ jiào kuài kāng fù.
entries.answerEnglish: Resting and drinking plenty of water helps you recover faster.

entries.example: 快遞員把包裹送到公司了。
entries.examplePinyin: kuài dì yuán bǎ bāo guǒ sòng dào gōng sī le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The courier delivered the package to the office.
entries.question: 你常常收到快遞員送的包裹嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng cháng shōu dào kuài dì yuán sòng de bāo guǒ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often get packages from couriers?
entries.answer: 常常，快遞員幾乎每天都來我們公司。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, kuài dì yuán jī hū měi tiān dōu lái wǒ men gōng sī.
entries.answerEnglish: Often; couriers come to our office almost every day.

entries.example: 這家咖啡廳很小，可是很溫馨。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā kā fēi tīng hěn xiǎo, kě shì hěn wēn xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This café is small but very cozy.
entries.question: 你覺得你家溫馨嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ jiā wēn xīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your home is cozy?
entries.answer: 很溫馨，我家有很多植物跟暖暖的燈光。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn wēn xīn, wǒ jiā yǒu hěn duō zhí wù gēn nuǎn nuǎn de dēng guāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Very cozy; my home has lots of plants and warm lighting.

entries.example: 我家還有很多舊的錄影帶。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ jiā hái yǒu hěn duō jiù de lù yǐng dài.
entries.exampleEnglish: We still have lots of old videotapes at home.
entries.question: 你小時候看過錄影帶嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu kàn guò lù yǐng dài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you watch videotapes as a kid?
entries.answer: 看過，我小時候常租錄影帶回家看。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ xiǎo shí hòu cháng zū lù yǐng dài huí jiā kàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, as a kid I often rented videotapes to watch at home.

entries.example: 週末公園有一場嘉年華。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōu mò gōng yuán yǒu yì chǎng jiā nián huá.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a carnival in the park this weekend.
entries.question: 你參加過嘉年華嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān jiā guò jiā nián huá ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been to a carnival?
entries.answer: 參加過，我參加過巴西的嘉年華。
entries.answerPinyin: cān jiā guò, wǒ cān jiā guò bā xī de jiā nián huá.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've been to the carnival in Brazil.

entries.example: 池塘裡有很多鯉魚。
entries.examplePinyin: chí táng lǐ yǒu hěn duō lǐ yú.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of carp in the pond.
entries.question: 你餵過鯉魚嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ wèi guò lǐ yú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever fed carp?
entries.answer: 餵過，我在公園的池塘餵過鯉魚。
entries.answerPinyin: wèi guò, wǒ zài gōng yuán de chí táng wèi guò lǐ yú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've fed the carp in a park pond.

entries.example: 我每天早上冥想十分鐘。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng míng xiǎng shí fēn zhōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I meditate for ten minutes every morning.
entries.question: 你試過冥想嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shì guò míng xiǎng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever tried meditating?
entries.answer: 試過，冥想讓我比較放鬆。
entries.answerPinyin: shì guò, míng xiǎng ràng wǒ bǐ jiào fàng sōng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, meditation helps me relax.

entries.example: 明星一出來就被粉絲包圍了。
entries.examplePinyin: míng xīng yì chū lái jiù bèi fěn sī bāo wéi le.
entries.exampleEnglish: As soon as the star came out, fans surrounded him.
entries.question: 你家被什麼包圍？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā bèi shén me bāo wéi?
entries.questionEnglish: What surrounds your home?
entries.answer: 我家四周被高樓大廈包圍。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā sì zhōu bèi gāo lóu dà shà bāo wéi.
entries.answerEnglish: My home is surrounded by tall buildings.

entries.example: 魚在網子裡一直掙扎。
entries.examplePinyin: yú zài wǎng zi lǐ yì zhí zhēng zhá.
entries.exampleEnglish: The fish kept struggling in the net.
entries.question: 早上起床時，你會掙扎很久嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zǎo shàng qǐ chuáng shí, nǐ huì zhēng zhá hěn jiǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you struggle for a long time to get up in the morning?
entries.answer: 會，我每天早上都要掙扎很久才起床。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng dōu yào zhēng zhá hěn jiǔ cái qǐ chuáng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, every morning I struggle for ages before I get up.

entries.example: 下大雨不能出門，他很無奈。
entries.examplePinyin: xià dà yǔ bù néng chū mén, tā hěn wú nài.
entries.exampleEnglish: It was pouring and he couldn't go out; he felt helpless.
entries.question: 什麼事會讓你覺得很無奈？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shì huì ràng nǐ jué de hěn wú nài?
entries.questionEnglish: What makes you feel helpless?
entries.answer: 每天塞車讓我覺得很無奈。
entries.answerPinyin: měi tiān sāi chē ràng wǒ jué de hěn wú nài.
entries.answerEnglish: Being stuck in traffic every day makes me feel helpless.

entries.example: 股票跌到今年的最低點。
entries.examplePinyin: gǔ piào dié dào jīn nián de zuì dī diǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The stock fell to its lowest point this year.
entries.question: 一天之中，你什麼時候精神在最低點？
entries.questionPinyin: yì tiān zhī zhōng, nǐ shén me shí hòu jīng shén zài zuì dī diǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: When during the day is your energy at its lowest?
entries.answer: 下午三點左右，我的精神在最低點。
entries.answerPinyin: xià wǔ sān diǎn zuǒ yòu, wǒ de jīng shén zài zuì dī diǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Around 3 p.m., my energy is at its lowest.

entries.example: 一杯珍奶有很多卡路里。
entries.examplePinyin: yì bēi zhēn nǎi yǒu hěn duō kǎ lù lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: A cup of bubble tea has a lot of calories.
entries.question: 你吃東西會算卡路里嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chī dōng xī huì suàn kǎ lù lǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you count calories when you eat?
entries.answer: 不會，我從來不算卡路里。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ cóng lái bú suàn kǎ lù lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I never count calories.

entries.example: 我們公司位於台北市中心。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men gōng sī wèi yú tái běi shì zhōng xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Our company is located in downtown Taipei.
entries.question: 你家位於哪一區？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā wèi yú nǎ yì qū?
entries.questionEnglish: Which district is your home in?
entries.answer: 我家位於台北的大安區。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā wèi yú tái běi de dà ān qū.
entries.answerEnglish: My home is in Da'an District, Taipei.

entries.example: 我在家用個人電腦工作。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài jiā yòng gè rén diàn nǎo gōng zuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: I work on a PC at home.
entries.question: 你比較常用個人電腦還是手機？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bǐ jiào cháng yòng gè rén diàn nǎo hái shì shǒu jī?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use a PC or your phone more?
entries.answer: 工作的時候我比較常用個人電腦。
entries.answerPinyin: gōng zuò de shí hòu wǒ bǐ jiào cháng yòng gè rén diàn nǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: I use a PC more when I'm working.

entries.example: 我們公司的休假制度很好。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men gōng sī de xiū jià zhì dù hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Our company's leave system is very good.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的健保制度怎麼樣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān de jiàn bǎo zhì dù zěn me yàng?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think of Taiwan's health insurance system?
entries.answer: 我覺得台灣的健保制度很方便。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de tái wān de jiàn bǎo zhì dù hěn fāng biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I think Taiwan's health insurance system is very convenient.

entries.example: 加一大匙醬油就好。
entries.examplePinyin: jiā yí dà chí jiàng yóu jiù hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Just add a tablespoon of soy sauce.
entries.question: 你炒菜會放幾大匙油？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chǎo cài huì fàng jǐ dà chí yóu?
entries.questionEnglish: How many tablespoons of oil do you use when stir-frying?
entries.answer: 我炒菜大概放一大匙油。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ chǎo cài dà gài fàng yí dà chí yóu.
entries.answerEnglish: I use about one tablespoon of oil when I stir-fry.

entries.example: 湯裡再加一茶匙鹽。
entries.examplePinyin: tāng lǐ zài jiā yì chá chí yán.
entries.exampleEnglish: Add another teaspoon of salt to the soup.
entries.question: 你喝咖啡加幾茶匙糖？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ hē kā fēi jiā jǐ chá chí táng?
entries.questionEnglish: How many teaspoons of sugar do you put in your coffee?
entries.answer: 我喝咖啡只加一茶匙糖。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ hē kā fēi zhǐ jiā yì chá chí táng.
entries.answerEnglish: I only put one teaspoon of sugar in my coffee.

entries.example: 現在不是買房子的好時機。
entries.examplePinyin: xiàn zài bú shì mǎi fáng zi de hǎo shí jī.
entries.exampleEnglish: Now isn't a good time to buy a house.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼時候是出國的好時機？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me shí hòu shì chū guó de hǎo shí jī?
entries.questionEnglish: When do you think is a good time to travel abroad?
entries.answer: 我覺得秋天是出國旅行的好時機。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de qiū tiān shì chū guó lǚ xíng de hǎo shí jī.
entries.answerEnglish: I think autumn is a good time to travel abroad.

entries.example: 聽音樂時，他的頭跟著節奏上下晃動。
entries.examplePinyin: tīng yīn yuè shí, tā de tóu gēn zhe jié zòu shàng xià huàng dòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: When he listens to music, his head bobs up and down to the beat.
entries.question: 你聽音樂時，頭會上下晃動嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tīng yīn yuè shí, tóu huì shàng xià huàng dòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you listen to music, does your head bob up and down?
entries.answer: 會，聽到喜歡的歌，我的頭會上下晃動。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, tīng dào xǐ huan de gē, wǒ de tóu huì shàng xià huàng dòng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when I hear a song I like, my head bobs up and down.

entries.example: 但願明天不要下雨，我們要去爬山。
entries.examplePinyin: dàn yuàn míng tiān bú yào xià yǔ, wǒ men yào qù pá shān.
entries.exampleEnglish: Hopefully it won't rain tomorrow; we're going hiking.
entries.question: 你對明年有什麼願望？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì míng nián yǒu shén me yuàn wàng?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you wish for next year?
entries.answer: 但願明年工作順利，身體健康。
entries.answerPinyin: dàn yuàn míng nián gōng zuò shùn lì, shēn tǐ jiàn kāng.
entries.answerEnglish: I hope work goes well next year and I stay healthy.

entries.example: 這台筆電的處理器很快，跑遊戲很順。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tái bǐ diàn de chǔ lǐ qì hěn kuài, pǎo yóu xì hěn shùn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This laptop's processor is fast, so games run smoothly.
entries.question: 你買電腦時會注意處理器嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi diàn nǎo shí huì zhù yì chǔ lǐ qì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you pay attention to the processor when you buy a computer?
entries.answer: 會，我一定會先看處理器夠不夠快。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ yí dìng huì xiān kàn chǔ lǐ qì gòu bu gòu kuài.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always check first whether the processor is fast enough.

entries.example: 計程車上的計費表跳得好快。
entries.examplePinyin: jì chéng chē shàng de jì fèi biǎo tiào de hǎo kuài.
entries.exampleEnglish: The meter in the taxi is going up really fast.
entries.question: 坐計程車時，你會一直看計費表嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zuò jì chéng chē shí, nǐ huì yì zhí kàn jì fèi biǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you take a taxi, do you keep looking at the meter?
entries.answer: 會，塞車的時候我會一直看計費表。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, sāi chē de shí hòu wǒ huì yì zhí kàn jì fèi biǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when there's traffic I keep watching the meter.

entries.example: 這兩張帳單合計三千塊。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè liǎng zhāng zhàng dān hé jì sān qiān kuài.
entries.exampleEnglish: These two bills add up to three thousand dollars.
entries.question: 你每個月的房租和水電合計多少？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ měi gè yuè de fáng zū hé shuǐ diàn hé jì duō shǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: How much do your rent and utilities come to each month?
entries.answer: 房租和水電合計大概兩萬塊。
entries.answerPinyin: fáng zū hé shuǐ diàn hé jì dà gài liǎng wàn kuài.
entries.answerEnglish: Rent and utilities come to about twenty thousand altogether.

entries.example: 炸的東西膽固醇很高，不要吃太多。
entries.examplePinyin: zhá de dōng xī dǎn gù chún hěn gāo, bú yào chī tài duō.
entries.exampleEnglish: Fried food is high in cholesterol, so don't eat too much.
entries.question: 哪些食物的膽固醇比較高？
entries.questionPinyin: nǎ xiē shí wù de dǎn gù chún bǐ jiào gāo?
entries.questionEnglish: Which foods are higher in cholesterol?
entries.answer: 蛋黃和內臟的膽固醇比較高。
entries.answerPinyin: dàn huáng hé nèi zàng de dǎn gù chún bǐ jiào gāo.
entries.answerEnglish: Egg yolks and organ meats are higher in cholesterol.

entries.example: 這位議員很關心捷運的問題。
