entries.answer: 有，出口旁邊有一條坡道。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, chū kǒu páng biān yǒu yì tiáo pō dào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a ramp beside the exit.

entries.example: 我們十年後在台北重逢了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men shí nián hòu zài tái běi chóng féng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: We met again in Taipei ten years later.
entries.question: 你跟老朋友重逢過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gēn lǎo péng yǒu chóng féng guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been reunited with an old friend?
entries.answer: 有，我去年跟高中同學重逢了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ qù nián gēn gāo zhōng tóng xué chóng féng le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I was reunited with a high school classmate last year.

entries.example: 古時候的信差要騎馬送信。
entries.examplePinyin: gǔ shí hòu de xìn chāi yào qí mǎ sòng xìn.
entries.exampleEnglish: In ancient times, messengers delivered letters on horseback.
entries.question: 你覺得現在還需要信差嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de xiàn zài hái xū yào xìn chāi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think we still need messengers today?
entries.answer: 不太需要，現在有快遞代替信差。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài xū yào, xiàn zài yǒu kuài dì dài tì xìn chāi.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really; couriers have replaced messengers.

entries.example: 旅行可以拓展視野。
entries.examplePinyin: lǚ xíng kě yǐ tuò zhǎn shì yě.
entries.exampleEnglish: Travel can broaden your horizons.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼可以拓展你的視野？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me kě yǐ tuò zhǎn nǐ de shì yě?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think can broaden your horizons?
entries.answer: 我覺得出國工作可以拓展視野。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de chū guó gōng zuò kě yǐ tuò zhǎn shì yě.
entries.answerEnglish: I think working abroad can broaden your horizons.

entries.example: 博物館的館長帶我們參觀。
entries.examplePinyin: bó wù guǎn de guǎn zhǎng dài wǒ men cān guān.
entries.exampleEnglish: The museum director showed us around.
entries.question: 你想當博物館的館長嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng dāng bó wù guǎn de guǎn zhǎng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to be a museum director?
entries.answer: 想，當館長應該很有趣。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, dāng guǎn zhǎng yīng gāi hěn yǒu qù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, being a museum director must be interesting.

entries.english: be infatuated with; be obsessed with
entries.example: 他很迷戀日本動漫。
entries.examplePinyin: tā hěn mí liàn rì běn dòng màn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's obsessed with Japanese anime.
entries.question: 你小時候迷戀過什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu mí liàn guò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What were you obsessed with as a child?
entries.answer: 我小時候很迷戀恐龍。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎo shí hòu hěn mí liàn kǒng lóng.
entries.answerEnglish: As a child I was obsessed with dinosaurs.

entries.example: 工廠不可以亂排污水。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng chǎng bù kě yǐ luàn pái wū shuǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Factories mustn't discharge wastewater as they please.
entries.question: 你覺得污水會影響海洋嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de wū shuǐ huì yǐng xiǎng hǎi yáng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think sewage affects the ocean?
entries.answer: 會，污水會讓海洋生病。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wū shuǐ huì ràng hǎi yáng shēng bìng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, sewage makes the ocean sick.

entries.example: 太魯閣峽谷非常漂亮。
entries.examplePinyin: tài lǔ gé xiá gǔ fēi cháng piào liang.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taroko Gorge is beautiful.
entries.question: 你去過太魯閣峽谷嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò tài lǔ gé xiá gǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to Taroko Gorge?
entries.answer: 去過，太魯閣峽谷很壯觀。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, tài lǔ gé xiá gǔ hěn zhuàng guān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, Taroko Gorge is spectacular.

entries.example: 兩個地方的價格差異很大。
entries.examplePinyin: liǎng gè dì fāng de jià gé chā yì hěn dà.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a big price difference between the two places.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣和你的國家有什麼差異？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān hé nǐ de guó jiā yǒu shén me chā yì?
entries.questionEnglish: What differences do you see between Taiwan and your country?
entries.answer: 最大的差異是台灣的天氣很熱。
entries.answerPinyin: zuì dà de chā yì shì tái wān de tiān qì hěn rè.
entries.answerEnglish: The biggest difference is that Taiwan is very hot.

entries.example: 工廠的煙囪一直冒煙。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng chǎng de yān cōng yì zhí mào yān.
entries.exampleEnglish: The factory chimney keeps belching smoke.
entries.question: 你家附近有高高的煙囪嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn yǒu gāo gāo de yān cōng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a tall chimney near your home?
entries.answer: 有，附近的工廠有一根大煙囪。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, fù jìn de gōng chǎng yǒu yì gēn dà yān cōng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a factory nearby has a big chimney.

entries.example: 這台機器可以檢測空氣品質。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tái jī qì kě yǐ jiǎn cè kōng qì pǐn zhí.
entries.exampleEnglish: This machine can test the air quality.
entries.question: 你會檢測家裡的空氣品質嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì jiǎn cè jiā lǐ de kōng qì pǐn zhí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you test the air quality at home?
entries.answer: 會，我有一台檢測空氣的機器。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ yǒu yì tái jiǎn cè kōng qì de jī qì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a machine that tests the air.

entries.example: 他在台灣沒有親屬。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài tái wān méi yǒu qīn shǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: He has no relatives in Taiwan.
entries.question: 你在台灣有親屬嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān yǒu qīn shǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any relatives in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 沒有，我的親屬都在美國。
entries.answerPinyin: méi yǒu, wǒ de qīn shǔ dōu zài měi guó.
entries.answerEnglish: No, all my relatives are in the US.

entries.example: 秋天的楓樹很漂亮。
entries.examplePinyin: qiū tiān de fēng shù hěn piào liang.
entries.exampleEnglish: Maple trees are beautiful in autumn.
entries.question: 你的國家有很多楓樹嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā yǒu hěn duō fēng shù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there many maple trees in your country?
entries.answer: 有，加拿大到處都有楓樹。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, jiā ná dà dào chù dōu yǒu fēng shù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are maple trees all over Canada.

entries.example: 玉山的海拔將近四千公尺。
entries.examplePinyin: yù shān de hǎi bá jiāng jìn sì qiān gōng chǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Jade Mountain is nearly four thousand metres above sea level.
entries.question: 你爬過海拔最高的山是哪座？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pá guò hǎi bá zuì gāo de shān shì nǎ zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the highest mountain you've climbed?
entries.answer: 我爬過合歡山，海拔三千多公尺。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ pá guò hé huān shān, hǎi bá sān qiān duō gōng chǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I've climbed Hehuan Mountain, over three thousand metres high.

entries.example: 我大學念的是人類學。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ dà xué niàn de shì rén lèi xué.
entries.exampleEnglish: I studied anthropology at university.
entries.question: 你對人類學有興趣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì rén lèi xué yǒu xìng qù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you interested in anthropology?
entries.answer: 有，我很喜歡看人類學的書。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ hěn xǐ huan kàn rén lèi xué de shū.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love reading books on anthropology.

entries.example: 他們兄弟長得很相像。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men xiōng dì zhǎng de hěn xiāng xiàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The brothers look very alike.
entries.question: 你跟你的兄弟姊妹長得相像嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gēn nǐ de xiōng dì jiě mèi zhǎng de xiāng xiàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you and your siblings look alike?
entries.answer: 很相像，很多人說我們像雙胞胎。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn xiāng xiàng, hěn duō rén shuō wǒ men xiàng shuāng bāo tāi.
entries.answerEnglish: Very; lots of people say we look like twins.

entries.example: 看電影是我最喜歡的消遣。
entries.examplePinyin: kàn diàn yǐng shì wǒ zuì xǐ huan de xiāo qiǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Watching films is my favourite pastime.
entries.question: 你週末有什麼消遣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhōu mò yǒu shén me xiāo qiǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do for fun at the weekend?
entries.answer: 我的消遣是打羽毛球。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de xiāo qiǎn shì dǎ yǔ máo qiú.
entries.answerEnglish: My pastime is playing badminton.

entries.example: 他終於征服了玉山。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zhōng yú zhēng fú le yù shān.
entries.exampleEnglish: He finally conquered Jade Mountain.
entries.question: 你想征服哪座山？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng zhēng fú nǎ zuò shān?
entries.questionEnglish: Which mountain would you like to conquer?
entries.answer: 我想征服雪山。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng zhēng fú xuě shān.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to conquer Snow Mountain.

entries.example: 他是一個很務實的人。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì yí gè hěn wù shí de rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a very practical person.
entries.question: 你買東西的時候務實嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi dōng xī de shí hòu wù shí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you practical when you shop?
entries.answer: 很務實，我只買需要的東西。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn wù shí, wǒ zhǐ mǎi xū yào de dōng xī.
entries.answerEnglish: Very; I only buy what I need.

entries.example: 公園的草皮很漂亮。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng yuán de cǎo pí hěn piào liang.
entries.exampleEnglish: The lawn in the park is lovely.
entries.question: 你喜歡坐在草皮上野餐嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zuò zài cǎo pí shàng yě cān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like having picnics on the lawn?
entries.answer: 喜歡，坐在草皮上很舒服。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, zuò zài cǎo pí shàng hěn shū fú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, sitting on the grass is very comfortable.

entries.example: 浴室的牆是馬賽克磁磚。
entries.examplePinyin: yù shì de qiáng shì mǎ sài kè cí zhuān.
entries.exampleEnglish: The bathroom wall is mosaic tile.
entries.question: 你喜歡馬賽克磁磚嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan mǎ sài kè cí zhuān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like mosaic tiles?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我想在浴室貼馬賽克磁磚。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ xiǎng zài yù shì tiē mǎ sài kè cí zhuān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like mosaic tiles in my bathroom.

entries.example: 我每天都要處理很多雜務。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi tiān dōu yào chǔ lǐ hěn duō zá wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: I have lots of odd jobs to deal with every day.
entries.question: 你在公司要做很多雜務嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài gōng sī yào zuò hěn duō zá wù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have to do a lot of odd jobs at work?
entries.answer: 要，我常常要處理雜務。
entries.answerPinyin: yào, wǒ cháng cháng yào chǔ lǐ zá wù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often have to deal with odd jobs.

entries.example: 我每天背誦十個生詞。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi tiān bèi sòng shí gè shēng cí.
entries.exampleEnglish: I memorize ten new words every day.
entries.question: 你會背誦中文課文嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì bèi sòng zhōng wén kè wén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you memorize Chinese texts?
entries.answer: 會，我常背誦課文練口說。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng bèi sòng kè wén liàn kǒu shuō.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often recite texts to practise speaking.

entries.example: 他用鋸子把木頭鋸開。
entries.examplePinyin: tā yòng jù zi bǎ mù tou jù kāi.
entries.exampleEnglish: He sawed the wood apart with a saw.
entries.question: 你家有鋸子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yǒu jù zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a saw at home?
entries.answer: 有，我爸爸有一把鋸子。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ bà ba yǒu yì bǎ jù zi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my dad has a saw.

entries.example: 面試官問了我很多問題。
entries.examplePinyin: miàn shì guān wèn le wǒ hěn duō wèn tí.
entries.exampleEnglish: The interviewer asked me lots of questions.
entries.question: 你遇過很嚴格的面試官嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yù guò hěn yán gé de miàn shì guān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had a very strict interviewer?
entries.answer: 遇過，那位面試官一直問我問題。
entries.answerPinyin: yù guò, nà wèi miàn shì guān yì zhí wèn wǒ wèn tí.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, that interviewer kept firing questions at me.

entries.example: 這台機器要拉下控制桿才會啟動。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tái jī qì yào lā xià kòng zhì gǎn cái huì qǐ dòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This machine only starts when you pull down the lever.
entries.question: 你操作過有控制桿的機器嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cāo zuò guò yǒu kòng zhì gǎn de jī qì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever operated a machine with a lever?
entries.answer: 有，我以前在工廠工作時常拉控制桿。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ yǐ qián zài gōng chǎng gōng zuò shí cháng lā kòng zhì gǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I used to pull levers a lot when I worked in a factory.

entries.example: 她在大學裡做學術研究。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài dà xué lǐ zuò xué shù yán jiù.
entries.exampleEnglish: She does academic research at a university.
entries.question: 你讀過學術文章嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dú guò xué shù wén zhāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever read academic articles?
entries.answer: 讀過，我念研究所的時候常讀學術文章。
entries.answerPinyin: dú guò, wǒ niàn yán jiù suǒ de shí hòu cháng dú xué shù wén zhāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I read academic articles a lot in grad school.

entries.example: 他在麵包店當了三年學徒。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài miàn bāo diàn dāng le sān nián xué tú.
entries.exampleEnglish: He was an apprentice at a bakery for three years.
entries.question: 如果可以，你想當哪一行的學徒？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ kě yǐ, nǐ xiǎng dāng nǎ yì háng de xué tú?
entries.questionEnglish: If you could, what trade would you like to be an apprentice in?
entries.answer: 我想去咖啡店當學徒，學煮咖啡。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng qù kā fēi diàn dāng xué tú, xué zhǔ kā fēi.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to be an apprentice at a café and learn to make coffee.

entries.example: 這種茶有幫助睡眠的功效。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhǒng chá yǒu bāng zhù shuì mián de gōng xiào.
entries.exampleEnglish: This kind of tea helps you sleep.
entries.question: 你相信保健食品的功效嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiāng xìn bǎo jiàn shí pǐn de gōng xiào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you believe health supplements work?
entries.answer: 我不太相信保健食品的功效。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bú tài xiāng xìn bǎo jiàn shí pǐn de gōng xiào.
entries.answerEnglish: I don't really believe in the effects of health supplements.

entries.example: 關渡有一大片濕地。
entries.examplePinyin: guān dù yǒu yí dà piàn shī dì.
entries.exampleEnglish: There is a large wetland in Guandu.
entries.question: 你去過哪裡的濕地？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò nǎ lǐ de shī dì?
entries.questionEnglish: Which wetlands have you been to?
entries.answer: 我去過關渡的濕地看鳥。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qù guò guān dù de shī dì kàn niǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: I went bird-watching at the Guandu wetland.

entries.example: 輪胎漏氣，發出嘶嘶聲。
entries.examplePinyin: lún tāi lòu qì, fā chū sī sī shēng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The tire is leaking air and making a hissing sound.
entries.question: 聽到嘶嘶聲，你會想到什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: tīng dào sī sī shēng, nǐ huì xiǎng dào shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think of when you hear a hissing sound?
entries.answer: 聽到嘶嘶聲，我會想到蛇。
entries.answerPinyin: tīng dào sī sī shēng, wǒ huì xiǎng dào shé.
entries.answerEnglish: When I hear hissing, I think of snakes.

entries.example: 在台北，中產階級買房子越來越難。
entries.examplePinyin: zài tái běi, zhōng chǎn jiē jí mǎi fáng zi yuè lái yuè nán.
entries.exampleEnglish: In Taipei it's getting harder and harder for the middle class to buy a home.
entries.question: 你覺得自己是中產階級嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ shì zhōng chǎn jiē jí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you consider yourself middle class?
entries.answer: 我覺得我是一般的中產階級。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de wǒ shì yì bān de zhōng chǎn jiē jí.
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm ordinary middle class.

entries.example: 工廠排放的廢氣會汙染大氣。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng chǎng pái fàng de fèi qì huì wū rǎn dà qì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Exhaust from factories pollutes the atmosphere.
entries.question: 你關心大氣汙染的問題嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ guān xīn dà qì wū rǎn de wèn tí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you care about atmospheric pollution?
entries.answer: 關心，大氣汙染會影響大家的健康。
entries.answerPinyin: guān xīn, dà qì wū rǎn huì yǐng xiǎng dà jiā de jiàn kāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, atmospheric pollution affects everyone's health.

entries.example: 有些公司很看重文憑。
entries.examplePinyin: yǒu xiē gōng sī hěn kàn zhòng wén píng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Some companies place a lot of weight on diplomas.
entries.question: 你覺得找工作時文憑重要嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zhǎo gōng zuò shí wén píng zhòng yào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think a diploma matters when job hunting?
entries.answer: 我覺得能力比文憑更重要。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de néng lì bǐ wén píng gèng zhòng yào.
entries.answerEnglish: I think ability matters more than a diploma.

entries.example: 這個公園的周長大約兩公里。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge gōng yuán de zhōu cháng dà yuē liǎng gōng lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The perimeter of this park is about two kilometers.
entries.question: 你常去跑步的公園周長大概多少？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng qù pǎo bù de gōng yuán zhōu cháng dà gài duō shǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: Roughly how long is the perimeter of the park where you run?
entries.answer: 那個公園的周長大概一公里。
entries.answerPinyin: nà ge gōng yuán de zhōu cháng dà gài yì gōng lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: That park's perimeter is about one kilometer.

entries.example: 他溫暖的話語讓我很感動。
entries.examplePinyin: tā wēn nuǎn de huà yǔ ràng wǒ hěn gǎn dòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: His warm words really moved me.
entries.question: 誰的話語曾經讓你很感動？
entries.questionPinyin: shéi de huà yǔ céng jīng ràng nǐ hěn gǎn dòng?
entries.questionEnglish: Whose words have really moved you?
entries.answer: 我媽媽鼓勵我的話語讓我很感動。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ mā ma gǔ lì wǒ de huà yǔ ràng wǒ hěn gǎn dòng.
entries.answerEnglish: My mom's encouraging words really moved me.

entries.example: 這個活動是去年的延續。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge huó dòng shì qù nián de yán xù.
entries.exampleEnglish: This event is a continuation of last year's.
entries.question: 你希望哪個傳統可以延續下去？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xī wàng nǎ gè chuán tǒng kě yǐ yán xù xià qù?
entries.questionEnglish: Which tradition do you hope will carry on?
entries.answer: 我希望過年吃團圓飯的傳統能延續下去。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xī wàng guò nián chī tuán yuán fàn de chuán tǒng néng yán xù xià qù.
entries.answerEnglish: I hope the tradition of the New Year reunion dinner carries on.

entries.example: 她去年晉升為部門經理。
entries.examplePinyin: tā qù nián jìn shēng wéi bù mén jīng lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: She was promoted to department manager last year.
entries.question: 你覺得在公司晉升最重要的是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zài gōng sī jìn shēng zuì zhòng yào de shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think matters most for getting promoted at work?
entries.answer: 我覺得想晉升，最重要的是能力。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de xiǎng jìn shēng, zuì zhòng yào de shì néng lì.
entries.answerEnglish: I think ability matters most if you want to be promoted.

entries.english: swirl; spin around; go in circles
entries.example: 落葉在風中不停地打轉。
entries.examplePinyin: luò yè zài fēng zhōng bù tíng dì dǎ zhuǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Fallen leaves keep swirling in the wind.
entries.question: 遇到難題時，你會一直在原地打轉嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: yù dào nán tí shí, nǐ huì yì zhí zài yuán dì dǎ zhuǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you face a tough problem, do you keep going in circles?
entries.answer: 會，我常常想太多，一直在原地打轉。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng cháng xiǎng tài duō, yì zhí zài yuán dì dǎ zhuǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often overthink and just go around in circles.

entries.example: 警察正在調查這件殺人案。
entries.examplePinyin: jǐng chá zhèng zài diào chá zhè jiàn shā rén àn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The police are investigating this homicide case.
entries.question: 警察通常怎麼調查殺人案？
entries.questionPinyin: jǐng chá tōng cháng zěn me diào chá shā rén àn?
entries.questionEnglish: How do the police usually investigate a homicide?
entries.answer: 警察會找證人、收集證據來調查殺人案。
entries.answerPinyin: jǐng chá huì zhǎo zhèng rén, shōu jí zhèng jù lái diào chá shā rén àn.
entries.answerEnglish: They find witnesses and collect evidence to investigate homicides.

entries.example: 貪婪會讓人做出錯誤的決定。
entries.examplePinyin: tān lán huì ràng rén zuò chū cuò wù de jué dìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Greed makes people make bad decisions.
entries.question: 你覺得人為什麼會貪婪？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de rén wèi shén me huì tān lán?
entries.questionEnglish: Why do you think people become greedy?
entries.answer: 我覺得人永遠不滿足，所以會貪婪。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de rén yǒng yuǎn bù mǎn zú, suǒ yǐ huì tān lán.
entries.answerEnglish: I think people are never satisfied, so they become greedy.

entries.example: 他用無人機空拍了日月潭。
entries.examplePinyin: tā yòng wú rén jī kōng pāi le rì yuè tán.
entries.exampleEnglish: He took aerial shots of Sun Moon Lake with a drone.
entries.question: 你看過台灣的空拍影片嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò tái wān de kōng pāi yǐng piàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen aerial videos of Taiwan?
entries.answer: 看過，台灣的空拍影片很漂亮。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, tái wān de kōng pāi yǐng piàn hěn piào liang.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, aerial videos of Taiwan are beautiful.

entries.example: 連假一個人在家，覺得有點空虛。
entries.examplePinyin: lián jià yī gè rén zài jiā, jué de yǒu diǎn kōng xū.
entries.exampleEnglish: Staying home alone over the long weekend, I felt a bit empty.
entries.question: 什麼時候你會覺得空虛？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shí hòu nǐ huì jué de kōng xū?
entries.questionEnglish: When do you feel empty?
entries.answer: 下班一個人吃晚餐時，我會覺得空虛。
entries.answerPinyin: xià bān yí gè rén chī wǎn cān shí, wǒ huì jué de kōng xū.
entries.answerEnglish: I feel empty when I eat dinner alone after work.

entries.example: 我弟弟是千禧年出生的。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ dì di shì qiān xǐ nián chū shēng de.
entries.exampleEnglish: My younger brother was born in the millennium year.
entries.question: 千禧年的時候你在做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: qiān xǐ nián de shí hòu nǐ zài zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What were you doing at the millennium?
entries.answer: 千禧年的時候我還在念小學。
entries.answerPinyin: qiān xǐ nián de shí hòu wǒ hái zài niàn xiǎo xué.
entries.answerEnglish: At the millennium I was still in elementary school.

entries.example: 照慣例，公司尾牙會抽獎。
entries.examplePinyin: zhào guàn lì, gōng sī wěi yá huì chōu jiǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: As usual, there's a prize draw at the company year-end party.
entries.question: 你們公司有什麼慣例？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men gōng sī yǒu shén me guàn lì?
entries.questionEnglish: What customs does your company have?
entries.answer: 我們公司的慣例是週五一起吃午餐。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men gōng sī de guàn lì shì zhōu wǔ yī qǐ chī wǔ cān.
entries.answerEnglish: Our company's custom is to have lunch together on Fridays.

entries.example: 我們坐在沙丘上看夕陽。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zuò zài shā qiū shàng kàn xì yáng.
entries.exampleEnglish: We sat on a sand dune watching the sunset.
entries.question: 你去過有沙丘的地方嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò yǒu shā qiū de dì fāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been somewhere with sand dunes?
entries.answer: 去過，我在杜拜的沙丘上滑過沙。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, wǒ zài dù bài de shā qiū shàng huá guò shā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I went sandboarding on the dunes in Dubai.

entries.example: 我每天花很多時間做文書作業。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi tiān huā hěn duō shí jiān zuò wén shū zuò yè.
entries.exampleEnglish: I spend a lot of time on paperwork every day.
entries.question: 你的工作需要做很多文書作業嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng zuò xū yào zuò hěn duō wén shū zuò yè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your job involve a lot of paperwork?
entries.answer: 需要，我每天下午都在做文書作業。
entries.answerPinyin: xū yào, wǒ měi tiān xià wǔ dōu zài zuò wén shū zuò yè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I spend every afternoon doing paperwork.

entries.example: 我們把舊東西放在閣樓。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men bǎ jiù dōng xī fàng zài gé lóu.
entries.exampleEnglish: We keep old things in the attic.
entries.question: 你想住在有閣樓的房子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng zhù zài yǒu gé lóu de fáng zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to live in a house with an attic?
entries.answer: 想，我想把閣樓當成書房。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, wǒ xiǎng bǎ gé lóu dàng chéng shū fáng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to turn the attic into a study.

entries.example: 爺爺喜歡坐在扶手椅上看報紙。
entries.examplePinyin: yé ye xǐ huan zuò zài fú shǒu yǐ shàng kàn bào zhǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Grandpa likes reading the paper in his armchair.
entries.question: 你家有扶手椅嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yǒu fú shǒu yǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have an armchair at home?
entries.answer: 有，我家客廳有一張舒服的扶手椅。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiā kè tīng yǒu yì zhāng shū fú de fú shǒu yǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a comfortable armchair in my living room.

entries.example: 蚵仔煎是用牡蠣做的。
entries.examplePinyin: é zǎi jiān shì yòng mǔ lì zuò de.
entries.exampleEnglish: Oyster omelets are made with oysters.
entries.question: 你敢吃生的牡蠣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gǎn chī shēng de mǔ lì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you dare to eat raw oysters?
entries.answer: 不敢，我只吃煮熟的牡蠣。
entries.answerPinyin: bù gǎn, wǒ zhǐ chī zhǔ shú de mǔ lì.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I only eat cooked oysters.

entries.example: 大樹遮蔽了中午的陽光。
entries.examplePinyin: dà shù zhē bì le zhōng wǔ de yáng guāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The big tree blocked out the midday sun.
entries.question: 夏天出門，你用什麼遮蔽陽光？
entries.questionPinyin: xià tiān chū mén, nǐ yòng shén me zhē bì yáng guāng?
entries.questionEnglish: When you go out in summer, what do you use to block the sun?
entries.answer: 我會戴帽子、撐傘遮蔽陽光。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì dài mào zi, chēng sǎn zhē bì yáng guāng.
entries.answerEnglish: I wear a hat and use an umbrella to block the sun.

entries.example: 我們在宜蘭划獨木舟。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zài yí lán huá dú mù zhōu.
entries.exampleEnglish: We went canoeing in Yilan.
entries.question: 你划過獨木舟嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huá guò dú mù zhōu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever paddled a canoe?
entries.answer: 划過，我去年在花蓮划過獨木舟。
entries.answerPinyin: huá guò, wǒ qù nián zài huā lián huá guò dú mù zhōu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I went canoeing in Hualien last year.

entries.example: 這句話後面要加冒號。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jù huà hòu miàn yào jiā mào hào.
entries.exampleEnglish: You need a colon after this sentence.
entries.question: 寫中文的時候，你什麼時候用冒號？
entries.questionPinyin: xiě zhōng wén de shí hòu, nǐ shén me shí hòu yòng mào hào?
entries.questionEnglish: When do you use a colon when writing Chinese?
entries.answer: 引用別人說的話時，我會用冒號。
entries.answerPinyin: yǐn yòng bié rén shuō de huà shí, wǒ huì yòng mào hào.
entries.answerEnglish: I use a colon when quoting what someone said.

entries.example: 這道菜展現了台南的飲食文化。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè dào cài zhǎn xiàn le tái nán de yǐn shí wén huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: This dish showcases Tainan's food culture.
entries.question: 面試時，你會怎麼展現自己？
entries.questionPinyin: miàn shì shí, nǐ huì zěn me zhǎn xiàn zì jǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you show yourself off in a job interview?
entries.answer: 我會舉具體的例子展現我的能力。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì jǔ jù tǐ de lì zi zhǎn xiàn wǒ de néng lì.
entries.answerEnglish: I give concrete examples to show my abilities.

entries.example: 爬山的時候最好帶指南針。
entries.examplePinyin: pá shān de shí hòu zuì hǎo dài zhǐ nán zhēn.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's best to bring a compass when hiking.
entries.question: 你用過指南針嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yòng guò zhǐ nán zhēn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever used a compass?
entries.answer: 用過，我現在都用手機裡的指南針。
entries.answerPinyin: yòng guò, wǒ xiàn zài dōu yòng shǒu jī lǐ de zhǐ nán zhēn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, these days I use the compass on my phone.

entries.example: 夏天的山上有很多甲蟲。
entries.examplePinyin: xià tiān de shān shàng yǒu hěn duō jiǎ chóng.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of beetles in the mountains in summer.
entries.question: 你小時候養過甲蟲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu yǎng guò jiǎ chóng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you keep beetles as a child?
entries.answer: 養過，我養過獨角仙，是一種甲蟲。
entries.answerPinyin: yǎng guò, wǒ yǎng guò dú jiǎo xiān, shì yì zhǒng jiǎ chóng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I kept a rhinoceros beetle, which is a kind of beetle.

entries.example: 這條路凹凸不平，騎車要小心。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tiáo lù āo tū bù píng, qí chē yào xiǎo xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This road is bumpy; ride carefully.
entries.question: 你家附近有凹凸不平的路嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn yǒu āo tū bù píng de lù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there any bumpy roads near your home?
entries.answer: 有，我家前面那條路凹凸不平。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiā qián miàn nà tiáo lù āo tū bù píng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the road in front of my home is bumpy.

entries.example: 新娘戴著白色的面紗。
entries.examplePinyin: xīn niáng dài zhe bái sè de miàn shā.
entries.exampleEnglish: The bride is wearing a white veil.
entries.question: 你參加過新娘戴面紗的婚禮嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān jiā guò xīn niáng dài miàn shā de hūn lǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to a wedding where the bride wore a veil?
entries.answer: 參加過，新娘戴的面紗很漂亮。
entries.answerPinyin: cān jiā guò, xīn niáng dài de miàn shā hěn piào liang.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the bride's veil was beautiful.

entries.example: 台灣的電壓是一百一十伏特。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān de diàn yā shì yì bǎi yī shí fú tè.
entries.exampleEnglish: The voltage in Taiwan is 110 volts.
entries.question: 出國的時候，你會注意電壓嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: chū guó de shí hòu, nǐ huì zhù yì diàn yā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you pay attention to voltage when you go abroad?
entries.answer: 會，我出國前會先查當地的電壓。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ chū guó qián huì xiān chá dāng dì de diàn yā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I check the local voltage before I travel.

entries.example: 警察正在查明車禍的原因。
entries.examplePinyin: jǐng chá zhèng zài chá míng chē huò de yuán yīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The police are trying to establish the cause of the accident.
entries.question: 電腦壞了，你會怎麼查明原因？
entries.questionPinyin: diàn nǎo huài le, nǐ huì zěn me chá míng yuán yīn?
entries.questionEnglish: If your computer breaks, how do you find out why?
entries.answer: 我會請工程師幫我查明原因。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì qǐng gōng chéng shī bāng wǒ chá míng yuán yīn.
entries.answerEnglish: I ask a technician to find out what's wrong.

entries.example: 我和我的同事個性互補。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ hé wǒ de tóng shì gè xìng hù bǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: My coworker and I have complementary personalities.
entries.question: 你和你的另一半個性互補嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ hé nǐ de lìng yí bàn gè xìng hù bǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you and your partner have complementary personalities?
entries.answer: 很互補，我比較急，他比較有耐心。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn hù bǔ, wǒ bǐ jiào jí, tā bǐ jiào yǒu nài xīn.
entries.answerEnglish: Very much; I'm impatient and he's patient.

entries.example: 出國旅行要準備好應付意外狀況。
entries.examplePinyin: chū guó lǚ xíng yào zhǔn bèi hǎo yìng fù yì wài zhuàng kuàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: When traveling abroad, be ready to handle the unexpected.
entries.question: 旅行時你遇過什麼意外狀況？
entries.questionPinyin: lǚ xíng shí nǐ yù guò shén me yì wài zhuàng kuàng?
entries.questionEnglish: What unexpected situations have you run into while traveling?
entries.answer: 我遇過班機被取消的意外狀況。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yù guò bān jī bèi qǔ xiāo de yì wài zhuàng kuàng.
entries.answerEnglish: I once had my flight canceled unexpectedly.

entries.example: 天氣冷的時候，血管會收縮。
entries.examplePinyin: tiān qì lěng de shí hòu, xiě guǎn huì shōu suō.
entries.exampleEnglish: Blood vessels contract when it's cold.
entries.question: 重訓時，你感覺得到肌肉收縮嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zhòng xùn shí, nǐ gǎn jué de dào jī ròu shōu suō ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you feel your muscles contract when you lift weights?
entries.answer: 感覺得到，舉重時肌肉收縮很明顯。
entries.answerPinyin: gǎn jué de dào, jǔ zhòng shí jī ròu shōu suō hěn míng xiǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, you can clearly feel the muscles contract when lifting.

entries.example: 中文一個字就是一個音節。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōng wén yí gè zì jiù shì yí gè yīn jié.
entries.exampleEnglish: In Chinese, each character is one syllable.
entries.question: 你的名字有幾個音節？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de míng zì yǒu jǐ gè yīn jié?
entries.questionEnglish: How many syllables are in your name?
entries.answer: 我的英文名字有三個音節。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de yīng wén míng zì yǒu sān gè yīn jié.
entries.answerEnglish: My English name has three syllables.

entries.example: 安排行程時要留一點緩衝時間。
entries.examplePinyin: ān pái xíng chéng shí yào liú yì diǎn huǎn chōng shí jiān.
entries.exampleEnglish: Leave some buffer time when you plan your schedule.
entries.question: 跟別人約見面，你會留緩衝時間嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: gēn bié rén yuē jiàn miàn, nǐ huì liú huǎn chōng shí jiān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you leave buffer time when meeting someone?
entries.answer: 會，我都會留十分鐘的緩衝時間。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōu huì liú shí fēn zhōng de huǎn chōng shí jiān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always leave ten minutes of buffer time.

entries.english: trigger; set off; give rise to
entries.example: 這則新聞引發了很多討論。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zé xīn wén yǐn fā le hěn duō tǎo lùn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This news story sparked a lot of discussion.
entries.question: 最近有什麼新聞引發很多討論？
entries.questionPinyin: zuì jìn yǒu shén me xīn wén yǐn fā hěn duō tǎo lùn?
entries.questionEnglish: What recent news has sparked a lot of discussion?
entries.answer: 電費要漲的新聞引發了很多討論。
entries.answerPinyin: diàn fèi yào zhǎng de xīn wén yǐn fā le hěn duō tǎo lùn.
entries.answerEnglish: The news about rising electricity prices sparked a lot of discussion.

entries.example: 這是一場網路購物的騙局。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shì yì chǎng wǎng lù gòu wù de piàn jú.
entries.exampleEnglish: This is an online shopping scam.
entries.question: 怎麼避免掉進網路騙局？
entries.questionPinyin: zěn me bì miǎn diào jìn wǎng lù piàn jú?
entries.questionEnglish: How can you avoid falling for online scams?
entries.answer: 不要隨便匯錢，才不會掉進騙局。
entries.answerPinyin: bú yào suí biàn huì qián, cái bú huì diào jìn piàn jú.
entries.answerEnglish: Don't wire money casually and you won't fall for scams.

entries.example: 兩台機車在路口相撞。
entries.examplePinyin: liǎng tái jī chē zài lù kǒu xiāng zhuàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Two scooters collided at the intersection.
entries.question: 走路滑手機時，你差點跟人相撞過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zǒu lù huá shǒu jī shí, nǐ chà diǎn gēn rén xiāng zhuàng guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever nearly bumped into someone while looking at your phone?
entries.answer: 有，我在捷運站差點跟人相撞。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ zài jié yùn zhàn chà diǎn gēn rén xiāng zhuàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I nearly collided with someone in an MRT station.

entries.example: 這家餐廳的裝潢很高雅。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā cān tīng de zhuāng huáng hěn gāo yǎ.
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant's décor is very elegant.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼樣的穿著很高雅？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me yàng de chuān zhuó hěn gāo yǎ?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of outfit do you find elegant?
entries.answer: 我覺得簡單的黑色洋裝很高雅。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de jiǎn dān de hēi sè yáng zhuāng hěn gāo yǎ.
entries.answerEnglish: I think a simple black dress is very elegant.

entries.example: 比起外表，我更在乎一個人的內在。
entries.examplePinyin: bǐ qǐ wài biǎo, wǒ gèng zài hū yí gè rén de nèi zài.
entries.exampleEnglish: I care more about a person's inner qualities than their looks.
entries.question: 你覺得外表重要還是內在重要？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de wài biǎo zhòng yào hái shì nèi zài zhòng yào?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think looks or inner qualities matter more?
entries.answer: 我覺得內在比較重要。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de nèi zài bǐ jiào zhòng yào.
entries.answerEnglish: I think inner qualities matter more.

entries.example: 爸爸收到一瓶白蘭地當禮物。
entries.examplePinyin: bà ba shōu dào yì píng bái lán dì dāng lǐ wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: Dad received a bottle of brandy as a gift.
entries.question: 你喝過白蘭地嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ hē guò bái lán dì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had brandy?
entries.answer: 喝過，可是我覺得白蘭地太烈了。
entries.answerPinyin: hē guò, kě shì wǒ jué de bái lán dì tài liè le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but I find brandy too strong.

entries.example: 這篇報導的內容不符合事實。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè piān bào dǎo de nèi róng bù fú hé shì shí.
entries.exampleEnglish: The content of this report isn't factual.
entries.question: 你怎麼知道網路新聞符合事實？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zěn me zhī dào wǎng lù xīn wén fú hé shì shí?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you know online news is factual?
entries.answer: 我會多看幾家媒體，確定符合事實。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì duō kàn jǐ jiā méi tǐ, què dìng fú hé shì shí.
entries.answerEnglish: I check several outlets to make sure it's factual.

entries.example: 在山上要學會辨別方向。
entries.examplePinyin: zài shān shàng yào xué huì biàn bié fāng xiàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: In the mountains you need to know how to get your bearings.
entries.question: 沒有手機的時候，你能辨別方向嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: méi yǒu shǒu jī de shí hòu, nǐ néng biàn bié fāng xiàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you find your way without your phone?
entries.answer: 不太能，沒有手機我很難辨別方向。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài néng, méi yǒu shǒu jī wǒ hěn nán biàn bié fāng xiàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really; without my phone it's hard to get my bearings.

entries.example: 老鷹在天空中滑翔。
entries.examplePinyin: lǎo yīng zài tiān kōng zhōng huá xiáng.
entries.exampleEnglish: An eagle is gliding in the sky.
entries.question: 你想去玩滑翔傘嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng qù wán huá xiáng sǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to try paragliding?
entries.answer: 想，我想去宜蘭玩滑翔傘。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, wǒ xiǎng qù yí lán wán huá xiáng sǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I want to go paragliding in Yilan.

entries.example: 今天霧很大，能見度很低。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn tiān wù hěn dà, néng jiàn dù hěn dī.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's very foggy today and visibility is low.
entries.question: 能見度很低的時候，你還會開車嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: néng jiàn dù hěn dī de shí hòu, nǐ hái huì kāi chē ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you still drive when visibility is very low?
entries.answer: 不會，能見度太低我就不開車。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, néng jiàn dù tài dī wǒ jiù bù kāi chē.
entries.answerEnglish: No, if visibility is too low I don't drive.

entries.example: 他們兩個在工作上常常有摩擦。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men liǎng gè zài gōng zuò shàng cháng cháng yǒu mó cā.
entries.exampleEnglish: Those two often have friction at work.
entries.question: 你跟室友有過摩擦嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gēn shì yǒu yǒu guò mó cā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had friction with a roommate?
entries.answer: 有，我們會因為打掃的事起摩擦。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men huì yīn wèi dǎ sǎo de shì qǐ mó cā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we have friction over cleaning.

entries.example: 這個背包是尼龍做的，很輕。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge bēi bāo shì ní lóng zuò de, hěn qīng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This backpack is made of nylon; it's very light.
entries.question: 你的包包是什麼材質的？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de bāo bāo shì shén me cái zhí de?
entries.questionEnglish: What material is your bag made of?
entries.answer: 我的包包是尼龍的，下雨也不怕。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de bāo bāo shì ní lóng de, xià yǔ yě bú pà.
entries.answerEnglish: My bag is nylon, so rain doesn't bother it.

entries.example: 河邊長了很多蘆葦。
entries.examplePinyin: hé biān zhǎng le hěn duō lú wěi.
entries.exampleEnglish: Lots of reeds grow along the river.
entries.question: 你在哪裡看過蘆葦？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài nǎ lǐ kàn guò lú wěi?
entries.questionEnglish: Where have you seen reeds?
entries.answer: 我在關渡的河邊看過很多蘆葦。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài guān dù de hé biān kàn guò hěn duō lú wěi.
entries.answerEnglish: I've seen lots of reeds by the river in Guandu.

entries.example: 半夜突然聽到救護車的警笛聲。
entries.examplePinyin: bàn yè tú rán tīng dào jiù hù chē de jǐng dí shēng.
entries.exampleEnglish: In the middle of the night I suddenly heard an ambulance siren.
entries.question: 你家附近常聽到警笛聲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn cháng tīng dào jǐng dí shēng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often hear sirens near your home?
entries.answer: 常聽到，我家附近有消防隊，常有警笛聲。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng tīng dào, wǒ jiā fù jìn yǒu xiāo fáng duì, cháng yǒu jǐng dí shēng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a fire station near me, so there are often sirens.

entries.example: 我打電話向客服申訴。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ dǎ diàn huà xiàng kè fú shēn sù.
entries.exampleEnglish: I called customer service to file a complaint.
entries.question: 遇到很差的服務，你會申訴嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: yù dào hěn chà de fú wù, nǐ huì shēn sù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you file a complaint when you get bad service?
entries.answer: 會，服務太差的話我會上網申訴。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, fú wù tài chà de huà wǒ huì shàng wǎng shēn sù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, if the service is really bad I complain online.

entries.example: 這個孩子的理解力很好。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge hái zi de lǐ jiě lì hěn hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This child has very good comprehension.
entries.question: 你覺得怎麼提高中文閱讀的理解力？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zěn me tí gāo zhōng wén yuè dú de lǐ jiě lì?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you think you can improve your Chinese reading comprehension?
entries.answer: 我覺得多看中文書可以提高理解力。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de duō kàn zhōng wén shū kě yǐ tí gāo lǐ jiě lì.
entries.answerEnglish: I think reading more Chinese books improves comprehension.

entries.example: 他穿紅色外套，在人群中很顯眼。
entries.examplePinyin: tā chuān hóng sè wài tào, zài rén qún zhōng hěn xiǎn yǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: In his red jacket, he stands out in the crowd.
entries.question: 你喜歡穿顯眼的顏色嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chuān xiǎn yǎn de yán sè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like wearing eye-catching colors?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，我不喜歡太顯眼的顏色。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xǐ huan, wǒ bù xǐ huan tài xiǎn yǎn de yán sè.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't like colors that are too eye-catching.

entries.example: 他想超越自己去年的紀錄。
entries.examplePinyin: tā xiǎng chāo yuè zì jǐ qù nián de jì lù.
entries.exampleEnglish: He wants to beat his own record from last year.
entries.question: 你有想超越的目標嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu xiǎng chāo yuè de mù biāo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a goal you want to surpass?
entries.answer: 有，我想超越我去年的馬拉松成績。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ xiǎng chāo yuè wǒ qù nián de mǎ lā sōng chéng jī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I want to beat my marathon time from last year.

entries.example: 她是一個很感性的人。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì yí gè hěn gǎn xìng de rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's a very sensitive, emotional person.
entries.question: 你覺得自己比較感性還是理性？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ bǐ jiào gǎn xìng hái shì lǐ xìng?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're more emotional or rational?
entries.answer: 我覺得我比較感性，看電影常常哭。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de wǒ bǐ jiào gǎn xìng, kàn diàn yǐng cháng cháng kū.
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm more emotional; I often cry at movies.

entries.example: 球迷們揮動著手上的旗子。
entries.examplePinyin: qiú mí men huī dòng zhe shǒu shàng de qí zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: The fans are waving the flags in their hands.
entries.question: 看棒球比賽時，你會揮動加油棒嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: kàn bàng qiú bǐ sài shí, nǐ huì huī dòng jiā yóu bàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you wave cheer sticks at baseball games?
entries.answer: 會，我會跟著大家一起揮動加油棒。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì gēn zhe dà jiā yì qǐ huī dòng jiā yóu bàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I wave my cheer sticks along with everyone.

entries.example: 我哥哥大學時參加了摔角隊。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ gē ge dà xué shí cān jiā le shuāi jiǎo duì.

entries.question: 你看過摔角比賽嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò shuāi jiǎo bǐ sài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever watched a wrestling match?
entries.answer: 看過，我在電視上看過摔角比賽。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài diàn shì shàng kàn guò shuāi jiǎo bǐ sài.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've watched wrestling on TV.

entries.example: 陽明山上的樹木很茂盛。
entries.examplePinyin: yáng míng shān shàng de shù mù hěn mào shèng.

entries.question: 你種的植物長得茂盛嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhòng de zhí wù zhǎng de mào shèng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are the plants you grow lush?
entries.answer: 很茂盛，我陽台的植物長得很好。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn mào shèng, wǒ yáng tái de zhí wù zhǎng de hěn hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Very lush; the plants on my balcony are doing great.

entries.example: 謝謝光顧，歡迎再來！
entries.examplePinyin: xiè xiè guāng gù, huān yíng zài lái!
entries.exampleEnglish: Thank you for your patronage; please come again!
entries.question: 你最常光顧哪家早餐店？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì cháng guāng gù nǎ jiā zǎo cān diàn?
entries.questionEnglish: Which breakfast shop do you go to most?
entries.answer: 我最常光顧我家樓下的早餐店。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì cháng guāng gù wǒ jiā lóu xià de zǎo cān diàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I go to the breakfast shop downstairs from my place most.

entries.example: 生魚沒處理好，可能會有寄生蟲。
entries.examplePinyin: shēng yú méi chǔ lǐ hǎo, kě néng huì yǒu jì shēng chóng.

entries.questionPinyin: zěn me bì miǎn chī dào jì shēng chóng?
entries.questionEnglish: How can you avoid eating parasites?
entries.answer: 肉要煮熟，才不會吃到寄生蟲。
entries.answerPinyin: ròu yào zhǔ shú, cái bú huì chī dào jì shēng chóng.
entries.answerEnglish: Cook meat thoroughly so you don't eat parasites.

entries.example: 語言常常是在國外工作的阻礙。
entries.examplePinyin: yǔ yán cháng cháng shì zài guó wài gōng zuò de zǔ ài.
entries.exampleEnglish: Language is often an obstacle to working abroad.
entries.question: 你覺得學中文最大的阻礙是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de xué zhōng wén zuì dà de zǔ ài shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is the biggest obstacle to learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 我覺得聲調是最大的阻礙。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de shēng diào shì zuì dà de zǔ ài.
entries.answerEnglish: I think tones are the biggest obstacle.

entries.example: 爸爸每個月都把菜刀磨利。
entries.examplePinyin: bà ba měi gè yuè dōu bǎ cài dāo mó lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Dad sharpens the kitchen knife every month.
entries.question: 你會自己把刀磨利嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zì jǐ bǎ dāo mó lì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you sharpen your knives yourself?
entries.answer: 不會，我都請市場的師傅幫我把刀磨利。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ dōu qǐng shì chǎng de shī fu bāng wǒ bǎ dāo mó lì.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I have a guy at the market sharpen them for me.

entries.example: 中秋節烤肉要先買木炭。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōng qiū jié kǎo ròu yào xiān mǎi mù tàn.

entries.question: 中秋節你會用木炭烤肉嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zhōng qiū jié nǐ huì yòng mù tàn kǎo ròu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you barbecue with charcoal at the Moon Festival?
entries.answer: 會，我們家都用木炭烤肉。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ men jiā dōu yòng mù tàn kǎo ròu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my family always barbecues with charcoal.

entries.example: 這條山路很崎嶇，開車要小心。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tiáo shān lù hěn qí qū, kāi chē yào xiǎo xīn.

entries.question: 你走過崎嶇的山路嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zǒu guò qí qū de shān lù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever traveled a rugged mountain road?
entries.answer: 走過，去合歡山的路很崎嶇。
entries.answerPinyin: zǒu guò, qù hé huān shān de lù hěn qí qū.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the road to Hehuanshan is very rugged.

entries.example: 我的襯衫袖口髒了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de chèn shān xiù kǒu zāng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: My shirt cuffs are dirty.
entries.question: 天氣熱時，你會把袖口捲起來嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: tiān qì rè shí, nǐ huì bǎ xiù kǒu juǎn qǐ lái ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you roll up your cuffs when it's hot?
entries.answer: 會，天氣熱我會把袖口捲起來。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, tiān qì rè wǒ huì bǎ xiù kǒu juǎn qǐ lái.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I roll up my cuffs when it's hot.

entries.example: 這家咖啡店的店主很親切。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā kā fēi diàn de diàn zhǔ hěn qīn qiè.
entries.exampleEnglish: The owner of this café is very friendly.
entries.question: 你跟常去的店的店主熟嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gēn cháng qù de diàn de diàn zhǔ shú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know the owners of the shops you go to often?
entries.answer: 很熟，早餐店的店主都記得我點什麼。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn shú, zǎo cān diàn de diàn zhǔ dōu jì de wǒ diǎn shén me.
entries.answerEnglish: Very well; the breakfast shop owner remembers my order.

entries.example: 颱風過後，大水慢慢退去。
entries.examplePinyin: tái fēng guò hòu, dà shuǐ màn màn tuì qù.
entries.exampleEnglish: After the typhoon, the floodwater slowly receded.
entries.question: 潮水退去後，你喜歡去海邊做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: cháo shuǐ tuì qù hòu, nǐ xǐ huan qù hǎi biān zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you like doing at the beach after the tide goes out?
entries.answer: 潮水退去後，我喜歡去撿貝殼。
entries.answerPinyin: cháo shuǐ tuì qù hòu, wǒ xǐ huan qù jiǎn bèi ké.
entries.answerEnglish: After the tide goes out, I like collecting shells.

entries.example: 河濱公園裡有很多單車騎士。
entries.examplePinyin: hé bīn gōng yuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō dān chē qí shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of cyclists in the riverside park.
entries.question: 你覺得台北對單車騎士友善嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái běi duì dān chē qí shì yǒu shàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taipei is friendly to cyclists?
entries.answer: 我覺得河濱公園對單車騎士很友善。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de hé bīn gōng yuán duì dān chē qí shì hěn yǒu shàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I think the riverside parks are very cyclist-friendly.

entries.example: 他還穿著那件破爛的外套。
entries.examplePinyin: tā hái chuān zhe nà jiàn pò làn de wài tào.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's still wearing that tattered jacket.
entries.question: 衣服破爛了，你還會留著嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: yī fu pò làn le, nǐ hái huì liú zhe ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you keep clothes once they're worn out?
entries.answer: 不會，衣服破爛了我就丟掉。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, yī fu pò làn le wǒ jiù diū diào.
entries.answerEnglish: No, once clothes are worn out I throw them away.

entries.examplePinyin: xià yǔ tiān lù miàn shī huá, qí chē yào xiǎo xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Roads are slippery on rainy days, so ride carefully.
entries.question: 下雨天走在濕滑的路上，你會怎麼做？
entries.questionPinyin: xià yǔ tiān zǒu zài shī huá de lù shang, nǐ huì zěn me zuò?

entries.answer: 我會走慢一點，因為路面濕滑容易跌倒。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì zǒu màn yì diǎn, yīn wèi lù miàn shī huá róng yì dié dǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: I walk slower, because it's easy to fall on slippery ground.

entries.example: 我們爬到山頂看火山口。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men pá dào shān dǐng kàn huǒ shān kǒu.

entries.answer: 看過，我在印尼看過冒煙的火山口。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài yìn ní kàn guò mào yān de huǒ shān kǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw a smoking crater in Indonesia.

entries.examplePinyin: tài yáng chū lái hòu, dì shàng de shuǐ dōu zhēng fā le.
entries.exampleEnglish: Once the sun came out, the water on the ground evaporated.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de xīn shuǐ shì bu shì yí xià zi jiù zhēng fā le?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your salary vanish in no time?
entries.answer: 對啊，繳完房租，我的薪水就蒸發了。
entries.answerPinyin: duì a, jiǎo wán fáng zū, wǒ de xīn shuǐ jiù zhēng fā le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, once I pay rent my salary just evaporates.

entries.english: wavelength; being on the same wavelength
entries.example: 我跟他很聊得來，我們波長很合。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ gēn tā hěn liáo de lái, wǒ men bō cháng hěn hé.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gēn shéi de bō cháng zuì hé?

entries.answer: 我跟大學室友的波長最合。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ gēn dà xué shì yǒu de bō cháng zuì hé.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm most on the same wavelength as my college roommate.

entries.examplePinyin: dòng wù yuán de wéi lán lǐ yǒu liǎng zhī lǎo hǔ.

entries.answer: 會，我會靠近圍欄拍長頸鹿。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì kào jìn wéi lán pāi cháng jǐng lù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I get close to the fence to photograph the giraffes.

entries.examplePinyin: zhè shì wǒ de shū hū, zhēn de hěn bào qiàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: That was my oversight; I'm really sorry.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gōng zuò shàng yǒu guò shén me shū hū ma?

entries.answer: 有，因為疏忽，我寄錯信給客戶。

entries.answerEnglish: Yes, through an oversight I sent an email to the wrong client.

entries.examplePinyin: qǐng shū rù jiǎn xùn lǐ de yàn zhèng mǎ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please enter the verification code from the text message.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yòng wǎng lù yín háng shí cháng xū yào yàn zhèng ma?

entries.answer: 需要，每次登入都要驗證身分。

entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge fāng fǎ de xiào guǒ hěn xiǎn zhù.

entries.questionPinyin: xué zhōng wén yǐ hòu, nǐ yǒu shén me xiǎn zhù de jìn bù?
entries.questionEnglish: Since learning Chinese, what notable progress have you made?
entries.answer: 我的聽力有很顯著的進步。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de tīng lì yǒu hěn xiǎn zhù de jìn bù.

entries.examplePinyin: zhè yì qū zhù de dōu shì fù yù de jiā tíng.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de fù yù de shēng huó yí dìng kuài lè ma?

entries.answer: 我覺得富裕的生活不一定快樂。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de fù yù de shēng huó bù yí dìng kuài lè.
entries.answerEnglish: I don't think an affluent life is necessarily happy.

entries.examplePinyin: nóng chǎng lǐ de gōng yáng yǒu hěn dà de jiǎo.

entries.questionPinyin: qù nóng chǎng shí, nǐ gǎn mō gōng yáng ma?

entries.answer: 不敢，公羊看起來有點兇。

entries.answerEnglish: No, rams look a bit fierce.

entries.answer: 我知道朱銘，他是台灣有名的雕刻家。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhī dào zhū míng, tā shì tái wān yǒu míng de diāo kè jiā.
entries.answerEnglish: I know Ju Ming; he's a famous Taiwanese sculptor.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn bù qīng chǔ de shí hòu huì mī yǎn ma?

entries.answer: 會，沒戴眼鏡時我常常瞇眼。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, méi dài yǎn jìng shí wǒ cháng cháng mī yǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often squint when I'm not wearing my glasses.

entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ de zhǐ jiān yí dào dōng tiān jiù hěn bīng.

entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ nǐ yǒu yí gè jīn kù, nǐ huì fàng shén me?

entries.answerEnglish: I'd keep my important documents in the vault.

entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiā bàn jìng wǔ bǎi gōng chǐ nèi jiù yǒu yí gè jié yùn zhàn.

entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng zài jiǎng yí gè fù zhì rén de gù shì.

entries.questionEnglish: Do you like symmetrical designs?
entries.answer: 喜歡，對稱的東西看起來很舒服。

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qí chē shí huì dài kǒu zhào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you wear a mask when you ride a scooter?
entries.answer: 會，我不想吸入太多廢氣。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ bù xiǎng xī rù tài duō fèi qì.

entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā kā fēi tīng de zhuāng huáng hěn huái jiù.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan huái jiù de lǎo gē ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like nostalgic old songs?
entries.answer: 喜歡，懷舊的老歌讓我想起小時候。

entries.question: 你覺得台灣哪種小吃勝過你國家的？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān nǎ zhǒng xiǎo chī shèng guò nǐ guó jiā de?
entries.questionEnglish: Which Taiwanese snack do you think beats the ones in your country?
entries.answer: 我覺得台灣的珍奶勝過我們那裡的。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de tái wān de zhēn nǎi shèng guò wǒ men nà lǐ de.
entries.answerEnglish: I think Taiwan's bubble tea beats ours.

entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge jī jīn huì zhuān mén zhào gù gū ér.

entries.answer: 可以捐錢給照顧孤兒的機構。
entries.answerPinyin: kě yǐ juān qián gěi zhào gù gū ér de jī gòu.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò guò mù fá ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been on a raft?
entries.answer: 坐過，我在湖上坐過木筏。
entries.answerPinyin: zuò guò, wǒ zài hú shàng zuò guò mù fá.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've been on a raft on a lake.

entries.examplePinyin: wǒ ā gōng zhù zài xiāng xià de yì jiān píng fáng.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zhù píng fáng hái shì dà lóu?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you rather live in a single-storey house or an apartment building?
entries.answer: 我喜歡住平房，比較安靜。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan zhù píng fáng, bǐ jiào ān jìng.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd rather live in a single-storey house; it's quieter.

entries.example: 停電了，我在黑暗中摸索手機。

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gāng lái tái wān shí, hěn duō shì yào zì jǐ mō suǒ ma?

entries.answer: 對，搭公車和看醫生都要自己摸索。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, dā gōng chē hé kàn yī shēng dōu yào zì jǐ mō suǒ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I had to figure out the buses and seeing a doctor on my own.

entries.examplePinyin: bān jiā shì yí jiàn hěn fèi lì de shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Moving house is very strenuous work.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼家事最費力？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me jiā shì zuì fèi lì?
entries.questionEnglish: Which household chore do you think is the most strenuous?
entries.answer: 我覺得拖地最費力。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de tuō dì zuì fèi lì.

entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to go into space in a space capsule?
entries.answer: 想，坐太空艙一定很酷。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, zuò tài kōng cāng yí dìng hěn kù.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò yīng huā huā bàn luò xià lái ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen cherry blossom petals falling?
entries.answer: 看過，櫻花花瓣落下來很漂亮。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, yīng huā huā bàn luò xià lái hěn piào liang.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, falling cherry blossom petals are beautiful.

entries.example: 我們週末去參觀了一家啤酒廠。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zhōu mò qù cān guān le yì jiā pí jiǔ chǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: We visited a brewery at the weekend.
entries.question: 你參觀過啤酒廠嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān guān guò pí jiǔ chǎng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever visited a brewery?
entries.answer: 參觀過，我去過台北的建國啤酒廠。
entries.answerPinyin: cān guān guò, wǒ qù guò tái běi de jiàn guó pí jiǔ chǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've been to the Jianguo Brewery in Taipei.

entries.example: 我們在冰島看到了好大的冰河。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zài bīng dǎo kàn dào le hǎo dà de bīng hé.
entries.exampleEnglish: We saw a huge glacier in Iceland.
entries.question: 你親眼看過冰河嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qīn yǎn kàn guò bīng hé ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen a glacier with your own eyes?
entries.answer: 看過，我在紐西蘭看過冰河。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài niǔ xī lán kàn guò bīng hé.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw a glacier in New Zealand.

entries.example: 這條老街上有很多可愛的壁畫。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tiáo lǎo jiē shàng yǒu hěn duō kě ài de bì huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of cute murals on this old street.
entries.question: 你在台灣看過漂亮的壁畫嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān kàn guò piào liang de bì huà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen beautiful murals in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 看過，台中的彩虹眷村有很多壁畫。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, tái zhōng de cǎi hóng juàn cūn yǒu hěn duō bì huà.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, Rainbow Village in Taichung has lots of murals.

entries.example: 這艘太空船明年要飛去月球。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè sāo tài kōng chuán míng nián yào fēi qù yuè qiú.
entries.exampleEnglish: This spacecraft will fly to the moon next year.
entries.question: 如果可以，你想坐太空船去哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ kě yǐ, nǐ xiǎng zuò tài kōng chuán qù nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: If you could, where would you go in a spacecraft?
entries.answer: 我想坐太空船去火星看看。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng zuò tài kōng chuán qù huǒ xīng kàn kàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to take a spaceship to Mars.

entries.example: 奶奶送了我一個玉手鐲。
entries.examplePinyin: nǎi nai sòng le wǒ yí gè yù shǒu zhuó.
entries.exampleEnglish: Grandma gave me a jade bangle.
entries.question: 你喜歡戴手鐲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan dài shǒu zhuó ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like wearing bracelets?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常戴一個銀手鐲。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ cháng dài yí gè yín shǒu zhuó.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often wear a silver bangle.

entries.example: 他背著降落傘跳下飛機。
entries.examplePinyin: tā bēi zhe jiàng luò sǎn tiào xià fēi jī.
entries.exampleEnglish: He jumped out of the plane with a parachute on his back.
entries.question: 你敢背降落傘從飛機上跳下來嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gǎn bēi jiàng luò sǎn cóng fēi jī shàng tiào xià lái ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you dare jump out of a plane with a parachute?
entries.answer: 不敢，就算有降落傘我也怕。
entries.answerPinyin: bù gǎn, jiù suàn yǒu jiàng luò sǎn wǒ yě pà.
entries.answerEnglish: No way; even with a parachute I'd be scared.

entries.example: 我們租了一輛吉普車上山。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zū le yí liàng jí pǔ chē shàng shān.
entries.exampleEnglish: We rented a jeep to drive up the mountain.
entries.question: 你開過吉普車嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kāi guò jí pǔ chē ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever driven a jeep?
entries.answer: 開過，我在美國開過吉普車。
entries.answerPinyin: kāi guò, wǒ zài měi guó kāi guò jí pǔ chē.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've driven a jeep in the US.

entries.example: 這個週末有一場花卉展覽。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge zhōu mò yǒu yì chǎng huā huì zhǎn lǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a flower exhibition this weekend.
entries.question: 你喜歡逛花卉市場嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan guàng huā huì shì chǎng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like browsing flower markets?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我週末常去花卉市場。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ zhōu mò cháng qù huā huì shì chǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often go to the flower market at weekends.

entries.example: 我在牛奶裡加了一匙可可粉。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài niú nǎi lǐ jiā le yì chí kě kě fěn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I added a spoonful of cocoa powder to my milk.
entries.question: 你喝熱牛奶會加可可粉嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ hē rè niú nǎi huì jiā kě kě fěn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you add cocoa powder to hot milk?
entries.answer: 會，加可可粉比較好喝。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, jiā kě kě fěn bǐ jiào hǎo hē.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, it tastes better with cocoa powder.

entries.example: 早上我會把百葉窗打開。
entries.examplePinyin: zǎo shàng wǒ huì bǎ bǎi yè chuāng dǎ kāi.
entries.exampleEnglish: In the morning I open the blinds.
entries.question: 你的房間有百葉窗嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de fáng jiān yǒu bǎi yè chuāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your room have blinds?
entries.answer: 有，我的房間裝了百葉窗。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de fáng jiān zhuāng le bǎi yè chuāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my room has blinds.

entries.example: 我剛開始學用筷子時很笨拙。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ gāng kāi shǐ xué yòng kuài zi shí hěn bèn zhuó.
entries.exampleEnglish: When I first started learning to use chopsticks, I was very clumsy.
entries.question: 你做什麼事的時候很笨拙？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò shén me shì de shí hòu hěn bèn zhuó?
entries.questionEnglish: What are you clumsy at?
entries.answer: 我包水餃的時候很笨拙。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bāo shuǐ jiǎo de shí hòu hěn bèn zhuó.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm clumsy at wrapping dumplings.

entries.example: 週末我喜歡一個人獨處。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōu mò wǒ xǐ huan yí gè rén dú chǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: At weekends I like to spend time alone.
entries.question: 你喜歡獨處嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan dú chǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like being alone?
entries.answer: 喜歡，獨處讓我很放鬆。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, dú chǔ ràng wǒ hěn fàng sōng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, being alone relaxes me.

entries.example: 下班時間，這條路的交通常常阻塞。
entries.examplePinyin: xià bān shí jiān, zhè tiáo lù de jiāo tōng cháng cháng zǔ sè.
entries.exampleEnglish: At rush hour, the traffic on this road is often congested.
entries.question: 你上班的路上交通會阻塞嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shàng bān de lù shang jiāo tōng huì zǔ sè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is traffic congested on your way to work?
entries.answer: 會，早上八點交通常常阻塞。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, zǎo shàng bā diǎn jiāo tōng cháng cháng zǔ sè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, traffic is often congested at 8 a.m.

entries.example: 會議一直拖長，大家都想回家了。
entries.examplePinyin: huì yì yì zhí tuō cháng, dà jiā dōu xiǎng huí jiā le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The meeting kept dragging on, and everyone wanted to go home.
entries.question: 開會時間拖長，你會覺得很煩嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: kāi huì shí jiān tuō cháng, nǐ huì jué de hěn fán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does it annoy you when meetings drag on?
entries.answer: 會，開會拖長我就會很餓。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, kāi huì tuō cháng wǒ jiù huì hěn è.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when meetings drag on I get really hungry.

entries.example: 樹上停著一隻黑色的烏鴉。
entries.examplePinyin: shù shàng tíng zhe yì zhī hēi sè de wū yā.
entries.exampleEnglish: A black crow is perched in the tree.
entries.question: 你的家鄉烏鴉多嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de jiā xiāng wū yā duō ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there many crows in your hometown?
entries.answer: 很多，我家附近常常有烏鴉。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn duō, wǒ jiā fù jìn cháng cháng yǒu wū yā.
entries.answerEnglish: Lots; there are often crows near my home.

entries.example: 當局要求大家颱風天不要出門。
entries.examplePinyin: dāng jú yāo qiú dà jiā tái fēng tiān bú yào chū mén.
entries.exampleEnglish: The authorities asked everyone to stay indoors during the typhoon.
entries.question: 你覺得當局處理颱風的方式好嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de dāng jú chǔ lǐ tái fēng de fāng shì hǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think the authorities handle typhoons well?
entries.answer: 我覺得很好，當局都會提早通知大家放颱風假。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de hěn hǎo, dāng jú dōu huì tí zǎo tōng zhī dà jiā fàng tái fēng jià.
entries.answerEnglish: I think so. The authorities always announce typhoon days off early.

entries.example: 市議會今天討論捷運的新路線。
entries.examplePinyin: shì yì huì jīn tiān tǎo lùn jié yùn de xīn lù xiàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The city council discussed the new MRT line today.
entries.question: 你看過議會開會的新聞嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò yì huì kāi huì de xīn wén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen news coverage of council meetings?
entries.answer: 看過，議會裡常常吵得很兇。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, yì huì lǐ cháng cháng chǎo de hěn xiōng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. There are often fierce arguments in the council.

entries.example: 他把公司的股份賣給了朋友。
entries.examplePinyin: tā bǎ gōng sī de gǔ fèn mài gěi le péng yǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: He sold his shares in the company to a friend.
entries.question: 你想買哪家公司的股份？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng mǎi nǎ jiā gōng sī de gǔ fèn?
entries.questionEnglish: Which company would you like to buy shares in?
entries.answer: 我想買台積電的股份。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng mǎi tái jī diàn de gǔ fèn.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to buy shares in TSMC.

entries.example: 大樓的管理委員會每個月開一次會。
entries.examplePinyin: dà lóu de guǎn lǐ wěi yuán huì měi gè yuè kāi yí cì huì.
entries.exampleEnglish: The building's management committee meets once a month.
entries.question: 你住的大樓有管理委員會嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhù de dà lóu yǒu guǎn lǐ wěi yuán huì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your apartment building have a management committee?
entries.answer: 有，可是我沒參加過委員會的會議。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, kě shì wǒ méi cān jiā guò wěi yuán huì de huì yì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but I've never been to a committee meeting.

entries.example: 社區公告說晚上十點以後要保持安寧。
entries.examplePinyin: shè qū gōng gào shuō wǎn shàng shí diǎn yǐ hòu yào bǎo chí ān níng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The building notice says to keep the peace and quiet after 10 p.m.
entries.question: 你住的地方晚上安寧嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhù de dì fāng wǎn shàng ān níng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is the place where you live peaceful at night?
entries.answer: 不太好，樓下夜市很吵，常常不得安寧。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài hǎo, lóu xià yè shì hěn chǎo, cháng cháng bù dé ān níng.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. The night market downstairs is loud, so I often get no peace.

entries.example: 她是這家公司的首席工程師。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì zhè jiā gōng sī de shǒu xí gōng chéng shī.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's the chief engineer at this company.
entries.question: 你的公司有首席執行長嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng sī yǒu shǒu xí zhí xíng zhǎng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company have a CEO?
entries.answer: 有，我們的首席執行長是美國人。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men de shǒu xí zhí xíng zhǎng shì měi guó rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our CEO is American.

entries.example: 美國的聯邦政府在華盛頓。
entries.examplePinyin: měi guó de lián bāng zhèng fǔ zài huá shèng dùn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The US federal government is in Washington.
entries.question: 你的國家是聯邦國家嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā shì lián bāng guó jiā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your country a federation?
entries.answer: 是，加拿大是一個聯邦國家。
entries.answerPinyin: shì, jiā ná dà shì yí gè lián bāng guó jiā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, Canada is a federal country.

entries.example: 很多人把錢拿去買房產。
entries.examplePinyin: hěn duō rén bǎ qián ná qù mǎi fáng chǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Many people put their money into property.
entries.question: 你覺得在台北買房產值得嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zài tái běi mǎi fáng chǎn zhí dé ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think buying property in Taipei is worth it?
entries.answer: 不值得，台北的房產太貴了，我寧可租房子。
entries.answerPinyin: bù zhí dé, tái běi de fáng chǎn tài guì le, wǒ nìng kě zū fáng zi.
entries.answerEnglish: It's not worth it. Property in Taipei is too expensive. I'd rather rent.

entries.example: 請你把事情的經過簡單陳述一下。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng nǐ bǎ shì qíng de jīng guò jiǎn dān chén shù yí xià.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please briefly state what happened.
entries.question: 開會的時候，你會陳述自己的意見嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: kāi huì de shí hòu, nǐ huì chén shù zì jǐ de yì jiàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: In meetings, do you state your own opinions?
entries.answer: 會，我會清楚陳述我的想法。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì qīng chǔ chén shù wǒ de xiǎng fǎ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I state my ideas clearly.

entries.example: 這家便利商店的分店遍及全台。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā biàn lì shāng diàn de fēn diàn biàn jí quán tái.
entries.exampleEnglish: This convenience store chain has branches all over Taiwan.
entries.question: 你知道哪家店的分店遍及全台嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào nǎ jiā diàn de fēn diàn biàn jí quán tái ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know a chain whose branches are all over Taiwan?
entries.answer: 全家便利商店的分店遍及全台。
entries.answerPinyin: quán jiā biàn lì shāng diàn de fēn diàn biàn jí quán tái.
entries.answerEnglish: FamilyMart has branches all over Taiwan.

entries.example: 這個案子下個月開始審判。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge àn zi xià gè yuè kāi shǐ shěn pàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The trial in this case begins next month.
entries.question: 你看過有關法院審判的電影嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò yǒu guān fǎ yuàn shěn pàn de diàn yǐng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen any films about court trials?
entries.answer: 看過，那部電影的審判過程很精彩。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, nà bù diàn yǐng de shěn pàn guò chéng hěn jīng cǎi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the trial in that film was gripping.

entries.example: 地點是開餐廳成功的要素之一。
entries.examplePinyin: dì diǎn shì kāi cān tīng chéng gōng de yào sù zhī yī.
entries.exampleEnglish: Location is one of the key factors in running a successful restaurant.
entries.question: 你覺得好工作有哪些要素？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de hǎo gōng zuò yǒu nǎ xiē yào sù?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think are the key elements of a good job?
entries.answer: 我覺得薪水和同事是最重要的要素。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de xīn shuǐ hé tóng shì shì zuì zhòng yào de yào sù.
entries.answerEnglish: I think pay and coworkers are the most important elements.

entries.example: 我出國的時候，請哥哥當我的代理人。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ chū guó de shí hòu, qǐng gē ge dāng wǒ de dài lǐ rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: When I'm abroad, my brother acts as my representative.
entries.question: 你曾經請別人當你的代理人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ céng jīng qǐng bié rén dāng nǐ de dài lǐ rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had someone act as your representative?
entries.answer: 有，我出國時請朋友當代理人幫我收信。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ chū guó shí qǐng péng yǒu dāng dài lǐ rén bāng wǒ shōu xìn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when I went abroad a friend acted for me and collected my mail.

entries.example: 隱形眼鏡要泡在專用的溶液裡。
entries.examplePinyin: yǐn xíng yǎn jìng yào pào zài zhuān yòng de róng yì lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Contact lenses need to soak in their special solution.
entries.question: 你會用什麼溶液清潔眼鏡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì yòng shén me róng yì qīng jié yǎn jìng?
entries.questionEnglish: What solution do you use to clean your glasses?
entries.answer: 我用眼鏡行送的清潔溶液。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yòng yǎn jìng háng sòng de qīng jié róng yì.
entries.answerEnglish: I use the cleaning solution the optician gave me.

entries.english: footprints; traces; places one has been
entries.example: 他的足跡遍布全台灣。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de zú jī biàn bù quán tái wān.
entries.exampleEnglish: He has been all over Taiwan.
entries.question: 你的足跡到過台灣哪些地方？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de zú jī dào guò tái wān nǎ xiē dì fāng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which parts of Taiwan have you been to?
entries.answer: 我的足跡到過台北、台南和花蓮。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de zú jī dào guò tái běi, tái nán hé huā lián.
entries.answerEnglish: I've been to Taipei, Tainan and Hualien.

entries.example: 這是歷史上很有名的戰役。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shì lì shǐ shàng hěn yǒu míng de zhàn yì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a very famous battle in history.
entries.question: 你知道哪一場有名的戰役？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào nǎ yì chǎng yǒu míng de zhàn yì?
entries.questionEnglish: Which famous battle do you know about?
entries.answer: 我知道諾曼第戰役。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhī dào nuò màn dì zhàn yì.
entries.answerEnglish: I know about the Battle of Normandy.

entries.example: 這條河是兩個縣的分界。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tiáo hé shì liǎng gè xiàn de fēn jiè.
entries.exampleEnglish: This river is the boundary between the two counties.
entries.question: 你覺得工作和生活應該有清楚的分界嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de gōng zuò hé shēng huó yīng gāi yǒu qīng chǔ de fēn jiè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think there should be a clear line between work and life?
entries.answer: 應該，工作和生活一定要有分界。
entries.answerPinyin: yīng gāi, gōng zuò hé shēng huó yí dìng yào yǒu fēn jiè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there has to be a line between work and life.

entries.example: 政府呼籲大家颱風天不要出門。
entries.examplePinyin: zhèng fǔ hū yù dà jiā tái fēng tiān bú yào chū mén.
entries.exampleEnglish: The government is urging everyone to stay home during the typhoon.
entries.question: 你覺得政府應該呼籲大家做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zhèng fǔ yīng gāi hū yù dà jiā zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think the government should call on people to do?
entries.answer: 應該呼籲大家多搭捷運，少開車。
entries.answerPinyin: yīng gāi hū yù dà jiā duō dā jié yùn, shǎo kāi chē.
entries.answerEnglish: It should urge people to take the MRT more and drive less.

entries.example: 這隻雄性孔雀的羽毛很漂亮。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhī xióng xìng kǒng què de yǔ máo hěn piào liang.
entries.exampleEnglish: This male peacock has beautiful feathers.
entries.question: 你養的寵物是雄性還是雌性？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǎng de chǒng wù shì xióng xìng hái shì cí xìng?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your pet male or female?
entries.answer: 是雄性的，牠是一隻公貓。
entries.answerPinyin: shì xióng xìng de, tā shì yì zhī gōng māo.
entries.answerEnglish: It's male; he's a tomcat.

entries.example: 這種植物不常澆水也能存活。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhǒng zhí wù bù cháng jiāo shuǐ yě néng cún huó.
entries.exampleEnglish: This plant can survive without much watering.
entries.question: 你種的植物都能存活嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhòng de zhí wù dōu néng cún huó ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do the plants you grow survive?
entries.answer: 不太能，我種的花很少存活。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài néng, wǒ zhòng de huā hěn shǎo cún huó.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. Few of my flowers survive.

entries.example: 珍珠奶茶被視為台灣的國民飲料。
entries.examplePinyin: zhēn zhū nǎi chá bèi shì wéi tái wān de guó mín yǐn liào.
entries.exampleEnglish: Bubble tea is regarded as Taiwan's national drink.
entries.question: 你把台灣視為第二個家嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bǎ tái wān shì wéi dì èr gè jiā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you consider Taiwan your second home?
entries.answer: 是的，我把台灣視為我的第二個家。
entries.answerPinyin: shì de, wǒ bǎ tái wān shì wéi wǒ de dì èr gè jiā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I consider Taiwan my second home.

entries.example: 我委託房仲幫我找房子。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ wěi tuō fáng zhòng bāng wǒ zhǎo fáng zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: I hired a real estate agent to find me a place.
entries.question: 你找房子時會委託房仲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhǎo fáng zi shí huì wěi tuō fáng zhòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you look for a place, do you use an agent?
entries.answer: 會，我上次就是委託房仲找到的。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ shàng cì jiù shì wěi tuō fáng zhòng zhǎo dào de.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, last time I found my place through an agent.

entries.example: 這座城堡以前住著一位統治者。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zuò chéng bǎo yǐ qián zhù zhe yí wèi tǒng zhì zhě.
entries.exampleEnglish: A ruler used to live in this castle.
entries.question: 你最欣賞歷史上哪一位統治者？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xīn shǎng lì shǐ shàng nǎ yí wèi tǒng zhì zhě?
entries.questionEnglish: Which ruler in history do you admire most?
entries.answer: 我最欣賞的統治者是伊莉莎白一世。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xīn shǎng de tǒng zhì zhě shì yī lì shā bái yí shì.
entries.answerEnglish: The ruler I admire most is Elizabeth I.

entries.example: 他承認自己犯下了大錯。
entries.examplePinyin: tā chéng rèn zì jǐ fàn xià le dà cuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: He admitted he had made a big mistake.
entries.question: 你說中文時犯過什麼好笑的錯誤？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shuō zhōng wén shí fàn guò shén me hǎo xiào de cuò wù?
entries.questionEnglish: What funny mistakes have you made speaking Chinese?
entries.answer: 我曾經犯下把「水餃」說成「睡覺」的錯誤。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ céng jīng fàn xià bǎ “shuǐ jiǎo” shuō chéng “shuì jiào” de cuò wù.
entries.answerEnglish: I once made the mistake of saying 'sleep' when I meant 'dumplings'.

entries.example: 婚禮來了三百多位賓客。
entries.examplePinyin: hūn lǐ lái le sān bǎi duō wèi bīn kè.
entries.exampleEnglish: Over three hundred guests came to the wedding.
entries.question: 你的婚禮想邀請多少賓客？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de hūn lǐ xiǎng yāo qǐng duō shǎo bīn kè?
entries.questionEnglish: How many guests would you invite to your wedding?
entries.answer: 我想邀請大概五十位賓客就好。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng yāo qǐng dà gài wǔ shí wèi bīn kè jiù hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: About fifty guests would be enough.

entries.example: 這部電影在講一件謀殺案。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng zài jiǎng yí jiàn móu shā àn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This movie is about a murder case.
entries.question: 推理劇裡的謀殺案通常是誰破的？
entries.questionPinyin: tuī lǐ jù lǐ de móu shā àn tōng cháng shì shéi pò de?
entries.questionEnglish: In mystery dramas, who usually solves the murder case?
entries.answer: 推理劇裡的謀殺案通常是警察或偵探破的。
entries.answerPinyin: tuī lǐ jù lǐ de móu shā àn tōng cháng shì jǐng chá huò zhēn tàn pò de.
entries.answerEnglish: In mystery dramas, the murder is usually solved by the police or a detective.

entries.example: 我們去山上採集植物做研究。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men qù shān shàng cǎi jí zhí wù zuò yán jiù.
entries.exampleEnglish: We went to the mountains to collect plants for research.
entries.question: 你小時候採集過昆蟲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu cǎi jí guò kūn chóng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you collect insects as a child?
entries.answer: 有，我以前常在公園採集昆蟲。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ yǐ qián cháng zài gōng yuán cǎi jí kūn chóng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I used to collect insects in the park.

entries.example: 法官明天會宣判這個案子。
entries.examplePinyin: fǎ guān míng tiān huì xuān pàn zhè ge àn zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: The judge will deliver the verdict on this case tomorrow.
entries.question: 你會看法院宣判的新聞嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì kàn fǎ yuàn xuān pàn de xīn wén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you follow news about court verdicts?
entries.answer: 有時候會，大案子宣判我會看。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu huì, dà àn zi xuān pàn wǒ huì kàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. I watch when big cases are decided.

entries.example: 他花了五年才還清債務。
entries.examplePinyin: tā huā le wǔ nián cái huán qīng zhài wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: It took him five years to pay off his debts.
entries.question: 你覺得年輕人有債務很正常嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nián qīng rén yǒu zhài wù hěn zhèng cháng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think it's normal for young people to have debt?
entries.answer: 很正常，很多人都有學貸這種債務。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn zhèng cháng, hěn duō rén dōu yǒu xué dài zhè zhǒng zhài wù.
entries.answerEnglish: Very normal. Lots of people have debt like student loans.

entries.example: 按摩可以緩解肩膀的痠痛。
entries.examplePinyin: àn mó kě yǐ huǎn jiě jiān bǎng de suān tòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: A massage can relieve sore shoulders.
entries.question: 你都怎麼緩解工作壓力？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dōu zěn me huǎn jiě gōng zuò yā lì?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you relieve work stress?
entries.answer: 我都去運動來緩解壓力。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dōu qù yùn dòng lái huǎn jiě yā lì.
entries.answerEnglish: I exercise to relieve stress.

entries.example: 他的舉止很有禮貌。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de jǔ zhǐ hěn yǒu lǐ mào.
entries.exampleEnglish: His manners are very polite.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣人的舉止有禮貌嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān rén de jǔ zhǐ yǒu lǐ mào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwanese people have polite manners?
entries.answer: 很有禮貌，大家的舉止都很客氣。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn yǒu lǐ mào, dà jiā de jǔ zhǐ dōu hěn kè qì.
