entries.answerEnglish: Very polite. Everyone behaves courteously.

entries.example: 洗手是防疫的第一道防線。
entries.examplePinyin: xǐ shǒu shì fáng yì de dì yī dào fáng xiàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Washing your hands is the first line of defense against disease.
entries.question: 你覺得防疫最重要的防線是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de fáng yì zuì zhòng yào de fáng xiàn shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is the most important line of defense against disease?
entries.answer: 我覺得勤洗手是最重要的防線。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de qín xǐ shǒu shì zuì zhòng yào de fáng xiàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I think washing your hands often is the most important line of defense.

entries.example: 虐待動物是違法的。
entries.examplePinyin: nüè dài dòng wù shì wéi fǎ de.
entries.exampleEnglish: Abusing animals is illegal.
entries.question: 在台灣，虐待動物會被處罰嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zài tái wān, nüè dài dòng wù huì bèi chǔ fá ma?
entries.questionEnglish: In Taiwan, is abusing animals punished?
entries.answer: 會，虐待動物可能會被罰款或關進監獄。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, nüè dài dòng wù kě néng huì bèi fá kuǎn huò guān jìn jiān yù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, abusing animals can lead to a fine or prison.

entries.example: 英國國會今天在討論新法律。
entries.examplePinyin: yīng guó guó huì jīn tiān zài tǎo lùn xīn fǎ lǜ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The British Parliament is debating a new law today.
entries.question: 你會看國會開會的新聞嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì kàn guó huì kāi huì de xīn wén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you watch news about parliament sessions?
entries.answer: 很少，我不太關心國會的新聞。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn shǎo, wǒ bú tài guān xīn guó huì de xīn wén.
entries.answerEnglish: Rarely. I don't pay much attention to parliament news.

entries.example: 比賽的優勝者可以免費去日本玩。
entries.examplePinyin: bǐ sài de yōu shèng zhě kě yǐ miǎn fèi qù rì běn wán.
entries.exampleEnglish: The winner of the contest gets a free trip to Japan.
entries.question: 你當過比賽的優勝者嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dāng guò bǐ sài de yōu shèng zhě ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever won a contest?
entries.answer: 當過一次，我是公司桌球比賽的優勝者。
entries.answerPinyin: dāng guò yí cì, wǒ shì gōng sī zhuō qiú bǐ sài de yōu shèng zhě.
entries.answerEnglish: Once. I won the company table tennis tournament.

entries.example: 下個月由小林接替我的工作。
entries.examplePinyin: xià gè yuè yóu xiǎo lín jiē tì wǒ de gōng zuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: Next month Xiao Lin will take over my job.
entries.question: 你休假時，誰接替你的工作？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiū jià shí, shéi jiē tì nǐ de gōng zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: Who takes over your work when you're on leave?
entries.answer: 我休假時，同事會接替我的工作。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiū jià shí, tóng shì huì jiē tì wǒ de gōng zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: When I'm on leave, a coworker takes over my work.

entries.example: 在捷運上吃東西會被處以罰款。
entries.examplePinyin: zài jié yùn shàng chī dōng xī huì bèi chǔ yǐ fá kuǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Eating on the MRT can get you fined.
entries.question: 你知道在捷運上喝水會被罰嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào zài jié yùn shàng hē shuǐ huì bèi fá ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know you can be fined for drinking water on the MRT?
entries.answer: 知道，在捷運上喝水會被處以罰款。
entries.answerPinyin: zhī dào, zài jié yùn shàng hē shuǐ huì bèi chǔ yǐ fá kuǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, drinking water on the MRT can get you fined.

entries.example: 律師在法庭上為他辯護。
entries.examplePinyin: lǜ shī zài fǎ tíng shàng wèi tā biàn hù.
entries.exampleEnglish: The lawyer defended him in court.
entries.question: 朋友被批評時，你會幫他辯護嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: péng yǒu bèi pī píng shí, nǐ huì bāng tā biàn hù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When a friend is criticised, do you defend them?
entries.answer: 會，我一定會站出來幫朋友辯護。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ yí dìng huì zhàn chū lái bāng péng yǒu biàn hù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'll always stand up and defend my friends.

entries.example: 大家都指責他開會遲到。
entries.examplePinyin: dà jiā dōu zhǐ zé tā kāi huì chí dào.
entries.exampleEnglish: Everyone criticised him for being late to the meeting.
entries.question: 你在工作上被人指責過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài gōng zuò shàng bèi rén zhǐ zé guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been blamed for something at work?
entries.answer: 有，主管曾經指責我報告寫得太慢。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, zhǔ guǎn céng jīng zhǐ zé wǒ bào gào xiě de tài màn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my manager once criticised me for writing a report too slowly.

entries.example: 警察終於抓到那個罪犯了。
entries.examplePinyin: jǐng chá zhōng yú zhuā dào nà ge zuì fàn le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The police finally caught that criminal.
entries.question: 罪犯被抓到以後會怎麼樣？
entries.questionPinyin: zuì fàn bèi zhuā dào yǐ hòu huì zěn me yàng?
entries.questionEnglish: What happens to criminals after they are caught?
entries.answer: 罪犯被抓到以後，可能會被關進監獄。
entries.answerPinyin: zuì fàn bèi zhuā dào yǐ hòu, kě néng huì bèi guān jìn jiān yù.
entries.answerEnglish: After criminals are caught, they may be sent to prison.

entries.example: 中正紀念堂看起來很宏偉。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōng zhèng jì niàn táng kàn qǐ lái hěn hóng wěi.
entries.exampleEnglish: Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall looks very grand.
entries.question: 你看過最宏偉的建築是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò zuì hóng wěi de jiàn zhú shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the most magnificent building you've seen?
entries.answer: 我覺得故宮博物院非常宏偉。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de gù gōng bó wù yuàn fēi cháng hóng wěi.
entries.answerEnglish: I think the National Palace Museum is magnificent.

entries.example: 警察已經抓到嫌疑犯了。
entries.examplePinyin: jǐng chá yǐ jīng zhuā dào xián yí fàn le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The police have already caught the suspect.
entries.question: 嫌疑犯一定是真正的犯人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: xián yí fàn yí dìng shì zhēn zhèng de fàn rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is a suspect always the real culprit?
entries.answer: 不一定，嫌疑犯也可能是無辜的。
entries.answerPinyin: bù yí dìng, xián yí fàn yě kě néng shì wú gū de.
entries.answerEnglish: Not necessarily; a suspect may also be innocent.

entries.example: 警察昨天逮捕了那個小偷。
entries.examplePinyin: jǐng chá zuó tiān dǎi bǔ le nà ge xiǎo tōu.
entries.exampleEnglish: The police arrested the thief yesterday.
entries.question: 在你的國家，酒駕會被逮捕嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zài nǐ de guó jiā, jiǔ jià huì bèi dǎi bǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: In your country, do people get arrested for drink-driving?
entries.answer: 會，酒駕可能會被警察逮捕。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, jiǔ jià kě néng huì bèi jǐng chá dǎi bǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, you can be arrested for drink-driving.

entries.example: 有兩個囚犯從監獄逃走了。
entries.examplePinyin: yǒu liǎng gè qiú fàn cóng jiān yù táo zǒu le.
entries.exampleEnglish: Two prisoners escaped from the prison.
entries.question: 囚犯在監獄裡每天要做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: qiú fàn zài jiān yù lǐ měi tiān yào zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do prisoners have to do every day in prison?
entries.answer: 很多囚犯每天要在監獄裡工作。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn duō qiú fàn měi tiān yào zài jiān yù lǐ gōng zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: Many prisoners have to work in the prison every day.

entries.example: 這件事由哪個部會負責？
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn shì yóu nǎ gè bù huì fù zé?
entries.exampleEnglish: Which ministry is responsible for this?
entries.question: 你知道台灣有哪些部會嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào tái wān yǒu nǎ xiē bù huì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know which ministries Taiwan has?
entries.answer: 我知道外交部和教育部這些部會。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhī dào wài jiāo bù hé jiào yù bù zhè xiē bù huì.
entries.answerEnglish: I know ministries like Foreign Affairs and Education.

entries.example: 在公司裡，她是我最好的盟友。
entries.examplePinyin: zài gōng sī lǐ, tā shì wǒ zuì hǎo de méng yǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: At the office, she's my best ally.
entries.question: 在工作上，你有盟友嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zài gōng zuò shàng, nǐ yǒu méng yǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have allies at work?
entries.answer: 有，我的主管是我最大的盟友。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de zhǔ guǎn shì wǒ zuì dà de méng yǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my manager is my biggest ally.

entries.example: 他用真實的事例說明這個問題。
entries.examplePinyin: tā yòng zhēn shí de shì lì shuō míng zhè ge wèn tí.
entries.exampleEnglish: He explained the problem with real-life examples.
entries.question: 你能舉一個文化差異的事例嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ néng jǔ yí gè wén huà chā yì de shì lì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you give an example of a cultural difference?
entries.answer: 在台灣送鐘不吉利，這就是一個事例。
entries.answerPinyin: zài tái wān sòng zhōng bù jí lì, zhè jiù shì yí gè shì lì.
entries.answerEnglish: In Taiwan, giving a clock as a gift is unlucky. That's one example.

entries.example: 機場有武裝警察在巡邏。
entries.examplePinyin: jī chǎng yǒu wǔ zhuāng jǐng chá zài xún luó.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are armed police patrolling the airport.
entries.question: 你在你的國家看過武裝警察嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài nǐ de guó jiā kàn guò wǔ zhuāng jǐng chá ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen armed police in your country?
entries.answer: 看過，機場常常有武裝警察。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, jī chǎng cháng cháng yǒu wǔ zhuāng jǐng chá.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are often armed police at the airport.

entries.example: 診所醫生把我轉介到大醫院。
entries.examplePinyin: zhěn suǒ yī shēng bǎ wǒ zhuǎn jiè dào dà yī yuàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The clinic doctor referred me to a big hospital.
entries.question: 診所醫生什麼時候會轉介病人？
entries.questionPinyin: zhěn suǒ yī shēng shén me shí hòu huì zhuǎn jiè bìng rén?
entries.questionEnglish: When does a clinic doctor refer a patient?
entries.answer: 病比較嚴重的時候，醫生會把病人轉介到大醫院。
entries.answerPinyin: bìng bǐ jiào yán zhòng de shí hòu, yī shēng huì bǎ bìng rén zhuǎn jiè dào dà yī yuàn.
entries.answerEnglish: When the illness is more serious, the doctor refers the patient to a big hospital.

entries.example: 美國有民主黨和共和黨。
entries.examplePinyin: měi guó yǒu mín zhǔ dǎng hé gòng hé dǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The US has the Democratic Party and the Republican Party.
entries.question: 你身邊有支持共和黨的朋友嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēn biān yǒu zhī chí gòng hé dǎng de péng yǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have friends who support the Republicans?
entries.answer: 有，我有幾個美國朋友支持共和黨。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ yǒu jǐ gè měi guó péng yǒu zhī chí gòng hé dǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a few of my American friends support the Republicans.

entries.example: 他每次都投票給民主黨。
entries.examplePinyin: tā měi cì dōu tóu piào gěi mín zhǔ dǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: He always votes for the Democrats.
entries.question: 你常看美國民主黨的新聞嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng kàn měi guó mín zhǔ dǎng de xīn wén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often follow news about the US Democrats?
entries.answer: 偶爾看，民主黨的新聞很多。
entries.answerPinyin: ǒu ěr kàn, mín zhǔ dǎng de xīn wén hěn duō.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. There's a lot of news about the Democrats.

entries.example: 這位評論家很喜歡這部電影。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè wèi píng lùn jiā hěn xǐ huan zhè bù diàn yǐng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This critic really likes the film.
entries.question: 你看電影前會看評論家的意見嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn diàn yǐng qián huì kàn píng lùn jiā de yì jiàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you read what critics say before seeing a film?
entries.answer: 不會，我不太相信評論家。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ bú tài xiāng xìn píng lùn jiā.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't really trust critics.

entries.example: 台灣的民主政治發展得很快。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān de mín zhǔ zhèng zhì fā zhǎn de hěn kuài.
entries.exampleEnglish: Democracy in Taiwan developed quickly.
entries.question: 你覺得民主政治有什麼缺點？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de mín zhǔ zhèng zhì yǒu shén me quē diǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think the weaknesses of democracy are?
entries.answer: 我覺得民主政治有時候做決定很慢。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de mín zhǔ zhèng zhì yǒu shí hòu zuò jué dìng hěn màn.
entries.answerEnglish: I think democracy is sometimes slow to make decisions.

entries.example: 你的幫忙是很大的助力。
entries.examplePinyin: nǐ de bāng máng shì hěn dà de zhù lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Your help has been a big boost.
entries.question: 誰是你學中文最大的助力？
entries.questionPinyin: shéi shì nǐ xué zhōng wén zuì dà de zhù lì?
entries.questionEnglish: Who has helped you most with learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 我的台灣朋友是我最大的助力。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de tái wān péng yǒu shì wǒ zuì dà de zhù lì.
entries.answerEnglish: My Taiwanese friends have been my biggest help.

entries.example: 最新民調顯示他領先。
entries.examplePinyin: zuì xīn mín diào xiǎn shì tā lǐng xiān.
entries.exampleEnglish: The latest poll shows him in the lead.
entries.question: 你相信民調嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiāng xìn mín diào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you trust opinion polls?
entries.answer: 不太相信，民調常常不準。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài xiāng xìn, mín diào cháng cháng bù zhǔn.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. Polls are often wrong.

entries.example: 這條街是那隻貓的地盤。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tiáo jiē shì nà zhī māo de dì pán.
entries.exampleEnglish: This street is that cat's territory.
entries.question: 你家的寵物有自己的地盤嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de chǒng wù yǒu zì jǐ de dì pán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your pet have its own territory at home?
entries.answer: 有，沙發就是我家貓的地盤。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, shā fā jiù shì wǒ jiā māo de dì pán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the sofa is my cat's territory.

entries.example: 兩個國家簽了一份條約。
entries.examplePinyin: liǎng gè guó jiā qiān le yí fèn tiáo yuē.
entries.exampleEnglish: The two countries signed a treaty.
entries.question: 你覺得國際條約重要嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de guó jì tiáo yuē zhòng yào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think international treaties are important?
entries.answer: 重要，條約可以讓國家之間更穩定。
entries.answerPinyin: zhòng yào, tiáo yuē kě yǐ ràng guó jiā zhī jiān gèng wěn dìng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, treaties make relations between countries more stable.

entries.example: 他是老闆最信任的副手。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì lǎo bǎn zuì xìn rèn de fù shǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's the boss's most trusted deputy.
entries.question: 你在工作上有副手嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài gōng zuò shàng yǒu fù shǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a deputy at work?
entries.answer: 有，我的副手幫了我很多忙。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de fù shǒu bāng le wǒ hěn duō máng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my deputy has helped me a lot.

entries.example: 愛滋病現在可以用藥控制。
entries.examplePinyin: ài zī bìng xiàn zài kě yǐ yòng yào kòng zhì.
entries.exampleEnglish: AIDS can now be controlled with medication.
entries.question: 你的國家常常宣導愛滋病的知識嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā cháng cháng xuān dǎo ài zī bìng de zhī shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your country often run AIDS awareness campaigns?
entries.answer: 會，政府常常宣導怎麼預防愛滋病。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, zhèng fǔ cháng cháng xuān dǎo zěn me yù fáng ài zī bìng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the government often promotes AIDS prevention.

entries.example: 法國是一個共和國。
entries.examplePinyin: fǎ guó shì yí gè gòng hé guó.
entries.exampleEnglish: France is a republic.
entries.question: 你的國家是共和國嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā shì gòng hé guó ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your country a republic?
entries.answer: 是，我的國家是共和國。
entries.answerPinyin: shì, wǒ de guó jiā shì gòng hé guó.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my country is a republic.

entries.example: 因為通膨，便當也變貴了。
entries.examplePinyin: yīn wèi tōng péng, biàn dāng yě biàn guì le.
entries.exampleEnglish: Because of inflation, even lunch boxes have got more expensive.
entries.question: 通膨對你的生活有影響嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: tōng péng duì nǐ de shēng huó yǒu yǐng xiǎng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has inflation affected your life?
entries.answer: 有，通膨讓我每個月多花很多錢。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, tōng péng ràng wǒ měi gè yuè duō huā hěn duō qián.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, inflation means I spend a lot more each month.

entries.example: 雙方還在協商價格。
entries.examplePinyin: shuāng fāng hái zài xié shāng jià gé.
entries.exampleEnglish: Both sides are still negotiating the price.
entries.question: 你跟房東協商過房租嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gēn fáng dōng xié shāng guò fáng zū ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever negotiated your rent with your landlord?
entries.answer: 協商過，房東每個月少算我一千塊。
entries.answerPinyin: xié shāng guò, fáng dōng měi gè yuè shǎo suàn wǒ yì qiān kuài.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my landlord knocked a thousand off each month.

entries.example: 政府今年的預算又是赤字。
entries.examplePinyin: zhèng fǔ jīn nián de yù suàn yòu shì chì zì.
entries.exampleEnglish: The government's budget is in deficit again this year.
entries.question: 你這個月的花費有赤字嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhè ge yuè de huā fèi yǒu chì zì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you in the red this month?
entries.answer: 有一點赤字，我這個月買太多東西了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu yì diǎn chì zì, wǒ zhè ge yuè mǎi tài duō dōng xī le.
entries.answerEnglish: A bit. I bought too much this month.

entries.example: 他的故事鼓舞了很多人。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de gù shì gǔ wǔ le hěn duō rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: His story inspired a lot of people.
entries.question: 誰的故事鼓舞過你？
entries.questionPinyin: shéi de gù shì gǔ wǔ guò nǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Whose story has inspired you?
entries.answer: 我奶奶的故事一直鼓舞著我。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ nǎi nai de gù shì yì zhí gǔ wǔ zhe wǒ.
entries.answerEnglish: My grandmother's story has always inspired me.

entries.example: 他的想法有點激進。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de xiǎng fǎ yǒu diǎn jī jìn.
entries.exampleEnglish: His ideas are a bit radical.
entries.question: 你覺得自己的想法激進嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ jī jìn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your views are radical?
entries.answer: 不會，我的想法一點也不激進。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ de xiǎng fǎ yì diǎn yě bù jī jìn.
entries.answerEnglish: No, my views aren't radical at all.

entries.example: 農夫在田邊釘了一排木樁。
entries.examplePinyin: nóng fū zài tián biān dìng le yì pái mù zhuāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The farmer drove a row of wooden stakes along the field.
entries.question: 你小時候看過用木樁做的圍籬嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu kàn guò yòng mù zhuāng zuò de wéi lí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you see fences made of wooden stakes as a child?
entries.answer: 看過，我爺爺的農場有很多木樁。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ yé ye de nóng chǎng yǒu hěn duō mù zhuāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my grandpa's farm had lots of wooden posts.

entries.example: 經濟衰退讓很多人失業了。
entries.examplePinyin: jīng jì shuāi tuì ràng hěn duō rén shī yè le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The recession left many people out of work.
entries.question: 你擔心經濟衰退嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dān xīn jīng jì shuāi tuì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you worried about a recession?
entries.answer: 有點擔心，經濟衰退會影響我的工作。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu diǎn dān xīn, jīng jì shuāi tuì huì yǐng xiǎng wǒ de gōng zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: A bit. A recession would affect my job.

entries.example: 各國領袖下週要開高峰會。
entries.examplePinyin: gè guó lǐng xiù xià zhōu yào kāi gāo fēng huì.
entries.exampleEnglish: World leaders are holding a summit next week.
entries.question: 你關心國際高峰會的新聞嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ guān xīn guó jì gāo fēng huì de xīn wén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you follow news about international summits?
entries.answer: 不太關心，高峰會的新聞很無聊。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài guān xīn, gāo fēng huì de xīn wén hěn wú liáo.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. News about summits is boring.

entries.example: 他年輕的時候相信共產主義。
entries.examplePinyin: tā nián qīng de shí hòu xiāng xìn gòng chǎn zhǔ yì.
entries.exampleEnglish: He believed in communism when he was young.
entries.question: 你的國家有人相信共產主義嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā yǒu rén xiāng xìn gòng chǎn zhǔ yì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there people in your country who believe in communism?
entries.answer: 有，但相信共產主義的人不多。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, dàn xiāng xìn gòng chǎn zhǔ yì de rén bù duō.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but not many people believe in communism.

entries.example: 很多國家一起制裁那個國家。
entries.examplePinyin: hěn duō guó jiā yì qǐ zhì cái nà ge guó jiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: Many countries imposed sanctions on that country together.
entries.question: 你覺得經濟制裁有用嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de jīng jì zhì cái yǒu yòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think economic sanctions work?
entries.answer: 我覺得制裁有一點用，但不夠。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de zhì cái yǒu yì diǎn yòng, dàn bú gòu.
entries.answerEnglish: I think sanctions help a little, but not enough.

entries.example: 他在電影裡演一個反叛者。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài diàn yǐng lǐ yǎn yí gè fǎn pàn zhě.
entries.exampleEnglish: He plays a rebel in the film.
entries.question: 你年輕時是個反叛者嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ nián qīng shí shì gè fǎn pàn zhě ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Were you a rebel when you were young?
entries.answer: 有一點，我年輕時是個小反叛者。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu yì diǎn, wǒ nián qīng shí shì gè xiǎo fǎn pàn zhě.
entries.answerEnglish: A bit. I was a little rebel when I was young.

entries.example: 他指稱公司沒有付他加班費。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zhǐ chēng gōng sī méi yǒu fù tā jiā bān fèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: He alleges the company didn't pay him overtime.
entries.question: 你聽過有人指稱老闆欠薪水嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tīng guò yǒu rén zhǐ chēng lǎo bǎn qiàn xīn shuǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you heard of anyone claiming their boss owed them wages?
entries.answer: 聽過，我朋友指稱他老闆欠他三個月薪水。
entries.answerPinyin: tīng guò, wǒ péng yǒu zhǐ chēng tā lǎo bǎn qiàn tā sān gè yuè xīn shuǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a friend claims his boss owes him three months' pay.

entries.example: 警察救出了所有的人質。
entries.examplePinyin: jǐng chá jiù chū le suǒ yǒu de rén zhì.
entries.exampleEnglish: The police rescued all the hostages.
entries.question: 電影裡的人質最後通常怎麼樣？
entries.questionPinyin: diàn yǐng lǐ de rén zhì zuì hòu tōng cháng zěn me yàng?
entries.questionEnglish: In films, what usually happens to the hostages in the end?
entries.answer: 電影裡的人質最後通常都會被救出來。
entries.answerPinyin: diàn yǐng lǐ de rén zhì zuì hòu tōng cháng dōu huì bèi jiù chū lái.
entries.answerEnglish: In films, the hostages are usually rescued in the end.

entries.example: 他是大家公認最好的廚師。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì dà jiā gōng rèn zuì hǎo de chú shī.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's widely recognised as the best chef.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼是台灣公認最好吃的小吃？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me shì tái wān gōng rèn zuì hǎo chī de xiǎo chī?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is widely seen as Taiwan's tastiest snack?
entries.answer: 我覺得牛肉麵是大家公認最好吃的。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de niú ròu miàn shì dà jiā gōng rèn zuì hǎo chī de.
entries.answerEnglish: I think beef noodles are generally agreed to be the best.

entries.example: 這部電影有很強的民族主義。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng yǒu hěn qiáng de mín zú zhǔ yì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This film has strong nationalist overtones.
entries.question: 你覺得你的國家民族主義強嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ de guó jiā mín zú zhǔ yì qiáng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is nationalism strong in your country?
entries.answer: 不太強，我們很少談民族主義。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài qiáng, wǒ men hěn shǎo tán mín zú zhǔ yì.
entries.answerEnglish: Not very. We rarely talk about nationalism.

entries.example: 法律明定員工每年有特休假。
entries.examplePinyin: fǎ lǜ míng dìng yuán gōng měi nián yǒu tè xiū jià.
entries.exampleEnglish: The law clearly states that employees get annual leave every year.
entries.question: 你的公司有明定上下班時間嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng sī yǒu míng dìng shàng xià bān shí jiān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company set clear working hours?
entries.answer: 有，公司明定九點上班、六點下班。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, gōng sī míng dìng jiǔ diǎn shàng bān, liù diǎn xià bān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the company states we start at nine and finish at six.

entries.example: 要先了解事情的脈絡，才能判斷。
entries.examplePinyin: yào xiān liǎo jiě shì qíng de mài luò, cái néng pàn duàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: You need to understand the context before you can judge.
entries.question: 你看新聞會注意事件的脈絡嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn xīn wén huì zhù yì shì jiàn de mài luò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you pay attention to the context when you read the news?
entries.answer: 會，了解脈絡才看得懂新聞。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, liǎo jiě mài luò cái kàn de dǒng xīn wén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, you need the context to understand the news.

entries.example: 疫情影響了很多小店老闆的生計。
entries.examplePinyin: yì qíng yǐng xiǎng le hěn duō xiǎo diàn lǎo bǎn de shēng jì.
entries.exampleEnglish: The pandemic hurt the livelihoods of many small shop owners.
entries.question: 你覺得在台灣維持生計容易嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zài tái wān wéi chí shēng jì róng yì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think it's easy to make a living in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 不太容易，維持生計要很努力。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài róng yì, wéi chí shēng jì yào hěn nǔ lì.
entries.answerEnglish: Not very. You have to work hard to make a living.

entries.example: 過年吃魚有年年有餘的寓意。
entries.examplePinyin: guò nián chī yú yǒu nián nián yǒu yú de yù yì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Eating fish at Lunar New Year symbolizes having more than enough every year.
entries.question: 你的國家有什麼有好寓意的食物？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā yǒu shén me yǒu hǎo yù yì de shí wù?
entries.questionEnglish: In your country, what foods carry a lucky meaning?
entries.answer: 有，我們過年吃葡萄，寓意是好運。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men guò nián chī pú táo, yù yì shì hǎo yùn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we eat grapes at New Year. They stand for good luck.

entries.example: 醫院買了一批新的醫療器械。
entries.examplePinyin: yī yuàn mǎi le yì pī xīn de yī liáo qì xiè.
entries.exampleEnglish: The hospital bought a batch of new medical equipment.
entries.question: 你會用健身房的器械嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì yòng jiàn shēn fáng de qì xiè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know how to use the equipment at the gym?
entries.answer: 會一點，我常用練腿的器械。
entries.answerPinyin: huì yì diǎn, wǒ cháng yòng liàn tuǐ de qì xiè.
entries.answerEnglish: A bit. I often use the leg machines.

entries.example: 從他的口音可以推斷他是南部人。
entries.examplePinyin: cóng tā de kǒu yīn kě yǐ tuī duàn tā shì nán bù rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: From his accent you can tell he's from southern Taiwan.
entries.question: 你能從口音推斷別人是哪裡人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ néng cóng kǒu yīn tuī duàn bié rén shì nǎ lǐ rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you tell where people are from by their accent?
entries.answer: 有時候可以推斷出來。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu kě yǐ tuī duàn chū lái.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes I can work it out.

entries.example: 醫生用燈檢查我的瞳孔。
entries.examplePinyin: yī shēng yòng dēng jiǎn chá wǒ de tóng kǒng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The doctor checked my pupils with a light.
entries.question: 你去看眼科時，醫生會看你的瞳孔嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù kàn yǎn kē shí, yī shēng huì kàn nǐ de tóng kǒng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you see an eye doctor, do they check your pupils?
entries.answer: 會，醫生會先檢查瞳孔。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, yī shēng huì xiān jiǎn chá tóng kǒng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the doctor checks my pupils first.

entries.example: 咖啡和茶，我比較喜歡後者。
entries.examplePinyin: kā fēi hé chá, wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan hòu zhě.
entries.exampleEnglish: Between coffee and tea, I prefer the latter.
entries.question: 海邊和山上，你比較喜歡哪個？
entries.questionPinyin: hǎi biān hé shān shàng, nǐ bǐ jiào xǐ huan nǎ gè?
entries.questionEnglish: The beach or the mountains: which do you prefer?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡後者，山上比較涼。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan hòu zhě, shān shàng bǐ jiào liáng.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer the latter. It's cooler in the mountains.

entries.example: 他很自律，每天早上都去跑步。
entries.examplePinyin: tā hěn zì lǜ, měi tiān zǎo shàng dōu qù pǎo bù.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's very self-disciplined and goes running every morning.
entries.question: 你覺得自己很自律嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ hěn zì lǜ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're self-disciplined?
entries.answer: 不太自律，我常常很晚才睡。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài zì lǜ, wǒ cháng cháng hěn wǎn cái shuì.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. I often go to bed very late.

entries.example: 演講最後，他向所有的人致謝。
entries.examplePinyin: yǎn jiǎng zuì hòu, tā xiàng suǒ yǒu de rén zhì xiè.
entries.exampleEnglish: At the end of his speech, he thanked everyone.
entries.question: 你在報告最後會致謝嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài bào gào zuì hòu huì zhì xiè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you thank people at the end of a presentation?
entries.answer: 會，我會向幫忙的同事致謝。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì xiàng bāng máng de tóng shì zhì xiè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I thank the coworkers who helped.

entries.example: 台北下雪是很罕見的事。
entries.examplePinyin: tái běi xià xuě shì hěn hǎn jiàn de shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Snow in Taipei is very rare.
entries.question: 你看過罕見的動物嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò hǎn jiàn de dòng wù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a rare animal?
entries.answer: 看過，我在花蓮看過罕見的鳥。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài huā lián kàn guò hǎn jiàn de niǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw a rare bird in Hualien.

entries.example: 港口旁邊有好幾座大型儲槽。
entries.examplePinyin: gǎng kǒu páng biān yǒu hǎo jǐ zuò dà xíng chú cáo.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are several large storage tanks by the harbor.
entries.question: 你住的地方附近有儲槽嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhù de dì fāng fù jìn yǒu chú cáo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there any storage tanks near where you live?
entries.answer: 有，工業區那邊有很多儲槽。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, gōng yè qū nà biān yǒu hěn duō chú cáo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are lots of storage tanks over in the industrial area.

entries.example: 這個團體倡議少用塑膠袋。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge tuán tǐ chàng yì shǎo yòng sù jiāo dài.
entries.exampleEnglish: This group advocates using fewer plastic bags.
entries.question: 你支持哪一種環保倡議？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī chí nǎ yì zhǒng huán bǎo chàng yì?
entries.questionEnglish: Which environmental initiative do you support?
entries.answer: 我支持減少塑膠的倡議。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhī chí jiǎn shǎo sù jiāo de chàng yì.
entries.answerEnglish: I support initiatives to cut plastic use.

entries.example: 他被任命為新的分公司經理。
entries.examplePinyin: tā bèi rèn mìng wéi xīn de fēn gōng sī jīng lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: He was appointed manager of the new branch.
entries.question: 如果你被任命當主管，你會怎麼做？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ nǐ bèi rèn mìng dāng zhǔ guǎn, nǐ huì zěn me zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: If you were appointed a manager, what would you do?
entries.answer: 如果被任命，我會先認識每個同事。
entries.answerPinyin: rú guǒ bèi rèn mìng, wǒ huì xiān rèn shì měi gè tóng shì.
entries.answerEnglish: If I were appointed, I'd get to know each coworker first.

entries.example: 站在山頂上，看到的是一片廣闊的大海。
entries.examplePinyin: zhàn zài shān dǐng shàng, kàn dào de shì yí piàn guǎng kuò de dà hǎi.
entries.exampleEnglish: From the mountaintop, all you can see is the vast ocean.
entries.question: 你喜歡廣闊的大自然嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan guǎng kuò de dà zì rán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like wide open nature?
entries.answer: 喜歡，看到廣闊的海讓我很放鬆。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, kàn dào guǎng kuò de hǎi ràng wǒ hěn fàng sōng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, seeing the wide sea relaxes me.

entries.example: 我週末去看了一個當代藝術展。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zhōu mò qù kàn le yí gè dāng dài yì shù zhǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: At the weekend I went to a contemporary art exhibition.
entries.question: 你喜歡當代藝術嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan dāng dài yì shù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like contemporary art?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常去當代藝術館。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ cháng qù dāng dài yì shù guǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often go to the contemporary art museum.

entries.example: 這句台語的含意很深。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jù tái yǔ de hán yì hěn shēn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This Taiwanese saying has a deep meaning.
entries.question: 你知道你中文名字的含意嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào nǐ zhōng wén míng zì de hán yì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know what your Chinese name means?
entries.answer: 知道，我名字的含意是光明。
entries.answerPinyin: zhī dào, wǒ míng zì de hán yì shì guāng míng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my name means brightness.

entries.example: 這個基金會每年都有很多出版物。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge jī jīn huì měi nián dōu yǒu hěn duō chū bǎn wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: This foundation puts out many publications every year.
entries.question: 你平常會看哪些出版物？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ píng cháng huì kàn nǎ xiē chū bǎn wù?
entries.questionEnglish: What publications do you usually read?
entries.answer: 我平常看雜誌之類的出版物。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ píng cháng kàn zá zhì zhī lèi de chū bǎn wù.
entries.answerEnglish: I usually read magazines and that sort of publication.

entries.example: 這棟大樓的地基打得很深。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè dòng dà lóu de dì jī dǎ de hěn shēn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This building's foundations go very deep.
entries.question: 你買房子會注意地基嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi fáng zi huì zhù yì dì jī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you pay attention to the foundations when buying a home?
entries.answer: 會，台灣常地震，地基很重要。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, tái wān cháng dì zhèn, dì jī hěn zhòng yào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, Taiwan has lots of earthquakes, so foundations matter.

entries.example: 你可以用書後面的索引找這個詞。
entries.examplePinyin: nǐ kě yǐ yòng shū hòu miàn de suǒ yǐn zhǎo zhè ge cí.
entries.exampleEnglish: You can use the index at the back of the book to find this word.
entries.question: 你查資料時會先看索引嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chá zī liào shí huì xiān kàn suǒ yǐn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you look something up, do you check the index first?
entries.answer: 會，用索引找資料比較快。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, yòng suǒ yǐn zhǎo zī liào bǐ jiào kuài.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, finding information through the index is faster.

entries.example: 這個新計畫遇到了很大的阻力。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge xīn jì huà yù dào le hěn dà de zǔ lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This new plan met with a lot of resistance.
entries.question: 你做重要決定時遇過阻力嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò zhòng yào jué dìng shí yù guò zǔ lì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever met resistance when making an important decision?
entries.answer: 遇過，我來台灣時，家人是最大的阻力。
entries.answerPinyin: yù guò, wǒ lái tái wān shí, jiā rén shì zuì dà de zǔ lì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. When I moved to Taiwan, my family was the biggest obstacle.

entries.example: 颱風過後，工人在修路邊的電纜。
entries.examplePinyin: tái fēng guò hòu, gōng rén zài xiū lù biān de diàn lǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: After the typhoon, workers are repairing the cables by the road.
entries.question: 你覺得電纜應該埋在地下嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de diàn lǎn yīng gāi mái zài dì xià ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think cables should be buried underground?
entries.answer: 應該，電纜埋在地下比較安全。
entries.answerPinyin: yīng gāi, diàn lǎn mái zài dì xià bǐ jiào ān quán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, burying cables underground is safer.

entries.example: 這個手錶可以監測你的心跳。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge shǒu biǎo kě yǐ jiān cè nǐ de xīn tiào.
entries.exampleEnglish: This watch can monitor your heart rate.
entries.question: 你會用手錶監測自己的健康嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì yòng shǒu biǎo jiān cè zì jǐ de jiàn kāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use a watch to monitor your health?
entries.answer: 會，我用手錶監測睡眠和心跳。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ yòng shǒu biǎo jiān cè shuì mián hé xīn tiào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I use my watch to monitor my sleep and heart rate.

entries.example: 這個醬是醬油、糖和蒜頭的混合物。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge jiàng shì jiàng yóu, táng hé suàn tóu de hùn hé wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: This sauce is a mixture of soy sauce, sugar and garlic.
entries.question: 你覺得奶茶是什麼的混合物？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǎi chá shì shén me de hùn hé wù?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think milk tea is a mixture of?
entries.answer: 奶茶是紅茶和牛奶的混合物。
entries.answerPinyin: nǎi chá shì hóng chá hé niú nǎi de hùn hé wù.
entries.answerEnglish: Milk tea is a mixture of black tea and milk.

entries.example: 這座山對原住民來說很神聖。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zuò shān duì yuán zhù mín lái shuō hěn shén shèng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This mountain is sacred to the Indigenous people.
entries.question: 對你來說，什麼東西很神聖？
entries.questionPinyin: duì nǐ lái shuō, shén me dōng xī hěn shén shèng?
entries.questionEnglish: What is sacred to you?
entries.answer: 對我來說，家人一起吃飯的時間很神聖。
entries.answerPinyin: duì wǒ lái shuō, jiā rén yì qǐ chī fàn de shí jiān hěn shén shèng.
entries.answerEnglish: To me, family mealtimes are sacred.

entries.example: 每天早上開會是我們的例行公事。
entries.examplePinyin: měi tiān zǎo shàng kāi huì shì wǒ men de lì xíng gōng shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: The morning meeting is part of our daily routine.
entries.question: 你每天早上的例行公事是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ měi tiān zǎo shàng de lì xíng gōng shì shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What's your morning routine?
entries.answer: 我的例行公事是先喝咖啡，再看新聞。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de lì xíng gōng shì shì xiān hē kā fēi, zài kàn xīn wén.
entries.answerEnglish: My routine is coffee first, then the news.

entries.example: 這件事到現在還是一個謎團。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn shì dào xiàn zài hái shì yí gè mí tuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: This is still a mystery even now.
entries.question: 你生活中有什麼解不開的謎團？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēng huó zhōng yǒu shén me jiě bù kāi de mí tuán?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there an unsolved mystery in your life?
entries.answer: 我的襪子常常少一隻，真是個謎團。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de wà zi cháng cháng shǎo yì zhī, zhēn shì gè mí tuán.
entries.answerEnglish: My socks keep losing their pairs. It's a real mystery.

entries.example: 前面在修路，所以放了路障。
entries.examplePinyin: qián miàn zài xiū lù, suǒ yǐ fàng le lù zhàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: They're doing roadwork ahead, so there's a roadblock.
entries.question: 你騎車的時候遇過路障嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qí chē de shí hòu yù guò lù zhàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever run into a roadblock while riding?
entries.answer: 遇過，前面有路障，我只好繞路。
entries.answerPinyin: yù guò, qián miàn yǒu lù zhàng, wǒ zhǐ hǎo rào lù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there was a roadblock ahead, so I had to take a detour.

entries.example: 她從小就有非凡的音樂天分。
entries.examplePinyin: tā cóng xiǎo jiù yǒu fēi fán de yīn yuè tiān fèn.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's had an extraordinary gift for music since she was little.
entries.question: 你認識有非凡才能的人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ rèn shì yǒu fēi fán cái néng de rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know anyone with extraordinary talent?
entries.answer: 認識，我朋友有非凡的語言天分，會說六種語言。
entries.answerPinyin: rèn shì, wǒ péng yǒu yǒu fēi fán de yǔ yán tiān fèn, huì shuō liù zhǒng yǔ yán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my friend has an extraordinary gift for languages; she speaks six.

entries.example: 老闆要我明天交企劃書的初稿。
entries.examplePinyin: lǎo bǎn yào wǒ míng tiān jiāo qì huà shū de chū gǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: My boss wants the first draft of the proposal tomorrow.
entries.question: 你寫重要的東西會先寫初稿嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiě zhòng yào de dōng xī huì xiān xiě chū gǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you write a first draft before important writing?
entries.answer: 會，我都先寫初稿，再慢慢修改。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dōu xiān xiě chū gǎo, zài màn màn xiū gǎi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always write a first draft and then revise it.

entries.example: 博物館裡有一頂很漂亮的王冠。
entries.examplePinyin: bó wù guǎn lǐ yǒu yì dǐng hěn piào liang de wáng guān.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a beautiful crown in the museum.
entries.question: 你在哪裡看過真的王冠？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài nǎ lǐ kàn guò zhēn de wáng guān?
entries.questionEnglish: Where have you seen a real crown?
entries.answer: 我在倫敦的博物館看過王冠。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài lún dūn de bó wù guǎn kàn guò wáng guān.
entries.answerEnglish: I saw crowns in a museum in London.

entries.example: 用夜市小吃招待客戶，真是個絕妙的主意！
entries.examplePinyin: yòng yè shì xiǎo chī zhāo dài kè hù, zhēn shì gè jué miào de zhǔ yì!
entries.exampleEnglish: Treating clients to night market snacks is a brilliant idea!
entries.question: 你最近有什麼絕妙的點子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn yǒu shén me jué miào de diǎn zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you had any brilliant ideas lately?
entries.answer: 有，我想到一個學中文的絕妙方法。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ xiǎng dào yí gè xué zhōng wén de jué miào fāng fǎ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I came up with a brilliant way to learn Chinese.

entries.example: 鄉下奶奶家的院子外面有一道竹籬笆。
entries.examplePinyin: xiāng xià nǎi nai jiā de yuàn zi wài miàn yǒu yí dào zhú lí bā.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a bamboo fence around the yard at Grandma's house in the countryside.
entries.question: 你小時候的家有籬笆嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu de jiā yǒu lí bā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did your childhood home have a fence?
entries.answer: 有，我家前面有一道白色的籬笆。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiā qián miàn yǒu yí dào bái sè de lí bā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there was a white fence in front of my house.

entries.example: 這兩隻公雞很好鬥，不能關在一起。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè liǎng zhī gōng jī hěn hào dòu, bù néng guān zài yì qǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: These two roosters are aggressive; they can't be kept together.
entries.question: 你覺得自己的個性好鬥嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ de gè xìng hào dòu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you have a combative personality?
entries.answer: 不會，我很少跟人吵架，一點也不好鬥。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ hěn shǎo gēn rén chǎo jià, yì diǎn yě bù hào dòu.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I rarely argue with people; I'm not combative at all.

entries.example: 教練說深蹲可以練臀部的肌肉。
entries.examplePinyin: jiào liàn shuō shēn dūn kě yǐ liàn tún bù de jī ròu.
entries.exampleEnglish: The coach says squats work your glute muscles.
entries.question: 你去健身房會練臀部嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù jiàn shēn fáng huì liàn tún bù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you work on your glutes at the gym?
entries.answer: 會，我每週練兩次腿和臀部。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi zhōu liàn liǎng cì tuǐ hé tún bù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I train legs and glutes twice a week.

entries.example: 他從一家小店開始，建立了自己的商業帝國。
entries.examplePinyin: tā cóng yì jiā xiǎo diàn kāi shǐ, jiàn lì le zì jǐ de shāng yè dì guó.
entries.exampleEnglish: He started with one small shop and built his own business empire.
entries.question: 你對哪個古代帝國最有興趣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì nǎ gè gǔ dài dì guó zuì yǒu xìng qù?
entries.questionEnglish: Which ancient empire interests you most?
entries.answer: 我對羅馬帝國最有興趣。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ duì luó mǎ dì guó zuì yǒu xìng qù.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm most interested in the Roman Empire.

entries.example: 這家咖啡廳放的音樂很輕柔，很適合看書。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā kā fēi tīng fàng de yīn yuè hěn qīng róu, hěn shì hé kàn shū.
entries.exampleEnglish: The music in this café is soft; it's great for reading.
entries.question: 你睡覺前喜歡聽輕柔的音樂嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shuì jiào qián xǐ huan tīng qīng róu de yīn yuè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like listening to soft music before bed?
entries.answer: 喜歡，輕柔的鋼琴音樂讓我很快睡著。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, qīng róu de gāng qín yīn yuè ràng wǒ hěn kuài shuì zháo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, soft piano music helps me fall asleep quickly.

entries.example: 地震來的時候，大家臉上都是驚恐的表情。
entries.examplePinyin: dì zhèn lái de shí hòu, dà jiā liǎn shàng dōu shì jīng kǒng de biǎo qíng.
entries.exampleEnglish: When the earthquake hit, everyone had a look of terror on their face.
entries.question: 你看恐怖片的時候會很驚恐嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn kǒng bù piàn de shí hòu huì hěn jīng kǒng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you get terrified watching horror movies?
entries.answer: 會，看到最可怕的地方我會驚恐地大叫。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, kàn dào zuì kě pà de dì fāng wǒ huì jīng kǒng de dà jiào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, at the scariest parts I scream in terror.

entries.example: 水壓太大，廁所的水管爆裂了。
entries.examplePinyin: shuǐ yā tài dà, cè suǒ de shuǐ guǎn bào liè le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The water pressure was too high and the bathroom pipe burst.
entries.question: 你家遇過水管爆裂的問題嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yù guò shuǐ guǎn bào liè de wèn tí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has your home ever had a burst pipe?
entries.answer: 遇過，去年廚房的水管爆裂，地上都是水。
entries.answerPinyin: yù guò, qù nián chú fáng de shuǐ guǎn bào liè, dì shàng dōu shì shuǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, last year the kitchen pipe burst and the floor was covered in water.

entries.example: 他離開自己的國家，向別的國家申請政治庇護。
entries.examplePinyin: tā lí kāi zì jǐ de guó jiā, xiàng bié de guó jiā shēn qǐng zhèng zhì bì hù.
entries.exampleEnglish: He left his country and applied for political asylum elsewhere.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣應該給難民庇護嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān yīng gāi gěi nàn mín bì hù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwan should give refugees asylum?
entries.answer: 我覺得應該給需要的人庇護。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de yīng gāi gěi xū yào de rén bì hù.
entries.answerEnglish: I think we should give asylum to people who need it.

entries.example: 公司對員工的穿著有很清楚的規範。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng sī duì yuán gōng de chuān zhuó yǒu hěn qīng chǔ de guī fàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The company has clear rules about what employees wear.
entries.question: 你們公司有哪些規範讓你覺得奇怪？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men gōng sī yǒu nǎ xiē guī fàn ràng nǐ jué de qí guài?
entries.questionEnglish: What rules at your company seem strange to you?
entries.answer: 我們公司規範上班不能穿短褲，我覺得很奇怪。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men gōng sī guī fàn shàng bān bù néng chuān duǎn kù, wǒ jué de hěn qí guài.
entries.answerEnglish: Our company rules say we can't wear shorts to work, which I find strange.

entries.example: 她的能力很出眾，很快就升上主管。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de néng lì hěn chū zhòng, hěn kuài jiù shēng shàng zhǔ guǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's exceptionally capable and was quickly promoted to manager.
entries.question: 你覺得自己哪方面比較出眾？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ nǎ fāng miàn bǐ jiào chū zhòng?
entries.questionEnglish: In what area do you think you stand out?
entries.answer: 我的語言能力比較出眾，會說四種語言。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de yǔ yán néng lì bǐ jiào chū zhòng, huì shuō sì zhǒng yǔ yán.
entries.answerEnglish: My language skills stand out; I speak four languages.

entries.example: 這棟老房子是用混凝土蓋的，很堅固。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè dòng lǎo fáng zi shì yòng hùn níng tǔ gài de, hěn jiān gù.
entries.exampleEnglish: This old house is built of concrete and is very solid.
entries.question: 你喜歡混凝土建築還是木頭房子？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan hùn níng tǔ jiàn zhú hái shì mù tou fáng zi?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer concrete buildings or wooden houses?
entries.answer: 我喜歡木頭房子，混凝土看起來太冷了。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan mù tou fáng zi, hùn níng tǔ kàn qǐ lái tài lěng le.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer wooden houses; concrete looks too cold.

entries.example: 起霧了，我們只看得到山的輪廓。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐ wù le, wǒ men zhǐ kàn de dào shān de lún kuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's foggy; we can only see the outline of the mountains.
entries.question: 你的臉的輪廓像爸爸還是媽媽？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de liǎn de lún kuò xiàng bà ba hái shì mā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is the shape of your face more like your dad's or your mom's?
entries.answer: 我的臉的輪廓比較像我爸爸。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de liǎn de lún kuò bǐ jiào xiàng wǒ bà ba.
entries.answerEnglish: The shape of my face is more like my dad's.

entries.example: 她對流行的東西很敏銳，總是第一個知道。
entries.examplePinyin: tā duì liú xíng de dōng xī hěn mǐn ruì, zǒng shì dì yī gè zhī dào.
entries.exampleEnglish: She has a keen sense for trends and is always the first to know.
entries.question: 你覺得自己對聲音敏銳嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ duì shēng yīn mǐn ruì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're sensitive to sounds?
entries.answer: 很敏銳，有一點聲音我就睡不著。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn mǐn ruì, yǒu yì diǎn shēng yīn wǒ jiù shuì bù zháo.
entries.answerEnglish: Very; the slightest sound keeps me awake.

entries.example: 有一位美國參議員今天來台灣訪問。
entries.examplePinyin: yǒu yí wèi měi guó cān yì yuán jīn tiān lái tái wān fǎng wèn.
entries.exampleEnglish: A US senator is visiting Taiwan today.
entries.question: 你們國家有參議員嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men guó jiā yǒu cān yì yuán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your country have senators?
entries.answer: 有，我們國家有一百位參議員。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men guó jiā yǒu yì bǎi wèi cān yì yuán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our country has a hundred senators.

entries.example: 這部電影裡的壞人非常邪惡。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng lǐ de huài rén fēi cháng xié è.
entries.exampleEnglish: The villain in this movie is truly evil.
entries.question: 你覺得人天生是善良還是邪惡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de rén tiān shēng shì shàn liáng hái shì xié è?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think people are born good or evil?
entries.answer: 我覺得人天生善良，不是邪惡的。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de rén tiān shēng shàn liáng, bú shì xié è de.
entries.answerEnglish: I think people are born good, not evil.

entries.example: 我喜歡山上寧靜的早晨。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xǐ huan shān shàng níng jìng de zǎo chén.
entries.exampleEnglish: I love the tranquil mornings in the mountains.
entries.question: 在台灣，你覺得哪裡最寧靜？
entries.questionPinyin: zài tái wān, nǐ jué de nǎ lǐ zuì níng jìng?
entries.questionEnglish: Where in Taiwan do you think is the most peaceful?
entries.answer: 我覺得花東的海邊最寧靜。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de huā dōng de hǎi biān zuì níng jìng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think the coast of Hualien and Taitung is the most peaceful.

entries.example: 這家茶館布置得很雅緻，很適合聊天。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā chá guǎn bù zhì de hěn yǎ zhì, hěn shì hé liáo tiān.
entries.exampleEnglish: This teahouse is tastefully decorated, perfect for a chat.
entries.question: 你喜歡雅緻的咖啡廳還是熱鬧的夜市？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan yǎ zhì de kā fēi tīng hái shì rè nào de yè shì?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer elegant cafés or lively night markets?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡雅緻的咖啡廳，比較安靜。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan yǎ zhì de kā fēi tīng, bǐ jiào ān jìng.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer elegant cafés; they're quieter.

entries.example: 孫子回來過年，奶奶非常歡喜。
entries.examplePinyin: sūn zi huí lái guò nián, nǎi nai fēi cháng huān xǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Grandma was delighted that her grandson came home for New Year.
entries.question: 什麼事會讓你滿心歡喜？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shì huì ràng nǐ mǎn xīn huān xǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: What fills you with joy?
entries.answer: 收到家人寄來的包裹，我就滿心歡喜。
entries.answerPinyin: shōu dào jiā rén jì lái de bāo guǒ, wǒ jiù mǎn xīn huān xǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: When I get a package from my family, I'm filled with joy.

entries.example: 這家店的招牌很醒目，一下就看到了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn de zhāo pái hěn xǐng mù, yí xià jiù kàn dào le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop's sign is eye-catching; you spot it right away.
entries.question: 你喜歡穿顏色醒目的衣服嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chuān yán sè xǐng mù de yī fu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like wearing eye-catching colors?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，我覺得醒目的顏色太引人注意了。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xǐ huan, wǒ jué de xǐng mù de yán sè tài yǐn rén zhù yì le.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I think striking colors draw too much attention.

entries.example: 媽媽在廚房剁肉做水餃。
entries.examplePinyin: mā ma zài chú fáng duò ròu zuò shuǐ jiǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Mom is mincing meat in the kitchen to make dumplings.
entries.question: 你包水餃的時候會自己剁肉嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bāo shuǐ jiǎo de shí hòu huì zì jǐ duò ròu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you make dumplings, do you mince the meat yourself?
entries.answer: 不會，我都買剁好的肉。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ dōu mǎi duò hǎo de ròu.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I always buy meat that's already minced.

entries.example: 颱風天，一棵樹倒下來砸到我的車。
entries.examplePinyin: tái fēng tiān, yì kē shù dǎo xià lái zá dào wǒ de chē.
entries.exampleEnglish: On the typhoon day, a tree fell and smashed into my car.
entries.question: 你有沒有不小心把東西砸壞過？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu bù xiǎo xīn bǎ dōng xī zá huài guò?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever accidentally smashed something?
entries.answer: 有，我搬家時不小心砸壞了一個花瓶。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ bān jiā shí bù xiǎo xīn zá huài le yí gè huā píng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when I moved I accidentally smashed a vase.

entries.example: 我的腳受傷了兩個月，現在終於痊癒了。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de jiǎo shòu shāng le liǎng gè yuè, xiàn zài zhōng yú quán yù le.
entries.exampleEnglish: My foot was injured for two months and has finally healed.
entries.question: 感冒通常要多久才會痊癒？
entries.questionPinyin: gǎn mào tōng cháng yào duō jiǔ cái huì quán yù?
entries.questionEnglish: How long does a cold usually take to clear up?
entries.answer: 通常一個禮拜左右就會痊癒了。
entries.answerPinyin: tōng cháng yí gè lǐ bài zuǒ yòu jiù huì quán yù le.
entries.answerEnglish: It usually clears up in about a week.

entries.example: 我的錢包裡還有幾個英國便士。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de qián bāo lǐ hái yǒu jǐ gè yīng guó biàn shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: I still have a few British pennies in my wallet.
entries.question: 你用過英國的便士嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yòng guò yīng guó de biàn shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever used British pennies?
entries.answer: 用過，我還留著幾個便士當紀念。
entries.answerPinyin: yòng guò, wǒ hái liú zhe jǐ gè biàn shì dàng jì niàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I still keep a few pennies as souvenirs.

entries.example: 這兩個方法本質上是一樣的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè liǎng gè fāng fǎ běn zhí shàng shì yí yàng de.
entries.exampleEnglish: These two methods are essentially the same.
entries.question: 你覺得工作和學習本質上一樣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de gōng zuò hé xué xí běn zhí shàng yí yàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think working and studying are essentially the same?
entries.answer: 我覺得本質上差不多，都需要努力。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de běn zhí shàng chà bù duō, dōu xū yào nǔ lì.
entries.answerEnglish: I think they're essentially similar; both take effort.

entries.example: 這部電影在講一個謀殺案。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng zài jiǎng yí gè móu shā àn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This movie is about a murder case.
entries.question: 推理小說裡常常有什麼案子？
entries.questionPinyin: tuī lǐ xiǎo shuō lǐ cháng cháng yǒu shén me àn zi?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of cases often come up in mystery novels?
entries.answer: 推理小說裡常常有謀殺案。
entries.answerPinyin: tuī lǐ xiǎo shuō lǐ cháng cháng yǒu móu shā àn.
entries.answerEnglish: Mystery novels often have murder cases.

entries.example: 台灣有很多特有的物種。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān yǒu hěn duō tè yǒu de wù zhǒng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan has many species found nowhere else.
entries.question: 你最喜歡台灣的哪個物種？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan tái wān de nǎ gè wù zhǒng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which of Taiwan's species do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡台灣黑熊這個物種。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan tái wān hēi xióng zhè ge wù zhǒng.
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite species is the Formosan black bear.

entries.example: 簽約前要仔細看清楚條款。
entries.examplePinyin: qiān yuē qián yào zǐ xì kàn qīng chǔ tiáo kuǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Read the terms carefully before you sign a contract.
entries.question: 你簽約前會看清楚所有條款嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qiān yuē qián huì kàn qīng chǔ suǒ yǒu tiáo kuǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you read all the terms carefully before signing a contract?
entries.answer: 會，我一定會先看完所有條款。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ yí dìng huì xiān kàn wán suǒ yǒu tiáo kuǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always read all the terms first.

entries.example: 開店前要先了解相關法規。
entries.examplePinyin: kāi diàn qián yào xiān liǎo jiě xiāng guān fǎ guī.
entries.exampleEnglish: Before opening a shop, you need to understand the relevant regulations.
entries.question: 你了解台灣的交通法規嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ liǎo jiě tái wān de jiāo tōng fǎ guī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: How well do you know Taiwan's traffic regulations?
entries.answer: 了解一些，考駕照的時候學過交通法規。
entries.answerPinyin: liǎo jiě yì xiē, kǎo jià zhào de shí hòu xué guò jiāo tōng fǎ guī.
entries.answerEnglish: A bit. I learned the traffic rules when I took my driving test.

entries.example: 這個小鎮仰賴觀光客生活。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge xiǎo zhèn yǎng lài guān guāng kè shēng huó.
entries.exampleEnglish: This small town depends on tourists to survive.
entries.question: 你的工作很仰賴電腦嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng zuò hěn yǎng lài diàn nǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your work rely heavily on computers?
entries.answer: 對，我的工作非常仰賴電腦。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ de gōng zuò fēi cháng yǎng lài diàn nǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my work depends heavily on computers.

entries.example: 政府應該照顧人民的福祉。
entries.examplePinyin: zhèng fǔ yīng gāi zhào gù rén mín de fú zhǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The government should look after the people's well-being.
entries.question: 你覺得你的公司重視員工福祉嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ de gōng sī zhòng shì yuán gōng fú zhǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your company cares about employee well-being?
entries.answer: 我覺得我們公司很重視員工福祉。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de wǒ men gōng sī hěn zhòng shì yuán gōng fú zhǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I think our company cares a lot about employee well-being.

entries.example: 這個國家的政權換了好幾次。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge guó jiā de zhèng quán huàn le hǎo jǐ cì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Power in this country has changed hands several times.
entries.question: 你的國家最近政權有改變嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā zuì jìn zhèng quán yǒu gǎi biàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has there been a change of government in your country recently?
entries.answer: 有，去年選舉以後政權輪替了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, qù nián xuǎn jǔ yǐ hòu zhèng quán lún tì le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, power changed hands after last year's election.

entries.example: 評審團選出了今年最好的電影。
entries.examplePinyin: píng shěn tuán xuǎn chū le jīn nián zuì hǎo de diàn yǐng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The jury chose this year's best film.
entries.question: 你參加過有評審團的比賽嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān jiā guò yǒu píng shěn tuán de bǐ sài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever entered a competition with a panel of judges?
entries.answer: 參加過，評審團給了我很高的分數。
entries.answerPinyin: cān jiā guò, píng shěn tuán gěi le wǒ hěn gāo de fēn shù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the judges gave me a high score.

entries.example: 我們先假定明天不會下雨。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men xiān jiǎ dìng míng tiān bú huì xià yǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's assume for now that it won't rain tomorrow.
entries.question: 計畫旅行時，你會假定天氣很好嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: jì huà lǚ xíng shí, nǐ huì jiǎ dìng tiān qì hěn hǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you plan a trip, do you assume the weather will be good?
entries.answer: 不會，我不會假定天氣一定很好。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ bú huì jiǎ dìng tiān qì yí dìng hěn hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I never assume the weather will be good.

entries.example: 這家餐廳拿到很高的評等。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā cān tīng ná dào hěn gāo de píng děng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant got a very high rating.
entries.question: 你選餐廳時會看評等嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xuǎn cān tīng shí huì kàn píng děng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you check ratings when choosing a restaurant?
entries.answer: 會，我只去評等四顆星以上的餐廳。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ zhǐ qù píng děng sì kē xīng yǐ shàng de cān tīng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I only go to restaurants rated four stars or above.

entries.example: 開會前請先看一下議程。
entries.examplePinyin: kāi huì qián qǐng xiān kàn yí xià yì chéng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please look over the agenda before the meeting.
entries.question: 你們開會前會先發議程嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men kāi huì qián huì xiān fā yì chéng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you send out an agenda before meetings?
entries.answer: 會，主管會先把議程寄給大家。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, zhǔ guǎn huì xiān bǎ yì chéng jì gěi dà jiā.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our manager emails the agenda to everyone first.

entries.example: 我們跟一家經銷商買了新車。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men gēn yì jiā jīng xiāo shāng mǎi le xīn chē.
entries.exampleEnglish: We bought a new car from a dealer.
entries.question: 你買車時會比較不同的經銷商嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi chē shí huì bǐ jiào bù tóng de jīng xiāo shāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you buy a car, do you compare different dealers?
entries.answer: 會，我會多看幾家經銷商。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì duō kàn jǐ jiā jīng xiāo shāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I check out several dealers.

entries.example: 這次選舉有很多國外觀察員。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì xuǎn jǔ yǒu hěn duō guó wài guān chá yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are many foreign observers at this election.
entries.question: 你當過活動的觀察員嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dāng guò huó dòng de guān chá yuán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been an observer at an event?
entries.answer: 沒有，我沒當過觀察員。
entries.answerPinyin: méi yǒu, wǒ méi dāng guò guān chá yuán.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I've never been an observer.

entries.example: 墮胎在很多國家都有爭議。
entries.examplePinyin: duò tāi zài hěn duō guó jiā dōu yǒu zhēng yì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Abortion is controversial in many countries.
entries.question: 你的國家允許墮胎嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā yǔn xǔ duò tāi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is abortion allowed in your country?
entries.answer: 允許，在我的國家墮胎是合法的。
entries.answerPinyin: yǔn xǔ, zài wǒ de guó jiā duò tāi shì hé fǎ de.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, abortion is legal in my country.

entries.example: 電影裡的指揮官非常勇敢。
entries.examplePinyin: diàn yǐng lǐ de zhǐ huī guān fēi cháng yǒng gǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The commander in the movie is very brave.
entries.question: 你覺得你適合當指揮官嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ shì hé dāng zhǐ huī guān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you'd make a good commander?
entries.answer: 不適合，我不想當指揮官。
entries.answerPinyin: bú shì hé, wǒ bù xiǎng dāng zhǐ huī guān.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I wouldn't want to be a commander.

entries.example: 台灣的戰略位置很重要。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān de zhàn lüè wèi zhì hěn zhòng yào.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan's strategic location is very important.
entries.question: 你玩遊戲時會想戰略嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ wán yóu xì shí huì xiǎng zhàn lüè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think about strategy when you play games?
entries.answer: 會，我玩遊戲很重視戰略。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ wán yóu xì hěn zhòng shì zhàn lüè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, strategy matters a lot to me when I play games.

entries.example: 有自殺的念頭時，一定要找人幫忙。
entries.examplePinyin: yǒu zì shā de niàn tou shí, yí dìng yào zhǎo rén bāng máng.
entries.exampleEnglish: If you have thoughts of suicide, be sure to reach out for help.
entries.question: 你的國家有自殺防治專線嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā yǒu zì shā fáng zhì zhuān xiàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your country have a suicide prevention hotline?
entries.answer: 有，我的國家也有自殺防治專線。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de guó jiā yě yǒu zì shā fáng zhì zhuān xiàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my country has a suicide prevention hotline too.

entries.example: 牆上掛著一幅爺爺的肖像畫。
entries.examplePinyin: qiáng shàng guà zhe yì fú yé ye de xiào xiàng huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: A portrait of Grandpa hangs on the wall.
entries.question: 你想請人幫你畫肖像畫嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng qǐng rén bāng nǐ huà xiào xiàng huà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to have your portrait painted?
entries.answer: 想，我想在夜市請人畫肖像畫。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, wǒ xiǎng zài yè shì qǐng rén huà xiào xiàng huà.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to get a portrait done at a night market.

entries.example: 新聞說鄰國又試射了飛彈。
entries.examplePinyin: xīn wén shuō lín guó yòu shì shè le fēi dàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The news says a neighboring country test-fired missiles again.
entries.question: 飛彈和火箭有什麼不同？
entries.questionPinyin: fēi dàn hé huǒ jiàn yǒu shén me bù tóng?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the difference between a missile and a rocket?
entries.answer: 飛彈是武器，火箭可以把衛星送上太空。
entries.answerPinyin: fēi dàn shì wǔ qì, huǒ jiàn kě yǐ bǎ wèi xīng sòng shàng tài kōng.
entries.answerEnglish: A missile is a weapon; a rocket can carry satellites into space.

entries.example: 衛生檢查員今天來餐廳檢查。
entries.examplePinyin: wèi shēng jiǎn chá yuán jīn tiān lái cān tīng jiǎn chá.
entries.exampleEnglish: A health inspector came to inspect the restaurant today.
entries.question: 你覺得檢查員的工作辛苦嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de jiǎn chá yuán de gōng zuò xīn kǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think an inspector's job is hard?
entries.answer: 我覺得檢查員的工作很辛苦。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de jiǎn chá yuán de gōng zuò hěn xīn kǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: I think being an inspector is hard work.

entries.example: 每個國家都有自己的憲法。
entries.examplePinyin: měi gè guó jiā dōu yǒu zì jǐ de xiàn fǎ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Every country has its own constitution.
entries.question: 你讀過你們國家的憲法嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dú guò nǐ men guó jiā de xiàn fǎ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you read your country's constitution?
entries.answer: 讀過一點，學校教過憲法。
entries.answerPinyin: dú guò yì diǎn, xué xiào jiāo guò xiàn fǎ.
entries.answerEnglish: A little. We learned about the constitution in school.

entries.example: 我們不應該因為種族歧視別人。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men bú yīng gāi yīn wèi zhǒng zú qí shì bié rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: We shouldn't discriminate against people because of their race.
entries.question: 你住的城市有很多不同種族嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhù de chéng shì yǒu hěn duō bù tóng zhǒng zú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there many different races in the city where you live?
entries.answer: 有，我住的城市有很多不同種族的人。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ zhù de chéng shì yǒu hěn duō bù tóng zhǒng zú de rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, people of many different races live in my city.

entries.example: 台灣也發射過人造衛星。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān yě fā shè guò rén zào wèi xīng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan has launched satellites too.
entries.question: 你晚上看過人造衛星飛過天空嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ wǎn shàng kàn guò rén zào wèi xīng fēi guò tiān kōng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a satellite cross the night sky?
entries.answer: 看過一次，人造衛星飛得很快。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò yí cì, rén zào wèi xīng fēi de hěn kuài.
entries.answerEnglish: Once. The satellite moved really fast.

entries.example: 颱風來之前，要先加固窗戶。
entries.examplePinyin: tái fēng lái zhī qián, yào xiān jiā gù chuāng hù.
entries.exampleEnglish: Before a typhoon comes, you should reinforce the windows.
entries.question: 颱風天你會加固家裡的窗戶嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: tái fēng tiān nǐ huì jiā gù jiā lǐ de chuāng hù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you reinforce your windows when a typhoon comes?
entries.answer: 會，我會用膠帶加固窗戶。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì yòng jiāo dài jiā gù chuāng hù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I reinforce the windows with tape.

entries.example: 山上有登山客被虎頭蜂襲擊。
entries.examplePinyin: shān shàng yǒu dēng shān kè bèi hǔ tóu fēng xí jí.
entries.exampleEnglish: Some hikers in the mountains were attacked by hornets.
entries.question: 在海邊，什麼動物可能會襲擊人？
entries.questionPinyin: zài hǎi biān, shén me dòng wù kě néng huì xí jí rén?
entries.questionEnglish: At the beach, what animals might attack people?
entries.answer: 海鷗有時候會襲擊拿食物的人。
entries.answerPinyin: hǎi ōu yǒu shí hòu huì xí jí ná shí wù de rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Seagulls sometimes attack people holding food.

entries.example: 他的爸爸是個知識分子。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de bà ba shì gè zhī shì fèn zǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: His father is an intellectual.
entries.question: 你覺得自己是知識分子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ shì zhī shì fèn zǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you consider yourself an intellectual?
entries.answer: 不是，我不算是知識分子。
entries.answerPinyin: bú shì, wǒ bú suàn shì zhī shì fèn zǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I wouldn't call myself an intellectual.

entries.example: 他最後被法院定罪了。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zuì hòu bèi fǎ yuàn dìng zuì le.
entries.exampleEnglish: In the end he was convicted by the court.
entries.question: 沒有證據，法院可以定罪嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: méi yǒu zhèng jù, fǎ yuàn kě yǐ dìng zuì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can a court convict someone without evidence?
entries.answer: 不行，沒有證據就不能定罪。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xíng, méi yǒu zhèng jù jiù bù néng dìng zuì.
entries.answerEnglish: No, you can't convict anyone without evidence.

entries.example: 我爸爸以前是工廠的機器操作員。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ bà ba yǐ qián shì gōng chǎng de jī qì cāo zuò yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: My dad used to be a machine operator in a factory.
entries.question: 你覺得機器操作員的工作難嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de jī qì cāo zuò yuán de gōng zuò nán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think working as a machine operator is hard?
entries.answer: 我覺得機器操作員要非常小心。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de jī qì cāo zuò yuán yào fēi cháng xiǎo xīn.
entries.answerEnglish: I think machine operators have to be very careful.

entries.example: 朋友之間要相互尊重。
entries.examplePinyin: péng yǒu zhī jiān yào xiāng hù zūn zhòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Friends should respect each other.
entries.question: 你覺得夫妻需要相互信任嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de fū qī xū yào xiāng hù xìn rèn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think couples need to trust each other?
entries.answer: 當然需要，夫妻要相互信任。
entries.answerPinyin: dāng rán xū yào, fū qī yào xiāng hù xìn rèn.
entries.answerEnglish: Of course. Couples need to trust each other.

entries.example: 這座老磨坊現在變成咖啡店了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zuò lǎo mò fáng xiàn zài biàn chéng kā fēi diàn le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This old mill has been turned into a coffee shop.
entries.question: 你參觀過老磨坊嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān guān guò lǎo mò fáng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever visited an old mill?
entries.answer: 參觀過，我在荷蘭看過風車磨坊。
entries.answerPinyin: cān guān guò, wǒ zài hé lán kàn guò fēng chē mò fáng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw a windmill in the Netherlands.

entries.example: 少開車可以減少碳排放。
entries.examplePinyin: shǎo kāi chē kě yǐ jiǎn shǎo tàn pái fàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Driving less can cut carbon emissions.
entries.question: 你會想辦法減少碳排放嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì xiǎng bàn fǎ jiǎn shǎo tàn pái fàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you try to cut your carbon emissions?
entries.answer: 會，我常搭捷運來減少碳排放。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng dā jié yùn lái jiǎn shǎo tàn pái fàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often take the MRT to cut carbon emissions.

entries.example: 他參加了全國羽球錦標賽。
entries.examplePinyin: tā cān jiā le quán guó yǔ qiú jǐn biāo sài.
entries.exampleEnglish: He took part in the national badminton championship.
entries.question: 你看過什麼錦標賽？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò shén me jǐn biāo sài?
entries.questionEnglish: What tournaments have you watched?
entries.answer: 我去現場看過網球錦標賽。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qù xiàn chǎng kàn guò wǎng qiú jǐn biāo sài.
entries.answerEnglish: I've watched a tennis tournament live.

entries.example: 新竹有很多做精密儀器的公司。
entries.examplePinyin: xīn zhú yǒu hěn duō zuò jīng mì yí qì de gōng sī.
entries.exampleEnglish: Hsinchu has lots of companies that make precision instruments.
entries.question: 你會修理精密的東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì xiū lǐ jīng mì de dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you repair delicate, precise things?
entries.answer: 不會，手錶這種精密的東西我不會修。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, shǒu biǎo zhè zhǒng jīng mì de dōng xī wǒ bú huì xiū.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I can't fix precise things like watches.

entries.example: 她是動物權益的倡議者。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì dòng wù quán yì de chàng yì zhě.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's an advocate for animal rights.
entries.question: 你想當哪個議題的倡議者？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng dāng nǎ gè yì tí de chàng yì zhě?
entries.questionEnglish: What issue would you like to be an advocate for?
entries.answer: 我想當環保議題的倡議者。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng dāng huán bǎo yì tí de chàng yì zhě.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to be an advocate for the environment.

entries.example: 警察查扣了一批假貨。
entries.examplePinyin: jǐng chá chá kòu le yì pī jiǎ huò.
entries.exampleEnglish: The police seized a batch of counterfeit goods.
entries.question: 你的東西在機場被查扣過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de dōng xī zài jī chǎng bèi chá kòu guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has anything of yours ever been confiscated at an airport?
entries.answer: 有，我帶的水果在機場被查扣了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ dài de shuǐ guǒ zài jī chǎng bèi chá kòu le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the fruit I brought was confiscated at the airport.

entries.example: 他昏倒以後失去了意識。
entries.examplePinyin: tā hūn dǎo yǐ hòu shī qù le yì shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: He lost consciousness after he fainted.
entries.question: 你有環保意識嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu huán bǎo yì shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you environmentally conscious?
entries.answer: 有，我的環保意識很強。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de huán bǎo yì shì hěn qiáng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm very environmentally conscious.

entries.example: 這間房子的所有權是我爸爸的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiān fáng zi de suǒ yǒu quán shì wǒ bà ba de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This house belongs to my father.
entries.question: 你住的房子所有權是你的嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhù de fáng zi suǒ yǒu quán shì nǐ de ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you own the home you live in?
entries.answer: 不是，我住的房子所有權是房東的。
entries.answerPinyin: bú shì, wǒ zhù de fáng zi suǒ yǒu quán shì fáng dōng de.
entries.answerEnglish: No, the landlord owns the place I live in.

entries.example: 週末我想逃離城市，去山上走走。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng táo lí chéng shì, qù shān shàng zǒu zǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: This weekend I want to escape the city and go walk in the mountains.
entries.question: 你會想逃離忙碌的生活嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì xiǎng táo lí máng lù de shēng huó ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you ever want to escape your busy life?
entries.answer: 會，我常想逃離台北的人潮。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng xiǎng táo lí tái běi de rén cháo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often want to escape the crowds in Taipei.

entries.example: 我們在船的甲板上看海。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zài chuán de jiǎ bǎn shàng kàn hǎi.
entries.exampleEnglish: We watched the sea from the ship's deck.
entries.question: 坐船時，你喜歡站在甲板上嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zuò chuán shí, nǐ xǐ huan zhàn zài jiǎ bǎn shàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you take a boat, do you like standing on the deck?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我喜歡在甲板上吹海風。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ xǐ huan zài jiǎ bǎn shàng chuī hǎi fēng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love feeling the sea breeze on deck.

entries.example: 冷氣不動了，可能是電路有問題。
entries.examplePinyin: lěng qì bú dòng le, kě néng shì diàn lù yǒu wèn tí.
entries.exampleEnglish: The air conditioner stopped working; maybe there's a wiring problem.
entries.question: 你會自己修理電路嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zì jǐ xiū lǐ diàn lù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you fix electrical wiring yourself?
entries.answer: 不會，電路壞了我會找水電工。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, diàn lù huài le wǒ huì zhǎo shuǐ diàn gōng.
entries.answerEnglish: No, when the wiring breaks I call an electrician.

entries.example: 他酒駕鬧事，被送進拘留所。
entries.examplePinyin: tā jiǔ jià nào shì, bèi sòng jìn jū liú suǒ.
entries.exampleEnglish: He drove drunk and caused trouble, so he was taken to a detention center.
entries.question: 你覺得拘留所跟監獄一樣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de jū liú suǒ gēn jiān yù yí yàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think a detention center is the same as a prison?
entries.answer: 不一樣，拘留所是暫時關人的地方。
entries.answerPinyin: bù yí yàng, jū liú suǒ shì zhàn shí guān rén de dì fāng.
entries.answerEnglish: No, a detention center only holds people temporarily.

entries.example: 全公司集體去花蓮旅遊。
entries.examplePinyin: quán gōng sī jí tǐ qù huā lián lǚ yóu.
entries.exampleEnglish: The whole company went on a trip to Hualien together.
entries.question: 你們公司會集體出去玩嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men gōng sī huì jí tǐ chū qù wán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company go on trips together?
entries.answer: 會，我們每年集體去員工旅遊。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ men měi nián jí tǐ qù yuán gōng lǚ yóu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we all go on a company trip every year.

entries.example: 這首歌是他自己作曲的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shǒu gē shì tā zì jǐ zuò qǔ de.
entries.exampleEnglish: He wrote the music for this song himself.
entries.question: 你會作曲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zuò qǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you compose music?
entries.answer: 不會，可是我很想學作曲。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, kě shì wǒ hěn xiǎng xué zuò qǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: No, but I'd really like to learn to compose.

entries.example: 立法院通過了新的修正案。
entries.examplePinyin: lì fǎ yuàn tōng guò le xīn de xiū zhèng àn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The Legislative Yuan passed a new amendment.
entries.question: 你關心立法院的修正案嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ guān xīn lì fǎ yuàn de xiū zhèng àn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you follow the amendments passed by the Legislative Yuan?
entries.answer: 不太關心，修正案太難懂了。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài guān xīn, xiū zhèng àn tài nán dǒng le.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. Amendments are too hard to understand.

entries.example: 這家咖啡店的競爭者很多。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā kā fēi diàn de jìng zhēng zhě hěn duō.
entries.exampleEnglish: This coffee shop has a lot of competitors.
entries.question: 你的工作有很多競爭者嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng zuò yǒu hěn duō jìng zhēng zhě ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there a lot of competitors in your line of work?
entries.answer: 有，我這行的競爭者很多。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ zhè háng de jìng zhēng zhě hěn duō.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are lots of competitors in my field.

entries.example: 他是個很老練的業務。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì gè hěn lǎo liàn de yè wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a very seasoned salesman.
entries.question: 你覺得自己做事老練嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ zuò shì lǎo liàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you handle things like a seasoned pro?
entries.answer: 還不夠老練，我還在學習。
entries.answerPinyin: hái bú gòu lǎo liàn, wǒ hái zài xué xí.
entries.answerEnglish: Not experienced enough yet. I'm still learning.

entries.example: 冬天的樹枝光禿禿的。
entries.examplePinyin: dōng tiān de shù zhī guāng tū tū de.
entries.exampleEnglish: The branches are bare in winter.
entries.question: 你看過光禿禿的山嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò guāng tū tū de shān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a bare mountain?
entries.answer: 看過，那座山光禿禿的，沒有樹。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, nà zuò shān guāng tū tū de, méi yǒu shù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, that mountain was bare, with no trees.

entries.example: 這個政治人物最近有醜聞。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge zhèng zhì rén wù zuì jìn yǒu chǒu wén.
entries.exampleEnglish: This politician has been caught up in a scandal lately.
entries.question: 你最近看到什麼醜聞的新聞？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn kàn dào shén me chǒu wén de xīn wén?
entries.questionEnglish: What scandals have you seen in the news lately?
entries.answer: 我看到一個明星的醜聞。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ kàn dào yí gè míng xīng de chǒu wén.
entries.answerEnglish: I saw a scandal about a celebrity.

entries.example: 歷史上，這個國家常被侵略。
entries.examplePinyin: lì shǐ shàng, zhè ge guó jiā cháng bèi qīn lüè.
entries.exampleEnglish: Throughout history, this country was often invaded.
entries.question: 你的國家以前被侵略過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā yǐ qián bèi qīn lüè guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has your country ever been invaded?
entries.answer: 有，我的國家以前被侵略過。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de guó jiā yǐ qián bèi qīn lüè guò.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my country was invaded in the past.

entries.example: 警察抓到了兩個恐怖分子。
entries.examplePinyin: jǐng chá zhuā dào le liǎng gè kǒng bù fèn zǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The police caught two terrorists.
entries.question: 機場為什麼要做安全檢查？
entries.questionPinyin: jī chǎng wèi shén me yào zuò ān quán jiǎn chá?
entries.questionEnglish: Why do airports do security checks?
entries.answer: 為了防止恐怖分子帶危險物品上飛機。
entries.answerPinyin: wèi le fáng zhǐ kǒng bù fèn zǐ dài wéi xiǎn wù pǐn shàng fēi jī.
entries.answerEnglish: To stop terrorists from taking dangerous items onto planes.

entries.example: 我在航空展看到了戰鬥機。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài háng kōng zhǎn kàn dào le zhàn dòu jī.
entries.exampleEnglish: I saw fighter jets at the air show.
entries.question: 你看過戰鬥機飛過天空嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò zhàn dòu jī fēi guò tiān kōng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a fighter jet fly overhead?
entries.answer: 看過，戰鬥機飛過去的聲音很大。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, zhàn dòu jī fēi guò qù de shēng yīn hěn dà.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, fighter jets are really loud when they fly past.

entries.example: 新兵要接受很辛苦的訓練。
entries.examplePinyin: xīn bīng yào jiē shòu hěn xīn kǔ de xùn liàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: New recruits go through tough training.
entries.question: 你覺得新兵訓練辛苦嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de xīn bīng xùn liàn xīn kǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think basic training for new recruits is tough?
entries.answer: 很辛苦，我當新兵的時候每天都很累。
