entries.answerPinyin: hěn xīn kǔ, wǒ dāng xīn bīng de shí hòu měi tiān dōu hěn lèi.
entries.answerEnglish: Very tough. When I was a new recruit, I was exhausted every day.

entries.example: 我們要把兩個部門整合起來。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men yào bǎ liǎng gè bù mén zhěng hé qǐ lái.
entries.exampleEnglish: We need to merge the two departments.
entries.question: 你會用App整合你的行程嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì yòng App zhěng hé nǐ de xíng chéng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use an app to bring all your plans together?
entries.answer: 會，我用一個App整合所有行程。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ yòng yí gè App zhěng hé suǒ yǒu xíng chéng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I use one app to keep all my plans in one place.

entries.example: 一架噴射機從頭上飛過去。
entries.examplePinyin: yí jià pēn shè jī cóng tóu shàng fēi guò qù.
entries.exampleEnglish: A jet flew overhead.
entries.question: 你坐過私人噴射機嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò guò sī rén pēn shè jī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever flown on a private jet?
entries.answer: 沒有，我從來沒坐過私人噴射機。
entries.answerPinyin: méi yǒu, wǒ cóng lái méi zuò guò sī rén pēn shè jī.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I've never been on a private jet.

entries.example: 新聞報導了一起強暴案。
entries.examplePinyin: xīn wén bào dǎo le yì qǐ qiáng bào àn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The news reported a rape case.
entries.question: 強暴在法律上是很重的罪嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: qiáng bào zài fǎ lǜ shàng shì hěn zhòng de zuì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is rape a serious crime under the law?
entries.answer: 是，強暴是很重的罪，會被判刑。
entries.answerPinyin: shì, qiáng bào shì hěn zhòng de zuì, huì bèi pàn xíng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, rape is a serious crime that leads to a prison sentence.

entries.example: 他否認了所有的指控。
entries.examplePinyin: tā fǒu rèn le suǒ yǒu de zhǐ kòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: He denied all the accusations.
entries.question: 你被別人錯誤指控過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bèi bié rén cuò wù zhǐ kòng guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been wrongly accused?
entries.answer: 有，同事曾經指控我偷吃他的便當。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, tóng shì céng jīng zhǐ kòng wǒ tōu chī tā de biàn dāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a coworker once accused me of eating his lunch box.

entries.example: 這家公司做零售，也做批發。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā gōng sī zuò líng shòu, yě zuò pī fā.
entries.exampleEnglish: This company does both retail and wholesale.
entries.question: 你做過零售業的工作嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò guò líng shòu yè de gōng zuò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever worked in retail?
entries.answer: 做過，我以前在零售業當店員。
entries.answerPinyin: zuò guò, wǒ yǐ qián zài líng shòu yè dāng diàn yuán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I used to work as a sales clerk in retail.

entries.example: 她緊張得緊握著我的手。
entries.examplePinyin: tā jǐn zhāng de jǐn wò zhe wǒ de shǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: She was so nervous she gripped my hand tightly.
entries.question: 坐雲霄飛車時，你會緊握扶手嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zuò yún xiāo fēi chē shí, nǐ huì jǐn wò fú shǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: On a roller coaster, do you grip the handlebar tight?
entries.answer: 會，我會緊握扶手，閉上眼睛。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì jǐn wò fú shǒu, bì shàng yǎn jīng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I grip the handlebar and close my eyes.

entries.example: 颱風過後，海邊有很多漂流木。
entries.examplePinyin: tái fēng guò hòu, hǎi biān yǒu hěn duō piāo liú mù.
entries.exampleEnglish: After the typhoon, there was lots of driftwood on the beach.
entries.question: 你看過在海上漂流的垃圾嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò zài hǎi shàng piāo liú de lè sè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen trash drifting in the sea?
entries.answer: 看過，我在海邊看到很多漂流的垃圾。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài hǎi biān kàn dào hěn duō piāo liú de lè sè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've seen lots of drifting trash at the beach.

entries.example: 他因為詐欺被警察抓了。
entries.examplePinyin: tā yīn wèi zhà qī bèi jǐng chá zhuā le.
entries.exampleEnglish: He was arrested by the police for fraud.
entries.question: 你覺得網路詐欺多嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de wǎng lù zhà qī duō ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think there's a lot of online fraud?
entries.answer: 很多，網路詐欺越來越多了。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn duō, wǎng lù zhà qī yuè lái yuè duō le.
entries.answerEnglish: A lot. Online fraud keeps increasing.

entries.example: 晚上潮水會漲到這裡。
entries.examplePinyin: wǎn shàng cháo shuǐ huì zhǎng dào zhè lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: In the evening the tide comes up to here.
entries.question: 去海邊玩時，你會注意潮水嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: qù hǎi biān wán shí, nǐ huì zhù yì cháo shuǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you go to the beach, do you keep an eye on the tide?
entries.answer: 會，我會先查潮水的時間。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì xiān chá cháo shuǐ de shí jiān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I check the tide times first.

entries.example: 這家公司剝削員工，常常不給加班費。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā gōng sī bō xuè yuán gōng, cháng cháng bù gěi jiā bān fèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: This company exploits its staff and often doesn't pay overtime.
entries.question: 你覺得你被老闆剝削過嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ bèi lǎo bǎn bō xuè guò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you feel you've ever been exploited by a boss?
entries.answer: 有，以前的老闆常剝削我們。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, yǐ qián de lǎo bǎn cháng bō xuè wǒ men.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my old boss often exploited us.

entries.example: 雨太大了，我們先撤退吧！
entries.examplePinyin: yǔ tài dà le, wǒ men xiān chè tuì ba!
entries.exampleEnglish: The rain's too heavy. Let's retreat for now!
entries.question: 爬山遇到大雨，你會撤退嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: pá shān yù dào dà yǔ, nǐ huì chè tuì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: If it pours while you're hiking, do you turn back?
entries.answer: 會，下大雨我一定馬上撤退。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, xià dà yǔ wǒ yí dìng mǎ shàng chè tuì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, if it pours I always turn back right away.

entries.example: 很多人譴責這種行為。
entries.examplePinyin: hěn duō rén qiǎn zé zhè zhǒng xíng wéi.
entries.exampleEnglish: Many people condemn this kind of behavior.
entries.question: 你會在網路上譴責別人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zài wǎng lù shang qiǎn zé bié rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you ever condemn people online?
entries.answer: 不會，我不喜歡在網路上譴責別人。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ bù xǐ huan zài wǎng lù shang qiǎn zé bié rén.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't like condemning people online.

entries.example: 加入協會前要先看章程。
entries.examplePinyin: jiā rù xié huì qián yào xiān kàn zhāng chéng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Read the charter before joining the association.
entries.question: 你參加的社團有章程嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān jiā de shè tuán yǒu zhāng chéng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does the club you belong to have a charter?
entries.answer: 有，我們的社團有一份章程。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men de shè tuán yǒu yí fèn zhāng chéng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our club has a charter.

entries.example: 他是一個社會主義者。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì yí gè shè huì zhǔ yì zhě.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a socialist.
entries.question: 你身邊有社會主義者嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēn biān yǒu shè huì zhǔ yì zhě ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know any socialists?
entries.answer: 有，我大學同學是社會主義者。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ dà xué tóng xué shì shè huì zhǔ yì zhě.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a classmate from university is a socialist.

entries.example: 去年雞蛋短缺，很難買到。
entries.examplePinyin: qù nián jī dàn duǎn quē, hěn nán mǎi dào.
entries.exampleEnglish: Last year there was an egg shortage, and eggs were hard to find.
entries.question: 你遇過什麼東西短缺嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yù guò shén me dōng xī duǎn quē ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever experienced a shortage of something?
entries.answer: 遇過，有一陣子雞蛋短缺，很難買。
entries.answerPinyin: yù guò, yǒu yí zhèn zi jī dàn duǎn quē, hěn nán mǎi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, for a while there was an egg shortage and they were hard to buy.

entries.example: 他說話的語氣很和緩。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shuō huà de yǔ qì hěn hé huǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He speaks in a calm, gentle tone.
entries.question: 你跟人吵架時語氣和緩嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gēn rén chǎo jià shí yǔ qì hé huǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you keep a calm tone when arguing with someone?
entries.answer: 我會盡量讓語氣和緩一點。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì jìn liàng ràng yǔ qì hé huǎn yì diǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: I try to keep my tone a bit calmer.

entries.example: 他在外交部工作。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài wài jiāo bù gōng zuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: He works at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
entries.question: 你對外交工作有興趣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì wài jiāo gōng zuò yǒu xìng qù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you interested in diplomatic work?
entries.answer: 有，我很想從事外交工作。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ hěn xiǎng cóng shì wài jiāo gōng zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd really like to work in diplomacy.

entries.example: 淹水的時候要用抽水機。
entries.examplePinyin: yān shuǐ de shí hòu yào yòng chōu shuǐ jī.
entries.exampleEnglish: When it floods, you need a water pump.
entries.question: 你家有抽水機嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yǒu chōu shuǐ jī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a water pump at home?
entries.answer: 沒有，可是我們大樓有抽水機。
entries.answerPinyin: méi yǒu, kě shì wǒ men dà lóu yǒu chōu shuǐ jī.
entries.answerEnglish: No, but our building has a water pump.

entries.example: 我們家每年的總收入不高。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men jiā měi nián de zǒng shōu rù bù gāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Our household's total yearly income isn't high.
entries.question: 你知道你一年的總收入嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào nǐ yì nián de zǒng shōu rù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know your total yearly income?
entries.answer: 知道，報稅的時候我會算總收入。
entries.answerPinyin: zhī dào, bào shuì de shí hòu wǒ huì suàn zǒng shōu rù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I work out my total income when I file my taxes.

entries.example: 花椰菜的莖也可以吃。
entries.examplePinyin: huā yē cài de jīng yě kě yǐ chī.
entries.exampleEnglish: You can eat broccoli stems too.
entries.question: 你吃花椰菜時會吃莖嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chī huā yē cài shí huì chī jīng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you eat the stem when you eat broccoli?
entries.answer: 會，我覺得花椰菜的莖很好吃。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ jué de huā yē cài de jīng hěn hǎo chī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I think broccoli stems are tasty.

entries.example: 這是一架民用飛機。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shì yí jià mín yòng fēi jī.
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a civilian aircraft.
entries.question: 你覺得民用無人機要管嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de mín yòng wú rén jī yào guǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think civilian drones should be regulated?
entries.answer: 要管，民用無人機不能亂飛。
entries.answerPinyin: yào guǎn, mín yòng wú rén jī bù néng luàn fēi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, civilian drones shouldn't fly just anywhere.

entries.example: 一支船隊慢慢開進了基隆港。
entries.examplePinyin: yì zhī chuán duì màn màn kāi jìn le jī lóng gǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: A fleet of ships slowly sailed into Keelung Harbor.
entries.question: 你看過很大的船隊嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò hěn dà de chuán duì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a large fleet of ships?
entries.answer: 看過，我在高雄港看過一支船隊。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài gāo xióng gǎng kàn guò yì zhī chuán duì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw a fleet at Kaohsiung Harbor.

entries.example: 水分子是由氫和氧組成的。
entries.examplePinyin: shuǐ fēn zǐ shì yóu qīng hé yǎng zǔ chéng de.
entries.exampleEnglish: A water molecule is made of hydrogen and oxygen.
entries.question: 你以前喜歡上化學課嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǐ qián xǐ huan shàng huà xué kè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you use to like chemistry class?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我覺得研究分子很有趣。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ jué de yán jiù fēn zǐ hěn yǒu qù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I found studying molecules really interesting.

entries.example: 政府的財政狀況不太好。
entries.examplePinyin: zhèng fǔ de cái zhèng zhuàng kuàng bú tài hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: The government's finances aren't in good shape.
entries.question: 你覺得你國家的財政好嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ guó jiā de cái zhèng hǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your country's finances are healthy?
entries.answer: 不太好，政府的財政有很多問題。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài hǎo, zhèng fǔ de cái zhèng yǒu hěn duō wèn tí.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really; the government's finances have a lot of problems.

entries.example: 這次車禍沒有人傷亡。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì chē huò méi yǒu rén shāng wáng.
entries.exampleEnglish: No one was hurt or killed in this car accident.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的車禍傷亡多嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān de chē huò shāng wáng duō ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwan has a lot of traffic casualties?
entries.answer: 很多，機車車禍的傷亡特別多。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn duō, jī chē chē huò de shāng wáng tè bié duō.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, especially from scooter accidents.

entries.example: 他終於履行了他的承諾。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zhōng yú lǚ xíng le tā de chéng nuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: He finally kept his promise.
entries.question: 你會履行對朋友的承諾嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì lǚ xíng duì péng yǒu de chéng nuò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you keep the promises you make to friends?
entries.answer: 會，我答應的事一定會履行。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ dā ying de shì yí dìng huì lǚ xíng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always carry out what I've promised.

entries.example: 晚上草叢裡有蟋蟀在叫。
entries.examplePinyin: wǎn shàng cǎo cóng lǐ yǒu xī shuài zài jiào.
entries.exampleEnglish: At night, crickets chirp in the grass.
entries.question: 你家附近晚上聽得到蟋蟀嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn wǎn shàng tīng de dào xī shuài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you hear crickets near your home at night?
entries.answer: 聽得到，夏天晚上常有蟋蟀叫。
entries.answerPinyin: tīng de dào, xià tiān wǎn shàng cháng yǒu xī shuài jiào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, crickets often chirp on summer nights.

entries.example: 煙太大，觸發了火災警報。
entries.examplePinyin: yān tài dà, chù fā le huǒ zāi jǐng bào.
entries.exampleEnglish: There was so much smoke that it set off the fire alarm.
entries.question: 你曾經觸發過警報器嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ céng jīng chù fā guò jǐng bào qì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever set off an alarm?
entries.answer: 有，我煮菜時觸發過煙霧警報器。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ zhǔ cài shí chù fā guò yān wù jǐng bào qì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I once set off the smoke alarm while cooking.

entries.example: 記者揭露了那家公司的問題。
entries.examplePinyin: jì zhě jiē lù le nà jiā gōng sī de wèn tí.
entries.exampleEnglish: A reporter exposed that company's problems.
entries.question: 記者應該揭露名人的私事嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: jì zhě yīng gāi jiē lù míng rén de sī shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Should reporters expose celebrities' private lives?
entries.answer: 不應該，記者只該揭露重要的事。
entries.answerPinyin: bú yīng gāi, jì zhě zhǐ gāi jiē lù zhòng yào de shì.
entries.answerEnglish: No, reporters should only expose things that matter.

entries.example: 這家公司今年發的股利很高。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā gōng sī jīn nián fā de gǔ lì hěn gāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This company paid a high dividend this year.
entries.question: 你買股票是為了領股利嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi gǔ piào shì wèi le lǐng gǔ lì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you buy stocks to collect dividends?
entries.answer: 對，我買股票主要是為了領股利。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ mǎi gǔ piào zhǔ yào shì wèi le lǐng gǔ lì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I mainly buy stocks for the dividends.

entries.example: 警察半夜突襲了那家店。
entries.examplePinyin: jǐng chá bàn yè tú xí le nà jiā diàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The police raided that shop in the middle of the night.
entries.question: 你的老闆會突襲檢查你的工作嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de lǎo bǎn huì tú xí jiǎn chá nǐ de gōng zuò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your boss make surprise checks on your work?
entries.answer: 會，他常常突襲檢查我們的進度。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, tā cháng cháng tú xí jiǎn chá wǒ men de jìn dù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, he often does surprise checks on our progress.

entries.example: 法院明天會做出判決。
entries.examplePinyin: fǎ yuàn míng tiān huì zuò chū pàn jué.
entries.exampleEnglish: The court will hand down its verdict tomorrow.
entries.question: 你覺得法官的判決都公平嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de fǎ guān de pàn jué dōu gōng píng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think judges' verdicts are always fair?
entries.answer: 不一定，有些判決不太公平。
entries.answerPinyin: bù yí dìng, yǒu xiē pàn jué bú tài gōng píng.
entries.answerEnglish: Not always; some verdicts aren't very fair.

entries.example: 那個國家昨天發生了政變。
entries.examplePinyin: nà ge guó jiā zuó tiān fā shēng le zhèng biàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: There was a coup in that country yesterday.
entries.question: 你的國家發生過政變嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā fā shēng guò zhèng biàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has your country ever had a coup?
entries.answer: 沒有，我的國家沒發生過政變。
entries.answerPinyin: méi yǒu, wǒ de guó jiā méi fā shēng guò zhèng biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: No, my country has never had a coup.

entries.example: 他昨天向老闆遞了辭呈。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zuó tiān xiàng lǎo bǎn dì le cí chéng.
entries.exampleEnglish: He handed his resignation to the boss yesterday.
entries.question: 你寫過辭呈嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiě guò cí chéng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever written a resignation letter?
entries.answer: 寫過，我去年遞過一次辭呈。
entries.answerPinyin: xiě guò, wǒ qù nián dì guò yí cì cí chéng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I handed one in last year.

entries.example: 我們公司有一位法律顧問。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men gōng sī yǒu yí wèi fǎ lǜ gù wèn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Our company has a legal adviser.
entries.question: 你工作上需要找法律顧問嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gōng zuò shàng xū yào zhǎo fǎ lǜ gù wèn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you need a legal adviser for your work?
entries.answer: 很少，有問題時才找法律顧問。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn shǎo, yǒu wèn tí shí cái zhǎo fǎ lǜ gù wèn.
entries.answerEnglish: Rarely; I only see a legal adviser when there's a problem.

entries.example: 他的公司去年宣告破產。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de gōng sī qù nián xuān gào pò chǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: His company declared bankruptcy last year.
entries.question: 你有沒有宣告失敗的新年計畫？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu xuān gào shī bài de xīn nián jì huà?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any New Year's plans that have officially failed?
entries.answer: 有，我的運動計畫已經宣告失敗了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de yùn dòng jì huà yǐ jīng xuān gào shī bài le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my exercise plan has officially failed.

entries.example: 那個城市昨晚發生了暴動。
entries.examplePinyin: nà ge chéng shì zuó wǎn fā shēng le bào dòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: A riot broke out in that city last night.
entries.question: 你的國家發生過暴動嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā fā shēng guò bào dòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has your country ever had riots?
entries.answer: 有，幾年前發生過一場暴動。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, jǐ nián qián fā shēng guò yì chǎng bào dòng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there was a riot a few years ago.

entries.example: 九份以前住了很多礦工。
entries.examplePinyin: jiǔ fèn yǐ qián zhù le hěn duō kuàng gōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Many miners used to live in Jiufen.
entries.question: 你覺得礦工的工作危險嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de kuàng gōng de gōng zuò wéi xiǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think a miner's job is dangerous?
entries.answer: 很危險，礦工真的很辛苦。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn wéi xiǎn, kuàng gōng zhēn de hěn xīn kǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: Very dangerous; miners really have it hard.

entries.english: debut (as a performer); start a career
entries.example: 這個歌手十六歲就出道了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge gē shǒu shí liù suì jiù chū dào le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This singer debuted at sixteen.
entries.question: 你最喜歡的歌手是哪年出道的？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan de gē shǒu shì nǎ nián chū dào de?
entries.questionEnglish: What year did your favorite singer debut?
entries.answer: 她是2010年出道的。
entries.answerPinyin: tā shì 2010 nián chū dào de.
entries.answerEnglish: She debuted in 2010.

entries.example: 週末凱達格蘭大道有一場集會。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōu mò kǎi dá gé lán dà dào yǒu yì chǎng jí huì.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a rally on Ketagalan Boulevard this weekend.
entries.question: 你參加過集會嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān jiā guò jí huì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever attended a rally?
entries.answer: 參加過，我參加過一次環保集會。
entries.answerPinyin: cān jiā guò, wǒ cān jiā guò yí cì huán bǎo jí huì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I once joined an environmental rally.

entries.example: 熬夜會削弱你的抵抗力。
entries.examplePinyin: áo yè huì xuè ruò nǐ de dǐ kàng lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Staying up late weakens your resistance to illness.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼會削弱你的動力？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me huì xuè ruò nǐ de dòng lì?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think weakens your motivation?
entries.answer: 太累的時候會削弱我的動力。
entries.answerPinyin: tài lèi de shí hòu huì xuè ruò wǒ de dòng lì.
entries.answerEnglish: Being too tired weakens my motivation.

entries.example: 今天股價暴跌，大家都很緊張。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn tiān gǔ jià bào dié, dà jiā dōu hěn jǐn zhāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Stock prices plunged today, and everyone is nervous.
entries.question: 如果股票暴跌，你會怎麼做？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ gǔ piào bào dié, nǐ huì zěn me zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: If your stocks plunged, what would you do?
entries.answer: 股票暴跌時，我會再買一點。
entries.answerPinyin: gǔ piào bào dié shí, wǒ huì zài mǎi yì diǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: When stocks plunge, I buy a little more.

entries.example: 台灣的代表團昨天到了東京。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān de dài biǎo tuán zuó tiān dào le dōng jīng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan's delegation arrived in Tokyo yesterday.
entries.question: 你參加過公司的代表團嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān jiā guò gōng sī de dài biǎo tuán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been part of a company delegation?
entries.answer: 參加過，我跟代表團去過日本開會。
entries.answerPinyin: cān jiā guò, wǒ gēn dài biǎo tuán qù guò rì běn kāi huì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I went to Japan with a delegation for meetings.

entries.example: 我朋友的爸爸是陸軍上校。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ péng yǒu de bà ba shì lù jūn shàng xiào.
entries.exampleEnglish: My friend's dad is an army colonel.
entries.question: 你認識當上校的人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ rèn shì dāng shàng xiào de rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know anyone who's a colonel?
entries.answer: 認識，我鄰居以前是空軍上校。
entries.answerPinyin: rèn shì, wǒ lín jū yǐ qián shì kōng jūn shàng xiào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my neighbor used to be an air force colonel.

entries.example: 這位球評說話很幽默。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè wèi qiú píng shuō huà hěn yōu mò.
entries.exampleEnglish: This sports commentator is really funny.
entries.question: 看球賽時，你會聽球評說話嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: kàn qiú sài shí, nǐ huì tīng qiú píng shuō huà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you listen to the commentators when watching games?
entries.answer: 會，我覺得有些球評說得很好。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ jué de yǒu xiē qiú píng shuō de hěn hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I think some commentators are really good.

entries.example: 這個政黨裡有很多派系。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge zhèng dǎng lǐ yǒu hěn duō pài xì.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are many factions within this party.
entries.question: 你的公司裡有派系嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng sī lǐ yǒu pài xì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there factions at your company?
entries.answer: 有，我們公司分成兩個派系。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men gōng sī fēn chéng liǎng gè pài xì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our company is split into two factions.

entries.example: 晚上一個人走路要提高警覺。
entries.examplePinyin: wǎn shàng yí gè rén zǒu lù yào tí gāo jǐng jué.
entries.exampleEnglish: When walking alone at night, stay alert.
entries.question: 接到陌生電話時，你會提高警覺嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: jiē dào mò shēng diàn huà shí, nǐ huì tí gāo jǐng jué ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you stay on guard when you get calls from strangers?
entries.answer: 會，我會提高警覺，小心詐騙。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì tí gāo jǐng jué, xiǎo xīn zhà piàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I stay alert and watch out for scams.

entries.example: 古代很多官員被流放到遠方。
entries.examplePinyin: gǔ dài hěn duō guān yuán bèi liú fàng dào yuǎn fāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: In ancient times, many officials were exiled to faraway places.
entries.question: 如果被流放到小島，你會帶什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ bèi liú fàng dào xiǎo dǎo, nǐ huì dài shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: If you were exiled to an island, what would you bring?
entries.answer: 如果被流放到小島，我會帶一本書。
entries.answerPinyin: rú guǒ bèi liú fàng dào xiǎo dǎo, wǒ huì dài yì běn shū.
entries.answerEnglish: If I were exiled to an island, I'd bring a book.

entries.example: 那個司機被檢察官起訴了。
entries.examplePinyin: nà ge sī jī bèi jiǎn chá guān qǐ sù le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The driver was indicted by the prosecutor.
entries.question: 在台灣，酒駕會被起訴嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zài tái wān, jiǔ jià huì bèi qǐ sù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: In Taiwan, can you be prosecuted for drunk driving?
entries.answer: 會，酒駕的人可能會被起訴。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, jiǔ jià de rén kě néng huì bèi qǐ sù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, drunk drivers can be prosecuted.

entries.example: 我的駕照明年要換發。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de jià zhào míng nián yào huàn fā.
entries.exampleEnglish: My driver's license needs to be renewed next year.
entries.question: 你的居留證多久要換發一次？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de jū liú zhèng duō jiǔ yào huàn fā yí cì?
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you have to renew your residence permit?
entries.answer: 我的居留證每年都要換發。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de jū liú zhèng měi nián dōu yào huàn fā.
entries.answerEnglish: I have to renew my residence permit every year.

entries.example: 這位醫生專攻皮膚問題。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè wèi yī shēng zhuān gōng pí fū wèn tí.
entries.exampleEnglish: This doctor specializes in skin problems.
entries.question: 你在大學專攻什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài dà xué zhuān gōng shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What did you specialize in at university?
entries.answer: 我在大學專攻經濟。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài dà xué zhuān gōng jīng jì.
entries.answerEnglish: I specialized in economics at university.

entries.example: 這次公投的結果明天公布。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì gōng tóu de jié guǒ míng tiān gōng bù.
entries.exampleEnglish: The results of this referendum will be announced tomorrow.
entries.question: 你的國家常常舉行公投嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā cháng cháng jǔ xíng gōng tóu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your country often hold referendums?
entries.answer: 不常，我們很少舉行公投。
entries.answerPinyin: bù cháng, wǒ men hěn shǎo jǔ xíng gōng tóu.
entries.answerEnglish: Not often; we rarely hold referendums.

entries.example: 他脾氣好得像聖人一樣。
entries.examplePinyin: tā pí qì hǎo de xiàng shèng rén yí yàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's as patient as a saint.
entries.question: 你認識脾氣好得像聖人的人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ rèn shi pí qì hǎo de xiàng shèng rén de rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know anyone as patient as a saint?
entries.answer: 認識，我媽媽就像聖人一樣。
entries.answerPinyin: rèn shì, wǒ mā ma jiù xiàng shèng rén yí yàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my mom is like a saint.

entries.example: 我每天早上看報紙的社論。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng kàn bào zhǐ de shè lùn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I read the newspaper editorial every morning.
entries.question: 你常看報紙的社論嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng kàn bào zhǐ de shè lùn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often read newspaper editorials?
entries.answer: 不常，我很少看社論。
entries.answerPinyin: bù cháng, wǒ hěn shǎo kàn shè lùn.
entries.answerEnglish: Not often; I rarely read editorials.

entries.example: 我們租了一艘遊艇出海。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zū le yì sāo yóu tǐng chū hǎi.
entries.exampleEnglish: We rented a yacht and went out to sea.
entries.question: 你坐過遊艇嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò guò yóu tǐng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been on a yacht?
entries.answer: 坐過，我在墾丁坐過遊艇。
entries.answerPinyin: zuò guò, wǒ zài kěn dīng zuò guò yóu tǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've been on a yacht in Kenting.

entries.example: 兩國簽了一項貿易協定。
entries.examplePinyin: liǎng guó qiān le yí xiàng mào yì xié dìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The two countries signed a trade agreement.
entries.question: 你覺得貿易協定對你的國家好嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de mào yì xié dìng duì nǐ de guó jiā hǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think trade agreements are good for your country?
entries.answer: 很好，貿易協定讓東西變便宜了。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn hǎo, mào yì xié dìng ràng dōng xī biàn pián yi le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, trade agreements have made things cheaper.

entries.example: 對我來說，早起是一種酷刑。
entries.examplePinyin: duì wǒ lái shuō, zǎo qǐ shì yì zhǒng kù xíng.
entries.exampleEnglish: For me, getting up early is torture.
entries.question: 對你來說，什麼事像酷刑？
entries.questionPinyin: duì nǐ lái shuō, shén me shì xiàng kù xíng?
entries.questionEnglish: What feels like torture to you?
entries.answer: 夏天沒有冷氣就是酷刑。
entries.answerPinyin: xià tiān méi yǒu lěng qì jiù shì kù xíng.
entries.answerEnglish: Summer without air conditioning is torture.

entries.example: 他們家的農場有一百英畝。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men jiā de nóng chǎng yǒu yì bǎi yīng mǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Their family farm is a hundred acres.
entries.question: 你家鄉的農場大概有幾英畝？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā xiāng de nóng chǎng dà gài yǒu jǐ yīng mǔ?
entries.questionEnglish: About how many acres are the farms in your hometown?
entries.answer: 大概有五十英畝。
entries.answerPinyin: dà gài yǒu wǔ shí yīng mǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: About fifty acres.

entries.example: 那個國家的領導人很好戰。
entries.examplePinyin: nà ge guó jiā de lǐng dǎo rén hěn hào zhàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: That country's leader is very belligerent.
entries.question: 你覺得好戰的國家可怕嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de hào zhàn de guó jiā kě pà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think warlike countries are frightening?
entries.answer: 很可怕，好戰的國家讓人不安。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn kě pà, hào zhàn de guó jiā ràng rén bù ān.
entries.answerEnglish: Very; warlike countries make people uneasy.

entries.example: 抽菸是他最大的惡習。
entries.examplePinyin: chōu yān shì tā zuì dà de è xí.
entries.exampleEnglish: Smoking is his worst habit.
entries.question: 你有什麼惡習想改掉？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu shén me è xí xiǎng gǎi diào?
entries.questionEnglish: What bad habit do you want to break?
entries.answer: 我想改掉熬夜的惡習。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng gǎi diào áo yè de è xí.
entries.answerEnglish: I want to break my habit of staying up late.

entries.example: 這段話是從那本書摘錄的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè duàn huà shì cóng nà běn shū zhāi lù de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This passage is excerpted from that book.
entries.question: 你看書時會摘錄好句子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn shū shí huì zhāi lù hǎo jù zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you copy out good sentences when you read?
entries.answer: 會，我會把喜歡的句子摘錄下來。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì bǎ xǐ huan de jù zi zhāi lù xià lái.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I copy out the sentences I like.

entries.example: 他們因為宗教被迫害。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men yīn wèi zōng jiào bèi pò hài.
entries.exampleEnglish: They were persecuted for their religion.
entries.question: 你覺得網路霸凌是一種迫害嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de wǎng lù bà líng shì yì zhǒng pò hài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think cyberbullying is a form of persecution?
entries.answer: 是，網路霸凌也是一種迫害。
entries.answerPinyin: shì, wǎng lù bà líng yě shì yì zhǒng pò hài.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, cyberbullying is also a kind of persecution.

entries.example: 他是這家公司的大股東。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì zhè jiā gōng sī de dà gǔ dōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a major shareholder in this company.
entries.question: 你當過公司的股東嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dāng guò gōng sī de gǔ dōng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been a shareholder in a company?
entries.answer: 當過，我是朋友咖啡店的股東。
entries.answerPinyin: dāng guò, wǒ shì péng yǒu kā fēi diàn de gǔ dōng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm a shareholder in my friend's café.

entries.example: 法院裁定這份合約無效。
entries.examplePinyin: fǎ yuàn cái dìng zhè fèn hé yuē wú xiào.
entries.exampleEnglish: The court ruled the contract invalid.
entries.question: 看比賽時，你相信裁判的裁定嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: kàn bǐ sài shí, nǐ xiāng xìn cái pàn de cái dìng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When watching games, do you trust the referee's rulings?
entries.answer: 大部分相信，但有些裁定不公平。
entries.answerPinyin: dà bù fèn xiāng xìn, dàn yǒu xiē cái dìng bù gōng píng.
entries.answerEnglish: Mostly, but some rulings are unfair.

entries.example: 中元節大家會在門口放供品。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōng yuán jié dà jiā huì zài mén kǒu fàng gòng pǐn.
entries.exampleEnglish: During Ghost Festival, people put offerings outside their doors.
entries.question: 你看過台灣人拜拜的供品嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò tái wān rén bài bài de gòng pǐn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen the offerings Taiwanese people make when they worship?
entries.answer: 看過，供品有水果和餅乾。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, gòng pǐn yǒu shuǐ guǒ hé bǐng gān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the offerings include fruit and cookies.

entries.example: 政府花太多錢，國庫快空了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhèng fǔ huā tài duō qián, guó kù kuài kōng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The government spent too much, and the treasury is almost empty.
entries.question: 你覺得國庫的錢該用在哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de guó kù de qián gāi yòng zài nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you think the treasury's money should go?
entries.answer: 我覺得國庫的錢應該用在教育上。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de guó kù de qián yīng gāi yòng zài jiào yù shàng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think public money should go to education.

entries.example: 那個國家的山區有游擊隊。
entries.examplePinyin: nà ge guó jiā de shān qū yǒu yóu jí duì.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are guerrillas in that country's mountains.
entries.question: 你看過關於游擊隊的電影嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò guān yú yóu jí duì de diàn yǐng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen a movie about guerrillas?
entries.answer: 看過，我看過一部關於游擊隊的電影。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ kàn guò yí bù guān yú yóu jí duì de diàn yǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've seen a movie about guerrillas.

entries.example: 新老闆接管了這家公司。
entries.examplePinyin: xīn lǎo bǎn jiē guǎn le zhè jiā gōng sī.
entries.exampleEnglish: The new boss took over the company.
entries.question: 如果你接管公司，你想改變什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ nǐ jiē guǎn gōng sī, nǐ xiǎng gǎi biàn shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: If you took over your company, what would you change?
entries.answer: 如果我接管公司，我會讓大家週五放假。
entries.answerPinyin: rú guǒ wǒ jiē guǎn gōng sī, wǒ huì ràng dà jiā zhōu wǔ fàng jià.
entries.answerEnglish: If I took over, I'd give everyone Fridays off.

entries.example: 她大學時很熱衷參加社運。
entries.examplePinyin: tā dà xué shí hěn rè zhōng cān jiā shè yùn.
entries.exampleEnglish: She was very active in social movements in college.
entries.question: 你參加過社運活動嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān jiā guò shè yùn huó dòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever taken part in activism?
entries.answer: 參加過，我參加過環保的社運活動。
entries.answerPinyin: cān jiā guò, wǒ cān jiā guò huán bǎo de shè yùn huó dòng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've joined environmental activism events.

entries.example: 政府打算讓這家銀行民營化。
entries.examplePinyin: zhèng fǔ dǎ suàn ràng zhè jiā yín háng mín yíng huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: The government plans to privatize this bank.
entries.question: 你覺得鐵路應該民營化嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tiě lù yīng gāi mín yíng huà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think the railways should be privatized?
entries.answer: 不應該，我覺得鐵路不該民營化。
entries.answerPinyin: bú yīng gāi, wǒ jué de tiě lù bù gāi mín yíng huà.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't think railways should be privatized.

entries.example: 兩國終於同意停火了。
entries.examplePinyin: liǎng guó zhōng yú tóng yì tíng huǒ le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The two countries finally agreed to a ceasefire.
entries.question: 你覺得戰爭中停火有用嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zhàn zhēng zhōng tíng huǒ yǒu yòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think ceasefires work in war?
entries.answer: 有用，停火可以救很多人。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu yòng, tíng huǒ kě yǐ jiù hěn duō rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a ceasefire can save many lives.

entries.example: 他把錢都拿去投資不動產。
entries.examplePinyin: tā bǎ qián dōu ná qù tóu zī bú dòng chǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He put all his money into real estate.
entries.question: 你想投資不動產嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng tóu zī bú dòng chǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to invest in real estate?
entries.answer: 想，但台北的不動產太貴了。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, dàn tái běi de bú dòng chǎn tài guì le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but real estate in Taipei is too expensive.

entries.example: 每個人對這句話的解讀都不同。
entries.examplePinyin: měi gè rén duì zhè jù huà de jiě dú dōu bù tóng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Everyone interprets this sentence differently.
entries.question: 你很會解讀別人的表情嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ hěn huì jiě dú bié rén de biǎo qíng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you good at reading people's expressions?
entries.answer: 還好，我比較會解讀朋友的表情。
entries.answerPinyin: hái hǎo, wǒ bǐ jiào huì jiě dú péng yǒu de biǎo qíng.
entries.answerEnglish: So-so; I'm better at reading my friends' expressions.

entries.example: 我們在猴硐參觀了老礦坑。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zài hóu dòng cān guān le lǎo kuàng kēng.
entries.exampleEnglish: We visited an old mine in Houtong.
entries.question: 你進過礦坑參觀嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jìn guò kuàng kēng cān guān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been inside a mine?
entries.answer: 進過，我在金瓜石進過礦坑。
entries.answerPinyin: jìn guò, wǒ zài jīn guā shí jìn guò kuàng kēng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I went into a mine in Jinguashi.

entries.example: 珍珠奶茶源自台中。
entries.examplePinyin: zhēn zhū nǎi chá yuán zì tái zhōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Bubble tea originated in Taichung.
entries.question: 你的名字源自哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de míng zì yuán zì nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where does your name come from?
entries.answer: 我的名字源自希臘文。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de míng zì yuán zì xī là wén.
entries.answerEnglish: My name comes from Greek.

entries.example: 他持有台灣和美國的護照。
entries.examplePinyin: tā chí yǒu tái wān hé měi guó de hù zhào.
entries.exampleEnglish: He holds Taiwanese and American passports.
entries.question: 你持有幾個國家的護照？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chí yǒu jǐ gè guó jiā de hù zhào?
entries.questionEnglish: How many countries' passports do you hold?
entries.answer: 我只持有一個國家的護照。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhǐ chí yǒu yí gè guó jiā de hù zhào.
entries.answerEnglish: I only hold one country's passport.

entries.example: 去廟裡不要穿太裸露的衣服。
entries.examplePinyin: qù miào lǐ bú yào chuān tài luǒ lù de yī fu.
entries.exampleEnglish: Don't wear revealing clothes to a temple.
entries.question: 你覺得上班可以穿得很裸露嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shàng bān kě yǐ chuān de hěn luǒ lù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think it's OK to wear revealing clothes to work?
entries.answer: 不行，上班穿太裸露不太好。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xíng, shàng bān chuān tài luǒ lù bú tài hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: No, it's not good to wear revealing clothes to work.

entries.example: 這家餐廳的熟成牛排很有名。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā cān tīng de shú chéng niú pái hěn yǒu míng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant's aged steak is famous.
entries.question: 你吃過熟成牛排嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chī guò shú chéng niú pái ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had aged steak?
entries.answer: 吃過，熟成牛排的味道很香。
entries.answerPinyin: chī guò, shú chéng niú pái de wèi dào hěn xiāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, aged steak has a really rich flavor.

entries.example: 醫生救活了那隻垂死的小狗。
entries.examplePinyin: yī shēng jiù huó le nà zhī chuí sǐ de xiǎo gǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: The vet saved the dying puppy.
entries.question: 在路上看到垂死的小動物，該怎麼辦？
entries.questionPinyin: zài lù shàng kàn dào chuí sǐ de xiǎo dòng wù, gāi zěn me bàn?
entries.questionEnglish: What should you do if you see a dying animal on the road?
entries.answer: 可以把垂死的小動物送去動物醫院。
entries.answerPinyin: kě yǐ bǎ chuí sǐ de xiǎo dòng wù sòng qù dòng wù yī yuàn.
entries.answerEnglish: You can take the dying animal to an animal hospital.

entries.example: 我們不應該教小孩仇恨。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men bú yīng gāi jiāo xiǎo hái chóu hèn.
entries.exampleEnglish: We shouldn't teach children to hate.
entries.question: 你覺得網路上的仇恨言論多嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de wǎng lù shang de chóu hèn yán lùn duō ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think there's a lot of hate speech online?
entries.answer: 很多，網路上常看到仇恨的留言。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn duō, wǎng lù shang cháng kàn dào chóu hèn de liú yán.
entries.answerEnglish: A lot. You often see hateful comments online.

entries.example: 他因為搶劫未遂被警察抓了。
entries.examplePinyin: tā yīn wèi qiǎng jié wèi suì bèi jǐng chá zhuā le.
entries.exampleEnglish: He was arrested by the police for attempted robbery.
entries.question: 在台灣，犯罪未遂也會被處罰嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zài tái wān, fàn zuì wèi suì yě huì bèi chǔ fá ma?
entries.questionEnglish: In Taiwan, can an attempted crime also be punished?
entries.answer: 會，犯罪未遂也可能會被處罰。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, fàn zuì wèi suì yě kě néng huì bèi chǔ fá.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, an attempted crime can also be punished.

entries.example: 公司把我的建議納入了新計畫。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng sī bǎ wǒ de jiàn yì nà rù le xīn jì huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: The company included my suggestion in the new plan.
entries.question: 你的意見常被主管納入考慮嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de yì jiàn cháng bèi zhǔ guǎn nà rù kǎo lǜ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your manager often take your opinions into account?
entries.answer: 有時候，主管會把我的意見納入考慮。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu, zhǔ guǎn huì bǎ wǒ de yì jiàn nà rù kǎo lǜ.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes my manager takes my opinions into account.

entries.example: 法官請被告站起來說話。
entries.examplePinyin: fǎ guān qǐng bèi gào zhàn qǐ lái shuō huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: The judge asked the defendant to stand and speak.
entries.question: 你覺得被告一定要請律師嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de bèi gào yí dìng yào qǐng lǜ shī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think a defendant must hire a lawyer?
entries.answer: 我覺得被告最好請律師。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de bèi gào zuì hǎo qǐng lǜ shī.
entries.answerEnglish: I think a defendant had better hire a lawyer.

entries.example: 國慶日有戰鬥機編隊飛過總統府。
entries.examplePinyin: guó qìng rì yǒu zhàn dòu jī biān duì fēi guò zǒng tǒng fǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: On National Day, fighter jets fly in formation over the Presidential Office.
entries.question: 你看過飛機編隊飛行嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò fēi jī biān duì fēi xíng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen planes flying in formation?
entries.answer: 看過，國慶日的飛機編隊很壯觀。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, guó qìng rì de fēi jī biān duì hěn zhuàng guān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the National Day flying formation was spectacular.

entries.example: 這種新藥還在做臨床試驗。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhǒng xīn yào hái zài zuò lín chuáng shì yàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This new drug is still in clinical trials.
entries.question: 你會參加新藥的臨床試驗嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì cān jiā xīn yào de lín chuáng shì yàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you take part in a clinical trial for a new drug?
entries.answer: 不會，我不敢參加臨床試驗。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ bù gǎn cān jiā lín chuáng shì yàn.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I wouldn't dare join a clinical trial.

entries.example: 免運費是我網購的最大誘因。
entries.examplePinyin: miǎn yùn fèi shì wǒ wǎng gòu de zuì dà yòu yīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Free shipping is my biggest incentive to shop online.
entries.question: 什麼誘因會讓你換工作？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me yòu yīn huì ràng nǐ huàn gōng zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: What incentive would make you change jobs?
entries.answer: 更高的薪水是最大的誘因。
entries.answerPinyin: gèng gāo de xīn shuǐ shì zuì dà de yòu yīn.
entries.answerEnglish: A higher salary is the biggest incentive.

entries.example: 他很會洞察顧客的需求。
entries.examplePinyin: tā hěn huì dòng chá gù kè de xū qiú.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's very good at seeing what customers really need.
entries.question: 你覺得自己能洞察別人的想法嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ néng dòng chá bié rén de xiǎng fǎ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you can see into other people's thoughts?
entries.answer: 不太能，我很難洞察別人的想法。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài néng, wǒ hěn nán dòng chá bié rén de xiǎng fǎ.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. It's hard for me to read other people's minds.

entries.example: 檢察官正在調查這個案子。
entries.examplePinyin: jiǎn chá guān zhèng zài diào chá zhè ge àn zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: The prosecutor is investigating this case.
entries.question: 你覺得當檢察官壓力大嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de dāng jiǎn chá guān yā lì dà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think being a prosecutor is stressful?
entries.answer: 我覺得當檢察官壓力很大。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de dāng jiǎn chá guān yā lì hěn dà.
entries.answerEnglish: I think being a prosecutor is very stressful.

entries.example: 換輪胎要先用千斤頂把車撐起來。
entries.examplePinyin: huàn lún tāi yào xiān yòng qiān jīn dǐng bǎ chē chēng qǐ lái.
entries.exampleEnglish: To change a tire, you first lift the car with a jack.
entries.question: 你會用千斤頂換輪胎嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì yòng qiān jīn dǐng huàn lún tāi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you use a jack to change a tire?
entries.answer: 不會，我沒用過千斤頂。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ méi yòng guò qiān jīn dǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I've never used a jack.

entries.example: 他堅稱自己沒有遲到。
entries.examplePinyin: tā jiān chēng zì jǐ méi yǒu chí dào.
entries.exampleEnglish: He insisted that he wasn't late.
entries.question: 你曾經堅稱自己是對的嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ céng jīng jiān chēng zì jǐ shì duì de ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever insisted that you were right?
entries.answer: 有，我堅稱自己沒有記錯時間。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiān chēng zì jǐ méi yǒu jì cuò shí jiān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I insisted I hadn't got the time wrong.

entries.example: 他把失敗歸因於運氣不好。
entries.examplePinyin: tā bǎ shī bài guī yīn yú yùn qì bù hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: He put his failure down to bad luck.
entries.question: 你把你的中文進步歸因於什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ bǎ nǐ de zhōng wén jìn bù guī yīn yú shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you attribute your progress in Chinese to?
entries.answer: 我的進步可以歸因於每天說中文。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de jìn bù kě yǐ guī yīn yú měi tiān shuō zhōng wén.
entries.answerEnglish: My progress can be attributed to speaking Chinese every day.

entries.example: 這家餐廳推出了一道實驗性的新菜。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā cān tīng tuī chū le yí dào shí yàn xìng de xīn cài.
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant has launched an experimental new dish.
entries.question: 你喜歡聽實驗性的音樂嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan tīng shí yàn xìng de yīn yuè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like listening to experimental music?
entries.answer: 不太喜歡，實驗性的音樂太奇怪了。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài xǐ huan, shí yàn xìng de yīn yuè tài qí guài le.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. Experimental music is too strange.

entries.example: 這家老店已經傳承了三代。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā lǎo diàn yǐ jīng chuán chéng le sān dài.
entries.exampleEnglish: This old shop has been passed down for three generations.
entries.question: 你家有什麼傳承下來的東西？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yǒu shén me chuán chéng xià lái de dōng xī?
entries.questionEnglish: What has been passed down in your family?
entries.answer: 我家有一個傳承了五十年的食譜。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā yǒu yí gè chuán chéng le wǔ shí nián de shí pǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: My family has a recipe passed down for fifty years.

entries.example: 他們吵架是因為意識形態不同。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men chǎo jià shì yīn wèi yì shì xíng tài bù tóng.
entries.exampleEnglish: They argue because their ideologies differ.
entries.question: 你和朋友會討論意識形態嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ hé péng yǒu huì tǎo lùn yì shì xíng tài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you discuss ideology with your friends?
entries.answer: 很少，意識形態的話題容易吵架。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn shǎo, yì shì xíng tài de huà tí róng yì chǎo jià.
entries.answerEnglish: Rarely. Talking about ideology easily leads to arguments.

entries.example: 台灣有很多餐飲業的從業人員。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān yǒu hěn duō cān yǐn yè de cóng yè rén yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan has many people working in the food and beverage industry.
entries.question: 你認識科技業的從業人員嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ rèn shì kē jì yè de cóng yè rén yuán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know anyone who works in the tech industry?
entries.answer: 認識，我先生是科技業的從業人員。
entries.answerPinyin: rèn shì, wǒ xiān shēng shì kē jì yè de cóng yè rén yuán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my husband works in the tech industry.

entries.example: 今天空氣裡的懸浮微粒很高，要戴口罩。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn tiān kōng qì lǐ de xuán fú wéi lì hěn gāo, yào dài kǒu zhào.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a lot of fine particulate matter in the air today, so wear a mask.
entries.question: 你會擔心空氣裡的微粒嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì dān xīn kōng qì lǐ de wéi lì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you worry about particles in the air?
entries.answer: 會，空氣不好時，我會擔心微粒太多。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, kōng qì bù hǎo shí, wǒ huì dān xīn wéi lì tài duō.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when the air is bad I worry about too many particles.

entries.example: 這個藍牙接收器很好用。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge lán yá jiē shōu qì hěn hǎo yòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This Bluetooth receiver works really well.
entries.question: 你的電腦有用無線接收器嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de diàn nǎo yǒu yòng wú xiàn jiē shōu qì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your computer use a wireless receiver?
entries.answer: 有，我的電腦有一個藍牙接收器。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de diàn nǎo yǒu yí gè lán yá jiē shōu qì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my computer has a Bluetooth receiver.

entries.example: 孩子一直央求媽媽買玩具。
entries.examplePinyin: hái zi yì zhí yāng qiú mā ma mǎi wán jù.
entries.exampleEnglish: The child kept begging his mom to buy a toy.
entries.question: 你小時候會央求爸媽買什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu huì yāng qiú bà mā mǎi shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What did you beg your parents to buy when you were little?
entries.answer: 我小時候常央求爸媽買糖果。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎo shí hòu cháng yāng qiú bà mā mǎi táng guǒ.
entries.answerEnglish: When I was little, I often begged my parents for candy.

entries.example: 這道菜的精髓是它的醬汁。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè dào cài de jīng suǐ shì tā de jiàng zhī.
entries.exampleEnglish: The essence of this dish is its sauce.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣文化的精髓是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān wén huà de jīng suǐ shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is the essence of Taiwanese culture?
entries.answer: 我覺得人情味是台灣文化的精髓。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de rén qíng wèi shì tái wān wén huà de jīng suǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I think human warmth is the essence of Taiwanese culture.

entries.example: 水是一種化合物。
entries.examplePinyin: shuǐ shì yì zhǒng huà hé wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: Water is a compound.
entries.question: 你知道哪些常見的化合物？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào nǎ xiē cháng jiàn de huà hé wù?
entries.questionEnglish: What common compounds do you know?
entries.answer: 我知道水和鹽都是化合物。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhī dào shuǐ hé yán dōu shì huà hé wù.
entries.answerEnglish: I know that water and salt are both compounds.

entries.example: 他在司法單位工作。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài sī fǎ dān wèi gōng zuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: He works for a judicial agency.
entries.question: 你相信你國家的司法嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiāng xìn nǐ guó jiā de sī fǎ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you trust the judiciary in your country?
entries.answer: 大部分相信，但司法還是有問題。
entries.answerPinyin: dà bù fèn xiāng xìn, dàn sī fǎ hái shì yǒu wèn tí.
entries.answerEnglish: Mostly, but the judiciary still has problems.

entries.example: 在台北，加班已經是常態了。
entries.examplePinyin: zài tái běi, jiā bān yǐ jīng shì cháng tài le.
entries.exampleEnglish: In Taipei, working overtime has become the norm.
entries.question: 在你的公司，加班是常態嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zài nǐ de gōng sī, jiā bān shì cháng tài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is overtime the norm at your company?
entries.answer: 對，在我們公司加班是常態。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, zài wǒ men gōng sī jiā bān shì cháng tài.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, overtime is the norm at our company.

entries.example: 這個專案的複雜度比我想的高。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge zhuān àn de fù zá dù bǐ wǒ xiǎng de gāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This project is more complex than I thought.
entries.question: 你覺得中文的複雜度高嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zhōng wén de fù zá dù gāo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Chinese is very complex?
entries.answer: 中文的複雜度很高，但很有趣。
entries.answerPinyin: zhōng wén de fù zá dù hěn gāo, dàn hěn yǒu qù.
entries.answerEnglish: Chinese is very complex, but very interesting.

entries.example: 法官相信了證人的證詞。
entries.examplePinyin: fǎ guān xiāng xìn le zhèng rén de zhèng cí.
entries.exampleEnglish: The judge believed the witness's testimony.
entries.question: 你覺得目擊者的證詞可靠嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de mù jí zhě de zhèng cí kě kào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think eyewitness testimony is reliable?
entries.answer: 不一定，證詞有時候會錯。
entries.answerPinyin: bù yí dìng, zhèng cí yǒu shí hòu huì cuò.
entries.answerEnglish: Not always. Testimony is sometimes wrong.

entries.example: 這幅畫描繪了九份的老街。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè fú huà miáo huì le jiǔ fèn de lǎo jiē.
entries.exampleEnglish: This painting depicts the old street in Jiufen.
entries.question: 你會用什麼詞描繪台灣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì yòng shén me cí miáo huì tái wān?
entries.questionEnglish: What words would you use to depict Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我會用「熱情」來描繪台灣。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì yòng “rè qíng” lái miáo huì tái wān.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd use the word 'warm-hearted' to describe Taiwan.

entries.example: 他懇求老闆再給他一次機會。
entries.examplePinyin: tā kěn qiú lǎo bǎn zài gěi tā yí cì jī huì.
entries.exampleEnglish: He pleaded with his boss to give him one more chance.
entries.question: 你曾經懇求別人幫忙嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ céng jīng kěn qiú bié rén bāng máng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever pleaded with someone for help?
entries.answer: 有，我曾經懇求房東晚一點收房租。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ céng jīng kěn qiú fáng dōng wǎn yì diǎn shōu fáng zū.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I once begged my landlord to collect the rent a little later.

entries.example: 他看到我，就咧嘴笑了。
entries.examplePinyin: tā kàn dào wǒ, jiù liě zuǐ xiào le.
entries.exampleEnglish: When he saw me, he grinned.
entries.question: 什麼事會讓你開心得咧嘴笑？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shì huì ràng nǐ kāi xīn de liě zuǐ xiào?
entries.questionEnglish: What makes you so happy that you grin?
entries.answer: 收到禮物時，我會開心得咧嘴笑。
entries.answerPinyin: shōu dào lǐ wù shí, wǒ huì kāi xīn de liě zuǐ xiào.
entries.answerEnglish: When I get a present, I grin with joy.

entries.example: 佛教的教義很重視慈悲。
entries.examplePinyin: fó jiào de jiào yì hěn zhòng shì cí bēi.
entries.exampleEnglish: Buddhist teachings place great importance on compassion.
entries.question: 你對哪個宗教的教義比較了解？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì nǎ gè zōng jiào de jiào yì bǐ jiào liǎo jiě?
entries.questionEnglish: Which religion's teachings do you know more about?
entries.answer: 我對佛教的教義比較了解，因為我常去寺廟。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ duì fó jiào de jiào yì bǐ jiào liǎo jiě, yīn wèi wǒ cháng qù sì miào.
entries.answerEnglish: I know more about Buddhist teachings because I often go to temples.

entries.example: 關渡的濕地是很多鳥的棲息地。
entries.examplePinyin: guān dù de shī dì shì hěn duō niǎo de qī xí dì.
entries.exampleEnglish: The Guandu wetlands are a habitat for many birds.
entries.question: 你知道台灣黑熊的棲息地在哪裡嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào tái wān hēi xióng de qī xí dì zài nǎ lǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know where the Formosan black bear's habitat is?
entries.answer: 牠們的棲息地在高山的森林裡。
entries.answerPinyin: tā men de qī xí dì zài gāo shān de sēn lín lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Their habitat is in the high mountain forests.

entries.example: 淡水有很多殖民時期的老房子。
entries.examplePinyin: dàn shuǐ yǒu hěn duō zhí mín shí qí de lǎo fáng zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: Tamsui has many old houses from the colonial period.
entries.question: 你看過殖民時期的建築嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò zhí mín shí qí de jiàn zhú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen any colonial-era buildings?
entries.answer: 看過，淡水的紅毛城就是殖民時期的建築。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, dàn shuǐ de hóng máo chéng jiù shì zhí mín shí qí de jiàn zhú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, Fort San Domingo in Tamsui is a colonial-era building.

entries.example: 他的政治立場在光譜的中間。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de zhèng zhì lì chǎng zài guāng pǔ de zhōng jiān.
entries.exampleEnglish: His political position is in the middle of the spectrum.
entries.question: 你知道光譜裡有哪些顏色嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào guāng pǔ lǐ yǒu nǎ xiē yán sè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know which colors are in the spectrum?
entries.answer: 光譜裡有紅、橙、黃、綠、藍、靛、紫七種顏色。
entries.answerPinyin: guāng pǔ lǐ yǒu hóng, chéng, huáng, lǜ, lán, diàn, zǐ qī zhǒng yán sè.
entries.answerEnglish: The spectrum has seven colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet.

entries.example: 這部電影的敘事方式很特別。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng de xù shì fāng shì hěn tè bié.
entries.exampleEnglish: This film tells its story in a very unusual way.
entries.question: 你喜歡什麼樣的敘事方式？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan shén me yàng de xù shì fāng shì?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of storytelling do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡簡單清楚的敘事方式。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan jiǎn dān qīng chǔ de xù shì fāng shì.
entries.answerEnglish: I like a simple, clear way of telling a story.

entries.example: 這張桌子是松木做的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhāng zhuō zi shì sōng mù zuò de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This table is made of pine.
entries.question: 你喜歡松木的家具嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan sōng mù de jiā jù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like pine furniture?
entries.answer: 喜歡，松木的家具看起來很自然。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, sōng mù de jiā jù kàn qǐ lái hěn zì rán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, pine furniture looks very natural.

entries.example: 士兵們背著步槍在路上行軍。
entries.examplePinyin: shì bīng men bēi zhe bù qiāng zài lù shang xíng jūn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The soldiers marched along the road with rifles on their backs.
entries.question: 在台灣，什麼人可以使用步槍？
entries.questionPinyin: zài tái wān, shén me rén kě yǐ shǐ yòng bù qiāng?
entries.questionEnglish: In Taiwan, who is allowed to use rifles?
entries.answer: 在台灣，通常只有軍人和警察可以使用步槍。
entries.answerPinyin: zài tái wān, tōng cháng zhǐ yǒu jūn rén hé jǐng chá kě yǐ shǐ yòng bù qiāng.
entries.answerEnglish: In Taiwan, usually only soldiers and police can use rifles.

entries.example: 上傳前要檢查檔案的完整性。
entries.examplePinyin: shàng chuán qián yào jiǎn chá dǎng àn de wán zhěng xìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Check the file's integrity before uploading it.
entries.question: 交報告前，你會檢查它的完整性嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: jiāo bào gào qián, nǐ huì jiǎn chá tā de wán zhěng xìng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Before handing in a report, do you check that it's complete?
entries.answer: 會，我會先檢查報告的完整性再交出去。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì xiān jiǎn chá bào gào de wán zhěng xìng zài jiāo chū qù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I check that the report is complete before handing it in.

entries.example: 這間老房子的樑是木頭做的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiān lǎo fáng zi de liáng shì mù tou zuò de.
entries.exampleEnglish: The beams of this old house are made of wood.
entries.question: 你家的天花板有樑嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de tiān huā bǎn yǒu liáng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does the ceiling in your home have beams?
entries.answer: 有，客廳上面有一根很大的樑。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, kè tīng shàng miàn yǒu yì gēn hěn dà de liáng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a big beam above the living room.

entries.example: 宇宙中有很多星系。
entries.examplePinyin: yǔ zhòu zhōng yǒu hěn duō xīng xì.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are many galaxies in the universe.
entries.question: 你知道我們住在哪個星系嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào wǒ men zhù zài nǎ gè xīng xì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know which galaxy we live in?
entries.answer: 知道，我們的星系叫銀河系。
entries.answerPinyin: zhī dào, wǒ men de xīng xì jiào yín hé xì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our galaxy is called the Milky Way.

entries.example: 他明天要去法院作證。
entries.examplePinyin: tā míng tiān yào qù fǎ yuàn zuò zhèng.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's going to testify in court tomorrow.
entries.question: 什麼樣的人會被請去法院作證？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me yàng de rén huì bèi qǐng qù fǎ yuàn zuò zhèng?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of people are asked to testify in court?
entries.answer: 看到事情發生的人會被請去作證。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn dào shì qíng fā shēng de rén huì bèi qǐng qù zuò zhèng.
entries.answerEnglish: People who saw what happened are asked to testify.

entries.example: 站在海邊，看著無盡的大海，心情很平靜。
entries.examplePinyin: zhàn zài hǎi biān, kàn zhe wú jìn de dà hǎi, xīn qíng hěn píng jìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Standing by the sea, looking at the endless ocean, I feel calm.
entries.question: 你覺得家事做得完嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de jiā shì zuò de wán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think housework ever gets finished?
entries.answer: 做不完，家事好像是無盡的。
entries.answerPinyin: zuò bù wán, jiā shì hǎo xiàng shì wú jìn de.
entries.answerEnglish: No, housework seems endless.

entries.example: 睡得好可以提高生產力。
entries.examplePinyin: shuì de hǎo kě yǐ tí gāo shēng chǎn lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Sleeping well can boost your productivity.
entries.question: 你一天中什麼時候生產力最高？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yì tiān zhōng shén me shí hòu shēng chǎn lì zuì gāo?
entries.questionEnglish: What time of day are you most productive?
entries.answer: 我早上的生產力最高。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zǎo shàng de shēng chǎn lì zuì gāo.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm most productive in the morning.

entries.example: 這個工程交給一家承包商做。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge gōng chéng jiāo gěi yì jiā chéng bāo shāng zuò.
entries.exampleEnglish: This project was given to a contractor.
entries.question: 裝潢房子時，要怎麼找承包商？
entries.questionPinyin: zhuāng huáng fáng zi shí, yào zěn me zhǎo chéng bāo shāng?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you find a contractor when renovating a home?
entries.answer: 可以請朋友介紹可靠的承包商。
entries.answerPinyin: kě yǐ qǐng péng yǒu jiè shào kě kào de chéng bāo shāng.
entries.answerEnglish: You can ask friends to recommend a reliable contractor.

entries.example: 他今年的年終獎金很可觀。
entries.examplePinyin: tā jīn nián de nián zhōng jiǎng jīn hěn kě guān.
entries.exampleEnglish: His year-end bonus this year is considerable.
entries.question: 你覺得台北的房租可觀嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái běi de fáng zū kě guān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think rent in Taipei is considerable?
entries.answer: 很可觀，房租花掉我一半的薪水。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn kě guān, fáng zū huā diào wǒ yí bàn de xīn shuǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Very. Rent takes half my salary.

entries.example: 這座城堡是中世紀蓋的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zuò chéng bǎo shì zhōng shì jì gài de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This castle was built in the Middle Ages.
entries.question: 你對中世紀的歷史有興趣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì zhōng shì jì de lì shǐ yǒu xìng qù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you interested in medieval history?
entries.answer: 有，我很喜歡看中世紀的故事。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ hěn xǐ huan kàn zhōng shì jì de gù shì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love reading stories set in the Middle Ages.

entries.example: 他來台灣追尋自己的夢想。
entries.examplePinyin: tā lái tái wān zhuī xún zì jǐ de mèng xiǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: He came to Taiwan to pursue his dream.
entries.question: 你現在在追尋什麼夢想？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiàn zài zài zhuī xún shén me mèng xiǎng?
entries.questionEnglish: What dream are you pursuing now?
entries.answer: 我在追尋開一家咖啡店的夢想。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài zhuī xún kāi yì jiā kā fēi diàn de mèng xiǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm pursuing my dream of opening a café.

entries.example: 九份因為金礦有過一段榮景。
entries.examplePinyin: jiǔ fèn yīn wèi jīn kuàng yǒu guò yí duàn róng jǐng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Jiufen once enjoyed a boom thanks to gold mining.
entries.question: 你的家鄉以前有過榮景嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de jiā xiāng yǐ qián yǒu guò róng jǐng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did your hometown ever have a boom period?
entries.answer: 有，五十年前那裡的工廠很多，有過一段榮景。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǔ shí nián qián nà lǐ de gōng chǎng hěn duō, yǒu guò yí duàn róng jǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, fifty years ago it had lots of factories and enjoyed a boom.

entries.example: 故宮裡有很多古代帝王用過的東西。
entries.examplePinyin: gù gōng lǐ yǒu hěn duō gǔ dài dì wáng yòng guò de dōng xī.
entries.exampleEnglish: The National Palace Museum holds many things used by ancient emperors.
entries.question: 你喜歡看古代帝王的故事嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kàn gǔ dài dì wáng de gù shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like stories about ancient emperors?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常看跟帝王有關的歷史劇。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ cháng kàn gēn dì wáng yǒu guān de lì shǐ jù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often watch historical dramas about emperors.

entries.example: 這首歌的旋律很深沉。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shǒu gē de xuán lǜ hěn shēn chén.
entries.exampleEnglish: This song's melody is deep and somber.
entries.question: 你喜歡聽深沉的音樂嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan tīng shēn chén de yīn yuè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like listening to deep, somber music?
entries.answer: 喜歡，下雨天我會聽比較深沉的音樂。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, xià yǔ tiān wǒ huì tīng bǐ jiào shēn chén de yīn yuè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, on rainy days I listen to deeper, moodier music.

entries.example: 這個活動是他構想出來的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge huó dòng shì tā gòu xiǎng chū lái de.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's the one who came up with this event.
entries.question: 你有什麼新的構想嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu shén me xīn de gòu xiǎng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any new ideas?
entries.answer: 我有開一家早午餐店的構想。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yǒu kāi yì jiā zǎo wǔ cān diàn de gòu xiǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: I have an idea to open a brunch place.

entries.example: 他坦承是他吃了我的蛋糕。
entries.examplePinyin: tā tǎn chéng shì tā chī le wǒ de dàn gāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: He admitted he was the one who ate my cake.
entries.question: 做錯事的時候，你會馬上坦承嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zuò cuò shì de shí hòu, nǐ huì mǎ shàng tǎn chéng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you do something wrong, do you own up right away?
entries.answer: 會，我會馬上坦承自己的錯。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì mǎ shàng tǎn chéng zì jǐ de cuò.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I own up to my mistakes right away.

entries.example: 這個品牌請了很多明星背書。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge pǐn pái qǐng le hěn duō míng xīng bèi shū.
entries.exampleEnglish: This brand got lots of stars to endorse it.
entries.question: 你會買名人背書的產品嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì mǎi míng rén bèi shū de chǎn pǐn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you buy a product endorsed by a celebrity?
entries.answer: 不一定，名人背書不代表東西好。
entries.answerPinyin: bù yí dìng, míng rén bèi shū bú dài biǎo dōng xī hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Not necessarily. A celebrity endorsement doesn't mean the product is good.

entries.example: 閒暇的時候，我喜歡去爬山。
entries.examplePinyin: xián xiá de shí hòu, wǒ xǐ huan qù pá shān.
entries.exampleEnglish: In my free time, I like to go hiking.
entries.question: 你閒暇的時候喜歡做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xián xiá de shí hòu xǐ huan zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you like to do in your free time?
entries.answer: 我閒暇的時候喜歡在家看電影。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xián xiá de shí hòu xǐ huan zài jiā kàn diàn yǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: In my free time I like watching movies at home.

entries.example: 中醫有很多傳統的療法。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōng yī yǒu hěn duō chuán tǒng de liáo fǎ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Chinese medicine has many traditional therapies.
entries.question: 中醫有哪些常見的療法？
entries.questionPinyin: zhōng yī yǒu nǎ xiē cháng jiàn de liáo fǎ?
entries.questionEnglish: What are some common therapies in Chinese medicine?
entries.answer: 針灸和拔罐都是中醫常見的療法。
entries.answerPinyin: zhēn jiǔ hé bá guàn dōu shì zhōng yī cháng jiàn de liáo fǎ.
entries.answerEnglish: Acupuncture and cupping are both common Chinese medicine therapies.

entries.example: 這家店上個月的營業額很高。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn shàng gè yuè de yíng yè é hěn gāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop's sales were very high last month.
entries.question: 你覺得夜市小吃攤的營業額高嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de yè shì xiǎo chī tān de yíng yè é gāo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think night market food stalls make a lot of money?
entries.answer: 我覺得有名的小吃攤營業額很高。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de yǒu míng de xiǎo chī tān yíng yè é hěn gāo.
entries.answerEnglish: I think famous food stalls have very high sales.

entries.example: 小孩自己出國需要監護人同意。
entries.examplePinyin: xiǎo hái zì jǐ chū guó xū yào jiān hù rén tóng yì.
entries.exampleEnglish: A child traveling abroad alone needs a guardian's consent.
entries.question: 小孩的監護人通常是誰？
entries.questionPinyin: xiǎo hái de jiān hù rén tōng cháng shì shéi?
entries.questionEnglish: Who is usually a child's guardian?
entries.answer: 小孩的監護人通常是父母。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎo hái de jiān hù rén tōng cháng shì fù mǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: A child's guardians are usually the parents.

entries.example: 這瓶紅酒在橡木桶裡放了三年。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè píng hóng jiǔ zài xiàng mù tǒng lǐ fàng le sān nián.
entries.exampleEnglish: This red wine was aged in oak barrels for three years.
entries.question: 你喜歡橡木做的家具嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan xiàng mù zuò de jiā jù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like oak furniture?
entries.answer: 喜歡，橡木的顏色很溫暖。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, xiàng mù de yán sè hěn wēn nuǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, oak has a warm color.

entries.example: 她的先生過世後，她成了寡婦。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de xiān shēng guò shì hòu, tā chéng le guǎ fù.
entries.exampleEnglish: After her husband passed away, she became a widow.
entries.question: 社會可以怎麼幫助寡婦？
entries.questionPinyin: shè huì kě yǐ zěn me bāng zhù guǎ fù?
entries.questionEnglish: How can society help widows?
entries.answer: 政府可以給寡婦一些生活補助。
entries.answerPinyin: zhèng fǔ kě yǐ gěi guǎ fù yì xiē shēng huó bǔ zhù.
entries.answerEnglish: The government can give widows some living allowances.

entries.example: 他的站姿很挺，看起來很有自信。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de zhàn zī hěn tǐng, kàn qǐ lái hěn yǒu zì xìn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He stands up straight and looks very confident.
entries.question: 你覺得自己的站姿好看嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ de zhàn zī hǎo kàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you have good posture when standing?
entries.answer: 不太好看，我的站姿有點駝背。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài hǎo kàn, wǒ de zhàn zī yǒu diǎn tuó bèi.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. I tend to slouch when I stand.

entries.example: 圖書館員正在替新書編目。
entries.examplePinyin: tú shū guǎn yuán zhèng zài tì xīn shū biān mù.
entries.exampleEnglish: The librarian is cataloguing the new books.
entries.question: 你覺得替很多書編目累嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tì hěn duō shū biān mù lèi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think cataloguing lots of books is tiring?
entries.answer: 應該很累，編目要很細心。
entries.answerPinyin: yīng gāi hěn lèi, biān mù yào hěn xì xīn.
entries.answerEnglish: It must be tiring; cataloguing takes a lot of care.

entries.example: 台灣的法定工時是一週四十小時。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān de fǎ dìng gōng shí shì yì zhōu sì shí xiǎo shí.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan's statutory working hours are forty hours a week.
entries.question: 你的國家喝酒的法定年齡是幾歲？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā hē jiǔ de fǎ dìng nián líng shì jǐ suì?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the legal drinking age in your country?
entries.answer: 我的國家喝酒的法定年齡是十八歲。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de guó jiā hē jiǔ de fǎ dìng nián líng shì shí bā suì.
entries.answerEnglish: The legal drinking age in my country is eighteen.

entries.example: 這個問題跟醫學倫理有關。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge wèn tí gēn yī xué lún lǐ yǒu guān.
entries.exampleEnglish: This issue has to do with medical ethics.
entries.question: 你覺得哪些工作特別重視倫理？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǎ xiē gōng zuò tè bié zhòng shì lún lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Which jobs do you think place special emphasis on ethics?
entries.answer: 我覺得醫生和律師特別重視倫理。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de yī shēng hé lǜ shī tè bié zhòng shì lún lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I think doctors and lawyers put special emphasis on ethics.

entries.example: 夏天的電費是累進的，用越多越貴。
entries.examplePinyin: xià tiān de diàn fèi shì lěi jìn de, yòng yuè duō yuè guì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Summer electricity rates are progressive: the more you use, the more you pay per unit.
entries.question: 你的國家也用累進稅率嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā yě yòng lěi jìn shuì lǜ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your country also use progressive tax rates?
entries.answer: 是的，我的國家也用累進稅率。
entries.answerPinyin: shì de, wǒ de guó jiā yě yòng lěi jìn shuì lǜ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my country also uses progressive tax rates.

entries.example: 東京是一個國際大都會。
entries.examplePinyin: dōng jīng shì yí gè guó jì dà dū huì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Tokyo is an international metropolis.
entries.question: 你喜歡住在大都會嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zhù zài dà dū huì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like living in a big city?
entries.answer: 喜歡，大都會的生活很方便。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, dà dū huì de shēng huó hěn fāng biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, life in a big city is very convenient.

entries.example: 農田旁邊有一座舊穀倉。
entries.examplePinyin: nóng tián páng biān yǒu yí zuò jiù gǔ cāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's an old barn beside the fields.
entries.question: 你看過真正的穀倉嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò zhēn zhèng de gǔ cāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a real barn?
entries.answer: 看過，我在鄉下看過一座穀倉。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài xiāng xià kàn guò yí zuò gǔ cāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've seen one in the countryside.

entries.example: 這兩家公司是敵對的關係。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè liǎng jiā gōng sī shì dí duì de guān xì.
entries.exampleEnglish: These two companies are rivals.
entries.question: 你知道哪兩支球隊是敵對的嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào nǎ liǎng zhī qiú duì shì dí duì de ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know two sports teams that are rivals?
entries.answer: 知道，洋基和紅襪是敵對的球隊。
entries.answerPinyin: zhī dào, yáng jī hé hóng wà shì dí duì de qiú duì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the Yankees and the Red Sox are rival teams.

entries.example: 我們在黎明前出發去看日出。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men zài lí míng qián chū fā qù kàn rì chū.
entries.exampleEnglish: We set off before dawn to see the sunrise.
entries.question: 你看過黎明時的天空嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò lí míng shí de tiān kōng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen the sky at dawn?
entries.answer: 看過，我在阿里山看過黎明時的天空。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài ā lǐ shān kàn guò lí míng shí de tiān kōng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've seen the dawn sky at Alishan.

entries.example: 會計師下週要來公司查帳。
entries.examplePinyin: kuài jì shī xià zhōu yào lái gōng sī chá zhàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The accountants are coming to audit the company next week.
entries.question: 公司為什麼要請人來查帳？
entries.questionPinyin: gōng sī wèi shén me yào qǐng rén lái chá zhàng?
entries.questionEnglish: Why do companies have people come to audit their accounts?
entries.answer: 查帳可以確定公司的帳是對的。
entries.answerPinyin: chá zhàng kě yǐ què dìng gōng sī de zhàng shì duì de.
entries.answerEnglish: An audit makes sure the company's accounts are correct.

entries.example: 這件訴訟已經拖了三年。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn sù sòng yǐ jīng tuō le sān nián.
entries.exampleEnglish: This lawsuit has dragged on for three years.
entries.question: 公司遇到訴訟時，通常會找誰？
entries.questionPinyin: gōng sī yù dào sù sòng shí, tōng cháng huì zhǎo shéi?
entries.questionEnglish: Who do companies usually turn to when facing a lawsuit?
entries.answer: 公司遇到訴訟時，通常會找律師。
entries.answerPinyin: gōng sī yù dào sù sòng shí, tōng cháng huì zhǎo lǜ shī.
entries.answerEnglish: When facing a lawsuit, companies usually turn to lawyers.

entries.example: 每把鑰匙對應一個房間。
entries.examplePinyin: měi bǎ yào shi duì yìng yí gè fáng jiān.
entries.exampleEnglish: Each key corresponds to one room.
entries.question: 你的英文名字有對應的中文名字嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de yīng wén míng zì yǒu duì yìng de zhōng wén míng zì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your English name have a corresponding Chinese name?
entries.answer: 有，對應的中文名字是馬克。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, duì yìng de zhōng wén míng zì shì mǎ kè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the corresponding Chinese name is Mǎkè (Mark).

entries.example: 這個廣告想誘導大家多買一點。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge guǎng gào xiǎng yòu dǎo dà jiā duō mǎi yì diǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This ad tries to lead people to buy more.
entries.question: 你覺得廣告會誘導你買東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de guǎng gào huì yòu dǎo nǐ mǎi dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think ads lead you to buy things?
entries.answer: 會，廣告常常誘導我買不需要的東西。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, guǎng gào cháng cháng yòu dǎo wǒ mǎi bù xū yào de dōng xī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, ads often lead me to buy things I don't need.

entries.example: 博物館裡有很多蝴蝶標本。
entries.examplePinyin: bó wù guǎn lǐ yǒu hěn duō hú dié biāo běn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The museum has lots of butterfly specimens.
entries.question: 你做過植物標本嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò guò zhí wù biāo běn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever made a plant specimen?
entries.answer: 做過，我小時候做過樹葉標本。
entries.answerPinyin: zuò guò, wǒ xiǎo shí hòu zuò guò shù yè biāo běn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I made leaf specimens as a kid.

entries.example: 今天的會議很有成效。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn tiān de huì yì hěn yǒu chéng xiào.
entries.exampleEnglish: Today's meeting was very productive.
entries.question: 你覺得線上會議有成效嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de xiàn shàng huì yì yǒu chéng xiào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think online meetings are productive?
entries.answer: 短的線上會議比較有成效。
entries.answerPinyin: duǎn de xiàn shàng huì yì bǐ jiào yǒu chéng xiào.
entries.answerEnglish: Short online meetings are more productive.

entries.example: 物價上漲，薪水也應該相應調整。
entries.examplePinyin: wù jià shàng zhǎng, xīn shuǐ yě yīng gāi xiāng yìng tiáo zhěng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Prices have gone up, so salaries should be adjusted accordingly.
entries.question: 東西變貴了，你的薪水有相應增加嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: dōng xī biàn guì le, nǐ de xīn shuǐ yǒu xiāng yìng zēng jiā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Things have got pricier. Has your salary risen accordingly?
entries.answer: 沒有，我的薪水沒有相應增加。
entries.answerPinyin: méi yǒu, wǒ de xīn shuǐ méi yǒu xiāng yìng zēng jiā.
entries.answerEnglish: No, my salary hasn't risen accordingly.

entries.example: 這部日本電影在講武士的故事。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù rì běn diàn yǐng zài jiǎng wǔ shì de gù shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This Japanese film tells the story of a samurai.
entries.question: 你喜歡看武士的電影嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kàn wǔ shì de diàn yǐng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like samurai films?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我很喜歡日本的武士電影。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ hěn xǐ huan rì běn de wǔ shì diàn yǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I really like Japanese samurai films.
