entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǎ gè háng yè bèi dà gōng sī lǒng duàn le?
entries.questionEnglish: Which industry do you think is monopolized by big companies?
entries.answer: 我覺得便利商店被幾家大公司壟斷了。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de biàn lì shāng diàn bèi jǐ jiā dà gōng sī lǒng duàn le.
entries.answerEnglish: I think convenience stores are monopolized by a few big companies.

entries.example: 有些新聞會操弄大家的情緒。
entries.examplePinyin: yǒu xiē xīn wén huì cāo nòng dà jiā de qíng xù.
entries.exampleEnglish: Some news stories manipulate people's emotions.
entries.question: 你覺得廣告會操弄人的想法嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de guǎng gào huì cāo nòng rén de xiǎng fǎ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think ads manipulate people's thinking?
entries.answer: 會，有些廣告很會操弄人的想法。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, yǒu xiē guǎng gào hěn huì cāo nòng rén de xiǎng fǎ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, some ads are very good at manipulating how people think.

entries.example: 教宗住在梵蒂岡。
entries.examplePinyin: jiào zōng zhù zài fàn dì gāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The Pope lives in the Vatican.
entries.question: 你在新聞上看過教宗嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài xīn wén shàng kàn guò jiào zōng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen the Pope on the news?
entries.answer: 看過，教宗常常在新聞上出現。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, jiào zōng cháng cháng zài xīn wén shàng chū xiàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the Pope often appears on the news.

entries.example: 我們沿著山脊走到山頂。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men yán zhe shān jǐ zǒu dào shān dǐng.
entries.exampleEnglish: We walked along the ridge to the summit.
entries.question: 你走過山脊上的步道嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zǒu guò shān jǐ shàng de bù dào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever hiked a trail along a ridge?
entries.answer: 走過，山脊上的風景很美，可是風很大。
entries.answerPinyin: zǒu guò, shān jǐ shàng de fēng jǐng hěn měi, kě shì fēng hěn dà.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the view from the ridge is beautiful, but it's very windy.

entries.example: 聖誕節是紀念基督出生的節日。
entries.examplePinyin: shèng dàn jié shì jì niàn jī dū chū shēng de jié rì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Christmas is the holiday that celebrates the birth of Christ.
entries.question: 你的國家很多人信基督嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā hěn duō rén xìn jī dū ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do many people in your country believe in Christ?
entries.answer: 對，我的國家很多人信基督。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ de guó jiā hěn duō rén xìn jī dū.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, many people in my country believe in Christ.

entries.example: 這部電影向很多老電影致敬。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng xiàng hěn duō lǎo diàn yǐng zhì jìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This film pays tribute to many old movies.
entries.question: 你最想向哪位歌手致敬？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xiǎng xiàng nǎ wèi gē shǒu zhì jìng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which singer would you most like to pay tribute to?
entries.answer: 我最想向鄧麗君致敬。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xiǎng xiàng dèng lì jūn zhì jìng.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd most like to pay tribute to Teresa Teng.

entries.example: 以前這片森林裡有很多野獸。
entries.examplePinyin: yǐ qián zhè piàn sēn lín lǐ yǒu hěn duō yě shòu.
entries.exampleEnglish: There used to be many wild beasts in this forest.
entries.question: 你看過《美女與野獸》嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò 《 měi nǚ yǔ yě shòu 》 ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen Beauty and the Beast?
entries.answer: 看過，我很喜歡裡面的野獸。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ hěn xǐ huan lǐ miàn de yě shòu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I really like the Beast in it.

entries.example: 我有一種錯覺，今天好像是星期五。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ yǒu yì zhǒng cuò jué, jīn tiān hǎo xiàng shì xīng qí wǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: I have this illusion that today is Friday.
entries.question: 你常常有手機在震動的錯覺嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cháng cháng yǒu shǒu jī zài zhèn dòng de cuò jué ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often get the false feeling that your phone is vibrating?
entries.answer: 常常，我常有手機在震動的錯覺。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, wǒ cháng yǒu shǒu jī zài zhèn dòng de cuò jué.
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I often think my phone is vibrating when it isn't.

entries.example: 他在山路上失足，幸好沒受傷。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài shān lù shang shī zú, xìng hǎo méi shòu shāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: He slipped on the mountain trail; luckily he wasn't hurt.
entries.question: 爬山時要怎麼避免失足？
entries.questionPinyin: pá shān shí yào zěn me bì miǎn shī zú?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you avoid slipping when hiking?
entries.answer: 要穿好走的鞋，慢慢走，才不會失足。
entries.answerPinyin: yào chuān hǎo zǒu de xié, màn màn zǒu, cái bú huì shī zú.
entries.answerEnglish: Wear good walking shoes and go slowly so you don't slip.

entries.example: 護士從靜脈抽血。
entries.examplePinyin: hù shì cóng jìng mài chōu xiě.
entries.exampleEnglish: The nurse draws blood from a vein.
entries.question: 抽血通常從哪裡抽？
entries.questionPinyin: chōu xiě tōng cháng cóng nǎ lǐ chōu?
entries.questionEnglish: Where is blood usually drawn from?
entries.answer: 通常從手臂的靜脈抽。
entries.answerPinyin: tōng cháng cóng shǒu bì de jìng mài chōu.
entries.answerEnglish: Usually from a vein in the arm.

entries.example: 這座橋用鋼索懸吊在河上。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zuò qiáo yòng gāng suǒ xuán diào zài hé shàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This bridge is suspended over the river by steel cables.
entries.question: 你走過懸吊在山谷上的吊橋嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zǒu guò xuán diào zài shān gǔ shàng de diào qiáo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever walked across a suspension bridge over a valley?
entries.answer: 走過，懸吊的吊橋一直晃，好可怕。
entries.answerPinyin: zǒu guò, xuán diào de diào qiáo yì zhí huàng, hǎo kě pà.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the suspended bridge kept swaying; it was scary.

entries.example: 官僚體制讓辦事變得很慢。
entries.examplePinyin: guān liáo tǐ zhì ràng bàn shì biàn de hěn màn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Bureaucracy makes getting things done slow.
entries.question: 你覺得哪裡的官僚體制最嚴重？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǎ lǐ de guān liáo tǐ zhì zuì yán zhòng?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you think bureaucracy is the worst?
entries.answer: 我覺得大公司的官僚體制也很嚴重。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de dà gōng sī de guān liáo tǐ zhì yě hěn yán zhòng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think bureaucracy in big companies is pretty bad too.

entries.example: 這件事要走法律程序。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn shì yào zǒu fǎ lǜ chéng xù.
entries.exampleEnglish: This matter has to go through legal proceedings.
entries.question: 跟房東有糾紛時，可以怎麼辦？
entries.questionPinyin: gēn fáng dōng yǒu jiū fēn shí, kě yǐ zěn me bàn?
entries.questionEnglish: What can you do if you have a dispute with your landlord?
entries.answer: 如果談不好，可以走法律程序。
entries.answerPinyin: rú guǒ tán bù hǎo, kě yǐ zǒu fǎ lǜ chéng xù.
entries.answerEnglish: If talking doesn't work, you can take legal action.

entries.example: 在車上匆匆一瞥，我就愛上了那片海。
entries.examplePinyin: zài chē shàng cōng cōng yì piē, wǒ jiù ài shàng le nà piàn hǎi.
entries.exampleEnglish: One quick glimpse from the car and I fell in love with that sea.
entries.question: 哪個地方讓你一瞥就難忘？
entries.questionPinyin: nǎ gè dì fāng ràng nǐ yì piē jiù nán wàng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which place stayed with you after just one glimpse?
entries.answer: 花東的海，我在火車上一瞥就難忘。
entries.answerPinyin: huā dōng de hǎi, wǒ zài huǒ chē shàng yì piē jiù nán wàng.
entries.answerEnglish: The Hualien–Taitung coast; one glimpse from the train and I never forgot it.

entries.example: 博物館展出了作家的手稿。
entries.examplePinyin: bó wù guǎn zhǎn chū le zuò jiā de shǒu gǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: The museum is exhibiting the writer's manuscripts.
entries.question: 你喜歡看名人的手稿嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kàn míng rén de shǒu gǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like looking at famous people's manuscripts?
entries.answer: 喜歡，看手稿可以看到他們寫的字。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, kàn shǒu gǎo kě yǐ kàn dào tā men xiě de zì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, in manuscripts you can see their handwriting.

entries.example: 每種文化都有固有的習慣。
entries.examplePinyin: měi zhǒng wén huà dōu yǒu gù yǒu de xí guàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Every culture has its own inherent customs.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣有什麼固有的傳統？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān yǒu shén me gù yǒu de chuán tǒng?
entries.questionEnglish: What traditions do you think are native to Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我覺得拜拜是台灣固有的傳統。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de bài bài shì tái wān gù yǒu de chuán tǒng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think temple worship is a native Taiwanese tradition.

entries.example: 疫情過後，觀光業慢慢復甦。
entries.examplePinyin: yì qíng guò hòu, guān guāng yè màn màn fù sū.
entries.exampleEnglish: After the pandemic, tourism slowly recovered.
entries.question: 你覺得夜市的生意復甦了嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de yè shì de shēng yì fù sū le ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think business at the night markets has recovered?
entries.answer: 復甦了，現在夜市又擠滿了人。
entries.answerPinyin: fù sū le, xiàn zài yè shì yòu jǐ mǎn le rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the night markets are packed again now.

entries.example: 他把會議資料彙編成一本手冊。
entries.examplePinyin: tā bǎ huì yì zī liào huì biān chéng yì běn shǒu cè.
entries.exampleEnglish: He compiled the meeting materials into a handbook.
entries.question: 你會把學過的生詞彙編成筆記嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì bǎ xué guò de shēng cí huì biān chéng bǐ jì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you compile the words you've learned into notes?
entries.answer: 會，我每個月把生詞彙編成一本筆記。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi gè yuè bǎ shēng cí huì biān chéng yì běn bǐ jì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, every month I compile my new words into a notebook.

entries.example: 這張桌子少了一根螺栓。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhāng zhuō zi shǎo le yì gēn luó shuān.
entries.exampleEnglish: This table is missing a bolt.
entries.question: 你自己組過家具嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zì jǐ zǔ guò jiā jù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever assembled furniture yourself?
entries.answer: 組過，那張桌子要鎖很多螺栓。
entries.answerPinyin: zǔ guò, nà zhāng zhuō zi yào suǒ hěn duō luó shuān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, that table needed a lot of bolts.

entries.example: 這筆收入需要課稅。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bǐ shōu rù xū yào kè shuì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This income is taxable.
entries.question: 你覺得哪些東西應該課稅？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǎ xiē dōng xī yīng gāi kè shuì?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think should be taxed?
entries.answer: 我覺得含糖飲料應該課稅。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de hán táng yǐn liào yīng gāi kè shuì.
entries.answerEnglish: I think sugary drinks should be taxed.

entries.example: 金瓜石以前是採礦的地方。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn guā shí yǐ qián shì cǎi kuàng de dì fāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Jinguashi used to be a mining area.
entries.question: 你覺得採礦的工作危險嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de cǎi kuàng de gōng zuò wéi xiǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think mining is dangerous work?
entries.answer: 很危險，採礦的工人很辛苦。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn wéi xiǎn, cǎi kuàng de gōng rén hěn xīn kǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: Very dangerous; miners have a hard job.

entries.example: 這次展覽吸引了空前的人潮。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì zhǎn lǎn xī yǐn le kōng qián de rén cháo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This exhibition drew unprecedented crowds.
entries.question: 你參加過人潮空前的活動嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān jiā guò rén cháo kōng qián de huó dòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been to an event with record crowds?
entries.answer: 參加過，去年跨年吸引了空前的人潮。
entries.answerPinyin: cān jiā guò, qù nián kuà nián xī yǐn le kōng qián de rén cháo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, last year's New Year's Eve party drew record crowds.

entries.example: 每個國家都很重視自己的主權。
entries.examplePinyin: měi gè guó jiā dōu hěn zhòng shì zì jǐ de zhǔ quán.
entries.exampleEnglish: Every country values its own sovereignty.
entries.question: 主權這個詞常在哪裡看到？
entries.questionPinyin: zhǔ quán zhè ge cí cháng zài nǎ lǐ kàn dào?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you often see the word 'sovereignty'?
entries.answer: 主權這個詞常在新聞裡看到。
entries.answerPinyin: zhǔ quán zhè ge cí cháng zài xīn wén lǐ kàn dào.
entries.answerEnglish: You often see the word 'sovereignty' in the news.

entries.example: 這家民宿的花園有一排樹籬。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā mín sù de huā yuán yǒu yì pái shù lí.
entries.exampleEnglish: This B&B's garden has a hedge.
entries.question: 你喜歡有樹籬的花園嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan yǒu shù lí de huā yuán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like gardens with hedges?
entries.answer: 喜歡，樹籬讓花園看起來很整齊。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, shù lí ràng huā yuán kàn qǐ lái hěn zhěng qí.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, hedges make a garden look neat.

entries.example: 立法院是台灣的立法機關。
entries.examplePinyin: lì fǎ yuàn shì tái wān de lì fǎ jī guān.
entries.exampleEnglish: The Legislative Yuan is Taiwan's legislature.
entries.question: 你國家的立法機關叫什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ guó jiā de lì fǎ jī guān jiào shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What is your country's legislature called?
entries.answer: 我們國家的立法機關叫國會。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ men guó jiā de lì fǎ jī guān jiào guó huì.
entries.answerEnglish: Our country's legislature is called Parliament.

entries.example: 兩條河在這裡匯合。
entries.examplePinyin: liǎng tiáo hé zài zhè lǐ huì hé.
entries.exampleEnglish: Two rivers meet here.
entries.question: 你住的城市有河流匯合的地方嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhù de chéng shì yǒu hé liú huì hé de dì fāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a place where rivers meet in the city you live in?
entries.answer: 有，台北的淡水河就是兩條河匯合成的。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, tái běi de dàn shuǐ hé jiù shì liǎng tiáo hé huì hé chéng de.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, Taipei's Tamsui River is formed where two rivers merge.

entries.example: 工程師用機器探查水管的問題。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng chéng shī yòng jī qì tàn chá shuǐ guǎn de wèn tí.
entries.exampleEnglish: The engineer used a machine to probe the problem with the pipes.
entries.question: 家裡漏水時，你會找誰來探查？
entries.questionPinyin: jiā lǐ lòu shuǐ shí, nǐ huì zhǎo shéi lái tàn chá?
entries.questionEnglish: When there's a leak at home, who do you call to check it out?
entries.answer: 我會找水電師傅來探查。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì zhǎo shuǐ diàn shī fu lái tàn chá.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd call a plumber to investigate.

entries.example: 這個礦井已經關閉很多年了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge kuàng jǐng yǐ jīng guān bì hěn duō nián le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This mine shaft has been closed for many years.
entries.question: 你參觀過以前的礦井嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān guān guò yǐ qián de kuàng jǐng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever visited an old mine shaft?
entries.answer: 參觀過，我在猴硐看過舊礦井。
entries.answerPinyin: cān guān guò, wǒ zài hóu dòng kàn guò jiù kuàng jǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw an old mine shaft in Houtong.

entries.example: 老鷹在天空中高飛。
entries.examplePinyin: lǎo yīng zài tiān kōng zhōng gāo fēi.
entries.exampleEnglish: An eagle soars in the sky.
entries.question: 你想像鳥一樣高飛嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng xiàng niǎo yí yàng gāo fēi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to soar like a bird?
entries.answer: 想，我想像老鷹一樣在天空高飛。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, wǒ xiǎng xiàng lǎo yīng yí yàng zài tiān kōng gāo fēi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to soar through the sky like an eagle.

entries.example: 我昨晚做了一個奇異的夢。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zuó wǎn zuò le yí gè qí yì de mèng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I had a bizarre dream last night.
entries.question: 你做過奇異的夢嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò guò qí yì de mèng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had a bizarre dream?
entries.answer: 做過，我夢到一個很奇異的地方。
entries.answerPinyin: zuò guò, wǒ mèng dào yí gè hěn qí yì de dì fāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I dreamed about a very strange place.

entries.example: 很多居民在請願書上簽名。
entries.examplePinyin: hěn duō jū mín zài qǐng yuàn shū shàng qiān míng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Many residents signed the petition.
entries.question: 你簽過請願書嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qiān guò qǐng yuàn shū ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever signed a petition?
entries.answer: 簽過，我簽過保護動物的請願書。
entries.answerPinyin: qiān guò, wǒ qiān guò bǎo hù dòng wù de qǐng yuàn shū.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've signed a petition to protect animals.

entries.example: 這家店是做棺材的老店。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn shì zuò guān cái de lǎo diàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This is an old shop that makes coffins.
entries.question: 棺材在台灣有什麼特別的意思？
entries.questionPinyin: guān cái zài tái wān yǒu shén me tè bié de yì sī?
entries.questionEnglish: What special meaning do coffins have in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 棺材聽起來像「官財」，代表升官發財。
entries.answerPinyin: guān cái tīng qǐ lái xiàng “guān cái”, dài biǎo shēng guān fā cái.
entries.answerEnglish: 'Coffin' sounds like 'office and wealth', so it stands for promotion and fortune.

entries.example: 白飯有很多碳水化合物。
entries.examplePinyin: bái fàn yǒu hěn duō tàn shuǐ huà hé wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: White rice has lots of carbohydrates.
entries.question: 你減肥時會少吃碳水化合物嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiǎn féi shí huì shǎo chī tàn shuǐ huà hé wù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you're dieting, do you cut down on carbs?
entries.answer: 會，我晚上會少吃碳水化合物。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ wǎn shàng huì shǎo chī tàn shuǐ huà hé wù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I eat fewer carbs in the evening.

entries.example: 捷運延長營運是夜貓族的福音。
entries.examplePinyin: jié yùn yán cháng yíng yùn shì yè māo zú de fú yīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Longer MRT hours are great news for night owls.
entries.question: 什麼新服務對你來說是福音？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me xīn fú wù duì nǐ lái shuō shì fú yīn?
entries.questionEnglish: What new service has been a godsend for you?
entries.answer: 外送服務對我來說是一大福音。
entries.answerPinyin: wài sòng fú wù duì wǒ lái shuō shì yí dà fú yīn.
entries.answerEnglish: Food delivery has been a real godsend for me.

entries.english: be furious; fly into a rage
entries.example: 老闆一看到報告就暴怒。
entries.examplePinyin: lǎo bǎn yí kàn dào bào gào jiù bào nù.
entries.exampleEnglish: The boss flew into a rage as soon as he saw the report.
entries.question: 什麼事最容易讓你暴怒？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shì zuì róng yì ràng nǐ bào nù?
entries.questionEnglish: What makes you furious most easily?
entries.answer: 有人一直插隊，最容易讓我暴怒。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu rén yì zhí chā duì, zuì róng yì ràng wǒ bào nù.
entries.answerEnglish: People cutting in line make me furious faster than anything.

entries.example: 政府決定廢止這條舊的法律。
entries.examplePinyin: zhèng fǔ jué dìng fèi zhǐ zhè tiáo jiù de fǎ lǜ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The government decided to repeal this old law.
entries.question: 你覺得公司哪條規定應該廢止？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de gōng sī nǎ tiáo guī dìng yīng gāi fèi zhǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Which rule at your company do you think should be abolished?
entries.answer: 上班一定要打卡的規定應該廢止。
entries.answerPinyin: shàng bān yí dìng yào dǎ kǎ de guī dìng yīng gāi fèi zhǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: The rule that we have to clock in should be abolished.

entries.example: 這家餐廳做的是正統的法國菜。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā cān tīng zuò de shì zhèng tǒng de fǎ guó cài.
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant serves traditional French cuisine.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃正統的外國料理嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan chī zhèng tǒng de wài guó liào lǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like eating traditional foreign food?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我最愛吃正統的日本拉麵。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ zuì ài chī zhèng tǒng de rì běn lā miàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love traditional Japanese ramen most.

entries.example: 明星一走進車站，就引起一陣騷動。
entries.examplePinyin: míng xīng yì zǒu jìn chē zhàn, jiù yǐn qǐ yí zhèn sāo dòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: As soon as the celebrity walked into the station, it caused a commotion.
entries.question: 你看過什麼引起騷動的事？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò shén me yǐn qǐ sāo dòng de shì?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen something that caused a commotion?
entries.answer: 有明星來夜市，引起了一陣騷動。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu míng xīng lái yè shì, yǐn qǐ le yí zhèn sāo dòng.
entries.answerEnglish: A celebrity came to the night market and caused quite a stir.

entries.example: 古柯鹼是一種違法的毒品。
entries.examplePinyin: gǔ kē jiǎn shì yì zhǒng wéi fǎ de dú pǐn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Cocaine is an illegal drug.
entries.question: 在台灣，帶古柯鹼入境會怎麼樣？
entries.questionPinyin: zài tái wān, dài gǔ kē jiǎn rù jìng huì zěn me yàng?
entries.questionEnglish: What happens if you bring cocaine into Taiwan?
entries.answer: 帶古柯鹼入境是違法的，會被判刑。
entries.answerPinyin: dài gǔ kē jiǎn rù jìng shì wéi fǎ de, huì bèi pàn xíng.
entries.answerEnglish: Bringing cocaine into the country is illegal, and you'll be sentenced.

entries.example: 這台機器的精確度非常高。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tái jī qì de jīng què dù fēi cháng gāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: This machine is extremely precise.
entries.question: 你覺得手機導航的精確度高嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shǒu jī dǎo háng de jīng què dù gāo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think phone navigation is accurate?
entries.answer: 很高，不過在山裡精確度就差一點。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn gāo, bú guò zài shān lǐ jīng què dù jiù chà yì diǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Very, but in the mountains it's a bit less accurate.

entries.example: 公司倒閉了，債權人都拿不回錢。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng sī dǎo bì le, zhài quán rén dōu ná bù huí qián.
entries.exampleEnglish: The company went bankrupt, and the creditors couldn't get their money back.
entries.question: 你覺得當債權人容易嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de dāng zhài quán rén róng yì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think being a creditor is easy?
entries.answer: 不容易，債權人常常要不回錢。
entries.answerPinyin: bù róng yì, zhài quán rén cháng cháng yào bù huí qián.
entries.answerEnglish: No. Creditors often can't get their money back.

entries.example: 這條老街這幾年慢慢復興起來了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tiáo lǎo jiē zhè jǐ nián màn màn fù xīng qǐ lái le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This old street has slowly come back to life in recent years.
entries.question: 你喜歡文藝復興時期的畫嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan wén yì fù xīng shí qí de huà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like Renaissance paintings?
entries.answer: 喜歡，文藝復興時期的畫很有味道。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wén yì fù xīng shí qí de huà hěn yǒu wèi dào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, Renaissance paintings have a lot of character.

entries.example: 每個人對辣的耐受度都不一樣。
entries.examplePinyin: měi gè rén duì là de nài shòu dù dōu bù yí yàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Everyone's tolerance for spicy food is different.
entries.question: 你對辣的耐受度高嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì là de nài shòu dù gāo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your tolerance for spicy food high?
entries.answer: 我的耐受度很低，吃一點辣就流汗。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de nài shòu dù hěn dī, chī yì diǎn là jiù liú hàn.
entries.answerEnglish: My tolerance is low. A little spice and I start sweating.

entries.example: 很多工廠都缺少勞動力。
entries.examplePinyin: hěn duō gōng chǎng dōu quē shǎo láo dòng lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Many factories are short of workers.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣缺勞動力嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái wān quē láo dòng lì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwan is short of labor?
entries.answer: 缺，很多工廠都找不到足夠的勞動力。
entries.answerPinyin: quē, hěn duō gōng chǎng dōu zhǎo bú dào zú gòu de láo dòng lì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. Lots of factories can't find enough workers.

entries.example: 有些邪教會騙走信徒的錢。
entries.examplePinyin: yǒu xiē xié jiào huì piàn zǒu xìn tú de qián.
entries.exampleEnglish: Some cults trick their followers out of their money.
entries.question: 怎麼分辨一個團體是不是邪教？
entries.questionPinyin: zěn me fēn biàn yí gè tuán tǐ shì bu shì xié jiào?
entries.questionEnglish: How can you tell whether a group is a cult?
entries.answer: 如果一直要你交錢，可能就是邪教。
entries.answerPinyin: rú guǒ yì zhí yào nǐ jiāo qián, kě néng jiù shì xié jiào.
entries.answerEnglish: If it keeps asking you for money, it might be a cult.

entries.example: 沒有人可以剝奪你受教育的權利。
entries.examplePinyin: méi yǒu rén kě yǐ bō duó nǐ shòu jiào yù de quán lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: No one can deprive you of your right to an education.
entries.question: 你覺得手機剝奪了你的睡眠嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shǒu jī bō duó le nǐ de shuì mián ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your phone deprives you of sleep?
entries.answer: 有，滑手機剝奪了我很多睡眠時間。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, huá shǒu jī bō duó le wǒ hěn duō shuì mián shí jiān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. Scrolling on my phone takes away a lot of my sleep.

entries.example: 這種簽證每年的配額有限。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhǒng qiān zhèng měi nián de pèi é yǒu xiàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This kind of visa has a limited quota each year.
entries.question: 你的國家有打工度假簽證的配額嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā yǒu dǎ gōng dù jià qiān zhèng de pèi é ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your country have a quota for working holiday visas?
entries.answer: 有，每年的配額很快就滿了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, měi nián de pèi é hěn kuài jiù mǎn le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. The quota fills up quickly every year.

entries.example: 公司的員工名錄放在網站上。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng sī de yuán gōng míng lù fàng zài wǎng zhàn shàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The company's staff directory is on the website.
entries.question: 你們公司有員工名錄嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men gōng sī yǒu yuán gōng míng lù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company have a staff directory?
entries.answer: 有，新同事的名字都會加進員工名錄。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, xīn tóng shì de míng zì dōu huì jiā jìn yuán gōng míng lù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. New colleagues' names all get added to the staff directory.

entries.example: 開會時，老闆的表情很凝重。
entries.examplePinyin: kāi huì shí, lǎo bǎn de biǎo qíng hěn níng zhòng.
entries.exampleEnglish: During the meeting, the boss's expression was grim.
entries.question: 什麼時候大家的表情會很凝重？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shí hòu dà jiā de biǎo qíng huì hěn níng zhòng?
entries.questionEnglish: When do people's faces look grim?
entries.answer: 聽到壞消息時，大家的表情都很凝重。
entries.answerPinyin: tīng dào huài xiāo xí shí, dà jiā de biǎo qíng dōu hěn níng zhòng.
entries.answerEnglish: When people hear bad news, they all look grim.

entries.example: 山上的寺廟住著幾位僧侶。
entries.examplePinyin: shān shàng de sì miào zhù zhe jǐ wèi sēng lǚ.
entries.exampleEnglish: A few monks live in the temple on the mountain.
entries.question: 你跟僧侶聊過天嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ gēn sēng lǚ liáo guò tiān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever chatted with a monk?
entries.answer: 聊過，我在泰國跟一位僧侶聊過天。
entries.answerPinyin: liáo guò, wǒ zài tài guó gēn yí wèi sēng lǚ liáo guò tiān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I chatted with a monk in Thailand.

entries.example: 這件外套的袖子上有流蘇。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn wài tào de xiù zi shàng yǒu liú sū.
entries.exampleEnglish: This jacket has fringe on the sleeves.
entries.question: 你喜歡有流蘇的衣服嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan yǒu liú sū de yī fu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like clothes with fringe?
entries.answer: 不太喜歡，流蘇太多看起來很亂。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài xǐ huan, liú sū tài duō kàn qǐ lái hěn luàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. Too much fringe looks messy.

entries.example: 海邊發現了一具鯨魚的屍體。
entries.examplePinyin: hǎi biān fā xiàn le yí jù jīng yú de shī tǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: A whale carcass was found on the beach.
entries.question: 看到路上有動物屍體，應該通知誰？
entries.questionPinyin: kàn dào lù shang yǒu dòng wù shī tǐ, yīng gāi tōng zhī shéi?
entries.questionEnglish: If you see a dead animal on the road, who should you notify?
entries.answer: 可以打電話請清潔隊來處理屍體。
entries.answerPinyin: kě yǐ dǎ diàn huà qǐng qīng jié duì lái chǔ lǐ shī tǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: You can call the sanitation team to come and remove the body.

entries.example: 這座宅邸以前是一位商人的家。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zuò zhái dǐ yǐ qián shì yí wèi shāng rén de jiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: This mansion used to be a merchant's home.
entries.question: 你參觀過古老的宅邸嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān guān guò gǔ lǎo de zhái dǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever visited an old mansion?
entries.answer: 參觀過，那座宅邸的花園很漂亮。
entries.answerPinyin: cān guān guò, nà zuò zhái dǐ de huā yuán hěn piào liang.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. That mansion had a beautiful garden.

entries.example: 這本書在介紹社會主義的歷史。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè běn shū zài jiè shào shè huì zhǔ yì de lì shǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: This book is about the history of socialism.
entries.question: 你對社會主義了解多少？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì shè huì zhǔ yì liǎo jiě duō shǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: How much do you know about socialism?
entries.answer: 不多，我只知道社會主義的基本想法。
entries.answerPinyin: bù duō, wǒ zhǐ zhī dào shè huì zhǔ yì de jī běn xiǎng fǎ.
entries.answerEnglish: Not much. I only know the basic ideas of socialism.

entries.example: 他是這家公司唯一的繼承人。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì zhè jiā gōng sī wéi yī de jì chéng rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's the sole heir to this company.
entries.question: 你覺得當有錢人家的繼承人好嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de dāng yǒu qián rén jiā de jì chéng rén hǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think being the heir to a rich family is a good thing?
entries.answer: 不一定，繼承人的壓力應該很大。
entries.answerPinyin: bù yí dìng, jì chéng rén de yā lì yīng gāi hěn dà.
entries.answerEnglish: Not necessarily. Heirs must be under a lot of pressure.

entries.example: 公司以前沒有這樣的先例。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng sī yǐ qián méi yǒu zhè yàng de xiān lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: The company has never had a precedent like this.
entries.question: 你們公司有帶狗上班的先例嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men gōng sī yǒu dài gǒu shàng bān de xiān lì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a precedent for bringing dogs to work at your company?
entries.answer: 有，已經有同事帶狗上班的先例了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, yǐ jīng yǒu tóng shì dài gǒu shàng bān de xiān lì le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. A colleague has already set the precedent of bringing a dog to work.

entries.example: 據內部人士說，公司要搬家了。
entries.examplePinyin: jù nèi bù rén shì shuō, gōng sī yào bān jiā le.
entries.exampleEnglish: According to an insider, the company is going to move.
entries.question: 你會相信內部人士的消息嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì xiāng xìn nèi bù rén shì de xiāo xí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you trust information from insiders?
entries.answer: 會，內部人士的消息通常比較準。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, nèi bù rén shì de xiāo xí tōng cháng bǐ jiào zhǔn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. Information from insiders is usually more accurate.

entries.example: 紀錄片裡的獸群正在過河。
entries.examplePinyin: jì lù piàn lǐ de shòu qún zhèng zài guò hé.
entries.exampleEnglish: In the documentary, the herd is crossing the river.
entries.question: 你在紀錄片裡看過獸群遷徙嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài jì lù piàn lǐ kàn guò shòu qún qiān xǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen herds migrating in a documentary?
entries.answer: 看過，非洲的獸群遷徙非常壯觀。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, fēi zhōu de shòu qún qiān xǐ fēi cháng zhuàng guān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. The herds migrating in Africa are spectacular.

entries.example: 這次地震造成了毀滅性的破壞。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì dì zhèn zào chéng le huǐ miè xìng de pò huài.
entries.exampleEnglish: This earthquake caused devastating damage.
entries.question: 哪些天災可能帶來毀滅性的影響？
entries.questionPinyin: nǎ xiē tiān zāi kě néng dài lái huǐ miè xìng de yǐng xiǎng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which natural disasters can have devastating effects?
entries.answer: 大地震和海嘯都可能帶來毀滅性的影響。
entries.answerPinyin: dà dì zhèn hé hǎi xiào dōu kě néng dài lái huǐ miè xìng de yǐng xiǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: Big earthquakes and tsunamis can both have devastating effects.

entries.example: 那座教堂有一個很大的圓頂。
entries.examplePinyin: nà zuò jiào táng yǒu yí gè hěn dà de yuán dǐng.
entries.exampleEnglish: That church has a huge dome.
entries.question: 你看過哪座有圓頂的建築？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò nǎ zuò yǒu yuán dǐng de jiàn zhú?
entries.questionEnglish: What domed buildings have you seen?
entries.answer: 我去過羅馬，看過萬神殿的圓頂。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qù guò luó mǎ, kàn guò wàn shén diàn de yuán dǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: I've been to Rome and seen the dome of the Pantheon.

entries.example: 這家咖啡店的咖啡豆是現場研磨的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā kā fēi diàn de kā fēi dòu shì xiàn chǎng yán mó de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This café grinds its coffee beans right there on the spot.
entries.question: 你在家會自己研磨咖啡豆嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài jiā huì zì jǐ yán mó kā fēi dòu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you grind your own coffee beans at home?
entries.answer: 會，我每天早上自己研磨咖啡豆。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng zì jǐ yán mó kā fēi dòu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I grind my own coffee beans every morning.

entries.example: 一隻老鷹在山上盤旋。
entries.examplePinyin: yì zhī lǎo yīng zài shān shàng pán xuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: An eagle is circling over the mountain.
entries.question: 你看過老鷹在天上盤旋嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò lǎo yīng zài tiān shàng pán xuán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen an eagle circling in the sky?
entries.answer: 看過，在基隆港常看到老鷹盤旋。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, zài jī lóng gǎng cháng kàn dào lǎo yīng pán xuán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. You often see kites circling over Keelung Harbor.

entries.example: 臭氧層可以保護地球。
entries.examplePinyin: chòu yǎng céng kě yǐ bǎo hù dì qiú.
entries.exampleEnglish: The ozone layer protects the earth.
entries.question: 你知道臭氧層為什麼重要嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào chòu yǎng céng wèi shén me zhòng yào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know why the ozone layer is important?
entries.answer: 知道，臭氧層可以擋住紫外線。
entries.answerPinyin: zhī dào, chòu yǎng céng kě yǐ dǎng zhù zǐ wài xiàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. The ozone layer blocks ultraviolet rays.

entries.example: 這部電影裡有很多政治宣傳。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng lǐ yǒu hěn duō zhèng zhì xuān chuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a lot of political propaganda in this movie.
entries.question: 你看得出來哪些是政治宣傳嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn de chū lái nǎ xiē shì zhèng zhì xuān chuán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you tell what is propaganda?
entries.answer: 有時候看得出來，政治宣傳通常很誇張。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu kàn de chū lái, zhèng zhì xuān chuán tōng cháng hěn kuā zhāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. Propaganda is usually exaggerated.

entries.example: 動物園裡傳來獅子的吼聲。
entries.examplePinyin: dòng wù yuán lǐ chuán lái shī zi de hǒu shēng.
entries.exampleEnglish: A lion's roar came from inside the zoo.
entries.question: 你在動物園聽過獅子的吼聲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài dòng wù yuán tīng guò shī zi de hǒu shēng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever heard a lion roar at the zoo?
entries.answer: 聽過，獅子的吼聲非常大。
entries.answerPinyin: tīng guò, shī zi de hǒu shēng fēi cháng dà.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. A lion's roar is really loud.

entries.english: after this; from then on; thereafter
entries.example: 他搬去台南，此後我們很少見面。
entries.examplePinyin: tā bān qù tái nán, cǐ hòu wǒ men hěn shǎo jiàn miàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He moved to Tainan, and after that we rarely saw each other.
entries.question: 你第一次喝珍奶後，有愛上它嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ dì yī cì hē zhēn nǎi hòu, yǒu ài shàng tā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: After your first bubble tea, did you fall in love with it?
entries.answer: 有，此後我幾乎每天都喝一杯。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, cǐ hòu wǒ jī hū měi tiān dōu hē yì bēi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. From then on I've had one almost every day.

entries.example: 這座老房子有一位看守人。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zuò lǎo fáng zi yǒu yí wèi kān shǒu rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: This old house has a caretaker.
entries.question: 你覺得當燈塔看守人會寂寞嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de dāng dēng tǎ kān shǒu rén huì jì mò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think a lighthouse keeper gets lonely?
entries.answer: 應該會，燈塔看守人常常一個人。
entries.answerPinyin: yīng gāi huì, dēng tǎ kān shǒu rén cháng cháng yí gè rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Probably. A lighthouse keeper is often alone.

entries.example: 他用輕蔑的眼神看著我。
entries.examplePinyin: tā yòng qīng miè de yǎn shén kàn zhe wǒ.
entries.exampleEnglish: He looked at me with contempt.
entries.question: 被人用輕蔑的態度對待，你會怎麼做？
entries.questionPinyin: bèi rén yòng qīng miè de tài dù duì dài, nǐ huì zěn me zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: If someone treats you with contempt, what do you do?
entries.answer: 我會不理他，輕蔑別人很沒禮貌。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì bù lǐ tā, qīng miè bié rén hěn méi lǐ mào.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd ignore them. Treating people with contempt is rude.

entries.example: 夕陽的光輝照在海面上。
entries.examplePinyin: xì yáng de guāng huī zhào zài hǎi miàn shàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The glow of the setting sun lights up the sea.
entries.question: 你喜歡在哪裡看夕陽？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zài nǎ lǐ kàn xì yáng?
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you like to watch the sunset?
entries.answer: 我喜歡在淡水看夕陽的光輝。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan zài dàn shuǐ kàn xì yáng de guāng huī.
entries.answerEnglish: I like watching the glow of the sunset in Tamsui.

entries.example: 醫生要我減少糖的攝取量。
entries.examplePinyin: yī shēng yào wǒ jiǎn shǎo táng de shè qǔ liàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The doctor wants me to cut down my sugar intake.
entries.question: 你會注意每天咖啡因的攝取量嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zhù yì měi tiān kā fēi yīn de shè qǔ liàng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you keep an eye on your daily caffeine intake?
entries.answer: 會，我每天最多喝兩杯，控制攝取量。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi tiān zuì duō hē liǎng bēi, kòng zhì shè qǔ liàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. I drink two cups a day at most to control my intake.

entries.example: 連假的時候，觀光客人數激增。
entries.examplePinyin: lián jià de shí hòu, guān guāng kè rén shù jī zēng.
entries.exampleEnglish: During the long weekend, the number of tourists surged.
entries.question: 你覺得夜市什麼時候人潮會激增？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de yè shì shén me shí hòu rén cháo huì jī zēng?
entries.questionEnglish: When do you think the crowds at night markets surge?
entries.answer: 週末晚上，夜市的人潮會激增。
entries.answerPinyin: zhōu mò wǎn shàng, yè shì de rén cháo huì jī zēng.
entries.answerEnglish: On weekend evenings, the night market crowds surge.

entries.example: 工人正在修水管的閥門。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng rén zhèng zài xiū shuǐ guǎn de fá mén.
entries.exampleEnglish: The worker is repairing the valve on the water pipe.
entries.question: 你知道家裡瓦斯的閥門在哪裡嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào jiā lǐ wǎ sī de fá mén zài nǎ lǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know where the gas valve is in your home?
entries.answer: 知道，閥門在廚房的瓦斯桶旁邊。
entries.answerPinyin: zhī dào, fá mén zài chú fáng de wǎ sī tǒng páng biān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. The valve is next to the gas tank in the kitchen.

entries.example: 總統赦免了這名犯人。
entries.examplePinyin: zǒng tǒng shè miǎn le zhè míng fàn rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: The president pardoned this prisoner.
entries.question: 在台灣，誰有權力赦免犯人？
entries.questionPinyin: zài tái wān, shéi yǒu quán lì shè miǎn fàn rén?
entries.questionEnglish: In Taiwan, who has the power to pardon prisoners?
entries.answer: 在台灣，總統有權力赦免犯人。
entries.answerPinyin: zài tái wān, zǒng tǒng yǒu quán lì shè miǎn fàn rén.
entries.answerEnglish: In Taiwan, the president has the power to pardon prisoners.

entries.example: 他說的話招致很多批評。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shuō de huà zhāo zhì hěn duō pī píng.
entries.exampleEnglish: What he said drew a lot of criticism.
entries.question: 什麼行為容易招致別人的不滿？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me xíng wéi róng yì zhāo zhì bié rén de bù mǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of behavior tends to annoy other people?
entries.answer: 在捷運上大聲講電話，容易招致不滿。
entries.answerPinyin: zài jié yùn shàng dà shēng jiǎng diàn huà, róng yì zhāo zhì bù mǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Talking loudly on the phone on the MRT tends to annoy people.

entries.example: 他對前老闆還有很多怨恨。
entries.examplePinyin: tā duì qián lǎo bǎn hái yǒu hěn duō yuàn hèn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He still has a lot of resentment toward his former boss.
entries.question: 你覺得怎麼做才能放下怨恨？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zěn me zuò cái néng fàng xià yuàn hèn?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you think a person can let go of resentment?
entries.answer: 多跟朋友聊聊，慢慢就能放下怨恨。
entries.answerPinyin: duō gēn péng yǒu liáo liáo, màn màn jiù néng fàng xià yuàn hèn.
entries.answerEnglish: Talk to friends a lot, and you can slowly let go of resentment.

entries.example: 父母不應該對孩子施加太多壓力。
entries.examplePinyin: fù mǔ bú yīng gāi duì hái zi shī jiā tài duō yā lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Parents shouldn't put too much pressure on their children.
entries.question: 你的主管會對你施加壓力嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de zhǔ guǎn huì duì nǐ shī jiā yā lì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your supervisor put pressure on you?
entries.answer: 有時候會，月底他會施加一點壓力。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu huì, yuè dǐ tā huì shī jiā yì diǎn yā lì.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. At the end of the month he puts on a bit of pressure.

entries.example: 這座核電廠的反應爐已經停了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zuò hé diàn chǎng de fǎn yìng lú yǐ jīng tíng le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The reactor at this nuclear power plant has already been shut down.
entries.question: 你覺得核電廠的反應爐安全嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de hé diàn chǎng de fǎn yìng lú ān quán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think nuclear reactors are safe?
entries.answer: 管理得好的話，反應爐應該很安全。
entries.answerPinyin: guǎn lǐ de hǎo de huà, fǎn yìng lú yīng gāi hěn ān quán.
entries.answerEnglish: If they're well managed, reactors should be quite safe.

entries.example: 洛杉磯有很多西語裔居民。
entries.examplePinyin: luò shān jī yǒu hěn duō xī yǔ yì jū mín.
entries.exampleEnglish: Los Angeles has many Hispanic residents.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ rèn shì xī yǔ yì de péng yǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any Hispanic friends?
entries.answer: 認識，我有一位西語裔的同事。
entries.answerPinyin: rèn shì, wǒ yǒu yí wèi xī yǔ yì de tóng shì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. I have a Hispanic coworker.

entries.examplePinyin: zhèng fǔ měi shí nián zuò yí cì rén kǒu pǔ chá.
entries.exampleEnglish: The government carries out a census every ten years.
entries.question: 你的國家多久做一次人口普查？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā duō jiǔ zuò yí cì rén kǒu pǔ chá?

entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de guó jiā měi wǔ nián zuò yí cì rén kǒu pǔ chá.
entries.answerEnglish: My country takes a census every five years.

entries.examplePinyin: tā de bù fá hěn kuài, wǒ gēn bú shàng.

entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de bù fá hěn kuài, péng yǒu cháng cháng gēn bú shàng.

entries.exampleEnglish: That last shot was the decisive one.
entries.question: 你覺得找工作時，什麼是決定性的因素？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zhǎo gōng zuò shí, shén me shì jué dìng xìng de yīn sù?

entries.answer: 我覺得語言能力是決定性的因素。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de yǔ yán néng lì shì jué dìng xìng de yīn sù.
entries.answerEnglish: I think language ability is the decisive factor.

entries.example: 我買了一台可攜式的喇叭。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ mǎi le yì tái kě xié shì de lǎ ba.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu shén me kě xié shì de diàn zǐ chǎn pǐn?
entries.questionEnglish: What portable electronics do you have?
entries.answer: 我有一台可攜式的投影機。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yǒu yì tái kě xié shì de tóu yǐng jī.
entries.answerEnglish: I have a portable projector.

entries.examplePinyin: jǐng chá yào yǒu fǎ yuàn de lìng zhuàng cái néng sōu suǒ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The police need a court warrant before they can search.

entries.questionPinyin: zài tái wān, jǐng chá méi yǒu lìng zhuàng néng sōu suǒ mín zhái ma?

entries.answer: 原則上不行，要先有法院的令狀。
entries.answerPinyin: yuán zé shàng bù xíng, yào xiān yǒu fǎ yuàn de lìng zhuàng.
entries.answerEnglish: As a rule, no. They first need a warrant from the court.

entries.example: 颱風過後，山上的石頭滾落到路上。
entries.examplePinyin: tái fēng guò hòu, shān shàng de shí tou gǔn luò dào lù shang.

entries.question: 下大雨時，山路會有石頭滾落嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: xià dà yǔ shí, shān lù huì yǒu shí tou gǔn luò ma?

entries.answer: 會，常有石頭從山上滾落下來。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, cháng yǒu shí tou cóng shān shàng gǔn luò xià lái.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. Rocks often tumble down from the mountain.

entries.example: 這把刀是手工鍛造的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bǎ dāo shì shǒu gōng duàn zào de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This knife was forged by hand.
entries.question: 你看過師傅鍛造刀子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò shī fu duàn zào dāo zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever watched a craftsman forge a knife?
entries.answer: 看過，我在金門看過師傅鍛造菜刀。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zài jīn mén kàn guò shī fu duàn zào cài dāo.

entries.example: 蔬菜有很多人體需要的營養素。
entries.examplePinyin: shū cài yǒu hěn duō rén tǐ xū yào de yíng yǎng sù.
entries.exampleEnglish: Vegetables have many nutrients the body needs.
entries.question: 你會吃保健食品補充營養素嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì chī bǎo jiàn shí pǐn bǔ chōng yíng yǎng sù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you take supplements to get extra nutrients?
entries.answer: 會，我每天吃維他命補充營養素。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi tiān chī wéi tā mìng bǔ chōng yíng yǎng sù.

entries.example: 這場地震給很多人帶來創傷。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè chǎng dì zhèn gěi hěn duō rén dài lái chuāng shāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The earthquake left many people traumatized.
entries.question: 有心理創傷的人可以去哪裡找幫助？
entries.questionPinyin: yǒu xīn lǐ chuāng shāng de rén kě yǐ qù nǎ lǐ zhǎo bāng zhù?

entries.answer: 可以去找心理師，他們能幫忙處理創傷。
entries.answerPinyin: kě yǐ qù zhǎo xīn lǐ shī, tā men néng bāng máng chǔ lǐ chuāng shāng.
entries.answerEnglish: They can see a psychologist, who can help them deal with trauma.

entries.example: 今年的被提名人都很優秀。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn nián de bèi tí míng rén dōu hěn yōu xiù.
entries.exampleEnglish: This year's nominees are all excellent.
entries.question: 你覺得今年金馬獎哪位被提名人會得獎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de jīn nián jīn mǎ jiǎng nǎ wèi bèi tí míng rén huì dé jiǎng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which Golden Horse nominee do you think will win this year?
entries.answer: 我覺得那位年輕的被提名人會得獎。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de nà wèi nián qīng de bèi tí míng rén huì dé jiǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think that young nominee will win.

entries.example: 他違抗了老闆的命令。
entries.examplePinyin: tā wéi kàng le lǎo bǎn de mìng lìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: He defied his boss's orders.
entries.question: 你小時候會違抗父母嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu huì wéi kàng fù mǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you defy your parents when you were a kid?
entries.answer: 會，我常違抗父母，不想早睡。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng wéi kàng fù mǔ, bù xiǎng zǎo shuì.

entries.example: 他們準備了一場豐盛的宴席。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men zhǔn bèi le yì chǎng fēng shèng de yàn xí.
entries.exampleEnglish: They prepared a lavish banquet.
entries.question: 你參加過台灣的婚禮宴席嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān jiā guò tái wān de hūn lǐ yàn xí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been to a Taiwanese wedding banquet?
entries.answer: 參加過，婚禮宴席的菜多到吃不完。
entries.answerPinyin: cān jiā guò, hūn lǐ yàn xí de cài duō dào chī bù wán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. There was so much food at the wedding banquet that we couldn't finish it.

entries.example: 這本書的著作權屬於作者。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè běn shū de zhù zuò quán shǔ yú zuò zhě.
entries.exampleEnglish: The copyright of this book belongs to the author.
entries.question: 你在網路上用圖片會注意著作權嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài wǎng lù shang yòng tú piàn huì zhù yì zhù zuò quán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you use pictures online, do you pay attention to copyright?
entries.answer: 會，我只用沒有著作權問題的圖片。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ zhǐ yòng méi yǒu zhù zuò quán wèn tí de tú piàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. I only use pictures without copyright issues.

entries.example: 出國前我都會先投保旅平險。
entries.examplePinyin: chū guó qián wǒ dōu huì xiān tóu bǎo lǚ píng xiǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Before going abroad, I always buy travel insurance.
entries.question: 你出國前會投保旅平險嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ chū guó qián huì tóu bǎo lǚ píng xiǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you buy travel insurance before going abroad?
entries.answer: 會，我每次出國前都會投保。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi cì chū guó qián dōu huì tóu bǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. I take out insurance every time before I go abroad.

entries.example: 這家飯店是歐陸風格的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā fàn diàn shì ōu lù fēng gé de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This hotel is in a continental European style.
entries.question: 你喜歡歐陸風格的建築嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan ōu lù fēng gé de jiàn zhú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like continental European architecture?
entries.answer: 喜歡，歐陸風格的建築很有氣質。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, ōu lù fēng gé de jiàn zhú hěn yǒu qì zhí.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. Continental European buildings have a lot of class.

entries.examplePinyin: wáng zǐ èr shí suì jiù jì chéng le wáng wèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: The prince inherited the throne at twenty.
entries.question: 你看過爭奪王位的電視劇嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò zhēng duó wáng wèi de diàn shì jù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever watched a TV drama about a fight for the throne?
entries.answer: 看過，那部爭奪王位的古裝劇很好看。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, nà bù zhēng duó wáng wèi de gǔ zhuāng jù hěn hǎo kàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. That period drama about fighting for the throne was great.

entries.example: 這件襯衫是亞麻布做的，很透氣。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn chèn shān shì yà má bù zuò de, hěn tòu qì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shirt is made of linen, so it's very breathable.
entries.question: 夏天你喜歡穿亞麻布的衣服嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: xià tiān nǐ xǐ huan chuān yà má bù de yī fu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like wearing linen clothes in summer?
entries.answer: 喜歡，亞麻布的衣服很涼快。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, yà má bù de yī fu hěn liáng kuai.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. Linen clothes are nice and cool.

entries.example: 海洛因是一種非常危險的毒品。
entries.examplePinyin: hǎi luò yīn shì yì zhǒng fēi cháng wéi xiǎn de dú pǐn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Heroin is an extremely dangerous drug.
entries.question: 在台灣，販賣海洛因會被怎麼處罰？
entries.questionPinyin: zài tái wān, fàn mài hǎi luò yīn huì bèi zěn me chǔ fá?
entries.questionEnglish: In Taiwan, how is selling heroin punished?
entries.answer: 販賣海洛因會被判很重的刑。
entries.answerPinyin: fàn mài hǎi luò yīn huì bèi pàn hěn zhòng de xíng.
entries.answerEnglish: Selling heroin carries a very heavy sentence.

entries.example: 歷史上這裡發生過一次叛亂。
entries.examplePinyin: lì shǐ shàng zhè lǐ fā shēng guò yí cì pàn luàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: A rebellion once broke out here.
entries.question: 叛亂通常是因為什麼原因發生的？
entries.questionPinyin: pàn luàn tōng cháng shì yīn wèi shén me yuán yīn fā shēng de?
entries.questionEnglish: What usually causes a rebellion?
entries.answer: 人民生活太苦，常常會引發叛亂。
entries.answerPinyin: rén mín shēng huó tài kǔ, cháng cháng huì yǐn fā pàn luàn.
entries.answerEnglish: When people's lives are too hard, it often leads to rebellion.

entries.example: 那艘船在港口下了錨。
entries.examplePinyin: nà sāo chuán zài gǎng kǒu xià le máo.
entries.exampleEnglish: That ship dropped anchor in the harbor.
entries.question: 你知道船為什麼要下錨嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào chuán wèi shén me yào xià máo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know why ships drop anchor?
entries.answer: 知道，下錨可以讓船停在原地。
entries.answerPinyin: zhī dào, xià máo kě yǐ ràng chuán tíng zài yuán dì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. Dropping anchor keeps a ship in one place.

entries.example: 這台機車的汽缸要換了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tái jī chē de qì gāng yào huàn le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This scooter's cylinder needs replacing.
entries.question: 你知道你的機車有幾個汽缸嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào nǐ de jī chē yǒu jǐ gè qì gāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know how many cylinders your scooter has?
entries.answer: 知道，我的機車只有一個汽缸。
entries.answerPinyin: zhī dào, wǒ de jī chē zhǐ yǒu yí gè qì gāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. My scooter has only one cylinder.

entries.example: 他在軍中是一位中尉。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài jūn zhōng shì yí wèi zhōng wèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a lieutenant in the military.
entries.question: 你認識當過軍官的人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ rèn shì dāng guò jūn guān de rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know anyone who has been a military officer?
entries.answer: 認識，我表哥當過海軍中尉。
entries.answerPinyin: rèn shì, wǒ biǎo gē dāng guò hǎi jūn zhōng wèi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes. My cousin was a navy lieutenant.

entries.example: 他對乾淨有一種執念，每天都要拖地。
entries.examplePinyin: tā duì gān jìng yǒu yì zhǒng zhí niàn, měi tiān dōu yào tuō dì.
entries.exampleEnglish: He has an obsession with cleanliness; he mops the floor every day.
entries.question: 你對什麼事情有執念嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì shén me shì qíng yǒu zhí niàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there anything you're obsessed with?
entries.answer: 我對準時有執念，從來不遲到。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ duì zhǔn shí yǒu zhí niàn, cóng lái bù chí dào.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm obsessed with being on time; I'm never late.

entries.example: 他的話裡隱含著不滿。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de huà lǐ yǐn hán zhe bù mǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: There was an implied dissatisfaction in what he said.
entries.question: 你覺得廣告常隱含什麼訊息？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de guǎng gào cháng yǐn hán shén me xùn xí?
entries.questionEnglish: What messages do you think ads often imply?
entries.answer: 很多廣告隱含著買了東西就會快樂的意思。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn duō guǎng gào yǐn hán zhe mǎi le dōng xī jiù huì kuài lè de yì sī.
entries.answerEnglish: Many ads imply that buying things will make you happy.

entries.example: 這幾年台灣的咖啡店蓬勃發展。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jǐ nián tái wān de kā fēi diàn péng bó fā zhǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Coffee shops in Taiwan have been booming in recent years.
entries.question: 你覺得哪個行業正在蓬勃發展？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǎ gè háng yè zhèng zài péng bó fā zhǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: Which industry do you think is booming right now?
entries.answer: 我覺得人工智慧正在蓬勃發展。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de rén gōng zhì huì zhèng zài péng bó fā zhǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: I think AI is booming right now.

entries.example: 這部連續劇在講一個男人和他的情婦。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù lián xù jù zài jiǎng yí gè nán rén hé tā de qíng fù.
entries.exampleEnglish: This TV drama is about a man and his mistress.
entries.question: 為什麼很多連續劇都有情婦的角色？
entries.questionPinyin: wèi shén me hěn duō lián xù jù dōu yǒu qíng fù de jué sè?
entries.questionEnglish: Why do so many TV dramas have a mistress character?
entries.answer: 因為情婦的角色可以讓劇情更有衝突。
entries.answerPinyin: yīn wèi qíng fù de jué sè kě yǐ ràng jù qíng gèng yǒu chōng tú.
entries.answerEnglish: Because a mistress character adds more conflict to the plot.

entries.example: 警察在街上擋住了一群暴民。
entries.examplePinyin: jǐng chá zài jiē shàng dǎng zhù le yì qún bào mín.
entries.exampleEnglish: The police stopped a mob in the street.
entries.question: 遇到暴民的時候，應該怎麼做？
entries.questionPinyin: yù dào bào mín de shí hòu, yīng gāi zěn me zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: What should people do if they run into a mob?
entries.answer: 應該馬上離開，遠離暴民並報警。
entries.answerPinyin: yīng gāi mǎ shàng lí kāi, yuǎn lí bào mín bìng bào jǐng.
entries.answerEnglish: Leave right away, stay away from the mob, and call the police.

entries.example: 這個國家有很多民兵組織。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge guó jiā yǒu hěn duō mín bīng zǔ zhī.
entries.exampleEnglish: This country has many militia groups.
entries.question: 民兵和一般軍人有什麼不同？
entries.questionPinyin: mín bīng hé yì bān jūn rén yǒu shén me bù tóng?
entries.questionEnglish: How are militia members different from regular soldiers?
entries.answer: 民兵通常不是全職的軍人。
entries.answerPinyin: mín bīng tōng cháng bú shì quán zhí de jūn rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Militia members usually aren't full-time soldiers.

entries.example: 那面牆上長滿了藤蔓。
entries.examplePinyin: nà miàn qiáng shàng zhǎng mǎn le téng wàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: That wall is covered in vines.
entries.question: 你家附近有長滿藤蔓的房子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn yǒu zhǎng mǎn téng wàn de fáng zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a house covered in vines near where you live?
entries.answer: 有，巷子裡有一棟長滿藤蔓的老房子。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, xiàng zi lǐ yǒu yí dòng zhǎng mǎn téng wàn de lǎo fáng zi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's an old house covered in vines in my lane.

entries.example: 這艘船的船身是白色的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè sāo chuán de chuán shēn shì bái sè de.
entries.exampleEnglish: The hull of this ship is white.
entries.question: 你坐過船身很大的船嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò guò chuán shēn hěn dà de chuán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been on a ship with a huge hull?
entries.answer: 坐過，我坐過船身很長的郵輪。
entries.answerPinyin: zuò guò, wǒ zuò guò chuán shēn hěn cháng de yóu lún.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've been on a cruise ship with a very long hull.

entries.example: 他在大學研究量子物理。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài dà xué yán jiù liàng zǐ wù lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: He researches quantum physics at a university.
entries.question: 你對量子電腦有興趣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì liàng zǐ diàn nǎo yǒu xìng qù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you interested in quantum computers?
entries.answer: 有一點，不過量子物理太難懂了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu yì diǎn, bú guò liàng zǐ wù lǐ tài nán dǒng le.
entries.answerEnglish: A little, but quantum physics is too hard to understand.

entries.example: 這個路口的塞車惡名昭彰。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge lù kǒu de sāi chē è míng zhāo zhāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This intersection is notorious for its traffic jams.
entries.question: 你住的地方有惡名昭彰的路口嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhù de dì fāng yǒu è míng zhāo zhāng de lù kǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a notorious intersection where you live?
entries.answer: 有，我家附近有一個惡名昭彰的路口，常常塞車。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiā fù jìn yǒu yí gè è míng zhāo zhāng de lù kǒu, cháng cháng sāi chē.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a notorious intersection near my home that's always jammed.

entries.example: 這片海是有名的漁場。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè piàn hǎi shì yǒu míng de yú chǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This sea is a famous fishing ground.
entries.question: 你的國家有很大的漁場嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā yǒu hěn dà de yú chǎng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your country have large fishing grounds?
entries.answer: 有，我們北邊的海有很大的漁場。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men běi biān de hǎi yǒu hěn dà de yú chǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the sea to our north has huge fishing grounds.

entries.example: 鄰居們自發地打掃公園。
entries.examplePinyin: lín jū men zì fā de dǎ sǎo gōng yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: The neighbors cleaned the park of their own accord.
entries.question: 你參加過自發的活動嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān jiā guò zì fā de huó dòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever joined a spontaneous, self-organized activity?
entries.answer: 有，我跟朋友自發去海邊撿垃圾。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ gēn péng yǒu zì fā qù hǎi biān jiǎn lè sè.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my friends and I went to pick up trash on the beach on our own.

entries.example: 他一邊開車一邊咒罵塞車。
entries.examplePinyin: tā yì biān kāi chē yì biān zhòu mà sāi chē.
entries.exampleEnglish: He cursed the traffic as he drove.
entries.question: 塞車的時候，你會咒罵嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: sāi chē de shí hòu, nǐ huì zhòu mà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you swear when you're stuck in traffic?
entries.answer: 不會，但我常聽到司機在車上咒罵。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, dàn wǒ cháng tīng dào sī jī zài chē shàng zhòu mà.
entries.answerEnglish: No, but I often hear drivers cursing in their cars.

entries.example: 我在捷運上遇到一位舊識。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zài jié yùn shàng yù dào yí wèi jiù shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: I ran into an old acquaintance on the MRT.
entries.question: 你在台灣遇過舊識嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān yù guò jiù shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever run into an old acquaintance in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 有，我在夜市巧遇一位大學的舊識。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ zài yè shì qiǎo yù yí wèi dà xué de jiù shì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I bumped into an old acquaintance from college at a night market.

entries.example: 請在貨單上簽名。
entries.examplePinyin: qǐng zài huò dān shàng qiān míng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Please sign the shipping list.
entries.question: 你的工作需要看貨單嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng zuò xū yào kàn huò dān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you need to read shipping lists at work?
entries.answer: 需要，我每天都要檢查貨單。
entries.answerPinyin: xū yào, wǒ měi tiān dōu yào jiǎn chá huò dān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have to check the shipping lists every day.

entries.example: 她穿了一件天鵝絨的外套。
entries.examplePinyin: tā chuān le yí jiàn tiān é róng de wài tào.
entries.exampleEnglish: She wore a velvet jacket.
entries.question: 你有天鵝絨做的衣服嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu tiān é róng zuò de yī fu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any clothes made of velvet?
entries.answer: 有，我有一件黑色的天鵝絨洋裝。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ yǒu yí jiàn hēi sè de tiān é róng yáng zhuāng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a black velvet dress.

entries.example: 我做沙拉都用初榨橄欖油。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ zuò shā lā dōu yòng chū zhà gǎn lǎn yóu.
entries.exampleEnglish: I always use virgin olive oil in salads.
entries.question: 你做菜會用初榨橄欖油嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò cài huì yòng chū zhà gǎn lǎn yóu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you cook with virgin olive oil?
entries.answer: 會，我拌沙拉都用初榨橄欖油。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ bàn shā lā dōu yòng chū zhà gǎn lǎn yóu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always dress salads with virgin olive oil.

entries.example: 這位醫生在地方上很有聲望。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè wèi yī shēng zài dì fāng shàng hěn yǒu shēng wàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This doctor has great prestige in the local community.
entries.question: 你覺得哪種工作最有聲望？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǎ zhǒng gōng zuò zuì yǒu shēng wàng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which kind of job do you think has the most prestige?
entries.answer: 我覺得醫生在台灣很有聲望。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de yī shēng zài tái wān hěn yǒu shēng wàng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think doctors have a lot of prestige in Taiwan.

entries.example: 這本小說的故事引人入勝。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè běn xiǎo shuō de gù shì yǐn rén rù shèng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The story of this novel is gripping.
entries.question: 你最近看過引人入勝的劇嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn kàn guò yǐn rén rù shèng de jù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you watched any gripping shows lately?
entries.answer: 有，我最近看的韓劇很引人入勝。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ zuì jìn kàn de hán jù hěn yǐn rén rù shèng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the Korean drama I'm watching is really gripping.

entries.example: 週末我會放縱一下，吃炸雞。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōu mò wǒ huì fàng zòng yí xià, chī zhà jī.
entries.exampleEnglish: On weekends I let myself go a bit and eat fried chicken.
entries.question: 你什麼時候會放縱自己大吃？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shén me shí hòu huì fàng zòng zì jǐ dà chī?
entries.questionEnglish: When do you let yourself indulge in a big meal?
entries.answer: 生日的時候，我會放縱自己吃蛋糕。
entries.answerPinyin: shēng rì de shí hòu, wǒ huì fàng zòng zì jǐ chī dàn gāo.
entries.answerEnglish: On my birthday I let myself indulge in cake.

entries.example: 這次地震帶來災難性的損失。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì dì zhèn dài lái zāi nàn xìng de sǔn shī.
entries.exampleEnglish: This earthquake caused catastrophic losses.
entries.question: 哪種天災可能造成災難性的影響？
entries.questionPinyin: nǎ zhǒng tiān zāi kě néng zào chéng zāi nàn xìng de yǐng xiǎng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which natural disaster could have a catastrophic impact?
entries.answer: 我覺得大地震會造成災難性的影響。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de dà dì zhèn huì zào chéng zāi nàn xìng de yǐng xiǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think a big earthquake would have a catastrophic impact.

entries.example: 這件襯衫的針腳很整齊。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn chèn shān de zhēn jiǎo hěn zhěng qí.
entries.exampleEnglish: The stitching on this shirt is very neat.
entries.question: 你買衣服時會看針腳嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi yī fu shí huì kàn zhēn jiǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you check the stitching when you buy clothes?
entries.answer: 會，我會看針腳整不整齊。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì kàn zhēn jiǎo zhěng bu zhěng qí.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I check whether the stitching is neat.

entries.example: 博物館裡有一具恐龍骨骸。
entries.examplePinyin: bó wù guǎn lǐ yǒu yí jù kǒng lóng gǔ hái.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a dinosaur skeleton in the museum.
entries.question: 在哪裡可以看到恐龍的骨骸？
entries.questionPinyin: zài nǎ lǐ kě yǐ kàn dào kǒng lóng de gǔ hái?
entries.questionEnglish: Where can you see dinosaur skeletons?
entries.answer: 在科學博物館可以看到恐龍的骨骸。
entries.answerPinyin: zài kē xué bó wù guǎn kě yǐ kàn dào kǒng lóng de gǔ hái.
entries.answerEnglish: You can see dinosaur skeletons at the science museum.

entries.example: 他們在婚禮上說了誓言。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men zài hūn lǐ shàng shuō le shì yán.
entries.exampleEnglish: They said their vows at the wedding.
entries.question: 你覺得結婚誓言重要嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de jié hūn shì yán zhòng yào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think wedding vows are important?
entries.answer: 很重要，誓言代表兩個人的承諾。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn zhòng yào, shì yán dài biǎo liǎng gè rén de chéng nuò.
entries.answerEnglish: Very important. Vows stand for the couple's commitment.

entries.example: 過年前夕，車站人很多。
entries.examplePinyin: guò nián qián xì, chē zhàn rén hěn duō.
entries.exampleEnglish: On the eve of Lunar New Year, the stations are crowded.
entries.question: 出國的前夕，你會做什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: chū guó de qián xì, nǐ huì zuò shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do the night before you go abroad?
entries.answer: 出國前夕，我會整理行李。
entries.answerPinyin: chū guó qián xì, wǒ huì zhěng lǐ xíng li.
entries.answerEnglish: The night before I go abroad, I pack my bags.

entries.example: 他在南部經營一座咖啡種植園。

entries.answer: 參觀過，我去過雲林的咖啡種植園。
entries.answerPinyin: cān guān guò, wǒ qù guò yún lín de kā fēi zhòng zhí yuán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've visited a coffee plantation in Yunlin.

entries.example: 路口的監視器可以嚇阻小偷。
entries.examplePinyin: lù kǒu de jiān shì qì kě yǐ hè zǔ xiǎo tōu.

entries.question: 什麼方法可以嚇阻闖紅燈？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me fāng fǎ kě yǐ hè zǔ chuǎng hóng dēng?
entries.questionEnglish: What can deter people from running red lights?
entries.answer: 裝更多監視器可以嚇阻闖紅燈。
entries.answerPinyin: zhuāng gèng duō jiān shì qì kě yǐ hè zǔ chuǎng hóng dēng.
entries.answerEnglish: Installing more cameras can deter red-light running.

entries.example: 早期的拓荒者在這裡開墾種田。

entries.answer: 有，很多拓荒者從歐洲來到我們國家。

entries.examplePinyin: qí mǎ qián yào xiān fàng hǎo mǎ ān.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qí mǎ shí zuò guò mǎ ān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever sat in a saddle while riding a horse?
entries.answer: 坐過，我在農場騎馬時坐過馬鞍。
entries.answerPinyin: zuò guò, wǒ zài nóng chǎng qí mǎ shí zuò guò mǎ ān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I sat in a saddle when I rode a horse at a farm.

entries.example: 他對公司的不公感到很生氣。
entries.examplePinyin: tā duì gōng sī de bù gōng gǎn dào hěn shēng qì.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's angry about the company's unfairness.
entries.question: 遇到不公的事，你會說出來嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: yù dào bù gōng de shì, nǐ huì shuō chū lái ma?

entries.answer: 會，遇到不公的事我一定會說出來。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, yù dào bù gōng de shì wǒ yí dìng huì shuō chū lái.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always speak up when something is unfair.

entries.example: 這是新手機的原型。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shì xīn shǒu jī de yuán xíng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a prototype of the new phone.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng zuò huì zuò chǎn pǐn yuán xíng ma?

entries.answer: 會，我們常常先做一個原型來測試。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ men cháng cháng xiān zuò yí gè yuán xíng lái cè shì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we often build a prototype first to test.

entries.examplePinyin: hěn duō hòu niǎo zài zhè piàn shī dì qī xí.
entries.exampleEnglish: Many migratory birds live in this wetland.
entries.question: 你看過棲息在公園裡的松鼠嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò qī xí zài gōng yuán lǐ de sōng shǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen squirrels living in the park?
entries.answer: 看過，大安森林公園有很多松鼠棲息。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, dà ān sēn lín gōng yuán yǒu hěn duō sōng shǔ qī xí.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, lots of squirrels live in Daan Forest Park.

entries.examplePinyin: tā shì zhè ge huán bǎo huó dòng de tuī dòng zhě.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's the driving force behind this environmental campaign.
entries.question: 你想當哪種活動的推動者？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng dāng nǎ zhǒng huó dòng de tuī dòng zhě?

entries.answer: 我想當淨灘活動的推動者。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng dāng jìng tān huó dòng de tuī dòng zhě.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to be the one promoting beach clean-ups.

entries.example: 他用笑容遮掩心裡的緊張。
entries.examplePinyin: tā yòng xiào róng zhē yǎn xīn lǐ de jǐn zhāng.

entries.answer: 我會一直笑，遮掩我的緊張。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì yì zhí xiào, zhē yǎn wǒ de jǐn zhāng.
entries.answerEnglish: I keep smiling to cover up my nerves.

entries.example: 很多國家提供人道救援。
entries.examplePinyin: hěn duō guó jiā tí gōng rén dào jiù yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: Many countries provide humanitarian aid.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de rén dào jiù yuán zhòng yào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think humanitarian aid is important?
entries.answer: 很重要，人道救援可以幫助很多人。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn zhòng yào, rén dào jiù yuán kě yǐ bāng zhù hěn duō rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Very important. Humanitarian aid can help a lot of people.

entries.example: 她很有外交手腕，跟誰都處得好。
entries.examplePinyin: tā hěn yǒu wài jiāo shǒu wàn, gēn shéi dōu chǔ de hǎo.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de gōng zuò xū yào wài jiāo shǒu wàn ma?

entries.answer: 需要，跟客戶溝通時要有外交手腕。
entries.answerPinyin: xū yào, gēn kè hù gōu tōng shí yào yǒu wài jiāo shǒu wàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, you need diplomacy when dealing with clients.

entries.examplePinyin: huī chén fù zhuó zài chuāng hù shàng.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā shén me dì fāng róng yì fù zhuó huī chén?

entries.answer: 我家的電風扇最容易附著灰塵。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā de diàn fēng shàn zuì róng yì fù zhuó huī chén.

entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge cūn zi de rén dōu shǔ yú tóng yí gè zōng zú.

entries.answer: 比較少，我們國家的宗族觀念很淡。

entries.answerEnglish: Not much. The idea of clans is weak in my country.

entries.exampleEnglish: In history, this city went through a long siege.
entries.question: 圍城的時候，城裡的人最缺什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: wéi chéng de shí hòu, chéng lǐ de rén zuì quē shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: During a siege, what do the people in the city lack most?
entries.answer: 圍城的時候，城裡最缺食物和水。
entries.answerPinyin: wéi chéng de shí hòu, chéng lǐ zuì quē shí wù hé shuǐ.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā yǒu zì zhì de dì qū ma?

entries.answer: 有，我們國家有幾個自治的地區。

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān jiā guò shén me jiē mù huó dòng ma?

entries.examplePinyin: tái fēng lái zhī qián, yào zuò hǎo yù fáng cuò shī.

entries.examplePinyin: tái fēng pò jìn, dà jiā dōu zài zhǔn bèi.

entries.questionPinyin: jié zhǐ rì qí pò jìn shí, nǐ huì jǐn zhāng ma?

entries.answer: 會，截止日期迫近時我常常熬夜。

entries.example: 警察護送救護車到醫院。
entries.examplePinyin: jǐng chá hù sòng jiù hù chē dào yī yuàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The police escorted the ambulance to the hospital.
entries.question: 什麼人出門需要有人護送？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me rén chū mén xū yào yǒu rén hù sòng?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of people need an escort when they go out?
entries.answer: 總統出門需要警察護送。
entries.answerPinyin: zǒng tǒng chū mén xū yào jǐng chá hù sòng.

entries.example: 海邊的椰子樹在風中搖曳。
entries.examplePinyin: hǎi biān de yē zi shù zài fēng zhōng yáo yè.
entries.exampleEnglish: The palm trees by the sea sway in the wind.

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kàn shù zài fēng zhōng yáo yè ma?

entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ men háng yè de qián jǐng àn dàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think the outlook for your industry is bleak?
entries.answer: 不會，我覺得前景沒有那麼黯淡。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ jué de qián jǐng méi yǒu nà me àn dàn.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't think the outlook is that bleak.

entries.example: 現在下結論還過早。
entries.examplePinyin: xiàn zài xià jié lùn hái guò zǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's still too early to draw a conclusion.
entries.question: 你覺得現在買房子會過早嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de xiàn zài mǎi fáng zi huì guò zǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think it's too early for you to buy a home now?
entries.answer: 會，我覺得現在買房子還過早。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ jué de xiàn zài mǎi fáng zi hái guò zǎo.

entries.answer: 身體不適時，可以找空服員幫忙。
entries.answerPinyin: shēn tǐ bú shì shí, kě yǐ zhǎo kōng fú yuán bāng máng.
entries.answerEnglish: If you feel unwell, you can ask a flight attendant for help.

entries.example: 公司把兩個部門整併成一個。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng sī bǎ liǎng gè bù mén zhěng bìng chéng yí gè.
entries.exampleEnglish: The company merged two departments into one.
entries.question: 你的公司有整併過部門嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng sī yǒu zhěng bìng guò bù mén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has your company ever merged departments?
entries.answer: 有，去年我們公司整併了兩個部門。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, qù nián wǒ men gōng sī zhěng bìng le liǎng gè bù mén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, last year my company merged two departments.

entries.example: 他剛來台灣時，生活很艱辛。
entries.examplePinyin: tā gāng lái tái wān shí, shēng huó hěn jiān xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Life was hard for him when he first came to Taiwan.
entries.question: 你覺得在國外生活艱辛嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zài guó wài shēng huó jiān xīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you find life abroad hard?
entries.answer: 剛開始很艱辛，現在已經習慣了。
entries.answerPinyin: gāng kāi shǐ hěn jiān xīn, xiàn zài yǐ jīng xí guàn le.
entries.answerEnglish: It was hard at first, but I'm used to it now.

entries.example: 田邊有一條溝渠。
entries.examplePinyin: tián biān yǒu yì tiáo gōu qú.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a ditch beside the field.
entries.question: 下大雨時，你家附近的溝渠會淹水嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: xià dà yǔ shí, nǐ jiā fù jìn de gōu qú huì yān shuǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When it pours, do the ditches near your home flood?
entries.answer: 會，下大雨時溝渠的水常常滿出來。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, xià dà yǔ shí gōu qú de shuǐ cháng cháng mǎn chū lái.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when it pours the ditches often overflow.

entries.example: 心臟把血送到動脈。
entries.examplePinyin: xīn zàng bǎ xuè sòng dào dòng mài.
entries.exampleEnglish: The heart pumps blood into the arteries.
entries.question: 什麼食物對動脈不好？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shí wù duì dòng mài bù hǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: What foods are bad for the arteries?
entries.answer: 太油的食物對動脈不好。
entries.answerPinyin: tài yóu de shí wù duì dòng mài bù hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Oily food is bad for the arteries.

entries.example: 老舊的木門打開時好像在呻吟。
entries.examplePinyin: lǎo jiù de mù mén dǎ kāi shí hǎo xiàng zài shēn yín.
entries.exampleEnglish: The old wooden door seems to groan when it opens.
entries.question: 老房子的地板會發出呻吟聲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: lǎo fáng zi de dì bǎn huì fā chū shēn yín shēng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do the floors in old houses groan?
entries.answer: 會，踩上去的時候，地板像在呻吟。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, cǎi shàng qù de shí hòu, dì bǎn xiàng zài shēn yín.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when you step on them, the floorboards seem to groan.

entries.example: 他年紀不大，卻很憤世嫉俗。
entries.examplePinyin: tā nián jì bú dà, què hěn fèn shì jí sú.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's not old, but he's very cynical.
entries.question: 你覺得自己憤世嫉俗嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ fèn shì jí sú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're cynical?
entries.answer: 不會，我不是一個憤世嫉俗的人。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ bú shì yí gè fèn shì jí sú de rén.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I'm not a cynical person.

entries.example: 博物館介紹了那場大屠殺的歷史。
entries.examplePinyin: bó wù guǎn jiè shào le nà chǎng dà tú shā de lì shǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The museum presents the history of that massacre.
entries.question: 為什麼要記得大屠殺的歷史？
entries.questionPinyin: wèi shén me yào jì de dà tú shā de lì shǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Why should we remember the history of massacres?
entries.answer: 記得大屠殺的歷史，才能避免悲劇再發生。
entries.answerPinyin: jì de dà tú shā de lì shǐ, cái néng bì miǎn bēi jù zài fā shēng.
entries.answerEnglish: Remembering the history of massacres helps prevent such tragedies from happening again.

entries.example: 這家牛肉麵店在台南享有盛名。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā niú ròu miàn diàn zài tái nán xiǎng yǒu shèng míng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This beef noodle shop is renowned in Tainan.
entries.question: 你的家鄉有什麼享有盛名的東西？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de jiā xiāng yǒu shén me xiǎng yǒu shèng míng de dōng xī?
entries.questionEnglish: What is your hometown famous for?
entries.answer: 我家鄉的起司在全世界享有盛名。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā xiāng de qǐ sī zài quán shì jiè xiǎng yǒu shèng míng.
entries.answerEnglish: My hometown's cheese is famous all over the world.

entries.example: 他的回答模稜兩可，大家都聽不懂。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de huí dá mó léng liǎng kě, dà jiā dōu tīng bù dǒng.
entries.exampleEnglish: His answer was ambiguous, and nobody understood it.
entries.question: 你遇到模稜兩可的回答會怎麼辦？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yù dào mó léng liǎng kě de huí dá huì zěn me bàn?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when you get an ambiguous answer?
entries.answer: 我會再問清楚，不想要模稜兩可的答案。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì zài wèn qīng chǔ, bù xiǎng yào mó léng liǎng kě de dá àn.
entries.answerEnglish: I ask again to make it clear; I don't want an ambiguous answer.

entries.example: 公司暫扣了他這個月的獎金。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng sī zhàn kòu le tā zhè ge yuè de jiǎng jīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The company withheld his bonus this month.
entries.question: 你覺得公司可以隨便暫扣薪水嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de gōng sī kě yǐ suí biàn zhàn kòu xīn shuǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think a company can withhold pay as it likes?
entries.answer: 不行，公司不能隨便暫扣員工的薪水。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xíng, gōng sī bù néng suí biàn zhàn kòu yuán gōng de xīn shuǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: No, a company can't just withhold employees' pay.

entries.example: 這裡的水資源很稀缺。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè lǐ de shuǐ zī yuán hěn xī quē.
entries.exampleEnglish: Water resources here are scarce.
entries.question: 你覺得台北什麼東西比較稀缺？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái běi shén me dōng xī bǐ jiào xī quē?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is scarce in Taipei?
entries.answer: 我覺得台北的停車位很稀缺。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de tái běi de tíng chē wèi hěn xī quē.
entries.answerEnglish: I think parking spaces in Taipei are scarce.

entries.example: 政府公布了一條新的法令。
entries.examplePinyin: zhèng fǔ gōng bù le yì tiáo xīn de fǎ lìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The government announced a new decree.
entries.question: 你覺得哪條交通法令最重要？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǎ tiáo jiāo tōng fǎ lìng zuì zhòng yào?
entries.questionEnglish: Which traffic law do you think is most important?
entries.answer: 我覺得禮讓行人的法令最重要。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de lǐ ràng xíng rén de fǎ lìng zuì zhòng yào.
entries.answerEnglish: I think the law about yielding to pedestrians is most important.

entries.example: 軍隊把火砲運到了海邊。
entries.examplePinyin: jūn duì bǎ huǒ pào yùn dào le hǎi biān.
entries.exampleEnglish: The army moved the artillery to the coast.
entries.question: 你在博物館看過火砲嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài bó wù guǎn kàn guò huǒ pào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen artillery in a museum?
entries.answer: 看過，那門火砲非常大。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, nà mén huǒ pào fēi cháng dà.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, that cannon was huge.

entries.example: 這篇報告冗詞太多，要刪掉一些。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè piān bào gào rǒng cí tài duō, yào shān diào yì xiē.
entries.exampleEnglish: This report has too many redundant words; some should be cut.
entries.question: 你寫中文的時候會有冗詞嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiě zhōng wén de shí hòu huì yǒu rǒng cí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use redundant words when you write Chinese?
entries.answer: 會，我寫的中文常常有很多冗詞。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ xiě de zhōng wén cháng cháng yǒu hěn duō rǒng cí.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my Chinese writing often has a lot of redundant words.

entries.example: 兩國簽了新的雙邊協議。
entries.examplePinyin: liǎng guó qiān le xīn de shuāng biān xié yì.
entries.exampleEnglish: The two countries signed a new bilateral agreement.
entries.question: 你覺得雙邊貿易重要嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shuāng biān mào yì zhòng yào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think bilateral trade is important?
entries.answer: 重要，雙邊貿易對兩國都有好處。
entries.answerPinyin: zhòng yào, shuāng biān mào yì duì liǎng guó dōu yǒu hǎo chù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, bilateral trade benefits both countries.

entries.example: 這裡的老住戶面臨迫遷的問題。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè lǐ de lǎo zhù hù miàn lín pò qiān de wèn tí.
entries.exampleEnglish: The old residents here are facing forced eviction.
entries.question: 你聽過台灣的迫遷新聞嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tīng guò tái wān de pò qiān xīn wén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you heard news about forced evictions in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 聽過，有些老社區因為都更面臨迫遷。
entries.answerPinyin: tīng guò, yǒu xiē lǎo shè qū yīn wèi dū gēng miàn lín pò qiān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, some old neighborhoods face eviction because of urban renewal.

entries.example: 我用廚餘在陽台做堆肥。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ yòng chú yú zài yáng tái zuò duī féi.
entries.exampleEnglish: I make compost from kitchen scraps on my balcony.
