entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de bāo bāo lǐ yǒu shén me huì dīng dāng xiǎng?
entries.questionEnglish: What in your bag jingles?
entries.answer: 我的鑰匙圈走路時會叮噹響。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de yào shi quān zǒu lù shí huì dīng dāng xiǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: My key ring jingles when I walk.

entries.example: 這位國王被埋葬在金字塔裡。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè wèi guó wáng bèi mái zàng zài jīn zì tǎ lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: This king was buried in a pyramid.
entries.question: 古代的國王通常埋葬在哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: gǔ dài de guó wáng tōng cháng mái zàng zài nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where were ancient kings usually buried?
entries.answer: 古代的國王通常埋葬在很大的陵墓裡。
entries.answerPinyin: gǔ dài de guó wáng tōng cháng mái zàng zài hěn dà de líng mù lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Ancient kings were usually buried in huge tombs.

entries.example: 這部電影今晚在電視上播映。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng jīn wǎn zài diàn shì shàng bò yìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This movie is being shown on TV tonight.
entries.question: 你喜歡的節目什麼時候播映？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan de jié mù shén me shí hòu bò yìng?
entries.questionEnglish: When is your favorite show broadcast?
entries.answer: 我喜歡的節目每週五晚上播映。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan de jié mù měi zhōu wǔ wǎn shàng bò yìng.
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite show airs every Friday night.

entries.example: 這杯咖啡是十二盎司的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bēi kā fēi shì shí èr àng sī de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This coffee is a twelve-ounce cup.
entries.question: 你喝咖啡都買幾盎司的？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ hē kā fēi dōu mǎi jǐ àng sī de?
entries.questionEnglish: What size coffee, in ounces, do you usually buy?
entries.answer: 我都買十六盎司的大杯咖啡。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ dōu mǎi shí liù àng sī de dà bēi kā fēi.
entries.answerEnglish: I always buy a large sixteen-ounce coffee.

entries.example: 非法入境的人會被遣返。
entries.examplePinyin: fēi fǎ rù jìng de rén huì bèi qiǎn fǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: People who enter illegally are sent back.
entries.question: 非法入境的人通常會怎麼樣？
entries.questionPinyin: fēi fǎ rù jìng de rén tōng cháng huì zěn me yàng?
entries.questionEnglish: What usually happens to people who enter a country illegally?
entries.answer: 非法入境的人通常會被遣返回國。
entries.answerPinyin: fēi fǎ rù jìng de rén tōng cháng huì bèi qiǎn fǎn huí guó.
entries.answerEnglish: People who enter illegally are usually sent back to their home country.

entries.example: 那名嫌犯被引渡回台灣。
entries.examplePinyin: nà míng xián fàn bèi yǐn dù huí tái wān.
entries.exampleEnglish: The suspect was extradited back to Taiwan.
entries.question: 什麼樣的人會被引渡回國？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me yàng de rén huì bèi yǐn dù huí guó?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of people get extradited back to their country?
entries.answer: 在國外犯罪的人可能會被引渡回國。
entries.answerPinyin: zài guó wài fàn zuì de rén kě néng huì bèi yǐn dù huí guó.
entries.answerEnglish: People who commit crimes abroad may be extradited home.

entries.example: 動物園裡有一座很大的鳥舍。
entries.examplePinyin: dòng wù yuán lǐ yǒu yí zuò hěn dà de niǎo shè.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a huge aviary at the zoo.
entries.question: 你在動物園看過鳥舍嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài dòng wù yuán kàn guò niǎo shè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen an aviary at a zoo?
entries.answer: 看過，木柵動物園的鳥舍很大。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, mù zhà dòng wù yuán de niǎo shè hěn dà.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the aviary at Muzha Zoo is huge.

entries.example: 越南是一個開發中國家。
entries.examplePinyin: yuè nán shì yí gè kāi fā zhōng guó jiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: Vietnam is a developing country.
entries.question: 你去過哪些開發中國家？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò nǎ xiē kāi fā zhōng guó jiā?
entries.questionEnglish: Which developing countries have you been to?
entries.answer: 我去過印尼和柬埔寨，它們都是開發中國家。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ qù guò yìn ní hé jiǎn pǔ zhài, tā men dōu shì kāi fā zhōng guó jiā.
entries.answerEnglish: I've been to Indonesia and Cambodia; both are developing countries.

entries.example: 保險公司派了一位調查員來。
entries.examplePinyin: bǎo xiǎn gōng sī pài le yí wèi diào chá yuán lái.
entries.exampleEnglish: The insurance company sent an investigator.
entries.question: 你覺得調查員的工作有趣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de diào chá yuán de gōng zuò yǒu qù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think an investigator's job is interesting?
entries.answer: 有趣，調查員可以到處去找真相。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu qù, diào chá yuán kě yǐ dào chù qù zhǎo zhēn xiàng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, investigators get to go everywhere looking for the truth.

entries.example: 現在的經濟有很多不確定性。
entries.examplePinyin: xiàn zài de jīng jì yǒu hěn duō bú què dìng xìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a lot of uncertainty in the economy right now.
entries.question: 你怎麼面對工作上的不確定性？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zěn me miàn duì gōng zuò shàng de bú què dìng xìng?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you deal with uncertainty at work?
entries.answer: 我會多存一點錢，面對不確定性。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì duō cún yì diǎn qián, miàn duì bú què dìng xìng.
entries.answerEnglish: I save a bit more money to deal with uncertainty.

entries.example: 我們換了一家新的供應商。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men huàn le yì jiā xīn de gōng yìng shāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: We switched to a new supplier.
entries.question: 你的工作需要跟供應商聯絡嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng zuò xū yào gēn gōng yìng shāng lián luò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your job involve contacting suppliers?
entries.answer: 需要，我每天都要跟供應商聯絡。
entries.answerPinyin: xū yào, wǒ měi tiān dōu yào gēn gōng yìng shāng lián luò.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have to contact suppliers every day.

entries.example: 他是一位手機遊戲的開發者。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì yí wèi shǒu jī yóu xì de kāi fā zhě.
entries.exampleEnglish: He is a mobile game developer.
entries.question: 你想當APP開發者嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng dāng APP kāi fā zhě ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to be an app developer?
entries.answer: 想，我想當APP開發者，自己做遊戲。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng, wǒ xiǎng dāng APP kāi fā zhě, zì jǐ zuò yóu xì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to be an app developer and make my own games.

entries.example: 立法院負責立法。
entries.examplePinyin: lì fǎ yuàn fù zé lì fǎ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The Legislative Yuan is responsible for making laws.
entries.question: 你覺得政府應該立法保護動物嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zhèng fǔ yīng gāi lì fǎ bǎo hù dòng wù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think the government should pass laws to protect animals?
entries.answer: 應該，政府應該立法保護流浪動物。
entries.answerPinyin: yīng gāi, zhèng fǔ yīng gāi lì fǎ bǎo hù liú làng dòng wù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the government should pass laws to protect stray animals.

entries.example: 這些錢都是納稅人的錢。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè xiē qián dōu shì nà shuì rén de qián.
entries.exampleEnglish: This is all taxpayers' money.
entries.question: 在台灣工作，你也是納稅人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zài tái wān gōng zuò, nǐ yě shì nà shuì rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Working in Taiwan, are you a taxpayer too?
entries.answer: 是，我在台灣工作，也是納稅人。
entries.answerPinyin: shì, wǒ zài tái wān gōng zuò, yě shì nà shuì rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I work in Taiwan, so I'm a taxpayer too.

entries.example: 我表哥在陸軍當中士。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ biǎo gē zài lù jūn dāng zhōng shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: My cousin is a sergeant in the army.
entries.question: 你認識當過中士的人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ rèn shì dāng guò zhōng shì de rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know anyone who has been a sergeant?
entries.answer: 認識，我叔叔以前是陸軍中士。
entries.answerPinyin: rèn shì, wǒ shú shú yǐ qián shì lù jūn zhōng shì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my uncle used to be an army sergeant.

entries.example: 這間老房子是維多利亞式的建築。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiān lǎo fáng zi shì wéi duō lì yà shì de jiàn zhú.
entries.exampleEnglish: This old house is a Victorian-style building.
entries.question: 你喜歡維多利亞式的房子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan wéi duō lì yà shì de fáng zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like Victorian houses?
entries.answer: 喜歡，維多利亞式的房子看起來很優雅。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wéi duō lì yà shì de fáng zi kàn qǐ lái hěn yōu yǎ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, Victorian houses look very elegant.

entries.example: 股價下跌，他把手上的持股都賣了。
entries.examplePinyin: gǔ jià xià dié, tā bǎ shǒu shàng de chí gǔ dōu mài le.
entries.exampleEnglish: When the stock price fell, he sold all his shares.
entries.question: 你會常常看自己的持股嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì cháng cháng kàn zì jǐ de chí gǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you check your stock holdings often?
entries.answer: 會，我每天下班都會看一下我的持股。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi tiān xià bān dōu huì kàn yí xià wǒ de chí gǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I check my holdings every day after work.

entries.example: 這位律師是這筆基金的受託人。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè wèi lǜ shī shì zhè bǐ jī jīn de shòu tuō rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: This lawyer is the trustee of the fund.
entries.question: 你覺得受託人需要什麼特質？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shòu tuō rén xū yào shén me tè zhí?
entries.questionEnglish: What qualities do you think a trustee needs?
entries.answer: 受託人一定要誠實又可靠。
entries.answerPinyin: shòu tuō rén yí dìng yào chéng shí yòu kě kào.
entries.answerEnglish: A trustee must be honest and reliable.

entries.example: 我奶奶個性很豁達，什麼事都看得開。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ nǎi nai gè xìng hěn huò dá, shén me shì dōu kàn de kāi.
entries.exampleEnglish: My grandma is very philosophical; she takes everything in stride.
entries.question: 你覺得自己是個豁達的人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zì jǐ shì gè huò dá de rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're an easygoing person?
entries.answer: 我覺得我滿豁達的，很少為小事生氣。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de wǒ mǎn huò dá de, hěn shǎo wèi xiǎo shì shēng qì.
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm pretty easygoing; I rarely get upset over small things.

entries.exampleEnglish: He was a substitute today and didn't play.
entries.question: 你在球隊裡當過替補嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài qiú duì lǐ dāng guò tì bǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been a substitute on a team?
entries.answer: 當過，我以前常常當替補球員。
entries.answerPinyin: dāng guò, wǒ yǐ qián cháng cháng dāng tì bǔ qiú yuán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I used to be a substitute player a lot.

entries.pinyin: fǎ xī sī zhǔ yì zhě
entries.example: 這本書在講一個法西斯主義者的一生。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè běn shū zài jiǎng yí gè fǎ xī sī zhǔ yì zhě de yì shēng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This book tells the life story of a fascist.
entries.question: 歷史上有名的法西斯主義者是誰？
entries.questionPinyin: lì shǐ shàng yǒu míng de fǎ xī sī zhǔ yì zhě shì shéi?
entries.questionEnglish: Who is a famous fascist in history?
entries.answer: 墨索里尼是很有名的法西斯主義者。
entries.answerPinyin: mò suǒ lǐ ní shì hěn yǒu míng de fǎ xī sī zhǔ yì zhě.
entries.answerEnglish: Mussolini is a very well-known fascist.

entries.example: 這台貨車滿載著西瓜。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tái huò chē mǎn zài zhe xī guā.
entries.exampleEnglish: This truck is fully loaded with watermelons.
entries.question: 你逛夜市常常滿載而歸嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ guàng yè shì cháng cháng mǎn zài ér guī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often come home from night markets loaded with stuff?
entries.answer: 對，我每次去夜市都滿載而歸。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, wǒ měi cì qù yè shì dōu mǎn zài ér guī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I come home loaded with stuff every time I go to a night market.

entries.example: 因為下大雨，比賽要重賽。
entries.examplePinyin: yīn wèi xià dà yǔ, bǐ sài yào chóng sài.
entries.exampleEnglish: Because of the heavy rain, the game has to be replayed.
entries.question: 比賽什麼時候需要重賽？
entries.questionPinyin: bǐ sài shén me shí hòu xū yào chóng sài?
entries.questionEnglish: When does a game need to be replayed?
entries.answer: 天氣太差時，比賽可能要重賽。
entries.answerPinyin: tiān qì tài chà shí, bǐ sài kě néng yào chóng sài.
entries.answerEnglish: When the weather is too bad, a game may need to be replayed.

entries.example: 警察在路口取締違規停車。
entries.examplePinyin: jǐng chá zài lù kǒu qǔ dì wéi guī tíng chē.
entries.exampleEnglish: Police are cracking down on illegal parking at the intersection.
entries.question: 警察常常取締什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: jǐng chá cháng cháng qǔ dì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do the police often crack down on?
entries.answer: 警察常常取締酒駕和違規停車。
entries.answerPinyin: jǐng chá cháng cháng qǔ dì jiǔ jià hé wéi guī tíng chē.
entries.answerEnglish: The police often crack down on drunk driving and illegal parking.

entries.example: 這個架子不牢靠，不要放太重的東西。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge jià zi bù láo kào, bú yào fàng tài zhòng de dōng xī.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shelf isn't secure, so don't put heavy things on it.
entries.question: 你家有不牢靠的家具嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yǒu bù láo kào de jiā jù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any wobbly furniture at home?
entries.answer: 有，我房間的椅子有點不牢靠。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ fáng jiān de yǐ zi yǒu diǎn bù láo kào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the chair in my room is a bit wobbly.

entries.example: 最近很多年輕人開始聽黑膠。
entries.examplePinyin: zuì jìn hěn duō nián qīng rén kāi shǐ tīng hēi jiāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Lately a lot of young people have started listening to vinyl.
entries.question: 你喜歡黑膠的聲音嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan hēi jiāo de shēng yīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like the sound of vinyl?
entries.answer: 喜歡，黑膠的聲音很溫暖。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, hēi jiāo de shēng yīn hěn wēn nuǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, vinyl has a warm sound.

entries.example: 這塊餅乾是五角形的。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè kuài bǐng gān shì wǔ jiǎo xíng de.
entries.exampleEnglish: This cookie is pentagon-shaped.
entries.question: 你看過五角形的建築嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò wǔ jiǎo xíng de jiàn zhú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen a pentagon-shaped building?
entries.answer: 看過，美國的五角大廈就是五角形的。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, měi guó de wǔ jiǎo dà shà jiù shì wǔ jiǎo xíng de.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the Pentagon in the US is pentagon-shaped.

entries.example: 這個杯子是鍍金的，不是真的金子。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge bēi zi shì dù jīn de, bú shì zhēn de jīn zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: This cup is gold-plated, not real gold.
entries.question: 你有鍍金的飾品嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǒu dù jīn de shì pǐn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any gold-plated jewelry?
entries.answer: 有，我有一條鍍金的項鍊。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ yǒu yì tiáo dù jīn de xiàng liàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a gold-plated necklace.

entries.example: 這是外用藥，不能吃。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shì wài yòng yào, bù néng chī.
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a topical medicine; don't take it by mouth.
entries.question: 外用藥和口服藥有什麼不同？
entries.questionPinyin: wài yòng yào hé kǒu fú yào yǒu shén me bù tóng?
entries.questionEnglish: What's the difference between topical and oral medicine?
entries.answer: 外用藥是擦在皮膚上的。
entries.answerPinyin: wài yòng yào shì cā zài pí fū shàng de.
entries.answerEnglish: Topical medicine is applied to the skin.

entries.example: 這部電影的原聲帶很好聽。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng de yuán shēng dài hěn hǎo tīng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This movie's soundtrack is great.
entries.question: 你喜歡聽電影原聲帶嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan tīng diàn yǐng yuán shēng dài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like listening to movie soundtracks?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我工作時常聽電影原聲帶。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ gōng zuò shí cháng tīng diàn yǐng yuán shēng dài.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often listen to movie soundtracks while I work.

entries.example: 日圓貶值了，很多人去日本玩。
entries.examplePinyin: rì yuán biǎn zhí le, hěn duō rén qù rì běn wán.
entries.exampleEnglish: The yen has fallen, so lots of people are going to Japan.
entries.question: 台幣貶值時，你還會出國嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: tái bì biǎn zhí shí, nǐ hái huì chū guó ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When the NT dollar is weak, do you still travel abroad?
entries.answer: 比較不會，台幣貶值時出國比較貴。
entries.answerPinyin: bǐ jiào bú huì, tái bì biǎn zhí shí chū guó bǐ jiào guì.
entries.answerEnglish: Less likely. Traveling abroad is pricier when the NT dollar is weak.

entries.example: 很多電影都在講黑手黨的故事。
entries.examplePinyin: hěn duō diàn yǐng dōu zài jiǎng hēi shǒu dǎng de gù shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Lots of movies tell stories about the mafia.
entries.question: 黑手黨最早出現在哪個國家？
entries.questionPinyin: hēi shǒu dǎng zuì zǎo chū xiàn zài nǎ gè guó jiā?
entries.questionEnglish: In which country did the mafia first appear?
entries.answer: 黑手黨最早出現在義大利。
entries.answerPinyin: hēi shǒu dǎng zuì zǎo chū xiàn zài yì dà lì.
entries.answerEnglish: The mafia first appeared in Italy.

entries.example: 政府宣布內閣要改組。
entries.examplePinyin: zhèng fǔ xuān bù nèi gé yào gǎi zǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The government announced a cabinet reshuffle.
entries.question: 你的公司最近有改組嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de gōng sī zuì jìn yǒu gǎi zǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Has your company been reorganized recently?
entries.answer: 有，去年我們部門改組了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, qù nián wǒ men bù mén gǎi zǔ le.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our department was reorganized last year.

entries.example: 這支球隊這一季保持不敗。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhī qiú duì zhè yí jì bǎo chí bú bài.
entries.exampleEnglish: This team stayed unbeaten all season.
entries.question: 你覺得一支球隊能一直不敗嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de yì zhī qiú duì néng yì zhí bú bài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think a team can stay unbeaten forever?
entries.answer: 很難，沒有球隊能永遠不敗。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn nán, méi yǒu qiú duì néng yǒng yuǎn bú bài.
entries.answerEnglish: That's hard. No team can stay unbeaten forever.

entries.example: 他在球隊裡踢邊鋒，跑得很快。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài qiú duì lǐ tī biān fēng, pǎo de hěn kuài.
entries.exampleEnglish: He plays winger on the team and runs really fast.
entries.question: 踢足球時，你喜歡當邊鋒嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: tī zú qiú shí, nǐ xǐ huan dāng biān fēng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you play soccer, do you like playing winger?
entries.answer: 喜歡，當邊鋒可以一直跑來跑去。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, dāng biān fēng kě yǐ yì zhí pǎo lái pǎo qù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, as a winger you get to run around all the time.

entries.example: 這位打者今天打了兩支全壘打。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè wèi dǎ zhě jīn tiān dǎ le liǎng zhī quán lěi dǎ.
entries.exampleEnglish: This batter hit two home runs today.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪位棒球打者？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ wèi bàng qiú dǎ zhě?
entries.questionEnglish: Who's your favorite baseball batter?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡大谷翔平這位打者。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan dà gǔ xiáng píng zhè wèi dǎ zhě.
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite batter is Shohei Ohtani.

entries.example: 兩個國家已經交戰了很多年。
entries.examplePinyin: liǎng gè guó jiā yǐ jīng jiāo zhàn le hěn duō nián.
entries.exampleEnglish: The two countries have been at war for many years.
entries.question: 交戰的國家要怎麼停火？
entries.questionPinyin: jiāo zhàn de guó jiā yào zěn me tíng huǒ?
entries.questionEnglish: How can warring countries reach a ceasefire?
entries.answer: 交戰的國家可以坐下來談判。
entries.answerPinyin: jiāo zhàn de guó jiā kě yǐ zuò xià lái tán pàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Warring countries can sit down and negotiate.

entries.example: 垃圾放太久，裡面長了蛆。
entries.examplePinyin: lè sè fàng tài jiǔ, lǐ miàn zhǎng le qū.
entries.exampleEnglish: The garbage was left too long and got maggots.
entries.question: 怎麼做垃圾才不會長蛆？
entries.questionPinyin: zěn me zuò lè sè cái bú huì zhǎng qū?
entries.questionEnglish: What can you do so your garbage doesn't get maggots?
entries.answer: 垃圾要每天丟，才不會長蛆。
entries.answerPinyin: lè sè yào měi tiān diū, cái bú huì zhǎng qū.
entries.answerEnglish: Take out the trash every day so it doesn't get maggots.

entries.example: 他們贏了資格賽，可以參加世界盃。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men yíng le zī gé sài, kě yǐ cān jiā shì jiè bēi.
entries.exampleEnglish: They won the qualifier and can play in the World Cup.
entries.question: 你看過世界盃的資格賽嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò shì jiè bēi de zī gé sài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you watched a World Cup qualifier?
entries.answer: 看過，資格賽也很精彩。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, zī gé sài yě hěn jīng cǎi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the qualifiers are exciting too.

entries.example: 這個地區有一些分離主義者。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge dì qū yǒu yì xiē fēn lí zhǔ yì zhě.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are some separatists in this region.
entries.question: 分離主義者通常想要什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: fēn lí zhǔ yì zhě tōng cháng xiǎng yào shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do separatists usually want?
entries.answer: 分離主義者通常想要獨立。
entries.answerPinyin: fēn lí zhǔ yì zhě tōng cháng xiǎng yào dú lì.
entries.answerEnglish: Separatists usually want independence.

entries.example: 大雨讓很多遊客受困在山上。
entries.examplePinyin: dà yǔ ràng hěn duō yóu kè shòu kùn zài shān shàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The heavy rain left many tourists stranded in the mountains.
entries.question: 受困在電梯裡時應該怎麼做？
entries.questionPinyin: shòu kùn zài diàn tī lǐ shí yīng gāi zěn me zuò?
entries.questionEnglish: What should you do if you're trapped in an elevator?
entries.answer: 受困在電梯裡要按緊急按鈕。
entries.answerPinyin: shòu kùn zài diàn tī lǐ yào àn jǐn jí àn niǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: If you're trapped in an elevator, press the emergency button.

entries.example: 她每週去做一次心理治療。
entries.examplePinyin: tā měi zhōu qù zuò yí cì xīn lǐ zhì liáo.
entries.exampleEnglish: She goes to therapy once a week.
entries.question: 想做心理治療可以去哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: xiǎng zuò xīn lǐ zhì liáo kě yǐ qù nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Where can you go if you want psychotherapy?
entries.answer: 可以去醫院的身心科做心理治療。
entries.answerPinyin: kě yǐ qù yī yuàn de shēn xīn kē zuò xīn lǐ zhì liáo.
entries.answerEnglish: You can go to a hospital's psychiatry department for therapy.

entries.example: 杜拜的酋長非常有錢。
entries.examplePinyin: dù bài de qiú zhǎng fēi cháng yǒu qián.
entries.exampleEnglish: The sheikh of Dubai is extremely rich.
entries.question: 你在新聞上看過酋長嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài xīn wén shàng kàn guò qiú zhǎng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen a sheikh on the news?
entries.answer: 看過，新聞常報導中東的酋長。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, xīn wén cháng bào dǎo zhōng dōng de qiú zhǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the news often reports on Middle Eastern sheikhs.

entries.example: 小貓藏身在沙發下面。
entries.examplePinyin: xiǎo māo cáng shēn zài shā fā xià miàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The kitten is hiding under the sofa.
entries.question: 小時候玩捉迷藏，你喜歡藏身在哪裡？
entries.questionPinyin: xiǎo shí hòu wán zhuō mí cáng, nǐ xǐ huan cáng shēn zài nǎ lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: When you played hide-and-seek as a kid, where did you like to hide?
entries.answer: 我喜歡藏身在衣櫃裡。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xǐ huan cáng shēn zài yī guì lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I liked hiding in the wardrobe.

entries.example: 這家店專門賣二手黑膠唱片。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā diàn zhuān mén mài èr shǒu hēi jiāo chàng piàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop specializes in secondhand vinyl records.
entries.question: 你家裡有黑膠唱片嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā lǐ yǒu hēi jiāo chàng piàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any vinyl records at home?
entries.answer: 有，我有幾張爸爸以前買的黑膠唱片。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ yǒu jǐ zhāng bà ba yǐ qián mǎi de hēi jiāo chàng piàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a few records my dad bought years ago.

entries.example: 這家酒吧晚上會放雷鬼樂。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā jiǔ bā wǎn shàng huì fàng léi guǐ yuè.
entries.exampleEnglish: This bar plays reggae at night.
entries.question: 你喜歡聽雷鬼樂嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan tīng léi guǐ yuè ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like listening to reggae?
entries.answer: 喜歡，雷鬼樂聽起來很輕鬆。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, léi guǐ yuè tīng qǐ lái hěn qīng sōng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, reggae sounds really relaxing.

entries.example: 這部獨立電影在影展得了獎。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù dú lì diàn yǐng zài yǐng zhǎn dé le jiǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This indie film won an award at a film festival.
entries.question: 你喜歡看獨立電影嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kàn dú lì diàn yǐng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like watching indie films?
entries.answer: 喜歡，獨立電影的故事比較特別。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, dú lì diàn yǐng de gù shì bǐ jiào tè bié.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, indie films have more unusual stories.

entries.example: 他是這份工作無庸置疑的最佳人選。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì zhè fèn gōng zuò wú yōng zhì yí de zuì jiā rén xuǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He is undoubtedly the best person for this job.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼事是無庸置疑的？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me shì shì wú yōng zhì yí de?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is beyond doubt?
entries.answer: 健康最重要，這是無庸置疑的。
entries.answerPinyin: jiàn kāng zuì zhòng yào, zhè shì wú yōng zhì yí de.
entries.answerEnglish: Health matters most; that's beyond doubt.

entries.example: 這部電影在講中央情報局的故事。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng zài jiǎng zhōng yāng qíng bào jú de gù shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This movie is about the CIA.
entries.question: 你看過跟中央情報局有關的電影嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò gēn zhōng yāng qíng bào jú yǒu guān de diàn yǐng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen any movies about the CIA?
entries.answer: 看過，我很喜歡看中央情報局的間諜片。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ hěn xǐ huan kàn zhōng yāng qíng bào jú de jiàn dié piàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love spy movies about the CIA.

entries.example: 他是錫克教徒，每天都會戴頭巾。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì xí kè jiào tú, měi tiān dōu huì dài tóu jīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a Sikh and wears a turban every day.
entries.question: 你認識錫克教徒嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ rèn shì xí kè jiào tú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know any Sikhs?
entries.answer: 認識，我以前的同事是錫克教徒。
entries.answerPinyin: rèn shì, wǒ yǐ qián de tóng shì shì xí kè jiào tú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a former colleague of mine is a Sikh.

entries.example: 開店之前，成本計算一定要做好。
entries.examplePinyin: kāi diàn zhī qián, chéng běn jì suàn yí dìng yào zuò hǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: Before opening a shop, you have to get the costing right.
entries.question: 你覺得開店最難的是成本計算嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de kāi diàn zuì nán de shì chéng běn jì suàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think costing is the hardest part of opening a shop?
entries.answer: 對，成本計算錯了就會賠錢。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, chéng běn jì suàn cuò le jiù huì péi qián.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, if you get the costing wrong, you lose money.

entries.example: 一百盧布大概是多少台幣？
entries.examplePinyin: yì bǎi lú bù dà gài shì duō shǎo tái bì?
entries.exampleEnglish: About how many Taiwan dollars is a hundred roubles?
entries.question: 你用過盧布嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yòng guò lú bù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever used roubles?
entries.answer: 沒有，我從來沒用過盧布。
entries.answerPinyin: méi yǒu, wǒ cóng lái méi yòng guò lú bù.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I've never used roubles.

entries.example: 梵蒂岡是世界上最小的國家。
entries.examplePinyin: fàn dì gāng shì shì jiè shàng zuì xiǎo de guó jiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: The Vatican is the smallest country in the world.
entries.question: 你去過梵蒂岡嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò fàn dì gāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been to the Vatican?
entries.answer: 去過，我在梵蒂岡看了很多有名的畫。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, wǒ zài fàn dì gāng kàn le hěn duō yǒu míng de huà.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw lots of famous paintings in the Vatican.

entries.example: 聯邦調查局正在調查這個案子。
entries.examplePinyin: lián bāng diào chá jú zhèng zài diào chá zhè ge àn zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: The FBI is investigating this case.
entries.question: 你在哪部電影裡看過聯邦調查局？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài nǎ bù diàn yǐng lǐ kàn guò lián bāng diào chá jú?
entries.questionEnglish: In which movie have you seen the FBI?
entries.answer: 很多美國影集裡都有聯邦調查局。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn duō měi guó yǐng jí lǐ dōu yǒu lián bāng diào chá jú.
entries.answerEnglish: Lots of American TV series have the FBI in them.

entries.example: 我開車的時候常聽調頻電台。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ kāi chē de shí hòu cháng tīng tiáo pín diàn tái.
entries.exampleEnglish: I often listen to FM radio when I drive.
entries.question: 你平常會聽調頻電台嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ píng cháng huì tīng tiáo pín diàn tái ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you usually listen to FM radio?
entries.answer: 會，我早上會聽調頻的音樂電台。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ zǎo shàng huì tīng tiáo pín de yīn yuè diàn tái.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I listen to an FM music station in the mornings.

entries.example: 克里姆林宮在俄羅斯的莫斯科。
entries.examplePinyin: kè lǐ mǔ lín gōng zài é luó sī de mò sī kē.
entries.exampleEnglish: The Kremlin is in Moscow, Russia.
entries.question: 你在新聞上常聽到克里姆林宮嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài xīn wén shàng cháng tīng dào kè lǐ mǔ lín gōng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often hear about the Kremlin in the news?
entries.answer: 常聽到，國際新聞常提到克里姆林宮。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng tīng dào, guó jì xīn wén cháng tí dào kè lǐ mǔ lín gōng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, international news often mentions the Kremlin.

entries.pinyin: měi guó tài kōng zǒng shù
entries.example: 美國太空總署又發射了一顆衛星。
entries.examplePinyin: měi guó tài kōng zǒng shù yòu fā shè le yì kē wèi xīng.
entries.exampleEnglish: NASA has launched another satellite.
entries.question: 你小時候想去美國太空總署工作嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎo shí hòu xiǎng qù měi guó tài kōng zǒng shù gōng zuò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: As a child, did you want to work at NASA?
entries.answer: 想過，我以前夢想在美國太空總署當太空人。
entries.answerPinyin: xiǎng guò, wǒ yǐ qián mèng xiǎng zài měi guó tài kōng zǒng shù dāng tài kōng rén.
entries.answerEnglish: I did. I used to dream of being an astronaut at NASA.

entries.example: 他在黨內是有名的強硬派。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài dǎng nèi shì yǒu míng de qiáng yìng pài.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a well-known hardliner in the party.
entries.question: 你覺得談判的時候需要強硬派嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tán pàn de shí hòu xū yào qiáng yìng pài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think hardliners are needed in negotiations?
entries.answer: 有時候需要，強硬派可以替我們爭取更多。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu shí hòu xū yào, qiáng yìng pài kě yǐ tì wǒ men zhēng qǔ gèng duō.
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. Hardliners can win more for our side.

entries.example: 這間實驗室在做最前沿的研究。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiān shí yàn shì zài zuò zuì qián yán de yán jiù.
entries.exampleEnglish: This lab is doing cutting-edge research.
entries.question: 你對哪個前沿科技有興趣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì nǎ gè qián yán kē jì yǒu xìng qù?
entries.questionEnglish: Which cutting-edge technology interests you?
entries.answer: 我對人工智慧這個前沿領域很有興趣。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ duì rén gōng zhì huì zhè ge qián yán lǐng yù hěn yǒu xìng qù.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm very interested in the cutting-edge field of AI.

entries.example: 玩這個遊戲要先破壞敵方的塔。
entries.examplePinyin: wán zhè ge yóu xì yào xiān pò huài dí fāng de tǎ.
entries.exampleEnglish: In this game you have to destroy the enemy's towers first.
entries.question: 你玩線上遊戲時常被敵方打敗嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ wán xiàn shàng yóu xì shí cháng bèi dí fāng dǎ bài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often get beaten by the other side in online games?
entries.answer: 常常，敵方的玩家都比我厲害。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng cháng, dí fāng de wán jiā dōu bǐ wǒ lì hài.
entries.answerEnglish: Often. The players on the other side are all better than me.

entries.example: 她的歌聲很圓潤，聽起來很舒服。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de gē shēng hěn yuán rùn, tīng qǐ lái hěn shū fú.
entries.exampleEnglish: Her singing voice is full and mellow, really pleasant to listen to.
entries.question: 你喜歡哪位歌手圓潤的聲音？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan nǎ wèi gē shǒu yuán rùn de shēng yīn?
entries.questionEnglish: Which singer's mellow voice do you like?
entries.answer: 我很喜歡鄧麗君圓潤的聲音。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ hěn xǐ huan dèng lì jūn yuán rùn de shēng yīn.
entries.answerEnglish: I love Teresa Teng's mellow voice.

entries.example: 他聽到這個消息以後，顯得很惱怒。
entries.examplePinyin: tā tīng dào zhè ge xiāo xí yǐ hòu, xiǎn de hěn nǎo nù.
entries.exampleEnglish: He looked very irritated after hearing the news.
entries.question: 什麼事會讓你感到惱怒？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me shì huì ràng nǐ gǎn dào nǎo nù?
entries.questionEnglish: What makes you feel irritated?
entries.answer: 說話一直被打斷會讓我很惱怒。
entries.answerPinyin: shuō huà yì zhí bèi dǎ duàn huì ràng wǒ hěn nǎo nù.
entries.answerEnglish: Being interrupted all the time irritates me.

entries.example: 山上有一間荒廢很久的老房子。
entries.examplePinyin: shān shàng yǒu yì jiān huāng fèi hěn jiǔ de lǎo fáng zi.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's an old house up the mountain that has been abandoned for years.
entries.question: 你去過荒廢的地方探險嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ qù guò huāng fèi de dì fāng tàn xiǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever explored an abandoned place?
entries.answer: 去過，我去過一間荒廢的工廠。
entries.answerPinyin: qù guò, wǒ qù guò yì jiān huāng fèi de gōng chǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've explored an abandoned factory.

entries.example: 這個線上課程分成五個模組。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge xiàn shàng kè chéng fēn chéng wǔ gè mó zǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: This online course is divided into five modules.
entries.question: 你喜歡分成小模組的課程嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan fēn chéng xiǎo mó zǔ de kè chéng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like courses split into small modules?
entries.answer: 喜歡，小模組比較容易學完。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, xiǎo mó zǔ bǐ jiào róng yì xué wán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, small modules are easier to finish.

entries.example: 原告要求對方賠償十萬元。
entries.examplePinyin: yuán gào yāo qiú duì fāng péi cháng shí wàn yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: The plaintiff is asking for NT$100,000 in compensation.
entries.question: 打官司的時候，原告要準備什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: dǎ guān sī de shí hòu, yuán gào yào zhǔn bèi shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What does a plaintiff need to prepare for a lawsuit?
entries.answer: 原告要準備好證據和文件。
entries.answerPinyin: yuán gào yào zhǔn bèi hǎo zhèng jù hé wén jiàn.
entries.answerEnglish: The plaintiff needs to get evidence and documents ready.

entries.example: 這次地震救出了十幾位倖存者。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì dì zhèn jiù chū le shí jǐ wèi xìng cún zhě.
entries.exampleEnglish: More than ten survivors were rescued after this earthquake.
entries.question: 災難的倖存者可以去哪裡找幫助？
entries.questionPinyin: zāi nàn de xìng cún zhě kě yǐ qù nǎ lǐ zhǎo bāng zhù?
entries.questionEnglish: Where can disaster survivors go for help?
entries.answer: 倖存者可以找社工或心理師幫忙。
entries.answerPinyin: xìng cún zhě kě yǐ zhǎo shè gōng huò xīn lǐ shī bāng máng.
entries.answerEnglish: Survivors can get help from social workers or counselors.

entries.example: 這件外套很有功能性，可以防水又保暖。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn wài tào hěn yǒu gōng néng xìng, kě yǐ fáng shuǐ yòu bǎo nuǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This jacket is very functional: it's waterproof and warm.
entries.question: 買包包時，你重視好看還是功能性？
entries.questionPinyin: mǎi bāo bāo shí, nǐ zhòng shì hǎo kàn hái shì gōng néng xìng?
entries.questionEnglish: When you buy a bag, do you care more about looks or function?
entries.answer: 我比較重視功能性，要能裝很多東西。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào zhòng shì gōng néng xìng, yào néng zhuāng hěn duō dōng xī.
entries.answerEnglish: I care more about function. It has to hold a lot.

entries.example: 大家對這個問題的認知不一樣。
entries.examplePinyin: dà jiā duì zhè ge wèn tí de rèn zhī bù yí yàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: People see this issue differently.
entries.question: 來台灣以後，你對台灣的認知改變了嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: lái tái wān yǐ hòu, nǐ duì tái wān de rèn zhī gǎi biàn le ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Since you came to Taiwan, has your understanding of it changed?
entries.answer: 改變很多，我對台灣的認知更深了。
entries.answerPinyin: gǎi biàn hěn duō, wǒ duì tái wān de rèn zhī gèng shēn le.
entries.answerEnglish: A lot. My understanding of Taiwan is much deeper now.

entries.example: 這件事不在我們分局的管轄範圍。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn shì bú zài wǒ men fēn jú de guǎn xiá fàn wéi.
entries.exampleEnglish: This isn't within our precinct's jurisdiction.
entries.question: 你知道你家屬於哪個區公所的管轄範圍嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào nǐ jiā shǔ yú nǎ gè qū gōng suǒ de guǎn xiá fàn wéi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know which district office's jurisdiction your home falls under?
entries.answer: 知道，我家在大安區公所的管轄範圍。
entries.answerPinyin: zhī dào, wǒ jiā zài dà ān qū gōng suǒ de guǎn xiá fàn wéi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my home is under the Da'an District Office's jurisdiction.

entries.example: 他們坐在門廊上喝咖啡聊天。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men zuò zài mén láng shàng hē kā fēi liáo tiān.
entries.exampleEnglish: They sat on the porch drinking coffee and chatting.
entries.question: 你老家的房子有門廊嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ lǎo jiā de fáng zi yǒu mén láng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your family home have a porch?
entries.answer: 有，我老家有一個很大的門廊。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ lǎo jiā yǒu yí gè hěn dà de mén láng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our family home has a big porch.

entries.example: 小提琴的琴弓不小心被我弄斷了。
entries.examplePinyin: xiǎo tí qín de qín gōng bù xiǎo xīn bèi wǒ nòng duàn le.
entries.exampleEnglish: I accidentally broke the violin bow.
entries.question: 你會用琴弓拉小提琴嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì yòng qín gōng lā xiǎo tí qín ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you play the violin with a bow?
entries.answer: 不會，我連琴弓都拿不好。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ lián qín gōng dōu ná bù hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I can't even hold the bow properly.

entries.example: 這座城堡以前屬於一位公爵。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zuò chéng bǎo yǐ qián shǔ yú yí wèi gōng jué.
entries.exampleEnglish: This castle once belonged to a duke.
entries.question: 你的國家現在還有公爵嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de guó jiā xiàn zài hái yǒu gōng jué ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are there still dukes in your country?
entries.answer: 有，我們國家現在還有幾位公爵。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ men guó jiā xiàn zài hái yǒu jǐ wèi gōng jué.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are still a few dukes in my country.

entries.example: 你可以在設定裡調整這些參數。
entries.examplePinyin: nǐ kě yǐ zài shè dìng lǐ tiáo zhěng zhè xiē cān shù.
entries.exampleEnglish: You can adjust these parameters in the settings.
entries.question: 你拍照的時候會自己調參數嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pāi zhào de shí hòu huì zì jǐ tiáo cān shù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you adjust the settings yourself when you take photos?
entries.answer: 會，我常自己調相機的參數。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng zì jǐ tiáo xiàng jī de cān shù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often adjust the camera's settings myself.

entries.example: 老鷹是很厲害的掠食者。
entries.examplePinyin: lǎo yīng shì hěn lì hài de lüè shí zhě.
entries.exampleEnglish: Eagles are formidable predators.
entries.question: 你覺得哪種動物是最可怕的掠食者？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǎ zhǒng dòng wù shì zuì kě pà de lüè shí zhě?
entries.questionEnglish: Which animal do you think is the scariest predator?
entries.answer: 我覺得鱷魚是最可怕的掠食者。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de è yú shì zuì kě pà de lüè shí zhě.
entries.answerEnglish: I think crocodiles are the scariest predators.

entries.example: 很多宗教節日現在都變得很世俗。
entries.examplePinyin: hěn duō zōng jiào jié rì xiàn zài dōu biàn de hěn shì sú.
entries.exampleEnglish: Many religious holidays have become very secular.
entries.question: 你在乎世俗的眼光嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài hū shì sú de yǎn guāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you care what society thinks?
entries.answer: 不太在乎，我不想活在世俗的眼光裡。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài zài hū, wǒ bù xiǎng huó zài shì sú de yǎn guāng lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Not much. I don't want to live by what society thinks.

entries.example: 冬天流感的發生率比較高。
entries.examplePinyin: dōng tiān liú gǎn de fā shēng lǜ bǐ jiào gāo.
entries.exampleEnglish: The incidence of flu is higher in winter.
entries.question: 哪個季節感冒的發生率比較高？
entries.questionPinyin: nǎ gè jì jié gǎn mào de fā shēng lǜ bǐ jiào gāo?
entries.questionEnglish: Which season has a higher incidence of colds?
entries.answer: 冬天感冒的發生率比較高。
entries.answerPinyin: dōng tiān gǎn mào de fā shēng lǜ bǐ jiào gāo.
entries.answerEnglish: Colds are more common in winter.

entries.example: 這個說法沒有實證的支持。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge shuō fǎ méi yǒu shí zhèng de zhī chí.
entries.exampleEnglish: This claim has no empirical support.
entries.question: 你相信沒有實證的偏方嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiāng xìn méi yǒu shí zhèng de piān fāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you believe in folk remedies with no empirical evidence?
entries.answer: 不相信，我只相信有實證的方法。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xiāng xìn, wǒ zhǐ xiāng xìn yǒu shí zhèng de fāng fǎ.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I only trust methods backed by evidence.

entries.example: 這個問題可以用矩陣來計算。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge wèn tí kě yǐ yòng jǔ zhèn lái jì suàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This problem can be worked out with a matrix.
entries.question: 你以前學過矩陣嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yǐ qián xué guò jǔ zhèn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever studied matrices?
entries.answer: 學過，可是我已經忘了矩陣怎麼算。
entries.answerPinyin: xué guò, kě shì wǒ yǐ jīng wàng le jǔ zhèn zěn me suàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but I've forgotten how to work with matrices.

entries.example: 這座老廟體現了台灣的傳統文化。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zuò lǎo miào tǐ xiàn le tái wān de chuán tǒng wén huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: This old temple embodies Taiwan's traditional culture.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼最能體現台灣文化？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me zuì néng tǐ xiàn tái wān wén huà?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think best embodies Taiwanese culture?
entries.answer: 我覺得夜市最能體現台灣文化。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de yè shì zuì néng tǐ xiàn tái wān wén huà.
entries.answerEnglish: I think night markets best embody Taiwanese culture.

entries.example: 加一點水，調整醬汁的濃稠度。
entries.examplePinyin: jiā yì diǎn shuǐ, tiáo zhěng jiàng zhī de nóng chóu dù.
entries.exampleEnglish: Add a little water to adjust the consistency of the sauce.
entries.question: 你喜歡濃稠度高的粥嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan nóng chóu dù gāo de zhōu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like thick congee?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我喜歡濃稠度高一點的粥。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ xǐ huan nóng chóu dù gāo yì diǎn de zhōu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like my congee a bit thicker.

entries.example: 審計員下週會來公司查帳。
entries.examplePinyin: shěn jì yuán xià zhōu huì lái gōng sī chá zhàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The auditors are coming to check the books next week.
entries.question: 你覺得審計員的工作辛苦嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shěn jì yuán de gōng zuò xīn kǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think an auditor's job is hard?
entries.answer: 很辛苦，審計員常常要加班。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn xīn kǔ, shěn jì yuán cháng cháng yào jiā bān.
entries.answerEnglish: Very. Auditors often have to work overtime.

entries.example: 馬偕是台灣很有名的傳教士。
entries.examplePinyin: mǎ xié shì tái wān hěn yǒu míng de chuán jiào shì.

entries.answerPinyin: shǒu jī shì wǒ shēng huó zhōng bù kě huò quē de dōng xī.

entries.example: 這間小套房的空間配置很好。
