entries.examplePinyin: guō zi lǐ hái yǒu yì xiē cán liú wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's still some residue in the pot.
entries.question: 你洗碗後會檢查殘留物嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ wǎn hòu huì jiǎn chá cán liú wù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you check for residue after washing the dishes?
entries.answer: 會，我會看碗上有沒有殘留物。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì kàn wǎn shàng yǒu méi yǒu cán liú wù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I check whether there's any residue on the bowls.

entries.example: 他在遺囑裡把房子留給女兒。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài yí zhǔ lǐ bǎ fáng zi liú gěi nǚ ér.
entries.exampleEnglish: In his will he left the house to his daughter.
entries.question: 想寫遺囑可以找誰幫忙？
entries.questionPinyin: xiǎng xiě yí zhǔ kě yǐ zhǎo shéi bāng máng?
entries.questionEnglish: Who can help you write a will?
entries.answer: 可以找律師幫忙寫遺囑。
entries.answerPinyin: kě yǐ zhǎo lǜ shī bāng máng xiě yí zhǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: You can ask a lawyer to help you write a will.

entries.example: 這部電影是寫實主義的風格。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng shì xiě shí zhǔ yì de fēng gé.
entries.exampleEnglish: This film is in a realist style.
entries.question: 你喜歡寫實主義的畫嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan xiě shí zhǔ yì de huà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like realist paintings?
entries.answer: 喜歡，寫實主義的畫很像照片。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, xiě shí zhǔ yì de huà hěn xiàng zhào piàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, realist paintings look like photographs.

entries.example: 他的性情很溫和。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de xìng qíng hěn wēn hé.
entries.exampleEnglish: He has a very gentle temperament.
entries.question: 你的性情像爸爸還是媽媽？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de xìng qíng xiàng bà ba hái shì mā ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is your temperament more like your dad's or your mom's?
entries.answer: 我的性情比較像媽媽。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de xìng qíng bǐ jiào xiàng mā ma.
entries.answerEnglish: My temperament is more like my mom's.

entries.example: 這是一個很有名的悖論。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè shì yí gè hěn yǒu míng de bèi lùn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a very famous paradox.
entries.question: 你聽過什麼有趣的悖論嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tīng guò shén me yǒu qù de bèi lùn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you heard of any interesting paradoxes?
entries.answer: 聽過，「先有雞還是先有蛋」就是一個悖論。
entries.answerPinyin: tīng guò, “xiān yǒu jī hái shì xiān yǒu dàn” jiù shì yí gè bèi lùn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, "which came first, the chicken or the egg" is a paradox.

entries.example: 貓從高處跳下來都能四腳著地。
entries.examplePinyin: māo cóng gāo chù tiào xià lái dōu néng sì jiǎo zhuó dì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Cats always land on their feet when they jump down from a height.
entries.question: 你跑步時是腳跟先著地嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pǎo bù shí shì jiǎo gēn xiān zhuó dì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you run, does your heel hit the ground first?
entries.answer: 不是，我跑步是腳尖先著地。
entries.answerPinyin: bú shì, wǒ pǎo bù shì jiǎo jiān xiān zhuó dì.
entries.answerEnglish: No, when I run my toes land first.

entries.example: 很多城市都有塑膠袋禁令。
entries.examplePinyin: hěn duō chéng shì dōu yǒu sù jiāo dài jìn lìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: Many cities have a plastic bag ban.
entries.question: 你覺得哪一項禁令最有用？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǎ yí xiàng jìn lìng zuì yǒu yòng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which ban do you think is the most useful?
entries.answer: 我覺得室內的禁菸禁令最有用。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de shì nèi de jìn yān jìn lìng zuì yǒu yòng.
entries.answerEnglish: I think the indoor smoking ban is the most useful.

entries.example: 這座山以前是採石場。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zuò shān yǐ qián shì cǎi shí chǎng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This mountain used to be a quarry.
entries.question: 你覺得採石場會破壞環境嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de cǎi shí chǎng huì pò huài huán jìng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think quarries damage the environment?
entries.answer: 會，採石場會破壞山的樣子。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, cǎi shí chǎng huì pò huài shān de yàng zi.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, quarries spoil the shape of the mountains.

entries.example: 農夫開著曳引機去田裡。
entries.examplePinyin: nóng fū kāi zhe yè yǐn jī qù tián lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The farmer drove the tractor to the field.
entries.question: 你開過曳引機嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kāi guò yè yǐn jī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever driven a tractor?
entries.answer: 沒開過，可是我坐過曳引機。
entries.answerPinyin: méi kāi guò, kě shì wǒ zuò guò yè yǐn jī.
entries.answerEnglish: No, but I've ridden on a tractor.

entries.example: 牧師每個星期天都會佈道。
entries.examplePinyin: mù shī měi gè xīng qí tiān dōu huì bù dào.
entries.exampleEnglish: The pastor preaches every Sunday.
entries.question: 你聽過教會的佈道嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tīng guò jiào huì de bù dào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever heard a sermon at a church?
entries.answer: 聽過，我跟朋友去聽過佈道。
entries.answerPinyin: tīng guò, wǒ gēn péng yǒu qù tīng guò bù dào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I went to hear a sermon with a friend.

entries.example: 他每天都精力充沛。
entries.examplePinyin: tā měi tiān dōu jīng lì chōng pèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's full of energy every day.
entries.question: 你早上精力充沛嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zǎo shàng jīng lì chōng pèi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Are you full of energy in the morning?
entries.answer: 喝了咖啡以後，我就精力充沛。
entries.answerPinyin: hē le kā fēi yǐ hòu, wǒ jiù jīng lì chōng pèi.
entries.answerEnglish: Once I've had coffee, I'm full of energy.

entries.example: 這段城牆是古代城市的殘餘。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè duàn chéng qiáng shì gǔ dài chéng shì de cán yú.
entries.exampleEnglish: This stretch of wall is a remnant of the ancient city.
entries.question: 你看過古城牆的殘餘嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò gǔ chéng qiáng de cán yú ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen the remains of an old city wall?
entries.answer: 看過，台南還有古城牆的殘餘。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, tái nán hái yǒu gǔ chéng qiáng de cán yú.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are still remnants of the old city wall in Tainan.

entries.example: 他們把紅酒放在地窖裡。
entries.examplePinyin: tā men bǎ hóng jiǔ fàng zài dì jiào lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: They keep the red wine in the cellar.
entries.question: 你家鄉的房子有地窖嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā xiāng de fáng zi yǒu dì jiào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do houses in your hometown have cellars?
entries.answer: 有，很多老房子都有地窖。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, hěn duō lǎo fáng zi dōu yǒu dì jiào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, many old houses have cellars.

entries.example: 士兵要效忠國家。
entries.examplePinyin: shì bīng yào xiào zhōng guó jiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: Soldiers must be loyal to their country.
entries.question: 你覺得員工應該效忠公司嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de yuán gōng yīng gāi xiào zhōng gōng sī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think employees should be loyal to their company?
entries.answer: 不一定，我覺得不用一直效忠公司。
entries.answerPinyin: bù yí dìng, wǒ jué de bú yòng yì zhí xiào zhōng gōng sī.
entries.answerEnglish: Not necessarily; I don't think you have to be loyal to a company forever.

entries.example: 這篇文章有很多引文。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè piān wén zhāng yǒu hěn duō yǐn wén.
entries.exampleEnglish: This article has a lot of quotations.
entries.question: 你寫報告時會用引文嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiě bào gào shí huì yòng yǐn wén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use quotations when you write reports?
entries.answer: 會，我會加一些專家的引文。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì jiā yì xiē zhuān jiā de yǐn wén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I add some quotes from experts.

entries.example: 農場裡堆了很多乾草。
entries.examplePinyin: nóng chǎng lǐ duī le hěn duō gān cǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a lot of hay piled up on the farm.
entries.question: 你在牧場看過乾草嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài mù chǎng kàn guò gān cǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen hay on a ranch?
entries.answer: 看過，牛很愛吃乾草。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, niú hěn ài chī gān cǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, cows love eating hay.

entries.example: 兩個國家簽下了盟約。
entries.examplePinyin: liǎng gè guó jiā qiān xià le méng yuē.
entries.exampleEnglish: The two countries signed a pact.
entries.question: 你覺得盟約一定要遵守嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de méng yuē yí dìng yào zūn shǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think a pact must always be honoured?
entries.answer: 對，簽了盟約就要遵守。
entries.answerPinyin: duì, qiān le méng yuē jiù yào zūn shǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, once you sign a pact you must keep it.

entries.example: 下雨後山路很泥濘。
entries.examplePinyin: xià yǔ hòu shān lù hěn ní nìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The mountain trail is muddy after the rain.
entries.question: 你喜歡在泥濘的路上跑步嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zài ní nìng de lù shang pǎo bù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like running on muddy paths?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，泥濘的路很容易滑倒。
entries.answerPinyin: bù xǐ huan, ní nìng de lù hěn róng yì huá dǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: No, it's easy to slip on muddy paths.

entries.example: 這個字有好幾種變體。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge zì yǒu hǎo jǐ zhǒng biàn tǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: This character has several variant forms.
entries.question: 你知道哪個漢字的變體？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào nǎ gè hàn zì de biàn tǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: Which Chinese character's variant do you know?
entries.answer: 我知道「台」是「臺」的變體。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhī dào “tái” shì “tái” de biàn tǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I know the simple form of "tai" is a variant of the full form.

entries.example: 他抹去臉上的眼淚。
entries.examplePinyin: tā mǒ qù liǎn shàng de yǎn lèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: He wiped the tears from his face.
entries.question: 你會用手機抹去照片裡的路人嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì yòng shǒu jī mǒ qù zhào piàn lǐ de lù rén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use your phone to erase strangers from photos?
entries.answer: 會，我常用手機抹去照片裡的路人。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ cháng yòng shǒu jī mǒ qù zhào piàn lǐ de lù rén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often erase passers-by from photos on my phone.

entries.example: 這份報告用的是定量研究。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè fèn bào gào yòng de shì dìng liàng yán jiù.
entries.exampleEnglish: This report uses quantitative research.
entries.question: 你覺得定量研究比較可靠嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de dìng liàng yán jiù bǐ jiào kě kào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think quantitative research is more reliable?
entries.answer: 我覺得定量研究比較客觀。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de dìng liàng yán jiù bǐ jiào kè guān.
entries.answerEnglish: I think quantitative research is more objective.

entries.example: 偵察員先到前面去看路。
entries.examplePinyin: zhēn chá yuán xiān dào qián miàn qù kàn lù.
entries.exampleEnglish: The scout went ahead to check the way.
entries.question: 你覺得偵察員的工作危險嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de zhēn chá yuán de gōng zuò wéi xiǎn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think a scout's job is dangerous?
entries.answer: 很危險，偵察員常要走在最前面。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn wéi xiǎn, zhēn chá yuán cháng yào zǒu zài zuì qián miàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Very; scouts often have to go out in front.

entries.example: 時間很緊迫，我們快走吧。
entries.examplePinyin: shí jiān hěn jǐn pò, wǒ men kuài zǒu ba.
entries.exampleEnglish: Time is tight, so let's get going.
entries.question: 你最近工作的時間緊迫嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì jìn gōng zuò de shí jiān jǐn pò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have your work deadlines been tight lately?
entries.answer: 很緊迫，下週就要交報告了。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn jǐn pò, xià zhōu jiù yào jiāo bào gào le.
entries.answerEnglish: Very tight; my report is due next week.

entries.example: 捐血可以捐全血或血漿。
entries.examplePinyin: juān xiě kě yǐ juān quán xiě huò xiě jiāng.
entries.exampleEnglish: When you give blood you can donate whole blood or plasma.
entries.question: 在台灣哪裡可以捐血漿？
entries.questionPinyin: zài tái wān nǎ lǐ kě yǐ juān xiě jiāng?
entries.questionEnglish: Where can you donate plasma in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 捐血中心可以捐血漿。
entries.answerPinyin: juān xiě zhōng xīn kě yǐ juān xiě jiāng.
entries.answerEnglish: You can donate plasma at a blood donation centre.

entries.example: 她在大學研究生態學。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zài dà xué yán jiù shēng tài xué.
entries.exampleEnglish: She does research in ecology at a university.
entries.question: 你覺得生態學重要嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shēng tài xué zhòng yào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think ecology is important?
entries.answer: 重要，生態學可以幫我們保護自然。
entries.answerPinyin: zhòng yào, shēng tài xué kě yǐ bāng wǒ men bǎo hù zì rán.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, ecology helps us protect nature.

entries.example: 看起來平靜的海裡暗藏危險。
entries.examplePinyin: kàn qǐ lái píng jìng de hǎi lǐ àn cáng wéi xiǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Danger lurks in the calm-looking sea.
entries.question: 你覺得網路購物暗藏什麼風險？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de wǎng lù gòu wù àn cáng shén me fēng xiǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: What risks do you think lurk in online shopping?
entries.answer: 網路購物可能暗藏詐騙的風險。
entries.answerPinyin: wǎng lù gòu wù kě néng àn cáng zhà piàn de fēng xiǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: Online shopping may hide the risk of scams.

entries.example: 牆上的壁龕放了一尊佛像。
entries.examplePinyin: qiáng shàng de bì kān fàng le yì zūn fó xiàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: A Buddha statue sits in the niche in the wall.
entries.question: 你家牆上有壁龕嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā qiáng shàng yǒu bì kān ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a niche in a wall of your home?
entries.answer: 有，我家客廳有一個小壁龕。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiā kè tīng yǒu yí gè xiǎo bì kān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a small niche in my living room.

entries.example: 這座工廠在精煉石油。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zuò gōng chǎng zài jīng liàn shí yóu.
entries.exampleEnglish: This plant refines oil.
entries.question: 你覺得精煉過的糖健康嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de jīng liàn guò de táng jiàn kāng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think refined sugar is healthy?
entries.answer: 不健康，精煉過的糖不要吃太多。
entries.answerPinyin: bú jiàn kāng, jīng liàn guò de táng bú yào chī tài duō.
entries.answerEnglish: No, you shouldn't eat too much refined sugar.

entries.example: 颱風過後，路上有一顆巨石。
entries.examplePinyin: tái fēng guò hòu, lù shang yǒu yì kē jù shí.
entries.exampleEnglish: After the typhoon, there was a boulder on the road.
entries.question: 你在海邊看過巨石嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài hǎi biān kàn guò jù shí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen boulders on the coast?
entries.answer: 看過，野柳有很多奇怪的巨石。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, yě liǔ yǒu hěn duō qí guài de jù shí.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, Yehliu has lots of strange boulders.

entries.example: 主管用問題引出大家的想法。
entries.examplePinyin: zhǔ guǎn yòng wèn tí yǐn chū dà jiā de xiǎng fǎ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The manager used questions to draw out everyone's ideas.
entries.question: 開會時，你會怎麼引出別人的意見？
entries.questionPinyin: kāi huì shí, nǐ huì zěn me yǐn chū bié rén de yì jiàn?
entries.questionEnglish: In meetings, how do you draw out other people's opinions?
entries.answer: 我會先問問題，引出大家的意見。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì xiān wèn wèn tí, yǐn chū dà jiā de yì jiàn.
entries.answerEnglish: I ask questions first to draw out everyone's views.

entries.example: 門和地板之間有一點間隙。
entries.examplePinyin: mén hé dì bǎn zhī jiān yǒu yì diǎn jiàn xì.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a small gap between the door and the floor.
entries.question: 你家的門下面有間隙嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā de mén xià miàn yǒu jiàn xì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a gap under your door at home?
entries.answer: 有，蟲會從門下的間隙爬進來。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, chóng huì cóng mén xià de jiàn xì pá jìn lái.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, bugs crawl in through the gap under the door.

entries.example: 以前的溫度計裡有水銀。
entries.examplePinyin: yǐ qián de wēn dù jì lǐ yǒu shuǐ yín.
entries.exampleEnglish: Thermometers used to contain mercury.
entries.question: 你家還有水銀溫度計嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā hái yǒu shuǐ yín wēn dù jì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you still have a mercury thermometer at home?
entries.answer: 沒有，我家的溫度計沒有水銀。
entries.answerPinyin: méi yǒu, wǒ jiā de wēn dù jì méi yǒu shuǐ yín.
entries.answerEnglish: No, my thermometer doesn't have mercury.

entries.example: 左邊的大腦半球控制右手。
entries.examplePinyin: zuǒ biān de dà nǎo bàn qiú kòng zhì yòu shǒu.
entries.exampleEnglish: The left hemisphere of the brain controls the right hand.
entries.question: 你知道哪個大腦半球負責語言嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào nǎ gè dà nǎo bàn qiú fù zé yǔ yán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know which hemisphere of the brain handles language?
entries.answer: 我聽說左邊的大腦半球負責語言。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ tīng shuō zuǒ biān de dà nǎo bàn qiú fù zé yǔ yán.
entries.answerEnglish: I've heard the left hemisphere handles language.

entries.example: 謝謝你們熱情的款待。
entries.examplePinyin: xiè xiè nǐ men rè qíng de kuǎn dài.
entries.exampleEnglish: Thank you for your warm hospitality.
entries.question: 你會怎麼款待來家裡的朋友？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì zěn me kuǎn dài lái jiā lǐ de péng yǒu?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you treat friends who come to your home?
entries.answer: 我會煮一桌好菜款待朋友。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì zhǔ yì zhuō hǎo cài kuǎn dài péng yǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: I cook a big meal for my friends.

entries.english: so far; to date; up to now
entries.example: 這間店開業迄今已經五十年。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiān diàn kāi yè qì jīn yǐ jīng wǔ shí nián.
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop has been open for fifty years to date.
entries.question: 你來台灣迄今多久了？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ lái tái wān qì jīn duō jiǔ le?
entries.questionEnglish: How long have you been in Taiwan so far?
entries.answer: 我來台灣迄今已經三年了。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ lái tái wān qì jīn yǐ jīng sān nián le.
entries.answerEnglish: I've been in Taiwan for three years so far.

entries.example: 這幅畫只是仿製品。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè fú huà zhǐ shì fǎng zhì pǐn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This painting is only a replica.
entries.question: 你會買名牌的仿製品嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ huì mǎi míng pái de fǎng zhì pǐn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Would you buy imitations of designer brands?
entries.answer: 不會，我不買仿製品。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ bù mǎi fǎng zhì pǐn.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't buy imitations.

entries.example: 我喜歡宜蘭的田園風景。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ xǐ huan yí lán de tián yuán fēng jǐng.
entries.exampleEnglish: I love Yilan's pastoral scenery.
entries.question: 你喜歡田園生活還是城市生活？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan tián yuán shēng huó hái shì chéng shì shēng huó?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer country life or city life?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡田園生活。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan tián yuán shēng huó.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer country life.

entries.example: 她的穿著很男性化。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de chuān zhuó hěn nán xìng huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: She dresses in a very masculine way.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼顏色比較男性化？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me yán sè bǐ jiào nán xìng huà?
entries.questionEnglish: Which colours do you think are more masculine?
entries.answer: 我覺得深藍色比較男性化。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de shēn lán sè bǐ jiào nán xìng huà.
entries.answerEnglish: I think dark blue is more masculine.

entries.english: elusive; unpredictable; hard to pin down
entries.example: 台北春天的天氣難以捉摸。
entries.examplePinyin: tái běi chūn tiān de tiān qì nán yǐ zhuō mō.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taipei's spring weather is unpredictable.
entries.question: 你覺得誰的個性難以捉摸？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shéi de gè xìng nán yǐ zhuō mō?
entries.questionEnglish: Whose personality do you find hard to read?
entries.answer: 我覺得我的老闆難以捉摸。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de wǒ de lǎo bǎn nán yǐ zhuō mō.
entries.answerEnglish: I find my boss hard to read.

entries.example: 結果跟我預想的不一樣。
entries.examplePinyin: jié guǒ gēn wǒ yù xiǎng de bù yí yàng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The result was different from what I'd envisioned.
entries.question: 你來台灣前，預想的生活是怎樣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ lái tái wān qián, yù xiǎng de shēng huó shì zěn yàng?
entries.questionEnglish: Before coming to Taiwan, what did you envision life here would be like?
entries.answer: 我預想的生活比現在更忙。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ yù xiǎng de shēng huó bǐ xiàn zài gèng máng.
entries.answerEnglish: I imagined life would be busier than it is.

entries.example: 塑膠是一種很常見的聚合物。
entries.examplePinyin: sù jiāo shì yì zhǒng hěn cháng jiàn de jù hé wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: Plastic is a very common polymer.
entries.question: 你知道生活中有哪些東西是聚合物嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào shēng huó zhōng yǒu nǎ xiē dōng xī shì jù hé wù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know which everyday things are polymers?
entries.answer: 塑膠袋和尼龍衣服都是聚合物做的。
entries.answerPinyin: sù jiāo dài hé ní lóng yī fu dōu shì jù hé wù zuò de.
entries.answerEnglish: Plastic bags and nylon clothes are both made of polymers.

entries.example: 法官判他緩刑兩年。
entries.examplePinyin: fǎ guān pàn tā huǎn xíng liǎng nián.
entries.exampleEnglish: The judge gave him two years' probation.
entries.question: 法官在什麼情況下可能給緩刑？
entries.questionPinyin: fǎ guān zài shén me qíng kuàng xià kě néng gěi huǎn xíng?
entries.questionEnglish: In what situations might a judge give probation?
entries.answer: 罪比較輕的時候，法官可能會給緩刑。
entries.answerPinyin: zuì bǐ jiào qīng de shí hòu, fǎ guān kě néng huì gěi huǎn xíng.
entries.answerEnglish: When the offense is minor, a judge may give probation.

entries.example: 金門有很多花崗岩。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn mén yǒu hěn duō huā gǎng yán.
entries.exampleEnglish: There is a lot of granite in Kinmen.
entries.question: 你家裡有用花崗岩做的東西嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā lǐ yǒu yòng huā gǎng yán zuò de dōng xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is there anything made of granite in your home?
entries.answer: 有，我家廚房的檯面是花崗岩做的。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiā chú fáng de tái miàn shì huā gǎng yán zuò de.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my kitchen countertop is made of granite.

entries.example: 智慧型手機問世以後，生活改變了很多。
entries.examplePinyin: zhì huì xíng shǒu jī wèn shì yǐ hòu, shēng huó gǎi biàn le hěn duō.
entries.exampleEnglish: Life changed a lot after the smartphone came out.
entries.question: 你覺得哪個產品問世後改變了你的生活？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǎ gè chǎn pǐn wèn shì hòu gǎi biàn le nǐ de shēng huó?
entries.questionEnglish: What product do you think changed your life when it came out?
entries.answer: 外送平台問世以後，我就很少自己煮飯了。
entries.answerPinyin: wài sòng píng tái wèn shì yǐ hòu, wǒ jiù hěn shǎo zì jǐ zhǔ fàn le.
entries.answerEnglish: Since delivery apps came out, I rarely cook for myself.

entries.example: 廟裡掛著很多老牌匾。
entries.examplePinyin: miào lǐ guà zhe hěn duō lǎo pái biǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Lots of old plaques hang in the temple.
entries.question: 你在哪裡看過牌匾？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài nǎ lǐ kàn guò pái biǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: Where have you seen plaques?
entries.answer: 我在龍山寺看過很多牌匾。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zài lóng shān sì kàn guò hěn duō pái biǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: I've seen lots of plaques at Longshan Temple.

entries.example: 這位男爵住在英國的一座城堡裡。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè wèi nán jué zhù zài yīng guó de yí zuò chéng bǎo lǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: This baron lives in a castle in England.
entries.question: 你覺得當男爵的生活是什麼樣子？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de dāng nán jué de shēng huó shì shén me yàng zi?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you imagine a baron's life is like?
entries.answer: 我覺得男爵應該很有錢，住在城堡裡。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de nán jué yīng gāi hěn yǒu qián, zhù zài chéng bǎo lǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I imagine a baron is rich and lives in a castle.

entries.example: 每家公司都想把利潤最大化。
entries.examplePinyin: měi jiā gōng sī dōu xiǎng bǎ lì rùn zuì dà huà.
entries.exampleEnglish: Every company wants to maximize its profits.
entries.question: 出國旅行時，你會想把行程最大化嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: chū guó lǚ xíng shí, nǐ huì xiǎng bǎ xíng chéng zuì dà huà ma?
entries.questionEnglish: When you travel abroad, do you try to maximize your itinerary?
entries.answer: 會，我會排很多景點，把時間最大化。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ huì pái hěn duō jǐng diǎn, bǎ shí jiān zuì dà huà.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I plan lots of sights to make the most of my time.

entries.example: 他十年前就說房價會漲，真像先知。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shí nián qián jiù shuō fáng jià huì zhǎng, zhēn xiàng xiān zhī.
entries.exampleEnglish: He said housing prices would rise ten years ago; he's like a prophet.
entries.question: 你身邊有像先知一樣的朋友嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēn biān yǒu xiàng xiān zhī yí yàng de péng yǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a friend who seems like a prophet?
entries.answer: 有，我朋友很早就買了科技股，真是先知。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ péng yǒu hěn zǎo jiù mǎi le kē jì gǔ, zhēn shì xiān zhī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my friend bought tech stocks really early; he's a real prophet.

entries.example: 老爺爺步履蹣跚地走過馬路。
entries.examplePinyin: lǎo yé ye bù lǚ pán shān de zǒu guò mǎ lù.
entries.exampleEnglish: The old man tottered across the road.
entries.question: 你看過小孩蹣跚學步的樣子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò xiǎo hái pán shān xué bù de yàng zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a toddler learning to walk?
entries.answer: 看過，我姪子剛開始蹣跚學步，很可愛。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, wǒ zhí zi gāng kāi shǐ pán shān xué bù, hěn kě ài.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my nephew has just started toddling; he's so cute.

entries.example: 夜市的攤販都搭起了遮篷。
entries.examplePinyin: yè shì de tān fàn dōu dā qǐ le zhē péng.
entries.exampleEnglish: The night market stalls have all put up awnings.
entries.question: 你家陽台有遮篷嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā yáng tái yǒu zhē péng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your balcony have an awning?
entries.answer: 有，我家陽台有遮篷可以擋雨。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ jiā yáng tái yǒu zhē péng kě yǐ dǎng yǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my balcony has an awning that keeps the rain off.

entries.example: 她寫了一本關於女權主義的書。
entries.examplePinyin: tā xiě le yì běn guān yú nǚ quán zhǔ yì de shū.
entries.exampleEnglish: She wrote a book about feminism.
entries.question: 女權主義在你的國家常被討論嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǚ quán zhǔ yì zài nǐ de guó jiā cháng bèi tǎo lùn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is feminism often discussed in your country?
entries.answer: 常被討論，女權主義在網路上很熱門。
entries.answerPinyin: cháng bèi tǎo lùn, nǚ quán zhǔ yì zài wǎng lù shang hěn rè mén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, feminism is a hot topic online.

entries.example: 香菇其實是一種真菌。
entries.examplePinyin: xiāng gū qí shí shì yì zhǒng zhēn jùn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Shiitake mushrooms are actually a kind of fungus.
entries.question: 你知道哪些食物是真菌嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào nǎ xiē shí wù shì zhēn jùn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know which foods are fungi?
entries.answer: 我知道香菇和木耳都是真菌。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhī dào xiāng gū hé mù ěr dōu shì zhēn jùn.
entries.answerEnglish: I know shiitake mushrooms and wood ear are both fungi.

entries.example: 在台灣，一般人不能擁有槍枝。
entries.examplePinyin: zài tái wān, yì bān rén bù néng yǒng yǒu qiāng zhī.
entries.exampleEnglish: In Taiwan, ordinary people can't own firearms.
entries.question: 台灣對槍枝的管理嚴格嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: tái wān duì qiāng zhī de guǎn lǐ yán gé ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is Taiwan strict about controlling firearms?
entries.answer: 很嚴格，一般人不能買槍枝。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn yán gé, yì bān rén bù néng mǎi qiāng zhī.
entries.answerEnglish: Very strict; ordinary people can't buy firearms.

entries.example: 大自然的力量令人敬畏。
entries.examplePinyin: dà zì rán de lì liàng lìng rén jìng wèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: The power of nature is awe-inspiring.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼景色令人敬畏？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me jǐng sè lìng rén jìng wèi?
entries.questionEnglish: What scenery do you find awe-inspiring?
entries.answer: 我覺得太魯閣的高山峽谷令人敬畏。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de tài lǔ gé de gāo shān xiá gǔ lìng rén jìng wèi.
entries.answerEnglish: I find the mountains and gorges of Taroko awe-inspiring.

entries.example: 這份報告用了質性研究的方法。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè fèn bào gào yòng le zhí xìng yán jiù de fāng fǎ.
entries.exampleEnglish: This report uses qualitative research methods.
entries.question: 你做過質性研究嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuò guò zhí xìng yán jiù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever done qualitative research?
entries.answer: 做過，我念研究所時做過質性研究。
entries.answerPinyin: zuò guò, wǒ niàn yán jiù suǒ shí zuò guò zhí xìng yán jiù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I did qualitative research in grad school.

entries.english: equate; be equal to; be the same as
entries.example: 有錢不等同於快樂。
entries.examplePinyin: yǒu qián bù děng tóng yú kuài lè.
entries.exampleEnglish: Having money isn't the same as being happy.
entries.question: 你覺得高薪等同於好工作嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de gāo xīn děng tóng yú hǎo gōng zuò ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think a high salary equals a good job?
entries.answer: 不，我覺得高薪不等同於好工作。
entries.answerPinyin: bù, wǒ jué de gāo xīn bù děng tóng yú hǎo gōng zuò.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't think a high salary equals a good job.

entries.example: 我對日本文化有一種親近感。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ duì rì běn wén huà yǒu yì zhǒng qīn jìn gǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I feel a kind of affinity for Japanese culture.
entries.question: 你對哪個國家特別有親近感？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì nǎ gè guó jiā tè bié yǒu qīn jìn gǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: Which country do you feel a special affinity for?
entries.answer: 住了三年，我對台灣特別有親近感。
entries.answerPinyin: zhù le sān nián, wǒ duì tái wān tè bié yǒu qīn jìn gǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: After living here three years, I feel a special affinity for Taiwan.

entries.example: 她申請到一筆研究獎助金。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shēn qǐng dào yì bǐ yán jiù jiǎng zhù jīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: She was awarded a research fellowship.
entries.question: 你申請過獎助金嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēn qǐng guò jiǎng zhù jīn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever applied for a grant?
entries.answer: 申請過，我念碩士時拿過獎助金。
entries.answerPinyin: shēn qǐng guò, wǒ niàn shuò shì shí ná guò jiǎng zhù jīn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I received a grant during my master's.

entries.example: 這種藥會影響大腦的受體。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhǒng yào huì yǐng xiǎng dà nǎo de shòu tǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: This drug affects receptors in the brain.
entries.question: 你知道舌頭上有味覺受體嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào shé tou shàng yǒu wèi jué shòu tǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Did you know the tongue has taste receptors?
entries.answer: 知道，舌頭上的受體讓我們嚐到味道。
entries.answerPinyin: zhī dào, shé tou shàng de shòu tǐ ràng wǒ men cháng dào wèi dào.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, receptors on the tongue let us taste things.

entries.example: 墾丁的海邊有很多石灰岩。
entries.examplePinyin: kěn dīng de hǎi biān yǒu hěn duō shí huī yán.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a lot of limestone along the coast in Kenting.
entries.question: 你知道石灰岩可以用來做什麼嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào shí huī yán kě yǐ yòng lái zuò shén me ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know what limestone can be used for?
entries.answer: 石灰岩可以用來做水泥。
entries.answerPinyin: shí huī yán kě yǐ yòng lái zuò shuǐ ní.
entries.answerEnglish: Limestone can be used to make cement.

entries.example: 看完電影，她一直在小聲啜泣。
entries.examplePinyin: kàn wán diàn yǐng, tā yì zhí zài xiǎo shēng chuò qì.
entries.exampleEnglish: After the movie, she kept quietly sobbing.
entries.question: 你看什麼電影會忍不住啜泣？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn shén me diàn yǐng huì rěn bú zhù chuò qì?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of movie makes you start sobbing?
entries.answer: 我看感人的家庭電影會忍不住啜泣。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ kàn gǎn rén de jiā tíng diàn yǐng huì rěn bú zhù chuò qì.
entries.answerEnglish: Touching family movies make me sob.

entries.example: 醫生在片子上發現一個小病灶。
entries.examplePinyin: yī shēng zài piàn zi shàng fā xiàn yí gè xiǎo bìng zào.
entries.exampleEnglish: The doctor found a small lesion on the scan.
entries.question: 醫生通常用什麼方法找病灶？
entries.questionPinyin: yī shēng tōng cháng yòng shén me fāng fǎ zhǎo bìng zào?
entries.questionEnglish: How do doctors usually find lesions?
entries.answer: 醫生會用超音波或電腦斷層找病灶。
entries.answerPinyin: yī shēng huì yòng chāo yīn bō huò diàn nǎo duàn céng zhǎo bìng zào.
entries.answerEnglish: Doctors use ultrasound or CT scans to find lesions.

entries.example: 檢查結果是良性的，不用擔心。
entries.examplePinyin: jiǎn chá jié guǒ shì liáng xìng de, bú yòng dān xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The test result is benign; no need to worry.
entries.question: 你覺得同事之間的良性競爭好嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tóng shì zhī jiān de liáng xìng jìng zhēng hǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think healthy competition between coworkers is good?
entries.answer: 我覺得良性競爭可以讓大家都進步。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de liáng xìng jìng zhēng kě yǐ ràng dà jiā dōu jìn bù.
entries.answerEnglish: I think healthy competition helps everyone improve.

entries.example: 這件襯衫的接縫裂開了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn chèn shān de jiē fèng liè kāi le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The seam on this shirt has split.
entries.question: 衣服的接縫裂開了，你會自己縫嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: yī fu de jiē fèng liè kāi le, nǐ huì zì jǐ féng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: If a seam on your clothes splits, do you sew it yourself?
entries.answer: 會，接縫裂開我會自己縫好。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, jiē fèng liè kāi wǒ huì zì jǐ féng hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, if a seam splits I sew it up myself.

entries.example: 我對大自然充滿敬畏。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ duì dà zì rán chōng mǎn jìng wèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm full of awe for nature.
entries.question: 你對什麼東西心存敬畏？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì shén me dōng xī xīn cún jìng wèi?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you hold in awe?
entries.answer: 我對大海心存敬畏，不敢游太遠。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ duì dà hǎi xīn cún jìng wèi, bù gǎn yóu tài yuǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: I hold the ocean in awe; I don't dare swim too far out.

entries.example: 我的主管見多識廣，什麼都懂。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ de zhǔ guǎn jiàn duō shì guǎng, shén me dōu dǒng.
entries.exampleEnglish: My manager is very worldly and knows about everything.
entries.question: 你身邊有見多識廣的朋友嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ shēn biān yǒu jiàn duō shì guǎng de péng yǒu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any well-informed, worldly friends?
entries.answer: 有，我的室友去過很多國家，見多識廣。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de shì yǒu qù guò hěn duō guó jiā, jiàn duō shì guǎng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my roommate has been to many countries and is very worldly.

entries.example: 大家一起哀悼地震的罹難者。
entries.examplePinyin: dà jiā yì qǐ āi dào dì zhèn de lí nàn zhě.
entries.exampleEnglish: Everyone mourned the earthquake victims together.
entries.question: 人們通常怎麼哀悼過世的人？
entries.questionPinyin: rén men tōng cháng zěn me āi dào guò shì de rén?
entries.questionEnglish: How do people usually mourn those who have died?
entries.answer: 人們常會參加告別式來哀悼過世的人。
entries.answerPinyin: rén men cháng huì cān jiā gào bié shì lái āi dào guò shì de rén.
entries.answerEnglish: People often attend a funeral service to mourn them.

entries.example: 故宮裡有很多珍寶。
entries.examplePinyin: gù gōng lǐ yǒu hěn duō zhēn bǎo.
entries.exampleEnglish: The National Palace Museum has many treasures.
entries.question: 你家裡有什麼像珍寶一樣的東西？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā lǐ yǒu shén me xiàng zhēn bǎo yí yàng de dōng xī?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you have at home that's like a treasure to you?
entries.answer: 奶奶給我的戒指是我的珍寶。
entries.answerPinyin: nǎi nai gěi wǒ de jiè zhǐ shì wǒ de zhēn bǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: The ring my grandma gave me is my treasure.

entries.example: 這件衣服上的花紋很繁複。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn yī fu shàng de huā wén hěn fán fù.
entries.exampleEnglish: The pattern on this garment is very intricate.
entries.question: 你喜歡繁複的設計還是簡單的設計？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan fán fù de shè jì hái shì jiǎn dān de shè jì?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer intricate or simple designs?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡簡單的，不喜歡繁複的設計。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan jiǎn dān de, bù xǐ huan fán fù de shè jì.
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer simple ones; I don't like intricate designs.

entries.example: 他咕噥了一句，我沒聽清楚。
entries.examplePinyin: tā gū nóng le yí jù, wǒ méi tīng qīng chǔ.
entries.exampleEnglish: He mumbled something and I didn't catch it.
entries.question: 別人咕噥的時候，你聽得懂嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: bié rén gū nóng de shí hòu, nǐ tīng de dǒng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you understand people when they mumble?
entries.answer: 聽不懂，別人咕噥的時候我都聽不清楚。
entries.answerPinyin: tīng bù dǒng, bié rén gū nóng de shí hòu wǒ dōu tīng bù qīng chǔ.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I can never hear clearly when people mumble.

entries.example: 這件事牽連了很多人。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiàn shì qiān lián le hěn duō rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: This matter has implicated a lot of people.
entries.question: 為什麼有些人會被別人的事牽連？
entries.questionPinyin: wèi shén me yǒu xiē rén huì bèi bié rén de shì qiān lián?
entries.questionEnglish: Why do some people get dragged into other people's affairs?
entries.answer: 因為他們跟那個人關係很近，所以被牽連。
entries.answerPinyin: yīn wèi tā men gēn nà ge rén guān xì hěn jìn, suǒ yǐ bèi qiān lián.
entries.answerEnglish: Because they're close to that person, they get implicated.

entries.english: repertoire; program of songs; track list
entries.example: 今晚音樂會的曲目都是蕭邦的作品。
entries.examplePinyin: jīn wǎn yīn yuè huì de qǔ mù dōu shì xiāo bāng de zuò pǐn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Tonight's concert program is all Chopin.
entries.question: 唱卡拉OK時，你有拿手的曲目嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: chàng kǎ lā OK shí, nǐ yǒu ná shǒu de qǔ mù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a signature song when you sing karaoke?
entries.answer: 有，我的拿手曲目是周杰倫的歌。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ de ná shǒu qǔ mù shì zhōu jié lún de gē.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my go-to songs are by Jay Chou.

entries.example: 她的頭髮又黑又有光澤。
entries.examplePinyin: tā de tóu fǎ yòu hēi yòu yǒu guāng zé.
entries.exampleEnglish: Her hair is dark and glossy.
entries.question: 你用什麼方法讓頭髮有光澤？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yòng shén me fāng fǎ ràng tóu fǎ yǒu guāng zé?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do to keep your hair glossy?
entries.answer: 我會用護髮乳，讓頭髮更有光澤。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì yòng hù fǎ rǔ, ràng tóu fǎ gèng yǒu guāng zé.
entries.answerEnglish: I use conditioner to make my hair glossier.

entries.example: 台灣以前經歷過一段威權時代。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān yǐ qián jīng lì guò yí duàn wēi quán shí dài.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan once went through an authoritarian era.
entries.question: 你覺得威權的管理方式有效嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de wēi quán de guǎn lǐ fāng shì yǒu xiào ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think an authoritarian management style works?
entries.answer: 我覺得威權的管理方式讓員工不開心。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de wēi quán de guǎn lǐ fāng shì ràng yuán gōng bù kāi xīn.
entries.answerEnglish: I think an authoritarian management style makes employees unhappy.

entries.example: 部門之間的橫向溝通很重要。
entries.examplePinyin: bù mén zhī jiān de héng xiàng gōu tōng hěn zhòng yào.
entries.exampleEnglish: Communication across departments is very important.
entries.question: 你們公司部門之間的橫向溝通好嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ men gōng sī bù mén zhī jiān de héng xiàng gōu tōng hǎo ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Is cross-department communication good at your company?
entries.answer: 不太好，我們部門很少跟別的部門橫向溝通。
entries.answerPinyin: bú tài hǎo, wǒ men bù mén hěn shǎo gēn bié de bù mén héng xiàng gōu tōng.
entries.answerEnglish: Not great; my department rarely communicates with others.

entries.example: 他相信打破鏡子會帶來厄運。
entries.examplePinyin: tā xiāng xìn dǎ pò jìng zi huì dài lái è yùn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He believes breaking a mirror brings bad luck.
entries.question: 在你的國家，大家覺得什麼會帶來厄運？
entries.questionPinyin: zài nǐ de guó jiā, dà jiā jué de shén me huì dài lái è yùn?
entries.questionEnglish: In your country, what do people think brings bad luck?
entries.answer: 在我的國家，很多人覺得黑貓會帶來厄運。
entries.answerPinyin: zài wǒ de guó jiā, hěn duō rén jué de hēi māo huì dài lái è yùn.
entries.answerEnglish: In my country, many people think black cats bring bad luck.

entries.example: 台北的房價令人卻步。
entries.examplePinyin: tái běi de fáng jià lìng rén què bù.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taipei's housing prices are daunting.
entries.question: 你覺得學中文有什麼令人卻步的地方？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de xué zhōng wén yǒu shén me lìng rén què bù de dì fāng?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you find daunting about learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 漢字太多了，一開始真的令人卻步。
entries.answerPinyin: hàn zì tài duō le, yì kāi shǐ zhēn de lìng rén què bù.
entries.answerEnglish: There are so many characters; at first it was really daunting.

entries.example: 不可否認，台北的交通很方便。
entries.examplePinyin: bù kě fǒu rèn, tái běi de jiāo tōng hěn fāng biàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Admittedly, getting around Taipei is very convenient.
entries.question: 住在台灣有什麼不可否認的好處？
entries.questionPinyin: zhù zài tái wān yǒu shén me bù kě fǒu rèn de hǎo chù?
entries.questionEnglish: What undeniable advantages are there to living in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 不可否認，台灣的便利商店真的很方便。
entries.answerPinyin: bù kě fǒu rèn, tái wān de biàn lì shāng diàn zhēn de hěn fāng biàn.
entries.answerEnglish: Undeniably, Taiwan's convenience stores are really handy.

entries.example: 她是我們公司的財務主管。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì wǒ men gōng sī de cái wù zhǔ guǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: She's our company's finance manager.
entries.question: 你覺得當財務主管需要什麼能力？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de dāng cái wù zhǔ guǎn xū yào shén me néng lì?
entries.questionEnglish: What skills do you think a treasurer needs?
entries.answer: 當財務主管要很細心，而且數字要好。
entries.answerPinyin: dāng cái wù zhǔ guǎn yào hěn xì xīn, ér qiě shù zì yào hǎo.
entries.answerEnglish: A treasurer needs to be careful and good with numbers.

entries.english: pervade; fill the air; be everywhere
entries.example: 夜市裡瀰漫著臭豆腐的味道。
entries.examplePinyin: yè shì lǐ mí màn zhe chòu dòu fu de wèi dào.
entries.exampleEnglish: The smell of stinky tofu fills the night market.
entries.question: 你家附近常瀰漫什麼味道？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn cháng mí màn shén me wèi dào?
entries.questionEnglish: What smell often fills the air near your home?
entries.answer: 我家附近常瀰漫著麵包的香味。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jiā fù jìn cháng mí màn zhe miàn bāo de xiāng wèi.
entries.answerEnglish: The smell of bread often fills the air near my home.

entries.example: 她終於向我吐露了心事。
entries.examplePinyin: tā zhōng yú xiàng wǒ tǔ lù le xīn shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: She finally confided what was on her mind to me.
entries.question: 你通常向誰吐露心事？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tōng cháng xiàng shéi tǔ lù xīn shì?
entries.questionEnglish: Who do you usually confide in?
entries.answer: 我通常向最好的朋友吐露心事。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ tōng cháng xiàng zuì hǎo de péng yǒu tǔ lù xīn shì.
entries.answerEnglish: I usually confide in my best friend.

entries.example: 銀行一直打電話給債務人。
entries.examplePinyin: yín háng yì zhí dǎ diàn huà gěi zhài wù rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: The bank keeps calling the debtor.
entries.question: 債務人還不出錢會怎麼樣？
entries.questionPinyin: zhài wù rén huán bù chū qián huì zěn me yàng?
entries.questionEnglish: What happens when a debtor can't pay?
entries.answer: 債務人還不出錢，銀行可能會拍賣房子。
entries.answerPinyin: zhài wù rén huán bù chū qián, yín háng kě néng huì pāi mài fáng zi.
entries.answerEnglish: If a debtor can't pay, the bank may auction off the house.

entries.example: 老闆總是偏袒他的親戚。
entries.examplePinyin: lǎo bǎn zǒng shì piān tǎn tā de qīn qi.
entries.exampleEnglish: The boss always favors his relatives.
entries.question: 你覺得爸媽會偏袒某個孩子嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de bà mā huì piān tǎn mǒu gè hái zi ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think parents favor one of their children?
entries.answer: 我覺得有些爸媽會偏袒最小的孩子。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de yǒu xiē bà mā huì piān tǎn zuì xiǎo de hái zi.
entries.answerEnglish: I think some parents favor the youngest child.

entries.example: 暮光下的海邊特別美。
entries.examplePinyin: mù guāng xià de hǎi biān tè bié měi.
entries.exampleEnglish: The seaside is especially beautiful in the twilight.
entries.question: 你喜歡在暮光中散步嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan zài mù guāng zhōng sàn bù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like walking in the twilight?
entries.answer: 喜歡，暮光中的河邊很安靜。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, mù guāng zhōng de hé biān hěn ān jìng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the riverside is very peaceful in the twilight.

entries.example: 這位師父收了很多弟子。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè wèi shī fu shōu le hěn duō dì zǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: This master has taken on many disciples.
entries.question: 你想當哪一種老師的弟子？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiǎng dāng nǎ yì zhǒng lǎo shī de dì zǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of master would you like to be a disciple of?
entries.answer: 我想當太極拳老師的弟子。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiǎng dāng tài jí quán lǎo shī de dì zǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to be the disciple of a tai chi master.

entries.example: 鑑識人員在現場找證據。
entries.examplePinyin: jiàn shì rén yuán zài xiàn chǎng zhǎo zhèng jù.
entries.exampleEnglish: Forensic officers are looking for evidence at the scene.
entries.question: 鑑識人員的工作是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: jiàn shì rén yuán de gōng zuò shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do forensic officers do?
entries.answer: 鑑識人員負責在現場收集證據。
entries.answerPinyin: jiàn shì rén yuán fù zé zài xiàn chǎng shōu jí zhèng jù.
entries.answerEnglish: Forensic officers collect evidence at the scene.

entries.example: 中午的陽光非常灼熱。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōng wǔ de yáng guāng fēi cháng zhuó rè.
entries.exampleEnglish: The midday sun is scorching.
entries.question: 你怎麼對付夏天灼熱的陽光？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zěn me duì fù xià tiān zhuó rè de yáng guāng?
entries.questionEnglish: How do you deal with the scorching summer sun?
entries.answer: 我會擦防曬，盡量避開灼熱的陽光。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ huì cā fáng shài, jìn liàng bì kāi zhuó rè de yáng guāng.
entries.answerEnglish: I wear sunscreen and try to avoid the scorching sun.

entries.example: 人的身體裡有很多腺體。
entries.examplePinyin: rén de shēn tǐ lǐ yǒu hěn duō xiàn tǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: There are many glands in the human body.
entries.question: 你知道身體有哪些腺體嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào shēn tǐ yǒu nǎ xiē xiàn tǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know which glands the body has?
entries.answer: 我知道甲狀腺和汗腺都是腺體。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zhī dào jiǎ zhuàng xiàn hé hàn xiàn dōu shì xiàn tǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I know the thyroid and sweat glands are both glands.

entries.example: 工作和生活失衡，會讓人很累。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng zuò hé shēng huó shī héng, huì ràng rén hěn lèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: An imbalance between work and life wears people out.
entries.question: 你覺得你的工作和生活失衡嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǐ de gōng zuò hé shēng huó shī héng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your work and life are out of balance?
entries.answer: 有點失衡，我最近加班太多了。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu diǎn shī héng, wǒ zuì jìn jiā bān tài duō le.
entries.answerEnglish: A bit out of balance; I've been working too much overtime.

entries.example: 他對公司的事漠不關心。
entries.examplePinyin: tā duì gōng sī de shì mò bù guān xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's indifferent to what goes on at the company.
entries.question: 你對什麼事情漠不關心？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ duì shén me shì qíng mò bù guān xīn?
entries.questionEnglish: What are you indifferent to?
entries.answer: 我對明星的八卦漠不關心。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ duì míng xīng de bā guà mò bù guān xīn.
entries.answerEnglish: I'm indifferent to celebrity gossip.

entries.example: 從這些資料，我們可以推論出原因。
entries.examplePinyin: cóng zhè xiē zī liào, wǒ men kě yǐ tuī lùn chū yuán yīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: From this data we can infer the cause.
entries.question: 你喜歡看需要推論的偵探小說嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan kàn xū yào tuī lùn de zhēn tàn xiǎo shuō ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like detective novels that make you work things out?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我喜歡跟著偵探一起推論。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, wǒ xǐ huan gēn zhe zhēn tàn yì qǐ tuī lùn.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like deducing along with the detective.

entries.example: 有人說海邊的空氣有很多負離子。
entries.examplePinyin: yǒu rén shuō hǎi biān de kōng qì yǒu hěn duō fù lí zǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Some say the air by the sea is full of negative ions.
entries.question: 你相信負離子對健康有幫助嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiāng xìn fù lí zǐ duì jiàn kāng yǒu bāng zhù ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you believe negative ions are good for your health?
entries.answer: 我不太相信負離子有那麼大的幫助。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ bú tài xiāng xìn fù lí zǐ yǒu nà me dà de bāng zhù.
entries.answerEnglish: I don't really believe negative ions help that much.

entries.english: relic; remains; belongings of the deceased
entries.example: 博物館展出很多古代的遺物。
entries.examplePinyin: bó wù guǎn zhǎn chū hěn duō gǔ dài de yí wù.
entries.exampleEnglish: The museum displays many ancient relics.
entries.question: 博物館裡通常有什麼樣的遺物？
entries.questionPinyin: bó wù guǎn lǐ tōng cháng yǒu shén me yàng de yí wù?
entries.questionEnglish: What kinds of relics are usually in museums?
entries.answer: 博物館裡常有古代的遺物，像是陶器。
entries.answerPinyin: bó wù guǎn lǐ cháng yǒu gǔ dài de yí wù, xiàng shì táo qì.
entries.answerEnglish: Museums often have ancient relics, like pottery.

entries.english: be proportional to; in direct proportion
entries.example: 努力和收穫不一定成正比。
entries.examplePinyin: nǔ lì hé shōu huò bù yí dìng chéng zhèng bǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: Effort and reward aren't always proportional.
entries.question: 你覺得薪水和工作時間成正比嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de xīn shuǐ hé gōng zuò shí jiān chéng zhèng bǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think pay is proportional to working hours?
entries.answer: 我覺得薪水跟工作時間不成正比。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de xīn shuǐ gēn gōng zuò shí jiān bù chéng zhèng bǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: I don't think pay is proportional to working hours.

entries.example: 工廠的鍋爐壞了，要停工一天。
entries.examplePinyin: gōng chǎng de guō lú huài le, yào tíng gōng yì tiān.
entries.exampleEnglish: The factory's boiler broke down, so work stops for a day.
entries.question: 你知道鍋爐是做什麼用的嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào guō lú shì zuò shén me yòng de ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know what a boiler is used for?
entries.answer: 知道，鍋爐可以把水加熱，產生蒸氣。
entries.answerPinyin: zhī dào, guō lú kě yǐ bǎ shuǐ jiā rè, chǎn shēng zhēng qì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a boiler heats water to make steam.

entries.example: 不要逐字翻譯，要翻得自然一點。
entries.examplePinyin: bú yào zhú zì fān yì, yào fān de zì rán yì diǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Don't translate word for word; make it sound natural.
entries.question: 你學中文時會逐字翻譯嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xué zhōng wén shí huì zhú zì fān yì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you translate word for word when learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 剛開始會，現在比較少逐字翻譯了。
entries.answerPinyin: gāng kāi shǐ huì, xiàn zài bǐ jiào shǎo zhú zì fān yì le.
entries.answerEnglish: At first I did, but now I rarely translate word for word.

entries.example: 古時候很多人死於傳染病。
entries.examplePinyin: gǔ shí hòu hěn duō rén sǐ yú chuán rǎn bìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: In ancient times many people died of infectious diseases.
entries.question: 古時候的人常死於什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: gǔ shí hòu de rén cháng sǐ yú shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What did people often die of in ancient times?
entries.answer: 古時候的人常死於傳染病和戰爭。
entries.answerPinyin: gǔ shí hòu de rén cháng sǐ yú chuán rǎn bìng hé zhàn zhēng.
entries.answerEnglish: In ancient times people often died of infectious disease and war.

entries.example: 教堂裡傳來唱聖歌的聲音。
entries.examplePinyin: jiào táng lǐ chuán lái chàng shèng gē de shēng yīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The sound of hymns came from the church.
entries.question: 你聽過聖誕節的聖歌嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ tīng guò shèng dàn jié de shèng gē ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever heard Christmas hymns?
entries.answer: 聽過，我在教會聽過大家唱聖歌。
entries.answerPinyin: tīng guò, wǒ zài jiào huì tīng guò dà jiā chàng shèng gē.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've heard people sing hymns at church.

entries.example: 年輕的時候，他非常渴求成功。
entries.examplePinyin: nián qīng de shí hòu, tā fēi cháng kě qiú chéng gōng.
entries.exampleEnglish: When he was young, he craved success.
entries.question: 你現在最渴求的是什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiàn zài zuì kě qiú de shì shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you crave most right now?
entries.answer: 我現在最渴求的是多一點休息時間。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ xiàn zài zuì kě qiú de shì duō yì diǎn xiū xí shí jiān.
entries.answerEnglish: What I crave most right now is a bit more rest.

entries.example: 巷子裡飄散著桂花的香味。
entries.examplePinyin: xiàng zi lǐ piāo sàn zhe guì huā de xiāng wèi.
entries.exampleEnglish: The scent of osmanthus wafts through the alley.
entries.question: 你最喜歡空氣中飄散的哪種香味？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zuì xǐ huan kōng qì zhōng piāo sàn de nǎ zhǒng xiāng wèi?
entries.questionEnglish: Which scent drifting in the air do you like most?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡麵包店飄散出來的香味。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huan miàn bāo diàn piāo sàn chū lái de xiāng wèi.
entries.answerEnglish: I love the smell wafting out of bakeries.

entries.example: 雙方決定把這件糾紛交給仲裁。
entries.examplePinyin: shuāng fāng jué dìng bǎ zhè jiàn jiū fēn jiāo gěi zhòng cái.
entries.exampleEnglish: Both sides decided to take the dispute to arbitration.
entries.question: 如果跟房東有糾紛，你會考慮仲裁嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: rú guǒ gēn fáng dōng yǒu jiū fēn, nǐ huì kǎo lǜ zhòng cái ma?
entries.questionEnglish: If you had a dispute with your landlord, would you consider arbitration?
entries.answer: 會，我覺得仲裁比上法院省時間。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ jué de zhòng cái bǐ shàng fǎ yuàn shěng shí jiān.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I think arbitration saves more time than going to court.

entries.example: 老闆在會議上又重申了一次公司的規定。
entries.examplePinyin: lǎo bǎn zài huì yì shàng yòu chóng shēn le yí cì gōng sī de guī dìng.
entries.exampleEnglish: At the meeting the boss reiterated the company rules once again.
entries.question: 開會時，你的主管常重申什麼？
entries.questionPinyin: kāi huì shí, nǐ de zhǔ guǎn cháng chóng shēn shén me?
entries.questionEnglish: What does your manager often reiterate in meetings?
entries.answer: 他常重申報告一定要準時交。
entries.answerPinyin: tā cháng chóng shēn bào gào yí dìng yào zhǔn shí jiāo.
entries.answerEnglish: He often reiterates that reports must be handed in on time.

entries.example: 這種投資太投機了，我不敢買。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhǒng tóu zī tài tóu jī le, wǒ bù gǎn mǎi.
entries.exampleEnglish: This kind of investment is too speculative; I don't dare buy it.
entries.question: 你覺得買虛擬貨幣很投機嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de mǎi xū nǐ huò bì hěn tóu jī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think buying cryptocurrency is speculative?
entries.answer: 我覺得有點投機，所以我不買。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de yǒu diǎn tóu jī, suǒ yǐ wǒ bù mǎi.
entries.answerEnglish: I think it's a bit speculative, so I don't buy it.

entries.example: 這家餐廳想給客人全新的感官體驗。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè jiā cān tīng xiǎng gěi kè rén quán xīn de gǎn guān tǐ yàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant wants to give customers a brand-new sensory experience.
entries.question: 你覺得哪一個感官最重要？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǎ yí gè gǎn guān zuì zhòng yào?
entries.questionEnglish: Which sense do you think is most important?
entries.answer: 我覺得視覺是最重要的感官。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de shì jué shì zuì zhòng yào de gǎn guān.
entries.answerEnglish: I think sight is the most important sense.

entries.example: 廟裡每天早上都有人在唸經文。
entries.examplePinyin: miào lǐ měi tiān zǎo shàng dōu yǒu rén zài niàn jīng wén.
entries.exampleEnglish: Every morning there are people chanting scripture at the temple.
entries.question: 你在台灣的廟裡聽過人唸經文嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zài tái wān de miào lǐ tīng guò rén niàn jīng wén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you heard people chanting scripture at a temple in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 聽過，我在龍山寺聽過人唸經文。
entries.answerPinyin: tīng guò, wǒ zài lóng shān sì tīng guò rén niàn jīng wén.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I heard people chanting scripture at Longshan Temple.

entries.example: 人的身體裡有二十三對染色體。
entries.examplePinyin: rén de shēn tǐ lǐ yǒu èr shí sān duì rǎn sè tǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: The human body has 23 pairs of chromosomes.
entries.question: 你知道人有幾條染色體嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào rén yǒu jǐ tiáo rǎn sè tǐ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know how many chromosomes humans have?
entries.answer: 知道，人有四十六條染色體。
entries.answerPinyin: zhī dào, rén yǒu sì shí liù tiáo rǎn sè tǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, humans have 46 chromosomes.

entries.example: 這次漲價成了大家改搭捷運的催化劑。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè cì zhǎng jià chéng le dà jiā gǎi dā jié yùn de cuī huà jì.
entries.exampleEnglish: This price rise became the catalyst for everyone switching to the MRT.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼是改變生活的催化劑？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shén me shì gǎi biàn shēng huó de cuī huà jì?
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is a catalyst for changing your life?
entries.answer: 我覺得搬到台灣是我改變生活的催化劑。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de bān dào tái wān shì wǒ gǎi biàn shēng huó de cuī huà jì.
entries.answerEnglish: I think moving to Taiwan was the catalyst that changed my life.

entries.example: 這只是一個假設性的問題。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhǐ shì yí gè jiǎ shè xìng de wèn tí.
entries.exampleEnglish: This is just a hypothetical question.
entries.question: 你喜歡回答假設性的問題嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xǐ huan huí dá jiǎ shè xìng de wèn tí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like answering hypothetical questions?
entries.answer: 喜歡，假設性的問題很有趣。
entries.answerPinyin: xǐ huan, jiǎ shè xìng de wèn tí hěn yǒu qù.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, hypothetical questions are interesting.

entries.example: 胰島素要放在冰箱裡保存。
entries.examplePinyin: yí dǎo sù yào fàng zài bīng xiāng lǐ bǎo cún.
entries.exampleEnglish: Insulin should be kept in the fridge.
entries.question: 什麼樣的人需要打胰島素？
entries.questionPinyin: shén me yàng de rén xū yào dǎ yí dǎo sù?
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of people need insulin injections?
entries.answer: 有些糖尿病人需要打胰島素。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu xiē táng niào bìng rén xū yào dǎ yí dǎo sù.
entries.answerEnglish: Some people with diabetes need insulin injections.

entries.example: 地震後，街上到處都是瓦礫。
entries.examplePinyin: dì zhèn hòu, jiē shàng dào chù dōu shì wǎ lì.
entries.exampleEnglish: After the earthquake, there was rubble all over the streets.
entries.question: 地震後，通常是誰清理瓦礫？
entries.questionPinyin: dì zhèn hòu, tōng cháng shì shéi qīng lǐ wǎ lì?
entries.questionEnglish: After an earthquake, who usually clears the rubble?
entries.answer: 通常是政府派人來清理瓦礫。
entries.answerPinyin: tōng cháng shì zhèng fǔ pài rén lái qīng lǐ wǎ lì.
entries.answerEnglish: Usually the government sends people to clear the rubble.

entries.example: 這種溶劑可以去掉衣服上的油漆。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zhǒng róng jì kě yǐ qù diào yī fu shàng de yóu qī.
entries.exampleEnglish: This solvent can remove paint from clothes.
entries.question: 你用過去油漆的溶劑嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yòng guò qù yóu qī de róng jì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you used a solvent to remove paint?
entries.answer: 用過，那種溶劑的味道很重。
entries.answerPinyin: yòng guò, nà zhǒng róng jì de wèi dào hěn zhòng.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, that solvent has a really strong smell.

entries.example: 膽汁可以幫助身體消化油脂。
entries.examplePinyin: dǎn zhī kě yǐ bāng zhù shēn tǐ xiāo huà yóu zhī.
entries.exampleEnglish: Bile helps the body digest fats.
entries.question: 你知道膽汁有什麼作用嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ zhī dào dǎn zhī yǒu shén me zuò yòng ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know what bile does?
entries.answer: 知道，膽汁可以幫助消化。
entries.answerPinyin: zhī dào, dǎn zhī kě yǐ bāng zhù xiāo huà.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, bile helps with digestion.

entries.example: 即將卸任的經理今天請大家吃飯。
entries.examplePinyin: jí jiāng xiè rèn de jīng lǐ jīn tiān qǐng dà jiā chī fàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The outgoing manager treated everyone to a meal today.
entries.question: 主管卸任前，你們公司會辦歡送會嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: zhǔ guǎn xiè rèn qián, nǐ men gōng sī huì bàn huān sòng huì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company hold a farewell party before a manager leaves the post?
entries.answer: 會，經理卸任前我們會幫他辦歡送會。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, jīng lǐ xiè rèn qián wǒ men huì bāng tā bàn huān sòng huì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we throw a farewell party for a manager before they leave the post.

entries.example: 這條老街最近又興旺起來了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tiáo lǎo jiē zuì jìn yòu xīng wàng qǐ lái le.
entries.exampleEnglish: This old street has started thriving again recently.
entries.question: 你家附近哪家店生意最興旺？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jiā fù jìn nǎ jiā diàn shēng yì zuì xīng wàng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which shop near your home does the best business?
entries.answer: 巷口那家早餐店生意最興旺。
entries.answerPinyin: xiàng kǒu nà jiā zǎo cān diàn shēng yì zuì xīng wàng.
entries.answerEnglish: The breakfast shop at the end of the lane does the best business.

entries.example: 我帶狗去動物醫院植入晶片。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ dài gǒu qù dòng wù yī yuàn zhí rù jīng piàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: I took my dog to the vet to have a microchip implanted.
entries.question: 你覺得寵物應該植入晶片嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de chǒng wù yīng gāi zhí rù jīng piàn ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think pets should be microchipped?
entries.answer: 應該，植入晶片比較不怕走丟。
entries.answerPinyin: yīng gāi, zhí rù jīng piàn bǐ jiào bú pà zǒu diū.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, with a chip implanted you don't have to worry so much about them getting lost.

entries.example: 他無疑是我們公司最認真的人。
entries.examplePinyin: tā wú yí shì wǒ men gōng sī zuì rèn zhēn de rén.
entries.exampleEnglish: He is undoubtedly the most hardworking person in our company.
entries.question: 你覺得誰無疑是最好的歌手？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de shéi wú yí shì zuì hǎo de gē shǒu?
entries.questionEnglish: Who do you think is undoubtedly the best singer?
entries.answer: 我覺得周杰倫無疑是最好的歌手。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de zhōu jié lún wú yí shì zuì hǎo de gē shǒu.
entries.answerEnglish: I think Jay Chou is undoubtedly the best singer.

entries.example: 海上的風力渦輪機可以發電。
entries.examplePinyin: hǎi shàng de fēng lì wō lún jī kě yǐ fā diàn.
entries.exampleEnglish: Wind turbines out at sea can generate electricity.
entries.question: 你看過海邊的大型渦輪機嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò hǎi biān de dà xíng wō lún jī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen big turbines by the sea?
entries.answer: 看過，新竹海邊有很多渦輪機。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn guò, xīn zhú hǎi biān yǒu hěn duō wō lún jī.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are lots of turbines along the coast in Hsinchu.

entries.example: 這塊石碑上的碑文已經看不清楚了。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè kuài shí bēi shàng de bēi wén yǐ jīng kàn bù qīng chǔ le.
entries.exampleEnglish: The inscription on this stone tablet can no longer be read clearly.
entries.question: 你看得懂古老的碑文嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn de dǒng gǔ lǎo de bēi wén ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Can you read ancient inscriptions?
entries.answer: 看不懂，碑文的字太難了。
entries.answerPinyin: kàn bù dǒng, bēi wén de zì tài nán le.
entries.answerEnglish: No, the characters in inscriptions are too hard.

entries.example: 寫信給客戶時，措辭要特別小心。
entries.examplePinyin: xiě xìn gěi kè hù shí, cuò cí yào tè bié xiǎo xīn.
entries.exampleEnglish: When writing to clients, you have to be especially careful with your wording.
entries.question: 你寫工作上的信會注意措辭嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ xiě gōng zuò shàng de xìn huì zhù yì cuò cí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you pay attention to wording when you write work emails?
entries.answer: 會，我寫信的措辭都很客氣。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ xiě xìn de cuò cí dōu hěn kè qì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always word my emails politely.

entries.example: 他是台灣研究颱風的權威。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì tái wān yán jiù tái fēng de quán wēi.
entries.exampleEnglish: He is Taiwan's leading authority on typhoons.
entries.question: 你覺得哪個新聞媒體比較權威？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǎ gè xīn wén méi tǐ bǐ jiào quán wēi?
entries.questionEnglish: Which news outlet do you think is more authoritative?
entries.answer: 我覺得公共電視比較權威。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de gōng gòng diàn shì bǐ jiào quán wēi.
entries.answerEnglish: I think Public Television is more authoritative.

entries.example: 我朋友在醫學院教解剖學。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ péng yǒu zài yī xué yuàn jiāo jiě pōu xué.
entries.exampleEnglish: My friend teaches anatomy at a medical school.
entries.question: 你覺得解剖學難嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de jiě pōu xué nán ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think anatomy is difficult?
entries.answer: 很難，解剖學要背很多東西。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn nán, jiě pōu xué yào bèi hěn duō dōng xī.
entries.answerEnglish: Very; anatomy involves memorising a lot.

entries.example: 這條繩子太鬆弛了，要再拉緊一點。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè tiáo shéng zi tài sōng chí le, yào zài lā jǐn yì diǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: This rope is too slack; it needs to be pulled tighter.
entries.question: 年紀大了，皮膚為什麼會鬆弛？
entries.questionPinyin: nián jì dà le, pí fū wèi shén me huì sōng chí?
entries.questionEnglish: Why does skin sag as we get older?
entries.answer: 因為皮膚的彈性變差，所以會鬆弛。
entries.answerPinyin: yīn wèi pí fū de tán xìng biàn chà, suǒ yǐ huì sōng chí.
entries.answerEnglish: Because skin loses its elasticity, it starts to sag.

entries.example: 山上有一座兩百年前的要塞。
entries.examplePinyin: shān shàng yǒu yí zuò liǎng bǎi nián qián de yào sài.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a 200-year-old fortress on the mountain.
entries.question: 你參觀過古老的要塞嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ cān guān guò gǔ lǎo de yào sài ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you visited an old fortress?
entries.answer: 參觀過，我在歐洲看過很古老的要塞。
entries.answerPinyin: cān guān guò, wǒ zài ōu zhōu kàn guò hěn gǔ lǎo de yào sài.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've seen very old fortresses in Europe.

entries.example: 忠烈祠裡供奉著很多烈士。
entries.examplePinyin: zhōng liè cí lǐ gòng fèng zhe hěn duō liè shì.
entries.exampleEnglish: Many martyrs are honoured at the Martyrs' Shrine.
entries.question: 台北的忠烈祠是紀念哪些人？
entries.questionPinyin: tái běi de zhōng liè cí shì jì niàn nǎ xiē rén?
entries.questionEnglish: Who does the Martyrs' Shrine in Taipei commemorate?
entries.answer: 忠烈祠紀念為國家犧牲的烈士。
entries.answerPinyin: zhōng liè cí jì niàn wèi guó jiā xī shēng de liè shì.
entries.answerEnglish: The Martyrs' Shrine commemorates martyrs who died for the country.

entries.english: to intertwine; to interweave; to mingle
entries.example: 夜市裡各種香味交織在一起。
entries.examplePinyin: yè shì lǐ gè zhǒng xiāng wèi jiāo zhī zài yì qǐ.
entries.exampleEnglish: In the night market all kinds of smells mingle together.
entries.question: 你覺得台北是新舊交織的城市嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de tái běi shì xīn jiù jiāo zhī de chéng shì ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taipei is a city where old and new are interwoven?
entries.answer: 是，台北的新舊建築交織在一起。
entries.answerPinyin: shì, tái běi de xīn jiù jiàn zhú jiāo zhī zài yì qǐ.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, Taipei's old and new buildings are interwoven.

entries.example: 我的教授很博學，什麼都懂。

entries.examplePinyin: gǔ piào zhǎng le, tā jiù bǎ jī jīn shú huí le.
entries.exampleEnglish: When the market went up, he redeemed his fund.
entries.question: 你買的基金賺錢了，會馬上贖回嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ mǎi de jī jīn zhuàn qián le, huì mǎ shàng shú huí ma?
entries.questionEnglish: If a fund you bought made money, would you redeem it right away?
entries.answer: 不會，我會再等一陣子才贖回。
entries.answerPinyin: bú huì, wǒ huì zài děng yí zhèn zi cái shú huí.
entries.answerEnglish: No, I'd wait a while before redeeming it.

entries.example: 這座雕像只有軀幹，沒有頭。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè zuò diāo xiàng zhǐ yǒu qū gàn, méi yǒu tóu.
entries.exampleEnglish: This statue has only a torso, no head.
entries.question: 你運動時會練軀幹的肌肉嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ yùn dòng shí huì liàn qū gàn de jī ròu ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you train your torso muscles when you work out?
entries.answer: 會，我每週都練軀幹的肌肉。
entries.answerPinyin: huì, wǒ měi zhōu dōu liàn qū gàn de jī ròu.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I train my core every week.

entries.example: 美術館正在辦一位畫家的回顧展。
entries.examplePinyin: měi shù guǎn zhèng zài bàn yí wèi huà jiā de huí gù zhǎn.
entries.exampleEnglish: The art museum is holding a retrospective of a painter.
entries.question: 你看過哪位藝術家的回顧展？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ kàn guò nǎ wèi yì shù jiā de huí gù zhǎn?
entries.questionEnglish: Which artist's retrospective have you seen?
entries.answer: 我看過草間彌生的回顧展。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ kàn guò cǎo jiān mí shēng de huí gù zhǎn.
entries.answerEnglish: I've seen a Yayoi Kusama retrospective.

entries.example: 我們涉水走過一條小溪。
entries.examplePinyin: wǒ men shè shuǐ zǒu guò yì tiáo xiǎo xī.
entries.exampleEnglish: We waded across a stream.
entries.question: 你爬山時有涉水過溪嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ pá shān shí yǒu shè shuǐ guò xī ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever waded across a stream while hiking?
entries.answer: 有，我爬山時涉水過好幾次。
entries.answerPinyin: yǒu, wǒ pá shān shí shè shuǐ guò hǎo jǐ cì.
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've waded across streams several times while hiking.

entries.example: 他是一名軍校生，週末才能回家。
entries.examplePinyin: tā shì yì míng jūn xiào shēng, zhōu mò cái néng huí jiā.
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a military cadet and can only go home at weekends.
entries.question: 你覺得軍校生的生活辛苦嗎？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de jūn xiào shēng de shēng huó xīn kǔ ma?
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think a cadet's life is hard?
entries.answer: 很辛苦，軍校生每天都要很早起床。
entries.answerPinyin: hěn xīn kǔ, jūn xiào shēng měi tiān dōu yào hěn zǎo qǐ chuáng.
entries.answerEnglish: Very hard; cadets have to get up very early every day.

entries.example: 這個充電器跟我的手機不相容。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè ge chōng diàn qì gēn wǒ de shǒu jī bù xiāng róng.
entries.exampleEnglish: This charger isn't compatible with my phone.
entries.question: 你的電腦跟哪個軟體不相容？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ de diàn nǎo gēn nǎ gè ruǎn tǐ bù xiāng róng?
entries.questionEnglish: Which software isn't compatible with your computer?
entries.answer: 我的電腦跟一個舊遊戲不相容。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ de diàn nǎo gēn yí gè jiù yóu xì bù xiāng róng.
entries.answerEnglish: My computer isn't compatible with an old game.

entries.example: 這部電影的主角是一名刺客。
entries.examplePinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng de zhǔ jué shì yì míng cì kè.
entries.exampleEnglish: The main character of this film is an assassin.
entries.question: 有哪部電影的主角是刺客？
entries.questionPinyin: yǒu nǎ bù diàn yǐng de zhǔ jué shì cì kè?
entries.questionEnglish: Which films have an assassin as the main character?
entries.answer: 《刺客聶隱娘》的主角就是刺客。
entries.answerPinyin: 《 cì kè niè yǐn niáng 》 de zhǔ jué jiù shì cì kè.
entries.answerEnglish: The main character of The Assassin is an assassin.

entries.example: 台灣正在發展再生能源。
entries.examplePinyin: tái wān zhèng zài fā zhǎn zài shēng néng yuán.
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan is developing renewable energy.
entries.question: 你覺得哪種再生能源最好？
entries.questionPinyin: nǐ jué de nǎ zhǒng zài shēng néng yuán zuì hǎo?
entries.questionEnglish: Which renewable energy do you think is best?
entries.answer: 我覺得太陽能是最好的再生能源。
entries.answerPinyin: wǒ jué de tài yáng néng shì zuì hǎo de zài shēng néng yuán.
entries.answerEnglish: I think solar is the best renewable energy.

entries.example: 警察抓到了偷機車的竊賊。
entries.examplePinyin: jǐng chá zhuā dào le tōu jī chē de qiè zéi.
entries.exampleEnglish: The police caught the thief who stole scooters.
entries.question: 怎麼做可以讓竊賊比較難進家裡？
entries.questionPinyin: zěn me zuò kě yǐ ràng qiè zéi bǐ jiào nán jìn jiā lǐ?
entries.questionEnglish: What can make it harder for burglars to get into a home?
entries.answer: 出門鎖好門窗，竊賊就比較難進來。
entries.answerPinyin: chū mén suǒ hǎo mén chuāng, qiè zéi jiù bǐ jiào nán jìn lái.
entries.answerEnglish: If you lock the doors and windows when you go out, burglars find it harder to get in.
